properties.label: Camp Spot + Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■車中泊公認で一台500円、料金詳細
■入浴♨️：「吉野地区活性化センター」で入浴が可能（温泉♨️）、300円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：吉野公園キャンプ場の駐車場です。ここはテント泊1張¥500、キャンピングカー1台¥500と破格。夜間も利用可能です。利用時は向かいにある吉野地区活性化センターにて受付。入浴施設(小さいですが…)もあり¥300で利用出来ます！入浴施設：利用可能日、火、水、土、日。利用時間10月～5月：15時～19時。6月～9月：14時～21時。利用料金：清掃協力金として、大人300円　中学生以下200円。（注意）石鹸やタオルなどは置いておりませんのでご用意ください。…となってますが、リンスインシャンプーとボディソープはセンターの好意で置いてあります。タオルは持参必須！トイレはウォシュレット無しですが、比較的綺麗です。ペーパーも有り。夜間も利用可能です。炊事場もトイレ出入口横にあります。開設期間：4月下旬（雪解け後）～10月下旬（2025年は、4月29日～10月31日チェックアウト）利用時間：チェックイン13時～チェックアウト10時。利用方法：予約不要のキャンプ場。チェックインが火・水・土・日曜日の場合：到着後、キャンプ場向かいの施設（吉野地区活性化センター）で受付。吉野地区活性化センターが開館する前に到着した場合は、センター開館後に受付をしてください。（13時以降であれば、受付前でもキャンプ場は利用できます。）　▼吉野地区活性化センターの開館時間・4月～5月、10月：15時～。6月～9月：14時～。チェックインが月・木・金曜日の場合、当日の夕刻または翌日の朝に施設管理人が集金にうかがいます。＜問い合わせ ＞吉野地区活性化センター 電話：0125-73-2632  (新十津川HPより) ここはシーズン1度は必ず利用する大好きな場所です。入浴して1泊しても¥800で利用でき、ハイシーズンを避ければ昼も夜も静かで快適です！春と秋シーズンがおすすめ。周辺には何もありません。センターと郵便局のみ…コンビニは無し、コカ・コーラ自動販売機がセンター入口に有り。（投稿：2026年4月、北のバグトラッカー様）
properties.desc_en:
■ Overnight stays in vehicles are permitted for 500 yen per vehicle. Details of fees apply.
■ Bathing ♨️: Bathing is available at the "Yoshino District Revitalization Center" (hot spring ♨️), 300 yen. Details.
■ Report from a reader of this site: This is the parking lot at Yoshino Park Campground. It's incredibly cheap here: 500 yen per tent and 500 yen per campervan. It's also available at night. When using the facilities, please register at the Yoshino District Revitalization Center across the street. There's also a bathing facility (small, but...) that you can use for 300 yen! Bathing facility: Available days: Tuesday, Wednesday, Saturday, Sunday. Hours: October-May: 3 PM - 7 PM. June-September: 2 PM - 9 PM. Usage fee: As a cleaning cooperation fee, 300 yen for adults, 200 yen for junior high school students and younger. (Note) Soap and towels are not provided, so please bring your own. ...However, rinse-in shampoo and body soap are provided courtesy of the center. Bringing your own towel is essential! The toilets do not have bidets, but they are relatively clean. Toilet paper is also provided. They can be used at night. There is also a cooking area next to the toilet entrance. Opening period: Late April (after snow melts) to late October (In 2025, check-out was from April 29th to October 31st). Usage time: Check-in 13:00 to check-out 10:00. How to use: No reservation required. If checking in on Tuesday, Wednesday, Saturday, or Sunday: After arrival, please register at the facility across from the campsite (Yoshino District Revitalization Center). If you arrive before the Yoshino District Revitalization Center opens, please register after the center opens. (You can use the campsite even before registration if it is after 13:00.) ▼Opening hours of the Yoshino District Revitalization Center: April-May, October: from 15:00. June-September: from 14:00. If checking in on Monday, Thursday, or Friday, the facility manager will come to collect payment in the evening of that day or the morning of the following day. <Inquiries> Yoshino District Revitalization Center Tel: 0125-73-2632 (From Shintotsukawa HP) This is one of my favorite places that I always use at least once a season. You can use the bath and stay overnight for only ¥800, and if you avoid the high season, it's quiet and comfortable both day and night! Spring and autumn seasons are recommended. There is nothing around. Only the center and post office...no convenience stores, but there is a Coca-Cola vending machine at the entrance of the center. (Posted by Kita no Bug Tracker, April 2026)

There are hot springs for general customers and for therapeutic bathers (lower water temperature), but you can use either. However, it might be a bit strong for people who don't like the smell of petroleum. (Posted: July 2023, by n)

■A very rare hot spring with a faint smell of petroleum. Free-flowing hot spring water. Rest room available. There are power outlets in the rest room where you can charge your PC. Cold water and tea are available. The jingisukan at the restaurant is very delicious and highly recommended.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 然別峡 鹿の湯（7月1日 〜 9月30日）
properties.desc_ja:
■無料の野湯。至高の名湯。詳細 ※7月1日 〜 9月30日
■管理人評価★5!!（泉質4.5、景色0.5+α）然別峡キャンプ場の奥にある。然別峡キャンプ場の開設期間（7月1日-9月30日）しか浴槽の掃除がされないので注意。掃除されてないと、藻が大量に付着、浮遊している。炊事場の左のわきに鹿の湯に下りる道がある。そんなに大変な道ではない。モスグリーンの濃厚な濁り湯で、湯船は茶色の析出物がびっしり。島根の温泉津温泉みたいな感じ。泉質満点4.5。そしてここは景色も非常に素晴らしい。全国トップレベルの景観。清冽な渓流が脇を流れており、広葉樹の森を一望できる。秋は最高でしょう。0.5満点。合計5点満点評価の超極上野湯。本当にすばらしいとしか言いようがない。虫（血を吸うブヨ）が大量にいるのでキンチョール必須。風呂から上がった瞬間に虫除けスプレーを付けるべき。とにかく非常にすばらしい。感動の野湯。管理人はこういう温泉が好きなのです。
properties.desc_en:
■Free wild hot spring. A supreme hot spring. Details *July 1st - September 30th
■Manager's rating ★5!! (Spring quality 4.5, Scenery 0.5+α) Located at the back of Shikaribetsu Gorge Campground. Note that the bath is only cleaned during the Shikaribetsu Gorge Campground's opening period (July 1st - September 30th). If it's not cleaned, a large amount of algae will be attached and floating in the water. There is a path leading down to Shika-no-yu to the left of the cooking area. It's not a very difficult path. The water is a thick, cloudy moss green, and the bath is covered with brown deposits. It's similar to Yunotsu Onsen in Shimane. Spring quality gets a perfect 4.5. And the scenery here is also very wonderful. One of the best views in the country. A clear stream flows beside it, and you can see a panoramic view of a broadleaf forest. Autumn must be the best. 0.5 out of 5. A superb wild hot spring with a total rating of 5 out of 5. There are no words to describe how truly wonderful it is. There are tons of insects (blood-sucking gnats), so insect repellent is a must. You should apply insect repellent spray the moment you get out of the bath. Anyway, it's absolutely wonderful. A truly moving natural hot spring. The caretaker loves hot springs like this.

■Report from our site's reader: It seems to have been renovated in 2015, and it is a very spacious and clean roadside station. The toilets are also among the cleanest of all roadside stations. There is a convenience store (Lawson) attached, and since it is close to the city center, there are supermarkets and gas stations nearby. It is along a national highway, but it is fairly quiet at night. The reason for this is that the bypass of National Route 337 is located some distance away, and it is thought that large vehicles use that route. The road to the roadside station is on National Route 337, which runs through an urban area, so there's a lot of traffic, but it gets quieter at night. However, it's a popular roadside station, so there's a lot of traffic and many cars idling, which can make it a little noisy. The roadside station has high-speed Wi-Fi, which can be accessed even from inside your car parked in the parking lot. There are no hot springs attached to the roadside station, but there are several nearby, so you shouldn't have any trouble finding a place to bathe. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Used on March 3rd, 2026 (2nd time). See attached image. Explanation of the areas in the photo. Red: Can be parked for relatively long periods of time. Blue: Area for check-in. Yellow: Waiting area for boarding. Green: Parking outside of terminal management. Using these areas is contingent on taking a ferry. (Except for the green area) For overnight stays in your car while waiting for the ferry, use the red area. This is used by people who are leaving their cars and going to Aomori, and they park here all day. If the red area is full, you can park in the green area, but it is separated from the FT area by a fence, so it is better to park closer to the entrance if you plan to use the FT. The FT is open 24 hours and has toilets, water refills, a cup noodle vending machine (with hot water), a TV, etc. For bathing, "Nishi Kikyo Health Ground (open 5:00-23:00 every day) details" is recommended for hot spring enthusiasts. If you want to save time and money, there are free showers on the ship. (Posted: March 2026, by tossan)

properties.desc_en: ■Free parking lot and public toilets that remain open even at night. Because it's in a residential area, there's a possibility of locals reporting it as a "suspicious person" living there. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.title_ja: 常盤パーキング 札幌市南区常盤の駐車帯
properties.title_en: Tokiwa Parking, a parking area in Tokiwa, Minami-ku, Sapporo.""
properties.desc_ja:
■夜は走り屋が来る場合がある。トイレは水洗洋式でキレイで良い。（2021年7月管理人現地確認）
■当サイト読者様レポート：国道４５３号線沿い。「チェーン脱着場」の案内があるが、２０台以上の駐車スペースがあり、トイレもある。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■At night, street racers may come. The toilets are clean and nice, with flushable Western-style toilets. (Confirmed on-site by the administrator in July 2021)
■Report from a reader of this site: Located along National Route 453. There is a sign for a "chain fitting area," but there is parking space for more than 20 cars and a toilet. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■夜はほとんど交通なく静か。長距離トラックは高速（無料区間）の方に行くため（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■It's quiet at night with almost no traffic. Long-distance trucks take the highway (free section) (older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: （トイレ不明）恵庭公園駐車場
properties.title_en: (Toilet facilities unknown) Eniwa Park Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■夜11時くらいになると消灯ですが、閉鎖はない模様。若者が溜まることもありますが、バカ騒ぎはしない。トイレは未確認。トイレ情報求む。
properties.desc_en: ■The lights are turned off around 11pm, but it doesn't seem to be closed down. Young people sometimes hang out here, but they don't make a racket. Toilets are unconfirmed. Toilet information is needed.

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja:
■網走刑務所とは別の場所にある。
■当サイト読者様レポート：博物館網走監獄 詳細 網走刑務所の旧建造物を保存公開している野外博物館。29月は監獄食を食べられる（10:0014:30）。入場料1080円（公式ページに割引クーポンあり） 9:0017:00（59月は8:3018:00）営業。
properties.desc_en:
■Located in a different place from Abashiri Prison.

■Report from our site's readers: Details of Abashiri Prison Museum An open-air museum preserving and displaying the former buildings of Abashiri Prison. Prison food is available in 29 months (10:00-14:30). Admission fee: 1080 yen (discount coupons available on the official website). Open 9:00-17:00 (8:30-18:00 in 59 months).

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.title_en: The spring water of your sleeve (Katsura water)
properties.desc_ja: ■網走郷土博物館下の踏切脇の林道のような細い道の先にある。案内等は無く、転回・離合には注意。
properties.desc_en: ■Located at the end of a narrow, forest-road-like path next to the railroad crossing below the Abashiri Local History Museum. There are no signs, so be careful when turning around or passing other vehicles.

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■網走監獄の食事を再現した人気の食堂。かなり美味い。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■A popular restaurant that recreates the meals served at Abashiri Prison. It's quite delicious. (Tabelog)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: きのこ王国 大滝本店
properties.desc_ja: ■名物きのこ汁110円。名水も無料で汲める。ホリエモンがここのお好み焼き「純々」を大絶賛。
properties.desc_en: ■Specialty mushroom soup 110 yen. You can also get pure spring water for free. Horie-san highly praised the okonomiyaki "Junjun" here.

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■霧多布湿原の南にあり展望台がある。南は海だが少し高台。道路には街灯が無いため星空観察に良い。車は極小。トイレあり。天体観測スポット。
properties.desc_en: ■Located south of the Kiritappu Marsh, there is an observation deck. The sea is to the south, but it is slightly elevated. There are no streetlights on the road, making it good for stargazing. Parking is very limited. There are toilets. A good spot for astronomical observation.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 浜益海浜公園 無料駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■無料駐車場と水洗トイレ。コンビニも近く便利。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Free parking and flush toilets. Conveniently located near a convenience store. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ（水洗洋式）。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。夜は静かでいいが、住宅街のど真ん中で早朝から地元民が集まってくる。（2024年6月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en: ■Free parking and public toilets (flush toilets, Western style). Confirmed that they are not closed at night. It's nice and quiet at night, but it's in the middle of a residential area and locals start gathering there early in the morning. (Confirmed by the administrator on-site in June 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間非常に静か。トイレは非常にキレイな簡易水洗の洋式＆ウォシュレット＆夜間電気付く。公衆トイレとしてハイグレード。難点としては、上のトイレに近い駐車場は水平な場所がほとんど無い。下の墓地の駐車場は水平で良いがトイレまで遠い。（2020年8月管理人現地確認）
■車中泊と心霊現象👻について
properties.desc_en:
■Free parking and public toilets. Very quiet at night. The toilets are very clean, simple flush toilets with Western-style toilets, bidet functions, and nighttime lighting. High-grade as public toilets. The downside is that there are almost no level spots in the parking lot near the upper toilets. The parking lot at the lower cemetery is level and good, but it's far from the toilets. (Confirmed on-site by the caretaker in August 2020)
■About overnight stays in cars and paranormal phenomena 👻

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間誰も来ないのでメチャクチャ静かでいいのだが、トイレが長期間掃除されていないようで、蜘蛛の巣が張っていて、枯れ葉とかが散乱している。簡易水洗の和式で、夜間も電気はつくし、一応水も流れるが、キレイとは言い難い。トイレがヤバイのを我慢すれば一応車中泊は可能。（2020年8月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en: ■Free parking and public toilets. It's incredibly quiet at night as no one comes, which is great, but the toilets don't seem to have been cleaned in a long time, as they're covered in cobwebs and scattered with dead leaves. They're simple flush toilets, and the lights work and the water does flow at night, but they're far from clean. If you can tolerate the awful toilets, it's possible to stay overnight in your car. (Confirmed by the administrator on-site in August 2020)

properties.label: Free Campground
properties.title_ja: 知内町農村公園（無料キャンプ場）
properties.desc_ja:
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。携帯電波OK。トイレは簡易水洗の和式。キレイとは言い難い。基本静かなのだが、定期的に貨物列車の通過音が響く。また、定期的に熊よけ？のパーンという音が響いている。こんな僻地なのに安眠のためには耳栓が必要で、微妙な感じ。（2022年6月管理人現地確認）
■無料キャンプ場。詳細。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed not to be closed at night. Cell phone reception is OK. The toilets are simple flush toilets (Japanese style). Not exactly clean. It's generally quiet, but the sound of passing freight trains can be heard periodically. Also, there's a periodic loud banging sound, possibly from bear deterrents. Despite being in such a remote location, earplugs are necessary for a good night's sleep, which is a bit of a mixed feeling. (Confirmed on-site by the caretaker in June 2022)
■Free campsite. Details. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 北海道駒ケ岳 六合目駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレは和式のポットンで当然ながら臭い。携帯電波ギリギリOK（ドコモ、SB）。難点としては、駐車場が未舗装かつ全体的にガッツリ傾斜している。あまりおすすめという感じはない。標高484m。（2023年9月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en: ■Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. The toilets are traditional Japanese-style pit toilets and, as expected, smelly. Cell phone reception is barely OK (Docomo, SoftBank). The downside is that the parking lot is unpaved and has a steep slope overall. Not really recommended. Elevation 484m. (Confirmed on-site by the administrator in September 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレは和式のポットン。携帯電波ギリギリOK。夜間超絶静か（静寂性Sランク）。治安については自己責任。駐車場全体に少し傾斜がある。（2023年8月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en: ■Free parking and public restrooms. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. The restrooms are Japanese-style pit toilets. Cell phone reception is barely OK. Extremely quiet at night (quietness level S). Safety is at your own risk. The entire parking lot has a slight slope. (Confirmed on-site by the caretaker in August 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレは和式のポットン。携帯電波OK。夜間非常に静か。治安については自己責任。（2022年8月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en: ■Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. The toilets are Japanese-style pit toilets. Cell phone reception is OK. Very quiet at night. Safety is at your own risk. (Confirmed on-site by the caretaker in August 2022)

properties.title_en: Parking lot of the Ayako Miura Memorial Literature Museum
properties.desc_ja:
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレは洋式のポットンだが、バイオトイレのため臭くなく、悪くない。トイレは夜間も電気つく。夜間非常に静か。住宅街のためパトカーの巡回＆職質の可能性が高い。（2022年7月管理人現地確認）
■当サイト読者様レポート：便所有り。水場有り。車中泊可能。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed they are not closed at night. The toilets are Western-style pit toilets, but they are bio-toilets so they don't smell and are not bad. The toilet lights are on at night. Very quiet at night. As it is a residential area, there is a high possibility of police patrols and questioning. (Confirmed on-site by administrator in July 2022)
■Report from a reader of this site: Toilets available. Water source available. Overnight parking possible. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 錦大沼公園 駐車場
properties.desc_ja:
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレは比較的きれいに管理されている簡易水洗で洋式もあり。携帯電波OK。夜間超絶静かで最高。素晴らしい。治安については自己責任。駐車場の近くに蝦夷鹿が集まる場合があり、夜中に鹿の鳴き声が響く場合あり。また、朝6時？ごろに謎の放送が大音量で響きそれで目が覚める（詳細な時間は失念）。（2022年6月管理人現地確認）
■当サイト読者様レポート：錦大沼の駐車場、静か、温泉ゆのみの湯が近い（大人600円）、オートキャンプ場アルテン近い（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed not to be closed at night. The toilets are relatively clean, simple flush toilets, and include Western-style toilets. Cell phone reception is OK. Extremely quiet at night, fantastic. Wonderful. Safety is at your own risk. Hokkaido deer sometimes gather near the parking lot, and you may hear their cries at night. Also, a mysterious loud announcement blares around 6 AM (I forget the exact time). (Confirmed on-site by the administrator in June 2022)
■Report from a reader of this site: Nishiki-Oonuma parking lot, quiet, close to Yunomi-no-Yu hot spring (600 yen for adults), close to Alten auto campsite (older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレは駐車場から少し歩くがキレイな簡易水洗で洋式もあり（詳細場所）。航空写真を見ると狭い駐車場のように見えるが、2022年に訪れたときは広く拡張されていて、奥の方に停めれば静かで良い。携帯電波OK。治安については自己責任。（2022年6月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en: ■Free parking and public restrooms. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. The restrooms are a short walk from the parking lot, but they are clean, simple flush toilets, and include Western-style toilets (see location for details). While the aerial photos make the parking lot appear small, when I visited in 2022, it had been expanded and is quiet and pleasant if you park in the back. Cell phone reception is OK. Safety is at your own risk. (Confirmed on-site by administrator in June 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレは駐車場から少し歩くが（詳細）、比較的キレイな水洗で洋式もあり。夜間は波の音が聞こえるくらいで基本静か。人気（ひとけ）は皆無なので治安については自己責任。（2023年8月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en: ■Free parking and public restrooms. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. The restrooms are a short walk from the parking lot (details), but they are relatively clean flush toilets, including Western-style ones. At night, it is generally quiet, with only the sound of waves audible. There are virtually no people around, so safety is your own responsibility. (Confirmed on-site by administrator in August 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 富士見ヶ丘公園 駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレは駐車場から少し歩くが、道路渡って向かいの公園管理棟の横（ココ）にある。簡易水洗の和式。夜間超絶静かで素晴らしい。坂の途中だがコストをかけてフラットに整地されている。携帯電波OK。（2022年7月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en: ■Free parking and public restrooms. Confirmed they are not closed at night. The restrooms are a short walk from the parking lot, across the road, next to the park management building (here). They are simple flush toilets in a Japanese style. It's incredibly quiet at night, which is wonderful. Although it's on a slope, the ground has been leveled to make it flat, at considerable expense. Cell phone reception is OK. (Confirmed on-site by the caretaker in July 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレは水洗和式。夜間非常に静か。治安については自己責任。（2022年7月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en: ■Free parking and public restrooms. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. The restrooms are flush toilets (Japanese style). Very quiet at night. Safety is at your own risk. (Confirmed on-site by the caretaker in July 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレは簡易水洗和式。夜間静か。治安については自己責任。（2023年8月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en: ■Free parking and public restrooms. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. The restrooms are simple flush toilets (Japanese style). Quiet at night. Safety is at your own risk. (Confirmed on-site by the caretaker in August 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレは簡易水洗の洋式で悪くない。携帯電波OK。夜中もちょちょい地元民？が休憩に来る、大型船のエンジン音が低周波音で響いてくる、夜中に何度も起きてしまった。特におすすめという感じは無い。（2022年6月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en: ■Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed they are not closed at night. The toilets are Western-style with simple flushing and are not bad. Cell phone reception is OK. Locals seem to come here to rest occasionally in the middle of the night, and the low-frequency sound of large ship engines is audible, waking me up several times during the night. I wouldn't particularly recommend it. (Confirmed on-site by the administrator in June 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレは簡易水洗で洋式もあり。夜間超絶静か。携帯電波OK。治安については自己責任。（2023年8月管理人現地確認）
■車中泊と心霊現象👻について
properties.desc_en:
■Free parking and public restrooms. Confirmed not to be closed at night. Restrooms are simple flush toilets, and Western-style toilets are also available. Extremely quiet at night. Cell phone reception is OK. Safety is at your own risk. (Confirmed on-site by the administrator in August 2023)
■Regarding overnight stays in vehicles and paranormal phenomena 👻

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレは仮設の和式ポットンで臭い。駐車場はフラットに整地されている。夜景の有名スポットのためDQNが来る場合あり。人気（ひとけ）は皆無なので治安については自己責任。（2023年8月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en: ■Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. The toilets are temporary Japanese-style pit toilets and smell bad. The parking lot is level and flat. As it is a famous spot for night views, there may be some troublemakers. There are virtually no people around, so safety is your own responsibility. (Confirmed on-site by administrator in August 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: さくらの滝 駐車場
properties.desc_ja:
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレは仮設の簡易水洗和式で臭い。夜間超絶静か（静寂性Sランク）。難点としては熊が出る可能性あるのと、携帯が圏外なので注意。（2023年8月管理人現地確認）
■当サイト読者様レポート：神の子池近くのさくらマスの滝登りが見れます。７.8月の夕方お勧め。駐車場所にトイレ（仮設）あり、熊出没の看板あり、ダート、静か、道の駅札弦（道の駅 パパスランドさっつる）が近いので無理に泊らない方がいいです。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. The toilets are temporary, simple flush toilets and smelly. Extremely quiet at night (quietness rank S). The downsides are the possibility of bears and the lack of cell phone reception. (Confirmed on-site by administrator in August 2023)
■Report from a reader of this site: You can see cherry salmon swimming up the waterfall near Kaminoko Pond. Recommended in the evenings of July and August. There are toilets (temporary) at the parking area, there are signs warning of bear sightings, the road is unpaved, it's quiet, and since Michi-no-Eki Satsuru (Michi-no-Eki Papasland Satsuru) is nearby, it's better not to stay overnight. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレはポットンだが洋式もあり。当然ながら臭い。駐車場は全体的に傾斜があり、比較的水平な場所は数台分のみ。携帯電波はドコモ、SBともにギリギリ通信可能。標高677m。苫小牧市街が酷暑だったのでここに来たが、涼しく快適に朝まで爆睡。夜間は超絶静かだが、早朝から登山者が続々と集まって騒がしくなる。（2023年8月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en: ■Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. The toilets are pit toilets, but there are also Western-style toilets. Naturally, they smell. The parking lot is generally sloped, with only a few relatively level spaces. Cell phone reception is barely possible for both Docomo and SoftBank. Elevation 677m. I came here because it was scorching hot in Tomakomai city, but it was cool and comfortable, and I slept soundly until morning. It is extremely quiet at night, but it gets noisy from early morning as hikers start gathering in droves. (Confirmed on-site by the administrator in August 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 野幌自然公園駐車場（登満別口）
properties.title_en: Nopporo Nature Park Parking Lot (Tomanbetsu Entrance)
properties.desc_ja:
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレはキレイな水洗で洋式もあり。夜間超絶静か（静寂性Sランク）。静かで空気がキレイで良いのだが、残念ながら携帯が圏外（ドコモ、SB）。一応電波はギリギリ掴むが、通信が不可状態。また、人気（ひとけ）皆無なので治安については自己責任。（2023年8月管理人現地確認）
■無料駐車場とトイレ。森の中で非常に気持ちが良い。人気皆無。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed they are not closed at night. The toilets are clean, flush toilets, and include Western-style toilets. Extremely quiet at night (quietness level S). It's quiet and the air is clean, which is great, but unfortunately, there is no cell phone signal (Docomo, SoftBank). You can barely pick up a signal, but communication is impossible. Also, there are absolutely no people around, so safety is your own responsibility. (Confirmed on-site by the administrator in August 2023)

■Free parking and toilets. Very pleasant in the middle of the forest. Absolutely no people around. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレはキレイな水洗で洋式もあり。難点としては非常に交通量の多い幹線国道沿いのため、大型トラックもバンバン走りうるさい。車中泊禁止的な張り紙は特に無かった。他の方のレポートにあるように、冬は駐車禁止なのかもしれない。（2022年8月管理人現地確認）
■当サイト読者様レポート：倶知安町のマックスバリュ向かいのトイレは車中泊不可です。除雪の妨げにもなりますので。そのような記載もあります。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：マックスバリュの斜め前で、自動販売機と綺麗なトイレがある。道路沿いなのでうるさいかも・・（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Free parking and public restrooms. Confirmed not to be closed at night. The restrooms are clean, flush toilets, and include Western-style toilets. The downside is that it's located along a very busy national highway, so large trucks pass by frequently, making it noisy. There were no signs specifically prohibiting overnight parking. As other reports indicate, parking may be prohibited in winter. (Administrator's on-site confirmation, August 2022)
■Report from a reader of this site: Overnight parking is not allowed at the restroom across from MaxValu in Kutchan Town. It also hinders snow removal. There is a notice to that effect. (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from a reader of this site: There are vending machines and clean restrooms diagonally across from MaxValu. It might be noisy as it's along the road... (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレはキレイな水洗で洋式もあり。長万部から日本海側に抜ける幹線道沿いで、トラックの走行音がエグい（時速100km以上で爆走している）。安眠は難しい。（2022年6月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en: ■Free parking and public restrooms. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. The restrooms are clean, flush toilets, and include Western-style toilets. Located along the main road that goes from Oshamanbe to the Sea of ​​Japan side, the noise from trucks is terrible (they speed at over 100 km/h). Getting a good night's sleep is difficult. (Confirmed on-site by the administrator in June 2022)

Trucks are parked overnight, and their vehicles are idling all night. There is traffic coming and going at the interchange all night. (Confirmed on-site by administrator in July 2022)
■Report from a reader of this site: It's not crowded with cars, the restrooms are clean, and it's quiet because it's on the outskirts of town. It's perfect for overnight stays in your car. The restrooms are clean and it's quiet at night. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_en: ■Free parking and public restrooms. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. The restrooms (details) appear to have been recently built, are clean, and include Western-style toilets. Very quiet at night. Cell phone reception is OK. The downside is that the parking lot is unpaved, so you might be woken up by the crunching sound of cars entering at night. Also, since it is a park in a residential area, locals will be extremely wary of you. (Confirmed on-site by administrator in July 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot

properties.desc_en: ■Free parking and public toilets. The toilets are Western-style bio-toilets. They are not flush toilets, but they are clean, well-maintained, and odorless. Cell phone reception is just barely OK. Basically, there are no people around, making it wonderfully quiet. There is a forest to the east, so you can relax in the shade until late in the morning. Safety is your own responsibility, but a good night's sleep is guaranteed. (Confirmed on-site by the caretaker in August 2021)

■当サイト読者様レポート：現地まで行きましたが、パークゴルフ場のトイレ兼パーキングでした。早朝からのパークゴルフ利用者が見込まれたため、利用を控えました。利用するならば早めの出発が良いかもしれません。夏の勝毎花火大会時も利用できないようです。詳細 詳細（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:

Since it's a park golf course, local elderly people gather there from early morning. There are police patrols. (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from a reader of this site: I went to the site, but it was a restroom and parking lot for a park golf course. Since park golfers were expected to be there from early morning, I refrained from using it. If you do use it, it might be best to leave early. It also seems that it cannot be used during the Kachimai Fireworks Festival in summer. Details Details (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_en:
■Free, mixed-gender open-air hot spring. No changing rooms or other facilities. The road towards Shirogane Onsen is closed during winter.

■In summer, there's always someone in the bath from morning till night. In the mornings and evenings, the parking lot gets shaded, so it's recommended to bathe around 4 PM, rest in the shade until sunset (around 7 PM), then move to Tokachidake Bogakudai (the parking lot is hot as there's no shade) and sleep in your car. The next day, when the sun comes up, Tokachidake Bogakudai gets hot, so move back there for a morning bath and rest in the shade until the shops in Furano open.

properties.label: Restaurant

■非常に美味い上に価格も良心的。11時開店だが、7時前に来て順番待ちの紙に名前を書いておくとよい。ガチ朝どれのウニ丼が滅茶苦茶美味い。積丹でウニ丼食うなら、みさきよりもこっちの方がおすすめ。店舗詳細、食べログ
■ウニ丼は本当に神恵内で採れた朝どれのウニしか使ってないので、天気が悪い日、風の強い日はウニ丼は無しなので注意。また、一回雨が降ると、数日間川から土砂が流れ込んで海が濁ってウニ漁ができないので、雨が降ったあと2日間くらいは晴れでもウニが無い場合がある。天気予報を要確認。天気予報（0-6時の風速にも注目）。ここのウニ丼は本物です。当サイト管理人も毎年リピートしてます。晴れが3日以上続いて、当日朝の風速が2m以下の日を狙って行きます（ウニ丼のため）。（2024年6月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■Incredibly delicious and reasonably priced. They open at 11am, but it's best to arrive before 7am and write your name on the waiting list. Their sea urchin rice bowl, made with genuinely freshly caught sea urchins, is unbelievably delicious. If you're going to eat a sea urchin rice bowl in Shakotan, this place is more recommended than Misaki. Store details, Tabelog

■Their sea urchin rice bowls only use sea urchins caught that morning in Kaminai, so be aware that they won't serve sea urchin rice bowls on bad weather or windy days. Also, if it rains, sediment flows in from the river for several days, making the sea muddy and preventing sea urchin fishing. Therefore, even if it's sunny, there may be no sea urchins for about two days after it rains. Check the weather forecast. (Pay attention to the wind speed from 0am to 6am). The sea urchin rice bowls here are the real deal. The administrator of this site is a repeat customer every year. I aim for days with three or more consecutive sunny days and a morning wind speed of 2m/s or less (for the sake of the sea urchin rice bowl). (Administrator's on-site verification, June 2024)

properties.desc_en:

■Report from a reader of this site: Free public parking? Seems to be for tourists going to Kawayu Onsen. There is a toilet building, but it appears to be closed. There is a Seicomart (6 AM - 12 AM) within easy walking distance. Not crowded even during the peak of Golden Week, and very quiet at night. There are streetlights, so it seems reasonably safe. The fact that the toilets themselves are closed is a negative point, but there are many convenience stores and small restaurants nearby, and plenty of day-trip hot springs in the famous Kawayu Onsen, so we stayed for two days. Day trip hot springs used: ① Oyado Kinkiyu (details) 13:00-20:00 ¥1,000 High-quality hot spring water flowing directly from the source in an indoor bath with temperature differences and a semi-open-air bath. ② Kawayu Public Bath Yukichi Details: A very clean public bath that was renovated in September 2024. Reasonably priced at ¥500, but shampoo and soap are not provided (available for purchase separately). (Posted: May 2025, by Minimogu)

■2018年、ネットで調べて安いという理由で管理人も行ってみましたが、入ってみてビックリ、泉質が凄い！！100%源泉かけ流し、塩素添加なしで、手触りがヌルンヌルン！管理人も全国いろんな温泉入ってきましたが、ここまでのヌルヌルは非常に珍しい。宮城県中山平温泉しんとろの湯と並んで全国トップクラスのヌルヌル。湯上がりの清々しさが素晴らしい。ここは絶対おすすめ。ちなみにロッカーなし、シャワーなし、アメニティなし、風呂が狭い。名湯認定させていただきます。すばらしい湯で感動しました。

■In 2018, I (the administrator) went there because it was cheap after researching online, but I was surprised when I got in—the water quality is amazing!! 100% natural hot spring water, no chlorine added, and it feels incredibly smooth! I (the administrator) have been to many hot springs throughout Japan, but this level of smoothness is extremely rare. It's among the top in the country for smoothness, alongside Shintoro no Yu in Nakayamadaira Onsen, Miyagi Prefecture. The refreshing feeling after bathing is wonderful. I highly recommend this place. By the way, there are no lockers, no showers, no amenities, and the bath is small. I'm giving it the title of a famous hot spring. I was deeply impressed by the wonderful water.

properties.desc_en:

According to hot spring enthusiasts, 2250 yen for a day trip is expensive, but it's worth it; it's meaningless to come to Noboribetsu without coming here. In summer, the open-air bath is swarming with blood-sucking horseflies, so bringing insect repellent is recommended. 9 types of hot springs.
■Manager's rating: ★4.8 (4.5 out of 5 for water quality, 0.3 for the spectacular view of Jigokudani) It's unusually expensive at 2250 yen, but it's something you should experience at least once. You can see Jigokudani through the glass from the bathhouse.

properties.title_ja: （移転）帯広豚丼 ぶた丼のとん田
properties.desc_ja:
■豚丼の有名店、ぶた丼のとん田が2017/8/1、ここに移転。広い駐車場完備だが、連休時は開店30分前には満車になってしまう。満車の場合は、ここの北にパチンコ屋があるのでそこに停めて歩いてくるとよい。
■ここは、バラ、ロース、ヒレから選べる。最初はとりあえずバラとロースの盛り合わせがオススメ。駐車場あり。もの凄い行列になるので、開店の40分以上前か、あるいは午後3時くらいに行くと良い。机の上にある「にんにく一味」なるものを振りかけて食べるとヤバいくらい美味しいことを発見。ここはホントに美味いですね。おすすめのお店。食べログ
properties.desc_en:
■Butadon no Tonda, a famous pork bowl restaurant, relocated here on August 1st, 2017. It has a large parking lot, but it fills up 30 minutes before opening during long weekends. If the parking lot is full, there's a pachinko parlor north of here where you can park and walk.

■Here you can choose from pork belly, loin, or tenderloin. For your first visit, I recommend the combination of pork belly and loin. Parking is available. There's a huge line, so it's best to go at least 40 minutes before opening, or around 3 PM. I discovered that sprinkling the "garlic chili powder" on the table makes it incredibly delicious. This place is truly delicious. Highly recommended. (Tabelog)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：良い。無料で利用でき、トイレ夜間閉鎖無し（22:00頃確認）。トイレは和式1つ、洋式1つ、小便器3つ。自動ドア＋通常ドアで中もとても綺麗。ステンドグラスがあり面白く、綺麗。駐車場は県道の真隣だが、夜間交通量は少なく静か奥まったところに停めれば更に静か。東側に木が植えられ、明け方も日陰になり涼しく、暗くて良い。駐車場からは羊蹄山が大きく望め景色も良い。22:30頃パトカーが巡回に来たのでパトロールルートなのかも。職質はされなかった。おすすめです。（投稿：2024年8月、s様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Good. It's free to use, and the toilets aren't closed at night (confirmed around 10:00 PM). There's one Japanese-style toilet, one Western-style toilet, and three urinals. There's an automatic door and a regular door, and the inside is very clean. There's stained glass, which is interesting and beautiful. The parking lot is right next to the prefectural road, but there's little traffic at night, and it's quiet if you park further back. There are trees planted on the east side, so it's shaded and cool even in the early morning, and it's nice and dark. You can see Mt. Yotei clearly from the parking lot, and the view is good. A police car came by around 10:30 PM, so it might be a patrol route. I wasn't stopped or questioned. I recommend it. (Submitted by: s, August 2024)

properties.label: Free Campground
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：料金無料。風呂：車で5分のところに利尻富士町温泉保養施設 利尻富士温泉があります。利尻山登山の拠点になる場所です。時期により止められないこともあると思います。第一駐車場・第二駐車場ともに管理小屋の方に聞いたら車中泊OKだそうです。ペット同乗の場合は難しいかもしれません。全体的に傾斜あります、第一駐車場管理小屋側の奥から３台分はほぼ平坦です。登山の為に早朝（３時過ぎから動き始める方もいます）登山拠点なのでご理解ください。私も20：00就寝3：30起で上りましたがぐっすり眠れました。標高207m（投稿：2024年7月、i様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free of charge. Bath: Rishiri Fuji Onsen, a hot spring resort in Rishiri Fuji Town, is a 5-minute drive away. This is a base for climbing Mount Rishiri. Depending on the season, parking may not be available. I asked the staff at the management hut for both the first and second parking lots, and they said overnight parking is OK. It may be difficult if you have pets with you. The whole area is sloped, but the three spaces at the back of the first parking lot near the management hut are almost flat. Please understand that this is a base for climbing, so people start moving early in the morning (some start moving after 3 am). I also went to bed at 8 pm and woke up at 3:30 am to climb, but I slept soundly. Elevation 207m (Posted: July 2024, by i)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：料金無料　トイレあり（バイオトイレ）　夜間閉鎖なし。携帯電波　ドコモがギリ・・・　水場なし。駐車台数は区画されてるところで１２～１４台それ以外も含めれば３０台くらい。区画されてるところはほぼ水平。登山道の入り口なので夜は静かですが朝早くから登る人もいるため朝は早いです。また下の東大雪荘までも林道ですが、さらに険しい林道が約8ｋｍつずきます。車高の低い車は到達が難しいと思います。私はハイエーススーパーロング4ＷＤで東大雪荘から３０分掛けて何とか到着しました。（投稿：2024年8月、i様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free admission, toilets available (bi-toilets), no closures at night. Cell phone signal: Docomo barely works... No water source. Parking capacity: 12-14 cars in the designated area, and about 30 cars including other areas. The designated area is almost level. It's quiet at night because it's the entrance to the hiking trail, but it gets busy early in the morning as some people start climbing early. Also, the road down to Higashi-Taisetsu-so is a forest road, but it's an even steeper forest road that continues for about 8 km. I think it would be difficult for low-clearance cars to reach it. I managed to arrive in 30 minutes from Higashi-Taisetsu-so in my Hiace Super Long 4WD. (Submitted by i in August 2024)

Toilets: Japanese style, it is dark so electricity is necessary, toilet paper is available, and the outdoor water tap is usable (usable from Golden Week to mid-October). Noise: Voices and sounds from people at the pool, and children playing in the park. It is relatively quiet as it is far from the national highway. Hot springs: Takikawa Fureai no Sato is about a 10-minute drive away. Lawson is 2 minutes away, 7-Eleven is 5 minutes away, and Aeon is 8 minutes away. (Submitted by: t, October 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：優良認定がありませんが、日本最東端納沙布岬に最も近いスポットなので日の出を見るために車中泊に使う人が多そうなことから、レビューを投稿させていただこうと思います。駐車場に関してですが、全体に海側に向かって下がる向きにきつめの傾斜が付いてます。駐車スペースがすべて傾斜に対して真横なので、スペーサーか何かないと不快感が強いかもしれません。奥の大型スペースは少し傾斜が緩い感じがしましたが、明るくなると早い時間から観光バスなどが入ってくるので、本当に日の出を見るための仮眠程度以上の良質な睡眠を取るには適していないと感じました。普通に眠るのであれば根室市街の数少ないスポットである明治公園の駐車場がおすすめです。傾斜もなく静かに寝れます。今回はそれらのことがあり寝る前に明治公園に移動してしまいました。根室の周辺は原野が多くて開かれた駐車場が少ないことからか車中泊スポットが少ないものの、日本最東端に最も近い拠点でありそこそこ旅人の集まる場所でもあるので、これから開拓が進むといいですね。今度行った時は私も探してみようと思います。（投稿：2020年9月）
■当サイト読者様レポート：24時間使える綺麗なトイレ+自販機有り。納沙布岬からの日の出を見る際の車中泊にオススメ。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: Although it doesn't have a rating as a top-rated spot, I thought I'd submit a review because it's the closest spot to Cape Nosappu, Japan's easternmost point, and I imagine many people use it for overnight stays in their cars to watch the sunrise. Regarding the parking lot, the entire area has a steep slope that goes down towards the sea. All the parking spaces are directly sideways to the slope, so it might be quite uncomfortable without spacers or something. The large space at the back seemed to have a slightly gentler slope, but tour buses and other vehicles start coming in early once it gets light, so I felt it wasn't suitable for getting a good night's sleep beyond a short nap to watch the sunrise. If you just want to sleep normally, I recommend the parking lot at Meiji Park, one of the few spots in Nemuro city. There's no slope and you can sleep peacefully. Because of these reasons, I ended up moving to Meiji Park before going to sleep this time. There are many open fields around Nemuro and not many open parking lots, so there aren't many spots for overnight stays in cars, but it's the closest base to Japan's easternmost point and a place where a fair number of travelers gather, so I hope it will be developed further in the future. I'll try to find one myself next time I go. (Posted: September 2020)
■Report from our site's reader: Clean toilets available 24 hours a day + vending machines. Recommended for overnight stays in your car when watching the sunrise from Cape Nosappu. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料駐車場、トイレあり。土日祝日を外せば、めちゃくちゃ静かです。街灯がないので星もキレイに見えます。金曜の夜に泊まったときは、花火で大騒ぎする若者がいました。朝6時と夜22時にはすぐ隣にある自衛隊基地からラッパが聞こえます。（投稿：2021年9月、参拝業者えーご様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free parking and restrooms available. It's incredibly quiet if you avoid weekends and holidays. There are no streetlights, so you can see the stars beautifully. When I stayed there on a Friday night, there were some young people making a lot of noise with fireworks. You can hear bugles from the Self-Defense Force base right next door at 6 AM and 10 PM. (Submitted by: Eigo, a shrine visitor, September 2021)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 相泊温泉 あいどまりおんせん（無料）
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料で入れます。地元の方の善意です。海の方向以外は、目隠しあり、屋根もあり、石鹸使用可能、洗面器あり。脱衣場所も浴槽の横です。貴重品も大丈夫、車で行ける端しっこの温泉、太平洋を見ながら夕日が最高です。行き止まり日本最北、最東の無料温泉です。駐車場所から歩いて3分、持参石鹸利用出来ます。源泉掛け流し。脱衣場所目の前のため貴重品も安心です。男女別にわかれてます。女性も安心して入浴できます。海側だけ開放されてます。国後島からの日ノ出が見れるかも。 私は、夕方でした。地元の方が掃除してくれます。挨拶しましょう。熊の湯みたいにうるさい人いないし、いごごちよし。駐車場所は、少なく車中泊は、迷惑になると思います。まだ先の漁港にキャンプされている方いましたが、熊出没、自己責任、電線が張ってあります。大丈夫かな？キャンプ場か道の駅がお勧めと思います。隣の瀬底温泉は、満潮時で入浴出来ませんでした。駐車場所せまいので車中泊無理です。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: It's free to enter. It's thanks to the kindness of the locals. There are screens for privacy on all sides except the ocean, there's a roof, you can use soap, and there are washbasins. The changing area is next to the bath. Your valuables are safe, it's a hot spring at the very edge of the world that you can reach by car, and the sunset overlooking the Pacific Ocean is amazing. It's the northernmost and easternmost free hot spring in Japan, at the end of a road. It's a 3-minute walk from the parking area, and you can use your own soap. It's a natural hot spring with free-flowing water. Your valuables are safe as the changing area is right in front of you. It's separated for men and women. Women can bathe with peace of mind. Only the ocean side is open. You might be able to see the sunrise from Kunashir Island. I went in the evening. The locals clean it up, so be sure to say hello. There aren't any noisy people like at Kuma-no-yu, and it's very comfortable. There are few parking spaces, so I think it would be a nuisance to park overnight in your car. There were people camping at the fishing port further down the road, but bears have been sighted, so it's at your own risk, and there are power lines strung up. Is it really safe? I think a campsite or roadside station would be better. The nearby Sesoko Onsen was closed due to high tide, so we couldn't bathe there. The parking area is small, so overnight stays in a car are not possible.

properties.label: Free Campground
properties.title_ja: 寿都浜中野営場（北海道寿都町）
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料キャンプ場ですが車中泊可能。アクセスは寿都温泉ゆべつのゆまで車で5分。買い出しはセイコーマート歌棄店まで車で10分。綺麗なトイレがあり、トイレとは別に水道もあるので自炊洗濯可能。駐車場も多数あり。天候が悪かったため人気は皆無でした。国道からも離れているため基本は静かですが、近くに風力発電があるのでプロペラの音が気になりました。海が近く、寿都は風が強いので波に注意。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: This is a free campsite, but overnight stays in your car are permitted. Access is a 5-minute drive to Yubetsu no Yu hot spring in Suttsu. For shopping, Seicomart Utasuki store is a 10-minute drive away. There are clean toilets, and a separate water tap, so you can cook and do laundry. There are also plenty of parking spaces. Due to bad weather, there were no other visitors. It is generally quiet as it is far from the national highway, but the sound of the propellers from the nearby wind turbines was noticeable. It is close to the sea, and Suttsu is windy, so be careful of the waves. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Free Campground
properties.title_ja: うにまるキャンプ場〜NONA BASE〜
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料キャンプ場。水道あり（ただし飲用不可の表示あり）、トイレは24時間利用可能で洋式の仮説トイレですが綺麗に清掃されていました。ウォシュレットはありませんが私が行った際はお尻拭きのウェットティッシュが用意されていました。買い出しはセイコーマートが車で5分、温泉は神居脇温泉（詳細）まで車で20分程度。手前にうにまるのモニュメントや炊事場がありますがそこはキャンプ車中泊はできず、奥の柵の中でキャンプや車中泊ができるようです。キャンプ場内は芝で、場内に車の乗り入れも可能ですが豪雨時はぬかるむ可能性が高いのでお勧めしません。フェリーターミナルから近いので、朝のフェリーを利用する際はこの辺りで車中泊しておくと楽かと。静かで景色も良いが夏場はかなりアブがいます。またうにまるのモニュメントが22時頃までライトアップされている＆市街地から近いので星空鑑賞には不向きです（逆にいうと場内はまあまあ明るい）。ゴミはセイコーマートやニコットでバラ売り販売している奥尻町指定のゴミ袋を買えばフェリーターミナルの向かいのゴミ捨て場で処分できます。（投稿：2025年8月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free campsite. There is running water (but it is marked as not potable), and the toilets are Western-style portable toilets that are available 24 hours a day and were kept clean. There are no bidet toilets, but when I went there, wet wipes were provided. For shopping, there is a Seicomart convenience store a 5 minute drive away, and the Kamui-waki Onsen (details) is about a 20 minute drive away. There is a Unimaru monument and a cooking area in front, but camping and overnight stays in vehicles are not allowed there. It seems that camping and overnight stays in vehicles are allowed in the fenced area at the back. The campsite is covered in grass, and it is possible to drive your car onto the grounds, but it is not recommended during heavy rain as it is likely to become muddy. It is close to the ferry terminal, so if you are using the ferry in the morning, it would be convenient to stay overnight in your car around here. It is quiet and the scenery is nice, but there are a lot of horseflies in the summer. Also, the Unimaru monument is lit up until around 10pm and it is close to the city, so it is not suitable for stargazing (on the other hand, the campsite is fairly bright). You can dispose of your trash at the garbage disposal area across from the ferry terminal by purchasing the designated garbage bags for Okushiri Town, which are sold individually at Seicomart and Nicotto. (Posted by: M, August 2025)

properties.label: Free Campground
properties.title_ja: 賽の河原公園キャンプ場
properties.title_en: [Free Camp] Sai no Kawara Park Campground
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：無料キャンプ場。水道あり（ただし飲用不可）、24時間利用可能なトイレあり。周辺はお土産屋＆食事処以外に何もないので買い出しは車で15分ほどのセイコーマートで。風呂は島内唯一の温泉である神居脇温泉（詳細）まで車で30分くらい（島北側からのアプローチは普通車でもすれ違い困難の狭隘路を通るので走行注意。）。車止めの奥がキャンプ場になっており、車止めより奥に自動車は入れないが、バイクの方はキャンプ場の中にバイクを入れてキャンプをしていました。車中泊なら車止めより手前の駐車場を利用することになると思われますが、日中は併設のお土産屋＆食事処の駐車場のようなので、日中に利用する際はお店の人に一声かける必要があると思います。私が来訪した際（2025.8）は、奥のコンクリート造りのトイレは閉鎖されており、手前のログハウス風のトイレは利用可能でした。また、手前のログハウス風のトイレは、身障者用トイレは唯一洋式で、ウォシュレット設備がありましたが、私が来訪した際は故障中と書かれておりウォシュレットは使えませんでした。キャンプ場の奥には北海道南西沖地震の慰霊碑や霊場があるも、キャンプ場からは見えないのでそこまで気になりません。大変静かで景色は抜群ですが、遮るものがなく風が強いことがあるので注意。また北海道南西沖地震で甚大な被害を受けた場所なので、津波災害にも注意が必要。（投稿：2025年8月、m様）
■水道トイレ在り、傍にお土産食堂あり（夏季営業）、海側に霊場、夜は明るい。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's readers: Free campsite. There is running water (but it is not potable), and toilets are available 24 hours a day. There is nothing around except souvenir shops and restaurants, so you will need to drive 15 minutes to the Seicomart for supplies. For bathing, it is about a 30-minute drive to Kamui-waki Onsen (details), the only hot spring on the island (be careful when driving as the approach from the north side of the island is a narrow road where it is difficult for even regular cars to pass each other). The campsite is beyond the barrier, and cars cannot go beyond the barrier, but motorcyclists were able to park their bikes inside the campsite and camp. If you are staying overnight in your car, you will probably need to use the parking lot before the barrier, but during the day it seems to be the parking lot for the adjacent souvenir shop and restaurant, so you will need to ask the shop staff if you plan to use it during the day. When I visited (August 2025), the concrete toilet at the back was closed, but the log cabin-style toilet at the front was available. Also, the log cabin-style toilets at the front of the campsite were the only Western-style toilets with handicap facilities and bidet functions, but when I visited, a sign indicated they were out of order and the bidet was unusable. There are memorials and sacred sites for the Hokkaido Southwest Offshore Earthquake at the back of the campsite, but they are not visible from the campsite, so they are not a major concern. It is very quiet and the scenery is superb, but be aware that it can be windy as there is nothing to block the wind. Also, since this area suffered extensive damage from the Hokkaido Southwest Offshore Earthquake, caution is needed regarding tsunami disasters. (Posted: August 2025, by M)
■Water and toilets available, souvenir shop nearby (open in summer), sacred site on the seaside, bright at night. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: 豊浦海浜公園、有料キャンプ場（※<font color="red">キャンプ場開設期間中は車中泊禁止️</font>）
properties.title_en: 豊浦海浜Park、有料Campground（※<font color="red">Campground開設期間中は車中泊禁止️</font>）
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：北海道豊浦町にある、豊浦温泉しおさい横にありますが、キャンプ場シーズンが終わるとトイレとキャンプ場は閉鎖されます。車中泊は、難しい感じです。（投稿：2024年10月、様）
■公式に、キャンプ場開設期間中はここでの車中泊は禁止との記載あり。詳細：「豊浦海浜公園の無料駐車場は、キャンプ場をご予約いただいた方のみがご利用いただけます。駐車場内での車中泊や、キャンピングカーでのご利用はできません。キャンピングカーのお客さまは、高岡オートキャンプ場や礼文華海浜公園キャンプ場のオートサイトをご利用ください。」
■キャンプ場の開設期間：令和4年は7月16日（土）〜9月25日（日）詳細
■【キャンプ場利用料金】大人１人500円、小学生以下１人200円。トイレあり。海水浴場と一体の施設、隣は日帰り温泉。キャンプ場は北海道民が夜中までドンチャン騒ぎです。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: Located next to Toyoura Onsen Shiosai in Toyoura Town, Hokkaido, the toilets and campsite close after the camping season ends. Overnight stays in a vehicle seem difficult. (Submitted by: October 2024)
■Officially, it is stated that overnight stays in vehicles are prohibited here during the campsite's operating season. Details: "The free parking lot at Toyoura Seaside Park is only available to those who have made a campsite reservation. Overnight stays in vehicles or use of campervans are not permitted in the parking lot. Campervan users should use the auto sites at Takaoka Auto Campground or Rebunka Seaside Park Campground."
■Campsite operating period: July 16th (Sat) to September 25th (Sun), 2022. Details
■[Campsite usage fee] 500 yen per adult, 200 yen per child under elementary school age. Toilets available. The facility is integrated with the beach, and there is a day-use hot spring next door. The campsite is a place where Hokkaido residents party loudly until late at night.

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：北海道十勝をご旅行される方へ、私有地を開放します。場所は、音更・十勝川温泉街です。料金は基本的には無料ですが、少し条件はあります。トイレは一応敷地内にはありますが、出来るだけ近くの道の駅をご利用ください。基本、一組貸切。ご興味のある方は、ilikeslowann@yahoo.co.jpまで、ご連絡ください。ロケーション等はインスタグラムを参照👉️//www.instagram.com/slowannah（投稿：2023年10月、AH様）
