There is basically no charge, but there are a few conditions. There is a toilet on the property, but please use the one at the nearest roadside station if possible. Basically, it is reserved for one group at a time. If you are interested, please contact ilikeslowann@yahoo.co.jp. See Instagram for location details 👉️//www.instagram.com/slowannah (Posted: October 2023, by AH)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.title_ja: 北の大地の水族館（山の水族館）
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：北の大地の水族館（山の水族館） 詳細 北見市の温根湯温泉にある淡水魚の水族館。「道の駅おんねゆ温泉」隣接。旭山動物園と同様に行動展示により人気の水族館になる。8:3017:00（113月は9:0016:30）営業、入館料670円、年末年始・4月に休館日あり。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Northern Land Aquarium (Mountain Aquarium) Details A freshwater fish aquarium located in Onneyu Onsen, Kitami City. Adjacent to "Michi-no-Eki Onneyu Onsen" (Roadside Station Onneyu Onsen). Similar to Asahiyama Zoo, it is a popular aquarium due to its behavioral exhibits. Open 8:30-17:00 (9:00-16:30 in November and March), admission fee 670 yen, closed during the New Year holidays and in April.

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：閉鎖（詳細）（投稿：2021年6月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Closure (details) (Submitted by: n, June 2021)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: オホーツクグリーンパーク
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車60台級の無料駐車場。トイレは綺麗な水洗洋式だが、トイレットペーパーが切れていた。国道からは少し奥まったところにあるので、車の走行音もそれほど気にならない。（投稿：2023年7月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A free parking lot with space for about 60 regular cars. The toilets are clean, flushable Western-style toilets, but they were out of toilet paper. It's set back a little from the national highway, so the noise from passing cars isn't too bothersome. (Submitted by: y, July 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車10台程度の無料駐車場。トイレは綺麗な水洗洋式だが、トイレットペーパーが切れていた。住宅街に隣接しており、特にオススメできるスポットでもないが、不都合なく一夜を過ごせた。（投稿：2023年8月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There is free parking for about 10 regular cars. The toilet is a clean Western-style flush toilet, but it was out of toilet paper. It is adjacent to a residential area and is not a particularly recommended spot, but I was able to spend the night without any problems. (Submitted by: y, August 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: （トイレ遠い）富良野 無料駐車場
properties.title_en: (Toilets are far away) Furano Free Parking
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：富良野駅周辺に無料公共駐車場を複数設けています。特にこの駅横の駐車場が、もう30メートル離れたところにも無料駐車場、さらに駅から反対側に100メートルほど行ったところにも線路の反対側に渡る歩道橋があり、そこにも無料公共駐車場があります。ただトイレはなく、唯一トイレがあるとしたら駅横の下記（ココ）の駐車場となります。（投稿：2020年9月、A様）
■トイレはココ。ここから徒歩5分かかる。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: There are several free public parking lots around Furano Station. In particular, there's a free parking lot right next to the station, another one just 30 meters away, and another free public parking lot about 100 meters on the opposite side of the tracks, accessible via a pedestrian overpass. However, there are no toilets in the parking lot itself; the only place with a toilet is the one next to the station (here). (Submitted by A, September 2020)

■Toilets are here. It's a 5-minute walk from here. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.title_ja: 標茶町農業者トレーニングセンター 摩周湖の伏流水
properties.title_en: Shibecha Town Agricultural Training Center: Groundwater from Lake Mashu
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：標茶町中心部、農業者トレーニングセンター（体育館）の駐車場、ペンギンの口から摩周湖の伏流水とされる水がこんこんと湧いています。くせのないとても美味しい水です。役場の方に教えて貰いました。添付画像（投稿：2026年1月、tossan様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: In the parking lot of the Agricultural Training Center (gymnasium) in the center of Shibecha Town, water believed to be groundwater from Lake Mashu gushes out from the mouth of a penguin statue. It's very tasty water with no unpleasant taste. I learned about it from someone at the town hall. Attached image (Submitted by tossan, January 2026)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：函館名物「やきとり弁当」（豚肉）を根室で提供。詳細、食べログ（投稿：2025年9月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Hakodate's famous "Yakitori Bento" (pork) is now available in Nemuro. Details on Tabelog (Posted by n, September 2025)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：白老牛肉祭り会場、祭り時は仮設トイレあり、河原で静か。
■白老牛肉まつりとは？
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website's readers: Shiraoi Beef Festival venue, temporary toilets available during the festival, quiet by the river.

■What is the Shiraoi Beef Festival?

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：白い恋人パーク 詳細 北海道の有名な土産菓子「白い恋人」の製造工程を見学できる他、出来立てのスイーツを食べられる。土産物も充実。工場見学は有料（600円）。9:0018:00営業。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Shiroi Koibito Park Details You can tour the manufacturing process of "Shiroi Koibito," a famous souvenir confectionery from Hokkaido, and eat freshly made sweets. There is also a wide selection of souvenirs. The factory tour is subject to a fee (600 yen). Open from 9:00 to 18:00.

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Shops and food court - Upbound: April-November 8:00-20:00, December-March 10:00-18:00; Downbound: April-November 7:00-19:00, December-March 9:00-17:00. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：売店・フードコート　4-11月7:00-21:00・12-3月9:00-19:00営業。ハイウェイオアシス（詳細）併設。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Shops and food court open 7:00-21:00 from April to November and 9:00-19:00 from December to March. Highway oasis (details) is located next door. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：納沙布岬 詳細 一般の人が自由に行ける日本最東端。ここにある北方領土資料館などの展望台からは北方領土（歯舞諸島）が見られる。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Nosappu Cape Details The easternmost point of Japan that is freely accessible to the general public. From the observation deck, including the Northern Territories Museum located here, you can see the Northern Territories (Habomai Islands).

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: 峠のあげいも（道の駅 望羊中山）
properties.title_en: Deep-fried potatoes at the mountain pass (Roadside Station Boyo Nakayama)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：峠のあげいも（道の駅 望羊中山） 詳細 羊蹄山麓産のジャガイモを揚げて３個串に刺した「あげいも」が名物。売店8:3017:30営業。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website readers: Touge no Ageimo (Michi-no-Eki Boyo Nakayama) Details The specialty is "ageimo," which consists of three fried potatoes grown at the foot of Mt. Yotei skewered on a stick. The shop is open from 8:30 to 17:30.

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：道道718号から「ペンケニコロベツ林道」に入って約2km先にある。詳細（投稿：2025年8月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: It is located about 2km after turning onto the "Penkenikorobetsu Forest Road" from Hokkaido Prefectural Road 718. Details (Submitted by: n, August 2025)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：道道478号線沿い、そば屋やレストランが集まる駐車場の脇で羊蹄山の湧水が汲める。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: You can draw spring water from Mt. Yotei next to a parking lot along Hokkaido Prefectural Road 478, where soba noodle shops and restaurants are located.

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：道央道・美沢PA（下り側）について：2023年7月の平日に利用。午前1時半に苫小牧港に着き、ここで朝まで仮眠してから道北へ向かいました。トイレのみの小振りなPAですが、静かで快適でした。（投稿：2023年7月、n様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ・自販機のみ設置。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Regarding the Misawa PA (downbound) on the Hokkaido Expressway: Used on a weekday in July 2023. Arrived at Tomakomai Port at 1:30 AM, took a nap here until morning, and then headed north to Hokkaido. It's a small PA with only toilets, but it was quiet and comfortable. (Submitted by: n, July 2023)

■Report from a reader of this site: Only toilets and vending machines are installed. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 旧 道の駅 足寄湖（道の駅登録廃止）
properties.title_en: Former Ashoro Lake Roadside Station (Roadside Station registration discontinued)
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：道の駅登録廃止されましたが、駐車場、トイレ、ドックラン、水飲み、全て利用可能です。草刈り等施設の管理がされていますので、車中泊は可能です。添付画像、添付画像、添付画像、添付画像（投稿：2022年9月、s様）
■2022年1月31日（月）をもって、道の駅登録廃止されました。詳細
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: Although the roadside station registration has been discontinued, the parking lot, toilets, dog run, and water fountain are all still available. The facilities are maintained, including grass cutting, so overnight stays in vehicles are permitted. (Attached images, attached images, attached images, attached images - Posted by: S, September 2022)

■As of January 31, 2022 (Monday), the roadside station registration has been discontinued. Details

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：道の駅ラウスから知床峠方面に行った無料駐車場とトイレですがトイレが閉鎖されており車中泊は不適当と考えます。（投稿：2021年9月、seed84様）
■無料駐車場とトイレ。傾斜あり。道沿いでうるさい。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: There is a free parking lot and toilets on the way from Michi-no-Eki Rausu towards Shiretoko Pass, but the toilets are closed, so I think it is unsuitable for overnight stays in a car. (Submitted by seed84 in September 2021)
■Free parking lot and toilets. There is a slope. It is noisy as it is along the road.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 上士幌農協前バス停前 24Hトイレ
properties.title_en: 24-hour restroom in front of the Kamishihoro Agricultural Cooperative bus stop
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：道の駅などが好みでない方に。トイレはとてもきれい(障害者用あり) 屋内型で冬場も安心です。Ｐはトイレの裏側にこぢんまりと。市街地で付近に民家もあるのでお静かに。徒歩圏内でほぼすべて揃います。南東550ｍに「ふれあいプラザ浴場」もあります。詳細。サウナまであって今どき￥300は超お薦め。（投稿：2022年8月、tossan様）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。車中泊可能との報告あり。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: For those who don't like roadside rest areas. The toilets are very clean (including accessible toilets). They are indoors, so they are safe even in winter. There is a small parking lot behind the toilets. It is in an urban area with houses nearby, so please be quiet. Almost everything you need is within walking distance. There is also the "Fureai Plaza Bathhouse" 550m to the southeast. Details. It even has a sauna, and at ¥300, it's highly recommended. (Posted: August 2022, by tossan)
■Free parking and public toilets. There are reports that overnight parking is possible. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：道の駅しゃりと同一な張り紙あり（「観光等目的の広域移動と長時間滞在については自粛をお願いいたします。」という張り紙）。どこかの管理団体が牛耳っているか？（投稿：2022年7月、k様）
■駐車場が幹線国道沿いでうるさい。ここはやめたほうがいい。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: There is a sign identical to the one at Michi-no-Eki Shari (a sign that reads, "We ask that you refrain from long-distance travel and extended stays for sightseeing purposes"). Is some management organization controlling this place? (Submitted by k, July 2022)
■The parking lot is noisy as it is along a main national highway. You should avoid this place. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.title_en: Sato no Mori Mori no Yu
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：土休日1000円、平日900円、詳細　9:00～22:00　受付内に休憩室・軽食コーナーあり。（投稿：2025年12月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: 1000 yen on weekends and holidays, 900 yen on weekdays. Details: 9:00 AM - 10:00 PM. There is a rest area and snack corner inside the reception area. (Submitted by: n, December 2025)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：土休日1,250円、平日1,100円　9:00～24:00、詳細　タオルまたは館内着付。受付内に食堂・休憩室あり。ネットができるパソコン設置。（投稿：2024年12月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: 1,250 yen on weekends and holidays, 1,100 yen on weekdays. 9:00 AM - 12:00 AM. Details: Towel or loungewear included. Cafeteria and rest area available in the reception area. Computers with internet access are available. (Submitted by: n, December 2024)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：登別地獄谷の追加情報です。登別は紅葉の名所でも有り、地獄谷のさらに奥に大湯沼と言う所が有ります。地獄谷駐車場で料金を払うと大湯沼の駐車場も共通で駐車できます。
■当サイト読者様レポート：登別地獄谷  登別温泉街の奥。谷に沿って数多くの温泉湧出口や噴気孔あり。駐車場1回500円。
properties.desc_en:
■Reader Report from this Site: Additional Information on Noboribetsu Jigokudani (Hell Valley). Noboribetsu is also famous for its autumn foliage, and further into Jigokudani there is a place called Oyunuma. If you pay the fee at the Jigokudani parking lot, you can also park at the Oyunuma parking lot.

■Reader Report from this Site: Noboribetsu Jigokudani (Hell Valley). Located deep within the Noboribetsu Onsen town. Numerous hot spring vents and fumaroles line the valley. Parking is 500 yen per visit.

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: 恵山 火口原駐車場
properties.title_en: Mount Esan Crater Plain Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：追加情報です。手前のゲートが夕方6時から朝6時まで閉鎖されるため、夜間使用不可です。泊まれません。（投稿：2021年10月、s様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：北海道 恵山の追加情報。駐車場は広いし、トイレも有りますが野生動物の糞が普通に有り、夜間とても不安ですので、少し麓のツツジ公園駐車場の方が周囲に民家も有り安心と思います。すぐ側に恵山温泉も有ります。トイレも有りますが夜間使用可能か未確認です。一番安心なのは、少し走って道の駅 なとわ恵山ですけど。
■無料駐車場とトイレ。天体観測ポイントとしても良さげ。
properties.desc_en:
■Reader Report: Additional Information. The gate in front is closed from 6 PM to 6 AM, making it unusable at night. Overnight stays are not permitted. (Submitted by: S, October 2021)
■Reader Report: Additional Information on Esan, Hokkaido. The parking lot is large and has toilets, but there is a lot of wild animal droppings, making it very unsettling at night. The Tsutsuji Park parking lot at the foot of the mountain is safer as there are houses nearby. Esan Onsen (hot spring) is also nearby. There are toilets, but it's unconfirmed whether they are usable at night. The safest option is the Natowa Esan roadside station, a short drive away.

■Free parking and toilets. Seems like a good spot for stargazing.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 礼文島・桃台猫台（桃岩猫岩）展望台
properties.title_en: Rebun Island - Momodai Nekodai (Momoiwa Nekoiwa) Observation Deck
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車料金：無料。駐車可能台数：約10台。トイレ：あり。男女別・24時間使用可能。注意事項：お風呂：フェリーターミナル近くの「うすゆきの湯」（詳細）を利用しました。コインランドリーあり。コンビニ：礼文島に１軒あります。場所：YH桃岩荘の上（YHへ下る手前）にあります。海岸近くですが、高台にあります。夕陽・日没も綺麗に見ることができます。（投稿：2024年3月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Parking fee: Free. Number of parking spaces: Approximately 10. Toilets: Available. Separate men's and women's toilets, 24-hour access. Notes: Bath: We used "Usuyuki no Yu" (details) near the ferry terminal. Coin laundry available. Convenience store: There is one on Rebun Island. Location: It is located above the Momoiwa Youth Hostel (before descending to the hostel). It is near the coast but on a hill. You can also see the sunset beautifully. (Submitted by: n, March 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場隣接の夜間トイレ、照明あり。車中泊車5-6台と適度に人はいますが、静かです。宗谷岬から日の出が綺麗に見えます。宗谷岬公園にもありますが、宗谷岬に直接訪れるなら宗谷岬駐車場がオススメです。（投稿：2025年8月、だ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There is a nighttime toilet adjacent to the parking lot, and it is lit. There are a moderate number of people, such as 5-6 cars parked overnight, but it is quiet. You can see a beautiful sunrise from Cape Soya. There is also a toilet at Cape Soya Park, but if you are going directly to Cape Soya, the Cape Soya parking lot is recommended. (Submitted by: Da, August 2025)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場隣接の朝市のトイレは、「24時間トイレ」との事だったが、22時翌4時頃まではシャッターが下りており、利用不可だった。トイレ内は暖房が入っており、とても綺麗。ウォシュレットです。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: The toilet at the morning market next to the parking lot was advertised as a "24-hour toilet," but the shutters were down from 10 PM until around 4 AM the next day, making it unusable. The toilet itself was heated and very clean. It also had a bidet.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場も広く、冬期間利用可かは不明だが公衆トイレ有り。すぐ近くに訓子府駅もありトイレには困らない。静かで快適。（投稿：2024年8月、巨人ファン様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: The parking lot is spacious, and there are public restrooms, although it is unclear if they are available during the winter. There is also Kunneppu Station nearby, so you won't have any trouble finding a restroom. It is quiet and comfortable. (Submitted by: Giants fan, August 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場にトイレあり。 国道真横 石狩からくるとトンネル出てすぐ右のため、行きすぎたら左手にキャンプ場ありUターンできます。北海道の道は、一度間違うと数キロ走らなければなりません。50キロ以上コンビニエンスなしです。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレあり。「白銀の滝」が見える。周囲にコンビニ等は無い。オロロンライン横のため交通量非常に多く、トラックが通るとものすごい轟音が響く。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: There is a toilet in the parking lot. It's right next to the national highway. Coming from Ishikari, it's immediately to the right after exiting the tunnel, so if you go too far, there's a campsite on the left where you can make a U-turn. Hokkaido roads are tricky; if you make a wrong turn, you have to drive for several kilometers. There are no convenience stores for over 50 kilometers. (Older post from before 2019)

■ Reader Report: There is a toilet. You can see "Shirogane Falls". There are no convenience stores nearby. Because it's next to the Orolon Line, there is a lot of traffic, and when trucks pass by, there is a tremendous roar. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場とトイレ。（投稿：2025年6月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Reader Report: Parking Lot and Restrooms. (Submitted by: n, June 2025)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場が近くにないため分かりにくいが白金観光センターが駐車場となっている。白金観光センター内トイレは24時間利用可能。（投稿：2021年3月、りんりんご様）
■美瑛の観光スポット
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: Although it's difficult to find because there's no nearby parking, the Shirogane Tourist Center serves as a parking lot. The restrooms inside the Shirogane Tourist Center are available 24 hours a day. (Submitted by: Rinringo, March 2021)
■Tourist spots in Biei

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 北海道釧路町 村田公園
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場から徒歩3分ほどに劣悪トイレ有。よほどの利用がない限りは車中泊にはお勧めできないが、他に泊まる場所がなければ泊まってみてください。幽霊、熊等非常に怖いです。（投稿：2022年5月、巨人ファン様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There is a terrible toilet about a 3-minute walk from the parking lot. I wouldn't recommend staying overnight in your car unless absolutely necessary, but if you have nowhere else to stay, give it a try. It's very scary with ghosts and bears. (Submitted by: Giants fan, May 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 北海道釧路市 千代ノ浦マリンパーク
properties.title_en: Chiyonoura Marine Park, Kushiro City, Hokkaido""
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場から徒歩3分ほどにトイレ有。夜中も夜釣り客も多く逆に安心できる。漁港も隣接されているので早朝は漁業関係者の作業音がする。（投稿：2022年5月、巨人ファン様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There is a restroom about a 3-minute walk from the parking lot. There are many night fishermen even in the middle of the night, which actually makes it feel safer. A fishing port is adjacent to the area, so you can hear the sounds of fishermen working in the early morning. (Submitted by: Giants Fan, May 2022)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：中村のとりめし、詳細。空知地方の鶏と米から作った郷土料理。郷里の味なかむらえぷろん倶楽部（詳細）や空知地方のAコープなどで買える。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website readers: Details on Nakamura's chicken rice. A local dish made from chicken and rice from the Sorachi region. It can be purchased at Nakamura Apron Club (details) and A-Coop stores in the Sorachi region.

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：池田ワイン城（池田町ブドウ・ブドウ酒研究所） 詳細 ワイン製造工場の見学やワインの試飲ができる。9:0017:00営業 年末年始休。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website readers: Ikeda Wine Castle (Ikeda Town Grape and Wine Research Institute) Details You can tour the wine production factory and sample wines. Open from 9:00 to 17:00. Closed during the New Year holidays.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：知られざる車中泊絶好ポイント。東川の道の駅「道草館」より遥かに広大な駐車場。トイレ有り。綺麗な池があり観光スポットとしても見る価値あり。詳細（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A little-known but excellent spot for overnight stays in your car. A much larger parking lot than the "Michikusa-kan" roadside station in Higashikawa. Restrooms available. There's a beautiful pond, making it worth seeing as a tourist spot. Details (older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：男女用トイレあり(ウォシュレット付き)風呂は北見市営の銭湯(車で五分)コンビニ(車で10分)静かです。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There are separate men's and women's toilets (with bidet functions). There is a public bathhouse run by Kitami City (5 minutes by car). There is a convenience store (10 minutes by car). It is quiet. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 中標津公園駐車場 中標津しるべっと広場脇の駐車場
properties.title_en: Nakashibetsu Park Parking Lot: Parking lot next to Nakashibetsu Shirubetto Plaza
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：大量のちょうちんがあるお祭りをやっていたので車中泊できませんでした。道の駅ではないので、イベント確認必須です。（投稿：2024年9月、ゆーぷる様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2022.5.11車中泊。キャンパーや地元のカップルなど約10台くらいが駐車。水洗トイレと洗面台も24時間使えて、そこそこキレイ。夜中に入ってきた大型トラックがアイドリングしながら駐車してから起きてしまったが、それがなければ朝まで快適に寝れるはず。大型トラックの騒音を避けるならば入口から見て右奥に停めるのがいいかも。入浴は車で2、3分の所にある「ホテルマルエー温泉」がおすすめ。地元の人たちにも人気のようで混雑していたが、お湯はツルツルで温まる。大人550円、添付画像（投稿：2022年8月、かずお様）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。トイレは水洗洋式でキレイ。街のど真ん中。（2021年7月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: There was a festival with a huge number of lanterns, so we couldn't stay overnight in our car. It's not a roadside station, so checking for events is essential. (Posted: September 2024, Yu-puru)
■Report from our site's reader: Overnight stay in car on May 11, 2022. About 10 cars were parked there, including campers and local couples. The flush toilets and sinks were available 24 hours a day and were reasonably clean. A large truck came in during the night and parked while idling, which woke me up, but otherwise, I should have been able to sleep comfortably until morning. If you want to avoid the noise of the large truck, it might be best to park in the back right corner from the entrance. For bathing, we recommend "Hotel Marue Onsen," which is a 2-3 minute drive away. It seemed popular with the locals and was crowded, but the water was smooth and warming. 550 yen for adults, see attached image (Posted: August 2022, Kazuo)
■Free parking and public toilets. The toilets are flush Western-style and clean. Right in the middle of town. (Confirmed on-site by administrator in July 2021)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：大変綺麗な公園です、管理棟の前で堂々と車中泊をしました。街に近い、と言うよりほぼ街中です。テニスコートが隣なので暗くなるまでパコーン、パコーンって。管理棟のトイレは夜8時閉鎖、池のトイレは24時間です。夏場は朝早くから市民が散歩に来ますから挨拶をするように心掛けましょう。SLの展示、博物館も隣接されています。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: This is a very beautiful park. I confidently camped my car overnight in front of the administration building. It's not just close to the town, it's practically in the middle of it. There are tennis courts next door, so you can hear people playing until it gets dark. The toilets in the administration building close at 8 pm, but the toilets by the pond are open 24 hours. In the summer, citizens come for walks early in the morning, so be sure to greet them. There is also a steam locomotive exhibit and a museum next door. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：大通公園 詳細 札幌市街地を東西に横切る公園。2月上旬にさっぽろ雪まつり、78月にさっぽろ夏まつり（ビアガーデンなど）、9月にさっぽろオータムフェスト（北海道のご当地グルメが集まる）などのイベントが開かれる。専用の駐車場なし（付近の有料駐車場を利用）。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website's readers: Odori Park Details A park that runs east to west through downtown Sapporo. Events held here include the Sapporo Snow Festival in early February, the Sapporo Summer Festival (including a beer garden) in July and August, and the Sapporo Autumn Fest (featuring local Hokkaido cuisine) in September. There is no dedicated parking lot (please use nearby paid parking lots).

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.title_ja: YUKARA AUTO CAMP（RVパークおおぬま）
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：大沼国定公園に徒歩圏内の車中泊可能キャンプ場。利用料金（車中泊有料1台1区画2000円、詳細）、夜間入退場可、清潔な無料トイレ有（水洗洋式ウォシュレット）、ご利用者居る場合は夜間もオープン。プラス評価：車で5分でコンビニ有（セブンイレブン）、15分圏内に複数天然温泉在り（600円～1000円）、何しろ広いのでプライバシー守られる距離感良い、緊急時管理人連絡即対応可能。マイナス評価：騒音では無いが少し離れた道路を通る車や駅を通過する汽車の音ごくわずか有、猫がたまに来る。百点満点で評価すると85点ぐらい。YUKARAグループの車中泊場なので、近隣には貴社レストランや有名だんご屋さん、夜オープンの徒歩圏内の飲み屋さんもあって道の駅とは違う楽しみが最高です。（投稿：2025年5月、ボビーはトレーラーが我が家様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A campsite where you can stay overnight in your car, within walking distance of Onuma Quasi-National Park. Usage fee (overnight stay in a car: 2000 yen per car per site, details), nighttime entry and exit allowed, clean free toilets available (flush toilets with Western-style toilets and bidet functions), open at night if there are users. Positive points: There is a convenience store (Seven-Eleven) a 5 minute drive away, several natural hot springs within a 15 minute radius (600 to 1000 yen), it is very spacious so privacy is well maintained, and the manager can be contacted immediately in case of emergency. Negative points: There is a slight sound of cars passing on a road a little distance away and trains passing the station, not loud noise, and cats occasionally come by. Rated at about 85 out of 100. As it is a YUKARA Group car campsite, there are your company's restaurants and famous dango shops nearby, as well as bars that are open at night within walking distance, which is a different kind of fun than a roadside station. (Posted: May 2025, Bobby's Trailer is My Home)

properties.label: Paid Campground
properties.title_ja: カムイチャシ駐車公園、大岸シーサイドキャンプ場
properties.title_en: Kamuy Chashi Parking Park, Ogishi Seaside Campground""
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：大岸シーサイドキャンプ場の向かい側。トイレあり。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：有料キャンプ場（５００円、但し係員が徴収に来るのは最盛期のみ？5/16現在来ていない）設備：トイレ（水洗）、水場 備考：キャンプ場（写真A）はすぐ横をJRが通っていて、夜間時々通過音がする。その３００ｍ離れた所の小さな駐車場にもトイレあり、ここのほうが静か（写真B）。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■夜中も貨物列車が走り、非常にうるさいので安眠は無理。車中泊場所としてはおすすめできない。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: Opposite Oogishi Seaside Campground. Toilets available. (Older post from before 2019)
■ Reader Report: Paid campground (500 yen, however, staff only collect fees during peak season? As of May 16th, no one has come). Facilities: Toilets (flush toilets), water source. Notes: The JR line runs right next to the campground (Photo A), and trains pass by occasionally at night. There are also toilets in a small parking lot 300m away, which is quieter (Photo B). (Older post from before 2019)
■ Freight trains run even at night, making it extremely noisy and impossible to get a good night's sleep. Not recommended as a place to sleep in a car. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: ラッキーピエロ 江差入口前
properties.title_en: Lucky Pierrot, in front of Esashi entrance""
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：大きな駐車場。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Large parking lot. (Tabelog)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：帯広とは違って、地元民向けの豚丼専門店。バラ丼、ロース丼、ミックス丼、カレー丼いずれも￥880でボリューム満足。帯広の観光客向け有名店よりも満足度は高い。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Unlike Obihiro, this is a pork bowl specialty restaurant for locals. Pork belly bowl, loin bowl, mixed bowl, and curry bowl are all ¥880 and offer satisfying portions. It's more satisfying than the famous tourist-oriented restaurants in Obihiro. (Tabelog)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：石鹸・シャンプーの備え付け無し。飲泉が出来なくなった。500円（北海道銭湯価格）、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：200台無料駐車場完備 受付内に休憩室・レストラン（11:0020:00）あり。湧水、地元の牛乳の自販機あり。この価格でスーパー銭湯レベルの設備
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: No soap or shampoo provided. Drinking the spring water is no longer possible. 500 yen (Hokkaido public bath price), details
■Report from our website reader: 200 free parking spaces available. Rest area and restaurant (11:00-20:00) inside the reception area. Spring water and local milk vending machines available. Super public bath level facilities at this price.

properties.label: Camp Spot + Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 臼別温泉 無人露天風呂 湯とぴあ臼別
properties.title_en: Usubetsu Onsen Unmanned Open-Air Bath Yutopia Usubetsu
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：清掃協力金として100円、詳細。大成町で管理しているログハウスで脱衣所他建物内にトイレ（和式ポットン、夜間真っ暗）有り。電灯は19時までしかついていないが、閉鎖はされないようで、懐中電灯を使えば夜間もトイレ利用可能で車中泊できるようです。素晴らしい露天風呂で本当は教えたくない＾＾ 夜は完全無人で静か。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: 100 yen cleaning cooperation fee, details. It's a log cabin managed by Taisei-cho, with a changing room and a toilet inside the building (Japanese-style pit toilet, pitch black at night). The lights are only on until 7 PM, but it doesn't seem to be closed off, and it seems you can use the toilet at night with a flashlight and even stay overnight in your car. It has a wonderful open-air bath, which I honestly don't want to tell anyone about ^^ It's completely deserted and quiet at night. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：整備された男女別水洗トイレ(洋式あり)。朝に漁業者のトラックが走りますが基本的に静かな所です。Ｐから一段上がると展望所があり、太平洋が一望できます。付近に商店等はありません。入浴施設は根室(15km)にしかありません。（投稿：2022年8月、tossan様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Well-maintained separate men's and women's flush toilets (including Western-style toilets). Although fishing trucks pass by in the morning, it is generally a quiet place. There is an observation deck one level up from the parking lot, offering a panoramic view of the Pacific Ocean. There are no shops or other facilities nearby. The only bathing facilities are in Nemuro (15km away). (Submitted by tossan, August 2022)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：水平線まで見渡される絶景スポット。観光客が少なく、鹿が間近に見れる。駐車場にトイレ有。ヒグマの糞などがあったので車中泊の際には注意が必要。（投稿：2021年3月、りんりんご様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A spectacular spot with panoramic views to the horizon. There are few tourists, and you can see deer up close. There are toilets in the parking lot. There was some brown bear droppings, so caution is needed when staying overnight in your car. (Submitted by: Rinringo, March 2021)

properties.label: Free Campground
properties.title_ja: 無人キャンプ場（無料キャンプ場）
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：水上バイクやモ−タ−ボ−トの愛好者が利用する無人キャンプ場。目印は道路横のド−ム型トイレの横から湖畔に入る。トイレはそこを利用するが炊事場などない。盛夏以外は人気なし。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: An unmanned campsite used by jet ski and motorboat enthusiasts. The landmark is the dome-shaped toilet next to the road; you enter the lakeside area from there. You use the toilet there, but there are no cooking facilities. It's not popular except in the peak of summer. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.title_ja: 森の天然水（道の駅摩周温泉の水）
properties.title_en: Natural spring water from the forest (water from Mashu Onsen roadside station)
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：水は道の駅営業時間のみ出ています。（投稿：2020年9月）
■道の駅の施設の裏に、飲用できる水が流れ出ている。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: Water is only available during the roadside station's operating hours. (Submitted: September 2020)
■Drinkable water flows out behind the roadside station's facilities.

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 ノンキーランドひがしもこと
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：新型コロナ感染対策として、洗面台で洗顔、歯磨き禁止になっていました。また、感染対策として小便器と洗面台それぞれ4基中2基が禁止となっています。（投稿：2022年9月、s様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：道を挟んでセコマ（コンビニ）あり。ゴミ捨て可能。温泉があったらＳクラス（投稿：2022年7月、k様）
■2017年9月1日オープン。目の前がセイコーマートで便利そう。駐車場は道路沿いでうるさそう。
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: As a measure against COVID-19 infection, washing your face and brushing your teeth at the sinks is prohibited. Also, as a measure against infection, 2 out of 4 urinals and sinks are closed. (Submitted by: S, September 2022)
■ Reader Report: There is a Secoma (convenience store) across the street. Garbage disposal is possible. If there was a hot spring, it would be an S class (Submitted by: K, July 2022)
■ Opened on September 1, 2017. Seems convenient as there is a Seicomart right in front. The parking lot is along the road and seems noisy.

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: ウトロ漁協婦人部食堂
properties.title_en: Utoro Fisheries Cooperative Women's Division Cafeteria
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：食べて損はない。いくら丼がお勧め。裏手の岸壁から釣りが出来る。（投稿：2022年7月、k様）
■食べログ
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: You won't regret eating here. I recommend the salmon roe rice bowl. You can fish from the pier behind the restaurant. (Submitted by: k, July 2022)
■Tabelog

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：乗船乗り場のトイレ(夜間も開放)が25年に新調されてウォシュレット付きの最新の綺麗なトイレになってます。（投稿：2025年8月、だ様）
■当日24時まで最大1000円、一泊すると2000円、詳細。トイレはココ
■当サイト読者様レポート：コメント：この駐車場について、管理者である小樽観光振興公社にメールにて問い合わせしたところ以下の回答を得ております。問い合わせ日：２０２５年３月。利用料金：例えば夜八時から翌朝七時までの場合、２０００円となるそうです。基本的には１時間３００円で、最大料金は当日２４時まで１０００円となっているので、この１０００円が二日分という考えの様です。以前の投稿では８００円との記載がありましたが、ゲート式となったことで見直されたようです。➂車中泊利用について：車中泊利用については、『問題ありません』との回答を得ております。特に手続等についても無いそうです。（投稿：2025年3月、j様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：徒歩1分のところにトイレあり。（投稿：2021年8月、ヨシ様）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: The toilets at the boarding area (open at night) were renovated in 2025 and are now clean, state-of-the-art toilets with bidet functions. (Posted: August 2025, by Da)
■Maximum 1000 yen until midnight on the day, 2000 yen for an overnight stay, details. Toilets are here.
■Report from our site's reader: Comment: Regarding this parking lot, we inquired via email with the administrator, the Otaru Tourism Promotion Corporation, and received the following response. Inquiry date: March 2025. Usage fee: For example, from 8 PM to 7 AM the next morning, it would be 2000 yen. Basically, it's 300 yen per hour, and the maximum charge is 1000 yen until midnight on the day, so it seems that this 1000 yen is for two days. A previous post mentioned 800 yen, but it seems to have been revised due to the introduction of a gate system. ③Regarding overnight parking: We received a response that there is "no problem" with overnight parking. There are no special procedures required. (Submitted by: j, March 2025)
■Report from a reader of this site: There is a toilet within a 1-minute walk. (Submitted by: Yoshi, August 2021)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：十勝川でつくられた氷が太平洋に流れ出て、海岸に打ち上げられたもの。例年、1月中旬から2月下旬ころまでの間に大津海岸の十勝川河口付近の砂浜で見ることができる。詳細、詳細（投稿：2025年11月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: This ice was formed in the Tokachi River, flowed out into the Pacific Ocean, and washed ashore. It can typically be seen on the sandy beach near the mouth of the Tokachi River at Otsu Beach from mid-January to late February. (Details, details) (Submitted by: n, November 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：住宅街の公園駐車場です。トイレあり。全長23キロの帯状の公園で他にも数か所駐車場があります。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: This is a park parking lot in a residential area. There are toilets. The park is a strip of land 23 kilometers long and has several other parking lots. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：宗谷岬 詳細 一般の人が自由に行ける日本最北端。晴れていればサハリンを見る事ができる。近くのガソリンスタンドで給油するとちょっとしたお土産が貰える。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Cape Soya Details The northernmost point of Japan that is freely accessible to the general public. If the weather is clear, you can see Sakhalin. You can get a small souvenir if you fill up your car at the nearby gas station.

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 ルート229 元和台
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：車通りも少なく静か。暗い場所も多く寝やすい。トイレにはカメムシが非常に多い。（投稿：2022年7月、りんりんご様）
■「げんなだい」と読む、コンビニなどは近くに無し、商店や自販機はある、海水浴場があるため夏は激込み（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: It's quiet with little traffic. There are many dark places, making it easy to sleep. There are a lot of stink bugs in the toilets. (Submitted by: Rinringo, July 2022)
■It's pronounced "Gennadai," there are no convenience stores nearby, but there are shops and vending machines, and it gets extremely crowded in the summer because there is a beach nearby (older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：車中泊出来てませんが、駐車場夜間閉鎖されなければ出来そうです。トイレ小2洋式2 紙あり 水洗。海のそばなので風が吹くか気に狩るところ。電波問題なし。（投稿：2024年9月、s様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: I haven't been able to stay overnight in my car yet, but it seems possible if the parking lot isn't closed at night. There are two urinals and two Western-style toilets with toilet paper and flush toilets. It's near the sea, so you have to be careful about the wind. There are no problems with cell phone reception. (Submitted by: s, September 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: <font color="red">（トイレ無し）</font>倶多楽湖 駐車場
properties.title_en: <font color="red">（トイレ無し）</font>倶多楽Lake Parking
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：車中泊はしてないが公共駐車場の看板があることから出来そう。Googleマップに無いが2ヶ所駐車場があり、サップ店を挟んだ隣にある。そちらの方が広く、平ら、東側木々で良さそう。トイレ無し（建物はあるが入れない）、電波無し、観光地化されていないので恐らく車通りもほぼ無いだろう  クマに注意レベルかもしれない。日中比較的少数の観光客あり。看板によるとヒメマス釣りのメッカらしいので朝釣り人が来るかも。道中狭く街灯無いので注意。誰もいない真ん丸な倶多楽湖は見ていて心安らぐ。標高290m（投稿：2024年9月、s様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: I didn't stay overnight in my car, but there was a sign for a public parking lot, so it seems possible. There are two parking lots that aren't on Google Maps, one next to a SUP shop. That one is wider, flatter, and has trees on the east side, which looks good. There are no toilets (there is a building but you can't enter), no cell phone reception, and it's not a tourist spot so there's probably almost no traffic. Be careful of bears. There are a relatively small number of tourists during the day. According to the sign, it seems to be a mecca for kokanee salmon fishing, so there might be fishermen in the morning. The road is narrow and there are no streetlights, so be careful. The perfectly round Lake Kuttara is peaceful to look at with no one around. Elevation 290m (Posted: September 2024, by s)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: 常南ビーチ駐車場（トイレ夜間閉鎖）
properties.title_en: Jonan Beach Parking Lot (Toilets closed at night)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：車中泊に適しません。夜中1時くらいから地元の漁師の方が海の様子を見に来るらしく、ひっきりなしにクルマの往来があります。料金無料。トイレは20時で閉鎖されます。ただし、食器類が洗える炊事場は24時間使えます。すぐ近くのスーパー「えいじろう」は品揃え良。銭湯の寿湯が歩いていける範囲にあります。（投稿：2021年9月、参拝業者えーご様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Not suitable for overnight stays in a car. Local fishermen apparently come to check on the sea from around 1 AM, so there is constant traffic. Free of charge. Toilets close at 8 PM. However, the kitchen where you can wash dishes is available 24 hours a day. The nearby supermarket "Eijiro" has a good selection of goods. The public bathhouse "Kotobuki-yu" is within walking distance. (Submitted by: Eigo, a shrine visitor, September 2021)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：車中泊MAPにあったので昼間、実際に行ってみましたが（7/24）トイレらしきところはなく、道も途中から灯台に行くには砂浜（砂地）を走らなければならず4WDで車高が高くないとスタックしそうで危険。（D）見た場所が違っていたらすみません。（投稿：2022年7月、d様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：バードウオッチングのポイントでトイレあり、道を外れるとスタックの恐れあり、高潮津波には注意。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: I actually went there during the daytime (July 24th) because it was on the car camping map, but there didn't seem to be any toilets, and the road to the lighthouse required driving on a sandy beach (sandy ground), which was dangerous as it seemed like you would get stuck unless you had a 4WD with high ground clearance. (D) I apologize if I saw the wrong place. (Submitted by d in July 2022)

■Report from a reader of this site: There are toilets at the birdwatching spot, but there is a risk of getting stuck if you go off the road, and be careful of high tides and tsunamis.

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)

properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Within the grounds of Mishima Shrine in Nanae Town. Details (Submitted by: n, September 2024)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：残念ながら夜間閉鎖。閉鎖時に窓コンコンされてチェックあり。連泊した場合おそらく警察に通報される。（投稿：2023年8月、佐藤様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Unfortunately, it is closed at night. When it closes, they knock on the window to check. If you stay for multiple nights, they will probably call the police. (Submitted by Mr. Sato, August 2023)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：札幌市時計台 詳細 札幌市を代表する建築物として知られているが、周囲を高層ビルで囲まれていて景観が悪く「日本三大がっかり名所」の１つにも挙げられている。入場料200円 8:4517:10営業。駐車場なし。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Sapporo Clock Tower Details Although known as a representative building of Sapporo, it is surrounded by high-rise buildings, resulting in a poor view, and is listed as one of the "Three Great Disappointing Tourist Attractions in Japan." Admission fee: 200 yen. Open from 8:45 to 17:10. No parking available.

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: ラッキーピエロ 森町赤井川
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：札幌に最も近いラッキーピエロの店。休日の昼などは非常に混雑する。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: The closest Lucky Pierrot restaurant to Sapporo. It gets extremely crowded on weekends and holidays. (Tabelog)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: 佐藤水産サーモンファクトリー店
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：佐藤水産サーモンファクトリー店 詳細 水産加工品の工場直結の販売店。試食品多数。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Sato Suisan Salmon Factory Store Details A store directly connected to a seafood processing factory. Many samples available. Tabelog

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：根室のご当地グルメ「エスカロップ」「オリエンタルライス」「ビドックライス」「スタミナライス」の店。詳細、食べログ（投稿：2025年2月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A restaurant serving Nemuro's local specialties: "Escalope," "Oriental Rice," "Bidoc Rice," and "Stamina Rice." Details on Tabelog (Posted by n, February 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 白糠除雪ステーション
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：今回はスポットの削除をお願いしたく連絡致しました。削除して欲しいポイントは以下となります。白糠除雪ステーション。削除の理由としては、当該ポイントは確かに無料駐車場とトイレはありますが、本来の目的は除雪のための重機の駐車、展開場所やそれに関連する作業の方の駐車が主目的です。一般の方では、高速道路に乗る前にトイレを含む一時休憩としては利用も可能ですが、「車中泊」としては不適切です。※実際これからの時期（2020年11月以降）は除雪作業なども行われるため、一般車がステーション内に長く留まることは作業の邪魔になります、上記の理由から削除をお願い致します。このマップは非常に有用だと思いますが、このポイントのように本来の目的とは違う駐車場を示すことは、無関係の方にも迷惑となるだけでなく、将来的に車中泊そのものが悪と捉えられかねないため、ポイントを載せる際は慎重な精査をお願い致します。（投稿：2020年10月、T様）
■無料駐車場ときれいなトイレ（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: This time, I am contacting you to request the removal of a spot. The point I would like removed is as follows: Shiranuka Snow Removal Station. The reason for removal is that although this point does have free parking and toilets, its primary purpose is to park heavy machinery for snow removal, to provide a deployment area, and to provide parking for related workers. While it is possible for the general public to use it for a short rest, including using the toilets, before getting on the highway, it is inappropriate for "overnight stays in a vehicle." *In fact, snow removal work will be carried out during this period (from November 2020 onwards), so if general vehicles remain in the station for a long time, it will interfere with the work. For the reasons above, I request that it be removed. I think this map is very useful, but showing parking lots that are not intended for their original purpose, as in this point, not only inconveniences unrelated people but could also lead to the perception that overnight stays in vehicles themselves are bad in the future. Therefore, I would like you to carefully review when adding points. (Submitted by: Mr. T, October 2020)
■Free parking and clean toilets (older posts from before 2019)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：黒い音威子府そばが復活。2025年9月下旬までの金、土、日曜日11時～15時営業。詳細（投稿：2025年8月、n様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：店主死去のため閉店。（投稿：2021年3月、N様）
■そばの甘皮まで挽いて入れているので、そばの風味が豊かな「音威子府そば」が駅で食べられる。駅前に駐車スペースあり。食べログ
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: Black Otoineppu Soba is back! Open Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays from 11:00 to 15:00 until late September 2025. Details (Posted: August 2025, by n)
■ Reader Report: Closed due to the death of the owner. (Posted: March 2021, by N)
■ Enjoy Otoineppu Soba, which has a rich buckwheat flavor because the buckwheat hulls are ground and used in the broth, at the station. Parking available in front of the station. Tabelog

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 北前船 松前
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：国道側に停めるとトラック等の通過音が騒がしいが、海側だと潮騒が他の音を打ち消してくれ、心地よく眠ることができた。日が暮れると津軽半島の竜飛岬灯台の灯りも見え風情がある。テラスが夜間も開放されているので潮風に吹かれながらゆっくりと時間を過ごすことができた。バス駐車ゾーンでの車中泊禁止、洗面所での洗髪禁止、トイレへの残飯捨て禁止など、張り紙による警告がトイレ内各所に掲示されていた。こうした内容が町の条例で定められたとのこと。利用マナーが悪いと車中泊全面禁止となる可能性があることを肝に銘ずる必要がある。（投稿：2023年7月、K様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：無料、トイレきれいで自動ドアなので夏場でも虫の侵入少ない。徒歩圏内にコンビニセイコーマートあり（ただし24時間ではない）。近くの温泉旅館の日帰り入浴が朝6時からなので、朝風呂入ってからの出発ができます。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：国道の横ですが交通量 夜間少ない。温泉は、松島温泉が車5分 サウナ休憩室あり、軽食あり、少し国道から入りますので明るい内に到着してください。道の駅に居酒屋の案内あり、歩いて松島市街にいけます。道の駅と市街地が近いのが特徴です。夕日が綺麗。夜は、居酒屋、朝一番に松前城観光。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: When parked on the national highway side, the noise of passing trucks and other vehicles is loud, but when parked on the ocean side, the sound of the waves drowns out other noises, allowing for a comfortable sleep. As the sun sets, you can see the light of the Tappi Cape Lighthouse on the Tsugaru Peninsula, which is picturesque. The terrace is open even at night, so you can spend time relaxing while being caressed by the sea breeze. Warning signs were posted throughout the restrooms prohibiting overnight parking in the bus parking zone, washing hair in the washroom, and discarding leftover food in the toilets. These rules are apparently stipulated by town ordinances. It is important to keep in mind that if usage manners are poor, overnight parking may be completely banned. (Submitted by K, July 2023)

■Report from a reader of this site: Free, the toilets are clean, and the automatic doors mean fewer insects get in even in summer. There is a Seicomart convenience store within walking distance (however, it is not 24 hours). Day-use bathing at a nearby hot spring inn starts at 6 am, so you can take a morning bath before departing. (Older posts from before 2019)
■Report from our site's reader: Although it's next to a national highway, traffic is light at night. Matsushima Onsen is a 5-minute drive away. It has a sauna and relaxation room, and light meals are available. It's a little off the main highway, so please arrive while it's still light. There's a sign for an izakaya (Japanese pub) at the roadside station, and you can walk to Matsushima town. A key feature is the proximity of the roadside station to the town center. The sunset is beautiful. At night, you can go to an izakaya, and first thing in the morning, you can sightsee Matsumae Castle. (Older posts from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：高台にあるためか、夜中幾度も突風で、地震かと思うくらい車体が激しく揺られ、眠れませんでした。風の強い日には車中泊には不向きです。（投稿：2022年7月、s様）
■無料駐車場とトイレ。眺めが素晴らしい。夕日が美しい。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Perhaps because it's on a hill, there were several strong gusts of wind during the night that shook the car so violently I thought it was an earthquake, and I couldn't sleep. It's not suitable for overnight stays in a car on windy days. (Submitted by: s, July 2022)
■Free parking and toilets. The view is wonderful. The sunset is beautiful. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Sightseeing

properties.desc_ja:

■蒸溜所内は無料で見学できるうえ、酒類の試飲も可能。詳細
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: Factory tours are by reservation only and cannot be booked on the day. (Submitted by: K, July 2022)
■The distillery tour is free, and you can also sample alcoholic beverages. Details

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：公衆トイレ有（冬季クローズ）塘路駅構内トイレは年間利用可、JR往来音が気にならなければ問題ない。（投稿：2022年5月、巨人ファン様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There are public toilets (closed in winter). The toilets inside Toro Station are available year-round, and there's no problem if you don't mind the noise of JR trains. (Submitted by: Giants fan, May 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：公園駐車場　便所有り。水場有り。静か。車中泊可能。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Park parking lot has toilets. Water source available. Quiet. Overnight parking possible. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: The slope was too steep, so I gave up on sleeping in my car (Submitted by: S, September 2024)
■ Reader Report: There are toilets, and it's also a rest stop for taxi drivers, so I felt safe sleeping in my car. (Submitted by: Giants Fan, May 2022)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：倶知安町名物のジャガイモのでんぷんを使った「豪雪うどん」発祥の店。詳細、食べログ（投稿：2025年3月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: The restaurant that originated "Gousetsu Udon," a local specialty of Kutchan Town, made with potato starch. For details, see Tabelog (posted by n in March 2025).

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：銀河・流星の滝 詳細 上川町・層雲峡の名瀑。「双瀑台」の展望台から２本の滝を見ることができる。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Ginga and Ryusei Falls Details A famous waterfall in Sounkyo, Kamikawa Town. You can see two waterfalls from the observation deck at "Sobakudai".

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 オーロラタウン93りくべつ
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：極寒の地として有名。冬場は多くの人々が寒さを味わうために集まり、駐車場が混みます。アイドリング車も多く、灯りも明るいです。（投稿：2022年7月、りんりんご様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Famous for its extreme cold. In winter, many people gather here to experience the cold, and the parking lot gets crowded. There are also many cars idling, and the lights are bright. (Submitted by: Rinringo, July 2022)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：旧標津線川北駅跡にある水汲み場。詳細（投稿：2025年9月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A water source located at the site of the former Kawakita Station on the Shibetsu Line. Details (Submitted by: n, September 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 北海道釧路市 新釧路川緑地駐車場
properties.title_en: Shin-Kushirogawa Green Space Parking Lot, Kushiro City, Hokkaido""
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：簡易トイレ有（汚い）、水飲み場有。花火利用者も多く、パトカーの巡視も多く車中泊可能ではあるが、環境は良くない。（投稿：2022年5月、巨人ファン様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There are portable toilets (dirty) and drinking fountains. Many people use the area for fireworks, and there are many police patrols, so it is possible to stay overnight in a car, but the environment is not good. (Submitted by: Giants fan, May 2022)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：環境省釧路湿原野生生物保護センター東の清水谷の水について。水質検査もパスしている飲める湧き水です。車を5台くらい停められる広さ。駐車料金200円を箱に入れる。30分以内に汲み終えて下さい、等のルールがあります。（投稿：2024年8月、タカネ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Reader Report: Regarding the water at Shimizu Valley, east of the Ministry of the Environment's Kushiro Marshland Wildlife Conservation Center. The spring water is drinkable and has passed water quality tests. There is enough space to park about 5 cars. There are rules such as a 200 yen parking fee (put in the box) and a request to finish filling up within 30 minutes. (Submitted by Takane, August 2024)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：角屋のやきそば 詳細 美唄市名物の袋から直接食べられる焼きそば。美唄のアンテナショップ（詳細）や美唄市付近のスーパー・コンビニで買える他、札幌の大丸地下食品街やHUGマート等でも売っている。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Kadoya's Yakisoba Details Yakisoba that can be eaten directly from the bag, a specialty of Bibai City. It can be purchased at Bibai's antenna shop (details), supermarkets and convenience stores near Bibai City, and is also sold at the Daimaru department store's basement food hall and HUG Mart in Sapporo.

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：海鮮を豪快にたっぷり使った看板メニュー「浜ちゃんぽん」や、ダシの効いた醤油味のあんかけ焼そばなど。10:30〜20:00営業。詳細、食べログ（投稿：2024年12月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Their signature dish, "Hama Chanpon," features a generous amount of seafood, and their stir-fried noodles have a flavorful soy sauce-based sauce. Open 10:30 AM to 8:00 PM. For details, see Tabelog (posted December 2024 by user n).

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: ファミリーすしガーデンハウス
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：海鮮ちらし寿司のボリュームは、ご飯の盛りです。ネタは北海道を周遊すると、それほどでもない。（投稿：2022年7月、k様）
■海鮮ちらし寿司がボリューム満点。空腹にしていかないと全部食べられない。食べログ
■特大まんぷくちらし1600円はご飯の量が異常なので、ご飯半分にしてもらうと良い。上のネタは普通に美味しい。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: The volume of the seafood chirashi sushi is mainly in the amount of rice. The toppings aren't that impressive when you consider all the different types of seafood in Hokkaido. (Submitted by K, July 2022)
■The seafood chirashi sushi is very filling. You can't eat it all unless you go on an empty stomach. (Tabelog)
■The extra-large Manpuku Chirashi (1600 yen) has an unusually large amount of rice, so it's a good idea to ask for half the amount. The toppings are normally delicious.

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：賀老の滝 詳細 島牧村の名瀑。駐車場からクマが出没する道を少々歩く。山奥にある雄大な滝。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Garo Falls Details A famous waterfall in Shimamaki Village. A short walk from the parking lot along a path where bears are known to appear. A magnificent waterfall deep in the mountains.

properties.label: Nature Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：何故か有名では無いのですが、紅葉の名所です。山全体が赤く染まるかのような紅葉です。此処から麓のツツジ公園にかけて紅葉します。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: For some reason it's not well-known, but it's a great spot for autumn foliage. The entire mountain is dyed red by the autumn leaves. The leaves change color from here down to the azalea park at the foot of the mountain.

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：塩ラーメンは最高。豚丼は絶品。昼来客多。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: The salt ramen is the best. The pork bowl is exquisite. It gets busy at lunchtime. (Tabelog)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：越川橋梁 詳細 旧国鉄根北線の橋梁として建設され結局使用されなかったアーチ橋。国道244号の工事で一部橋脚が撤去されたが他の橋脚は現在も残っている。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Koshikawa Bridge Details An arch bridge that was constructed as a bridge for the former JNR Nekita Line but was ultimately not used. Some of the bridge piers were removed during construction of National Route 244, but the other piers still remain.

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.title_ja: 津別峠 雲海がすごい
properties.title_en: The sea of ​​clouds at Tsubetsu Pass is incredible.
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：雲海凄い、出現率高い、津別町のライブカメラで事前確認できる。詳細
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: The sea of ​​clouds is amazing, it appears frequently, and you can check it in advance using the live camera in Tsubetsu Town. Details

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 「プレミアホテル-CABIN-旭川」内 天然温泉大浴場「かぐらの湯」 （旭川）
properties.title_en: """"Kagura no Yu,"""" a natural hot spring bathhouse located inside the Premier Hotel -CABIN- Asahikawa (Asahikawa)""
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：旭川駅前のホテル内日帰り入浴です。1000円、詳細
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Day-use hot spring bath at a hotel in front of Asahikawa Station. 1000 yen, details

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: 立ち喰いそば屋 天勇
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：旭川のソウルフード「ゲソ丼」（ゲソ（イカの足）の揚げ物をのせた丼物）発祥の店。詳細、食べログ（投稿：2024年12月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: The restaurant that originated "Geso-don" (a rice bowl topped with fried squid tentacles), a soul food of Asahikawa. For details, see Tabelog (posted by n in December 2024).

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: ローソン名寄昭和通り店
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：ローソンに事前に電話確認したところ車中泊OKとのこと。ただしお店についたら店員さんに電話番号と名前の記入をお願いされました。トイレも快く使わせてもらえました。繁華街や国道から離れていることもあり夜間の車の音も気になりませんでした。（投稿：2024年5月、たつや様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: I called Lawson in advance and they said it was OK to park overnight in my car. However, when I arrived at the store, a staff member asked me to write down my phone number and name. They also kindly allowed me to use the restroom. Since it is away from the city center and the national highway, I wasn't bothered by the noise of cars at night. (Submitted by Tatsuya in May 2024)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: まりんはうす古平駐車場
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：まりんはうす内のトイレは、営業時間外は施錠されていて使用不可でした。
■当サイト読者様レポート：無料駐車場、トイレ在り（マリンハウス内２４時間）、夏は海水浴場、向かいの駐車場ではＰが取締りしてる。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: The toilets inside Marine House were locked and unusable outside of business hours.

■Report from our website reader: Free parking available, toilets available (24 hours inside Marine House), beach in summer, parking enforcement at the parking lot across the street.

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：ホルモンをラーメンの上に載せたホルモンラーメン（モルメン）の店。詳細、食べログ（投稿：2025年3月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A restaurant specializing in "hormone ramen" (morumen), which is ramen topped with offal. Details on Tabelog (Posted by n in March 2025)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: ほろしん温泉ほたる館の裏の無料キャンプ場
properties.title_en: Free campsite behind Horoshin Onsen Hotaru-kan
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：ホテル裏の旧キャンプ場は閉鎖され、トイレはシャッターが下りています。道路向かいの広い駐車場には、ホテルの敷地につきで車中泊禁止との看板が立っています。事実上、車中泊不可と判断しました。なお、温泉は硫黄の鉱泉が減っているらしく、それらしい浴感は皆無で、塩素臭しか感じませんでした。以前とは様変わりしていて残念です。（投稿：2023年10月、m様）
■情報提供感謝いたします。超絶穴場ですね、これは凄い。管理人も行ってきましたが、トイレも水場も完備です。夜も静かで最高。
■当サイト読者様レポート：ホテル側ではなく温泉側の建物に向かって右側の建物の影に細い道があり昔使っていたキャンプ場が無料で開放されています。道の向い側のキャンプ施設も５００円程度ですが無料だし温泉に近いので私はコチラを使っています。
■《ほろしん温泉ほたる館》500円、10:0022:00（日帰り入浴）、定休日は不明。詳細。露天風呂、サウナあり。無料休憩所完備。コンセント利用可能。お茶無料。休憩所の奥にコインランドリーと乾燥機あり。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: The old campsite behind the hotel is closed, and the toilets are shuttered. A sign across the road in the large parking lot indicates that overnight parking is prohibited as it is on hotel property. Effectively, I concluded that overnight parking is not possible. Also, the hot spring seems to have less sulfurous mineral water; there was no noticeable sulfurous feeling, only a chlorine smell. It's a shame that it's changed so much from before. (Submitted by: m, October 2023)

■Thank you for the information. This is an incredible hidden gem! I've been there myself, and the toilets and water facilities are all excellent. It's quiet at night, which is fantastic.

■Report from a reader of this site: There's a narrow path in the shadow of the building to the right of the building on the hot spring side (not the hotel side), and the old campsite is open to the public for free. The camping facility across the road costs around 500 yen, but it's free and closer to the hot spring, so I use that one.

■ Horoshin Onsen Hotarukan: 500 yen, 10:00-22:00 (day-use bathing), closing days unknown. Details: Open-air bath and sauna available. Free rest area available. Power outlets available. Free tea. Coin laundry and dryer located at the back of the rest area.

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：ビューポイントの投稿です。道路沿いに展望台の標識が有りますが、ほとんど人が行かない隠れスポットの様な所です。高台から駒ヶ岳から大沼まで全体が展望でき絶景です。
properties.desc_en: ■Reader Report from this Site: A review of a viewpoint. There is a sign for an observation deck along the road, but it is a hidden spot that hardly anyone goes to. From the hilltop, you can see the entire area from Mount Komagatake to Lake Onuma, and the view is spectacular.

properties.label: Nature Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：ニセコというとスキー場で有名ですが、北海道でもトップ3に入るほど有名な紅葉の名所です。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Niseko is famous for its ski resorts, but it is also one of the top three most famous spots for autumn foliage in Hokkaido.

properties.label: Camp Spot + Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 標津町 川北温泉（ヒグマ出没注意）
properties.title_en: Kawakita Onsen, Shibetsu Town (Beware of brown bear sightings)""
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：なんと無料の露天風呂♨️！詳細。乳青白色の極上濁り湯！男女別 車中泊 温泉跡地 国道244金山橋より林道。なんとトイレもある。ありがとうございます。ちなみに凶暴なヒグマが出るので気をつけてください・・・。ヒグマに気をつければ人気皆無でとても良いところです。単独で車中泊する場合は、車外にラジオを置いて鳴らし続けた方が良いかもしれません。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■標高310m
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: A free open-air bath! ♨️ Details. A superb milky-blue, cloudy hot spring! Separate baths for men and women. Suitable for overnight stays in vehicles. Located at the site of a former hot spring. Accessible via a forest road from the Kanayama Bridge on National Route 244. There's even a toilet! Thank you. Incidentally, be careful as there are aggressive brown bears... If you're careful of the brown bears, it's a very nice place with no other people around. If you're staying overnight alone in your car, you might want to place a radio outside and keep it playing. (Older post from before 2019)
■Elevation 310m

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ有（劣悪）、駐車場からやや離れたところにトイレあり。（投稿：2022年5月、巨人ファン様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There are toilets (but they are of poor quality), and they are located a short distance from the parking lot. (Submitted by: Giants fan, May 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ有（冬季は閉鎖かも？）鶴も見れるのでお勧め。朝早く鶴が鳴くので、神経質な人には向いていない。（投稿：2022年5月、巨人ファン様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレあり。名前通りのタンチョウヅルが集まるのは主に11-3月で、この時期の車中泊は厳しい。（夏に来ることもあるが）（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: Toilets available (may be closed in winter?). Recommended because you can see cranes. The cranes call out early in the morning, so it's not suitable for people who are easily bothered. (Posted by: Giants fan, May 2022)
■Report from our site's reader: Toilets available. As the name suggests, red-crowned cranes gather mainly from November to March, and overnight stays in a car during this period are difficult. (They sometimes come in the summer as well) (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 北海道釧路市 鶴ケ岱公園駐車場
properties.title_en: Tsurugadai Park Parking Lot, Kushiro City, Hokkaido""
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ有。近くの団地住人も勝手に駐車場として利用している。釧路随一のハッテン場としても有名。（※Google検索：ハッテン場とは？）（投稿：2022年5月、巨人ファン様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There is a toilet. Residents of the nearby housing complex also use it as a parking lot without permission. It is also famous as one of Kushiro's top cruising spots. (※Google search: What is a cruising spot?) (Submitted by: Giants fan, May 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 北海道釧路市 鳥取7号公園
properties.title_en: Tottori Park No. 7, Kushiro City, Hokkaido""
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ有、野球場、バスケットボールコートがあるので早朝から利用者がいる。神経質な人には音が気になるかもしれません。（投稿：2022年5月、巨人ファン様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There are toilets, a baseball field, and a basketball court, so there are users from early in the morning. The noise might be bothersome for sensitive people. (Submitted by: Giants fan, May 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ有、付近は住宅街なので気にする人には向かない（投稿：2022年5月、巨人ファン様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There is a toilet, but it is in a residential area so it may not be suitable for people who are sensitive to noise (Submitted by: Giants fan, May 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 北海道釧路市 治水記念公園
properties.title_en: Kushiro City, Hokkaido: Flood Control Memorial Park""
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ有、付近の道道がやや交通量が多いが、夜はそれほどでもない。神経質な人でなければ気にならない。中学校も近いので治安は悪くない。（投稿：2022年5月、巨人ファン様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There are toilets, and the nearby road has a fair amount of traffic, but it's not too bad at night. It shouldn't bother anyone unless they are particularly sensitive to noise. There is a junior high school nearby, so the area is safe. (Submitted by: Giants fan, May 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 北海道池田町 千代田えん堤公園
properties.title_en: Chiyoda Embankment Park, Ikeda Town, Hokkaido""
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ有、水流音が気にならなければ問題ない。（投稿：2022年5月、巨人ファン様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There is a toilet, and it's fine as long as you don't mind the sound of running water. (Submitted by: Giants fan, May 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ有、焼肉コーナーがあるので遅くまで利用している人がいると騒がしいので神経質な人には向かない。（投稿：2022年5月、巨人ファン様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There are toilets, but there is a yakiniku (grilled meat) area, so it can get noisy if there are people using it late at night. It's not suitable for people who are easily bothered by noise. (Submitted by: Giants fan, May 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 別海鉄道記念公園駐車場
properties.title_en: Betsukai Railway Memorial Park Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ有、構内に併設されているバス待合室のトイレを利用できる。鉄道に関する博物館やSLが展示されている。利用者は少ないので静か。（投稿：2022年5月、巨人ファン様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There are toilets available, and you can use the toilets in the bus waiting room located on the premises. There is a railway museum and a steam locomotive on display. It is quiet because there are few users. (Submitted by: Giants fan, May 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 北海道釧路市 春採公園
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ有、近くの病院利用者も多く停める。夜間は救急車の往来もあり、神経質な人には向かない。（投稿：2022年5月、巨人ファン様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There are toilets, and many people using the nearby hospital park here. There is also ambulance traffic at night, so it's not suitable for people who are easily bothered. (Submitted by: Giants fan, May 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ有、近くの団地の住人が駐車場として利用しているので混んでいる（投稿：2022年5月、巨人ファン様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There are toilets, but it gets crowded because residents of the nearby housing complex use it as a parking lot (Submitted by: Giants Fan, May 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 北海道釧路市 緑ヶ岡公園
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ有、トイレは非常にキレイ。駐車スペースも広く、車中泊利用者も多い。夏場は焼肉利用者も多く、夜まで騒ぐ者もいる。（投稿：2022年5月、巨人ファン様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There are toilets, and they are very clean. There is ample parking space, and many people stay overnight in their cars. In the summer, many people come for barbecues, and some make noise until late at night. (Submitted by: Giants fan, May 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: <font color="red">（早朝にラジオ体操あり）</font>小樽公園
properties.title_en: <font color="red">（早朝にラジオ体操あり）</font>小樽Park
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ夜間閉鎖なし（24時頃確認）多目的トイレで洋式1つのみだが、トイレットペーパーが設置されていない模様。芯のゴミが見当たらなかった。自販機が3つ設置、コンビニも車で2.3分ヶ所に4つ、入浴施設も車3分で2ヶ所。街灯もあり暗すぎない。静かでよいが25時頃男女が乗った軽が来てずっとアイドリング＆少し騒いで行った。6:30頃から地域の人が集まりラジオ体操が始まります笑。6:00頃から人が集まり初め、爆音ラジオ＆談笑で起こされます笑。今日は6:45までやってました。お聞きしたところ、夏でも冬でも毎日（雨天中止かもしれない）開催するようです。迷惑でないか、もお聞きしたところ、おば様にはどうぞどうぞと笑顔で答えて頂けましたが、利用するなら6時前までの利用が迷惑でなくて良いかも。邪魔にならないようになるべく端には止めるべき。と、ここで気づいたが長時間の駐車はご遠慮下さいと看板あり。（投稿：2024年8月、s様）
■穴場を発見。無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレはキレイな水洗洋式で夜間も電気つく。夜間非常に静か。治安については自己責任。（2022年7月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's readers: The toilets are not closed at night (confirmed around midnight). There is only one Western-style toilet in the multipurpose toilet area, but it seems that there is no toilet paper. No cardboard cores were found. There are three vending machines, four convenience stores within a 2-3 minute drive, and two bathing facilities within a 3 minute drive. There are streetlights so it's not too dark. It's quiet and nice, but around 1am a light vehicle with a man and woman in it came and idled for a long time and made some noise before leaving. Around 6:30am local people gather and radio calisthenics begin lol. People start gathering around 6am, and you are woken up by loud radio and chatting lol. Today it went on until 6:45am. When I asked, it seems that it is held every day, summer and winter (may be canceled in case of rain). When I asked if it was a nuisance, an older woman smiled and said please go ahead, but if you are going to use it, it might be better to use it before 6am to avoid causing a nuisance. You should park as far to the side as possible so as not to get in the way. And then I noticed there was a sign that said please refrain from parking for long periods of time. (Submitted by: S, August 2024)
■Discovered a hidden gem. Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. The toilets are clean, flushable Western-style toilets with lights on at night. Very quiet at night. Safety is at your own risk. (Confirmed on-site by administrator in July 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ夜間解放は恐らく道路先端の駐車場のことかと思われ、こちらでも車中泊出来そう。小便器、和式 1つずつ。洗面所も水流れず、和式にも便が放置されてました。あまり利用したくない清潔感。漁師さん用なのかも知れません。（投稿：2024年8月、s様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：夜でもトイレ解放されているけど、電気点かず真っ暗。駐車場にも近くにも街灯無く真っ暗でした。夜になると誰も通らないのでとても静かではあります。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：無料駐車場と、外に夜間も使える公衆トイレあり。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: The toilets that are open at night are probably the ones in the parking lot at the end of the road, and it seems possible to park overnight there. There is one urinal and one squat toilet. The sink doesn't flush, and there was feces left in the squat toilet. It's not very clean, so I wouldn't want to use it. Maybe it's for fishermen. (Submitted by: s, August 2024)

■ Reader Report: The toilets are open at night, but the lights are off, so it's pitch black. There are no streetlights in the parking lot or nearby, so it's completely dark. It's very quiet at night because no one passes by. (Older post from before 2019)

■ Reader Report: There is a free parking lot and a public toilet outside that can be used at night. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレや24hガソリンスタンドがある、北海道では最大規模のPA。フードコート・売店は411月は8:0020:00、123月は9:0019:00（上り線（函館方面）売店は24h）営業。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■輪厚PA、広大なPA。普通。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's readers: The largest PA in Hokkaido, with restrooms and a 24-hour gas station. The food court and shops are open from 8:00 to 20:00 in November, and from 9:00 to 19:00 in March (the shops on the northbound lane (towards Hakodate) are open 24 hours). (Older post from before 2019)

■Watsu PA, a vast PA. Average. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There are toilets, but they are closed in winter. There are convenience stores and hot springs in the town about a 5-minute drive away, and the sound of frogs in the summer is unbearable. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレあり。海沿いのため津波に注意。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Toilets available. Be careful of tsunamis as it is located near the coast. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: There is a toilet. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ・自販機設置。隣接するレストラン等の施設は昼のみ営業。詳細（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■本線から分離で非常に良い！（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■下道用の駐車場は夜間完全閉鎖。また、ここの周辺に駐車場があちこちにあるが、全て夜間閉鎖となるので、下道では車中泊利用はできない。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: Toilets and vending machines available. Adjacent restaurants and other facilities are only open during the day. Details (Older post from before 2019)
■ Excellent separation from the main road! (Older post from before 2019)
■ Parking for local roads is completely closed at night. Also, there are many parking lots around here, but they are all closed at night, so overnight parking is not possible on local roads. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ・自販機の他、売店・フードコート　4-11月8:00-20:00、12-3月9:00-19:00営業。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: In addition to toilets and vending machines, there is a shop and food court open from 8:00 to 20:00 from April to November, and from 9:00 to 19:00 from December to March. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：タウシュベツ川橋梁 詳細 糠平湖に架かる旧国鉄士幌線のアーチ橋。ダムの水が少ない冬季に橋の姿を見ることができる。810月頃は湖面に沈む。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Taushubetsu River Bridge Details An arch bridge of the former JNR Shihoro Line spanning Lake Nukabira. The bridge can be seen in winter when the dam's water level is low. Around October it is submerged in the lake.

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.title_ja: しべちゃ風牧場 摩周湖からの伏流水
properties.title_en: Shibetsu Ranch, using groundwater from Lake Mashu""
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：ソフトクリーム販売店舗の横に、摩周湖からの伏流水が出ているので店員さんに確認したら飲んでも、汲んで帰っても良いとのです。駐車スペースは広いです。（投稿：2024年8月、タカネ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There is a spring next to the soft-serve ice cream shop where groundwater from Lake Mashu flows out. I asked the staff and they said it's okay to drink it or take some home. There is ample parking space. (Submitted by Takane, August 2024)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: バーベキューパーク ブロイラー
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：ザンギ専門店。美味です。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A specialty fried chicken (zangi) restaurant. Delicious! (Tabelog)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：サロベツ湿原 詳細 日本最北の広大な湿原。夏季には様々な花が咲く。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website readers: Sarobetsu Wetland Details Japan's northernmost vast wetland. Various flowers bloom in the summer.

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：サービスエリアとは名ばかりでトイレと自販機しか無い（夏は軽食の売店が出る）。本線とは区分されているため割と静か。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: It's a service area in name only, with only toilets and vending machines (a snack stand appears in the summer). It's relatively quiet because it's separated from the main road. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：ゴンドラ乗り場のトイレは営業時間外は閉鎖されてます。4:00ぐらいから開場するので、夜間は隣の木林の湯の駐車場に停泊し、クラブメッツのロビーのトイレを使わせてもらう必要あります。(公式には宿泊者以外の立ち入りは禁止ですが、わからないので普通に使えます) リゾート内で無料バスが循環しており、車を停泊してリゾート内のラストランへ行くこと可能です。（投稿：2025年8月、だ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: The toilets at the gondola station are closed outside of operating hours. They open around 4:00 AM, so at night you'll need to park in the parking lot of the adjacent Kibayashi no Yu hot spring and use the toilets in the Club Mets lobby. (Officially, entry is prohibited for non-guests, but I'm not sure, so you can use them without any problems.) There is a free shuttle bus circulating within the resort, so you can park your car and go to the last run within the resort. (Submitted by: Da, August 2025)

properties.label: Camp Spot + Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：この駐車場は車中泊禁止です。（投稿：2020年9月）（※真偽不明）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。「野宿、キャンプは禁止」との看板あり。車中泊は微妙な感じだが、物理的には車中泊可能。超有名な無料温泉、コタンの湯が隣接。200円の公衆浴場「コタン共同浴場」も利用可能。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: Overnight parking is prohibited in this parking lot. (Posted: September 2020) (※Authenticity unknown)
■Free parking and public toilets. There is a sign that says "No sleeping in the wild or camping." Overnight parking is questionable, but physically possible. The very famous free hot spring, Kotan no Yu, is next door. The 200 yen public bath, "Kotan Kyodo Yukujo," is also available. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: 函館港 謎の駐車スペース（無料）
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：こちら函館港　ナゾの駐車場ですが、30年位前にタクシー運転手が殺害された事件があり、未だに犯人は捕まっていません。それどころか、この港では車ごと海に落ちる事が相次いでいて、2020年頃には鉄パイプのサクが取り付けられました。車止めは元々ありました。車中泊はおすすめしません。（投稿：2022年1月、n様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：津軽海峡フェリーの東側にある道路及び、その東にある駐車場。フェリー利用者の駐車スペースになっている模様。駐車場の方は、80台くらい停めれるスペースがある。トイレは、フェリーターミナルの入り口にあり、ゴミ箱もあります。時折、フェリーの放送がある程度で、そんなにうるさくはない。（投稿：2020年8月、M様）
■トイレは徒歩3分のところに公衆トイレがある。
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: This is a mysterious parking lot at Hakodate Port. About 30 years ago, a taxi driver was murdered here, and the culprit has still not been caught. Moreover, there have been numerous incidents of cars falling into the sea at this port, and around 2020, a fence made of iron pipes was installed. There were already car stoppers. Overnight parking is not recommended. (Submitted: January 2022, Mr. N)

■ Reader Report: The road on the east side of the Tsugaru Strait Ferry terminal and the parking lot to the east of it. It appears to be a parking space for ferry users. The parking lot has space for about 80 cars. There are toilets at the entrance of the ferry terminal, and there are also trash cans. There are occasional ferry announcements, but it's not that noisy. (Submitted: August 2020, Mr. M)

■ There is a public toilet a 3-minute walk away.

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 あいおいの「クマヤキ」
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：クマヤキが有名。手づくり豆腐、十割蕎麦、やけどにいい熊の油(超レア)がある。道の駅で売っている。タイヤキではなく、クマヤキ。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Famous for its bear-shaped pastries. They also have handmade tofu, 100% buckwheat soba noodles, and bear oil (extremely rare) which is good for burns. Sold at a roadside station. It's bear-shaped pastries, not taiyaki. Tabelog

properties.label: Paid Campground
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：キャンプ場内には車は入れない。支笏湖では人気のキャンプ場で週末は混雑する。料金詳細。湖畔から恵庭岳を望み風光明媚なり。トイレ、炊事場在り。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Cars are not allowed inside the campsite. It's a popular campsite at Lake Shikotsu and gets crowded on weekends. Details on fees. The view of Mount Eniwa from the lakeside is scenic. There are toilets and cooking facilities. (Older post from before 2019)
