■Report from our site's reader: This roadside station is not very large, located south of Mt. Yotei, but it's quite quiet and recommended. There is no onsen (hot spring) on-site, but there is "Makari Onsen (500 yen)" a 34-minute drive away. It's a small onsen, but you can see Mt. Yotei from the open-air bath, so I think it's quite nice. If this is closed, "Rusutsu Onsen (200 yen)" in the neighboring village is also recommended. This is an even smaller onsen with only an indoor bath, but the water quality is very good and it felt great. There is a convenience store (Seven-Eleven) and a gas station near the roadside station, which is convenient. The restaurant (soba and donburi) inside the roadside station facility was also delicious. You can use free high-speed Wi-Fi from inside your car if you are near the roadside station building, which is convenient. On a clear morning, you can step out of your car and be greeted by the magnificent view of Mount Yotei. However, power lines and trees obstruct the view, so if you want a better perspective, you might consider going to "Flower Parking," about 3km east of this roadside station. (Older post from before 2019)

■足湯が有るが温泉は無い。広めの駐車場と、凄く綺麗なトイレ。駐車場が幹線道路に沿った場所にあり、非常にうるさい。安眠は難しい。利便性はいいが、車中泊場所としてはあまりおすすめではない。（2019年以前の古い投稿）

■Report from a Reader of This Site: Today, October 3rd, I visited Michi-no-Eki Mashu Onsen and saw information about paid garbage collection, so I'm letting you know. There was a sign at the outdoor trash cans for plastic bottles, beverage cans, and glass bottles that said, "General garbage will be collected for a fee." (Attached images, attached images, attached images, attached images) Inside the store, there were posters, garbage bags for sale, and information on how to collect garbage. 50 yen per bag / 10-liter size (see attachment) Garbage collection hours are from opening time until 5 PM. You need to put out your garbage according to the sorting categories. (Posted: October 2025, k)
■Report from a Reader of This Site: Many people were camping in their cars in both the 1st and 2nd parking lots. In particular, there were many campervans in the 2nd parking lot that seemed to have mistaken it for an auto campsite. It looked like it would be noisy with partying idiots along the main road. However, the temporary parking lot (details below) is located in the forest and is quiet. Officially, it is recommended to use this parking lot for rest. The reason it's not explicitly labeled as "overnight parking" is probably because it has a paid overnight parking area attached. See attached images for location 👉️ Image 1, Image 2, detailed location (Posted: July 2022, by s)
■ There is a footbath, but no hot spring. There is a spacious parking lot and very clean toilets. The parking lot is located along a main road and is very noisy. A good night's sleep is difficult. properties.desc_ja:
■2024年8月管理人現地確認：車中泊評価【Aランク😄】83点👉️現地の写真・詳細案内図はこちら

■当サイト読者様レポート：温泉が併設されており入浴後すぐに眠りにつけます。車中泊車多数停まっていました。その多さゆえに深夜にドアをぶつけたぶつけてない口論が起きていてうるさかったです。トイレ２４時間使えます。（投稿：2024年9月、ゆーぷる様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：温泉併設で車中泊人気スポット。人気がゆえに、連休はすごく混んでいます。隣に、アイドリング厨がいた場合、最悪。場所移動も出来ない。（投稿：2022年9月、s様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：三連泊しました。温泉に休憩室、レストラン スープらしいカレー1000円で、シェフのお勧め、しょうが焼き定食、Bランチ全部美味しかった。売店の缶ビール持ち込みOK、ノンアルコールもあり。静かな駐車場、コンビニ2分。温泉、食事、静か、空いている。知床の入口、摩周湖の入口今話題の神の子池15分 ダート2キロぐらいあり 夕方が特に綺麗 さくら滝10分ダート500m マスの滝登り 7月15日17時 バンバン跳んでました。朝方は、5分に1匹ぐらい、温泉で地元の方にお聞きしました。裏摩周までの道 完全舗装 鹿と衝突多い 朝方衝突現場目撃しました。朝夕 特に注意です。（投稿：2017年7月、h様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：北海道斜里郡清里町にあります「道の駅 パパスランドさっつる」です。こちらに車中泊しましたがかなり快適です。車中泊お断りと掲載されておりますがそんなことはなく結構な車中泊の方々がおりました。道沿いですが車の往来はそんなになく建物に近いところに停めれば結構静かに寝られますし、夜中はほとんど車は通らないので静かでした。さらに建物側に停めると同時に道の駅の無料wifiが車内にいながら快適に使用できました。食事や温泉も満喫できたのでだまされたと思ってぜひ行かれることをオススメします。SランクかAランクにできるかと思います。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■昔は車中泊お断りの看板あったが、今は撤去されたもよう。「道の駅ＳＰＯＴ」なる無料無線LANが24時間使える。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■August 2024 Administrator's On-Site Verification: Car Camping Rating [A Rank 😄] 83 points 👉️ Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■Bathing ♨️: 《Papasland Hot Spring》 480 yen Details
■Report from our site's reader: There is a hot spring attached, so you can go to sleep immediately after bathing. Many cars were parked there for overnight stays. Because of the large number, there was a loud argument in the middle of the night about whether or not doors had been bumped. The toilet is available 24 hours a day. (Posted: September 2024, Yu-puru)
■Report from our site's reader: A popular spot for car camping with an attached hot spring. Because of its popularity, it gets very crowded during long weekends. It's the worst if there's an idling enthusiast next to you. You can't move locations either. (Posted: September 2022, s)
■Report from our site's reader: I stayed for three nights. The hot springs have a rest area and a restaurant. The soup-like curry is 1000 yen, and the chef's recommendation, ginger pork set meal, and B lunch were all delicious. You can bring your own canned beer from the shop, and non-alcoholic options are available. There's a quiet parking lot and a convenience store a 2-minute walk away. The hot springs, food, quiet atmosphere, and uncrowded are all great. It's the entrance to Shiretoko and Lake Mashu. The currently popular Kaminoko Pond is 15 minutes away, with about 2km of dirt road. It's especially beautiful in the evening. Sakura Falls is 10 minutes away, 500m dirt road. Trout were jumping up the waterfall (July 15th, 5pm). In the morning, there was about one every 5 minutes, according to a local at the hot springs. The road to Ura-Mashu is fully paved, but there are many collisions with deer. I witnessed a collision in the morning. Be especially careful in the morning and evening. (Posted: July 2017, by h)

■Report from a reader of this site: This is "Michi-no-Eki Papasland Satsuru" in Kiyosato-cho, Shari-gun, Hokkaido. I stayed overnight in my car here and it was quite comfortable. Although it says "No overnight parking," there were quite a few people staying overnight in their cars. It's along the road, but there isn't much traffic, and if you park close to the building, it's quite quiet to sleep. There's hardly any traffic at night, so it's very peaceful. Furthermore, parking closer to the building allowed me to comfortably use the roadside station's free Wi-Fi from inside my car. I also enjoyed the food and hot springs, so I highly recommend you go and check it out. I think it deserves an S or A rating. (Older post from before 2019)

■There used to be a sign saying "No overnight parking," but it seems to have been removed. There's a free 24-hour wireless LAN called "Roadside Station SPOT." (Older post from before 2019)

■当サイト読者様レポート：掲載されている道の駅阿寒丹頂の里についてメールしました。時系列で表記します。
2022.9
車中泊はご遠慮（有料RVパーク）看板・掲示確認。添付画像1、添付画像2。国交省管轄部署へ連絡👉️表現・道の駅駐車場の運用とも不適切との回答。後日看板、掲示物撤去したとの連絡あり。
2023.1
一部古い掲示物（旧）がそのままなので（添付画像1）再度国交省へ連絡。現地から撤去済報告は受けていたが国交省担当者は未確認とのこと。後日確実に撤去したとの連絡。
2023.5.30
有料RVパーク併設の他の道の駅と同じく「道の駅駐車場」での休憩は（無料で）できます。（道の駅インフォーメーションでも確認済）
2023.6
現在も「宿泊目的…」の掲示物(新)=添付画像3はあります。ただ道の駅インフォメーションに「道の駅駐車場」での夜間の休憩を確認したところご自由にとのことでした。
（投稿：2023年6月、t様）（英雄。皆のために抗議活動ありがとうございました。）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2022年8月22日（月）にRVパークを利用しました。最初は「車中泊禁止」の掲示にびっくりしましたが、道の駅の受付で確認したところ、吹き出しにありましたように「温泉入浴券一人分」、+「ワンドリンク券（ビールまたはソフトドリンクを１杯）」（ワンドリンクは８月中で終わりで以後はないそうですので掲示は無しかと）。＊駐車スペースは、奥行き７X横５ⅿで、両隣１台分の空きは確保される。　＊可燃ゴミ３０ℓ分、ペットボトル１０ℓ分、缶10ℓ分のごみ袋が渡される。　＊空きガスボンベ、瓶は無料のボックスあり　＊車外でのカセットガスコンロの使用はOK（直火、花火、炭火、薪は禁止）　なので、実質の持ち出しは1,000円未満かと。安いか高いかは受け取りの方で違うと思いますが、こんなにプレミアが付いて、1泊1,500円ならどしどし増えて欲しいです。（投稿：2022年8月、j様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：２０２２年７月中旬から、車中泊専用スペースが1日1500円で1人温泉無料、となりました。電源を使う場合は2000円。それ以外の場所では車中泊禁止とあり、以前奧にあった専用スペースは従業員用になったようです。（投稿：2022年8月、m様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：車中泊専用スペースがあり、こちらは幹線道路から離れており静かです。ただし、街頭は無く懐中電灯が必要です。車中泊組は多数居ましたがマナーよく静かでした。（投稿：2022年7月、s様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：今晩は「道の駅阿寒丹頂の里」で車中泊しています。温泉・レストランも併設されており、なんと言っても車中泊スペースが確保されているところがいいと思います。（投稿：2021年9月、i様）

■Report from our site's reader: There was a sign stating "Please refrain from using the facility for overnight stays or parking." (Attached images, attached images) (This is thought to be in consideration of the adjacent RV park) (Submitted: October 2025, k)
■Report from our site's reader: We sent an email regarding the listed Michi-no-Eki Akan Tancho no Sato. Listed chronologically.

2022.9
Confirmed sign/posting stating "Please refrain from overnight stays in vehicles (paid RV park)." Attached image 1, attached image 2. Contacted the relevant department of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism 👉️ Response: Both the wording and the operation of the Michi-no-Eki parking lot were deemed inappropriate. Later, we received notification that the sign and postings had been removed.

2023.1
Some old notices (previous) remain (attached image 1), so I contacted the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism again. Although I had received a report from the site that they had been removed, the Ministry official said they hadn't confirmed it. Later, I received confirmation that they had definitely been removed.

2023.5.30
Like other roadside stations with paid RV parks, you can rest in the "Roadside Station Parking Lot" (free of charge). (Confirmed at the Roadside Station Information Center)
2023.6
The "For Overnight Stays..." notice (new) = attached image 3 is still there. However, when I inquired at the Roadside Station Information Center about resting overnight in the "Roadside Station Parking Lot," they said it was fine.

(Posted: June 2023, by T) (Hero. Thank you for your protest activities for everyone.)
■Report from a reader of this site: I used the RV park on August 22, 2022 (Monday). At first I was surprised to see the "No Overnight Parking" sign, but when I checked at the roadside station's reception, as indicated in the speech bubble, it included "One Hot Spring Bathing Ticket" + "One Drink Ticket (One Beer or Soft Drink)" (the free drink offer ended in August and will not be available after that, so the sign probably won't be up). *The parking space is 7m deep x 5m wide, with one space reserved on either side. *Garbage bags for 30L of combustible waste, 10L of plastic bottles, and 10L of cans are provided. *There is a free box for empty gas cylinders and bottles. *Using a portable gas stove outside the car is OK (open fires, fireworks, charcoal, and firewood are prohibited). So, the actual cost out of pocket is probably less than 1,000 yen. Whether it's cheap or expensive depends on the person receiving it, but with such a premium, at 1,500 yen per night, I hope it becomes more popular. (Posted: August 2022, by J)
■Report from our site's reader: From mid-July 2022, the dedicated overnight parking space for cars is 1500 yen per day, with free access to the hot springs for one person. Using electricity costs 2000 yen. Overnight parking is prohibited in other areas, and the previously designated space at the back seems to be for employees only. (Posted: August 2022, by M)
■Report from our site's reader: There is a dedicated overnight parking space, which is quiet as it is away from the main road. However, there are no streetlights, so a flashlight is necessary. There were many people staying overnight in their cars, but they were well-mannered and quiet. (Posted: July 2022, by S)
■Report from our site's reader: Tonight I'm staying overnight in my car at "Michi-no-Eki Akan Tancho no Sato". It has hot springs and a restaurant, and best of all, there's a designated overnight parking space. (Posted: September 2021, by I)

(Posted: July 2023, by n)

■当サイト読者様レポート：フェリーターミナルの無料駐車場で車中泊。ターミナル内のトイレは夜間用出入り口があり24時間使用可能。とても綺麗なウォッシュレットトイレ。駐車場広く駐車している車はほぼ島に行った人の車。漁船の出入りあり。ターミナル内の「浜の母ちゃん食堂」は朝8時から14時まで営業だが営業期間は5月から8月までのようです。値段はそれなりですが美味しかったです。ターミナル内に観光案内所があり釣竿レンタル（1時間500円）して港で釣りができました。（投稿：2023年8月、d様）
properties.desc_en:
■Administrator's On-Site Verification, July 2024: Car Camping Evaluation [Excluded Rank 😅] 57 points 👉️ Click here for photos and detailed map of the site

Very clean toilets with washlets. The parking lot is large, and almost all the parked cars belong to people going to the island. Fishing boats come and go. The "Hama no Kaachan Shokudo" inside the terminal is open from 8 am to 2 pm, but it seems to be open only from May to August. The prices are reasonable, but it was delicious. There is a tourist information center inside the terminal where you can rent a fishing rod (500 yen for 1 hour) and go fishing at the port. (Posted: August 2023, by d)

■星空マニアの説明：詳細
properties.desc_en:
■See photos of the Milky Way taken here

To deter bears, it is recommended to keep the car engine running and the radio playing while taking photos. There is a public toilet at the trailhead and overnight parking is possible. (Older post from before 2019)
■Just before the trailhead parking lot, there is a clearing with an open view of the southeastern sky (details of location), where you can see the southeastern Milky Way perfectly. It is extremely beautiful due to the high altitude and darkness of the sky. However, the view is narrower compared to Highland Koshimizu 725. Incidentally, it is very difficult to get here as you need to drive on a bumpy dirt road for more than 30 minutes. If your purpose is to photograph the Milky Way, Ginsendai is one of the best, but if you want to see a sky full of stars, Highland Koshimizu 725 is more convenient and recommended for its grand panoramic view of the starry sky (literally a sky full of stars). I thought it was strange that no one was there, but then the caretaker happened to come and asked if I was planning to camp here in my car, so I said yes. The caretaker said that if it rains here, the road will be closed and landslides will occur, and if something happens, calling for help from Kitami would cost over 100,000 yen. Because of the potential for serious problems, we don't allow car camping. He clearly told me that car camping is allowed at the Bihoro Pass roadside station or the Wakoto campsite, so I should go there instead. Car camping is prohibited. (Posted: June 2023, Nanami☆)

■トイレ完備（簡易水洗の洋式）。飲用可能な水道水を汲める。快晴の夜は満天の星。天体観測スポット。携帯圏外のため注意。 →2019年ドコモ電波OKになってました。キャンプ場の手前の管理棟のところにも広い駐車場ときれいなトイレ（水洗洋式）がある。非常に素晴らしい。（2019年8月管理人現地確認）

There is also a large parking lot and clean toilets (flush toilets, Western style) near the management building before the campsite. Absolutely wonderful. ■天体観測スポット。標高1063m。東の帯広方面は光害が酷いが、南方面は暗くて天の川を見ることができる。しかし残念ながら、ちょうど南にこの展望台よりも高い山があり、天の川銀河中心部（射手座方向）のモヤモヤ（暗黒星雲）が山に隠れて見えない。天の川撮影的には中心部のあのモヤモヤが無いと寂しく微妙なので、あまりおすすめとは言えない感じ。ちなみにトイレは無いので車中泊は無理。あとヒグマ出没注意。（2021年8月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■See photos of the Milky Way taken here
■Astronomical observation spot. Elevation 1063m. Light pollution is severe towards Obihiro in the east, but it is dark to the south and the Milky Way can be seen. However, unfortunately, there is a mountain higher than this observation deck just to the south, and the hazy area (dark nebula) at the center of the Milky Way galaxy (towards Sagittarius) is hidden by the mountain and cannot be seen. From the perspective of photographing the Milky Way, it is a bit disappointing and not very good without that hazy area at the center, so it is not really recommended. By the way, there are no toilets, so overnight stays in a car are not possible. Also, be careful of brown bear sightings. (Confirmed on-site by the administrator in August 2021)

■It's also featured on the Shibecha town's country sign, offering a 360° view of the horizon. The surrounding area is Japan's largest "Great Ranch with a View of the Horizon." There is a paid campsite and a spring. There are toilets in the parking lot, and overnight stays in vehicles are possible. A good spot for stargazing. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_ja:
■ここで撮影された天の川写真を見てみる
■当サイト読者様レポート：天文台脇の駐車場。坂道を降りると道の駅「ロマン街道初山別」があり温泉も入れる。露天風呂からは遠別から稚内への海岸線が見える。日本海に沈む太陽を見送り、天文台で入館料を払い星を見て駐車場で車中泊したが、天の川がくっきりと見える光害の少ない空だった。天体観測スポット。
properties.desc_en:
■See photos of the Milky Way taken here
■Report from a reader of this site: The parking lot next to the observatory. If you go down the slope, you will find the roadside station "Roman Kaido Shosanbetsu" where you can also enjoy a hot spring bath. From the open-air bath, you can see the coastline from Enbetsu to Wakkanai. After watching the sun set over the Sea of ​​Japan, I paid the entrance fee to the observatory, watched the stars, and slept in my car in the parking lot. The sky was clear with little light pollution, and the Milky Way was clearly visible. A great spot for stargazing.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■ここで撮影された天の川写真を見てみる
■無料駐車場とトイレ（簡易水洗の洋式）完備。山頂まで車で行ける。携帯電波もギリギリOK。見晴らしも最高で、極上の天体観測スポットである。標高1113m。凶暴なヒグマ出没注意。真南に旭川の光害があるので、南東に天の川がある時間を狙うのが良さそう。美深市街側にある林道入口（詳細場所）から山頂まで砂利のダート道を走って70分程度かかる。登るのが大変なわりには南から西にかけて市街地の光害があるので、星空（天の川）を見るならこれなら銀泉台行ったほうが良いかも。視界が広大で、南から北へと空を縦断する天の川を一望できるのは素晴らしい。管理人がここで撮影した天の川（2020年7月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■See photos of the Milky Way taken here
■Free parking and toilets (simple flush Western-style toilets) are available. You can drive all the way to the summit. Cell phone reception is just about OK. The view is superb, making it a top-notch stargazing spot. Elevation 1113m. Beware of aggressive brown bears. There is light pollution from Asahikawa to the south, so it's best to aim for a time when the Milky Way is to the southeast. It takes about 70 minutes to drive on the gravel dirt road from the forest road entrance on the Bifuka town side (details of location) to the summit. It's hard to climb, and there is light pollution from the town from the south to the west, so if you want to see the starry sky (Milky Way), you might be better off going to Ginsendai. The view is vast, and it's wonderful to be able to see the Milky Way traversing the sky from south to north. Milky Way photographed here by the administrator (verified on-site by the administrator in July 2020)

■当サイト読者様レポート：北海道の景勝地巡ってますが、ハイランド小清水、21時頃消灯してました！（投稿：2022年6月、さすらい様）
■2021年7月、夜に快晴予報だったので久しぶりに来てみたら、駐車場の電灯が夜中までついたままで、その光害のために駐車場ではろくに星が見えなくなっていた。2018年に来たときには、21時すぎには電灯は消えて真っ暗で最高だったのだが。星を見たい場合は、南の方にある展望台まで歩いて行くか、ここの近くの路肩（例えばココやココ）で見るのが良いと思う。（2021年7月管理人現地確認）
■無料駐車場とトイレ（きれいな水洗洋式）。車中泊可能。標高は施設名のとおり725m　詳細説明（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■2018年管理人も行ってきました。快晴の夜はもの凄い星空。大パノラマの視界で文字通り満天の星。南から北へと空を縦断する天の川を肉眼で見ることができる（関西の護摩壇山や剱山は北天が明るいため、ここのような南から北へと縦断する大パノラマの天の川を見ることができない）。めちゃくちゃキレイでビックリ。感動しました。南天の天の川銀河中心部（射手座方向）を撮りたい場合は100mほど離れた展望台に行く（長時間露光すると釧路の光害あり）。ここは車でのアクセスも容易だし車中泊も快適だし非常におすすめです。北海道の星見スポットで一番気に入りました（銀泉台よりもこっちのほうが満足度高い）。ここで管理人が撮影した天の川（2018年）
properties.desc_en:
■See photos of the Milky Way taken here
■Report from a reader of this site: I'm touring scenic spots in Hokkaido, and the lights at Highland Koshimizu were turned off around 9 PM! (Posted: June 2022, by Sasurai)
■In July 2021, I came here for the first time in a while because the forecast was for clear skies at night, but the lights in the parking lot were on until midnight, and due to the light pollution, it was almost impossible to see any stars in the parking lot. When I came in 2018, the lights were turned off after 9 PM, and it was pitch black, which was great. If you want to see the stars, I think it's best to walk to the observation deck to the south or look from the roadside nearby (for example, here or here). (Administrator's on-site confirmation, July 2021)
■Free parking and toilets (clean flush toilets). Overnight parking is possible. The elevation is 725m as the facility name suggests. Detailed explanation (older posts from before 2019)
■The administrator also went there in 2018. On clear nights, the starry sky is amazing. A truly magnificent panoramic view of the starry sky. You can see the Milky Way stretching from south to north with the naked eye (you can't see such a grand panoramic view of the Milky Way from south to north at Gomadanzan or Tsurugiyama in the Kansai region because the northern sky is too bright). It was incredibly beautiful and amazing. I was deeply moved. If you want to photograph the southern Milky Way's galactic center (towards Sagittarius), go to the observation deck about 100m away (there is light pollution from Kushiro if you use long exposures). This place is easily accessible by car, comfortable for overnight stays in your car, and highly recommended. It's my favorite stargazing spot in Hokkaido (more satisfying than Ginsendai). The Milky Way photographed here by the administrator (2018)

properties.title_ja: 函館 空港緑地 志海苔ふれあい広場
properties.title_en: Hakodate Airport Green Space, Shinori Fureai Plaza""
properties.desc_ja:
■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2025年6月現地調査）
■当サイト読者様レポート：到着したときには一台だけ停まっていて人気ゼロでした。辺りには民家がありますが、暗いです。治安については自己責任です。（投稿：2024年9月、ゆーぷる様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ夜間閉鎖無し。空港のすぐ隣にあり離発着する飛行機が見られ、音もすごい。夜は20:00頃で離発着便無くなるので問題なく寝れる。（投稿：2024年8月、s様）
■フライト時刻表、詳細
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。車中泊可能との報告あり。ナビは海保航空基地でＯＫ 駐車スペースは上下に有り、裕に数十台分 上段がおすすめ トイレはきれい ジュース自販機 早朝、散歩人が通る程度 WiMAXは上段でなんとか圏内（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is possible. (On-site survey, June 2025)
■Report from our site's reader: When I arrived, there was only one car parked and no one was around. There are houses nearby, but it's dark. Safety is at your own risk. (Posted: September 2024, Yu-puru)
■Report from our site's reader: Toilets are not closed at night. It's right next to the airport, so you can see planes taking off and landing, and the noise is incredible. There are no more flights taking off or landing around 8:00 PM, so you can sleep without any problems. (Posted: August 2024, s)
■Flight timetable, details
■Free parking and public toilets. Reports indicate that overnight parking is possible. Navigation to Japan Coast Guard Air Base is OK. There are parking spaces on both the upper and lower levels, easily enough for dozens of cars. The upper level is recommended. The toilets are clean. There is a juice vending machine. Only a few people pass by in the early morning. WiMAX has some signal on the upper level (older post from before 2019)

properties.title_ja: 西大沼チェーン脱着場
properties.desc_ja:
■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2024年9月現地調査）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレは近年リニューアルされたようでキレイな水洗で洋式もあり。携帯電波OK。難点としては非常に交通量の多い国道沿いで、大型トラックや爆音バイクもガンガン走りうるさい。あまりおすすめという感じはない。（2023年9月管理人現地確認）
■トイレあり、広い駐車スペース。北の方にはコンビニやラッキーピエロ（0:30）あり。主要幹線（国道5号）沿いで、通行量多い。当然ながらうるさいので安眠は難しい。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is possible. (September 2024, on-site survey)
■Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. The toilets appear to have been recently renovated and are clean, with flush toilets and Western-style toilets. Cell phone reception is OK. The downside is that it is located along a very busy national highway, and large trucks and loud motorcycles pass by constantly, making it noisy. Not really recommended. (September 2023, on-site verification by administrator)
■Toilets available, large parking space. There is a convenience store and Lucky Pierrot (0:30) to the north. It is located along a major highway (National Route 5), so there is a lot of traffic. Naturally, it is noisy, making a good night's sleep difficult. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 長万部町役場 駐車場
properties.desc_ja:
■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2025年8月現地調査）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2022.5.18車中泊。午後6時くらいに訪問したら車が20台ほど停まっていたが、これらは役場職員のクルマの様子。帰宅する職員に怪訝そうに見られるが、通報はされなかった。夜11時過ぎまで働いている人も多く、朝は6時ごろから出勤してくる人もいて、地方の役場も勤務時間が長くて大変だなぁと思いつつ二度寝してしまった(笑)。出入りがあっても広いのでさほど気にならず快適。トイレは敷地隣にあり、24時間使える。もちろん水洗式。トイレの向かいには大きな郵便局もあり、深夜も真っ暗にはならず怖くない。添付画像（投稿：2022年8月、かずお様）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレは建物の一角にあり、ココにきれいな水洗洋式トイレがある。幹線国道沿いだが、広い駐車場で、国道から離れたところは比較的静かで良い。（2022年6月管理人現地確認）
■当サイト読者様レポート：役場の横に大きな駐車場があり、24時間トイレがあります。おそらくですが、バイパスの建設後に長万部温泉などの客が減り、車中泊を増やしたいのではないか？と思われます。（投稿：2020年9月、A様）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photo of toilet 🚻. Overnight parking is possible. (On-site survey August 2025)
■Report from a reader of this site: Overnight parking on May 18, 2022. When I visited around 6 PM, there were about 20 cars parked there, which appeared to belong to town hall employees. Employees leaving work looked at me suspiciously, but no one reported me. Many people work until after 11 PM, and some start work around 6 AM. I thought to myself how tough working hours are at local town halls, but I ended up falling back asleep (lol). Even with people coming and going, it's spacious so it's not too bothersome and very comfortable. The toilet is next to the property and is available 24 hours a day. It's a flush toilet, of course. There's a large post office across from the toilet, so it doesn't get completely dark even late at night and isn't scary. Attached image (Posted: August 2022, Kazuo)
■Free parking and public toilet. Confirmed that it's not closed at night. The toilet is in a corner of the building and has a clean, flushable Western-style toilet. Although it's located along a major national highway, the parking lot is spacious, and the area away from the highway is relatively quiet and pleasant. (Administrator's on-site verification, June 2022)
■Report from a reader of this site: There is a large parking lot next to the town hall, and there are 24-hour restrooms. I suspect that after the construction of the bypass, the number of visitors to Oshamanbe Onsen and other places decreased, and they want to increase the number of people staying overnight in their cars. (Submitted by Mr. A, September 2020)

■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2024年9月現地調査）
■無料駐車場とトイレ。奥にはキャンプ場があり、バイカーの聖地になっている。キャンプ場は夜中までドンチャン騒ぎになるのでそっちには行かず、公園の駐車場で車中泊が静かで良い。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■2018年、きれいなトイレが新設されました。ピカピカの水洗洋式！Wimaxも利用可能！非常に良い。一泊してみたが、夜は誰も来ないし職質も受けなかった。朝まで静かで快眠。ここ最高です。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight stays in vehicles are permitted. (Survey conducted in September 2024)
■Free parking and toilets. There is a campsite further in, which is a mecca for bikers. The campsite gets noisy until late at night, so it's best to avoid it and stay overnight in your vehicle in the park's parking lot for a quieter experience. (Older post from before 2019)
■In 2018, clean toilets were newly installed. Sparkling clean flush toilets! WiMAX is also available! Very good. I stayed overnight and no one came at night and I wasn't questioned by the police. It was quiet until morning and I slept well. This place is the best. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.title_en: Poroto Mintara (Shiraoi Station North Tourist and Commercial Zone)
properties.desc_ja:
■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2024年9月現地調査）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2025/2/19～20に利用。地元の方が白老駅利用のために駐車されることもあって除雪されています。冬期も終夜閉鎖されません。駅裏になるため夜中はとても静かですし、敷地も全面フラットです。貨物列車の騒音については頻繁ではないのでさほど気になりません。トイレは暖房が入ってとても清潔です。添付画像（投稿：2025年2月、tossan様）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレはキレイな水洗で洋式ウォシュレット。難点としてはガッツリJR室蘭本線沿いで、深夜帯もガッツリ貨物列車が走る。個人的にはあまりおすすめとは言い難い。（2022年6月管理人現地確認）
■当サイト読者様レポート：車中泊禁止の看板は無い。新しい施設という事もあり、トイレが非常に綺麗。周辺にはスーパー、コンビニ、ドラッグストアがあり便利。適度に明かりもあり住宅もあるので防犯面も心配なし。施設の裏側が線路であるが音はさほど気にならない。国道から外れているので、車通りも少なく大変静か。（投稿：2021年6月、D様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：ウポポイまで徒歩６分、８０台駐車可能、２４時間トイレあり。なお、インフォメーションセンターは、8:00-18:00。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is permitted. (On-site survey, September 2024)
■Report from a reader of this site: Used on February 19-20, 2025. The area is cleared of snow because locals park there to use Shiraoi Station. It is not closed overnight even in winter. Because it's behind the station, it's very quiet at night, and the entire site is flat. Freight train noise isn't frequent, so it's not a major concern. The toilets are heated and very clean. Attached image (Posted by tossan, February 2025)
■Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. The toilets are clean, flush toilets with Western-style bidet functions. The downside is that it's right along the JR Muroran Main Line, and freight trains run frequently even late at night. Personally, I wouldn't recommend it. (On-site verification by administrator, June 2022)
■Report from a reader of this site: There are no signs prohibiting overnight parking. Because it's a new facility, the toilets are very clean. There are supermarkets, convenience stores, and drugstores nearby, making it very convenient. There's a moderate amount of lighting and residential areas, so security isn't a concern. While there are train tracks behind the facility, the noise isn't too bothersome. It's off the main road, so there's little traffic and it's very quiet. (Posted by Mr. D, June 2021)

■Report from a reader of this site: 6-minute walk to Upopoy, 80 parking spaces available, 24-hour restrooms. The information center is open from 8:00 to 18:00. (Older post from before 2019)

■当サイト読者様レポート：「手宮公園」に車中泊しました。坂道登ってこんなとこ？って思ったけど、とっても静かで良いとこでした。ですが、トイレにペーパーが無かったです。マックスバリューが近くにあったので買って行きました。それと、土日だったので日曜の朝から陸上？大会があったようで、車が満車になり、恐縮しました(笑)大会関係者がペーパーを置いてましたので、回収されなければ置いてあるかもです。ペーパーホルダーが無かったので、常時備え付けではなさそうです。（投稿：2022年6月、l様）
■小樽の超穴場車中泊スポットを発見！無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。トイレはきれいな水洗洋式。夜間非常に静か。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。携帯電波も問題なし。住宅街に近いので地元民には全力で警戒される。（2021年7月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photo of toilet 🚻. Overnight parking is possible. (On-site survey August 2024)
■Report from a reader of this site: "I stayed overnight in my car at Temiya Park. I thought, 'Is this really the place after climbing the hill?' but it was a very quiet and nice place. However, there was no toilet paper. There was a MaxValu nearby so I bought some there. Also, since it was the weekend, there seemed to be an athletics competition from Sunday morning, and the parking lot was full, which was embarrassing (lol). Competition staff had left some toilet paper, so it might be there if it hasn't been collected. There was no toilet paper holder, so it doesn't seem to be permanently provided. (Posted: June 2022, l)
■Discovered a hidden gem of an overnight parking spot in Otaru! Free parking and public toilet. The toilet is a clean flush toilet. Very quiet at night. Confirmed that it is not closed at night. No problems with cell phone reception. It is close to a residential area, so locals are very wary of you. (Confirmed on-site by administrator in July 2021)

■河川敷の無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。携帯電波OK。人気（ひとけ）は皆無なので、治安については自己責任。ちなみにアクセスがわかりにくく、進入口はココ。難点としては、たまたまなのかは不明だが、管理人が車中泊したときは、夜中23時ごろにわざわざここの河川敷の道路に来て延々と何回も往復して爆走するSUVとバイクのアホがいた。なぜココでそんなことをやってるのかは謎（ポケモンGOか？）。その連中が飽きて帰ったあと（24:30ごろ）は静寂で、朝まで爆睡できた。（2022年8月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is permitted. (On-site survey conducted in August 2025)
■Free parking and public toilets on the riverbank. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. Cell phone reception is OK. There are virtually no people around, so safety is at your own risk. Incidentally, access is difficult to find, and the entrance is here. One drawback is that, whether it was a coincidence or not, when the administrator stayed overnight in his car, there were some idiots in an SUV and a motorcycle who came all the way to this riverbank road around 11 PM and drove back and forth repeatedly at breakneck speed. Why they were doing that here is a mystery (Pokemon GO?). After those guys got bored and left (around 12:30 AM), it was quiet, and I was able to sleep soundly until morning. (Administrator's on-site confirmation conducted in August 2022)

There are no convenience stores nearby. The nearest convenience store is Seicomart Odaitonuma store (older post from before 2019).

■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2025年8月現地調査）
■当サイト読者様レポート：霧多布キャンプ場の徒歩5分くらいの場所で展望台の無料駐車場です。トイレは5月から10月まで24時間利用可能。隣のキャンプ場駐車場の方が景色は良いですがキャンプ場のトイレは数が少なく、こちらの方が数が多く良いです（水洗洋式、きれいでした）今回は車中泊はキャンプ場駐車場を利用しトイレは散策がてら展望台駐車場のトイレを利用しました。（投稿：2022年8月、d様）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is permitted. (On-site survey conducted in August 2025)
■Report from a reader of this site: This is a free parking lot at the observation deck, about a 5-minute walk from the Kiritappu Campsite. The toilets are available 24 hours a day from May to October. The view is better from the adjacent campsite parking lot, but the campsite toilets are few in number, while this one has more and is better (flush toilets, Western style, and clean). This time, I used the campsite parking lot for overnight parking and used the toilets at the observation deck parking lot while taking a walk. (Posted by: d, August 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: スマイルタウン灯台公園
properties.desc_ja:
■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2025年7月現地調査）
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレが新しくなり非常に綺麗です。夜間も閉鎖されず、人感センサーで点灯して明るいです。利用料金は無料。全てウォシュレット付き水洗洋式トイレ。トイレ裏にはコンビニ、日帰温泉は田中旅館があります。何方も営業時間注意です。 トイレ前には車5台分の駐車スペースがありますが、真夜中や早朝に地元の方(主に漁師さん)が利用されますので、長時間駐車や車中泊をする場合は、灯台公園の反対側の駐車場を利用すると良いでしょう。 灯台側に向けて止めると、リア側から太陽が登ります。トイレまでは50m程です。(トイレ前は長時間駐車禁止を検討するとの事) 静かさは、車の音は交通量がそれほど無いので静かなのですが、えりも港の向いですので23時頃(出港)や5時頃(帰港)でしょうか、漁船のエンジン音が響きます。 海抜は3.7mです。寝る前に避難経路を確認しましょう。千島海溝地震では、道の想定で最大高さ26mの津波が約30分で押し寄せるとされています。避難所は標高43mのえりも高校又は役場裏の山等です。（投稿：2025年6月、naka0514k様）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is permitted. (On-site survey conducted in July 2025)
■Report from our site's reader: The toilets have been renovated and are very clean. They are not closed at night and are brightly lit with motion sensors. There is no charge for use. All are flush toilets with bidet functions. There is a convenience store behind the toilets, and Tanaka Ryokan is a hot spring resort for day trips. Please be aware of the operating hours of both. There is parking space for 5 cars in front of the toilets, but it is used by locals (mainly fishermen) in the middle of the night and early morning, so if you plan to park for a long time or stay overnight in your car, it is best to use the parking lot on the opposite side of the lighthouse park. If you park facing the lighthouse, the sun will rise from the rear. It is about 50m to the toilets. (They are considering prohibiting long-term parking in front of the toilets.) In terms of quietness, there is not much traffic, so it is quiet, but since it is across from Erimo Port, you will hear the sound of fishing boat engines around 11pm (departure) and around 5am (return). The elevation is 3.7m above sea level. Please check the evacuation route before going to bed. In the event of a Kuril Trench earthquake, it is estimated that a tsunami with a maximum height of 26m will arrive in about 30 minutes. Evacuation shelters are Erimo High School (elevation 43m) or the mountain behind the town hall. (Posted by naka0514k, June 2025)

■当サイト読者様レポート：5/19に訪れたのですが、公衆トイレが浄化槽の故障のため閉鎖されていました。17:00までは隣の観光センターでトイレを利用できるようですが、それ以降は2、30分離れた公衆トイレを利用するようにと案内されていました。（投稿：2025年5月、i様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場は無料、綺麗なトイレは24時間通年使用可能。食堂もある土産物屋は夕方で閉まる、飲料の自販機あり。街灯もあり。強風で有名な場所だが、穏やかな日は灯台の灯りを見ながら静かな夜を、強風の日はワイルドな夜を過ごせる。駐車場は全体に傾きが有るため、快適に寝るには場所を選ぶ必要あり。テントは強風の不意打ちを食らう場合があるのでダメ。夜が明けると目の前に雄大な太平洋が一望出来る。夏は夜間に人の出入りが少々あるが、冬季は雪が少ないが夜はほぼ無人地帯。付近に店がないので買い出しはえりも市街か広尾市街で。添付画像、添付画像（投稿：2022年12月、m様）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is possible. (On-site survey, July 2025)
■Report from our website reader: The toilets appear to have been repaired. I was able to use them without any problems on June 25, 2025. The toilets are clean, but they have heated seats (no bidet). (Posted by naka0514k, June 2025)
■Report from our website reader: I visited on May 19th, but the public toilets were closed due to a septic tank malfunction. It seems that toilets can be used at the adjacent tourist center until 17:00, but after that, we were instructed to use the public toilets 20-30 minutes away. (Posted by i, May 2025)
■Report from our website reader: Parking is free, and the clean toilets are available 24 hours a day, year-round. The souvenir shop, which also has a restaurant, closes in the evening, and there are vending machines for drinks. There are also streetlights. This place is famous for its strong winds, but on calm days you can enjoy a peaceful night while watching the lighthouse light, and on windy days you can have a wild night. The parking lot is sloped overall, so you need to choose your spot carefully to sleep comfortably. Tents are not recommended as they can be hit by sudden strong winds. When dawn breaks, you can enjoy a magnificent view of the Pacific Ocean. In summer there are some people coming and going at night, but in winter there is little snow and it is almost deserted at night. There are no shops nearby, so you will need to do your shopping in Erimo city or Hiroo city. Attached images (Posted by: m, December 2022)

■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2025年7月現地調査）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。車中泊車両ちらほら。23時過ぎからDQNの皆さんが次々と集まって騒ぎ始めたので退散した。夜はヤンキーのたまり場になっているという噂は本当だった。東側に林があり、朝日が当たらず遅くまでゆっくりできるのは良い。携帯電波OK。治安については自己責任。雨の日ならDQNの皆さんが外で騒がないのでいいのかもしれない。（2023年7月管理人現地確認）
■夜間も開放されている公園の駐車場。トイレあり。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■夜はヤンキーが集まって騒ぐとの報告あり。パトカーの巡回が多く、職質が頻繁にあるとの報告あり。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is permitted. (On-site survey, July 2025)
■Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. There were a few vehicles parked overnight. After 11 PM, a group of delinquents started gathering and making noise, so we left. The rumor that it's a hangout for delinquents at night was true. There is a forest to the east, so it's nice that you can relax until late without the morning sun hitting it. Cell phone reception is OK. Safety is at your own risk. It might be better on rainy days as the delinquents won't be making noise outside. (On-site confirmation by administrator, July 2023)
■Park parking lot that is open at night. Toilets available. (Older post from before 2019)
■Reports that delinquents gather and make noise at night. There are reports of frequent police patrols and frequent questioning by the police. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2025年7月現地調査）
■当サイト読者様レポート：再訪問です。25時頃まで遊具で遊ぶ輩がいました。夜間交通量は割とあり爆音の車、バイクが何度か通った。また、以前宿泊した際、金･土曜日はDQNが爆音バイクと仲間数人で25時ほどまでたむろ。平日6:30から交通量あり。静かになってからは耳栓装備すれば寝れる。（投稿：2024年9月、s様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：思った程住宅街の中ではなかった。周りにはﾎ-ﾑｾﾝﾀ-や企業の建物、大きめのｱﾊﾟ-ﾄが数棟。隣の道路はバス、トラックも通り、割と交通量がある。速度域が低いので窓を閉めていれば気にならない。トイレ夜間閉鎖なし  小便器3つ、和式1つ。ﾄｲﾚｯﾄﾍﾟ-ﾊﾟ-設置無し。騒音の苦情が多いらしく、看板で閉鎖をほのめかす警告あり、防犯カメラも設置されているそう。他の車中泊族数台あり。（投稿：2024年8月、s様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：夜間も開放されている公園の駐車場。住宅街のため不審車両として通報、職質の可能性高い。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight stays in vehicles are possible. (On-site survey, July 2025)
■Report from a reader of this site: This is a return visit. There were people playing on the playground equipment until around 1 AM. There was a fair amount of traffic at night, and loud cars and motorcycles passed by several times. Also, when I stayed there previously, on Fridays and Saturdays, a group of delinquents with loud motorcycles hung around until around 1 AM. There is traffic from 6:30 AM on weekdays. Once it gets quiet, you can sleep if you wear earplugs. (Submitted by: s, September 2024)
■Report from a reader of this site: It wasn't as much of a residential area as I thought. There are home improvement stores, company buildings, and several large apartment buildings nearby. Buses and trucks also use the adjacent road, so there is a fair amount of traffic. The speed is low, so it's not a problem if you close the windows. The toilets are not closed at night. There are 3 urinals and 1 squat toilet. No toilet paper is provided. Apparently, there are many noise complaints, so there are signs warning of closure, and security cameras have been installed. There are several other people staying overnight in their cars. (Posted: August 2024, by s)
■Report from a reader of this site: A park parking lot that is open even at night. Because it is in a residential area, there is a high possibility that it will be reported as a suspicious vehicle and questioned by the police. (Older post from before 2019)

There are 35 parking spaces, and it was not crowded that day, so I could use it freely and spaciously. Moreover, it's completely free and no reservation is required. Perhaps because it was late at night, I couldn't find any signs along the way and got a little lost, but I recommend this place. (Posted by: n, July 2023)
■Report from a reader of this site: Free campsite, auto-sites with parking available, toilets available, shopping can be done along the way. Details (older posts from before 2019)

■駅横の無料駐車場。駅構外にトイレ有。夜中の貨物列車通過音がうるさいので安眠は無理。ここはやめておいたほうがいい。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場は広く、周りを気にせず車中泊利用がしやすい。夜間の貨物列車の通過音が、かなり響く。 駅構外のトイレはとても綺麗で、24時間使用可能。トイレ内の暖房、ウォシュレットあり。手洗い場の水も温水が出てくる。（2019年以前の古い投稿）

■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight stays in vehicles are possible. (On-site survey, June 2025)
■Free parking lot next to the station. Toilets are located outside the station. The noise from passing freight trains at night is so loud that a good night's sleep is impossible. It's best to avoid this location. (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from a reader of this site: The parking lot is spacious, making it easy to stay overnight in a vehicle without worrying about others. The noise from passing freight trains at night is quite loud. The toilets outside the station are very clean and available 24 hours a day. There is heating and a bidet in the toilet. Hot water is also available at the sinks. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_ja:
■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2025年6月現地調査）
■当サイト読者様レポート：静かなキャンプ場です。駐車場、横のエリアはテント張り可能。炊事場、トイレあり。水は飲用不可。トイレは、改修ありウォシュレットになっていました。フェリー待ちで数日過ごすのに適しています。以前は、偶に地元車がアイドリングで長時間滞在する事もありましたが、アイドリング禁止の張り紙が貼られました。携帯は、docomoが何とか入る程度で、移動して良い場所を探すと良い。ソフトバンクは、よくないと管理人のおじさんは言ってました。広いので、好きな所に止めれます。混んだ時は奥へ行く事も出来ます。土日は、少し混むので、良い場所を早めに行き確保すると良いが、時期次第です。（投稿：2024年10月、T様）
■無料駐車場とトイレ。無料キャンプ場。函館から近いので、週末は宴会DQNが集まる可能性あり。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of toilets 🚻. Overnight stays in vehicles are permitted. (On-site survey conducted in June 2025)
■Report from a reader of this site: It's a quiet campsite. Tent pitching is possible in the parking lot and adjacent area. There is a cooking area and toilets. The water is not potable. The toilets have been renovated and now have bidet functions. It is suitable for spending several days waiting for a ferry. Previously, local cars would occasionally stay for long periods with their engines idling, but signs prohibiting idling have now been posted. Cell phone reception is only so-so for Docomo, so it's best to move to a better spot. The caretaker said that Softbank is not good. It's spacious, so you can park wherever you like. When it's crowded, you can go further in. It gets a little crowded on weekends, so it's best to go early to secure a good spot, but it depends on the time of year. (Posted by Mr. T, October 2024)
■Free parking and toilets. Free campsite. It's close to Hakodate, so there's a possibility of party-loving, rowdy people gathering on weekends. (Older posts from before 2019)

properties.title_en: [S-Rank] Roadside Station Kamiyubetsu Onsen Tulip no Yu
properties.desc_ja:
■詳細案内図
■2025年7月管理人現地確認：車中泊評価【Sランク🤩】86点👉️現地の写真・詳細案内図はこちら
■入浴♨️：650円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：温泉、食事処が遅い時間まで営業しています。夜は道の駅のトイレが使えないので、隣の公園のトイレを利用しました。とても良かったです。（投稿：2025年6月、totomo様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2023年10月に利用しました。ここのレポートを見てトイレ事情を心配しましたが、夜間トイレは隣にきれいな公衆トイレが有りました。車中泊車は温泉利用者が多い温泉施設前よりも駐車場入口側が多く、そこだとかえって公衆トイレのほうが近いです（公衆トイレの看板は隣接の公園駐車場での車中泊を禁止してるもので道の駅についてではないです）。歩いてすぐの寿司屋のサロマ湖産のネタをふんだんに使った寿司が美味しかったです。（投稿：2023年10月、k様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2022年6月20日に行きました。道の駅にふさわしくありません。理由：道の駅に24Ｈトイレがありません。チューリップの湯が閉鎖されると道の駅のトイレが使えません。道の駅で24Ｈトイレがないのは初めてです。隣接の公園には24Ｈトイレはあるのですが、車中泊禁止の看板があります。Ｓクラスとは言えない。（投稿：2022年6月、k様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：連泊しました。温泉にサウナ、休憩室、軽食あり ラーメン、飲みアテ200円から安い、22時まで利用出来ます。コンビニ15分ぐらい。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed Map
■July 2025 Administrator's On-site Verification: Car Camping Rating [S Rank 🤩] 86 points 👉️Click here for on-site photos and detailed map
■Bathing ♨️: 650 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: The hot springs and restaurants are open until late. The toilets at the roadside station are unavailable at night, so I used the toilets in the adjacent park. It was very good. (Posted: June 2025, totomo)
■Report from our site's reader: I used it in October 2023. I was worried about the toilet situation after reading the reports here, but there was a clean public toilet next door for nighttime use. There are more cars camping on the parking lot entrance side than in front of the hot spring facility where there are many hot spring users, and in that case the public toilet is actually closer (the sign for the public toilet prohibits car camping in the adjacent park parking lot, not the roadside station). The sushi at the sushi restaurant a short walk away, which uses plenty of ingredients from Lake Saroma, was delicious. (Posted: October 2023, by K)
■Report from our site's reader: I went there on June 20, 2022. It's not suitable for a roadside station. Reason: There are no 24-hour toilets at the roadside station. When Tulip no Yu is closed, the toilets at the roadside station are unusable. This is the first time I've seen a roadside station without 24-hour toilets. There are 24-hour toilets in the adjacent park, but there's a sign prohibiting overnight parking. It can't be called S-class. (Posted: June 2022, by K)
■Report from our site's reader: I stayed for several nights. There's a hot spring, sauna, rest room, and light meals. Ramen and snacks are cheap, starting from 200 yen, and you can use them until 10pm. There's a convenience store about 15 minutes away. (Older post from before 2019)

■詳細案内図
■2024年7月管理人現地確認：車中泊評価【良😊】74点👉️現地の写真・詳細案内図はこちら
■この道の駅で車中泊する場合は、WEBで利用者登録が必要なので注意。👉️詳細、利用者登録はこちら
■当サイト読者様レポート：追加情報：車中泊専用エリアを利用する場合は登録してほしいとのことです。看板などにQRコードもありますが、トイレ前に用紙と投入箱があり10秒で書けます。強制ではないですが協力したほうがよいかと。（投稿：2025年2月、tossan様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2023年6月ならびに7月利用。どちらの場合も、日本全国津々浦々、数十台という規模の車中泊車両で駐車スペースが埋まっていた。車中泊者に対する規制を生まぬよう、皆がマナーを守って利用することを願うばかりである。（投稿：2023年7月、K様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2022.6.8車中泊。2022年4月にオープンしたばかりのため、トイレや売店などすべてが新しくキレイ。車中泊専用スペースが12台分あり。ここ以外のスペースでも10台以上のキャンピングカーが泊まっていた。幹線道路沿いだが敷地が広大のためか騒音はさほど気にならない。パン屋「みちます」は7:30から営業。(冬季は9時開店の様子)交通アクセスも良くとても快適なスポットなのでますます人気が出そう。それゆえにマナー違反が多出して、いろいろな利用規制がかからないことを祈りたい。添付画像、添付画像（投稿：2022年8月、かずお様）
■2022/4/15、移転フルリニューアルオープン！
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed Map
■Administrator's On-Site Verification, July 2024: Car Camping Rating [Good 😊] 74 points 👉️Click here for on-site photos and detailed map
■Note that user registration is required online if you plan to camp in your car at this roadside station. 👉️Click here for details and user registration
■Report from our site's reader: Additional information: They request that you register if you use the car camping-only area. There are QR codes on signs, but there is also a form and a drop box in front of the toilets that you can fill out in 10 seconds. It's not mandatory, but it's best to cooperate. (Posted: February 2025, by tossan)
■Report from our site's reader: Used in June and July 2023. In both cases, the parking spaces were filled with dozens of cars camping in their vehicles, from all over Japan. We sincerely hope that everyone will use the facilities with good manners so that restrictions on car campers do not arise. (Posted: July 2023, Mr. K)
■Report from our site's reader: Overnight stay in a car on June 8, 2022. Since it only opened in April 2022, everything, including the toilets and shop, is new and clean. There are 12 spaces specifically for overnight stays in cars. More than 10 campervans were parked in other areas as well. Although it's along a main road, the noise isn't too bothersome, perhaps because the site is so vast. The bakery "Michimasu" opens at 7:30 AM (apparently opens at 9 AM in winter). It's a very comfortable spot with good transportation access, so it's likely to become even more popular. Therefore, I hope there won't be too many breaches of etiquette and various usage restrictions. Attached images, attached images (Posted: August 2022, Mr. Kazuo)
■Relocated and fully renovated, reopened on April 15, 2022!

■Report from a reader of this site: I went to the site on February 23rd, but the snow had only been cleared from the point where the road from the town road to the sports park parking lot to the park entrance. Beyond that (towards the toilets) there was a wall of snow. Even in the widest parts of the road, only about 1.5 lanes had been cleared. When I arrived at the parking lot, only about one-third of the parking lot had been cleared, and the toilet side was covered in snow, making it impossible to see the toilet building shown in the photos. Overnight parking seems impossible during the winter. The snow removal was not done properly, and I almost got buried. I forgot to take photos of the site. (Submitted by: s, February 2025)

■当サイト読者様レポート：道の駅 なみおか アップルヒル(青森県）の入口近くの立て看板です（添付画像）。車中泊禁止とは書かれていませんが、宿泊を禁止とわざわざ書かれていたので泊まりづらくなりました。（投稿：2026年5月、h様）

■幹線道から距離があるのは良いが、駐車場が全体的に傾斜があるのが難点。水平な駐車場所がほとんどない。また、夜中まで車の出入りが多く騒がしい。爆音のDQN車も来る。トイレは遠くなるが、北の奥の方に静かな駐車場（隣接した公園の駐車場）あり（航空写真で見るとわかりやすい）。寝る前にトイレをすませてから、北の静かな駐車場に移動すると良い（トイレは遠くなる）。Wimax利用OK。（2019年9月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■September 2024 Administrator's On-Site Verification: Car Camping Rating [Rank B] ​​67 points 👉️Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■Report from our site's reader: This is a sign near the entrance of Michi-no-Eki Namioka Apple Hill (Aomori Prefecture) (attached image). It doesn't say that car camping is prohibited, but it specifically says that overnight stays are prohibited, making it difficult to stay overnight. (Submitted: May 2026, h)
■Report from our site's reader: Corn "Takekimi" was being sold. It was very delicious. You should try it. (Submitted: July 2022, k)
■The distance from the main road is good, but the downside is that the parking lot is generally sloped. There are hardly any level parking spaces. Also, there is a lot of traffic and it is noisy until late at night. Loud, obnoxious cars also come. The toilets are far away, but there is a quiet parking lot (parking lot of the adjacent park) in the far north (easier to see in aerial photos). It's best to use the restroom before going to bed, then move to the quiet parking lot to the north (the restrooms will be further away). WiMAX is available. (Confirmed on-site by the administrator in September 2019)

properties.title_en: Katagishi Park (Katagishi-cho, Kamaishi City, Iwate Prefecture)""
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：震災後に旧河道湖周辺を整備して汽水域のある公園としたところ。トイレはウォッシュレットではないが水洗洋式で、通年夜間も使用可であることを管理部署に確認済。遊具等は無いが、冬は白鳥・初夏は各種トンボが見られます。震災後に嵩上げされた防潮堤14.5ｍの陸側にあるが、津波警報時には事前にチェックした高台に避難が推奨。散策見学には、新設水門（詳細）・ラグビーワールドカップ会場のスタジアム（詳細）・伝承施設トモス（詳細）・夏は海水浴場根浜海岸（詳細）等。入浴はマストの湯（詳細）まで4.1km。食糧調達はマルイチ（詳細）まで1.4km（投稿：2026年3月、草の湯様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: This park was created after the earthquake by developing the area around the former Kawado Lake into a park with a brackish water area. The toilets are flush toilets (We have confirmed with the management department) and are usable year-round, even at night, although they do not have bidet toilets. There are no playground equipment, but swans can be seen in winter and various dragonflies in early summer. It is located on the landward side of the 14.5m seawall that was raised after the earthquake, but in the event of a tsunami warning, evacuation to a higher ground that has been checked in advance is recommended. For sightseeing, there are the newly constructed sluice gate (details), the Rugby World Cup stadium (details), the Tomos memorial facility (details), and Nehama Beach, a swimming beach in summer (details), etc. For bathing, Mast no Yu (details) is 4.1km away. For food, Maruichi (details) is 1.4km away (Posted: March 2026, Kusanoyu)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2026年3月宿泊利用。ウォッシュレットではないが水洗洋式で、冬期夜間も利用可。散策路や遊具あり展望台から海も見える。駐車場は交通少なく静かだが一部傾斜箇所あり。外来入浴のできる宿泊施設「いこいの村なみえ」まで250ｍ。ケイタイはau・楽天圏内。テレビは設備によっては映らない。買い物はイオン浪江店まで2.2km（投稿：2026年3月、草の湯様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Stayed in March 2026. While it doesn't have a bidet, it has a flush toilet (Western style) and is usable even at night during winter. There are walking paths and playground equipment, and you can see the sea from the observation deck. The parking lot is quiet with little traffic, but there are some slopes. It's 250m to "Ikoi no Mura Namie," a lodging facility that offers bathing for non-guests. Mobile phone service is available within the au and Rakuten networks. Some TVs may not work. For shopping, Aeon Namie is 2.2km away. (Reported by: Kusanoyu, March 2026)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■龍泉洞（りゅうせんどう）は、日本の岩手県下閉伊郡岩泉町にある鍾乳洞。岩泉湧窟（いわいずみわっくつ）とも言う。総延長約1200m（日本の洞窟中第62位）。高低差約249mは日本の洞窟中第5位。秋芳洞（山口県美祢市）・龍河洞（高知県香美市）と共に「日本三大鍾乳洞」の一つに数えられる。詳細
properties.desc_en: ■ Ryusendo Cave is a limestone cave located in Iwaizumi-cho, Shimohei-gun, Iwate Prefecture, Japan. It is also known as Iwaizumi Wakkutsu. Its total length is approximately 1200m (62nd longest among Japanese caves). Its height difference of approximately 249m is the 5th longest among Japanese caves. Along with Akiyoshido Cave (Mine City, Yamaguchi Prefecture) and Ryugado Cave (Kami City, Kochi Prefecture), it is considered one of the "Three Great Limestone Caves of Japan." Details

properties.desc_en:
■Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. The toilets are clean, flush toilets, and include Western-style toilets. Cell phone reception is OK. properties.title_en: Bronze Statue Teahouse Parking Lot (Monument commemorating the snow march disaster)
properties.desc_ja:
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。トイレは仮設トイレ（仮設ながら簡易水洗の洋式）。銅像茶屋は閉業しており廃墟になっている。標高710mで夏も涼しい。青森市内から30分で来れる。ただしここは心霊スポットで、ここで車中泊すると夜中に大勢の人の足音が聞こえるという都市伝説がある。詳しくは「八甲田 雪中行軍」で検索。また、ここは八戸方面から青森市への幹線道になっているようで、意外と夜中まで交通量が多くうるさい。また、駐車場や付近の道路にドリフトをしたようなタイヤ痕があり、夜は暴走車の運動会になる模様。（2020年9月管理人現地確認）
■車中泊と心霊現象👻について
properties.desc_en:
■Free parking and public toilets. The toilets are temporary (though temporary, they are Western-style with simple flushing). The bronze statue tea house is closed and in ruins. It's at an altitude of 710m and cool even in summer. It's a 30-minute drive from Aomori city. However, this is a haunted spot, and there's an urban legend that if you stay overnight in your car here, you'll hear the footsteps of many people in the middle of the night. For more details, search for "Hakkoda Snow March". Also, this seems to be a main road from Hachinohe to Aomori city, so there's surprisingly a lot of traffic and it's noisy even in the middle of the night. In addition, there are tire marks in the parking lot and on the nearby roads that look like they were from drifting, and it seems to become a sports day for reckless drivers at night. (Confirmed on-site by the administrator in September 2020)
■About overnight stays in cars and paranormal phenomena 👻

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■無料の野湯。多数の温泉マニアが大絶賛。
■管理人評価★5.0至高（泉質4.5、景色0.5）まず泉質は有馬温泉のような、茶褐色の濃厚な濁り湯。炭酸も含有しているという。そして足元からものすごい勢いで噴出している。これだけでもすごいが、なんと44度という最適な温度で湧出している。濃厚な濁り湯が、足元から最適な温度でガンガン湧出。凄すぎる。天地自然の奇跡である。そして景色も広葉樹の山が眼前にそびえており、秋の景色が大変美しい。全国的にも最高レベル、至高の野湯。
properties.desc_en:
■Free wild hot spring. Highly praised by many hot spring enthusiasts.

■Manager's rating ★5.0 Supreme (Spring quality 4.5, Scenery 0.5) First of all, the spring quality is like Arima Onsen, a rich, cloudy, reddish-brown water. It is said to contain carbon dioxide. And it gushes out from the ground with incredible force. This alone is amazing, but it also gushes out at the perfect temperature of 44 degrees Celsius. Rich, cloudy water gushes out from the ground at the perfect temperature. It's incredible. A miracle of nature. And the scenery is also amazing, with broadleaf forest mountains towering before you, and the autumn scenery is very beautiful. One of the best wild hot springs in the country, a supreme experience.

properties.desc_ja: ■入浴料、衝撃の110円！詳細。湧出温度53℃のガチ温泉（カルシウム・ナトリウム・硫酸塩温泉）！安すぎてやばいが、ちゃんとロッカー（100円戻り式）、シャワー完備で、カビも無く綺麗に管理されている。体育館の施設。南側の駐車場に車を停めて、南から3つ目の建物（総合体育館）入って左側にある。110円を券売機で払って、受付でカードキーをもらう。詳細（2022年9月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en: ■Admission fee: an astonishing 110 yen! Details. A genuine hot spring with a spring temperature of 53℃ (calcium, sodium, sulfate spring)! It's so cheap it's unbelievable, but it has lockers (100 yen refundable), showers, and is kept clean with no mold. It's located in the gymnasium. Park your car in the south parking lot, enter the third building from the south (the general gymnasium), and it's on the left. Pay 110 yen at the ticket machine and get a card key at the reception. Details (Confirmed on-site by the administrator in September 2022)

properties.desc_ja:
■入浴♨️：緑の湯で有名な名湯「国見温泉 石塚旅館」が隣接で日帰り入浴可能（700円、詳細）。
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレはキレイな簡易水洗で洋式もあり。夜間非常に静か。難点としては、水平な場所がトイレの隣数台分しかなく、その他は全面的に傾斜がある。また、携帯が完全に圏外（ドコモ、SBともに×）。管理人はここでの車中泊は無理と判断して他の場所に移動した。（2023年9月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■Bathing♨️: The famous "Kunimi Onsen Ishizuka Ryokan," known for its green-colored hot springs, is located next door and offers day-use bathing (700 yen, details).

■Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. The toilets are clean, simple flush toilets, and include Western-style toilets. Very quiet at night. The downside is that there are only a few level spaces next to the toilets; the rest of the area is entirely sloped. Also, there is absolutely no cell phone reception (neither Docomo nor SoftBank). The administrator decided that overnight parking here was not feasible and moved to another location. (Administrator's on-site verification, September 2023)

properties.label: Camp Spot + Hot Spring
properties.title_en: Takahata Station Front Parking Lot (West Exit)
properties.desc_ja:
■入浴♨️：高畠町太陽館：400円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：山形県高畠町のJR高畠駅前駐車場について投稿します。2018年9月23日，10月18日に訪れました。東口には、駅前ロータリーに4台分の駐車スペースがありますが、客待ちタクシーや駅や駅の中にある入浴施設の利用者の目があり、車中泊するのはひんしゅくをかいそうです。ロータリーの北側には、200台くらい止められる24時間出入り可能な無料駐車場があります。地元の方が鉄道利用時に利用されているようで、夜間にも何台も止まっています。ここは人目を気にすることなく車中泊できます。ロータリーのすぐ北側に公衆トイレがありますが、午後5時にはシャッターが下ろされます。便器の数は少ないもののウォシュレットで清潔なトイレですが、夜間は使用できません。夜間のトイレは、最終電車の0時までは駅構内のトイレを、それ以降は西口のトイレを利用することになります。西口にも18台くらい止められる無料駐車場があるので、夜間にトイレを使用したい場合は、西口駐車場が便利かと思います。しかし、あくまでもここは鉄道に乗るための駐車場なので、利用するのは駅構内の温泉にとどめて、その後は「道の駅・たかはた」で車中泊するのが良いかと思います。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■無料駐車場と、駅とは独立した公衆トイレもある。駅の中に３００円の温泉あり。電車が走るとうるさい。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Bathing♨️: Takahata Town Taiyokan: 400 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: This post is about the parking lot in front of JR Takahata Station in Takahata Town, Yamagata Prefecture. I visited on September 23rd and October 18th, 2018. On the east side, there are 4 parking spaces in the rotary in front of the station, but with taxis waiting for customers and people using the station and the bathing facilities inside the station, it seems like you would get disapproving looks if you stayed overnight in your car. On the north side of the rotary, there is a free 24-hour parking lot that can accommodate about 200 cars. It seems that locals use it when using the train, and there are many cars parked there even at night. You can stay overnight in your car here without worrying about being seen. There is a public toilet just north of the rotary, but the shutters are lowered at 5pm. Although there are few toilets, it is a clean toilet with a bidet, but it cannot be used at night. For toilets at night, you will have to use the toilets inside the station until the last train at midnight, and after that use the toilets at the west exit. There's a free parking lot on the west side with space for about 18 cars, so if you need to use the restroom at night, the west side parking lot might be convenient. However, this is primarily a parking lot for train passengers, so it's best to limit your use to the hot springs inside the station and then stay overnight in your car at "Michi-no-Eki Takahata" (Roadside Station Takahata). (Older post from before 2019)
■There's a free parking lot and a public restroom separate from the station. There's a 300 yen hot spring inside the station. It's noisy when trains are running. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Free Campground
properties.title_ja: 青少年野外活動基地 親子キャンプ場（無料キャンプ場）
properties.title_en: Youth Outdoor Activity Base, Parent-Child Campsite (Free Campsite)""
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：利用料金　無料　　水洗トイレと炊事場が２４時間利用可能、私が知る限り最高のキャンプ場。もちろんテントなしの車中泊可。ですが冬季閉鎖で利用可能期間は６月から１０月。　ケイタイ（au）は圏外。　温泉は12ｋｍ（約30分）ほど手前の杣温泉旅館。予約が基本のようですが、私は当日受付しかしたことがありません。（9〜１７時）、夜間に到着した場合には翌日に受け付けてもらったことがあります。別の名称は「親子ふれあいオートキャンプ場」。オートキャンプ場というと校庭のようなところに密集して車とテントを並べるイメージですが、ここは別天地です。整備された芝地と十分間隔のある駐車場所が６０区画あります。桃洞渓谷等の散策や森吉山登山など周辺の野外活動基地にも良。空撮動画が次にあります（７分くらいから）👉️Youtube（投稿：2022年4月、草の湯様）
■標高704m
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's readers: Usage fee: Free. Flush toilets and cooking facilities are available 24 hours a day. The best campsite I know of. Of course, overnight stays in your car without a tent are permitted. However, it's closed during the winter, and only open from June to October. Cell phone (au) reception is unavailable. The nearest hot spring is Soma Onsen Ryokan, about 12km (approximately 30 minutes) away. Reservations seem to be the norm, but I've only ever checked in on the day (9am-5pm). I have been allowed to check in the next day when arriving at night. Another name for this campsite is "Parent-Child Interaction Auto Campground." When you think of auto campgrounds, you imagine cars and tents crammed together in a schoolyard-like area, but this place is a different world. There are 60 well-maintained grassy areas and parking spaces with ample spacing. It's also a good base for outdoor activities in the surrounding area, such as walks in Momoto Valley and climbing Mt. Moriyoshi. Aerial video is below (starting around 7 minutes) 👉️YouTube (Posted: April 2022, by Kusanoyu)
■Elevation: 704m
