properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There is a paved parking lot with space for about 30 cars and flush toilets that can be used even at night (I think the toilets were Western-style, but I can't remember). There are no views due to the surrounding trees. There are views of Hachinohe City from the nearby "Tsutsuji no Mori Campsite," which requires a fee and postal application. This is the trailhead for Mt. Hashikami, at an altitude of 610m. There is a nice shelter, "Hashikami-dake Daikaihei Rest Area," 80m away on foot (details), where toilets and water are also available. (Posted by: Kusanoyu, who stayed overnight in the parking lot in September 2022)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: （桜まつり期間中）角館駐車場
properties.title_en: (During the cherry blossom festival) Kakunodate Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：夜間閉鎖、翌朝確認時にローブが張られ、中にはキャンカー1台だけがありました。（投稿：2022年4月、草の湯様）
■巨大駐車場。一回500円。桜まつり期間中は仮設トイレもあり、車中泊も可能。入場受付は朝4時から。夜に入ってそのまま車中泊して翌日出ても500円でOK！仮設トイレは当然ながら臭くて汚いので、桜並木駐車場で車中泊する人も多い。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Closed at night, ropes were put up when I checked the next morning, and there was only one camper van inside. (Submitted by: Kusanoyu, April 2022)
■Huge parking lot. 500 yen per entry. During the cherry blossom festival, there are temporary toilets, and overnight parking is possible. Entry reception starts at 4 AM. You can enter at night, stay overnight in your car, and leave the next day for 500 yen! The temporary toilets are, of course, smelly and dirty, so many people choose to stay overnight in their cars in the parking lot along the cherry blossom avenue.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：夜間でもトイレ使えました。外灯が道路沿いに1つしかしかなく、電気のスイッチはトイレ扉内の為、トイレ前に車停めた方が良いかと。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■トイレあり。かなり広い駐車場でなかなかよい。幹線道路のため走行音は響く。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: The toilet was usable even at night. There is only one streetlamp along the road, and the light switch is inside the toilet door, so it's best to park your car in front of the toilet. (Older post from before 2019)

■Toilets available. The parking lot is quite large and nice. Because it's on a main road, traffic noise is noticeable. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 杜せきのした中央公園トイレ（駐車場）
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：名称：杜せきのした中央公園トイレ。利用料金:無料。トイレの有無：有り。静かさ：上に高速道路があるのでその車の音のみ。概ね静かです。入浴施設：なし、近くにもなし。近く：大きな商業施設有り（イオンタウン等）（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Name: Morisekinoshita Central Park Toilet. Usage fee: Free. Availability of toilets: Yes. Quietness: There is only the sound of cars from the highway above. Generally quiet. Bathing facilities: None, and none nearby. Nearby: There are large commercial facilities (Aeon Town, etc.) (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：名所眼鏡橋のそば。スーパーの駐車場を間借りしているような道の駅。わさびラーメン　７００円。ラーメンに生わさびがついてきて自分ですって食べる。（投稿：2021年5月、渡り鳥漫遊記様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Near the famous Meganebashi Bridge. A roadside station that seems to be renting space in a supermarket parking lot. Wasabi Ramen - 700 yen. The ramen comes with fresh wasabi that you grate yourself. (Submitted by: Migratory Bird Travelogue, May 2021)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 海岸公園センター 駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料駐車場とトイレは隣のセンターハウス駐車場にあり→詳細（※夜間利用可否不明）（投稿：2025年6月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Free parking and restrooms are located in the adjacent Center House parking lot → Details (※ Availability at night is unknown) (Submitted by a reader in June 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 原釜尾浜防災緑地 駐車場
properties.title_en: Haragama Ohama Disaster Prevention Green Space Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料駐車場とトイレ（※夜間利用可否不明）。夜間非常に寂しい所につき治安は自己責任。（投稿：2025年6月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Free parking and restrooms (※Availability at night is unknown). The area is very deserted at night, so safety is at your own risk. (Submitted by a reader in June 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料駐車場とトイレ（※夜間利用可否不明）。サーファーが大半を占める駐車場。（投稿：2025年6月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Free parking and restrooms (※Availability at night is unknown). The parking lot is mostly used by surfers. (Submitted by a reader in June 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料駐車場とトイレ(和式)（※夜間利用可否不明）（投稿：2025年6月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Free parking and toilet (Japanese style) (※Availability at night is unknown) (Submitted by a reader in June 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 庄内空港 緑地公園駐車場
properties.title_en: Shonai Airport Green Park Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料駐車場&トイレあり。24時間利用可。とても静かですし、かなり広い駐車スペースがあります。空港のすぐそばのため街灯は消えません。近くにある空港の駐車場は夜間閉鎖される可能性があるので、停めないほうがよいかと。（投稿：2021年10月、参拝業者えーご様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Free parking and restrooms available. Open 24 hours. It's very quiet and has a fairly large parking area. The streetlights never go out because it's right next to the airport. The nearby airport parking lot may be closed at night, so it's probably best not to park there. (Posted by: Eigo, a shrine visitor, October 2021)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: ヒバの埋没林 駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料駐車場。水洗トイレあり。ただ、肝心の「ヒバの埋没林」は見る価値無し。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Free parking available. Flush toilets available. However, the main attraction, the "buried cypress forest," is not worth seeing. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料の駐車場、トイレあり。時々、職質あり。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Free parking and restrooms available. Occasionally, police questioning occurs. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: さくらんぼ東根駅東口無料駐車場
properties.title_en: Free parking at Sakuranbo Higashine Station East Exit
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料でかなり台数が止められます。１０日間駐車可など本来は旅行時の利用が想定された駐車場で、駅、付帯施設利用者用の注意書きはあり。（夜間だけ利用では特になにもありませんでした）夜間閉鎖なし。駅が開いている時間（朝６時～２３時ごろ）は駅の綺麗なトイレが使えます。それ以外の時間は徒歩２分程度の場所に２４時間営業のコンビニがあります。交番もその隣にあり治安は良好。整備された駅前で徒歩圏にチェーンの飲食店やイオンなどもあり非常に便利です。線路脇ですが運行本数の少ない山形新幹線専用駅なので夜間は静かで、日中も１時間に一本程度しか電車は通らないので、騒音はあまり気になりませんでしたが、ちょっとした公共施設もあり駅利用者を中心に日中は車の出入りはあります。入浴施設はありませんが車で１０分程度の東根温泉に日帰り入浴施設が複数あります。（投稿：2025年8月、いかり様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A considerable number of cars can be parked for free. It is a parking lot originally intended for travelers, with a 10-day parking limit, and there are notices for station and ancillary facility users. (There were no particular issues when using it only at night.) There is no closure at night. Clean toilets at the station are available during station hours (around 6am to 11pm). Outside of those hours, there is a 24-hour convenience store about a 2-minute walk away. There is also a police box next to it, so the area is safe. The area in front of the station is well-maintained, and there are chain restaurants and Aeon within walking distance, making it very convenient. Although it is next to the railway tracks, it is a Yamagata Shinkansen-only station with infrequent service, so it is quiet at night, and even during the day, only about one train per hour passes, so noise was not much of a concern. However, there are some public facilities, so there is some car traffic during the day, mainly from station users. There are no bathing facilities, but there are several day-trip bathing facilities in Higashine Onsen, about a 10-minute drive away. (Submitted by: Ikari, August 2025)

properties.label: Free Campground
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料キャンプ場と広い駐車場とトイレ完備のオススメスポットです。駐車場横の食堂（人生の楽園で取り上げられた）では、気の良い夫婦が、リーズナブルな料金で20時まで料理を提供してくれます。 御崎では、綺麗な夕日と星空が堪能出来ます。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: This is a recommended spot with a free campsite, a large parking lot, and restrooms. At the restaurant next to the parking lot (featured on the TV show "Life's Paradise"), a friendly couple serves food at reasonable prices until 8 PM. You can enjoy beautiful sunsets and starry skies at Misaki. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Free Campground
properties.title_ja: 岩手県 ツブ沼キャンプ場駐車場（無料キャンプ場）
properties.title_en: Iwate Prefecture, Tsubunuma Campsite Parking Lot (Free Campsite)""
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料。駐車だけでなくキャンプも無料。 炊事場の水道の利用可。 トイレは駐車場から１、２分。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Free. Not only parking but also camping is free. Water is available at the cooking area. Toilets are 1-2 minutes from the parking lot. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料。トイレあり　直近には民家等無く静かそう。2023年11月現地確認。ただし夜間トイレ施錠の有無については確認していませんので、利用不可の場合には近くの「只見川農村公園」に車で退避可の距離。冬期間は多分ですが、多雪のため閉鎖されると思われます。（投稿：2023年11月、草の湯様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free. Toilets available. Seems quiet with no houses nearby. Visited in November 2023. However, we did not confirm whether the toilets are locked at night, so if they are unusable, it is possible to pull over to the nearby "Tadami River Rural Park" by car. It is likely that it will be closed during the winter due to heavy snow. (Submitted by: Kusanoyu, November 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: [標高1600ｍ] 刈田駐車場（山形蔵王）
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料。ゲート等無し。標高1600ｍ。洋式水洗トイレで夜間利用可だが電気照明は無し。水は洗浄用(雨水？）と手洗い用大ポリタンクのみ。見晴らしがよく夕日が望める。強風時は遮るものなし。場内全般にゆるい傾斜。TV受信可。auは圏内、楽天モバイルは圏外。夜は通行量少ない。積雪期は閉鎖・到達不可。（2024年７月現地確認）（投稿：2024年7月、草の湯様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free. No gates, etc. Elevation 1600m. Western-style flush toilets available at night, but no electric lighting. Water is only available in large plastic tanks for flushing (rainwater?) and handwashing. Great views, and you can see the sunset. Nothing to block strong winds. Gentle slope throughout the grounds. TV reception available. au has coverage, Rakuten Mobile has no coverage. Low traffic volume at night. Closed and inaccessible during snowy season. (Confirmed on-site in July 2024) (Submitted by: Kusanoyu, July 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料。きれいなトイレあり、直近には民家等無く往来車両も見当たらず静か。2023年11月現地確認。車中泊利用経験者複数のコメントがGooglemapにあり。冬期間は多分ですが、多雪のため閉鎖されると思われます。（投稿：2023年11月、草の湯様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Free of charge. There are clean toilets, no houses nearby, and no passing vehicles, making it very quiet. Confirmed on-site in November 2023. There are multiple comments on Google Maps from people who have used it for overnight stays in their cars. It is likely that it will be closed during the winter due to heavy snowfall. (Posted by: Kusanoyu, November 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: （トイレは一回100円）山形県 月山八合目駐車場
properties.title_en: (Toilet fee: 100 yen per use) Gassan 8th Station Parking Lot, Yamagata Prefecture""
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料。 トイレは有料（１回100円）鶴岡市街の夜景、日本海の漁火など景色が良い。(車中泊した日は鶴岡の花火大会開催日で高見の見物。ほかにも見ている人が複数いた。) 夏は涼しい。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Free of charge. Toilets are available for a fee (100 yen per use). The view is great, with night views of Tsuruoka city and fishing lights on the Sea of ​​Japan. (The day I stayed overnight in my car was the day of the Tsuruoka Fireworks Festival, and I had a great view from a high vantage point. There were several other people watching as well.) It's cool in the summer. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 岩手県 ツブ沼登山口駐車場
properties.title_en: Iwate Prefecture, Tsubunuma Trailhead Parking Lot""
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料。 トイレあり(ただし現在改修工事中で、使用不可)。 ツブ沼キャンプ場駐車場も確認、いい方を利用してください。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Free. Toilets available (however, currently under renovation and unusable). Check out the Tsubunuma Campsite parking lot as well and use whichever is better. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 与兵衛沼公園北駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料、夜間閉鎖無し、トイレ有り、普通車30台ほど駐車可、駐車場すぐ隣に水飲み場あり。東西に長い比較的新しい公園。北西の端に北駐車場、南東の端に東駐車場あり（詳細）。東駐車場もトイレ有り無料で24時間利用可だが、駐車場は9台分のスペースで住宅が近くあまりおすすめできない。この北駐車場は道路を挟んで住宅街はあるが、広い道路なので夜間エンジンかけっぱなしでも問題なさそう。朝から夕方は常時5～15台駐車、夜～早朝は3～5台程度は止まってる。車中泊らしいのも1.2台いる。コンビニは車で5分、スーパーは5～10分もあれば複数ある(24時間のスーパーもあり)。トイレは洋式でトイレットペーパーがなく、センサーの不調かライトが消えることがある。利用者はほぼ地元ナンバーで、タクシーや工事業者もトイレや仮眠で良く利用してる。仙台中心部にそこそこ近く周囲へのアクセスも良く穴場だと思う。（投稿：2023年12月、t様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Free, no closures at night, toilets available, parking for about 30 regular cars, drinking fountain right next to the parking lot. A relatively new park that is long from east to west. There is a North Parking Lot at the northwest end and an East Parking Lot at the southeast end (details). The East Parking Lot also has toilets and is free to use 24 hours a day, but it only has space for 9 cars and is close to houses so it is not highly recommended. The North Parking Lot is across the road from a residential area, but the road is wide so it seems like it would be fine to leave the engine running at night. There are always 5 to 15 cars parked from morning to evening, and about 3 to 5 cars parked from night to early morning. There are also 1 or 2 cars that seem to be parked overnight. There is a convenience store a 5 minute drive away, and several supermarkets within 5 to 10 minutes (there are also 24-hour supermarkets). The toilets are Western style but there is no toilet paper, and the lights sometimes go out due to a sensor malfunction. Most users have local license plates, and taxis and construction workers also frequently use it for toilets and naps. It is fairly close to the center of Sendai and has good access to the surrounding area, so I think it is a hidden gem. (Posted by: T, December 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: カッパ淵 無料大駐車場
properties.title_en: Kappa Fuchi Free Large Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料、夜間開放、トイレあり、静寂。カッパ淵、遠野物語の伝承園の無料駐車場です。夜は真っ暗で土地柄的に少し怖いぐらい静かですが、これぞ遠野という感じですね。朝6時ぐらいに地元のおばちゃんがトイレを清掃しておられました。（投稿：2024年8月、w様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free, open at night, toilets available, quiet. This is the free parking lot for Kappa-buchi and the Tono Monogatari Folklore Park. It's pitch black at night and so quiet that it's almost a little spooky, but that's what Tono is all about. Around 6am, a local woman was cleaning the toilets. (Submitted by: w, August 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料、24時間、トイレ有り(冬季使用中止の可能性あり)。普通車31台駐車可能。駐車場内に小さな鶴亀大橋展望台あり。島の北端の高台にあり風が少し強い。交通量は多くなく付近に何もないので静か。橋の向こう側(本土側)にも10台ほどのトイレ有り駐車場があるがすぐ近くに民家がある。（投稿：2024年1月、t様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free, 24 hours, toilets available (may be closed in winter). Parking available for 31 regular cars. There's a small Tsurukame Ohashi observation deck within the parking lot. Located on a hill at the northern tip of the island, so it can be a bit windy. Traffic is light and there's nothing nearby, so it's quiet. There's also a parking lot with toilets for about 10 cars on the other side of the bridge (mainland side), but there are houses very close by. (Submitted by: t, January 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料、24時間、トイレ有り(冬季使用中止の可能性あり)。すぐそばの第二駐車場と合わせて普通車37台駐車可。気仙沼市の公園トイレは冬季使用中止の所があるが、1月上旬までは全ての公園で使えていた。また、比較的新しく使用者の多いトイレは凍結防止の対策がされ使用可能。少し急な所もあるがそばに龍舞崎灯台や遊歩道あり。交通量はほとんどなくかなり静か。この大島にはコンビニもスーパーもない。（投稿：2024年1月、t様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free, 24 hours, toilets available (may be closed in winter). Parking for 37 regular cars is possible, including the nearby second parking lot. While some park toilets in Kesennuma City are closed in winter, all park toilets were usable until early January. Also, relatively newer, frequently used toilets have been fitted with anti-freezing measures and are usable. There are some slightly steep sections, but Ryumaizaki Lighthouse and walking trails are nearby. Traffic is very light, making it quite quiet. There are no convenience stores or supermarkets on this island. (Submitted by: t, January 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料、24時間、トイレ有り(冬季使用中止) 普通車80台ほど駐車可。コンビニは500m、イオンモールが1km。野球場やテニスコートがある公園で土日は小中学生の練習の送り迎えで若干混雑する。平日は主に休憩に使われ夕方以降はほぼ利用者はいなくなる。車中泊は時々見かける。横の道路はトラックが通るがうるさいほどではない。トイレは2か所あるがどちらも駐車場から少し離れてる。（投稿：2024年1月、t様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free, 24 hours, toilets available (closed in winter). Parking for about 80 regular cars. Convenience store is 500m away, Aeon Mall is 1km away. It's a park with a baseball field and tennis courts, so it gets a little crowded on weekends with elementary and junior high school students being dropped off and picked up from practice. On weekdays, it's mainly used for resting, and after the evening, there are hardly any users. Overnight parking is sometimes seen. Trucks pass on the road next to it, but it's not too noisy. There are two toilets, but both are a little distance from the parking lot. (Submitted by: t, January 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: あゆみ野近隣公園駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料、24時間、トイレ有り(冬季使用可)。普通車46台駐車可。住宅街の真ん中にある広い公園で１日中比較的に静か。朝から夕方は付近住民の利用が多く土日は満車になることもある。スーパーやコンビニは車で5分以内に複数あり。（投稿：2024年1月、t様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free, 24 hours, toilets available (usable in winter). Parking for 46 regular cars. A large park in the middle of a residential area, relatively quiet throughout the day. It is frequently used by local residents from morning to evening, and can be full on weekends. There are several supermarkets and convenience stores within a 5-minute drive. (Submitted by: t, January 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_en: Minatohama Seaside Green Space Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料、24時間、トイレ有り。普通車58台駐車可。トイレは和式であまり綺麗ではない。車で5分以内にコンビニあり。駐車場の北と西に緑地があり、南側には砂浜あり。現在砂浜は遊泳禁止BBQ禁止だが、砂浜の隣の漁港や付近の堤防はちょっとした釣りスポット。近くの火力発電所やコンビナートの夜景が綺麗だが夜は静かでかなり寂しくなる。外海に近く防風林もないので風の影響は大きい。夜(とくに夏)は地元の若造が集まることがある。（投稿：2023年12月、t様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free, 24 hours, toilets available. Parking for 58 regular cars. The toilets are Japanese style and not very clean. There is a convenience store within a 5-minute drive. There are green spaces to the north and west of the parking lot, and a sandy beach to the south. Swimming and BBQ are currently prohibited on the beach, but the fishing port next to the beach and the nearby breakwater are good fishing spots. The night view of the nearby thermal power plant and industrial complex is beautiful, but it gets very quiet and lonely at night. It is close to the open sea and there are no windbreaks, so it is very windy. Local young people sometimes gather there at night (especially in summer). (Submitted by: t, December 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 大川さくら総合公園 防災公園駐車場
properties.title_en: Okawa Sakura General Park Disaster Prevention Park Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料、24時間、トイレ有り。普通車50台程度駐車可。コンビニ近く、スーパーは車で5分。大きな多目的総合公園に併設された防災公園。全部で5か所の駐車場があるが、そばにトイレがあるのはこの防災公園の駐車場(第5駐車場)だけ。R5年4月オープンですごく綺麗。時々散歩に来る程度で利用は少なく1日中静かで日が暮れるとほとんど車のない状態。三陸海岸の自治体では機器のチェックも兼ねて定時に防災行政無線のチャイムがあるが、気仙沼市では6.12.18.21時に放送がありかなりの音量なので驚かないように。※R6年1月現在GoogleマップではJR気仙沼線と大船渡線のBRT専用道路が一般道と同じ扱いになってて、ナビのルートに選択されることがある。この防災公園もBRT専用道が選択されたり、オープン前の工事用車両入口から入る表示になる。あらかじめストリートビューやクチコミの画像などを見て確認したい。詳細（投稿：2024年1月、t様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Free, 24 hours, toilets available. Parking for about 50 regular cars. Convenience store nearby, supermarket is a 5-minute drive away. A disaster prevention park attached to a large multi-purpose comprehensive park. There are a total of 5 parking lots, but only this disaster prevention park parking lot (Parking Lot 5) has toilets nearby. It opened in April 2023 and is very clean. It is not used often, with only occasional walks, and is quiet all day long, with almost no cars after sunset. Municipalities along the Sanriku coast have chimes on the disaster prevention administrative radio at set times, which also serve as equipment checks, but in Kesennuma City, the broadcast is at 6, 12, 18 and 21, and is quite loud, so don't be startled. *As of January 2024, Google Maps treats the BRT-only roads for the JR Kesennuma Line and Ofunato Line the same as regular roads, and may select them in navigation routes. This disaster prevention park may also be selected as a BRT-only road, or it may show an entrance for construction vehicles before it opens. It is recommended to check Street View and images from reviews beforehand. Details (Posted by: T, January 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 松崎尾崎防災公園駐車場
properties.title_en: Matsuzaki Ozaki Disaster Prevention Park Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料、24時間、トイレ有り。普通車40台駐車可。向かい側にさらに広いスペースがあり駐車してる人もいる。コンビニやスーパーは車で3～10分程度で複数あり。家族連れ、犬の散歩、釣りなどに来てる。隣接するグラウンドではキャッチボールやラジコンなども。各設備は綺麗。夕方以降はほとんど誰もいなくなり、付近を走る車もなくかなり静かになる。（投稿：2024年1月、t様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free, 24 hours, toilets available. Parking for 40 regular cars. There is an even larger space across the street where some people park. There are several convenience stores and supermarkets within a 3-10 minute drive. Families, dog walkers, and anglers come here. People play catch and play with remote-controlled cars on the adjacent grounds. All facilities are clean. After evening, there is almost no one there, and it becomes very quiet with no cars driving nearby. (Submitted by: t, January 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料、24時間、トイレ有り。普通車35台、大型トラック2台駐車可。仙台空港東隣で着陸が良く見える。コンビニ等の商業施設までは2kmほど。周囲に民家や建物はなく夜は交通量も少なく怖いほど静かになり、たまに来るカップル以外利用者もほとんどなく防犯の面で安心できないと思う。空港以外に建物がなく風をまともに受ける。震災以降、仙台東部道路と常磐自動車道東側にはここ以外にもたくさん公園ができたが、24時間無料でトイレと駐車場有りで比較的大きな公園は寂しい場所にあり、防犯の面から夜間の利用は避けたほうが良いかもしれない。また、震災ではおおよそ仙台東部道路まで津波が来たのでその心配もある。（投稿：2023年12月、t様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Free, 24 hours, toilets available. Parking available for 35 regular cars and 2 large trucks. Located next to Sendai Airport to the east, offering a good view of landings. It's about 2km to convenience stores and other commercial facilities. There are no houses or buildings nearby, and at night the traffic is so light it's eerily quiet. Aside from the occasional couple, there are hardly any users, so I don't feel safe from a security standpoint. There are no buildings other than the airport, so it's directly exposed to the wind. Since the earthquake, many other parks have been built on the east side of the Sendai Eastern Expressway and the Joban Expressway, but this is the only relatively large park that is free 24 hours a day, has toilets and parking, and is in a secluded location. From a security standpoint, it might be best to avoid using it at night. Also, the tsunami reached roughly as far as the Sendai Eastern Expressway during the earthquake, so there are concerns about that as well. (Submitted by: t, December 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 花の道けせんぬまパーキング
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料、24時間、トイレ有り。普通車25台程度駐車可。コンビニもスーパーも車で5分以内にあり。三陸道気仙沼中央IC近くで市街地南端にあり各方面のアクセスは良好。目の前の45号線は交通量が多くスピードも出てるので出入りは注意。出入りには上り(南行き)のみと考えたほうが良いと思う。地元民の利用が多く日中はいっぱいになることも。また大型トラックも常時利用があり、45号線の交通量と合わせて騒音はそれなりにある。週末夜には若者が集まることもある。（投稿：2023年12月、t様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free, 24 hours, toilet available. Parking for about 25 regular cars. Convenience stores and supermarkets are within a 5-minute drive. It is located near the Sanriku Expressway Kesennuma Chuo Interchange and at the southern edge of the city, so access to all directions is good. The Route 45 in front of it has heavy traffic and people are speeding, so be careful when entering and exiting. It is probably best to assume that you can only enter and exit going in the northbound (southbound) direction. It is frequently used by locals and can get full during the day. Large trucks also use it regularly, and combined with the traffic on Route 45, there is a fair amount of noise. Young people sometimes gather there on weekend nights. (Submitted by: t, December 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料、24時間、トイレ有り。普通車15台駐車可。コンビニ、スーパーは車で5分程度に複数あり。犬の散歩やウォーキングの利用者がほとんどで、満車になることはまずなさそう。トイレはちょっと離れてるが綺麗。徒歩で遊覧船の発着場やお魚いちばに行ける距離。夜には駐車場からトイレ周辺にイルミネーションが点灯(点滅はしない)して綺麗だが少し落ち着かないかも。（投稿：2024年1月、t様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free, 24 hours, toilets available. Parking for 15 regular cars. Several convenience stores and supermarkets are within a 5-minute drive. Most users are dog walkers or jogging, so it's unlikely to be full. The toilets are a little far away but clean. It's within walking distance of the sightseeing boat dock and the fish market. At night, the area from the parking lot to the toilets is illuminated (not flashing), which is beautiful but might be a little unsettling for some. (Submitted by: t, January 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料、24時間、トイレ有り。普通車100台は駐車可。駐車場の中央にトレーラーハウスの喫茶店がある。整備された芝生と舗装路の長い公園で、釣りや犬の散歩の人が来る。家族連れが多い。スケボーの練習してる人もいる。夜はほとんど車は通らず民家も付近にはない。明かりは道路の街灯だけ。冬以外で天気が良ければかなり快適な場所だと思う。コンビニやスーパーは車で10分くらいにある。（投稿：2023年12月、t様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free, 24 hours, toilets available. Parking for 100 regular cars. There is a trailer house cafe in the middle of the parking lot. It is a long park with well-maintained lawns and paved paths, and people come here to fish or walk their dogs. There are many families. Some people practice skateboarding. There are hardly any cars at night and no houses nearby. The only light is from the streetlights on the road. I think it is a very comfortable place if the weather is nice and it is not winter. There are convenience stores and supermarkets about 10 minutes away by car. (Submitted by: t, December 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 西行戻しの松公園駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料、24時間、トイレ有り。駐車場とトイレは2か所あり西側は大型バス専用数台、普通車37台駐車可、東側は普通車5台駐車可。眺めが良く歩道や芝生が綺麗に整備され犬の散歩に来る人が多い。県道からほんの少し上ったところにあるが観光客はあまり来ない。さらに歩いてすぐ上に白衣観音展望台があり、ここからの朝日はすごく綺麗。県道と反対の下り坂はちょっとしたワインディングロードで、近隣の走り屋モドキが夜間走りに来ることがあるが絡んでくるやつらではない。すぐ下にある町営駐車場で車中泊、朝方ここに来て朝日を見るのがおすすめ。（投稿：2023年12月、t様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free, 24 hours, toilets available. There are two parking lots and toilets; the west side has space for several large buses and 37 regular cars, and the east side has space for 5 regular cars. The view is nice, and the sidewalks and lawns are well-maintained, so many people come to walk their dogs. It's located just a short distance up from the prefectural road, but not many tourists come here. A short walk further up is the Byakue Kannon Observatory, and the sunrise from here is incredibly beautiful. The downhill road opposite the prefectural road is a bit of a winding road, and some wannabe street racers from the area sometimes come here at night, but they're not the kind of people who will cause trouble. I recommend staying overnight in your car at the town-operated parking lot just below and coming here in the morning to watch the sunrise. (Submitted by: t, December 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 松島町営三十刈駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料、24時間、トイレ有り。大型バス14台、普通車310台駐車可とかなり大きな駐車場。コンビニは5分、スーパーは10分。松島海岸駅まで徒歩5分で松島観光には便利な場所。帰りの登りはきついが、駅北側の田町歩道橋を使うと少しは楽で、線路をくぐって跨いでと面白い。休日は観光客で午前中にはいっぱいになる。車中泊してる人も数人いた。駅や交番も近く治安は比較的良く、前の県道は夜間は交通量が少なく車中泊にはかなり良いと思う。（投稿：2023年12月、t様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free, 24 hours, toilets available. A fairly large parking lot with space for 14 large buses and 310 regular cars. A convenience store is 5 minutes away, and a supermarket is 10 minutes away. It's a convenient location for sightseeing in Matsushima, being a 5-minute walk to Matsushima Kaigan Station. The uphill climb on the way back is tough, but using the Tamachi pedestrian overpass north of the station makes it a little easier, and it's interesting to go under and over the railway tracks. On holidays, it gets full of tourists by midday. There were several people sleeping in their cars. The station and police box are nearby, so the area is relatively safe, and the prefectural road in front has little traffic at night, making it quite good for sleeping in your car. (Submitted by: t, December 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 気仙沼漁港 海の道公衆トイレ
properties.title_en: Kesennuma Fishing Port Sea Road Public Toilet
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料、24時間、トイレ有り。岸壁に沿った駐車スペースで北と南にトイレがあり普通車80台ほど駐車可。トイレはすごく綺麗。コンビニ、スーパーは車で5分程度に複数あり。利用者の半分くらいは漁船関係でタクシーや営業マンの休憩も多い。釣り人も多くたまにキャンピングカーも見かける。時間に関係なく漁船出港の時に車の出入りが少し増えるが気になるほどではないと思う。（投稿：2024年1月、t様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free, 24 hours, toilets available. There are toilets on the north and south sides of the parking area along the quay, and it can accommodate about 80 regular cars. The toilets are very clean. There are several convenience stores and supermarkets within a 5-minute drive. About half of the users are related to fishing boats, and there are also many taxi drivers and salespeople taking breaks. There are also many anglers, and you occasionally see campervans. Regardless of the time of day, there is a slight increase in car traffic when fishing boats depart, but I don't think it's a problem. (Submitted by: Mr. T, January 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 長浜緑地広場駐車場(わたのは海水浴場)
properties.title_en: Nagahama Green Space Parking Lot (Watanoha Beach)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料、24時間、トイレ有り、普通車30台ほど駐車可。魚市場や関連する冷凍倉庫と物流倉庫がある地域にあり、付近で働く人も通勤に使ってるようだ。営業マンやタクシーも休憩で使ってる。場所柄、深夜早朝からトラックの往来はそこそこあるので治安はさほど悪くなさそう。トイレは砂浜との間にある堤防の上で、堤防の下は扇形の階段状になってる。海水浴シーズンは約1か月で駐車場は混む。冬を除くそれ以外はサーファーの姿もある。足洗い用の水道や芝生なども綺麗に整備されてる。コンビニは500mほどに数件あり。（投稿：2023年12月、t様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free, 24 hours, toilets available, parking for about 30 regular cars. It is located in an area with a fish market and related cold storage and logistics warehouses, and it seems that people who work nearby use it for commuting. Salespeople and taxi drivers also use it for breaks. Due to its location, there is a fair amount of truck traffic from late at night and early in the morning, so the area does not seem to be particularly unsafe. The toilets are on the breakwater between the beach and the beach, and below the breakwater there are fan-shaped steps. The parking lot gets crowded during the swimming season, which lasts for about a month. Outside of winter, surfers can also be seen there. There are water taps for washing feet and lawns, which are well maintained. There are several convenience stores within about 500m. (Submitted by: t, December 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料、24時間、トイレ有り、自販機有り。普通車60数台駐車可。入り口が見つけにくい。道路の向かい側はホームセンターとドラッグストアー。コンビニとスーパーは500mから1kmに複数あり。国道の抜け道みたいな道路で交通量はそこそこある。夜間は少なくなるが速度は速いので多少の騒音は仕方ないところ。公園らしさはないが目の前の堀で釣りをする人はいる。車中泊は5.6台いる。いくつかの住宅街の間にあり、パトカーが巡回してたり治安は悪くなさそう。車中泊にはけっこう良い所だと思う。（投稿：2023年12月、t様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free, 24 hours, toilets available, vending machines available. Parking available for over 60 regular cars. The entrance is difficult to find. Across the road are a home improvement store and a drug store. There are several convenience stores and supermarkets within 500m to 1km. It's a road that's like a shortcut to the national highway, so there's a fair amount of traffic. It gets quieter at night, but the speed is high so some noise is unavoidable. It doesn't feel like a park, but there are people fishing in the moat in front. There are 5 or 6 cars parked overnight. It's located between several residential areas, and police cars patrol, so the area doesn't seem unsafe. I think it's a pretty good place for overnight parking. (Submitted by: t, December 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: （※トイレ無し）ブルーインパルス観覧駐車場
properties.title_en: （※トイレ無し）ブルーインパルス観覧Parking
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料、24時間、トイレ無し。航空自衛隊松島基地すぐ横の東松島市営駐車場で約100台駐車可。砂利だがきちんと整地されてる。トイレはないが近くの公園(8:30～18:00)にある。コンビニやスーパーは車で5分程度に複数あり。駐車場近くの土手が絶好の観覧スポットでブルーインパルスの格納庫も近くで見られる。上空での訓練はすごい迫力。訓練は平日のみだが朝から駐車場はいっぱいになる。遮る物が全くないので暑さや風には注意。余談だが1/3くらいは女子で、一人で来たり立派なカメラを持ってたり。上空訓練のスケジュールは金曜日に更新される→詳細（投稿：2024年1月、t様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free, 24 hours, no toilets. The Higashi-Matsushima municipal parking lot, right next to the Japan Air Self-Defense Force Matsushima Air Base, can accommodate about 100 cars. It's gravel, but well-maintained. There are no toilets, but there are some in a nearby park (open 8:30-18:00). There are several convenience stores and supermarkets within a 5-minute drive. The embankment near the parking lot is an excellent viewing spot, and you can see the Blue Impulse hangar up close. The aerial training is incredibly impressive. Training only takes place on weekdays, but the parking lot fills up from early morning. There's absolutely no shade, so be careful of the heat and wind. As a side note, about a third of the visitors are women, some coming alone and others with impressive cameras. The aerial training schedule is updated on Fridays → Details (Posted: January 2024, by t)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 気仙沼大島ウェルカムターミナル
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料・道の駅的施設・２４ｈ使用可能水洗トイレあり・車中泊は多くなくて静か・強風時は風を遮るものがなく車が揺れることも。（投稿：2022年3月、草の湯様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free, roadside station-like facility, 24-hour usable flush toilets, not many people staying overnight in their cars, quiet, no windbreaks so cars can shake in strong winds. (Submitted by: Kusanoyu, March 2022)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：本線と完全分離なのはGood！早めに来て普通車エリアの奥の場所を取りましょう。おすすめ。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: The complete separation from the main line is great! Arrive early and secure a spot at the back of the regular car area. Recommended. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 青森市 野木和公園（青照苑裏）
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：北東北マップの野木和公園ですが、トイレにトイレットペーパーはありませんでした。すぐ近くのローソンで水に流せるティッシュが110円で購入できました。なお、駐車場入ってすぐに巡回してるパトカーに職質受けました。よく巡回しているという噂はホントのようです。（投稿：2020年10月、匿名希望様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：青照苑と言う施設の裏の駐車場。  煌々と点いている水銀灯も深夜時間帯は消えます。  公衆トイレは電灯が点かないので、夜間は明かり必須。 何かの機械の音がしていて不気味ですが、清掃はされているので綺麗。  秋に利用、冬は使えない可能性が高い。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Reader Report: Regarding Nogikawa Park on the Northern Tohoku Map, there was no toilet paper in the restroom. I was able to buy flushable tissues for 110 yen at a nearby Lawson convenience store. Also, I was stopped and questioned by a patrolling police car immediately after entering the parking lot. It seems the rumors about frequent patrols are true. (Submitted: October 2020, Anonymous)

■Reader Report: The parking lot behind a facility called Seishoen. The brightly lit mercury lamps turn off at night. The public restrooms don't have lights, so a light is essential at night. There's a strange noise from some kind of machine, which is eerie, but it's clean as it is regularly cleaned. I used it in the fall; it's highly likely it won't be usable in winter. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：福島市内から、東日本大震災・原子力災害伝承館に向かう途中に車中泊しました。復興拠点商業施設であり、広々とした駐車場、24時間開放された綺麗なトイレあり。自分以外は乗用車の方おられませんでしたが、トラックなどは車中泊していました。何より標高が高い（標高539m）ため涼しく、夏の車中泊には向いていると思います。PS  灯に集まってきた生き物が大量にいます。生きたゲンゴロウ初めて見ました。道の駅のような施設なので、無料です。また夜間開放されています。山の中なので非常に静か。（投稿：2024年8月、w様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: I stayed overnight in my car on my way from Fukushima City to the Great East Japan Earthquake and Nuclear Disaster Memorial Museum. It's a commercial facility that serves as a reconstruction base, with a spacious parking lot and clean restrooms that are open 24 hours a day. There were no other passenger cars besides mine, but there were trucks parked overnight. Best of all, it's cool because of the high altitude (539m above sea level), so I think it's suitable for overnight stays in your car in the summer. PS There are a lot of creatures that are attracted to the lights. I saw a live diving beetle for the first time. It's a facility like a roadside station, so it's free. It's also open at night. It's very quiet because it's in the mountains. (Submitted by: w, August 2024)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: シーフードレストラン メヒコ 福島店
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：福島県発祥のチェーン店、名物はカニピラフ。食べログ、詳細（投稿：2024年9月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A chain restaurant originating in Fukushima Prefecture, famous for its crab pilaf. Tabelog, details (Posted: September 2024, by user n)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：福島県道65号沿い、「ひまわり交通」営業所近く。放射能検査済。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Located along Fukushima Prefectural Road 65, near the Himawari Kotsu bus depot. Radiation testing completed.

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：福島県道116号から入った所、案内の看板・のぼり等あり。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There are signs and banners indicating the way off Fukushima Prefectural Road 116.

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：福島県田村郡の滝桜大駐車場は夕方鎖が張ってあって、入れませんでした。（投稿：2025年5月、a様）
■桜シーズンも駐車場は無料で利用可能。夜間利用も可能なトイレ（仮設トイレで臭いが）が有り車中泊可能。ここは夜桜で21:00ごろまでライトアップがされ混雑が続くので、夜から車中泊する場合は22時過ぎに来るのが良い。そのまま車中泊して、早朝から撮影などすれば良い。（トイレが臭いので車中泊は別の場所で行い、早朝にココへ来る人も多い。）桜の観覧は一人300円徴収される。夜桜のライトアップを見たい場合は、車中泊の後丸一日ここで時間を潰すか、午後に来て数時間の渋滞に並ぶしかない。
■案内マップ
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: The Takizakura large parking lot in Tamura-gun, Fukushima Prefecture, was chained off in the evening and inaccessible. (Submitted by: A, May 2025)
■The parking lot is free to use even during cherry blossom season. There are toilets (temporary toilets, so they smell) that can be used at night, and overnight parking is possible. The cherry blossoms here are lit up until around 9:00 PM, so it gets crowded. If you plan to stay overnight in your car, it's best to arrive after 10:00 PM. You can stay overnight in your car and take photos in the early morning. (Many people stay overnight elsewhere and come here in the early morning because the toilets smell.) There is a 300 yen fee per person to view the cherry blossoms. If you want to see the illuminated cherry blossoms at night, you'll have to spend the whole day here after staying overnight in your car, or come in the afternoon and wait in traffic for several hours.

■Guidance Map

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：風呂は車で15分ほどで小田代温泉がある、三陸では珍しい。2021年5月24日現地宿泊。（投稿：2021年5月、b様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：新設されたので、広い駐車場にきれいなトイレ。飲食店も一軒、夜間まで営業しています。詳細（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■2016年7月31日、移転オープン。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: There's a hot spring bath about 15 minutes away by car, Odashiro Onsen, which is rare in Sanriku. Stayed there on May 24, 2021. (Posted by b, May 2021)
■Report from our website reader: It's newly built, so there's a large parking lot and clean toilets. There's also one restaurant that's open until late at night. Details (older post from before 2019)
■Relocated and reopened on July 31, 2016.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車60台級の無料駐車場。トイレは簡易水洗洋式で綺麗に清掃されている。開放感のある駐車場で閑静な一夜を過ごせる。名前の通り、サッカーグラウンド用の駐車場なので、地元チームの夜間練習等が入っていた場合は、夜が更けるまで騒々しいかもしれない。（投稿：2023年7月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A free parking lot with space for about 60 regular cars. The toilets are simple flush toilets and are kept clean. You can spend a quiet night in this spacious parking lot. As the name suggests, it is a parking lot for a soccer field, so if a local team is practicing there at night, it may be noisy until late at night. (Submitted by: y, July 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車50台級の無料駐車場。トイレは水洗和式だが、綺麗に清掃されている。夜は無人状態となるので、静かな夜を過ごしたい人にオススメ。標高600m程度で、夏でもそれなりに涼しい。（投稿：2023年10月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A free parking lot that can accommodate about 50 regular cars. The toilets are flush toilets (Japanese style), but they are kept clean. It is unmanned at night, so it is recommended for those who want to spend a quiet night. It is at an altitude of about 600m, so it is reasonably cool even in summer. (Submitted by: y, October 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車50台級の無料駐車場。トイレは水洗洋式で清掃状態も良好。公衆トイレとしては上々のレベル。夕日スポットなので、日没前後はそれなりに人がいるが、日が暮れて一時間もすれば無人状態となる。ひとけのない場所での車中泊が好きな人にはオススメできるスポット。（投稿：2024年10月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A free parking lot that can accommodate about 50 regular cars. The toilets are flush toilets and are in good condition. They are of a very good standard for public toilets. It's a sunset spot, so there are a fair number of people around before and after sunset, but it becomes deserted within an hour after sunset. It's a recommended spot for people who like to camp in their cars in secluded places. (Submitted by: y, October 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 鼠ヶ関マリンパーク（※夏季有料）
properties.title_en: Nezugaseki Marine Park (*Admission fee applies during summer)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車50台級の無料駐車場。トイレは水洗洋式で清掃状態も悪くない。幹線道路から離れているので、閑静な一夜を過ごせる。夏場はそれなりに混雑するのかもしれないが、シーズンオフならとても快適な車中泊スポット。（投稿：2024年10月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A free parking lot that can accommodate about 50 regular cars. The toilets are flush toilets and are in good condition. It's away from the main road, so you can spend a quiet night. It might get quite crowded in the summer, but it's a very comfortable spot for overnight stays in your car during the off-season. (Submitted by: y, October 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車50台以上の無料駐車場。トイレは水洗洋式ウオシュレット付き&暖房付きで清掃状態も良好。公衆トイレとしては文句なしのレベル。R101とJR五能線に隣接しているが、夜間の通行量は絶無レベルなので、閑静な一夜を過ごせる。ひとけのない場所での車中泊が好きな人にはかなりオススメできるスポット。（投稿：2024年10月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free parking for over 50 regular cars. The toilets are flush toilets with bidet functions and heating, and are kept very clean. As a public toilet, it's absolutely top-notch. It's adjacent to Route 101 and the JR Gono Line, but traffic at night is practically nonexistent, so you can spend a peaceful night. This is a highly recommended spot for those who like to camp in their car in secluded places. (Submitted by: y, October 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_en: Kuji City Comprehensive Disaster Prevention Park
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車40台級の無料駐車場。トイレは水洗洋式で清掃状態も良好。夜は訪れる人もなく、閑静な一夜を過ごせる。隣接する第二広場にも同規模の駐車場＆トレイがあって車中泊できそう。2019年にオープンした新しめの公園なので、駐車場もトイレも気持ちよく利用できた。（投稿：2024年10月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A free parking lot that can accommodate about 40 regular cars. The toilets are flush toilets and are in good condition. There are no visitors at night, so you can spend a quiet night. There is also a parking lot and toilets of the same size in the adjacent second plaza, so it seems possible to stay overnight in your car. Since it is a relatively new park that opened in 2019, the parking lot and toilets were pleasant to use. (Submitted by: y, October 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車30～40台級の無料駐車場。トイレは水洗和式で清掃状態はイマイチ。吹風殿にあるトイレは洋式で綺麗なのだが、深夜は閉鎖されてしまうのが残念。9月の連休に利用したが、夜間は訪れる人もなく、閑静な一夜を過ごせる。買い出しは、県境をまたいで北茨城市側に向かった方が便利かも。（投稿：2024年10月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Free parking lot that can accommodate 30-40 regular cars. The toilets are flush toilets (Japanese style) and not very clean. The toilets in the Fufuden building are Western style and clean, but unfortunately they are closed at night. I used it during the September long weekend, and there were no visitors at night, so I was able to spend a quiet night. For shopping, it might be more convenient to cross the prefectural border and head towards Kitaibaraki City. (Submitted by: y, October 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車250台の広大な無料駐車場は素晴らしい。トイレは水洗洋式で清掃状態も悪くない。夜は訪れる人もなく、閑静な一夜を過ごせる。駐車場にやや傾斜があり、神経質な人は気になるかも。（投稿：2024年10月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: The vast free parking lot with space for 250 regular cars is fantastic. The toilets are flush toilets and are in good condition. There are no visitors at night, so you can spend a peaceful night. The parking lot has a slight slope, which might bother some people. (Submitted by: y, October 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 田子倉レイクビュー駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車20台級の無料駐車場。トイレは水洗洋式で綺麗に清掃されている。隣接する国道は夜間の通行量も少なく閑静な一夜を過ごせる。（投稿：2023年10月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A free parking lot that can accommodate about 20 regular cars. The toilets are flush toilets and are kept clean. The adjacent national highway has little traffic at night, so you can spend a quiet night. (Submitted by: y, October 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車20台級の無料駐車場。トイレは水洗洋式ウオシュレット付きで清掃状態も良好。公衆トイレとしては文句なしのレベル。隣接する国道R103は、夜間の通行量は極小レベルで、落ち着いた夜を過ごせる。ただし、日が昇って明るくなると、大型車もそこそこ往来する＆休憩に来るので注意。（投稿：2024年10月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A free parking lot with space for about 20 regular cars. The toilets are flush toilets with bidet functions and are kept in good condition. As a public toilet, it's absolutely perfect. The adjacent National Route R103 has very little traffic at night, so you can spend a peaceful evening. However, once the sun rises and it gets light, there is a fair amount of traffic from large vehicles and people also come here to take a break, so be careful. (Submitted by: y, October 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 津山もくもくらんど
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車140台の駐車場。トイレは水洗洋式ウオシュレット付きで清掃状態も良好。幹線国道のR45沿いだが、夜間の交通量はそれほどでもなく、快眠の妨げにはならない。平日の夜に利用したが、同好の車が二台いた。（投稿：2024年10月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A parking lot with space for 140 regular cars. The toilets are flush toilets with bidet functions and are kept clean. It is located along National Route 45, a major national highway, but the traffic volume at night is not that high, so it does not disturb sleep. I used it on a weekday night and there were two other cars with the same interests. (Submitted by: y, October 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車100台級の無料駐車場。駐車場の北側にきれいな水洗洋式のトイレがある。隣接する「わたり温泉」も評判が良い。行き交う車も少なく、閑静な一夜を過ごせる。周辺の荒浜漁港公園・荒浜防災公園にも駐車場とトイレがあり車中泊可能。地震時の津波だけが心配だが、それ以外は車中泊のユートピアとも言える環境でオススメ。（投稿：2022年10月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A free parking lot with space for about 100 regular cars. There is a clean, flushable Western-style toilet on the north side of the parking lot. The adjacent "Watari Onsen" hot spring is also highly regarded. There are few cars passing by, so you can spend a quiet night. There are also parking lots and toilets at the nearby Arahama Fishing Port Park and Arahama Disaster Prevention Park, so overnight stays in your car are possible. The only concern is tsunamis in the event of an earthquake, but otherwise it is a utopia for overnight stays in your car and highly recommended. (Submitted by: y, October 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 八幡平ビジターセンター
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：八幡平ＶＣ近くの駐車場とトイレ。現地に行き利用しようと確認をしたところ　トイレの床、壁、便器に足の踏み場もないほど虫（カメムシ＋？？）がいてとても利用できるものではありませんでした。（投稿：2021年11月、車中泊Mapの利用者（User？）様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：先日八幡平に行ったのですが、秋田側のの八幡平ビジターセンターと後生掛温泉近くの無料駐車場は車中泊禁止の大きな掲示がありました。誰もいなかったので私も車中泊を断念して「道の駅かづの」に移動しました。車中泊ポイントとしては使えないと感じましたにで報告させていただきました。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■標高963m！夏も涼しい。無料駐車場、トイレあり、携帯◎（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Parking lot and toilets near Hachimantai Visitor Center. Upon checking the facilities, I found the toilets were infested with insects (stink bugs + ??) on the floor, walls, and toilet bowl, making them unusable. (Posted: November 2021, by a user of the Car Camping Map)

■Report from a reader of this site: I recently visited Hachimantai, and there were large signs prohibiting overnight parking at the free parking lot near the Hachimantai Visitor Center and Goshogake Onsen on the Akita side. Since there was no one there, I also gave up on overnight parking and moved to "Michi-no-Eki Kazuno." I felt it was unsuitable as an overnight parking spot, so I wanted to report it. (Older post from before 2019)

■Altitude 963m! Cool even in summer. Free parking, toilets available, cell phone reception ◎ (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：白河ラーメンの店。詳細、食べログ（投稿：2025年4月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A Shirakawa ramen shop. Details on Tabelog (Posted by: n, April 2025)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：豚骨醤油のラーメン店です。山形県の東根市にあります。博多豚骨、群馬豚骨、それぞれ食べたことがありますが、ここはそれらに比べてパンチこそないものの、非常に上品に豚骨から出汁をとっていると感じました。麺はストレート太麺ですが、それはそれで合うものです。一度味わう価値はあると思いました。ただ、混みますね。駐車場も九台ほどありますが、埋っていました。ですが、並ぶ価値はありました。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: This is a tonkotsu shoyu ramen shop. It's located in Higashine City, Yamagata Prefecture. I've tried Hakata tonkotsu and Gunma tonkotsu ramen, and while this one doesn't have the same punch, I felt that the broth was made very elegantly from pork bones. The noodles are thick and straight, but they work well with the ramen. I think it's worth trying at least once. However, it gets crowded. There are about nine parking spaces, but they were all full. But it was worth the wait. Tabelog

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：東北道・菅生SA（下り側）について：２０２３年７月の週末に利用。東北道の中でも広いSAのひとつで、フードコートが24H営業しています。そのため終夜クルマの出入りが絶えず、建物に近いところはドアの開閉音や話し声が賑やかです。SAの入口に近い側か後方少し離れたところなら静かかもです。大型車と小型車はエリアが明確に分かれています。EVのQuick Chargeがあります。（投稿：2023年7月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Reader Report: Regarding Sugao Service Area (downbound) on the Tohoku Expressway: Used on a weekend in July 2023. It is one of the largest service areas on the Tohoku Expressway, and the food court is open 24 hours. As a result, there is a constant flow of cars coming and going throughout the night, and it is noisy near the building with the sounds of doors opening and closing and people talking. It may be quieter near the entrance of the service area or a little further back. There are clearly separated areas for large and small vehicles. Quick Charge for EVs is available. (Submitted by: n, July 2023)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：東北道・紫波SA（上り側）について：2023年7月の平日に利用。大間で夕食の後にここまで南下して１泊しました。比較的広いSAです。大型車と小型車はエリアが違うし、すいているので静かに休めました。EVのQuick Chargeがあります。（投稿：2023年7月、n様）
■トラックと分離でGood！ここは良い。本線からも離れている。しかもなんとfreespot使えます。かなりおすすめ。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Reader Report: Regarding Shiwa Service Area (Upbound) on the Tohoku Expressway: Used on a weekday in July 2023. After dinner in Oma, I drove south to this point and stayed overnight. It's a relatively large service area. Large and small vehicles have separate areas, and it was quiet and peaceful. There's an EV Quick Charge. (Posted by n, July 2023)

■Good because it's separated from trucks! This place is great. It's also far from the main road. And what's more, you can use freespot. Highly recommended. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 四十八坂展望台駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：冬季も利用可能なトイレ　食堂と売店　眺望良　道路沿い、本人最終目視確認　2020年9月（投稿：2022年5月、草の湯様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Toilets available even in winter, cafeteria and shop, good view, located along the road, last visual confirmation by the user, September 2020 (Submitted in May 2022 by Kusanoyu)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: ふれあい公園 駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：冬季はトイレ閉鎖＆除雪作業の為車中泊不可（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Toilets are closed and overnight parking is not possible during winter due to snow removal work (older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 仙台湯処 サンピアの湯
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：土休日1300円、平日1100円（タオルセット付き） 詳細　9:00～2:00　受付内に食堂・休憩室あり。（投稿：2026年1月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: 1300 yen on weekends and holidays, 1100 yen on weekdays (towel set included). Details: 9:00 AM - 2:00 PM. Cafeteria and rest area available inside the reception area. (Submitted by: n, January 2026)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：潮目もあるだろうが朝5:30からサーファーと釣り人が集まり煩くて起きた。遅起きさんにはおすすめしない。（投稿：2024年9月、s様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：無料、24時間、トイレ有り。普通車50台駐車可。比較的新しくトイレも綺麗。周囲は物流倉庫ばかり、前の道路は夜ほとんど車が通らない。治安に少し不安を感じるがほぼ毎晩パトカーが巡回に来る。土手の向こうに国土地理院認定の「日本一低い山(標高3m)」の日和山がある。日和山の先には野鳥がいる蒲生干潟、さらにその先に太平洋があり、意外と眺めがいい。特に日和山山頂から見る朝日はおすすめ。（投稿：2023年12月、t様）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: There may be tides, but surfers and fishermen gathered from 5:30 AM and it was so noisy I woke up. Not recommended for late risers. (Submitted: September 2024, Mr. S)
■Report from our site's reader: Free, 24 hours, toilets available. Parking for 50 regular cars. Relatively new and the toilets are clean. The surrounding area is full of logistics warehouses, and there is hardly any traffic on the road in front at night. I feel a little uneasy about the safety, but a police car patrols almost every night. Across the embankment is Hiyoriyama, the "lowest mountain in Japan (elevation 3m)" certified by the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan. Beyond Hiyoriyama is the Gamou tidal flat where wild birds live, and even further beyond is the Pacific Ocean, so the view is surprisingly good. The sunrise viewed from the summit of Hiyoriyama is especially recommended. (Submitted: December 2023, Mr. T)

■Report from our website reader: Free, restrooms available. At the tip of the Oshika Peninsula, the end of the Cobalt Line, 360-degree panoramic view, a spectacular viewpoint overlooking the entire Oshika Peninsula, Kinkasan, Ajishima, Tashirojima, and the vast Pacific Ocean. There are many motorcyclists during the day, but it's quiet at night, so you can sleep peacefully. There are no convenience stores nearby, but the bath is at Oshika Exchange Center Hottomaru. Stayed at the location on May 25, 2021. (Posted by: b, May 2021)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：震災後に整備された公園。トイレあり。夜間（ずっと）照明がついている。【ここポイント】海風が心地よく夏はへたな高原より気候が良い（日が多い）。体感気温がめっちゃ気持ちいい。また海風で蚊がまず来ない（ため防犯を除けば夜にマドを中途半端に開けて寝れる※夜間照明ありで防犯に心理効果あると思われる。）コンビニが車で数分に2件ある。風呂がないため済ませてから行くと良い。海鮮丼ランチ名店（少し離れるともっと評価高い店あり）、震災記念館、美空ひばり記念碑が付近にあり。散歩と自転車ツーリングにも適している。日没後は近くの灯台灯が廻っている。朝は日の出と太平洋が気持ちいい。【これ大事】いい場所なので（ゴミなど）マナー守って保全したい。地元民の負担にならないようにしたい。（投稿：2026年2月、オカザキ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A park that was renovated after the earthquake. There are toilets. The lights are on all night. [Key point] The sea breeze is pleasant, and the climate is better than some highlands in the summer (there are many sunny days). The perceived temperature is very comfortable. Also, mosquitoes hardly come because of the sea breeze (so you can sleep with the window half-open at night, except for security reasons *the nighttime lighting probably has a psychological effect on security). There are two convenience stores within a few minutes' drive. There are no baths, so it's best to take care of that before you go. There is a famous seafood rice bowl lunch restaurant (there are even more highly rated restaurants a little further away), an earthquake memorial museum, and a Hibari Misora ​​memorial nearby. It is also suitable for walking and cycling tours. After sunset, the nearby lighthouse light rotates. In the morning, the sunrise and the Pacific Ocean are pleasant. [This is important] It is a nice place, so let's preserve it by following the rules (littering, etc.). Let's not burden the local residents. (Submitted by: Okazaki, February 2026)
