properties.title_ja: 道の駅 遠野風の丘
properties.title_en: Roadside Station Tono Kaze no Oka
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：車中泊レポート2024/8/10、車：ワンボックス。風車が目印になる道の駅。トイレが新しくとてもきれい。ショップも18時までやっていて便利。駐車場が広い。風があるので夏でも過ごしやすい。幹線道路沿いで交通量は多いが、夜はそんなにうるさくなく寝られた。約3kmの所に踊鹿(おどろか)温泉 天の湯という天然ラドン冷鉱泉があり、大人700円だが温まって良かった。スーパーやコンビニ、牛丼チェーン店も近く、食事には不自由しない。風の丘という名前の通り風が強いので、停める場所を選ぶ必要がある。トイレの近くがお勧め。大型車の駐車スペースに近く、何台も停まっているとおそらくアイドリングがうるさいだろう。(今回は１台しかいなかった)　トータル的には90点。道の駅としては、温泉併設ではないが良いスポットだったと思います。（投稿：2024年8月、h様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Car camping report 2024/8/10, Vehicle: Minivan. A roadside station marked by a windmill. The toilets are new and very clean. The shops are open until 6pm, which is convenient. The parking lot is spacious. It's comfortable even in summer because there's a breeze. It's along a main road so there's a lot of traffic, but it wasn't too noisy at night and I was able to sleep. About 3km away is Odoroka Onsen Ten no Yu, a natural radon cold spring, which costs 700 yen for adults but was nice and warming. There are supermarkets, convenience stores, and beef bowl chain restaurants nearby, so you won't have any trouble finding food. As the name Kaze no Oka (Windy Hill) suggests, it's windy, so you need to choose your parking spot carefully. Near the toilets is recommended. It's close to the parking space for large vehicles, so if there are many cars parked there, the idling will probably be noisy. (There was only one car this time) Overall, I'd give it 90 points. As a roadside station, it's a good spot even though it doesn't have a hot spring attached. (Submitted: August 2024, by h)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: 中山チェーン脱着所 岩手県八幡平市 チェーン着脱所
properties.title_en: Nakayama Chain Installation/Removal Station, Hachimantai City, Iwate Prefecture.""
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：車中泊マップ東北　のうち、「岩手県八幡平市　チェーン着脱所」、トイレ入り口に閉鎖の掲示あり。　一部車両が入れる屋根あり、本人最終目視確認　2021年秋（投稿：2022年5月、草の湯様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：とりあえずトイレあります。車は泊められそうです。
■無料駐車場とトイレ。幹線道路沿いのためうるさい。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Regarding the "Car Camping Map Tohoku," at "Iwate Prefecture Hachimantai City Chain Attachment/Detachment Area," there is a "Closed" sign at the toilet entrance. There is a roof that some vehicles can enter; last visual confirmation by the person: Autumn 2021 (Posted: May 2022, Kusanoyu)

■Report from a reader of this site: There is a toilet, at least. It seems possible to park a car there.

■Free parking and toilet. It is noisy because it is located along a main road.

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: （車中泊不可）弘前運動公園駐車場
properties.title_en: (Overnight parking not permitted) Hirosaki Sports Park Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：車中泊は不可です。2023/5/24(水)、午後8時過ぎに車中泊の準備をしていたところ、警備員から、午後9時50分に進入路を閉鎖するから退去して欲しいと言われました。（投稿：2023年5月、tossanyzf様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレあり。ただし国道沿いのため、多少の騒音は覚悟。比較的市街地に近いので、意外と穴場かも。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: Overnight stays in vehicles are not permitted. On Wednesday, May 24, 2023, while preparing to stay overnight in my vehicle after 8 PM, a security guard told me that the access road would be closed at 9:50 PM and asked me to leave. (Submitted by tossanyzf, May 2023)

■Report from our site's reader: There is a toilet. However, since it is located along a national highway, be prepared for some noise. It's relatively close to the city center, so it might be a hidden gem.

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: 弘前市リンゴ公園駐車場
properties.title_en: Hirosaki City Apple Park Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：車中泊は不可でした。無料でトイレなどもありますが、使用時間は17時までとあり、それ以上滞在しようとしたら警備員に警告されました。原則17時には閉鎖されます。従って車中泊はできません。訂正をお願いします。（投稿：2025年8月、t様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：ここ自体も観光地です。駐車場　無料。けっこう広いです。トイレも無料で複数あります。弘前公園までも２．５キロくらいです。途中禅林街あり。岩木山がとてもきれいです。弘前市内は複数の基本日帰りの温泉があります。車で１０分も走れば市営で格安のできて５年ぐらいの御所温泉があります。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Overnight parking was not allowed. There are free toilets and other facilities, but the usage time is until 5 PM, and I was warned by a security guard when I tried to stay longer. The facility is closed at 5 PM as a rule. Therefore, overnight parking is not allowed. Please correct this. (Submitted: August 2025, by T)

■Report from a reader of this site: This place itself is a tourist spot. Free parking. It's quite spacious. There are also multiple free toilets. It's about 2.5 km to Hirosaki Park. There's a Zenrin-gai along the way. Mount Iwaki is very beautiful. There are several hot springs in Hirosaki city that are basically day-trip hot springs. If you drive for 10 minutes, you'll find Gosho Onsen, a municipal hot spring that's been open for about 5 years and is very inexpensive.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 種差海岸インフォメーションセンター
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：車中泊？？？泊まれるものなら泊まってみな、くらいの傾斜地にある駐車場。前後だけでなく、左右の傾斜チャレンジャーのために。トイレはウォッシュレットでないトイレが１。ウォッシュレットのある多機能トイレは9時から17時まで利用可。景色は素晴らしい。自然芝、砂浜、岩場にウミネコ多数。日の出、月の沈みはインホメーションに案内あり。場所により寝たまま日の出が見られるかも。風光明媚という言葉の意味がわかる場所。（投稿：2021年5月、渡り鳥漫遊記様）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。車中泊可能との報告あり。詳細レポート（2019年）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: Overnight stay in your car??? A parking lot on a slope so steep you'd want to try it if you could. Not just front and back, but also left and right slopes for those who are up for the challenge. There is one toilet without a bidet. A multi-purpose toilet with a bidet is available from 9 am to 5 pm. The scenery is wonderful. Natural grass, sandy beach, rocky areas, and many seagulls. Sunrise and moonset times are announced at the information desk. Depending on the spot, you might be able to see the sunrise while lying down. A place where you understand the meaning of the word "scenic beauty." (Submitted by: Migratory Bird Travelogue, May 2021)
■Free parking and public toilets. Reports indicate that overnight stays in cars are possible. Detailed report (2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 西蔵王展望広場（山形市）
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：山形市街を見下ろし、夜景・夕日がきれい。夜間も車が来るのでやや音あり。蔵王温泉内には車中泊適地が無いのでここを利用しました。和式水洗トイレあり（冬季利用可否は不明）　2022年8月投稿者宿泊確認。（投稿：2022年8月、草の湯様）
■標高561m
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Overlooking Yamagata city, the night view and sunset are beautiful. There is some noise from cars even at night. There are no suitable places to stay overnight in a car within Zao Onsen, so I used this place. There is a Japanese-style flush toilet (whether it can be used in winter is unknown). Confirmed by the poster who stayed there in August 2022. (Posted by: Kusanoyu, August 2022)
■Elevation 561m

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：山形県天童市にある煮干し系ラーメン店です。奇しくも、青森にあるラーメン屋と同じ「たかはし」…ただ、味は似て非なるもの。濃厚な煮干しの味わいは、上品で苦味や酸味はなく、ただただ煮干しの甘みが感じられるスープでした…。チャーシューやメンマもデカい。加えて大盛は普通盛と同値段。素晴らしいと思いました。おすすめしたいです。ただ、駐車場は少なく、四台ほど。お昼時は常に埋まるので時間をずらすことをおすすめします。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: This is a dried sardine-based ramen shop in Tendo City, Yamagata Prefecture. Coincidentally, it shares the same name as a ramen shop in Aomori called "Takahashi"... however, the taste is similar but different. The rich dried sardine flavor is refined, without bitterness or sourness, and the soup simply has a sweet taste of dried sardines... The char siu and bamboo shoots are also huge. In addition, a large serving is the same price as a regular serving. I thought it was wonderful. I would recommend it. However, there is little parking space, only about four cars. It is always full during lunchtime, so I recommend going at a different time. Tabelog

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：山形県の光ヶ丘公園駐車場がとの事で昨夜宿泊したのですが、トイレが施錠されてて使えませんでした。（投稿：2023年8月、まこと様）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。水洗洋式でキレイ。幹線道から離れており静か。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。非常に良いです。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: I stayed overnight at the Hikari-ga-oka Park parking lot in Yamagata Prefecture, but the toilets were locked and unusable. (Submitted by Makoto, August 2023)
■Free parking and public toilets. Clean, flushable Western-style toilets. Quiet as it's away from the main road. Confirmed that it's not closed at night. Very good.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 八ツ沼駐車場（山形県朝日町）
properties.title_en: Yatsunuma Parking Lot (Asahi Town, Yamagata Prefecture)""
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：山の中で沼の畔に遊歩道と植栽等が整備されている。地元車両が通る道沿い。静かで穏やかな景色が好きな方に適。水洗トイレあり（冬季利用可否は不明）　2022年8月投稿者現地確認（投稿：2022年8月、草の湯様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A walking path and landscaping have been developed along the edge of a marsh in the mountains. It is located along a road used by local vehicles. Suitable for those who like quiet and peaceful scenery. There is a flush toilet (whether it can be used in winter is unknown). Confirmed on-site by the poster in August 2022 (Posted by: Kusanoyu, August 2022)

properties.label: Scenic Park
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：三春滝桜に匹敵する樹形規模の一本桜(見頃は4月中下旬)。オオヤマ桜(多分)なのでエドヒガン桜やシダレ桜に比べ樹高があり男性的な印象。一本杉公園へのアプローチが分かりにくいためか花見客が少ない。舗装駐車場にトイレ完備の穴場。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: A single cherry tree comparable in size and shape to the Miharu Takizakura (best viewing time is mid-to-late April). It is probably an Ooyama cherry tree, so it is taller and has a more masculine appearance compared to Edohigan cherry trees and weeping cherry trees. There are few cherry blossom viewers, perhaps because the approach to Ipponsugi Park is difficult to find. A hidden gem with a paved parking lot and toilets.

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.title_ja: 花やしき公園(ミニ花見山)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：桜はないが4月中旬にハナモモやレンギョウが見頃になる超穴場。花見山よりも前後奥行感のある花の写真が撮り易い。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: There are no cherry blossoms, but it's a hidden gem where flowering peach and forsythia are in full bloom in mid-April. It's easier to take photos of flowers with a sense of depth than at Hanamiyama.

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：最高の車中泊スポットです。夜も静かで街灯も少なく、ほかの車中泊車もいるので治安も安心です。トイレも２４時間使えます。（投稿：2024年9月、ゆーぷる様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：広大な駐車場で奥の方は静かだが、警察の見回りや職質で寝にくい （朝の4時とかに車の横にエンジンをかけたまま来て車内を覗いてくる) 。美術館が併設なので、警備が厳重なのだと思われる。地粉のそばとソースカツ丼がうまい。職質上等なら良いところ。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: This is the best spot for overnight stays in your car. It's quiet at night, there are few streetlights, and there are other cars parked there, so it feels safe. The toilets are available 24 hours a day. (Posted by: Yu-puru, September 2024)

■ Reader Report: The parking lot is vast, and the back is quiet, but it's difficult to sleep due to police patrols and questioning (they come up to your car with the engine running at 4 AM and peek inside). There's an art museum attached, so I think that's why security is so strict. The soba noodles made with local flour and the katsudon with sauce are delicious. It's a good place if you don't mind being questioned by the police. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：国道49号強清水交差点の南、そば屋「もろはくや」の脇。湧水口の構造的に大量には汲みづらい。放射能検査済。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: South of the Tsuyoshimizu intersection on National Route 49, next to the soba restaurant "Morohakuya". Due to the structure of the spring, it is difficult to draw large quantities of water. Radioactivity tested.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 茶たての清水 無料駐車場
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：国道３４１号線、先人が名水のある駐車場で紹介しています。水を汲んでいたら、次々四台の車が入ってきたので、洗い物は諦めたが、このあたりまだ雪のための通行止めがあちこちある。（投稿：2021年5月、渡り鳥漫遊記様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレあり、携帯◎LTE◎ なんと名水も無料で汲める、なかなかすごいが、幹線道路沿いのためうるさい。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website's reader: National Route 341, a parking lot with famous spring water has been featured by previous readers. While I was collecting water, four cars pulled in one after another, so I gave up on washing dishes. There are still many road closures due to snow around here. (Posted: May 2021, by Migratory Bird Travelogue)

■Report from our website's reader: Toilets available, cell phone reception ◎LTE◎. Amazingly, you can collect famous spring water for free, which is quite impressive, but it's noisy because it's along a main road. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：国道339号、竜飛崎近くにある、日本で唯一車が通れない国道。詳細（投稿：2025年10月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: National Route 339, near Cape Tappi, is the only national highway in Japan that is impassable by car. Details (Submitted by: n, October 2025)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：高速道路のPAのような道の駅、国道の上下線に分かれて設置。売店・軽食コーナー・24hコンビニあり。詳細（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: A roadside station similar to a highway rest area, located on both the northbound and southbound lanes of a national highway. It has a shop, a snack corner, and a 24-hour convenience store. Details (older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: セデッテかしま第二駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：高速を利用しなくても駐車可能。トイレはS.A.内にあり。（投稿：2025年6月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Parking is possible even without using the highway. Toilets are located inside the service area. (Submitted by a reader in June 2025)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：弘前市にある味噌ラーメンの店。弘前のソウルフード。詳細、食べログ（投稿：2025年12月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A miso ramen shop in Hirosaki City. Hirosaki's soul food. Details on Tabelog (Posted: December 2025, by n)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：向かいに24hコンビニ（ファミリーマート）あり。（投稿：2025年6月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: There is a 24-hour convenience store (FamilyMart) across the street. (Submitted by: n, June 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：景勝地近くに３段の駐車場で十分な広さで上段は展望良・２４ｈ使用可能水洗トイレあり（冬季も利用可）・近くに有料キャンプ場もあり（投稿：2022年3月、草の湯様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A spacious three-tiered parking lot near a scenic spot, with a great view from the upper level. 24-hour flush toilets are available (even in winter). There is also a paid campsite nearby. (Submitted by Kusanoyu, March 2022)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: （<font color="red">トイレ夜間閉鎖</font>）大正ろまん館
properties.title_en: （<font color="red">トイレ夜間閉鎖</font>）大正ろまん館
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：銀山温泉観光の車でほぼ満車状態でしたが、22時23時ごろになるとほぼ居なくなりました。入り口の方に街灯があるので離れて停めるかシェードが必要です。横の道は銀山温泉のホテルの車で深夜も交通量多いです。トイレは２４時間利用できません。早朝は近所の方が犬の散歩にきます。GWでも早朝は気温4度近くまで下がります。（投稿：2024年9月、ゆーぷる様）
■残念ながらトイレが夜間封鎖。詳細（2024年の情報）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: The parking lot was almost full with cars for sightseeing in Ginzan Onsen, but it was almost empty by around 10 or 11 PM. There are streetlights near the entrance, so you need to park far away or use a shade. The road next to it is busy even late at night with cars from the Ginzan Onsen hotels. The toilets are not available 24 hours a day. In the early morning, locals come to walk their dogs. Even during Golden Week, the temperature drops to around 4 degrees Celsius in the early morning. (Submitted by: Yu-puru, September 2024)

■Unfortunately, the toilets are closed at night. Details (Information from 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：近所に福島県の大手スーパー「リオン・ドール」があるので、食料類の調達には便利。道の駅の施設前にある駐車場は手狭だが、公称80台なので第二駐車場があるのかも？P.S.職質されました。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There's a large supermarket from Fukushima Prefecture called "Lion Dor" nearby, so it's convenient for buying groceries. The parking lot in front of the roadside station is small, but it's officially listed as having 80 spaces, so there might be a second parking lot? P.S. I was stopped and questioned by the police. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: いわき湯本温泉 さはこの湯 公衆浴場
properties.title_en: Iwaki Yumoto Onsen Sahako-no-Yu Public Bath
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：共同浴場。300円と安い。近くに無料駐車場あり　詳細
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Public bath. Only 300 yen. Free parking available nearby. Details

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：巨大な市場タイプの食品センター。鮮魚から干物、野菜、果物、酒、お土産が買える。駐車場も巨大。向かいにホームセンターや安売りのスーパー有り。食品調達に事欠かない。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A huge market-type food center. You can buy everything from fresh fish and dried seafood to vegetables, fruits, alcohol, and souvenirs. The parking lot is also huge. There is a home improvement store and a discount supermarket across the street. You will never be short of food supplies. (Tabelog)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：岩手県発祥のチェーン店、名物はキムチ納豆ラーメン。食べログ、詳細（投稿：2024年9月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A chain restaurant originating in Iwate Prefecture, famous for its kimchi natto ramen. Tabelog, details (Posted by: n, September 2024)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：寒河江市にあるラーメン屋です。ワンタン麺が有名です。山形の酒田にある「満月」も食べたことがありますが、こちらの方が好みです。ツルツルとして柔らか、 それでいて絹のような、湯葉のような弾力、口の中でとろける食感…たまりませんでした…。お昼頃は並ぶようです。おすすめさせてもらいます。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: This is a ramen shop in Sagae City. They are famous for their wonton noodles. I've also eaten at "Mangetsu" in Sakata, Yamagata, but I prefer this one. The noodles were smooth and soft, yet had a silky, tofu-like elasticity, and melted in my mouth...it was irresistible... It seems there's a line around lunchtime. I highly recommend it. Tabelog

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 葦毛崎展望台 駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：海が見えて夜間は通行量少なく、たまにうるさい車が通ることはあるがおおむね静か。展望台は要塞風で趣がある。トイレ夜間使用可。和・洋式水洗、洗面所あり。独立して水飲み場と蛇口あり。日中は隣接してカフェあり。大型車三台を含め40台以上駐車可。標高は19ｍほどで、海辺ながら東日本大震災クラスなら津波に吞まれない高さあり。夏季の気温は風向により熱いこともある。ヤマセが入ると涼しい。八戸市内に近いので館鼻岸壁朝市など混雑地や街中を避けたい方に適。入浴施設は直近には無いが八戸市内に多数、又は三陸道経由の場合には洋野町種市にあり。青森県の入浴ではシャンプー類が無いのが標準なので注意が必要。（投稿：2025年6月、草の湯様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: It has a view of the sea and traffic is light at night, although occasionally noisy cars pass by, but it is generally quiet. The observation deck is fortress-like and has a charming atmosphere. Toilets are available at night. There are Japanese and Western style flush toilets and washbasins. There is a separate drinking fountain and tap. There is a cafe next door during the day. There is parking for more than 40 cars, including three large vehicles. The elevation is about 19m, and although it is on the coast, it is high enough that it will not be swallowed by a tsunami of the magnitude of the Great East Japan Earthquake. In summer, the temperature can be hot depending on the wind direction. It is cool when the Yamase wind comes in. It is close to Hachinohe city, so it is suitable for those who want to avoid crowded places such as the Tatehana Wharf Morning Market and the city center. There are no bathing facilities immediately nearby, but there are many in Hachinohe city, or in Taneichi, Hirono town if you take the Sanriku Expressway. Note that in Aomori prefecture, it is standard for bathing facilities not to provide shampoo and other toiletries. (Posted: June 2025, Kusano-yu)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：夏場は下界より5℃ほど気温が低く快適。日本海を展望できる側はトイレから遠くなる。鳥海山への登山基地のため、午前３時頃から人が動き始めます。夕日と朝日がとてもきれいです。入浴は麓の温泉「あぽん西浜」がお薦め。（投稿：2022年8月、tossan様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：男女別のトイレあり。鳥海山ブルーライン沿い。星がよく見える。日本海の絶景。標高が高く夏涼しい。鳥海山５合目。冬季閉鎖。車中泊例：詳細（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: In summer, the temperature is about 5°C lower than in the lowlands, making it comfortable. The side with a view of the Sea of ​​Japan is far from the toilets. As it is a base camp for climbing Mt. Chokai, people start moving around from about 3 AM. The sunset and sunrise are very beautiful. For bathing, the hot spring "Apon Nishihama" at the foot of the mountain is recommended. (Posted: August 2022, by tossan)

■Report from our site's reader: Separate toilets for men and women. Located along the Mt. Chokai Blue Line. The stars are clearly visible. Spectacular view of the Sea of ​​Japan. High altitude, cool in summer. 5th station of Mt. Chokai. Closed in winter. Example of overnight stay in a car: Details (older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: 駅近安24H 池月ム一ンライトパーキング
properties.title_en: Iketsuki Moonlight Parking: Affordable 24-hour parking near the station.
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：下記状況から見て車中泊スポットではなくなった模様。「管理物件」「月極駐車場」の表示があり、ストビューにあるような車中泊等の看板は撤去済。会社HPもリニューアルされそちらには掲載無し。（車中泊マップ上のリンク先は現会社HPでは使用されておらず旧情報が放置されている可能性大）（投稿：2025年11月、匿名希望様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Based on the following circumstances, it appears that this is no longer a spot for overnight parking. There are signs indicating "managed property" and "monthly parking lot," and signs for overnight parking, like those seen on Street View, have been removed. The company's website has also been revamped and is no longer listed there. (The link on the overnight parking map is no longer used on the current company website, and it is highly likely that the old information has been left up.) (Submitted: November 2025, anonymous)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 安比高原 ぶなの駅
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：駅舎（キャンプ避難所）は通常は日中管理人駐在で、夜間は閉鎖だが、トイレだけは２４時間利用可能。冬季（11月中旬〜）は積雪のため到達できずトイレ等も閉鎖。温泉は手前集落や安比リゾートにあり。周辺の自然環境を楽しむベースとして好適。早朝等もやや車の出入りあり。標高842m。最終現地確認2021年6月。（投稿：2022年5月、草の湯様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: The station building (camp shelter) is usually staffed by a caretaker during the day and closed at night, but the toilets are available 24 hours a day. During winter (mid-November onwards), it is inaccessible due to snow and the toilets are closed. Hot springs are located in the nearby village and at Appi Resort. It is a suitable base for enjoying the surrounding natural environment. There is some car traffic even in the early morning. Elevation 842m. Last on-site confirmation June 2021. (Submitted by: Kusanoyu, May 2022)

properties.label: Highway Rest + Shower
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：安積SAシャワー24時間になっていました。添付画像。少し感想を。シャワールームに入り、鍵を掛け200円入れるとスタートします。 100円玉以外使えません。 24時間の売店で両替してもらえます。入口に半畳位の着替えるスペースがあり、シャワー室も半畳くらいです。お湯が出ている時間が10分、それ以外は自由。シャワーの出る止めるボタンと残り時間が表示されます。シャワールームの鍵を開けるとリセットされます。自分は3分残しで出ました。 でもとてもお得だと思います。シャワールームの手前に洗面台とドライヤーがあり助かります。シャワールームは3部屋あり、昼も夜も数人並んでいますが5〜10分待ちで入れます。女性用のシャワールームも一部屋あります。以上ご報告です。（投稿：2022年10月、千葉県　s様）
■上下コインシャワーあり(24時間、300円/10分)。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: Asaka SA showers are now 24 hours. See attached image. Here are some thoughts. You enter the shower room, lock the door, and insert 200 yen to start. Only 100 yen coins are accepted. You can get change at the 24-hour shop. There is a changing space of about half a tatami mat at the entrance, and the shower room is also about half a tatami mat. The hot water runs for 10 minutes, and the rest of the time is free. There are buttons to turn the shower on and off and the remaining time is displayed. It resets when you unlock the shower room door. I left with 3 minutes left. But I think it's a great deal. There is a sink and hairdryer in front of the shower room, which is helpful. There are 3 shower rooms, and although there are several people in line both day and night, you can get in after a 5-10 minute wait. There is also one shower room for women. That's all for my report. (Posted: October 2022, Chiba Prefecture, Ms. S)
■Coin-operated showers available (24 hours, 300 yen/10 minutes).

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 やまだ おいすた
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：リニューアルをして綺麗な施設。物販が豊富。可燃ごみ捨てができるのはありがたい。トイレの数も多い。駐車場も広く、幹線道路もないため静か。大型車と普通車が離れているのもいい。（投稿：2023年11月、t様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: The facility is clean after the renovation. There is a wide variety of goods for sale. It is great that they have a place to dispose of combustible waste. There are also plenty of toilets. The parking lot is spacious and quiet because it is not on a main road. It is also good that large vehicles and regular vehicles are separated. (Submitted by: t, November 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：ホテル竜飛で入浴可・２４時間トイレあり・夜は静か（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Hotel Tappi offers bathing facilities, 24-hour toilets, and is quiet at night (older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：ほかの方も書かれていますがPA自体は非常に小さいですが、普通車のエリアは手前です。奥側に大型が止まりますが、小さいPAなので本線進行方向を向いて停車するのでアイドリング音は聞こえにくいですが、東北道の本線の真横ですから、気にしないのであれば大型のアイドリング音よりは良いかと思います。気になる方は耳栓等があればよいかも。高速のPAは必ず大型アイドリング音は有りますから仕方ないと思います。（投稿：2023年6月、読者様）
■超狭い。普通車駐車場のすぐ後ろが高速本線でものすごくうるさい。安眠は不可能。ここはやめといたほうがいい。が、給水場所があるのはGood.名水かただの水道かは不明。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: As others have written, the rest area itself is very small, but the area for regular cars is at the front. Large trucks park at the back, but because it's a small rest area, they park facing the direction of travel on the main road, so the idling noise is not easily heard. However, it's right next to the main road of the Tohoku Expressway, so if you don't mind, it's probably better than the idling noise of large trucks. If it bothers you, you might want to bring earplugs. There is always the idling noise of large trucks at rest areas on expressways, so I think it can't be helped. (Posted: June 2023, by a reader)

■Extremely narrow. The main road is right behind the regular car parking area, so it's extremely noisy. Getting a good night's sleep is impossible. You should avoid this place. However, the fact that there is a water refill is good. It is unclear whether it is famous spring water or just tap water. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：バイパス沿いだが、少し距離があるのでさほど気にならない程度。水洗トイレあり。 売店のコンプレッサーが少々うるさいかも！ 民家が近いので、大きい音は厳禁です。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。幹線道路沿いでうるさい。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: It's along a bypass, but it's a bit far away so it's not too bothersome. There are flush toilets. The compressor at the shop might be a little noisy! There are houses nearby, so loud noises are strictly prohibited. (Older post from before 2019)

■Report from a reader of this site: Free parking and public toilets. It's noisy because it's along a main road. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: 花見山臨時駐車場(阿武隈川河川敷)
properties.title_en: Hanamiyama Temporary Parking Lot (Abukuma River riverbed)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：ハイシーズンの4月には一般車両を花見山に直接乗り入れることができません。シャトルバス(有料／所要約10分)で花見山に向かいます。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website readers: During the peak season in April, private vehicles cannot drive directly onto Hanamiyama. You must take a shuttle bus (fee required / approximately 10 minutes) to get to Hanamiyama.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: ふれあい公園 駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ夜間閉鎖無し。洋式水洗清潔感あり。au電波2本まぁまぁ。車通り少なからずあり、道路から少し離れているが走行音が気になる。（投稿：2024年9月、s様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Toilets are not closed at night. Western-style flush toilets are clean. au signal is decent (2 bars). There is a fair amount of traffic, and although it's a little distance from the road, the traffic noise is noticeable. (Submitted by: s, September 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: うみどり公園 駐車場（北側エリア）
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ夜間閉鎖無し。洋式水洗紙あり清潔。電波問題無し。公園利用者以外の駐車場禁止の張り紙あり。国道近くなので走行音有り。耳栓推奨。下段上段あり、上段がまだ静か。（投稿：2024年9月、s様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Toilets are not closed at night. Western-style toilets are flushable and have toilet paper, and are clean. No cell phone reception issues. There is a sign prohibiting parking for non-park users. There is traffic noise because it is near a national highway. Earplugs are recommended. There are upper and lower levels, and the upper level is quieter. (Submitted by: s, September 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: うみどり公園 駐車場（南側エリア）
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ夜間閉鎖無し。洋式水洗紙あり清潔。電波問題無し。狭い。公園利用者以外の駐車場禁止の張り紙は無い。北側より国道に近く騒音もある。新しい公園で綺麗。津波避難場所にも指定されている。17アイス自販機がある。調査に行った21時頃爆音車で来た輩たちがバスケをしていた。他にも車が止まっており住民の溜まり場になっている印象。（投稿：2024年9月、s様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Toilets are not closed at night. Western-style flush toilets with toilet paper are clean. No cell phone reception issues. It's small. There are no signs prohibiting parking for non-park users. It's closer to the national highway on the north side, so there is noise. It's a new park and clean. It's also designated as a tsunami evacuation site. There's a 17 Ice cream vending machine. When I went to investigate around 9 PM, there were people playing basketball in loud cars. There were other cars parked there as well, giving the impression that it's a hangout for residents. (Submitted by: s, September 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: さくら公園 駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ夜間閉鎖無し。住宅地の隣。洋式1和式1水洗紙あり。車通り割とあり。電波問題無し。公園利用者以外の駐車場禁止張り紙あり。（投稿：2024年9月、s様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Toilets are not closed at night. Located next to a residential area. One Western-style toilet and one Japanese-style toilet with flush toilet paper. There is a fair amount of traffic. No cell phone reception issues. There is a sign prohibiting parking for non-park users. (Submitted by: s, September 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: いちのへ花の丘公園 駐車場
properties.title_en: Ichinohe Flower Hill Park Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：ﾄｲﾚ夜間閉鎖無し、洋式水洗清潔感良し。平らで電波も問題なし。隣にｺﾝﾋﾞﾆ、ｽ-ﾊﾟ-、ﾎ-ﾑｾﾝﾀ-があり街灯もあることから治安は良し。車通り多少あり。耳栓推奨。近くに病院があり緊急車両や夜に公園で遊ぶ輩が居ないかが懸念点。（投稿：2024年9月、s様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Toilets are not closed at night, and the Western-style flush toilets are clean. The area is flat and there are no problems with cell phone reception. There is a convenience store, supermarket, and home center next door, and there are streetlights, so the area is safe. There is some traffic. Earplugs are recommended. There is a hospital nearby, so concerns are about emergency vehicles and whether there are any people playing in the park at night. (Submitted by: s, September 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 無料駐車場（北緯40度ライン駐車場）
properties.title_en: Free parking (parking lot along the 40th parallel north latitude line)
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ夜間閉鎖無し、自動点灯で清潔感もあり。和式水洗紙あり。駐車場全体傾斜あり。8台分だけほぼ平らなのでそこに止めるべし。au電波2本まぁまぁ。車通りほぼ無し。道路隣なので耳栓推奨。（投稿：2024年9月、s様）
■無料駐車場、トイレあり、携帯○（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: Toilets are not closed at night, have automatic lighting and feel clean. Japanese-style toilets with flush toilet paper. The entire parking lot is sloped. Only 8 spaces are almost flat, so park there. au signal is decent (2 bars). Almost no traffic. Earplugs recommended as it's next to a road. (Submitted by: s, September 2024)
■Free parking, toilets available, cell phone reception OK (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: （トイレ無し）一戸公園駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ無し、全面砂利、平らなのは良い。国道沿いで騒音あり。狭い。わざわざ泊まるほどでは無い。（投稿：2024年9月、s様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: No toilet, all gravel, but it's flat which is good. It's noisy because it's along a national highway. It's small. Not worth staying overnight. (Submitted by: s, September 2024)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ閉鎖（建物はあるが運用を廃止）する旨の掲示がありましたので、マップから除外くださいますようお願いします。2025年3月確認（投稿：2025年4月、草の湯様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A notice was posted stating that the toilets would be closed (the building still exists, but operations have been discontinued), so please remove them from the map. Confirmed March 2025 (Posted by: Kusanoyu, April 2025)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 猪苗代（※コインシャワーは廃止）
properties.title_en: Roadside Station Inawashiro (※Coin showers have been discontinued)
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ入り口（複数個所）に「車中泊ご遠慮願う・・・」の張り紙あり。そのためか、日曜日泊の車中泊台数は5-6台程度。ただし、前日の土曜日泊は数10台の車中泊車両あり。もちろん、トイレ（ウォシュレット付き）の終夜利用は可能。また、車中泊しても何ら咎められることもなし。2025年8/2-4車中泊。（投稿：2025年8月、千葉県MO様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2019年9月19日福島県道の駅猪苗代に行きました。シャワーは「災害緊急用」とされ立ち入り禁止でした。近隣の温泉を利用下さいと2件紹介写真があり「レイクサイド磐光」へ行きました。片道車で8分ほど。600円→800円に値上がりしていました。1人貸し切り状態で、猪苗代湖を見ながらの露天風呂は良かったですが。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：7/15-7/16に利用しました。RVパーク 6台分のスペースの隣に停車しました。20時に駐車場の照明が消えました。割と静かでよかったです。難点としては季節的なものですが小さな虫が飛んできます。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■夜は交通量少なく比較的静かで大変良い。うるさいのはトラックのアイドリング音だけ。wimaxも利用可能で非常に良い。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■【RVパーク道の駅猪苗代】1泊　2000円／1台　電源込　詳細
■平成２８年11月オープン。奥の方は静かでよさそう。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: There were signs at the toilet entrances (multiple locations) saying "Please refrain from overnight parking..." Perhaps because of this, there were only about 5-6 cars parked overnight on Sunday. However, on the previous Saturday, there were dozens of cars parked overnight. Of course, the toilets (with bidet functions) were available for overnight use. Also, there was no reprimand for staying overnight in a car. Overnight stay in a car from August 2-4, 2025. (Submitted by MO from Chiba Prefecture, August 2025)

■Report from a reader of this site: On September 19, 2019, I went to the Inawashiro Roadside Station in Fukushima Prefecture. The showers were marked "for emergency use during disasters" and off-limits. There were photos of two nearby hot springs, and I went to "Lakeside Banko." It was about an 8-minute drive one way. The price had increased from 600 yen to 800 yen. I had the open-air bath all to myself, and it was nice to be able to see Lake Inawashiro. (Older posts from before 2019)
■Report from a reader of this site: Used on July 15-16. Parked next to a space for 6 RVs in the RV park. The parking lot lights were turned off at 8 PM. It was relatively quiet, which was nice. The only drawback is that, although it's seasonal, small insects fly around. (Older posts from before 2019)
■At night, there is little traffic and it is relatively quiet, which is very good. The only noise is the idling of trucks. WiMAX is also available, which is very good. (Older posts from before 2019)
■[RV Park Michi-no-Eki Inawashiro] 1 night 2000 yen/1 vehicle, power included, details
■Opened in November 2016. The back area seems quiet and nice.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: （※トイレ故障の可能性あり）仏ヶ浦展望台
properties.title_en: (※Toilet may be out of order) Hotokegaura Observatory
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ故障につき使用禁止でした。（修理日不明）国道沿いだが飛ばしにくい道なので走行音はそこまで。6時頃観光客が来て起こされた。耳栓すると良い。（投稿：2024年9月、s様）
■水洗トイレあり。又、仏が浦を望む展望台もある。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■若干傾斜あり。トイレは水洗洋式。携帯電波微妙。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: The toilet was out of order and unusable. (Repair date unknown) It's along a national highway, but it's not a road where you can speed, so the traffic noise isn't too bad. Tourists arrived around 6 AM and woke me up. It's a good idea to wear earplugs. (Submitted by: s, September 2024)
■There is a flush toilet. There is also an observation deck overlooking Hotokegaura. (Older post from before 2019)
■There is a slight slope. The toilet is a flush Western-style toilet. Cell phone reception is weak. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: The toilet is inside the building and is closed at night. Is it available from 9 AM? It's unclear what time it opens at night. There is one EV charging spot. There appear to be second and third parking spaces along the road. There is no traffic at all. I successfully slept soundly without earplugs. I had two bars of au signal, which is pretty good. In some places, it's nice in the shade of trees in the morning. (Submitted by: s, September 2024)

■Report from a reader of this site: Toilets available, good view from the observation deck, large parking lot, no commercial facilities. Last visually confirmed by the user: April 2022 (Posted by: Kusanoyu, May 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 夜の森つつみ公園トイレ／駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレは木造で新しく、閉鎖するためのドア等が無い構造なので、通年24h使用可。ウォッシュレット付き男・女・多目的ブースあり。駐車場は十数台、前後方向にやや傾斜あり。周辺には民家・商業施設は無し。夜の森駅まで600ｍ。富岡中心部（ショッピングモール等）まで約4km。R５.11.30に特定復興再生拠点区域（点・線拠点区域）を解除された所で、開花期には夜の森の花見が可能。2025年4月現地確認（投稿：2025年4月、草の湯様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: The toilets are made of wood, are new, and have no doors or other means to close them off, so they can be used 24 hours a day, year-round. There are separate men's, women's, and multi-purpose stalls with bidet toilets. There is parking for about a dozen cars, with a slight slope in the front and back directions. There are no private houses or commercial facilities in the surrounding area. It is 600m to Yonomori Station. It is about 4km to the center of Tomioka (shopping malls, etc.). The area was declassified as a specific reconstruction and revitalization base area (point/line base area) on November 30, 2023, so it is possible to enjoy cherry blossoms in Yonomori during the blooming season. Confirmed on site in April 2025 (Posted by: Kusanoyu, April 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 錦秋湖大滝 駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレは男女＋多目的の３室で各洗浄便座付き。夜間も利用可。近隣町内には温泉が何か所かあり（ほっと湯田は2.1km、詳細）。食品購入先は近くにはないが「スーパーオセン」4.5kmがオススメ。ダム湖畔のロケーションで、春は水没林、夏は大滝（貯砂ダム越流裏側通り抜け）とカキツバタ庭園、秋は錦秋と景色が良く散策に良い。隣接して野球場、300ｍに民家。GW期間だったが他に宿泊車は無く静か。TV全6局受信良好。ケイタイ（AU）も良。冬季の利用可否は不明。（2024.5現地利用）（投稿：2024年5月、草の湯様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: The toilets consist of three rooms: men's, women's, and a multi-purpose room, each equipped with a bidet. They are also available at night. There are several hot springs in the nearby town (Hot Yuda is 2.1km away, see details). There are no places to buy groceries nearby, but "Super Osen" is recommended at 4.5km away. The location on the shore of the dam lake offers beautiful scenery for walks: a submerged forest in spring, a large waterfall (accessible by passing behind the overflowing sediment dam) and an iris garden in summer, and vibrant autumn colors in fall. There is a baseball field next door and houses 300m away. It was during Golden Week, but there were no other overnight vehicles, so it was quiet. All 6 TV channels were received well. Cell phone reception (AU) was also good. Winter availability is unknown. (Used on site in May 2024) (Posted by: Kusanoyu, May 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: ふれあい公園野球広場 駐車場
properties.title_en: Fureai Park Baseball Field Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレは近くに無く、離れたところにある。（ここ）道路から離れており騒音気にならない。隣が野球場な事から土日は利用者が集まる可能性あり。奥程、砂が覆っている。耳栓無しで寝れた。（投稿：2024年9月、s様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There are no toilets nearby, they are located some distance away. (This place) is away from the road, so noise is not a problem. Since it is next to a baseball field, it may get crowded on weekends. The further back you go, the more it is covered in sand. I was able to sleep without earplugs. (Submitted by: s, September 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 硯上の里おがつ
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレはまだ新しいのでとてもキレイです。24時間使えるトイレが2箇所あります。GW中に車中泊させて頂きましたが自分達も含め4台しかいませんでした。（翌朝移動して近くの道の駅を見たときはは、ほぼ満車でした。） 穴場かもしれません😁 夜も静かでゆっくり休めました。ただし近くには、コンビニやスーパーは、無いので事前準備は、必要です。道の駅の中に　もんま商店さんがありますが、カップラーメンとかジュースや簡単な日用雑貨は、確認できました。メイン国道から離れているので、多少不便は、ありますが海がきれいで眺めも良くて良かったです。階段で船着き場に降りられるので夜釣りも出来るしかもしれません。因みに日中は釣人がいましたよ（投稿：2023年5月、ひーちゃん様）
■2021年4月11日グランドオープン。幹線国道から離れており静かで良さそう。期待の新人。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: The toilets are still new and very clean. There are two toilets that are open 24 hours. We stayed overnight in our car during Golden Week, and there were only four cars including ours. (When we moved the next morning and looked at a nearby roadside station, it was almost full.) It might be a hidden gem 😁 It was quiet at night and we were able to rest well. However, there are no convenience stores or supermarkets nearby, so you need to prepare in advance. There is a store called Monma Shoten inside the roadside station, and we were able to confirm that they have cup noodles, juice and simple daily necessities. It is a little inconvenient because it is away from the main national highway, but the sea is beautiful and the view is good, so it was worth it. You can go down to the boat landing by stairs, so you might be able to do night fishing. By the way, there were fishermen during the day (Posted by: Hii-chan, May 2023)
■Grand opening on April 11, 2021. It is away from the main national highway and seems quiet and nice. A promising newcomer.

properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Toilets: 1 with bidet, 1 Japanese-style toilet. Rest area closed. No Wi-Fi. I almost hit a squirrel 2km before the destination. It was the first time I'd ever seen a squirrel. I thought "oh no," but when I looked in the rearview mirror, I had turned back. There's a campsite on the mountain ahead for 500 yen per person. You can see the Kitakami Basin from a little way up from the campsite. (Submitted by: Migratory Bird Travelogue, May 2021)

■Report from a reader of this site: Because of its moderate altitude, it's quite comfortable unless it's the peak of summer. The adjacent national highway has been relegated to the old road due to the opening of the Shinkukai Tunnel, so nighttime traffic is sparse, allowing for a quiet night. The parking lot is generally sloped, which is a drawback, but a few spaces on the valley side are flat. (Submitted by: y, July 2023)
■Altitude: 740m

properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: This is a beautifully maintained park. It is free to use. There are multiple toilets, and they are kept very clean. The park was created by developing an area that was damaged by the tsunami. There are various sports facilities, and you can even surf. There is a nice bath nearby, "Watari Onsen Torinoumi," a natural hot spring by the sea. (Submitted by: Saitama Kotaro, February 2023)

properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: 900 yen, details. It's located in Matsushima, a famous tourist spot, but it's quiet because it's on a side street. There's also parking available. (Submitted by: A, June 2024)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：770円、詳細。湯Youパークにもなっているようで電話で予約すれば第２駐車場で車中泊させてもらえました(※無料だが湯Youパーク会員登録が必要)。チェックインチェックアウトの縛りはないようです。難点としては近場のトイレが徒歩4~5分くらいの反対車線にあるセブンイレブンしかないところ。4号線の近くなので多少の騒音はありますが許容範囲内かと。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: 770 yen, details. It seems to be a YuYou Park as well, and if you make a reservation by phone, you can park your car overnight in the second parking lot (※free, but YuYou Park membership registration is required). There seem to be no restrictions on check-in and check-out times. The downside is that the only nearby toilet is at a 7-Eleven on the opposite side of the road, about a 4-5 minute walk away. It is near Route 4, so there is some noise, but I think it is within an acceptable range.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：50台近く停めれる駐車場。道路沿いだが交通量も少ないため静か。街頭も明るい。駐車場もゲートなし。トイレは24時間使えました。新しい感じはしましたが掃除はあんまりしてなさそうです。その日はマフラーのうるさい車が3台ほど集まってきてうるさかった。200mほど南の位置に踏切があり、貨物列車や仙石線が通るので窓を開けてると気になるレベル。車中泊の車も結構いました。（投稿：2025年10月、a様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A parking lot that can accommodate nearly 50 cars. It's located along a road, but traffic is light, so it's quiet. The streetlights are bright. There is no gate to the parking lot. The toilets were available 24 hours a day. It looked new, but it didn't seem to be cleaned very often. On that day, about three cars with loud mufflers gathered there, making a lot of noise. There is a railroad crossing about 200m to the south, and freight trains and the Senseki Line pass by, so it's noticeable if you have your windows open. There were quite a few cars parked overnight. (Submitted by: A, October 2025)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: いわき市 南部清掃センター 想いの家
properties.title_en: Iwaki City Southern Cleaning Center, House of Thoughts""
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：50円！非温泉、詳細（投稿：2025年6月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: 50 yen! Non-hot spring, details (Submitted: June 2025, by a reader)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：500円、詳細。使い勝手のいい温泉です。特筆すべき点に駐車場内に安くて美味い焼き鳥屋「鳥すず」（テイクアウト専門）がある。地元の人たちは入浴前に注文している。（投稿：2022年9月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: 500 yen, details. This is a convenient hot spring. A notable feature is the cheap and delicious yakitori (grilled chicken skewer) shop "Torisuzu" (takeout only) located in the parking lot. Locals order before bathing. (Submitted by: m, September 2022)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：500円、詳細。町の銭湯のような温泉。駐車場あり。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website's readers: 500 yen, details. A hot spring like a local public bath. Parking available.

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 南相馬市健康福祉センター ゆらっと
properties.title_en: Minamisoma City Health and Welfare Center Yuratto
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：500円 閉館時間が早いので注意、詳細（投稿：2025年6月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: 500 yen. Note that the closing time is early. Details (Submitted: June 2025, by a reader)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：480円　6:00～1:00　受付内に食堂・休憩室あり。詳細（投稿：2025年2月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: 480 yen, 6:00 AM - 1:00 AM. Cafeteria and rest area available inside the reception area. Details (Posted by: n, February 2025)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: あったまりランド深堀
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：400円、詳細。サウナあり。サウナに入るには腰にバスタオルを巻くように、受付で１００円で貸出あり。源泉かけ流しで露天風呂で岩の間から流れでていくお湯を勿体無いと思うぐらい、一人ようの露天風呂、順番待ちの列ができる。ちょっとHなデザイン、女性用も同じかしらん。（投稿：2021年5月、渡り鳥漫遊記様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: 400 yen, details. Sauna available. To enter the sauna, you need to wrap a bath towel around your waist, which can be rented at the reception for 100 yen. The open-air bath uses free-flowing hot spring water, and the water flows out from between the rocks, making it a shame to waste it. There is a line of people waiting for their turn in the single-person open-air bath. The design is a little suggestive, I wonder if the women's bath is the same. (Submitted by: Migratory Bird Travelogue, May 2021)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 鶴岡市 湯野浜下区公衆浴場
properties.title_en: Public bathhouse in Yunohama-shimo district, Tsuruoka City""
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：290円、詳細、駐車場がわかりにくい、信用金庫の裏。温泉もロータリーに面した建物の付属みたいな感じ。源泉かけ流しを楽しんでいたら、全身真っ赤、水道でうめてよいので無理しないで。（投稿：2021年5月、渡り鳥漫遊記様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: 290 yen, details, parking is hard to find, behind the credit union. The hot spring feels like an annex to the building facing the rotary. I was enjoying the free-flowing hot spring water when my whole body turned bright red, so don't push yourself too hard, you can dilute it with tap water. (Submitted by: Migratory Bird Travelogue, May 2021)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 仙台市太白区 三神峯公園駐車場
properties.title_en: Mikami Park Parking Lot, Taihaku Ward, Sendai City""
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：24時間のトイレ有ります。車で直ぐの所にやまびこの湯と言うお風呂も有ります。スーパーも有ります。治安の方は少し微妙かな？何回か車中泊で利用したことは有ります。（投稿：2021年8月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There are 24-hour toilets. There is also a hot spring called Yamabiko-no-Yu just a short drive away. There is also a supermarket. The safety is a bit questionable, though. I have used it for overnight stays in my car a few times. (Submitted by: m, August 2021)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: 遠野 車中泊スポット
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：２４時間トイレあり。お酒を飲む場合ラーメン屋に相談する。朝５時以降まで駐車する場合ＯＫ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website readers: 24-hour restrooms available. Consult with the ramen shop if you plan to drink alcohol. Parking is OK until after 5 AM.

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 いなかだて
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2025/2/17～18に利用しました。冬期も閉鎖されません。大雪の日でしたが未明に除雪車が入ったおかげで、朝は問題なく出発できました。（投稿：2025年2月、tossan様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：弘前さくらまつりの時期は道の駅ひろさきが混雑するので道の駅いなかだてを利用した。普通車の駐車スペースが約１８０台分で十分余裕があった。買い物はベニーマート黒石店（2.3km）、温泉は田舎館村役場の近くにある老人憩いの家（2.8km、１５０円）を利用した。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■幹線道路沿いでうるさい。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: Used on February 17-18, 2025. It's not closed during winter. It was a day of heavy snow, but thanks to snowplows clearing the road in the early morning, we were able to depart without any problems. (Posted by tossan, February 2025)

■ Reader Report: During the Hirosaki Cherry Blossom Festival, the Hirosaki Roadside Station gets crowded, so I used the Inakadate Roadside Station instead. There was ample parking space for about 180 regular cars. For shopping, I used Benny Mart Kuroishi (2.3km), and for hot springs, I used the Senior Citizens' Rest House near the Inakadate Village Office (2.8km, 150 yen). (Older post from before 2019)

■ It's noisy because it's along a main road. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 かみこあに
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2025-9-7 現地確認　道の駅そのものはごく普通です。その奥にある生涯学習センターが、トラックも入らず静かで過ごしやすいです。また、隣接するふるさと公園には四阿が二つ、水栓もあるので便利に使えそうです。五城目方向350mにローソンがあります。風呂は近隣にありません。（投稿：2025年9月、tossan様）
■幹線道沿いだが広大な駐車場で、奥の方は静かで大変良い（航空写真で見ると分かりやすい👉️詳細）。東側の奥の方（詳細）も静か。車中泊スポットとして非常に良い。（2022年6月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: September 7, 2025 (On-site verification) The roadside station itself is quite ordinary. The lifelong learning center located behind it is quiet and pleasant, with no trucks entering. Also, the adjacent Furusato Park has two gazebos and a water tap, making it convenient to use. There is a Lawson convenience store 350m towards Gojome. There are no baths nearby. (Submitted by tossan, September 2025)

■Although it is located along a main road, it has a vast parking lot, and the back area is quiet and very nice (easier to see in the aerial photo 👉️ details). The far eastern side (details) is also quiet. It is an excellent spot for overnight stays in a car. (On-site verification by administrator, June 2022)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2024年9月7日時点で、国道からの入り口付近に「閉鎖中」の掲示がありました。（投稿：2024年9月、草の湯様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: As of September 7, 2024, there was a "Closed" sign near the entrance from the national highway. (Submitted by: Kusanoyu, September 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 ふくしま東和
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2023/10月泊。裏手に大きな駐車場があります。ただ、施設（トイレ）の近くは大型ファンの音が大きかったので、施設の前に止めましたが、交通量は多くないので、明け方以外は静かでよく寝れました。トイレは新しくてきれい。コンビニ徒歩圏内。温泉は車で15分の名目津温泉。（投稿：2023年10月、h様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Stayed in October 2023. There is a large parking lot behind the building. However, the noise from the large fans near the facilities (toilets) was loud, so I parked in front of the facilities. There wasn't much traffic, so it was quiet except in the early morning and I slept well. The toilets are new and clean. There is a convenience store within walking distance. The nearest hot spring is Myōmezu Onsen, a 15-minute drive away. (Submitted by: h, October 2023)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2023/10月泊。福島空港の隣の道の駅。駐車場はさほど大きくないので、大型車のアイドリングが聞こえていましたが、1台のみで、それも夜中には止まり、よく寝れました。また、飛行機の発着陸の音は一度もききませんでした。食堂兼用の休憩室は営業終了後も使用できました。コンビニは車で5分、温泉は車で15分のあゆり温泉。トイレは新しくきれいでした。ここの男子小トイレは水も電気も使用せず、微生物で分解するという変わったトイレでした。（投稿：2023年10月、h様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Stayed in October 2023. A roadside station next to Fukushima Airport. The parking lot is not very big, so I could hear the idling of a large vehicle, but there was only one, and even that stopped in the middle of the night, so I was able to sleep well. Also, I never heard the sound of airplanes taking off or landing. The rest area, which also serves as a dining room, was available even after closing time. There is a convenience store a 5 minute drive away, and Ayuri Onsen is a 15 minute drive away. The toilets were new and clean. The men's urinal here was an unusual toilet that did not use water or electricity, but decomposed by microorganisms. (Submitted by: h, October 2023)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2023/10月泊。施設の反対側にできた新しいトイレは夜間・冬季閉鎖中と書かれ使用できず、古いトイレは古いのでかなりにおいました。夜は走り屋がトイレ休憩で何度か立ち寄り、その時だけは爆音がしていましたが、それ以外は静かでした。コンビニ・温泉は車で10分の岳温泉。（投稿：2023年10月、h様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場が狭いのでマークしていなかったが、道路看板を見てちょっと寄っていこうかと。驚いたことに、トイレが駐車場の両端にありウォッシュレット。先人のレポートに傾斜があるとこれを見て初めて傾斜に気づく。幹線道路と言っても、山の中、一晩でも数えるくらいの数、大部分は道の駅の手前でまがる。（投稿：2021年5月、渡り鳥漫遊記様）
■福島市から会津若松への幹線道沿いにあり、意外と交通量が多い。山の中なのに大型トラックもバンバン走っている。爆音の走り屋（笑）も来る。さらに駐車場が全体的に傾斜している。あまりおすすめという感じはない。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Stayed in October 2023. The new toilets on the opposite side of the facility were closed at night and during winter, and the old toilets were quite smelly. At night, street racers stopped by several times for toilet breaks, and there was a loud noise only then, but otherwise it was quiet. There is a convenience store and hot springs in Gake Onsen, a 10-minute drive away. (Submitted by: h, October 2023)

■Report from a reader of this site: I hadn't marked this place because the parking lot is small, but I thought I'd stop by after seeing the road sign. To my surprise, there were toilets on both ends of the parking lot with bidet functions. I only noticed the slope after seeing this, as mentioned in previous reports. Even though it's a main road, it's in the mountains, and there are only a few cars in one night; most turn before reaching the roadside station. (Submitted by: Wataridori Manyuki, May 2021)

■Located along the main road from Fukushima City to Aizuwakamatsu, it has surprisingly heavy traffic. Even though it's in the mountains, large trucks are constantly driving by. Street racers with loud engines (lol) also come here. Furthermore, the parking lot is sloped overall. I wouldn't really recommend it. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 震災遺構 仙台市荒浜地区 住宅基礎 観光バス駐車場
properties.title_en: Earthquake-related remains: Residential foundations and tourist bus parking lot in Arahama district, Sendai City.""
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2022年GWに利用しました。無料駐車場が綺麗に整備されています。震災遺構として、津波で流されてしまった住宅の基礎がそのまま残され、それを見学するための駐車場で、慰霊碑もあります。整備されたばかりなのか、夜間はほとんど車がなく穴場です。駐車場すぐそばのトイレは24時間LEDがついており、とても綺麗です。車中泊は不謹慎かな、とも思いましたが海岸沿いでBBQをする方(たぶん地元民)もいましたし、車中泊目的と思われる車も自車以外に2台とまっていました。（投稿：2022年7月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: I used this place during Golden Week in 2022. The free parking lot is beautifully maintained. As a disaster memorial, the foundations of houses that were swept away by the tsunami remain, and the parking lot is for viewing them. There is also a memorial monument. It seems to have been recently renovated, as there are hardly any cars at night, making it a hidden gem. The toilets right next to the parking lot have LED lights on 24 hours a day and are very clean. I wondered if it was inappropriate to park overnight in my car, but there were people (probably locals) having BBQs along the coast, and there were two other cars parked there that seemed to be there for overnight stays. (Submitted by: M, July 2022)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 いいたて村の道の駅 までい館
properties.title_en: Roadside Station Iitate Village Roadside Station Madeikan
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2020年10月に車中泊しました。夜中に警察による職務質問を受けた。約30分もあれこれ聞かれた。恐らく周辺で空き巣等の犯罪が多いのでしょう。逆に警察のパトロールで安心感はあるが、夜中に起こされるのはちょっとな〜！車中泊は遠慮することをおすすめします。（投稿：2021年4月、T様）
■2017年8月12日オープン。あの飯舘村です。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: I stayed overnight in my car in October 2020. I was stopped and questioned by the police in the middle of the night. They asked me all sorts of questions for about 30 minutes. There are probably a lot of burglaries and other crimes in the area. On the one hand, the police patrols give me a sense of security, but being woken up in the middle of the night is a bit much! I recommend refraining from staying overnight in your car. (Submitted by Mr. T, April 2021)
■Opened on August 12, 2017. It's in Iitate Village.

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2019年9月利用。松島観光の後、夢実の国で温泉に浸かってからここで車中泊。幹線沿いの割には静かでした。隣がコンビニです。EV用の急速充電器があります。 駐車場内で車の横にテーブルを出して食事をしている不届き者の家族がいました。こういうマナー違反者がいると、車中泊禁止になる場所が増えてしまいます。絶対にやめよう！ それから、朝6時にスピーカーから大音量で音楽が鳴りました！最悪！（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：施設は道の駅なので問題ないのですが、集まる人間のマナーが悪い。醜いものを見聞きするでしょうから安心して眠りにつきたい人はパスすべきでしょう。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Used in September 2019. After sightseeing in Matsushima, I soaked in the hot springs at Yumemi no Kuni and then stayed overnight in my car here. It was quiet despite being along a main road. There's a convenience store next door. There's a fast charger for EVs. There was a family with no manners who had set up a table next to their car in the parking lot and were eating. If there are people like this who violate manners, more and more places will have to ban overnight parking. Absolutely do not do that! Also, loud music was playing from the speakers at 6 AM! Terrible! (Older post from before 2019)

■Report from a reader of this site: The facility itself is a roadside station, so there's no problem there, but the manners of the people who gather there are bad. You'll see and hear ugly things, so people who want to sleep peacefully should pass this place up. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2019年9月に道の駅＋震災復興祈念公園としてリニューアルオープン！広大な駐車場＆豪華なトイレで快適でした。万が一の地震＆津波に備えて、避難経路だけは確認しておきましょう。併設の震災津波伝承館（入館無料）は、同類の施設としては国内トップレベルで一見の価値あり。（投稿：2020年11月、Y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Reopened in September 2019 as a roadside station + earthquake recovery memorial park! The spacious parking lot and luxurious restrooms made for a comfortable experience. In case of an earthquake and tsunami, be sure to check the evacuation routes. The adjacent Earthquake and Tsunami Memorial Museum (free admission) is one of the best facilities of its kind in Japan and well worth a visit. (Submitted by: Y, November 2020)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2019年7月オープン。良くも悪くも市街地の中にある道の駅。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Opened in July 2019. A roadside station located in the middle of the city, for better or for worse. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 あに マタギの里
properties.title_en: Roadside Station Ani Matagi no Sato
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2019年10月利用。翌朝一番に「安の滝」に行くため、ここで前泊。幹線道路沿いですが意外に静か。でも地デジが受信できません・・・。EV用の急速充電器があります。最寄りのコンビニまでは20km以上あるようです。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■隣接の幹線道路は高速道路状態で、皆めちゃくちゃなスピードで走っておりうるさい。大型トラックが走るとものすごいごう音が響く。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■トラックが普通車エリアにも停めに来る。延々とアイドリングがうるさい。あまりおすすめできない。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Used in October 2019. Stayed here the night before going to "Annotaki" first thing the next morning. It's surprisingly quiet despite being along a main road. However, digital terrestrial television reception is unavailable... There is a fast charger for EVs. The nearest convenience store seems to be over 20km away. (Older post from before 2019)

■The adjacent main road is like a highway, with everyone driving at incredibly high speeds, making it very noisy. Large trucks make an extremely loud roar. (Older post from before 2019)

■Trucks also park in the regular car area. The idling is endlessly loud. Not highly recommended. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station

■当サイト読者様レポート：1980年代から利用していますが、自家発電であることと過酷な環境のためか、トイレ棟が夜間閉鎖され使えない年が時々あります。2024年5月5日時点でも使えないため、来訪者は朝９時のレストハウス開店まで待つ必要がありました。ロケーションは最高ですが事前にトイレ夜間利用可否を確認する必要があります（※八幡平山頂レストハウス）。なお春・秋の路面凍結の可能性がある期間はゲート両端が夜間閉鎖され、翌日も悪天候時には引き続き閉鎖されて出られなくなる可能性がありますので注意が必要です。（投稿：2024年5月、草の湯様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：本日、八幡平見返り峠駐車場に宿泊しております。ドコモですが電波入るようになったようです。ここは第１駐車場は有料になり、岩手県側に少し下った第２駐車場は無料です。もちろん私は第２駐車場です。※追伸：第１駐車場も8:30-17:00以外は無料開放でした。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■標高1543m！夏は最高ですね。無料、トイレあり。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: I've been using this place since the 1980s, but perhaps because it relies on its own power generation and is in a harsh environment, there are times when the toilet building is closed at night and unusable. As of May 5, 2024, it was still unusable, so visitors had to wait until the rest house opened at 9 AM. The location is superb, but you need to check in advance whether the toilets are available at night (※Hachimantai Summit Rest House). Also, during the spring and autumn when there is a possibility of road freezing, both ends of the gate are closed at night, and if the weather is bad the next day, they may remain closed, making it impossible to leave, so please be careful. (Posted: May 2024, Kusanoyu)

■Report from a reader of this site: I am staying at the Hachimantai Mikaeri Pass parking lot today. I have Docomo, and it seems that the signal has returned. The first parking lot here is now paid, while the second parking lot, a little further down on the Iwate Prefecture side, is free. Of course, I am in the second parking lot. ※Postscript: The first parking lot was also open for free except from 8:30-17:00. (Older post from before 2019)
■ Elevation 1543m! It's great in the summer. Free admission, toilets available. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_ja:

■390円の銭湯だが、泉質が凄まじい。１００％源泉掛け流し。車中泊マニアが絶賛。
■管理人も入ってきましたが、ここは本当に凄いです。湯が乳緑白色。まずこの色がめちゃくちゃ珍しい。全国的にもほとんど無いです。緑系はだいたい透明な緑が多いのですが、乳白色に濁った緑の湯というのはほんとに超激レアです。たしか塩原温泉の大出館にもうぐいす色の湯があったくらいでそれくらいだと思います。さらに湯は強烈な酸性泉で、草津的な湯です。それでいて、トゲトゲしい感じではなく、意外と肌に馴染む柔らかい感じで大変良い。湧出温度は46℃という最適な温度で出ており、それをそのまんま湯船にドバドバにかけ流しています。めちゃくちゃ凄いです。露天風呂がなく、眺望がないのでアレなんですが、泉質だけなら全国トップクラスですね。浴場の一番奥で窓を開けて、湯船からドバドバ湯が流れているとこに寝転がると非常に気持ちがいいです。非常に素晴らしい温泉です。簡易的な休憩所もあります。なお、鍵がかかるロッカーは無いので、貴重品はジップロックとかにいれて持って入りましょう（コンビニ袋だと密封できないので風呂の酸性の蒸気でやられる可能性あります。スマホは非防水だとこの蒸気が内部浸入するとたぶん基板が腐食します）。
properties.desc_en:
■Currently closed for an extended period. Reopening date unknown. Details
■A 390 yen public bath, but the quality of the spring water is incredible. 100% natural hot spring water flowing directly from the source. Highly praised by car camping enthusiasts.

■I, the administrator, also went in, and this place is truly amazing. The water is milky greenish-white. First of all, this color is extremely rare. There are hardly any like it anywhere in the country. Most green waters are transparent, but milky white, cloudy green water is truly super rare. I think there was a similar greenish-brown water at Oidekan in Shiobara Onsen, but that's about it. Furthermore, the water is a strongly acidic spring, similar to Kusatsu Onsen. Yet, it doesn't feel harsh, but surprisingly soft and gentle on the skin, which is very nice. The spring water comes out at the optimal temperature of 46℃, and it flows directly into the bath. It's incredibly amazing. There's no open-air bath and no view, but in terms of spring water quality alone, it's top class in the country. It feels incredibly good to lie down in the furthest corner of the bathhouse with the window open, where the hot water is gushing out of the tub. It's a truly wonderful hot spring. There's also a simple rest area. However, there are no lockers that can be locked, so be sure to bring your valuables in a Ziploc bag or something similar (a convenience store bag won't seal properly and could be damaged by the acidic steam in the bath. If your smartphone isn't waterproof, the steam getting inside will probably corrode the circuit board).

properties.desc_en:
■Parking is available for regular cars and kei cars for 400 yen. You can't see the townscape of the post town at all unless you park your car and walk (lol). It shows a strong determination not to let anyone who doesn't pay see anything. There's a public toilet in the parking lot that's open at night, so it might be possible to stay overnight in your car. When I arrived early in the morning, there was a camper van parked there that looked like someone was staying overnight.

■Ouchi-juku is the name of a post town in Ouchi, Shimogo-machi, Minamiaizu-gun, Fukushima Prefecture, that was a "half-farming, half-inn" post town on the Aizu-Nishi Kaido during the Edo period. Although it lost its status as a post town with the opening of the railway in the Meiji era, the name is still used today as a common name for the settlement, where thatched-roof houses line the road, or as a tourist destination.

properties.desc_ja:
■駐車場は8-18時の間、有料一回500円。夜は管理員もいなくなり、出入り口は封鎖はされないので、20-翌朝7時ごろまでは無料で車中泊が可能。トイレは道路渡って向かいに公衆トイレ（キレイな水洗洋式ウォシュレット！）がある。奥の方に停めれば静かで良い。他の方のレポートで夜間閉鎖との情報があったが、2022年9月に来た時は特に閉鎖されていなかった。桜や紅葉のシーズン中は厳格な管理がされるのかもしれない。（2022年9月管理人現地確認）
■当サイト読者様レポート：「角館桜並木駐車場」について、本日（２０２２．４．２２）に確認した内容です。今年は場内車中泊禁止。２１時から翌８時までは閉鎖、とのことです。１７時少し前に入ってみましたが、普通車も相当数駐車していました。追記：角館周辺の状況について、翌朝（4/23）までに追加で確認した状況をお知らせします。前回報告通り夜間は閉鎖のようです。翌朝5：20頃に確認したところ、出入り口にロープが張られていました。場内にはキャンカーが1台だけありました。（投稿：2022年4月、草の湯様）
■一回500円。公衆トイレあり。桜まつり期間中（4/20〜ゴールデンウィーク終わるまで）の7時〜17時はバス専用になり一般車は使えないので注意。17時〜翌朝7時は普通車も駐車可能となり、駐車代の500円で夜桜を見た後にそのまま車中泊も可能。綺麗なトイレもすぐ近くにある。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■The parking lot is open from 8am to 6pm and costs 500 yen per entry. At night, there are no attendants, and the entrances and exits are not blocked, so overnight parking is free from 8pm until around 7am the next morning. There is a public toilet across the road (clean flush toilets with bidet functions!). Parking further back is quiet and nice. Other reports mentioned nighttime closures, but when I visited in September 2022, it wasn't closed. Strict management may be in place during cherry blossom and autumn foliage seasons. (Confirmed by the attendant in September 2022)

■Regarding the "Kakunodate Cherry Blossom Avenue Parking Lot" report from our site's readers, this is what we confirmed today (April 22, 2022). Overnight parking is prohibited this year. It is closed from 9pm to 8am the next day. I entered a little before 5pm, and there were a considerable number of regular cars parked there. Addendum: We will inform you of the situation around Kakunodate, based on additional information confirmed by the following morning (April 23). As previously reported, it appears to be closed at night. Upon checking around 5:20 AM the following morning, ropes had been strung across the entrance. There was only one camper van inside. (Posted by: Kusanoyu, April 2022)

■ 500 yen per visit. Public toilets available. During the cherry blossom festival (April 20th to the end of Golden Week), from 7 AM to 5 PM, it becomes bus-only and not accessible to private vehicles, so please be aware. From 5 PM to 7 AM the following morning, regular cars can also park, and for a parking fee of 500 yen, you can view the cherry blossoms at night and then stay overnight in your car. There are also clean toilets nearby. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_ja: ■大曲花火大会の時はここが無料駐車場になる。仮設トイレも設置され、車中泊も可能。車中泊いっぱい。花火大会の前日夜にここで車中泊し、そのままここに車を置いておく。投光機の近くは発電機の音が一晩中うるさいので、投光機（発電機）から離れたところが良い。花火大会当日は、早朝にここを出て徒歩で場所取りに行く。管理人おすすめの穴場観覧場所はここ。　場所を取ったあとは駐車場で晩まで休んでおけばいい。花火が終わったあとはここでそのまま車中泊して翌朝出ればいい。なお、ここから花火観覧場所まで徒歩35分くらいかかるので、可能なら折りたたみ自転車があると便利。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■This area becomes a free parking lot during the Omagari Fireworks Festival. Temporary toilets are set up, and overnight parking is possible. There's plenty of space for overnight parking. The night before the fireworks festival, you can park your car here overnight and leave it there. The generators near the floodlights are noisy all night, so it's best to park away from them. On the day of the fireworks festival, leave here early in the morning and walk to secure a spot. This is the administrator's recommended hidden viewing spot. Once you've secured a spot, you can rest in the parking lot until evening. After the fireworks are over, you can stay here overnight in your car and leave the next morning. Note that it takes about 35 minutes to walk from here to the fireworks viewing area, so a folding bicycle would be convenient if possible. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_ja:

■管理人評価★4.9（泉質4.5、景色0.4）多数の温泉マニアが大絶賛する名湯。これバスクリンじゃないの？というような嘘のようなライムグリーン。これが天然色だから凄い。景色は絶景というほとでもないので0.4といたしました。泉質は当然ながら満点。
properties.desc_en:
■Highly praised by many hot spring enthusiasts. A truly exceptional hot spring. A beautiful green hot spring. The spring water is a sulfur-containing sodium bicarbonate spring. Day trip bathing: 700 yen. Details:
■Manager's rating: ★4.9 (Spring water quality 4.5, Scenery 0.4) A famous hot spring highly praised by many hot spring enthusiasts. Is this bath salts? It's an unbelievable lime green. It's amazing that this is a natural color. The scenery isn't spectacular, so I gave it a 0.4. The spring water quality is, of course, perfect.

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: ぴょんぴょん舎 稲荷町本店
properties.desc_ja: ■盛岡冷麺の超人気店。管理人は冷麺＋岩手短角牛のセット税込み2052円をいただきましたが、物凄く美味しかったです。冷麺もお肉もめちゃくちゃ美味い。これで2000円は安いと感じるレベル。焼き肉の火も、ガスではなく炭を手間を掛けてわざわざセットしてくれます。手抜きが一切ない。これはリピートしてしまうわと思いました。かなりおすすめ。焼肉屋のランチとしてここまで満足度高いのは初めて。なお、超人気店で、土日は開店前から大量の客が押し寄せます。開店30分前には店の駐車場に入って、お店に入って順番待ちの名前を言っておくとよいです。次も盛岡に来たら必ず再訪したいと思います。思い出すだけでよだれが出てくる。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■ An extremely popular restaurant specializing in Morioka cold noodles. I ordered the cold noodles + Iwate short-horned beef set for 2052 yen (tax included), and it was incredibly delicious. Both the cold noodles and the meat were incredibly tasty. At 2000 yen, it felt like a bargain. They even go to the trouble of setting up charcoal for the yakiniku (grilled meat) instead of gas. There's absolutely no cutting corners. I thought to myself, "I'll definitely be coming back." Highly recommended. This is the first time I've been so satisfied with a yakiniku lunch. Note that it's an extremely popular restaurant, and on weekends, a huge number of customers arrive even before it opens. It's best to arrive at the restaurant's parking lot 30 minutes before opening and give your name to wait in line inside the restaurant. I will definitely visit again the next time I come to Morioka. Just thinking about it makes my mouth water. Tabelog

properties.desc_ja: ■盛岡名物じゃじゃ麺の元祖、白龍（パイロン）。カワトクという盛岡土着のデパートの地下一階に支店が入っている。本店の周りは駐車場が高いのでこっちがおすすめ。席数も多く回転が早い。カワトクの駐車場は30分100円。デパートで合計2000円以上の買い物をすると1時間無料になる。詳しくは検索。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■ Pailong, the originator of Morioka's famous Jajamen noodles. They have a branch in the basement of Kawatoku, a local Morioka department store. Parking is expensive around the main store, so this branch is recommended. It has plenty of seating and a quick turnover. Kawatoku's parking is 100 yen for 30 minutes. If you spend over 2000 yen at the department store, you get one hour of free parking. Search for more details. (See Tabelog)

■水くみ場所完備。この湧き水は、霊験あらたかな水として、人々に大切にされ、1杯飲めば10年若返り、2杯飲めば20年若返り、3杯飲めば死ぬまで若返ると言い伝えられるようになった。また一方で、この場所は俗界と霊界の境目であるともいわれ、人間のみならず、恐山へ集まってくる霊も飲みにやってくるのだと言い伝えられている。

properties.desc_en:
■Water drawing area available. This spring water is cherished by people as miraculous water, and it is said that drinking one cup will make you 10 years younger, two cups 20 years younger, and three cups will make you young until you die. On the other hand, this place is also said to be the boundary between the mortal world and the spirit world, and it is said that not only humans but also spirits that gather at Mount Osore come to drink from it.

■Although water quality tests are apparently conducted, there are no papers with the test results posted at the site. Drinking raw water is at your own risk. Details

properties.desc_ja: ■親子丼が絶品。これはマジでうまい。このあと道の駅ひないでも親子丼を食べたが、こちらの「秋田比内や 大館本店」の方が美味いと思った。おすすめ。駐車場は隣の太平楽というビルの駐車場が１時間無料となる（めちゃくちゃギリギリ＆狭い駐車場なので軽以外はやめといたほうがいいかも）。食べログ

I also ate oyakodon at the Hinai roadside station afterwards, but I thought the one at "Akita Hinaiya Odate Main Store" was tastier. Highly recommended. properties.desc_en: ■This rest area is near the end of the Joban Expressway, so it's not crowded. Traffic is light, making it quiet and comfortable. I believe this is the rest area where the Tokyo Fire Department and Self-Defense Forces gathered before deploying to spray water during the nuclear accident. ■入浴♨️：「女川温泉 ゆぽっぽ」併設：500円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：宮城県、道の駅「おながわ」について。2023年11月初旬に車中泊してきました。道の駅駐車場以外に、周辺には無料町営Ｐが多数ありますが、24hトイレに最も近いのは赤丸で囲った駐車場（添付画像）です。街中ですが夜間の交通量は少なくとても静か。徒歩圏内に温泉施設、コンビニ、居酒屋あり。近くの居酒屋で食べた、蒸しホヤが最高に美味しかった。ここいいと思います。（投稿：2023年11月、d様）
■2021年4月3日オープン。女川駅前の広大なエリアが丸ごと道の駅化する模様。

■Report from our site's reader: About the roadside station "Onagawa" in Miyagi Prefecture. I stayed overnight in my car in early November 2023. In addition to the roadside station parking lot, there are many free town-operated parking lots in the surrounding area, but the closest to the 24-hour toilet is the parking lot circled in red (attached image). It's in the middle of town, but the traffic volume at night is low and it's very quiet. There are hot spring facilities, convenience stores, and izakayas within walking distance. The steamed sea squirts I ate at a nearby izakaya were incredibly delicious. I think this is a good place. (Posted: November 2023, by d)
■Opened April 3, 2021. It seems that the entire vast area in front of Onagawa Station will be turned into a roadside station.

■入浴♨️：《なの花温泉 田田（でんでん）》 500円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：2019年10月利用。車中泊の車が非常に多い。EV用の急速充電器があります。「大量投棄などマナー違反者が多いため、可燃ゴミ用のゴミ箱は廃止しました」との掲示あり。車中泊禁止の道の駅が増えてしまわないよう、迷惑行為は絶対にやめましょう。近隣の「なの花温泉田田」へは徒歩数分です。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■ここは良い！駐車場があちこちにあり、スーパーの裏の方は夜は非常に静か。車中泊者非常に多く治安も良い。併設のスーパー、コインランドリーも便利。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：車中泊者多く安心。キャブコンやけん引トレーラー型、バスコン多い。夜になると次々に車中泊車が増える。併設スーパー建物右側にラーメン屋有り。更に建物右側にコインランドリー有り。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■幹線国道からある程度距離があり、音はそこまで気にならない。奥の方は静か。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：施設敷地内に夜９時まで営業のスーパーあり。便利でした。お風呂（なの花温泉 田田）とは５分程度離れています。（2019年以前の古い投稿）

■Report from our site's reader: Used in October 2019. There are many cars parked overnight. There is a fast charger for EVs. There is a sign that says, "Due to many people violating manners such as large-scale dumping, the trash cans for combustible waste have been abolished." Let's absolutely refrain from disruptive behavior so that the number of roadside stations prohibiting car camping increases. It is a few minutes' walk to the nearby "Nanohana Onsen Denden". (Older post from before 2019)
■This place is good! There are parking lots all over the place, and the area behind the supermarket is very quiet at night. There are many people parked overnight and the area is safe. The attached supermarket and coin laundry are also convenient. (Older posts from before 2019)
■Report from our site's reader: Many people stay overnight in their vehicles, making it a safe place. There are many campervans, trailer-type vehicles, and bus conversions. More and more vehicles arrive overnight as night falls. There is a ramen shop to the right of the adjacent supermarket building. There is also a coin laundry further to the right of the building. (Older posts from before 2019)
■It is a reasonable distance from the main national highway, so the noise is not too bothersome. The back area is quiet. (Older posts from before 2019)
■Report from our site's reader: There is a supermarket on the premises that is open until 9 pm. It was convenient. It is about a 5 minute walk from the bathhouse (Nanohana Onsen Tada). (Older posts from before 2019)

■車中泊評価【Sランク🤩】86点👉️採点詳細と詳細案内図はこちら。（2024年9月）
■入浴♨️：しらかみの湯：350円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：（2023/5/31車中泊）過去にも車中泊をした 道の駅津軽白神 ビーチにしめや の同一敷地内の　やすらぎの駐車場　です（詳細場所）。道の駅の駐車場より少し高くなった場所で山小屋風のトイレもあります。道の駅の駐車場よりこじんまりしています。トイレはとても小さいですがとても綺麗で洗浄機能つきでした。気になる方は道の駅のインフォメーションセンター奥にあるトイレも良いと思います。お風呂は道路を挟んだ向かい側にある　しらかみの湯　（詳細）350円で入浴できます。（投稿：2023年6月、読者様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：9月13日現在の情報をご連絡いたします。道の駅津軽白神は、昨年7月に24時間開放のインフォメーションセンターとトイレがリニューアルされて、とても清潔で綺麗です。また、道路側にも従来のトイレが24時間開放されています。とても静かで、熟睡出来る環境です。特A（王冠）の価値はあると思われます。（投稿：2020年9月、Y様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：道の駅と同等な車中泊のスポットです。さわやかトイレあり。コンビニは車で5分程度の所にあり。 幹線道路沿いだが、交通量はさほど無いので大丈夫です。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■2017年11月11日オープン。
properties.desc_en:
■Car Camping Rating [S Rank 🤩] 86 points 👉️ Click here for detailed scoring and detailed map. (September 2024)
■Bathing ♨️: Shirakami no Yu: 350 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: (Car camping, May 31, 2023) This is the Yasuragi Parking Lot, located on the same premises as Michi-no-Eki Tsugaru Shirakami Beach Nishimeya, where I have car camped in the past (detailed location). It is located slightly higher than the Michi-no-Eki parking lot and has a mountain lodge-style toilet. It is smaller than the Michi-no-Eki parking lot. The toilet is very small but very clean and has a bidet function. If you are concerned, the toilet at the back of the Michi-no-Eki information center is also a good option. For bathing, you can bathe at Shirakami no Yu (details) across the road for 350 yen. (Posted: June 2023, reader)
■Report from our site's reader: We will inform you of the information as of September 13th. Michi-no-Eki Tsugaru Shirakami (Roadside Station Tsugaru Shirakami) had its 24-hour information center and restrooms renovated last July, and they are very clean and well-maintained. The existing restrooms on the roadside are also open 24 hours a day. It's very quiet and provides an environment conducive to a good night's sleep. It deserves its A-grade rating. (Posted by Mr. Y, September 2020)
■Report from a reader of this site: A great spot for overnight stays in your car, comparable to a roadside station. Refreshing restrooms available. A convenience store is about a 5-minute drive away. Although it's along a main road, the traffic isn't too heavy, so it's fine. (Older post from before 2019)
■Opened November 11, 2017.

properties.desc_ja:
