■入浴♨️：《鹿角市大湯温泉保養センター 湯都里》450円、詳細
■入浴♨️：《ホテル鹿角 日帰り入浴》1,000円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：建物はとても綺麗です。トイレもとても綺麗です。しかし、雨上がりで湿度が高かったのか虫がすごかったです。車に乗り込むときに大量のハエが車内に入り込み、外に逃がすこともできませんでした(別の新しいハエが入り込むので)。仕方なく近くのコンビニへいきましたが、田舎で殺虫剤がありませんでした。遠くの別のコンビニまで大量のハエとドライブ。虫嫌いにとってはまさに地獄絵図。もう二度といくことはないでしょう。今考えるとあの町の雰囲気も閉鎖的で怖かったです。（投稿：2024年9月、ゆーぷる様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：２０２３年９月の平日に利用。酸ケ湯温泉に浸かってからここまで下りてきて泊まりました。国道からは川を隔てているのでとても静か。広い駐車場、トイレが超キレイです。但し南北方向に傾斜があるので、どちらを頭にして休むかを考えて駐めたほうが良いです。EV Quickが東の出入口付近にあります。（投稿：2023年10月、n様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：鹿角市大湯温泉保養センター 湯都里は良い。ただし、トレーニング器械は上履きがないと使用できない。車中泊しました。トイレが非常にきれいです。（投稿：2022年7月、k様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：秋田県鹿角市の道の駅おおゆは非常に良いところでした。入浴施設の「鹿角市大湯温泉保養センター 湯都里」が火曜日休みと記載されていますが、午前中は休みでしたが、午後は平常通り営業していました。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■2018/4/28グランドオープン。秋田県。正面に日帰り入浴施設がある！幹線国道からも川を隔てて距離があるので静か。期待の新人。
properties.desc_en:
■Car Camping Rating [S Rank 🤩] 86 points 👉️Click here for detailed scoring and detailed map. (September 2024)
■Bathing ♨️: 《Kazuno City Oyu Onsen Health Resort Yutori》 450 yen, details
■Bathing ♨️: 《Hotel Kazuno Day Trip Bathing》 1,000 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: The building is very clean. The toilets are also very clean. However, perhaps because it had just rained and the humidity was high, there were a lot of insects. When I got into the car, a large number of flies got inside, and I couldn't get them out (because more new flies would get in). I had no choice but to go to a nearby convenience store, but there was no insecticide in the countryside. I drove to another convenience store far away with a large number of flies. For someone who hates insects, it was a hellish scene. I will never go there again. Looking back now, the atmosphere of that town was also closed off and scary. (Posted: September 2024, by Yu-puru)
■Report from our site's reader: Used on a weekday in September 2023. After soaking in Sukayu Onsen, I came down here and stayed the night. It's very quiet as it's separated from the national highway by a river. The parking lot is spacious and the toilets are extremely clean. However, there is a slope in the north-south direction, so it's best to consider which way you'll be resting when parking. There is an EV Quick near the east entrance. (Posted: October 2023, by n)
■Report from our site's reader: Kazuno City Oyu Onsen Health Resort Yutori is good. However, the training equipment cannot be used without indoor shoes. I stayed overnight in my car. The toilets are extremely clean. (Posted: July 2022, by k)
■Report from our site's reader: Michi-no-Eki Oyu in Kazuno City, Akita Prefecture was a very good place. The bathing facility "Kazuno City Oyu Onsen Health Resort Center Yutori" is listed as being closed on Tuesdays, but although it was closed in the morning, it was open as usual in the afternoon. (Older post from before 2019)
■Grand opening on April 28, 2018. Akita Prefecture. There is a day-use bathing facility right in front! It's quiet because it's separated from the main national highway by a river. A promising newcomer.

■当サイト読者様レポート：大型車と完全分離。真ん中の森のような場所と建物の間に泊まれば騒音無し。車中泊車が多く安心。24時間トイレは温泉施設と道の駅の間を通り、メインの建物の裏側にあり。大きなトイレ棟でトイレの戸数も多く、宿泊者が多くても待ち無し。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Car Camping Rating [S Rank 🤩] 86 points 👉️ Click here for detailed scoring and detailed map. (June 2025)
■Bathing ♨️: Tenno Onsen Kurara no Yu 500 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: Free. The toilets aren't new but are large and equipped with shower toilets. The parking lot is spacious. There's a soccer field nearby with lights, but they seem to turn off at 8 PM. It's great that there's a bathing facility attached, and the restaurant inside closes late on weekends. Personally, I'd rate it S-class. (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from our site's reader: Completely separated from large vehicles. If you stay between the forest-like area in the middle and the building, there's no noise. There are many cars camping, so it feels safe. The 24-hour toilets are located behind the main building, between the hot spring facility and the roadside station. It's a large toilet building with many toilet stalls, so there's no waiting even with many overnight guests. (Older post from before 2019)

■当サイト読者様レポート：2025/2/16～17に利用しました。夜は建物のすぐそばまで車が入れるので、折からの強い西風をしのげました。徒歩圏内に7/11･ガスト･ドラッグストアがあります。おまけですが、道の駅構内にせんべいの24ｈ無人販売所ができていて、格安で割れせんなどが売られていました。温泉が併設されていますが、北へ2.5kmの「はまなす」をお勧めします。（投稿：2025年2月、tossan様）
■幹線国道沿いでややうるさい。夕日の名所。（2019年以前の古い投稿）

■Car Camping Rating [A Rank 😄] 84 points 👉️ Click here for detailed scoring and detailed map. (June 2025)
■Bathing ♨️: 《4F Observation Hot Spring "Chokai no Yu"》 450 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: Used on February 16-17, 2025. At night, you can drive your car right up to the building, so it was sheltered from the strong westerly winds. There is a 7/11, Gusto, and a drugstore within walking distance. As a bonus, there is a 24-hour unmanned rice cracker stand inside the roadside station, selling broken crackers and other items at a bargain price. There is a hot spring attached, but I recommend "Hamanasu" 2.5km to the north. (Posted: February 2025, by tossan)
■Somewhat noisy as it is along a main national highway. A famous spot for sunsets. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_en: Funaoka Castle Ruins Park Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja:
■山の麓と中腹の二箇所に公園の駐車場がある。桜シーズン中は有料駐車場となり一回500円。車中泊の場合は翌朝管理員が来たら500円を払えばOK。上の駐車場は桜シーズン中の8:00以降は障害者とバス専用になるので、一般車は駐車NGになる（そんな説明どこにも書いてないｗ）。管理人も下の駐車場に行けと追い出されました。なお、下の駐車場から上まで行く無料のシャトルバスが出ている。船岡城公園案内図（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■トイレについて：桜シーズンは両方の駐車場に簡易トイレが設置される。また、下から上の駐車場に行く途中に、夜間も利用可能な公衆トイレ（水洗洋式でキレイ）がある。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■夜に来て上の駐車場で寝る前まで過ごし（きれいな公衆トイレは上の方にある）、寝る前にトイレを済ませてから下の駐車場に移動して車中泊、翌朝駐車料金を払って桜見物するのがおすすめ。有名な白石川堤一目千本桜へもそのまま歩いて行ける。桜のピーク時は猛烈な渋滞で夜中まで出られなくなるので注意。駐車場詳細（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■上の駐車場は夜中までDQNとかアイドリング厨とか集まりうるさいので、寝る前のトイレを済ませたら下の駐車場で寝るのがおすすめ。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■There are two parking lots in the park, one at the foot of the mountain and one halfway up. During cherry blossom season, it becomes a paid parking lot at 500 yen per visit. If you're staying overnight in your car, you just pay 500 yen when the attendant comes the next morning. The upper parking lot becomes reserved for disabled people and buses after 8:00 AM during cherry blossom season, so general cars are not allowed to park there (there's no such explanation anywhere lol). Even the attendant was chased away and told to go to the lower parking lot. There is a free shuttle bus from the lower parking lot to the upper one. Funaoka Castle Park Map (older post from before 2019)
■Regarding toilets: During cherry blossom season, temporary toilets are set up in both parking lots. Also, on the way from the lower to the upper parking lot, there is a public toilet (clean, flushable Western-style toilet) that can be used at night. (Older post from before 2019)
■It is recommended to come at night, spend time in the upper parking lot until bedtime (the clean public toilet is higher up), use the toilet before going to bed, then move to the lower parking lot for overnight parking, pay the parking fee the next morning, and enjoy the cherry blossoms. You can also walk directly to the famous Shiraishi River Embankment with its thousand cherry trees. Be aware that during peak cherry blossom season, traffic jams are so severe you might be stuck until late at night. Parking details (older post from before 2019):
■ The upper parking lot is noisy with rowdy drivers and people idling their engines until late at night, so it's recommended to use the restroom before going to bed and then sleep in the lower parking lot. (Older post from before 2019)

■案内マップ

properties.desc_en:
■Miharu Takizakura (Fukushima), one of the Five Great Cherry Trees: A Famous Cherry Blossom Spot
■Report from a reader of this site: Naturally, street parking for cherry blossom viewing is strictly prohibited, so please park in the designated parking lot (donation required). However, it gets extremely crowded during the day, and especially on holidays, you can expect to be stuck in traffic for several hours just to get into the parking lot, so we recommend arriving before dawn or viewing the cherry blossoms at night.

■Guidance Map
■The appearance changes depending on the angle of the sunlight, so we recommend viewing it three times: in the morning, at noon, and in the evening (night cherry blossoms).

properties.desc_ja: ■紅葉の絶景ポイント。蔦温泉に入ってすぐの広い無料駐車場（トイレあり）に止めてO.K. 朝焼けの紅葉が絶景として有名。シーズンには、朝5時前には行って場所取りしないと人いっぱいになる。写真の後は温泉に入りましょう。蔦温泉は日帰りは10時からなので、蔦沼のあとは沼巡りをしましょう
properties.desc_en: ■A spectacular spot for viewing autumn foliage. You can park in the large free parking lot (with restrooms) right after entering Tsuta Onsen. The autumn leaves at sunrise are famous for their spectacular view. During the season, you need to go before 5 am to secure a spot, otherwise it will be crowded. After taking photos, let's go for a dip in the hot springs. Tsuta Onsen opens for day-trippers at 10 am, so after visiting Tsuta Marsh, let's go marsh hopping.

properties.label: Scenic Park
properties.desc_ja: ■弘前城桜見物の駐車場は津軽藩ねぷた村を使うと良い。駐車場入口は西側なので注意。桜祭り期間中は一回1000円で朝から夜まで滞在OK。桜シーズン中の土日祝日、桜見頃期間中は、朝5時から駐車場に入れる（一応電話確認した方がいいかも0172-39-1511）。なお、津軽藩ねぷた村駐車場は夜間閉鎖で23時には車を追い出されるため車中泊は不可なので注意。キレイなトイレも完備なので、朝、昼に桜を見て回って、夕桜、夜桜までの待ち時間はここでのんびりしていればいい。なお、朝５時ちょうどに来れば余裕で入れるので、開場待ちとかはしなくても大丈夫です（管理人が実際に桜満開時期ここに駐車して確認しました。）。郊外で車中泊して、朝5時にねぷた村駐車場に停めて、朝桜→昼桜→休憩→夕桜→夜桜見物→離脱→温泉（青森は温泉天国でもある）→郊外で車中泊、という流れとなります。弘前城の桜は、満開の桜と、散った後の「花筏」の両方を見るのがおすすめです。満開も花筏も両方すばらしいです。なお、花筏は風向きや形成のタイミング、上の桜の花の残り具合のタイミング等で撮影難易度が非常に高いです（桜写真の中でも最高難易度）。【Sランク🤩】に誰も異論はないでしょう。
properties.desc_en: ■For those viewing the cherry blossoms at Hirosaki Castle, it's best to use the parking lot at Tsugaru-han Neputa Village. Note that the entrance to the parking lot is on the west side. During the cherry blossom festival, it costs 1000 yen per entry and you can stay from morning until night. On weekends and holidays during the cherry blossom season, and during the peak blooming period, you can enter the parking lot from 5am (it might be a good idea to call and confirm: 0172-39-1511). Note that the Tsugaru-han Neputa Village parking lot closes at night and cars are kicked out at 11pm, so overnight parking is not allowed. There are clean restrooms available, so you can enjoy the cherry blossoms in the morning and afternoon, and then relax here while waiting for the evening and nighttime cherry blossoms. If you arrive exactly at 5am, you can easily get in, so you don't need to wait for the gates to open (the administrator has actually parked here during the peak cherry blossom season and confirmed this). The plan is to camp in the car in the suburbs, park at the Neputa Village parking lot at 5am, see the cherry blossoms in the morning, then the afternoon, take a break, see the cherry blossoms in the evening, then enjoy the cherry blossoms at night, leave, go to a hot spring (Aomori is also a hot spring paradise), and then camp in the car in the suburbs again. At Hirosaki Castle, it is recommended to see both the cherry blossoms in full bloom and the "flower rafts" after they have fallen. Both the full bloom and the flower rafts are wonderful. However, photographing the flower rafts is extremely difficult due to the wind direction, the timing of their formation, and the remaining cherry blossoms on top (it is one of the most difficult types of cherry blossom photography). No one would disagree that it deserves an S rank🤩.

properties.title_ja: 岩木山麓桜並木（自称：世界一の桜並木）
properties.title_en: Cherry blossom trees at the foot of Mt. Iwaki (self-proclaimed: the world's best cherry blossom avenue)
properties.desc_ja: ■弘前市内から嶽温泉に通じる県道3号には、岩木山南麓に入ると全長約20kmにわたってオオヤマザクラ約6500本が植えられている。世界一の桜並木をつくろうと市民の手により植えられたもので、春には緑萌える山麓に鮮やかな紅の色が添えられる。（実際に世界一というわけではない。あくまでも世界一を目指して、、、という話）※百選ではない
properties.desc_en: ■Along Prefectural Road 3, which connects Hirosaki city to Dake Onsen, approximately 6,500 Oyamazakura cherry trees are planted along a 20km stretch once you enter the southern foothills of Mt. Iwaki. They were planted by citizens with the aim of creating the world's longest cherry blossom avenue, and in spring, they add a vibrant red color to the lush green foothills. (It's not actually the world's longest; it's just an attempt to be the world's longest.) *Not one of the Top 100 Cherry Blossom Avenues

properties.desc_ja: ■弘前桜祭りの無料駐車場。富士見橋臨時駐車場。祭りのときは簡易トイレも設置されている。利用は１８時までとされているが、みんな夜もここに停めている。要は、夜間になんか事故、事件あっても行政は責任取らないよ、ということで、物理的には利用はできてしまう。自己責任で車中泊も可能。ちなみに明かりは一切なく真っ暗。DQNに襲撃されたら終了。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Free parking for the Hirosaki Cherry Blossom Festival. Fujimi Bridge Temporary Parking Lot. Temporary toilets are also set up during the festival. While it's supposed to be open until 6 PM, everyone parks there overnight. Essentially, the government won't take responsibility for any accidents or incidents that occur at night, so it's physically possible to use it. Overnight parking is also possible at your own risk. Incidentally, there are absolutely no lights, it's pitch black. If you get attacked by a thug, you're finished. (Old post from before 2019)

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 恐山菩提寺の境内にある温泉
properties.title_en: Hot spring located within the grounds of Osorezan Bodaiji Temple
properties.desc_ja:
■境内にある温泉。濃厚な乳青白色の極上温泉。参拝者は無料で入れるが、寺に入るのに700円必要。詳細
■管理人評価：★4.8（泉質4.5、景色は湯小屋の雰囲気を評価して0.3） ここに入らずして温泉を語るなかれ。草津、万座に似た、青色の濃厚な湯。極上である。
■当サイト読者様レポート：私も入浴しました。すごいいいですね。観光客が多いので、以下を補足します。裏手にある薬師（やくし）の湯は、観光客も来ないため安心して入浴可能。ただし混浴。詳細
properties.desc_en:
■Hot spring located within the temple grounds. A superb hot spring with rich, milky-blue water. Visitors can enter for free, but there is a 700 yen entrance fee to enter the temple itself. Details
■Administrator's rating: ★4.8 (Spring quality 4.5, scenery 0.3 based on the atmosphere of the bathhouse) You can't talk about hot springs without experiencing this one. A rich, blue-colored water similar to Kusatsu and Manza. Absolutely superb.

■Report from a reader of this site: I also bathed here. It's amazing! Since there are many tourists, I'll add the following: Yakushi no Yu, located behind the main building, is less frequented by tourists, so you can bathe with peace of mind. However, it is a mixed-gender bath. Details

properties.label: Paid Campground
properties.desc_ja:
■協力金500円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：「すぐ近くに温泉あり」とありますが、相の沢温泉は2016年から営業していないため、最寄りの温泉は約8km離れた網張温泉になります。なのでこの記載は無いほうが誤解を生じないかと思います。（投稿：2024年5月、草の湯様）
properties.desc_en:
■ Donation: 500 yen, details
■ Reader report on this site: "It says there is a hot spring nearby," but Ainosawa Onsen has not been operating since 2016, so the nearest hot spring is Amihari Onsen, which is about 8km away. Therefore, I think it would be less misleading if this statement were omitted. (Posted by: Kusanoyu, May 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■漁港の無料駐車スペースと公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレは水洗和式。早朝から漁に出る船があるのでエンジン音が響く。（2022年9月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en: ■Free parking space and public toilets at the fishing port. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. The toilets are flush toilets (Japanese style). There is engine noise from boats that go out fishing early in the morning. (Confirmed on-site by administrator in September 2022)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■漁港の人気食堂。数量限定の海鮮定食が人気。11時オープンだが、土日は人が多すぎてメチャメチャな行列になるので、9:00〜10時前にはこの食堂に来て整理券をもらうのがよい。整理券は9時から配布。数量限定の海鮮定食はすぐに売り切れる。格安なのに、臭みが全く無く、非常に美味しかった。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■A popular restaurant at the fishing port. Their limited-quantity seafood set meals are very popular. They open at 11am, but on weekends the lines get incredibly long, so it's best to arrive at the restaurant between 9am and 10am to get a numbered ticket. Tickets are distributed from 9am. The limited-quantity seafood set meals sell out quickly. Despite being inexpensive, the seafood had absolutely no unpleasant smell and was extremely delicious. (Tabelog)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■牛肉ど真ん中という駅弁で有名。駐車場完備。駐車場ですぐ食べられる。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Famous for its "Beef Right in the Center" bento box. Parking available. You can eat right there in the parking lot. (Tabelog)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■牛タン発祥の店。考案者の店はここだが、もうひとつ「旨味太助」という店もあり、そこは考案者の直弟子のお店で、元祖牛タンを名乗っているそうです。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■The restaurant where beef tongue originated. This is the restaurant of the inventor, but there is also another restaurant called "Umami Tasuke," which is run by the inventor's direct disciple and claims to be the original beef tongue restaurant. Tabelog

properties.desc_ja:
■幹線道路沿いのため結構うるさいですね。みんなめちゃくちゃなスピードで走っててうるさい。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■無料駐車場とトイレ。遠刈田温泉にも徒歩10分ほど。なんと無料キャンプ場併設で、水場も使える。いいんじゃないでしょうか。（2019年以前の古い投稿）

properties.desc_en:
■It's quite noisy because it's located along a main road. Everyone drives at crazy speeds, making a lot of noise. (Older post from before 2019)
■Free parking and toilets. It's also about a 10-minute walk to Togatta Onsen. And it even has a free campsite with water facilities. Sounds good, doesn't it? (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from a reader of this site: I stayed here for one night based on the reviews on this site, and it was very comfortable! There's a ramen shop and a stylish restaurant within a few minutes' walk. Furthermore, if you walk about 10 minutes, you'll reach the Togatta Onsen area, where there are restaurants and convenience stores. Note that most restaurants close around 7 PM! (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■海鮮丼の人気店。高品質で美味いのにお値段安く、非常にコスパが良い。注文を受けてから一つ一つ刺し身を切っており、それを店主が一人で全部やっているため提供までに非常に時間がかかるので、開店前から並ぶのがおすすめ。詳細、食べログ（2023年9月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en: ■A popular restaurant specializing in seafood rice bowls. The food is high-quality and delicious, yet inexpensive, offering excellent value for money. Since the owner cuts each piece of sashimi individually after receiving an order, and does all of this by himself, it takes a considerable amount of time for the food to be served. Therefore, it's recommended to line up before opening time. (For details, see Tabelog; verified by the administrator in September 2023.)

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 夏油温泉 夏油元湯
properties.desc_ja:
■夏油と書いてゲトウと読む。700円、詳細、マニア絶賛
■管理人評価★4.8（泉質4.3、景色0.5満点） 最高。秋が特に至高。美しすぎる。泉質も良い。足元から自噴。露天風呂の眺めも最高。ここは秋に来ましょう。感動しました。ありがとうございます。
properties.desc_en:
■Getou (written as 夏油). 700 yen, details, highly praised by enthusiasts.
■Manager's rating ★4.8 (Spring quality 4.3, Scenery 0.5 out of 5) Superb. Autumn is especially sublime. Absolutely beautiful. The spring quality is also good. It gushes from the ground. The view from the open-air bath is also superb. You should come here in autumn. I was deeply moved. Thank you.

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja: ■夏でも涼しい。良い。標高572m。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■It's cool even in summer. Good. Elevation 572m. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: （花見山桜シーズン限定）あぶくま親水公園駐車場
properties.title_en: (Limited to the cherry blossom season at Hanamiyama) Abukuma Waterfront Park Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja:
■仮設トイレあり（汚い）。花見山公園の桜のシーズン中はここが臨時駐車場となり、ここからシャトルバスが出る（一人往復500円、これが駐車場代も兼ねている模様）。水、食料を準備して夜にここに来て車中泊。花見山公園までは歩くと1時間程度で行ける。シャトルバスは朝7時からなので、早朝から撮影する場合は徒歩で行く。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■実際に車中泊してみました。仮設トイレはかなり奥の方で、地下連絡道のところにズラっとある。夜間はトイレは電気はつかない。駐車場全体も真っ暗。トイレは当然ながら臭くて汚いので、車中泊は別のところでやって、早朝にここにくるのがいいかも。（全てが真っ暗なので、治安的にも不安あり。地元のDQNに襲撃されたら終了。）朝6時くらいに来れば余裕で駐車可能。wimaxも利用可能。併走する幹線道路が交通量がかなり多くて結構うるさい。道路渡って対面のヘルシーランド福島で入浴が可能！なんと300円。地下道通って行けばすぐ。なお、朝のシャトルバスは6:30過ぎに並び始めればすぐ乗れる。コンパクトな折り畳みのイスなどを持って行くと、バスの待ち時間などに座れて便利。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Temporary toilets available (dirty). During the cherry blossom season at Hanamiyama Park, this becomes a temporary parking lot, and a shuttle bus departs from here (500 yen round trip per person, which seems to cover the parking fee). Prepare water and food, come here at night, and sleep in your car. It takes about an hour to walk to Hanamiyama Park. The shuttle bus starts at 7 am, so if you want to take photos early in the morning, you'll have to walk. (Older post from before 2019)
■I actually tried sleeping in my car here. The temporary toilets are quite far back, lined up near the underground passage. The toilets don't have lights at night. The entire parking lot is pitch black. The toilets are obviously smelly and dirty, so it might be better to sleep in your car somewhere else and come here early in the morning. (Everything is pitch black, so there are safety concerns. If you get attacked by local thugs, it's game over.) If you come around 6 am, you can easily find a parking spot. WiMAX is also available. The main road running alongside has a lot of traffic and is quite noisy. You can take a bath at Healthy Land Fukushima across the road! It only costs 300 yen! It's a quick ride through the underpass. Also, if you start lining up for the morning shuttle bus after 6:30 AM, you can get on right away. Bringing a compact folding chair or something similar is convenient for sitting while waiting for the bus. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: うめたふれあいセンター
properties.desc_ja: ■温泉銭湯。350円、詳細。休憩所は別料金。泉質非常に素晴らしい。消毒のみ添加のかけ流し。
properties.desc_en: ■Hot spring bathhouse. 350 yen, details. Rest area is an additional charge. The water quality is excellent. Free-flowing hot spring water with only disinfectant added.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■温泉マニア大絶賛。泉質は旧表示では単純酸性硫黄泉。700円、詳細。１１月中旬から冬休み閉鎖、不定休！要電話確認！
■管理人評価★4.9（泉質4.5、景色0.4）まさに秘湯。泉質は何も言うことなし。眺望は絶景とまでは言えないが壮観。
properties.desc_en:
■Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. The spring water was formerly classified as a simple acidic sulfur spring. 700 yen, details available. Closed for winter holidays from mid-November, irregular closing days! Call to confirm!

■Manager's rating ★4.9 (Spring water quality 4.5, Scenery 0.4) A true hidden hot spring. The spring water quality is impeccable. The view isn't spectacular, but it's magnificent.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 乳頭温泉郷 蟹場温泉
properties.desc_ja:
■温泉マニア大絶賛。800円、詳細、泉質：重曹炭酸水素泉
■管理人評価：★4.9（泉質4.4、景色0.5） 景色が非常に素晴らしい。お湯は透明だが湯ノ花が舞っていて美しい。
properties.desc_en:
■Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. 800 yen, details, spring quality: bicarbonate spring
■Manager's rating: ★4.9 (Spring quality 4.4, Scenery 0.5) The scenery is absolutely stunning. The water is clear, but the floating mineral deposits are beautiful.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■温泉マニア大絶賛。700円、詳細
■管理人評価★4.85（泉質4.45、景色0.4）風呂は内湯と露天の二つ。内湯も悪くはないが、泉質、眺望ともに露天風呂の方がすばらしい。ベースは透明の硫黄泉で、湯の花が大量に舞っている。香り、味、ともに濃厚。泉質は4.45と評価。景色も大変よく、秋の紅葉が美しい。景色は0.4と評価。合計4.85の極上温泉。
properties.desc_en:
■Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. 700 yen, details
■Manager's rating ★4.85 (Spring quality 4.45, Scenery 0.4) There are two baths, an indoor bath and an outdoor bath. The indoor bath is not bad, but the outdoor bath is superior in both spring quality and scenery. The base is a clear sulfur spring with a large amount of mineral deposits floating in it. Both the scent and taste are rich. Spring quality is rated 4.45. The scenery is also very good, and the autumn foliage is beautiful. Scenery is rated 0.4. A superb hot spring with a total score of 4.85.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■温泉マニア大絶賛。700円、詳細
■管理人評価★5!!至高（泉質4.5、景色0.5）ここは日帰りの場合は3つ風呂に入れる。まず内湯は吉倉屋と同様の透明ベースの硫黄泉。なかなか良い。そして本館2階の展望露天風呂湯は、下の湯よりもやや濃厚で、青白く美しい。そして眺望が非常にすばらしい。裏山の秋の紅葉を一望できる。眺望満点0.5。そして、一回外に出て裏にまわったところにあるこぢんまりとした露天風呂が非常に素晴らしい。物凄く濃厚な乳青白色の濁り湯。泉質満点4.5。この濃厚なにごり湯は、吉倉屋さんにはない。というわけで、総合的に至高の5.0満点と評価させていただきます。かなりオススメ。
properties.desc_en:
■Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. 700 yen, details
■Manager's rating ★5!! Supreme (Spring quality 4.5, view 0.5) Here, if you're a day-tripper, you can use three baths. First, the indoor bath is a clear-based sulfur spring, similar to Yoshikuraya. Quite good. Then, the open-air bath on the second floor of the main building has a slightly richer water than the bath below, and is a beautiful bluish-white. And the view is absolutely superb. You can see the autumn foliage on the mountain behind the building. View score: 0.5. And, if you go outside and around to the back, there is a small open-air bath that is absolutely wonderful. An incredibly rich, milky bluish-white cloudy water. Spring quality score: 4.5. This rich cloudy water is not available at Yoshikuraya. Therefore, overall, I rate it as a supreme 5.0 out of 5.0. Highly recommended.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■温泉マニア大絶賛。700円、詳細
■管理人評価★4.8（泉質4.4、景色0.4） 藤七温泉の凄まじい湯の後に来ると正直物足りなさを感じてしまうが、すばらしい温泉であることはまちがいない。風呂から見える秋の紅葉が美しい。ここは紅葉がかなり早めで、９月末ごろが紅葉の見頃。
properties.desc_en:
■Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. 700 yen, details
■Manager's rating ★4.8 (Spring quality 4.4, Scenery 0.4) After experiencing the incredible waters of Fujishichi Onsen, this one honestly feels a bit underwhelming, but it is undoubtedly a wonderful hot spring. The autumn foliage visible from the bath is beautiful. The leaves change color quite early here, with the best time to see them being around the end of September.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 大湯温泉 阿部旅館
properties.desc_ja:
■温泉マニア大絶賛。500円、詳細

properties.desc_en:
■Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. 500 yen, details

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:

■管理人評価★4.5（泉質4.5、景色0）泉質については何も言うことなし。極上の満点。ただ、眺望は皆無なのでこの評価。
properties.desc_en:
■Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. One of Japan's three greatest hidden hot springs, celebrating its 400th anniversary. A soft, milky-blue simple hydrogen sulfide spring. Day trips for bathing are also available (800 yen, details).

■Manager's rating ★4.5 (Spring quality 4.5, View 0) Nothing more to say about the spring quality. A perfect score. However, the complete lack of view is the reason for this rating.

properties.label: Nature Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■奥入瀬渓流、おいらせ、と読む。十和田湖の方が上流になる。上流の、十和田湖、子の口駐車場に車を止めて、遊歩道を歩いて３時間かけて石ヶ戸まで歩くのがおすすめ。大変だけど充実感ありまくり。石ヶ戸からはJRバスが一時間に一本くらい出ているのでそれに乗って子の口まで戻るのが良い。ちなみに片道４６０円。歩いた後に石ヶ戸でそばを食べると異常に美味い。午後は温泉巡りを楽しんでください。車中泊スポットは十和田湖の周辺にいっぱいあります。
properties.desc_en: ■Oirase Gorge, pronounced "Oirase". Lake Towada is upstream. It is recommended to park your car at the Konokuchi parking lot upstream at Lake Towada and walk along the promenade to Ishigedo, which takes 3 hours. It is tough, but very rewarding. From Ishigedo, there is a JR bus that runs about once an hour, so it is best to take that back to Konokuchi. By the way, it costs 460 yen one way. Eating soba noodles at Ishigedo after the walk is exceptionally delicious. In the afternoon, enjoy visiting hot springs. There are plenty of places to park your car and stay overnight around Lake Towada.

properties.desc_en: ■Visit in conjunction with Oirase Gorge. It's also a great spot for watching the sunset and a famous place for autumn foliage.

properties.title_en: Entrance to Okuhachikuro Onsen (the one with only one """"Oku"""").""
properties.desc_ja: ■この場所から南に獣道のような林道があり、ここから歩いて行く。川を気合で渡ると「奥八九郎温泉」に行ける。「奥」が一つの方。この北に行くと、超有名な「奥奥八九郎温泉」（奥が２個）がある。「奥八九郎温泉」は行くのが大変だし、泥がたまっていてあまりキレイでもないので、無理して行くほどでもない。「奥奥八九郎温泉」（奥が２個）に行けば十分。アクセス難度はかなり高め。マニア向け。
properties.desc_en: ■From this location, there is a forest path resembling an animal trail to the south, and you can walk from there. If you cross the river with determination, you can reach "Okuhachikuro Onsen". This is the one with one "Oku". If you go north from here, you will find the very famous "Okuokuhachikuro Onsen" (with two "Oku"s). "Okuhachikuro Onsen" is difficult to get to, and it's not very clean with a lot of mud, so it's not worth going out of your way to go. Going to "Okuokuhachikuro Onsen" (with two "Oku"s) is sufficient. Access is quite difficult. For enthusiasts only.

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.title_ja: 大曲花火 穴場の観覧場所
properties.title_en: Hidden viewing spots for the Omagari Fireworks Festival
properties.desc_ja: ■このマーカーを置いている場所付近の道路の端の方（東側）を、花火当日の朝6時くらいに場所取りすると良い。もちろん無料。ガムテープを道路に貼って場所取りする。車の通行のじゃまにならないように。大曲花火の目玉である大会提供花火をほぼ正面から全体を見渡すことができる。この場所の難点としては、トイレが遠いのが弱点。特に大をしたくなった場合が悲惨なので、ここでは飲み物だけにして、食べ物はやめたほうがいいと思う。なお、無料駐車場から徒歩35分かかる。あと、音楽とかはほとんど聞こえないし、花火の音圧は弱め。河川敷の有料席の方が全身で花火を感じることができ感動は大きいので、大曲花火が初めてという方には河川敷の有料席をおすすめする。（2018年8月の情報。by管理人）
properties.desc_en: ■It's best to reserve a spot on the edge of the road (east side) near where this marker is placed, around 6 AM on the day of the fireworks. Of course, it's free. Reserve your spot by taping duct tape to the road. Make sure not to obstruct traffic. You can get a nearly head-on view of the entire fireworks display, which is the highlight of the Omagari Fireworks Festival. The downside of this location is that the toilets are far away. It's especially miserable if you need to go to the bathroom, so I think it's best to only bring drinks and no food. It's a 35-minute walk from the free parking lot. Also, you can barely hear any music, and the sound pressure of the fireworks is weak. The paid seats on the riverbank allow you to feel the fireworks with your whole body and the experience is much more impressive, so I recommend the paid seats on the riverbank for those who are seeing the Omagari Fireworks Festival for the first time. (Information from August 2018. by administrator)

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■800円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：2連泊しました。自炊部の炊事場が２つになりました。部屋には冷蔵庫があります。室内岩盤浴は予約制で５０分間です。小生は汗もかかず出ました。（投稿：2022年7月、k様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2019年10月利用。日帰り利用者は「園地駐車場」（100円）の駐めて利用します。この時期の日帰り温泉受付は15:30まで（16時閉館）です。遊歩道＋屋外岩盤浴＋温泉＋売店（＆ランチ）で、3時間程度は要るでしょう。
■全国のガン患者が集う、伝説の温泉。超強烈なお湯と岩盤浴。ＰＨ１.２という超強烈な酸性泉（強酸性塩化物泉、含二酸化炭素・アルミニウム・鉄・塩化物泉）＆ラジウム泉＆本物の岩盤浴。全国のガン患者のみなさんが押し寄せる。いわゆるホルミシス効果。強烈な湯治場である。全国的に見ても最高峰の湯治場ではないでしょうか。本気度高すぎ。８:００〜２０:００（日帰り入浴）６００円。
■管理人評価★5（泉質4.5、景色は地獄谷の方も含めて評価して0.5）お風呂＋地獄谷の岩盤浴セットで全体として★５の評価。至高の湯治場。 緑の強烈な酸性ラジウム泉。お湯も凄いですが、岩盤浴もポカポカして気持ちいいです。温熱効果と放射能の効果です。温泉入る前に、岩盤浴を１時間ほどしてから、お風呂にはいてさっぱりして帰りましょう。岩盤浴の道具としては、下に敷くゴザ（ブルーシート）、ジャージ、タオル、日よけの傘、飲料水など。現場では末期のガン患者の方とかいっぱいいるので、ワイワイやらないようにしましょう。なお、日帰りの場合は駐車場は上の１００円有料駐車場になります。
properties.desc_en:
■800 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: I stayed for two nights. There are now two kitchens in the self-catering area. There is a refrigerator in the room. The indoor bedrock bath is by reservation only and lasts for 50 minutes. I came out without even sweating. (Posted: July 2022, Mr. K)
■Report from our site's reader: Used in October 2019. Day-trippers park in the "park parking lot" (100 yen). During this period, the reception for day-trip hot springs is until 15:30 (closing at 16:00). You will need about 3 hours for the walking trails + outdoor bedrock bath + hot springs + shop (and lunch).

■A legendary hot spring where cancer patients from all over the country gather. Extremely strong water and bedrock bath. Extremely acidic spring with a pH of 1.2 (strongly acidic chloride spring, containing carbon dioxide, aluminum, iron, and chloride) & radium spring & real bedrock bath. Cancer patients from all over the country flock here. This is the so-called hormesis effect. It's an intensely therapeutic hot spring resort. It might be one of the best therapeutic hot spring resorts in the entire country. The level of dedication is incredible. 8:00 AM - 8:00 PM (day trip bathing) 600 yen.

■Manager's rating ★5 (Spring quality 4.5, scenery including Jigokudani 0.5) The bath + Jigokudani bedrock bath set earns a 5-star rating overall. A supreme therapeutic hot spring resort. A green, intensely acidic radium spring. The water is amazing, but the bedrock bath is also wonderfully warming and comfortable. It's the effect of heat and radiation. Before entering the hot spring, spend about an hour in the bedrock bath, then take a bath to freshen up before heading home. For the bedrock bath, bring a mat (blue tarp) to lay on, a tracksuit, a towel, a sun umbrella, and drinking water. There are many terminally ill cancer patients there, so please be quiet and not make too much noise. For day trips, please use the 100-yen paid parking lot mentioned above.

■Manager's Rating ★4.8 (Spring Quality 4.4, Scenery 0.4) It's 800 yen as a set with Osawa Onsen, so you should try both. The spring quality at Namagari is superior. The famous Shirazaru no Yu is a well-known mixed-gender bath, and even though the water is clear, young women enter without hesitation. Surprising. (lol) You can enter all three on a day trip, so try all three. All three are different hot springs. The scenery from the baths is more beautiful at Osawa Onsen, but you can also see the stream and autumn leaves from the open-air bath here. It's a wonderful hot spring.

properties.desc_en:
■700 yen, details
■A famous hot spring. Features a spectacular open-air bath.
■[The origin of Tsuru-no-Yu Onsen] Twelve hundred years ago, in the remote Tadami River Valley, a place rarely inhabited, a farmer noticed a crane flying and motionless beneath a giant rock. Peering in, he saw a clear hot spring gushing forth, and the crane was soaking its injured leg. When he tried bathing himself, he was amazed and delighted by the magical effects, as his injuries to his hands and feet, as well as his back pain and fatigue, were healed after just one bath. Hearing of this, people from the surrounding villages begged to be allowed to bathe, and the farmer opened a hot spring resort to help people, which is said to be the origin of Tsuru-no-Yu Onsen. In this remote area, the hot spring must have been a treasure that protected the lives of the residents.

properties.desc_ja:
■400円、詳細
■温泉マニア大絶賛。営業時間、要問い合わせ。0241-43-2021 お婆さんが一人でやっているので、お婆さんが畑に行っている時、おでかけの時は入れません。だいたい昼には家におられるようです。今でも畑仕事をなさっているそうです。頭が下がります。
■管理人評価★4.85（泉質4.45、景色0.4）噂通りなかなかすごい湯だった。ベースの色は透明だが、ヌルヌルで白い湯の花が大量に舞っている。コップがあるので飲んでみると、澄まし汁のようなダシ味、凄すぎる。こんな温泉は初めて。湯上がりはものすごいスベスベ。その辺の自称美人の湯が裸足で逃げ出すような極上の湯である。透明の湯としては全国的にも最高レベル。泉質は4.45と評価。満点でもいいかも。景色は、この建物自体がいい感じだし、窓を開けると川と紅葉が見える。大変気持ちがよい。0.4点。合計4.85点の極上温泉。なお場所は分かりにくいのですが、このマップで正確な位置にマークしています。あと、息子さんが跡を継がれるそうです。前日に電話で予定確認を推奨。12:30-13:00くらいならだいたい家におられるそうです。マニアならここは一度は来るべき。
properties.desc_en:
■400 yen, details
■Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. Opening hours, please inquire. 0241-43-2021 An elderly woman runs the place alone, so you can't enter when she's out in the fields or out and about. She's usually home around noon. She still works in the fields, apparently. I'm truly impressed.

■Manager's rating ★4.85 (Spring quality 4.45, Scenery 0.4) As rumored, it was an amazing hot spring. The base color is transparent, but it's slippery and full of white mineral deposits. There's a cup, so I tried drinking it, and it had a broth-like flavor – incredible! I've never experienced a hot spring like this before. My skin was incredibly smooth after bathing. It's such a superb hot spring that all those self-proclaimed "beauty springs" would run away in fear. It's among the best transparent hot springs in the country. The spring quality is rated 4.45. Maybe it deserves a perfect score. As for the scenery, the building itself is nice, and when you open the window you can see the river and autumn leaves. It's very pleasant. 0.4 points. A superb hot spring with a total score of 4.85 points. The location is a bit hard to find, but I've marked the exact spot on this map. Also, I heard that his son will be taking over the business. I recommend calling the day before to confirm his schedule. He's usually home between 12:30 and 13:00. If you're a hot spring enthusiast, this is a place you should definitely visit at least once.

There are three toilets on the premises, all of which were available in the early morning hours. One of them had a bidet. The parking lot on the southwest side is large but adjacent to private houses, so the northeast side is quieter and suitable for car camping. A one-minute walk north from the same location is Hiraka-cho Yutori-kan (details, 10am-8pm, 310 yen, closed Tuesdays), which has a public bath (not a "hot spring"). There were also covered playground equipment so children can enjoy themselves even in rainy weather. It is expected to be crowded during the iris festival in late June. ■Bathing ♨️: "Koma no Yu" 700 yen, details
■Report from a reader of this site: This was a designated parking lot for viewing the Hinoemata Kabuki, but I ended up camping here in my car. There is a clean toilet at the entrance to the parking lot, a flush toilet with a washlet, and it is lit up and usable even at night. There is the village's only JA supermarket nearby, but it closes early (17:30). There is also a public hot spring facility adjacent to it, "Koma no Yu" (details), which is a very convenient location. There is also an izakaya nearby, so you can eat even if it's late. For car camping in this area, the Oze Hinoemata Roadside Station is probably the standard, but the hot spring facility adjacent to the roadside station closes early and is a bit expensive, and there are no places to eat nearby after evening. This time it was the weekend, but since it is originally the town hall's parking lot, it is thought that parking for purposes other than its intended use is prohibited during weekday daytime hours. (Posted by: Veru, September 2025)

properties.desc_ja:
■2025年6月20日移転オープン。【シャワー🚿あり】9分300円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：車中泊については、道の駅としては原則認めてはいないが、厳しく取り締まったりすることは無いとの事です。車中泊を推奨するわけでは無いようですが、拒否する姿勢では無いようです。＊北海道の「道の駅おとふけ」では、事前登録や道の駅での受付で、車中泊を認めている例を話していたら、「奥の方にまだ、拡げる予定もあるので、今後村の方にも情報提供していきますよ！そして食堂の営業時間も需要があるなら考えなきゃね。」と前向きでした。トイレについては24時間対応のトイレを用意している。そして、今回コインシャワー（9分300円）を新設したとの事です。有料（1泊2000円）ではあるが、電源付きのキャンピングカーサイトもオープンする予定の様です。以上の情報を、当HPに情報提供し掲載する旨は、管理者から許可を頂いております。【車中泊場所としての評価は？】駐車場：道の駅側の駐車場は比較的広くフラット、建物が道路側にあるため、とても静か（こちらがお薦め）キャンピングカーサイト側は、道路沿いなので、騒音が気になるかも（場所的に自動車専用道の入り口なので、交通量はそれなりにあります。トイレ新築なので当然綺麗です。WIFI 確認できませんでした＊2011年の東日本大震災で被害を受けた村ですが、今回の道の駅は、津波浸水想定区域外の高台になりますので、安心して車中泊が可能です。（投稿：2025年6月、j様）
properties.desc_en:
■Relocated and reopened on June 20, 2025. [Showers available] 300 yen for 9 minutes, details
■Report from a reader of this site: Regarding overnight stays in vehicles, the roadside station does not generally permit them, but they do not strictly enforce the rules. It seems they are not encouraging overnight stays in vehicles, but they are not outright rejecting them either. *When I mentioned the example of "Michi-no-Eki Otofuke" in Hokkaido, which allows overnight stays in vehicles with prior registration or on-site registration, they responded positively, saying, "We have plans to expand further in the back, so we will provide information to the village in the future! And if there is demand, we will have to consider extending the restaurant's operating hours." They have 24-hour toilets available. And they have newly installed coin showers (300 yen for 9 minutes). They also seem to be planning to open a campervan site with electricity, although it will be a paid service (2000 yen per night). We have received permission from the administrator to provide and publish the above information on this website. [What is the evaluation of this as an overnight parking spot?] Parking: The parking lot on the roadside station side is relatively large and flat, and since the building faces the road, it is very quiet (this is recommended). The campervan site side is along the road, so noise may be a concern (it is located at the entrance to an expressway, so there is a fair amount of traffic). The toilets are newly built, so they are naturally clean. WIFI could not be confirmed. *Although the village was damaged in the 2011 Great East Japan Earthquake, this roadside station is on high ground outside the tsunami inundation zone, so you can stay overnight in your vehicle with peace of mind. (Posted: June 2025, by j)

■Report from our site's reader: It's spacious and you can't hear the idling sound if you stay in the back, but some inconsiderate car campers left their trash on top of the trash can in the toilet. If this continues, I think they'll put up a sign saying "No Car Camping Allowed." (Posted: June 2023, Reader)
■Report from our site's reader: There's an Aeon and a gas station next door. On the other side is a convenience store with clean facilities. The white lines in the parking lot are clearly marked. Unfortunately, there's no employee parking, so employees who come early in the morning naturally park near the building, and cars parked there overnight = a nuisance. There are signs everywhere saying "No Overnight Stays." The bidet toilets only produce cold water, even in this cold weather. Just over 2 kilometers away is "Asunaro Onsen," a hot spring with a free-flowing source. While many hot springs only have trickles of water, this one offers a gushing hot spring for only 300 yen. You can fully enjoy the free-flowing hot spring water. The water is slippery, and your whole body will turn bright red in just a few minutes. (Posted by: Migratory Bird Travelogue, April 2021)

■当サイト読者様レポート：2023/4/9に宿泊しました。管理人さんの情報とおりに裏側の奥に止めましたが、そこに温泉施設への暖房供給装置が設置されており、ブォーと言うエンジン音がしておりました。大きな音ではなかったのですが、周囲が静かになるとうるさくなると思い、前の奥（温泉入り口側）に止めなおしました。この暖房供給装置が温泉営業終了後も稼働しているのか、深夜は停止するかは雨と風の為、確認できませんでした。それと温泉に近い側はトイレが遠いですね。以上報告です。（投稿：2023年4月、m様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：温泉あり。警察の意味の無い見回りや職質で寝にくい（朝の4時とかに車の横にエンジンをかけたまま来て車内を覗いてくる。）（2019年以前の古い投稿）

As the administrator had instructed, I parked at the back, but there was a heating supply unit for the hot spring facility installed there, making a loud humming engine noise. It wasn't a loud noise, but I thought it would become noisy when the surroundings were quiet, so I moved to the front (towards the hot spring entrance). Due to the rain and wind, I couldn't confirm whether this heating supply unit was still operating after the hot spring closed or if it stopped at night. Also, the toilets are far away on the side closer to the hot spring. That's all for my report. (Posted: April 2023, by m)

■夜間トイレは敷地内の西の端にある。東側の駐車場に車停めると遠すぎて徒歩4分くらいかかる。トイレの裏のあたりに車停めると夜間静かで良い。（不審者扱いされて職質される可能性あるが）（2019年以前の古い投稿）

■September 2024 Administrator's On-Site Verification: Car Camping Rating [Rank B] ​​69 points 👉️Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■Report from a reader of this site: There is a parking lot in front of the building, but there is actually a large parking lot along the river behind it. (Gravel) It's a hidden spot, and there are no streetlights, but it's very quiet and you can sleep soundly here. However, the toilet is very far away...I use it often so I'm sharing this information. There's one more point to be aware of. Early in the morning, local elderly people start gathering from nowhere. (There is a gateball venue next door) So, I think it's best to park on the right side when facing the site. I don't recommend staying long. Also, the homemade two-color ice cream here has always been excellent. By the way, the sesame and rice flavors are delicious. (Older post from before 2019)
■The nighttime toilet is at the western end of the site. If you park your car in the eastern parking lot, it's too far and takes about 4 minutes on foot. Parking your car near the back of the toilet is quiet at night and is good. (There's a possibility you might be treated as a suspicious person and questioned by the police.) (Older post from before 2019)

■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレがウォッシュレットでない。足湯があるが、せっかく天童温泉に来たのに足湯だけでは。歩いて１０分程の所に、はな駒荘という源泉かけ流しの老人福祉の施設が2020年にリニューアルされてオープン。一般３５０円、６５才以上２５０円。浴槽はあつ湯とふつう湯（投稿：2021年5月、渡り鳥漫遊記様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2018年来てみたが、夜間は専門店エリアは本当に鎖で閉鎖される（昔はコーンだけだった）。夜間出入り禁止の看板もある。しかし、実は鎖の端っこはフックになっており、簡単に外せる（笑）。ここだけの秘密。道の駅エリアは車中泊車両はめちゃくちゃ多い。GWに来たら広い駐車場がなんと満車状態。幹線道は一晩中トラックの往来がありうるさい。閉鎖される＆ナンバー控えられたりするが、専門店エリアの方が圧倒的に静かではある。wimax使えるのも便利。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■温泉と駅名にあるが、敷地内に温泉が無い。無料の足湯はある。巨大な敷地で、地方によくあるメガストアみたいな感じで、敷地の一角に道の駅がある。店舗エリアは夜間は駐車禁止になるが、駐車禁止の標識をずらすと出入りは可能。ナンバー控えられたりするが、それでもよければ店舗エリアの方が圧倒的に静か。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：道の駅内に足湯がありますが入浴施設はありません。車で１０分のところに入浴施設ゆぴあがあります。朝６：３０-21：００まで営業。道の駅の向かいに２４Ｈのスーパー有。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■夜間も駐車可能なエリアは平日も車中泊いっぱい。トラックもいっぱいでアイドリング音がかなりうるさい。国道の走行音もかなりうるさい。夜間駐車禁止エリアは非常に静かで最高。自己責任で。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■September 2024 Administrator's On-site Verification: Car Camping Rating [A Rank 😄] 83 points 👉️ Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■Bathing ♨️: Day-use bathing is available at the nearby "Sakaeya ​​Hotel" for 800 yen. Details
■Report from our site's reader: The toilets are not washlets. There is a footbath, but it's a shame to come all the way to Tendo Onsen just for a footbath. About a 10-minute walk away, there is a senior welfare facility with a free-flowing hot spring called Hanakoma-so, which was renovated and reopened in 2020. General admission is 350 yen, 250 yen for those 65 and older. The baths are hot and regular temperature (Posted: May 2021, by Wataridori Manyuki)
■Report from our site's reader: I came in 2018, and at night the specialty shop area is really closed off with chains (it used to be just cones). There are also signs prohibiting entry at night. However, the end of the chain is actually a hook and can be easily removed (lol). This is a secret just between us. The roadside station area has a huge number of vehicles parked overnight. When I came during Golden Week, the large parking lot was completely full. The main road is noisy with truck traffic all night long. The specialty store area is overwhelmingly quieter, although it may be closed off and license plates may be recorded. The availability of WiMAX is also convenient. (Older post from before 2019)
■Although it has "hot spring" in its name, there is no hot spring on the premises. There is a free footbath. It's a huge site, like a megastore often found in rural areas, with the roadside station in one corner of the grounds. Parking is prohibited in the store area at night, but you can enter and exit by moving the no-parking signs. Your license plate may be recorded, but if that's okay with you, the store area is overwhelmingly quieter. (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from a reader of this site: There is a footbath inside the roadside station, but there are no bathing facilities. There is a bathing facility, Yupia, a 10-minute drive away. It is open from 6:30 AM to 9:00 PM. There is a 24-hour supermarket across from the roadside station. (Older post from before 2019)
■The area where parking is allowed at night is full of people sleeping in their cars even on weekdays. There are also lots of trucks, and the idling noise is quite loud. The traffic noise from the national highway is also quite loud. The area where nighttime parking is prohibited is extremely quiet and great. Use at your own risk. (Older post from before 2019)

■管理人評価★4.9（泉質4.3、景色特別加算0.6）まず泉質は、無色透明だが香り、味があり、析出物がみとめられる。4.3点。そしてここは、景色が非常にすばらしい。秋の紅葉が非常に美しい。最高レベルの景観。特別加算0.6。合計4.9点の最高レベルの名湯。ただし！ここへのアクセスの道が厳しすぎます！行きは駐車場から極端な急な下り坂で片道20分。足がガクガクになります。帰りは当然登りになるのですが、これが本当にかなりきつい。帰りは休み休みじゃないと登れないので、40分かかります。足の悪い人、心臓の弱い人はこれは無理でしょう。温泉マニアなら一度は来るべきですが、普通の人にはあまりお勧めできません。バイクで来て、下の階段までバイクで行った方がいいでしょう。本気でキツいです。

■1000 yen, details
■Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. The spring water contains sulfur, gypsum, calcium, and sulfate.
■Manager's rating ★4.9 (Spring water quality 4.3, special bonus for scenery 0.6) First, the spring water is colorless and transparent, but has a scent and taste, and mineral deposits can be seen. 4.3 points. And the scenery here is absolutely wonderful. The autumn foliage is incredibly beautiful. Top-level scenery. Special bonus 0.6. A top-level hot spring with a total of 4.9 points. However! The road to get here is extremely difficult! The way there is a very steep downhill slope from the parking lot, a 20-minute walk one way. Your legs will be shaking. The way back is, of course, uphill, and it's really quite tough. You can't climb back up without taking breaks, so it takes 40 minutes. This would be impossible for people with bad legs or weak hearts. Hot spring enthusiasts should come here at least once, but I wouldn't recommend it to the average person. It would be better to come by motorcycle and ride your motorcycle down to the stairs. It's seriously tough.

properties.title_ja: 須川温泉 栗駒山荘
properties.desc_ja:

■立ち寄りも可。温泉自体もいいのですが東北一の絶景 紅葉時期の夕刻は特にいい。紅葉シーズンは露天風呂の眺めが絶景。隣の須川高原温泉は泉質、こちらは眺望が至高。両方入った方が良いと思います。
■管理人評価★5（泉質4.5、景色0.5） 至高。泉質、眺望、共に至高。10月中旬が露天風呂からみる紅葉が絶景。
properties.desc_en:
■1000 yen, details
■Drop-in visits are welcome. The hot spring itself is good, but the view is the best in Tohoku. It's especially beautiful in the evening during the autumn foliage season. The view from the open-air bath is spectacular during the autumn foliage season. The neighboring Sugawa Kogen Onsen has excellent water quality, while this one has superb views. I think you should try both.

■Manager's rating ★5 (Water quality 4.5, View 0.5) Superb. Both the water quality and the view are superb. The view of the autumn leaves from the open-air bath in mid-October is spectacular.

■百名湯ではないが、眺望、泉質ともにすばらしい。日本海の日没が美しい。交通の便は最悪。多数の温泉マニア絶賛。海辺の湯船から日没を見るのは宿泊じゃないとできません。
■管理人評価：★5（泉質4.5、景色0.5）至高の名湯、日本海の水平線に沈む夕日を眺められるというのが素晴らしい、泉質も濃厚な茶褐色で何も言うことなし。
properties.desc_en:
■1000 yen, details
■Not one of the top 100 hot springs, but the view and water quality are superb. The sunset over the Sea of ​​Japan is beautiful. Access is terrible. Highly praised by many hot spring enthusiasts. You can only see the sunset from the seaside bath if you stay overnight.

■Manager's rating: ★5 (Water quality 4.5, view 0.5) A supreme hot spring, it's wonderful to be able to watch the sunset sinking over the horizon of the Sea of ​​Japan, and the water quality is a rich reddish-brown, nothing more to say.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■1000円、詳細
■ナトリウム硫酸塩 炭酸水素塩塩化物泉
■管理人評価★4.5（泉質4.3、景色0.2） 泉質、雰囲気は申し分ない。足下湧出で透明。足下が板敷きでそこから温泉が噴き出している。風呂からの眺望が無いが、風呂場は雰囲気たっぷりのため0.2の加算。裏の蔦沼が紅葉の絶景ポイント。
properties.desc_en:
■1000 yen, details
■Sodium sulfate bicarbonate chloride spring
■Manager's rating ★4.5 (Spring quality 4.3, Scenery 0.2) The spring quality and atmosphere are excellent. The water is clear and springs up from the ground. The ground is covered with wooden planks and the hot spring water gushes out from there. There is no view from the bath, but the bath area has a great atmosphere, so 0.2 is added. The Tsutanuma marsh behind the bath is a great spot for viewing autumn leaves.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 吾妻高湯温泉 玉子湯
properties.desc_ja:
■1000円、詳細
■硫黄泉（含石膏明ばん硫化水素泉）、乳青色、超有名旅館。
■管理人評価★5（泉質4.5、景色0.5）日帰りの場合は内湯、湯小屋、露天の三カ所入れる。まず泉質は乳青白色の美しい濁り湯。満点。そして景色も美しい。秋の紅葉がすばらしい。玉子湯の湯小屋の風情もすばらしい。満点評価です。
properties.desc_en:
■1000 yen, details
■Sulfur spring (containing gypsum alum hydrogen sulfide spring), milky blue, extremely famous inn.
■Manager's rating ★5 (Spring quality 4.5, Scenery 0.5) For day trips, you can use three places: indoor bath, bathhouse, and open-air bath. First of all, the spring quality is a beautiful milky blue-white cloudy water. Perfect score. And the scenery is also beautiful. The autumn foliage is wonderful. The atmosphere of the Tamagoyu bathhouse is also wonderful. Perfect score.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■1000円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：２０２３年９月の週末に利用。伝説のお風呂ですね。強酸性(pH1.6)で硫黄臭が強いです。混浴のヒバ千人風呂は女性用に湯衣が販売（1300円！）されています。もちろん男性のようにタオルで隠しても構いません。そういう女性も複数いました。日帰り入浴は１８時までですが、食事処は早く終わってしまいます。（投稿：2023年10月、n様）
■超有名温泉、混浴マニアの聖地。これでなんと「すかゆ」と読む。言わずと知れた、超有名温泉。混浴の聖地。泉質は強酸性で含二酸化炭素・鉄・硫黄−アルミニウム−硫酸・塩化物泉
■管理人評価★4.7（泉質4.5、景色は風呂の雰囲気とか面白いので0.2加算） 泉質は申し分ないです。言うことなし。名物の混浴大風呂は、人多すぎてあまりのんびりはできない。あと若い女性が入ってきたら、おっさんたちがそわそわするのがアレですね。混浴大風呂と、男女別の内湯セットで1000円なので、ゆっくりしたい人はそちらで。泉質は言うことないが、眺望のよい露天風呂が無いのでこの評価。露天風呂作ればいいのに。あと、ここの食堂のそばが十割そばの本格派で結構美味いです。おにぎり、おでんも美味しい。
properties.desc_en:
■1000 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: Used on a weekend in September 2023. This is a legendary bath. It's highly acidic (pH 1.6) and has a strong sulfurous smell. In the mixed-gender Hiba Sennin-buro (thousand-person bath), bathrobes are sold for women (1300 yen!). Of course, you can also cover yourself with a towel like the men. There were several women doing that. Day-use bathing is available until 6pm, but the restaurant closes earlier. (Posted: October 2023, by n)
■A super famous hot spring, a holy site for mixed-gender bathing enthusiasts. This is pronounced "Sukayu". A super famous hot spring that needs no introduction. A holy site for mixed-gender bathing. The spring water is highly acidic and contains carbon dioxide, iron, sulfur, aluminum, sulfate, and chloride.
■Administrator's rating ★4.7 (Spring water quality 4.5, added 0.2 for the scenery and the interesting atmosphere of the bath) The spring water quality is impeccable. Nothing more to say. The famous mixed-gender large bath is too crowded to really relax. Also, it's a bit awkward when the older men get restless when young women come in. The mixed-gender large bath and the separate indoor baths for men and women are available as a set for 1000 yen, so if you want to relax, that's the way to go. The quality of the spring water is excellent, but the lack of an open-air bath with a good view is why it's rated this way. They should really build an open-air bath. Also, the soba noodles at the restaurant here are authentic 100% buckwheat noodles and are quite delicious. The rice balls and oden are also tasty.

properties.title_en: Oedo Onsen Monogatari Premium Sendai Sakunami (formerly: Sakunami Onsen Iwamatsu Ryokan)
properties.desc_ja:
■1,200円、詳細。大江戸温泉物語になってリニューアル。秋がオススメ。
■管理人評価★4.9(泉質4.1、景色特別加算0.8)異常に高いですが、管理人は入ってみてその価格に納得しました。川沿いの岩風呂が最高に美しい。美しすぎる。秋が最高に美しい。景色は至高です。景色は夏油より上で、鷹の湯温泉と同格です。ただ、、、泉質が惜しい！悪くはないのですが、無色透明で香りも弱いです。ぜひ秋に来てください。ちなみに正岡子規もここに泊まったそうです。温泉博士の松田教授も大絶賛。ここの秋の景色は本当に最高。思い出すだけで涙が出そう。
properties.desc_en:
■1,200 yen, details. Renovated as Oedo Onsen Monogatari. Autumn is recommended.

■Manager's rating ★4.9 (Spring quality 4.1, Special bonus for scenery 0.8) It's unusually high, but after visiting, I was convinced it was worth the price. The rock bath along the river is absolutely beautiful. Too beautiful. Autumn is the most beautiful. The scenery is sublime. The scenery is better than Geto and on par with Takanoyu Onsen. However... the spring quality is a shame! It's not bad, but it's colorless and transparent and has a weak scent. Please come in autumn. Incidentally, Masaoka Shiki is said to have stayed here as well. Professor Matsuda, the hot spring expert, also highly praises it. The autumn scenery here is truly the best. Just thinking about it brings tears to my eyes.

properties.desc_ja:
■1,000円、詳細
■管理人評価★5.0（泉質4.5、景色0.5）時間帯によって入れる風呂が違うので、HPをよく見てから来てください。また、清掃が13〜14時まで入ることがあります。電話して予定を確認しておくと良いと思います。管理人は、12時に入館して、うまく全部のお風呂にはいれました。男性の日帰りは4つ風呂に入れます。まず鬼面の湯は、濃厚な乳青白色の露天風呂。紅葉が美しい。満点。千寿の湯は濃厚な白濁した濁り湯。木造の湯小屋の趣もすばらしい。天狗の湯は濃厚な乳青白色の露天風呂。剣の湯は、透明なクセのない湯。ここ、かなりオススメです。800円出す価値あります。隣の相模屋さんよりも、正直満足度は高いです。満点評価。至高の温泉宿です。
properties.desc_en:
■1,000 yen, details
■Manager's rating ★5.0 (Spring quality 4.5, Scenery 0.5) The baths you can use vary depending on the time of day, so please check the website carefully before coming. Also, cleaning may take place from 13:00 to 14:00. It is a good idea to call and check the schedule. The manager entered at 12:00 and was able to use all the baths. Men on day trips can use 4 baths. First, Onimen-no-yu is an open-air bath with rich milky-blue water. The autumn leaves are beautiful. Perfect score. Senju-no-yu is a rich, cloudy white hot spring. The charm of the wooden bathhouse is also wonderful. Tengu-no-yu is an open-air bath with rich milky-blue water. Ken-no-yu is a clear, mild hot spring. I highly recommend this place. It is worth the 800 yen. To be honest, I am more satisfied than with the neighboring Sagamiya. Perfect score. A supreme hot spring inn.

■管理人評価★5（泉質4.5、景色0.5） 非常に素晴らしい。秋が特に素晴らしい。文句のつけようがない。ロッカーは有料100円なので貴重品入れるコンビニ袋を持参して風呂まで持って行きましょう。予想以上に素晴らしかったです。秋にもう一度行きたい。
properties.desc_en:

■A large, highly acidic sulfur spring bath is located on two levels. If you want to use the washing area, head down to the Genshichi Open-Air Bath. The autumn foliage is beautiful.

■Manager's rating ★5 (Spring quality 4.5, Scenery 0.5) Absolutely wonderful. Autumn is especially wonderful. There's nothing to complain about. Lockers cost 100 yen, so bring a convenience store bag to put your valuables in and take it with you to the bath. It was even better than expected. I want to go again in the autumn.

■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレは和式のポットン。夜は誰も来ないので非常に静かで朝まで爆睡。住宅街に近いので、明るいうちから駐車していると通報されて職質の可能性はある。トイレが和式のポットンなので、寝る前に道の駅でトイレを済ませてからここで寝ると良い。トイレがやばい以外は最高。（2022年9月管理人現地確認）

■Bathing ♨️: There is a public bathhouse "Yokohama Onsen" nearby for 350 yen. Details
■Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. The toilets are Japanese-style pit toilets. No one comes at night, so it's very quiet and you can sleep soundly until morning. Since it's close to a residential area, there's a possibility of being reported and questioned by the police if you park there during the day. Since the toilets are Japanese-style pit toilets, it's a good idea to use the toilets at the roadside station before going to sleep here. It's great except for the toilets. (September 2022, on-site verification by the administrator)

■当サイト読者様レポート：2019年9月利用。むつ市内で食事、グランドHの立ち寄り温泉で入浴の後、ここで車中泊。静かで快適でした。ほぼ満車なので人気の車中泊スポットかと思いきや、ほとんどの車が無人。これ、周囲の人たちが便利な無料駐車場として活用？しているのか？（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：綺麗な洋式外トイレ棟有り。男性側は小×2子器、大×2部屋。駐車場の注意書きには「駐車を確認してから5日以上経過した場合は対処する」との記載有り。JR本州最北端の駅ではあるが、それを気付かせる看板などが無いのが不思議。車で15分走って「むつグランドホテル」で温泉に入れる。露天有りで快適。婚礼や同窓会などで駐車場はとても混んでいるが、裏のほうにイベント広場のような場所有りで離れるが止められる詳細（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：出入り自由で問題無く寝れます。トイレも終日利用可、きれいで明かりは人感センサー。ＧＳ、すき家至近。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is possible. (Survey conducted in September 2024)
■Report from a reader of this site: Used in September 2019. Had a meal in Mutsu City, took a bath at the hot springs at the Grand Hotel, and then stayed overnight in the car here. It was quiet and comfortable. It was almost full, so I thought it was a popular spot for overnight parking, but most of the cars were empty. Are people in the surrounding area using this as a convenient free parking lot? (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from a reader of this site: There is a clean Western-style outdoor toilet building. The men's side has two urinals and two stalls. The parking lot notice states that "action will be taken if more than 5 days have passed since the parking was confirmed." It is the northernmost JR station on Honshu, but it is strange that there are no signs to make people aware of this. You can take a 15-minute drive to the hot springs at "Mutsu Grand Hotel". It has an open-air bath and is comfortable. The parking lot is very crowded due to weddings and reunions, but there is an event plaza-like area at the back where you can park, albeit a bit further away. (Details from an older post before 2019)
■Report from a reader of this site: You can come and go freely and sleep there without any problems. The toilets are available all day, are clean, and have motion-sensor lights. Gas station and Sukiya are very close. (Older post before 2019)

The parking lot in front of Tashirodaira Marshland has toilets available and overnight parking is possible. (On-site confirmation by administrator September 2023)
■About overnight parking and paranormal phenomena 👻
■Free parking and public toilets. I was surprised that the toilets were very clean, simple flush Western-style toilets. The lights work even at night. It's a haunted spot, but the administrator doesn't believe in ghosts at all, so I slept soundly until morning (lol). Cell phone reception is also fine. It's cool even in summer at an altitude of 560m. This place is seriously the best. (On-site confirmation by administrator September 2020)
■Report from a reader of this site: Toilets available. Hot springs across the road. However, it is a famous haunted spot. It looks like you'd need a very strong heart to do this. (Older post from before 2019)

■当サイト読者様レポート：無料・無人のキャンプ場。トイレは和洋水洗で洗面蛇口もあるが、飲用可否は不明。広大な駐車場・トイレとも夜間使用可。テントサイトはやや凹凸あるが車両乗り入れ可。道路から離れた方は静か。周囲が開けていて気持ちが良い。400ｍ北の駒込駐車場は密林の中にあって熊が心配だが、こちらは木立が無く車通りも見えて少しは安心。標高600ｍ、冬季は多分閉鎖、2024年6月現地利用。参考ストリートビュー：広大な駐車場の中央奥がトイレ　左右が車両乗り入れ可能なフリーテントサイト。駒込駐車場トイレ内に添付写真のような案内看板が保存してありました→添付画像、添付画像（投稿：2024年7月、草の湯様）

■Report from our site's reader: Free, unmanned campsite. The toilets are Japanese and Western style flush toilets with sinks, but it is unclear whether the water is potable. The vast parking lot and toilets are usable at night. The tent sites are somewhat uneven, but vehicles can be driven in. The areas away from the road are quiet. The surroundings are open and pleasant. The Komagome parking lot 400m north is in a dense forest and bears are a concern, but this area has no trees and you can see the roads, making it a little safer. Elevation 600m, probably closed in winter, on-site visit in June 2024. Reference Street View: The toilet is in the back center of the vast parking lot, with free tent sites accessible by vehicle on the left and right. An information sign like the one in the attached photo was found preserved inside the restroom at Komagome Parking Lot. → Attached image, Attached image (Posted by: Kusanoyu, July 2024)

properties.desc_ja:
■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2025年6月現地調査）
■入浴♨️：名湯「酸ヶ湯」（すかゆ）まで徒歩3分（1000円、詳細）
■当サイト読者様レポート：十和田湖方面から深夜に向かいました。道中は暗闇、濃霧、クマ注意看板で非常に怖かったです。到着すると凄まじい硫黄の匂いがします。周りには数台の車が止まっていました。トイレは２４時間使えます。センサーライトがついています。深夜に車から降りてトイレに向かうまでにクマに遭わないか不安になります。（投稿：2024年9月、ゆーぷる様）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is possible. (On-site survey conducted in June 2025)
■Bathing ♨️: 3-minute walk to the famous "Sukayu" hot spring (1000 yen, details)
■Report from a reader of this site: I headed there late at night from the Lake Towada area. The journey was very scary with darkness, dense fog, and bear warning signs. Upon arrival, there was an overwhelming smell of sulfur. Several cars were parked nearby. The toilets are available 24 hours a day. They have sensor lights. I was worried about encountering a bear when getting out of the car in the middle of the night to go to the toilet. (Submitted by Yu-puru in September 2024)

properties.desc_ja:
■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2025年6月現地調査）
■ここで撮影された天の川写真を見てみる
■入浴♨️：700円払って恐山菩提寺に入場すると無料の温泉に入れる。
■特級クラスの心霊スポットなので注意（笑）。車中泊と心霊現象👻について
■天体観測スポット。天の川撮影スポット。標高は219m。天の川を肉眼で視認できた。トイレは夜間も利用可能だった（水洗洋式でキレイ）。ここはカルデラ（火山の火口）であり、全方位の視野がガッツリ開けている。PM2.5の影響も少なく、クリアな星空を堪能した。（2019年5月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is possible. (On-site survey, June 2025)
■See photos of the Milky Way taken here
■Bathing ♨️: If you pay 700 yen to enter Osorezan Bodaiji Temple, you can use the hot springs for free.

■Be careful, this is a top-class haunted spot (lol). About overnight parking and paranormal phenomena 👻
■Astronomical observation spot. Milky Way photography spot. The elevation is 219m. The Milky Way was visible to the naked eye. The toilets were available at night (clean, flush toilets). This is a caldera (volcanic crater), and the view is wide open in all directions. There was little influence from PM2.5, and we enjoyed a clear starry sky. (On-site confirmation by administrator, May 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 多賀城跡 管理棟駐車場
properties.title_en: [Quiet] Tagajo Ruins Management Building Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja:
■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2024年9月現地調査）
■当サイト読者様レポート：無料、24時間、トイレ有り、普通車16台駐車可。多賀城市の管理事務所隣にある一般向け駐車場。日本百名城のスタンプはこの事務所(全日8:30から17:00)でもらえる。多賀城跡の中心地である政庁跡の北隣にある駐車場。すごく狭い道路の三叉路にあるが西側から入ったほうが少しはまし。東南方向の道は深く広い側溝があちこちにあり危険。夜間はちょっと寂しく感じるが少し交通量のある道路がすぐそばにある。コンビニやスーパーは1km以内にある。観光客は南側のいくつかの駐車場を利用するのがほとんどで、ここを使う人は地元民でもほとんどいない。（投稿：2023年12月、t様）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is permitted. (Survey conducted in September 2024)
■Report from a reader of this site: Free, 24 hours, toilets available, parking for 16 regular cars. A public parking lot located next to the Tagajo City Management Office. The stamp for the "100 Famous Castles of Japan" can be obtained at this office (open daily from 8:30 to 17:00). The parking lot is located north of the government office ruins, the central area of ​​the Tagajo ruins. It is at a three-way intersection on a very narrow road, but it is slightly better to enter from the west. The road to the southeast has deep, wide ditches everywhere, making it dangerous. It feels a little lonely at night, but there is a road with some traffic nearby. There are convenience stores and supermarkets within 1km. Most tourists use the several parking lots on the south side, and hardly anyone, even locals, uses this one. (Submitted by: t, December 2023)

■当サイト読者様レポート：合浦公園（西南の駐車場）2019年9月利用。公園の駐車場は複数あるようですが、野球場の東側の駐車場を利用しました。駐車場の東側と北側にトイレが2ヶ所ありますが、北側のほうが新しくてキレイです。但しトイレットペーパーが備えられていないので要注意です（イタズラ等の対策とのこと）。隣がコンビニです。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。幹線道から離れており静かで非常に良い。駐車場から北に100mほどのところに水洗洋式のきれいな公衆トイレがある。桜シーズンは一回500円の有料駐車場になるが18時以降は無料で停められる。wimaxも電波OK。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■非常に静かで朝まで爆睡してしまった。最高。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is possible. (September 2024 site survey)
■Report from our site's reader: Gappo Park (southwest parking lot), used in September 2019. There seem to be multiple parking lots in the park, but I used the one east of the baseball field. There are two toilets, one on the east side and one on the north side of the parking lot, but the one on the north side is newer and cleaner. However, be aware that there is no toilet paper provided (apparently to prevent vandalism). There is a convenience store next door. (Older post from before 2019)
■Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. It is away from the main road and very quiet, which is great. There is a clean public toilet with a flush toilet about 100m north of the parking lot. During cherry blossom season, it becomes a paid parking lot at 500 yen per use, but it is free after 6 PM. WiMAX signal is OK. (Older post from before 2019)
■It was very quiet and I slept soundly until morning. The best. (Older posts from before 2019)

properties.desc_ja: ■「焼き鳥」（豚のカシラ肉）で有名なお店。「焼き鳥」は3本から注文でき、タレ、塩、ともに絶品（管理人はいつも塩2本、タレ1本を注文）。塩ラーメン、卵かけご飯も美味い。土日はものすごい待ち時間になる。開店前にウェイティングシートに名前を書いておくのがおすすめ。焼き鳥は土日祝は9時から注文できるが、平日は10:30すぎくらいから注文可能なので注意。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■ A restaurant famous for its "yakitori" (pork head meat). You can order yakitori in sets of three, and both the sauce and salt versions are excellent (the reviewer always orders two salt and one sauce). The salt ramen and egg rice are also delicious. There is a huge wait on weekends. It is recommended to write your name on the waiting list before the restaurant opens. Yakitori can be ordered from 9am on weekends and holidays, but on weekdays it can only be ordered from around 10:30am, so please be aware of that. Tabelog

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■「あおに」と読む。無色透明無味無臭のアルカリ性単純泉
■600円、詳細
■管理人評価★4.8（泉質4.0、景色特別加算0.8） 泉質は正直物足りないが、景観がとにかく凄すぎる。露天風呂から大きな滝が見えるし、紅葉も美しい。建物の雰囲気もすばらしい。、、、が、泉質がアルカリ性単純泉というのが惜しい！これで濁り湯、あるいは硫黄臭があれば満点なのだが、惜しい。申し訳ないですが、満点の泉質とは言えないのでちょい減点。でも卓越した極上の温泉宿なのは間違いないです。秋が超おすすめ。美しすぎる。これで酸ヶ湯の泉質だったら最強なんですが。とりあえず景観は全国最高峰かと思います。また秋に行きたいです。
properties.desc_en:
■ Pronounced "Aoni". Colorless, transparent, tasteless, and odorless alkaline simple spring water.
■ 600 yen, details
■ Manager's rating ★4.8 (Spring quality 4.0, special bonus for scenery 0.8) The spring quality is honestly a bit disappointing, but the scenery is absolutely amazing. You can see a large waterfall from the open-air bath, and the autumn leaves are beautiful. The atmosphere of the building is also wonderful. ...However, it's a shame that the spring water is alkaline simple spring water! If it were cloudy or had a sulfurous smell, it would be perfect, but it's a pity. I'm sorry, but I can't say the spring quality is perfect, so I've deducted a few points. But it is undoubtedly an outstanding, superb hot spring inn. Autumn is highly recommended. It's too beautiful. If it had the same spring quality as Sukayu, it would be the best. Anyway, I think the scenery is among the best in the country. I want to go again in the autumn.

properties.desc_ja: ■新東名のSA。マークはおおよその場所。2028年度（令和10年度）以降オープン予定。中日本高速道路は、トンネル工事の難航などで遅れた新秦野IC―新御殿場IC（静岡県御殿場市）の約25キロ区間について、開通予定を5年後の2027年度と発表した。この区間が開通すると、新東名は海老名南ジャンクション（JCT、海老名市）―豊田東JCT（愛知県豊田市）の全線約253キロが一本につながる。同時に秦野丹沢スマートICのそばには、秦野丹沢サービスエリアも開業予定だ。
properties.desc_en: ■Service areas on the Shin-Tomei Expressway. The marks indicate approximate locations. Scheduled to open in fiscal year 2028 (Reiwa 10) or later. Central Nippon Expressway Company announced that the approximately 25-kilometer section between Shin-Hadano IC and Shin-Gotemba IC (Gotemba City, Shizuoka Prefecture), which has been delayed due to difficulties in tunnel construction, will now open in fiscal year 2027, five years from now. Once this section opens, the entire 253-kilometer Shin-Tomei Expressway from Ebina-Minami Junction (JCT, Ebina City) to Toyota-Higashi JCT (Toyota City, Aichi Prefecture) will be connected as a single line. At the same time, the Hadano-Tanzawa Service Area is also scheduled to open near the Hadano-Tanzawa Smart IC.

■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2026年3月現地調査）
■【予定】上り側PAは2026年オープン予定。
■旧名：鬼高PA。2018年4月24日待望のグランドオープン！下り線のみなので注意。残念ながら立体構造で、駐車場は３階にある。トラックが来ると揺れる。揺れる場所は熟睡は無理です。ここは車中泊用途にはおすすめしません。京葉道路下り本線と、京葉道路下りの市川IC入り口から本PAに入ることができます。デイリーヤマザキ併設。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the restrooms 🚻. Overnight parking is possible. (Survey conducted in March 2026)
■[Planned] The northbound PA is scheduled to open in 2026.

■Former name: Onitaka PA. The long-awaited grand opening was on April 24, 2018! Note that it is only for the southbound lane. Unfortunately, it is a multi-story structure, and the parking lot is on the 3rd floor. It shakes when trucks come by. It is impossible to sleep soundly in a shaking area. This place is not recommended for overnight parking. You can enter this PA from the southbound main line of the Keiyo Expressway and from the Ichikawa IC entrance on the southbound Keiyo Expressway. Daily Yamazaki convenience store is located on the premises. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station + Shower
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 発酵の里こうざき
properties.title_en: Roadside Station Hakko no Sato Kozaki
properties.desc_ja:
■2024年12月管理人現地確認：車中泊評価【良😊】74点👉️現地の写真・詳細案内図はこちら
■【シャワー🚿あり】道の駅で受付、一回300円、9－17時
■当サイト読者様レポート：国道沿いにしては比較的静か。緩い傾斜地にあるため、気にならない程度の若干の勾配あり。コンビニ併設。深夜の珍走団、週末の早朝はツーリング軍団の集合、休憩場でうるさいかも。少し離れた保冷、冷凍トラックのアイドリング音あり。　トイレは遠くなりますが、道を挟み東側の「第二駐車場」(高速バス利用者兼用)は平らで夜間は車の出入りが少なく熟睡できます。早朝、ガテン系が集合、車乗り捨て→相乗り場にしてるので、入口近くはうるさい可能性あり。（投稿：2022年5月、a様）
■平成27年4月29日オープン。
properties.desc_en:
■December 2024 Administrator's On-site Verification: Car Camping Rating [Good 😊] 74 points 👉️Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■[Showers 🚿 Available] Reception at the roadside station, 300 yen per use, 9am-5pm
■Report from a reader of this site: Relatively quiet for a location along a national highway. Located on a gentle slope, there is a slight incline that is not bothersome. Convenience store attached. May be noisy at night due to motorcycle gangs and early morning gatherings of touring groups on weekends. There is idling noise from refrigerated and frozen trucks a short distance away. The toilets are far away, but the "Second Parking Lot" (shared with highway bus users) on the east side across the road is flat and has little traffic at night, allowing for a good night's sleep. Early in the morning, construction workers gather and abandon their cars, using it as a ride-sharing area, so it may be noisy near the entrance. (Posted: May 2022, by A)
■Opened April 29, 2015.

■当サイト読者様レポート：夜はものすごく静かで快眠できます。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: Due to large-scale construction, the quiet, large temporary gravel parking lot on the south side has been replaced by a park and disappeared. The roadside station parking lot has become enormous, and a sign saying "No overnight parking in vehicles" has been posted at the entrance. See attached image (Posted: May 2026, by user a)

■ Reader Report: As previously reported, it is very quiet at night, but the temporary gravel parking lot at the back of the southwest side is even quieter, completely silent, and the ground is level, allowing for a good night's sleep. There are houses nearby, which provides a sense of security. It might even be considered one of the best places at the roadside station for a good night's sleep. (Posted: June 2023, by a reader)

■ Reader Report: It is extremely quiet at night, allowing for a good night's sleep. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：1回500円。寸又峡の日帰り温泉では1番営業時間が長い。9:00～不明、不明～21:00(最終受付)。夜と朝に入浴し女将さんからの情報なので正確なはず。公式サイトには記載されていない。私は8:30から入浴させて貰えた。シャンプーボディソープあり。3名ほどしか入れず狭いが古めの雰囲気とお湯は良い。宿泊者では無い為、礼儀正しく、感謝しながらお湯を頂きたい。(周辺の日帰り温泉が掲載されている、大井川実行委員会公式サイト⇨詳細)（投稿：2026年5月、s様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: 500 yen per visit. It has the longest operating hours of any day-trip hot spring in Sumatakyo. 9:00 AM - unknown, unknown - 9:00 PM (last entry). I bathed there in the morning and evening and the information came from the proprietress, so it should be accurate. It's not listed on the official website. I was allowed to bathe from 8:30 AM. Shampoo and body soap are provided. It's small, only fitting about 3 people, but the old-fashioned atmosphere and the water are good. Since I wasn't an overnight guest, I wanted to be polite and grateful while enjoying the bath. (For more information on nearby day-trip hot springs, see the Oigawa Executive Committee official website ⇨ details) (Posted: May 2026, by s)

■当サイト読者様レポート：夢の吊り橋に近い。砂利の平ら。坂を下った所にとても綺麗なトイレあり。近隣にはいくつも有料駐車場があり、大体1回500円。小銭を用意しておこう。秘境の温泉郷なのでもちろん静か。ちなみに、温泉郷までの道のりは決して楽では無い。特に静岡市からの国道362号線はおすすめできない。いずれもなるべく明るいうちに到着すべし。（投稿：2026年5月、s様）
properties.desc_en:
■Bathing♨️: There are many day-trip hot springs in the surrounding area. ⇨Try searching for them.
■Report from a reader of this site: It's close to the Dream Suspension Bridge. It's a flat, gravel area. There's a very clean toilet down the slope. There are several paid parking lots nearby, usually around 500 yen per visit. Be sure to have some change ready. It's a secluded hot spring village, so of course it's quiet. By the way, the road to the hot spring village is not easy. I especially don't recommend taking National Route 362 from Shizuoka City. In any case, you should try to arrive while it's still light. (Posted: May 2026, by s)

■入浴♨️：周辺に日帰り入浴多数あり。⇨探してみる
■当サイト読者様レポート：温泉街の手前に広い駐車場が有ります。夜間も使用可能なトイレ有り。土曜日でしたが、有料500円と表示されていますが料金箱が有るのみで管理人は居ませんでした。多分、平日は無料と思います。♨日帰り入浴可能な温泉旅館多数有り。一番手前の旅館はタオル持参で大人500円でした。ツルツルのお湯です。蕎麦屋が有りましたがコンビニ等は無いので食事には注意が必要です。星がキレイな所のようですが周囲が山で見通しは良くないです。途中の道は対向車とすれ違い出来ない所がかなり有り混む時期は大変かも。グリーンの湖面の吊り橋が有名な所ですが残念ながら渇水期なのか水位が低く期待外れでした。(４月上旬)90分くらい歩きます。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■標高534m
properties.desc_en:
■ 500 yen per day (until midnight), 1000 yen for an overnight stay, details
■ Bathing ♨️: Many day-trip baths are available in the surrounding area. ⇨ Try searching for them
■ Report from our site's readers: There is a large parking lot just before the hot spring town. There are toilets that can be used at night. It was a Saturday, and although it was marked as a paid bath for 500 yen, there was only a payment box and no attendant. I think it's probably free on weekdays. ♨ Many hot spring inns offer day-trip bathing. The inn closest to the entrance charged 500 yen for adults if you bring your own towel. The water is very smooth. There was a soba noodle shop, but there are no convenience stores, so be careful about what you eat. It seems to be a place where the stars are beautiful, but the surrounding area is mountainous and visibility is not good. There are many places on the road where it is difficult to pass oncoming cars, so it may be difficult during busy seasons. It is famous for its suspension bridge over a green lake, but unfortunately, the water level was low, perhaps due to the dry season, which was disappointing. (Early April) It takes about 90 minutes to walk. (Older posts from before 2019)
■ Elevation 534m

■ Report from a reader of this site: Visited April 2026. Consists of four buildings: a toilet/information center, a local vegetable shop/cafe, a public bath, and a pottery studio. There are two parking lots. I camped in the parking lot on the toilet/information center side. Although it was a weekday, I was the only car camping in both parking lots combined. As reported, there is a chicken coop adjacent to it, where music is played all day, and the lights are turned on from midnight to create a daytime atmosphere, resulting in a loud chorus of chickens. There is no smell. Combined with the howling of dogs, it honestly creates a strange atmosphere. The distance is just right, so it may not bother some people. Toilets: 24-hour access, indoors, 3 urinals, 2 stalls (with bidet). WIFI: WiMAX = 1 bar signal, almost unreliable. Supermarket & Convenience Store: FamilyMart, about 5-10 minutes by car from the roadside station. There are no supermarkets on the mountain side from the interchange on the National Highway 1, so it's best to stock up in this area. For emergencies, the aforementioned FamilyMart is the best option. (Posted by: Clipper's Gussan, April 2026)

properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight stays in vehicles are permitted. (On-site survey conducted in March 2026)

I was able to comfortably stay overnight in my vehicle. 2023.10.05 *Postscript: I will be staying overnight in my vehicle again tonight. It is still open 24 hours. There are no signs indicating otherwise. There are no DNQs either. The toilets are separate for men and women. The sinks in the men's toilet do not have water, but the sinks right inside the building have plenty of water. It is easy to wash your teeth and face. The streetlights in the park and parking lot turn off at 10pm, but the lights from the truck parking lot make it quite bright. Additional information. (Posted by: w, October 2023)
