■西側の「川の駅」にシャワー🚿あり。100円2分、9-17時。
■当サイト読者様レポート：利用日2023/10/14（土）。昼間は穏やかでタリーズ、セブンのほか寿司屋やレストランなどあり、観光客で賑わう。毎週金曜日はローカルラジオのライブスタジオ放送も。夜は一転、地元の若者が集合しマフラー音がうるさい改造車の出入りがあり夜半までうるさい。この日は雨だったので10時ごろには静かになった。道を挟んだ川の駅に小さめの駐車場あり、そちらの方が静かかもしれない。ただ、川の駅にはキャンプ施設が併設されているが、そちらのレビューではそちらも落ち着かないとの声あり。（投稿：2023年10月、ジル415様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2022年11月の日曜夜に利用。タリーズ、7-11、沼津魚がし寿司、洋食レストランなどがあります。隣はわさびミュージアムとめんたいパーク。建屋の背後が伊豆中央道ですが、建物を挟んだところに駐めればクルマの騒音はブロックできます。しかしこの晩は若者のグループが駐車場の真ん中で夜半過ぎまで大声で談笑していました。私は常時使用している耳栓のおかげでほとんど気になりませんでしたが、同行者は何度も目が覚めたと怒っていました。EV Quickがあります。（投稿：2022年12月、n様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2017年5月1日オープン。売店・レストラン9:00〜18:00営業。24hコンビニ併設。主要国道に接しているため道路と離れた所を選ぶと良い。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■March 2026 Administrator's On-Site Verification: Car Camping Rating [Good 😊] 77 points 👉️Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■There is a shower 🚿 at the "River Station" on the west side. 100 yen for 2 minutes, 9am-5pm.

■Report from a reader of this site: Date of use: October 14, 2023 (Saturday). During the day it is calm and bustling with tourists, with Tully's, 7-Eleven, sushi restaurants, and other restaurants. There is also a live studio broadcast of local radio every Friday. At night, however, it changes completely, with local young people gathering and noisy modified cars coming and going until midnight. It was raining that day, so it became quiet around 10pm. There is a small parking lot at the River Station across the road, which may be quieter. However, there is a camping facility attached to the River Station, and reviews of that facility mention that it is also not very peaceful. (Posted: October 2023, by Jill415)
■Report from our site's reader: Used on a Sunday night in November 2022. There is a Tully's, 7-Eleven, Numazu Uogashi Sushi, and a Western-style restaurant. Next door are the Wasabi Museum and Mentai Park. The Izu Chuo Expressway is behind the building, but if you park on the other side of the building, you can block out the noise from cars. However, on this night, a group of young people were chatting loudly in the middle of the parking lot until past midnight. Thanks to the earplugs I always wear, I was hardly bothered, but my companion was angry because they woke up several times. There is an EV Quick. (Posted: December 2022, by n)
■Report from our site's reader: Opened on May 1, 2017. Shops and restaurants are open from 9:00 to 18:00. There is a 24-hour convenience store. Since it is adjacent to a major national highway, it is best to choose a spot away from the road. (Older post from before 2019)

■当サイト読者様レポート：3月連休に利用。無料駐車場、南北二箇所に水洗トイレあり。外観おしゃれで中はそこそこ綺麗、ウォッシュレット無し。セブンイレブンが目の前、里見の湯、スーパーまで車で5分とアクセス良し。道路沿いのため静かとは言い難いが海の目前で夕陽がとても美しい。朝は釣り客とビーチアクティビティ、サイクリング客で賑やか。人気エリアのため夏は混雑しそう。（投稿：2026年3月、o様）
■目の前が海岸で、晴れている日は富士山が見える。サンセットが素晴らしい！トイレは道路向かいのローソンのを使う。公衆トイレはない。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Used during the March long weekend. Free parking, and flush toilets in two locations, north and south. The exterior is stylish and the interior is reasonably clean, but there are no bidet toilets. There is a 7-Eleven right in front, and it's a 5-minute drive to Satomi no Yu hot spring and a supermarket, so access is good. It's not exactly quiet because it's along the road, but the sunset is very beautiful as it's right by the sea. In the morning, it's lively with anglers, beach activity enthusiasts, and cyclists. It's a popular area, so it's likely to be crowded in the summer. (Posted: March 2026, by Mr. O)

■The beach is right in front, and you can see Mt. Fuji on clear days. The sunset is amazing! Use the toilet at the Lawson across the road. There are no public toilets. (Older post from before 2019)

There are other parking lots around the dam. It is not crowded except when the daffodils and Kawazu cherry blossoms are in bloom (January to early March). There is a bathing facility called Shouraku no Yu (500 yen for adults, details) within a 10-minute drive, but it closes at 4 PM on weekdays and 7 PM on weekends and holidays. There are no convenience stores nearby, so you need to go to National Route 127 near the coast. (Submitted by Nagio-san, March 2026)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area

■有料高速PA（👉️トイレの写真はこちら）。車中泊可能ではあるが、うるさいのでおすすめしない。（2024年12月管理人現地確認）
■当サイト読者様レポート：大型車と普通乗用車のエリアが完全に分離されているのは良い。携帯電波問題なし。wimaxも利用可能。wifiも利用可能。ファミマもある。夜（1時以降）は比較的静かで耳栓すればそれなりに寝られる。しかし、駐車場全体が立体の建造物なので、横を車が走ると少し振動が来る。この揺れがあると深く寝られない。駐車場所は、行き止まりの場所はなく、基本的にすべて走行導線上にあるので、この揺れを避けられる場所は無い。また、夜中の１時ごろまで爆音のアホ（ランボルギーニ？スカイライン？）がアクアラインを行ったり来たり何往復もしてうるさい場合がある（「みんな僕を見て〜」「僕はここにいるよ！」ということだろうか。承認欲求の塊の気の毒な人々である。幼少期に育児放棄、ネグレクトを経験するなど心理的に深いコンプレックスを抱えている可能性が高い。珍走も同様の気の毒な人々である。）。なお、大型車エリアに一回入ってしまうと、小型車エリアには行けない構造なので、大型車エリアには入らないように注意する必要がある。車中泊場所としてあまりオススメという感じはない。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Paid highway rest area (👉️Photo of toilet here). While overnight parking is possible, it's noisy and not recommended. (Administrator's on-site verification, December 2024)
■Report from a reader of this site: It's good that the areas for large vehicles and regular passenger cars are completely separated. No cell phone signal issues. WiMAX is available. Wi-Fi is also available. There's a FamilyMart convenience store. It's relatively quiet at night (after 1 AM), and you can sleep reasonably well with earplugs. However, since the entire parking lot is a multi-story structure, there's some vibration when cars drive by. This vibration makes it difficult to sleep deeply. There are no dead-end parking spots; basically, all parking spaces are on the roadways, so there's no place to avoid this vibration. Also, sometimes loud, idiotic drivers (Lamborghinis? Skylines?) make multiple trips back and forth on the Aqua-Line until around 1 AM, causing a lot of noise (perhaps they're trying to say, "Look at me, everyone!" or "I'm here!" They're pathetic people driven by a desperate need for attention. It's highly likely they have deep psychological complexes, perhaps due to experiencing neglect or abandonment in their childhood. These reckless drivers are similarly pathetic people.) Furthermore, once you enter the large vehicle area, you can't go back to the small vehicle area, so you need to be careful not to enter the large vehicle area. It's not really a place I'd recommend for overnight stays in your car. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_ja: ■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。少し傾斜がある。トイレは簡易水洗の和式で、結構臭い。ここは夜景で有名らしく、深夜まで結構車が来る。治安については自己責任。夜景見物客がいなくなったら朝まで無音の静寂で最高。携帯電波ギリギリOK。標高は253m。なお、ここに至る道が非常に狭くすれ違い困難のため、来る場合は対向車とのすれ違いで非常に面倒なことになるのを覚悟して来ること。先述のように夜も結構車の出入りがある。（2021年11月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en: ■Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. There is a slight slope. The toilets are simple flush toilets and quite smelly. This place is apparently famous for its night view, and quite a few cars come until late at night. Safety is at your own risk. Once the night viewers have left, it is wonderfully quiet until morning. Cell phone reception is just barely OK. The elevation is 253m. Note that the road leading here is very narrow and difficult to pass other vehicles on, so be prepared for a lot of trouble when passing oncoming cars if you come here. As mentioned above, there is quite a bit of traffic even at night. (Confirmed on-site by the administrator in November 2021)

properties.title_ja: 昭和島運動場 東側駐車場
properties.title_en: Showajima Sports Ground East Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。トイレは水洗和式だがちゃんと清掃されていてキレイ。高速道路の走行音が非常にうるさい。あまりおすすめという感じはない。なお、公園の北側にも駐車場っぽいのがあるが、そこは公園の駐車場ではなく、私有地なので関係者以外は駐車はできない。
properties.desc_en: ■Free parking and public restrooms. The restrooms are flush toilets (Japanese style) but are kept clean. The noise from the highway is extremely loud. I wouldn't particularly recommend it. Also, there is something that looks like a parking lot on the north side of the park, but it is not the park's parking lot and is on private property, so parking is not allowed for anyone other than authorized personnel.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。トイレは水洗洋式でキレイでした。ただ、街灯無し、トイレもライト無しで完全に真っ暗。夜間は人通りもなく、DQNに襲撃されたら終了なのであまりおすすめはしない。あと、公園の裏が工場なのかわからないが、ゴーっという轟音が一晩中響いておりうるさい。あまりおすすめという感じはない。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Free parking and public toilets. The toilets were clean and had flushable Western-style toilets. However, there were no streetlights, and the toilets had no lights either, making it completely dark. There were no people around at night, and if you were attacked by a thug, you'd be finished, so I wouldn't recommend it. Also, I don't know if there's a factory behind the park, but there was a loud roaring sound that echoed all night long, which was annoying. I wouldn't really recommend it. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■富士山絶景スポット 料金所前なので無料で入れる。駐車場広し。
properties.desc_en: ■A great spot to see Mt. Fuji. It's right in front of the toll booth, so entry is free. There's plenty of parking.

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■富士山を見るには絶景ポイント、遊具もあるので小さいお子さん連れは遊べる。メインの駐車場は深夜締められるが、裏の駐車場は静かに寝れる。
properties.desc_en: ■This is a great spot to see Mt. Fuji, and there are playground equipment so it's suitable for families with young children. The main parking lot is closed at night, but the parking lot at the back is quiet and perfect for sleeping.

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■富士宮市の田貫湖近くにある「休暇村富士」の本館入り口の左手にある。蛇口をひねると富士山の伏流水が出るが、飲用のため消毒している。
properties.desc_en: ■Located to the left of the main entrance of "Kyukamura Fuji," near Lake Tanuki in Fujinomiya City. Turning the tap dispenses groundwater from Mount Fuji, but it is disinfected for drinking.

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)

properties.desc_ja:
■富士の湧水を無料で汲める
■当サイト読者様レポート：建物脇に水を汲める蛇口が3つある。ここは行列はあまり出来ていない。富士山の伏流水から作った水道水。
properties.desc_en:
■Free access to spring water from Mt. Fuji
■Report from a reader of this site: There are three taps where you can draw water next to the building. There isn't usually a long line here. The tap water is made from groundwater from Mt. Fuji.

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■浜松餃子の人気店。魚介入りのギョウザが結構うまい。あっさりしているのにうまい。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■A popular Hamamatsu gyoza restaurant. The seafood gyoza is surprisingly delicious. It's light yet tasty. (Tabelog)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 中田島砂丘 西駐車場
properties.title_en: Nakatajima Sand Dunes West Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■浜松の超穴場車中泊スポット。無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレは簡易水洗ながら、新しくキレイな洋式で良い。携帯電波OK。真っ暗で人気（ひとけ）がないため治安については自己責任。難点としては津波が来たら終了なので、携帯の緊急地震速報は必ずオンにしておくこと。夜間は基本的に静かだが、早朝の日の出前くらいから釣りやマリンスポーツ？などで人がたくさん集まってくるので騒がしくなる。（2021年11月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en: ■A hidden gem for overnight stays in your car in Hamamatsu. Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed that it is not closed at night. The toilets are simple flush toilets, but they are new and clean Western-style toilets, which is good. Cell phone reception is OK. It is pitch black and deserted, so safety is your own responsibility. The downside is that if a tsunami hits, it's all over, so be sure to turn on your cell phone's earthquake early warning system. It is generally quiet at night, but from early morning before sunrise, many people gather for fishing or marine sports, so it gets noisy. (Confirmed on-site by administrator in November 2021)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: ぎょうざ七福（旧：かんべゑ）
properties.desc_ja: ■浜松ギョウザの超人気店。昼しかやってない。餃子の皮からすべて自家製。かなり混むので開店前に並んだ方がいい。詳細、食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■ An extremely popular Hamamatsu gyoza restaurant. Only open for lunch. Everything, including the gyoza wrappers, is homemade. It gets very crowded, so it's best to line up before opening time. For details, see Tabelog.

properties.desc_ja:
■標高1452mで夏でも寒いぐらい。トイレありの大きな駐車場。非常に綺麗。トイレがある側の駐車場が鎖張られて閉鎖されていることがあるが、それを普通に徒歩で抜ければトイレは利用可能。（2019年以前の古い投稿）

properties.desc_en:
■At an altitude of 1452m, it's quite cold even in summer. There's a large parking lot with toilets. It's very clean. The parking lot on the side with the toilets is sometimes closed off with a chain, but you can still use the toilets by walking past it. (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from a reader of this site: During the Mt. Fuji climbing season (early July to early September), the parking lot becomes for climbers only, and there is a parking fee of 1000 yen per car (free for the first hour or less). (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■皮から全て手作りの絶品餃子。皮がもっちりしていてめちゃくちゃ美味い。焼餃子がおすすめ。マンゴーかき氷も美味い。非常におすすめ。なお、火、木、土の週３日しか営業してない。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■ Exquisite dumplings, all handmade from the wrapper up. The wrapper is chewy and incredibly delicious. Fried dumplings are recommended. The mango shaved ice is also delicious. Highly recommended. Note that they are only open three days a week: Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday. Tabelog

properties.label: Camp Spot + Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■入浴♨️：富士八景の湯がすぐ近くにある。1500円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：無料駐車場。トイレ、自販機あり。晴れていれば富士山が見える。夜景も見れる。駐車場は未舗装で傾斜あり。トイレは洋式でキレイ。しかし、爆音DQNのたまり場であまりおすすめはしない。峠道＆夜景が見えるという、DQNを引き寄せる要素満載。ここの道は珍走のサーキット場になっているようで、深夜まで延々と爆音のアホが飽きもせず走り回っている。ここでの車中泊はやめたほうがいい。足柄SAのぷらっとパークが近いのでそっちのがおすすめ。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Bathing♨️: Fuji Hakkei no Yu hot spring is very close by. 1500 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: Free parking. Toilets and vending machines available. You can see Mt. Fuji on a clear day. You can also see the night view. The parking lot is unpaved and sloped. The toilets are Western-style and clean. However, it's a hangout for loud, rowdy drivers, so I don't really recommend it. It's a mountain pass road and you can see the night view, so it has all the elements to attract rowdy drivers. This road seems to be a race track for rowdy drivers, and loud idiots keep driving around endlessly until late at night without getting bored. You should avoid staying overnight in your car here. The Ashigara SA Puratto Park is closer, so that's a better option. (Old post from before 2019)

properties.label: Camp Spot + Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■入浴♨️：駐車場隣接のホテル ＴＨＥ ＯＣＥＡＮ♨で日帰り入浴可能（1000円、詳細） 。
■新幹線、貨物列車の通過音がうるさいので注意。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：料金は１回４１０円。２泊したわけではないですが、出ていくときに支払いなので２泊程度なら問題なさそうです。駐車場内にトイレあります。海水浴とまではいかないですが、子供が水遊びする程度の砂浜があります。釣りも狭いですが、できました。駐車場隣にファミマがあります。駐車場側から入館可です。開華亭にも日帰り入浴がありますが、１５時までとありましたので、オーシャンを利用した方がいいかも。また、オーシャンにWifiがあり、近くまで行けば使えそうです。館内なら使えます（入浴の際、利用できます）パスワード無しなのでセキュリティーは不安ですが。もっともっと、車中泊できそうな場所があるといいですねえ(^^♪（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Bathing♨️: Day-use bathing is available at Hotel THE OCEAN♨, adjacent to the parking lot (1000 yen, details).

■Be aware that the noise from passing Shinkansen and freight trains is loud. (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from our site's reader: The fee is 410 yen per use. I didn't stay for two nights, but since payment is made upon departure, it seems fine for a two-night stay. There are toilets in the parking lot. While not a full-fledged swimming beach, there is a sandy area suitable for children to play in. Fishing was also possible, albeit in a small area. There is a FamilyMart next to the parking lot. You can enter the building from the parking lot side. There is also day-use bathing at Kaikatei, but it was listed as being until 3 PM, so it might be better to use Ocean. Also, Ocean has Wi-Fi, and it seems usable if you get close. It can be used inside the building (when bathing), but there is no password, so security is a concern. It would be great if there were more places where you could stay overnight in your car(^^♪ (Older post from before 2019)

■当サイト読者様レポート：車中泊料金1泊2200円　電源有り。トイレ24時間使用可能です。ゴミ捨て場、水道も24時間使用できます。（私のYouTubeでゴミ置き場、水道、トイレの場所など確認ができます。）夜は静かでぐっすり眠ることができました。この施設のお風呂は景色がすごく良かったです。食事はテーブルクロスがあるようなレストランになります。ワイナリーのため色々なワインの試飲もできます。注意：RVパーク駐車場自体は広いので大型キャンピングカーでも駐車できますが、RVパークまでの道が少し狭いため走行に注意が必要です。ワイン試飲希望の方はワインカーヴ（ワイン蔵）での試飲は17時までのため16時まで、できれば15時までに現地に到着することをおすすめします。施設参考URL、施設参考URL。私のYouTubeでこちらの施設を説明しております。👉️詳細（投稿：2021年8月、沖縄ないちゃー様、Youtubeチャンネル）
properties.desc_en:
■Bath♨️: Budou no Oka Onsen Tenku no Yu: 840 yen, details
■RV Park: 2200 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: Overnight stay in vehicle fee 2200 yen per night. Power available. Toilets are available 24 hours a day. Garbage disposal area and water supply are also available 24 hours a day. (You can check the location of the garbage disposal area, water supply, and toilets on my YouTube channel.) It was quiet at night and I was able to sleep soundly. The view from the bath at this facility was amazing. Meals are served in a restaurant with tablecloths. As it is a winery, you can also sample various wines. Note: The RV park parking lot itself is large, so even large campervans can park there, but the road to the RV park is a little narrow, so caution is needed when driving. If you wish to sample wine, wine tasting in the wine cellar is until 5 PM, so we recommend arriving by 4 PM, or preferably by 3 PM. Facility reference URL, facility reference URL. I explain this facility on my YouTube channel. 👉️Details (Posted: August 2021, Okinawa Naicha-sama, YouTube channel)

properties.desc_ja:
■日帰り入浴1500円、詳細。温泉マニア絶賛。箱根温泉。
■管理人評価★4.1（泉質4.0、景色0.1）（日帰り入浴としての評価。）箱根でここが最高というマニアが多い。箱根で珍しい硫黄泉の濁り湯。注意点としては、日帰り入浴の場合は、塩素添加の循環湯しか入れない。この場合、循環の過程で、本来の濁り湯の色が消えてしまうとのこと。掛け流しの本物に入りたい場合は宿泊しないとダメ。この点は非常に残念。あえて日帰り入浴としての評価をすると、塩素添加、循環で0.5減点の泉質4.0。景色は普通の露天風呂ということで0.1加算、合計4.1と評価。
properties.desc_en:
■Day trip bathing: 1500 yen, details. Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. Hakone Onsen.

■Manager's rating: ★4.1 (Spring quality 4.0, Scenery 0.1) (Rating as a day trip bathing experience.) Many enthusiasts consider this the best in Hakone. A rare sulfur spring with cloudy water in Hakone. A point to note is that for day trips, only chlorinated, recirculated water is available. In this case, the original cloudy color of the water disappears during the recirculation process. If you want to experience the real, free-flowing hot spring water, you must stay overnight. This is very unfortunate. If we were to rate it specifically as a day trip bathing experience, we would deduct 0.5 points for chlorine and recirculation, resulting in a spring quality rating of 4.0. We would add 0.1 for the scenery as it is just an ordinary open-air bath, for a total rating of 4.1.

I think they were flush toilets. There is nothing around so it is quiet. If you're unlucky, wild animals might come, but it's surrounded by a fence so it should be okay? properties.title_ja: 成田市さくらの山公園
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：利用料金：無料。トイレの有無：有り。静かさ：成田空港近く飛行機音でうるさい、２４時過ぎると静か。その他ポイント：警備が厳しい、職務質問もあり、逆に安全。入浴施設：なし。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Usage fee: Free. Toilet availability: Yes. Quietness: Noisy due to airplane noise near Narita Airport, quiet after midnight. Other points: Tight security, police questioning is common, but conversely, it's safe. Bathing facilities: None. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：利用料金：無料、夜間利用可能。トイレ：洋式、水洗、複数個有、電気は人感センサーで点灯、夜間利用可能。駐車場内は明かりが無いため暗い。大型車は進入不可なため静か。トイレは建物裏にあるので、夜間に初めてだと探すのに苦労する。トイレへ行くまでの通路が真っ暗（ただし人感センサーで通路点灯）なので、女性は怖い。（投稿：2025年11月、a様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：無料駐車場とトイレ、標高598m（投稿：2024年8月、読者様）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: Usage fee: Free, available at night. Toilets: Western-style, flush toilets, multiple toilets available, lights turn on with motion sensors, available at night. The parking lot is dark as there are no lights. It is quiet as large vehicles cannot enter. The toilets are located behind the building, so it is difficult to find them at night for the first time. The passageway to the toilets is pitch black (however, the passageway lights up with motion sensors), which is scary for women. (Submitted: November 2025, by A)

■Report from our website reader: Free parking and toilets, elevation 598m (Submitted: August 2024, by a reader)

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：利用料金；入庫後24時間600円（繰り返し適用）、24時間利用可能、立体駐車場。すぐ近くにトイレ有り；京成成田駅東口べデストリアンデッキ公園トイレ（詳細、24時間利用可能、水洗ウォシュレット無し、男＋女＋多機能トイレ）すぐ近くにローソンが二店舗有り。利点：利用料金が安い（周辺に同様の立体駐車場複数有り）、立体駐車場で雨音が低減されるため、雨天の車中泊に便利、京成成田駅への連絡通路があり、周辺観光の拠点に便利。難点：成田空港利用者も使うため、特に連休は満車になる事が多い、立体駐車場のため傾斜がついており、停める場所によっては、車が傾き車中泊が不快になる（平坦な場所もある）。（投稿：2025年10月、車中泊で酒場放浪様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Usage fee; 600 yen for 24 hours after entry (repeated), 24-hour access, multi-story parking garage. There are toilets nearby; Keisei Narita Station East Exit Pedestrian Deck Park Toilets (details: 24-hour access, flush toilets, no bidet, men's + women's + multi-purpose toilets). There are two Lawson convenience stores nearby. Advantages: Low usage fee (there are several similar multi-story parking garages in the area), the sound of rain is reduced in the multi-story parking garage, making it convenient for overnight stays in the car during rainy weather, there is a connecting passage to Keisei Narita Station, making it a convenient base for sightseeing in the surrounding area. Disadvantages: It is also used by Narita Airport users, so it is often full, especially during long holidays, the multi-story parking garage is sloped, and depending on where you park, your car may tilt, making overnight stays in the car uncomfortable (there are also flat areas). (Submitted by: Car Camping & Bar Hopping, October 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 富士山さくらの園駐車場
properties.title_en: Mount Fuji Sakura Garden Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：利用料金 無料。30台くらい停められる駐車場で、ほぼ平坦です。バスコンも駐車可能(2台くらい)　富士山の目の前で良く見えますが駿河湾は見えません。トイレもウォッシュレットトイレでとてもキレイです。交通量も少なくてグッスリ眠れました！車中泊禁止の看板ありません。朝方にご近所の方が散歩に来られましたが不審がられることもなく楽しい時間を過ごせました。車で5分程のところに入浴剤施設｢富士山天母の湯｣があります。(たぶん)温泉ではなく沸かし湯ですが、露天風呂からの景色は最高です！入浴料金もリーズナブルでした。（当日1時間券 410円）詳細（投稿：2023年1月、f様）
■標高532m
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: Free of charge. The parking lot can accommodate about 30 cars and is mostly flat. Bus conversions can also be parked (about 2). You can see Mt. Fuji clearly from here, but not Suruga Bay. The toilets are very clean and have bidet functions. There was little traffic, so I slept soundly! There were no signs prohibiting overnight parking. Some locals came for a walk in the morning, but they didn't seem suspicious, and I had a pleasant time. There's a bathing facility called "Fujisan Tenbo no Yu" about a 5-minute drive away. (Probably) it's heated water, not a natural hot spring, but the view from the open-air bath is fantastic! The bathing fee was also reasonable. (1-hour ticket for the day: 410 yen) Details (Posted: January 2023, by f)

■Elevation: 532m

properties.label: Free Campground
properties.title_ja: 油山寺無料駐車場（200台以上）
properties.title_en: Free parking available at Aburayama Temple (over 200 spaces)
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：利用料金 無料　24時間利用可。公式サイト。トイレ　有　無料　男子、女子別　洋式　24時間利用可。水道　有　24時間利用可。自販機　有　24時間利用可。入浴施設　南方7ｋｍ（車で15分）に入浴施設「和の湯」あり（詳細）　10：00～22：00。コンビニ　4ｋｍにファミマ、セブン、ローソンあり、6ｋｍに24時間スーパーあり。病院　総合病院まで3ｋｍ。街灯　冬期は16：00～19：00まで駐車場灯が点灯するそうです。
評価：先日バイクツーリングで参拝し、ご住職とお会いしましたので色々聞きました。ご自身も若い頃全国をツーリングなさったそうで（日本を5周だそう・・・）野宿、車中泊にとても理解がある方でした。現在はバイクで野宿というわけにはいかないとのことですが、出張の時にはルーフテントとサイドタープを積んでいくそうです。車中泊の際は許可は必要ないそうです。
静かさ　100点
暗さ　100点
地面　50点　舗装面と土があり、土の駐車場は礫まじりの山土のためペグが入りにくい
焚火　100点　舗装面での直火は勘弁してくださいとのことでした。あとはご自由に。とのことです。薪も山から自由にどうぞだそうです。
アクセス　80点　道の駅というわけにはいきませんね。国道150号より20分、国道1号バイパスより5分、東名袋井、新東名森掛川より15分
雰囲気　70点　山なので、海沿いに比べると見劣りします
水はけ　80点　西に向かって水勾配がついているので問題なさそうです。
感想：紹介してもらった入浴施設に行き、帰路スーパーで夕食を購入し、のんびりと朝まで過ごしました。とても静かで遠くに東名高速の車の音が聞こえる程度です。フクロウがないていました。焚火で焼き鳥をしていたら周りに気配が・・熊？とライトで照らしたらタヌキだらけでした。20匹ぐらいいたでしょうか。人馴れしているのか3ｍくらいまで近寄ってきます。朝、住職さんにお礼を言いながら熊について聞いたところ、熊の生息域はずっと北なので大丈夫だそうです。これからはタケノコのシーズンなのでタケノコもご自由にどうぞと笑ってました。静岡は幹線道路が通る割には車中泊や野宿ができる場所がすくないのでこういう場所はありがたいです。いままでは静岡県西部で野宿のときは天竜川河川敷にしていましたが、とにかくうるさくて。次回からは油山寺さんにしようと思います。ただ、やぶ蚊はすごいかも。（投稿：2025年3月、k様）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's readers: Usage fee: Free, 24-hour access. Official website. Toilets: Available, free, separate for men and women, Western style, 24-hour access. Water: Available, 24-hour access. Vending machines: Available, 24-hour access. Bathing facilities: There is a bathing facility "Wa no Yu" 7km south (15 minutes by car) (details), open from 10:00 to 22:00. Convenience stores: FamilyMart, Seven-Eleven, and Lawson are 4km away, and a 24-hour supermarket is 6km away. Hospitals: A general hospital is 3km away. Streetlights: In winter, the parking lot lights are apparently on from 16:00 to 19:00.

Evaluation: I recently visited the temple on a motorcycle tour and met the head priest, so I asked him many questions. He said that he himself toured all over Japan when he was younger (he said he toured Japan 5 times...), and he was very understanding of camping and sleeping in cars. Currently, he says he can't camp out on his motorcycle, but when he goes on business trips, he loads a roof tent and side tarp. He says no permit is needed for overnight stays in his vehicle.

Quietness: 100 points
Darkness: 100 points
Ground: 50 points (There's paved and unpaved areas; the unpaved parking area is a mix of gravel and mountain soil, making it difficult to drive in pegs)
Campfire: 100 points (He asked that open fires on the paved area be avoided. Otherwise, it's up to you. You can also freely gather firewood from the mountain.)

Access: 80 points (It's not exactly a roadside rest area. 20 minutes from National Route 150, 5 minutes from National Route 1 Bypass, 15 minutes from Tomei Fukuroi and Shin-Tomei Mori-Kakegawa)
Atmosphere: 70 points (It's in the mountains, so it's less impressive than a coastal location)
Drainage: 80 points (There's a slope towards the west, so it seems fine.) Review: I went to the bathing facility that was recommended to me, bought dinner at a supermarket on the way back, and spent a relaxing time until morning. It was very quiet, with only the sound of cars on the Tomei Expressway in the distance. I heard an owl hooting. While I was grilling yakitori over a bonfire, I sensed something around me...a bear? I shone my light on it and it was full of raccoons. There were about 20 of them. They seemed used to people and came within about 3 meters of me. In the morning, I thanked the head priest and asked about the bears, and he said it was okay because the bears' habitat is much further north. He also laughed and said that it's bamboo shoot season now, so I could take as many as I wanted. Shizuoka has many main roads, but there aren't many places where you can camp in your car or wild camp, so places like this are very welcome. Until now, when I wild camped in western Shizuoka Prefecture, I used the Tenryu River riverbed, but it was so noisy. I think I'll go to Aburayama-ji Temple next time. However, there might be a lot of mosquitoes. (Posted by K in March 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 弓ヶ浜駐車場（中央未舗装）
properties.title_en: Yumigahama Parking Lot (Unpaved in the center)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：利用日　2024年4月28日。弓ヶ浜ビーチ周辺には３つの駐車場があります。一番東側の、休暇村に近いところはトイレや足洗い場、自販機などあり利用者も多いですが宿泊利用不可のポスターがあります。一番西側はキャンピングカー禁止の看板あり。穴場は中央付近にある広めの砂利の駐車場で、津波タワーの近くにあります。トイレは徒歩1分のところに綺麗な水洗トイレあり。この日は連休中でしたが利用者は4台ほどで、静かでした。夏季は有料となるようなので注意が必要かもです。どの駐車場もサーファーやマリンスポーツ目的の車中泊者が多く、車外にテーブル出して飲食するなどマナーが気になります。全面禁止にならないよう節度を持って利用したいものです。（投稿：2024年4月、ジル415様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Date of use: April 28, 2024. There are three parking lots around Yumigahama Beach. The easternmost one, closest to Kyukamura, has toilets, foot washing facilities, and vending machines, and is popular, but there is a poster indicating that overnight stays are not permitted. The westernmost one has a sign prohibiting campervans. A hidden gem is the spacious gravel parking lot near the center, close to the Tsunami Tower. There is a clean flush toilet a one-minute walk away. Although it was during a long weekend, there were only about four cars using the parking lot, and it was quiet. It seems that it will be a paid parking lot in the summer, so caution may be needed. All the parking lots are popular with surfers and people staying overnight in their cars for marine sports, and their manners are a concern, such as setting up tables outside their cars to eat and drink. We should use them with moderation so that they don't end up being completely banned. (Submitted by: Jill415, April 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：利用は無料です。Wi-Fiは、無料の道の駅スポットからパスワードなくログインでき、60分毎に使えるようです。ローソンが併設されており、タバコ、お酒も売っています。駐車場は、大きく分けて2箇所に駐車場があり、傾斜が緩めな方は大型車の駐車場と近いので、少しうるさいかもしれません。もう一方は小型車の駐車場ですが、傾斜があるため、車を停めて寝るときの向きを気にしないといけないです。どちらも高速と国道52号に近いので、交通量があるときは気になるかもしれません。トイレは、どちらにもそれぞれの近くにあり、とてもきれいです。ドッグランがあり、犬連れでも楽しめそうです。ごみ箱は分別で設置されています。トイレは、男性側しかわかりませんが、ウォシュレット付きでとてもきれいです。手洗い場では、お湯は出ません。ローソンで買い物したレシートを持っていくと、道の駅から車で10分ほど離れた『森のなかの温泉なんぶの湯』で100円引きになるそうです。（投稿：2022年2月、snowchoco様）
■2018/7/21オープン。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's readers: It is free to use. The Wi-Fi can be accessed from the free roadside station hotspot without a password and seems to be available every 60 minutes. There is a Lawson convenience store attached, which also sells cigarettes and alcohol. There are two main parking areas. The one with a gentler slope is close to the parking area for large vehicles, so it may be a little noisy. The other parking area is for small vehicles, but it is sloped, so you have to be careful about the direction your car faces when you park and sleep in it. Both are close to the expressway and National Route 52, so it may be a concern when there is a lot of traffic. There are toilets nearby in both areas and they are very clean. There is a dog run, so it seems like it would be fun for people with dogs. Trash cans are provided for sorting. I only know about the men's toilet, but it is very clean and has a bidet. There is no hot water at the handwashing area. If you bring a receipt from shopping at Lawson, you can get a 100 yen discount at "Mori no Naka no Onsen Nanbu no Yu," a hot spring about 10 minutes by car from the roadside station. (Posted by snowchoco in February 2022)
■Opened on July 21, 2018.

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：有料だが入庫時の発券が無く、出庫時は時間関係なく普通車一律300円でお得。幹線道路から遠く静かで富士山一望。撮影者がよく車中泊している。イベント時貸切で使用不可の日あり。きれいなトイレが隣の野外ライブ会場に👉️詳細（投稿：2023年7月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Although it's a paid parking lot, there's no ticket issued upon entry, and the exit fee is a flat 300 yen for regular cars regardless of the time, which is a great deal. It's quiet, far from the main road, and offers a panoramic view of Mt. Fuji. Photographers often stay overnight in their cars here. It may be unavailable on certain days due to being booked for events. There are clean toilets at the adjacent outdoor live music venue 👉️Details (Posted: July 2023, by a reader)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：夜間封鎖なし、トイレは夜中は電気つきませんでした。有料のBBQ場があります。幹線道路から離れていて、様々な植物が植えられている静かでのんびりできる良い公園です。電源が使えるRVパークも2台分あります（RVパーク 古代蓮の里、詳細）。泊まったのは梅の花が散って桜が咲く前のガラガラな時期でした。蓮の花や桜が咲いて混む時期だと何か言われるかもしれません。（投稿：2024年3月、すみしん様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There was no nighttime closure, but the toilets didn't have electricity at night. There is a paid BBQ area. It's a nice, quiet park away from the main road, with various plants planted around it, perfect for relaxing. There are also two RV parks with power outlets (RV Park Kodai Hasu no Sato, details). We stayed there during the time when the plum blossoms had fallen and the cherry blossoms were in full bloom, so it was practically empty. You might get some complaints if you stay during the busy season when the lotus flowers and cherry blossoms are in bloom. (Submitted by: Sumishin, March 2024)

properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Parking is available even at night. There are temporary toilets in the park. Although it's on a riverbank, there are many houses on the other side of the embankment, so there is little to worry about. (Submitted by: A, January 2026)

properties.title_ja: 大達原ふれあい交流多機能トイレ駐車場

properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Free parking and public toilets. It's a nice place, quiet and with water available, but it seems to be causing problems with people living in their cars for extended periods. When I visited, there were three immobile minivans with Shikoku license plates parked there day and night. There was a long notice posted warning people about sleeping in their cars, suggesting that there have been many troublemakers in the past. (Submitted by a reader in July 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料駐車場です。トイレあり(洋式）個室は一つだけ男女共用です。ただ2024年2月現在、故障中のためか電気は付かず個室の鍵も壊れているので徒歩10ぐらいの場所にあるコンビニ利用を推奨します、夜間閉鎖はありません、海の側なので景観は良いです、釣りスポットなのか早朝の釣り人は多いです、平らな場所は奥に数台分しかありません。すぐそばに民家があるためアイドリングは厳禁です。（投稿：2024年2月、すみしん様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: This is a free parking lot. There is a toilet (Western style), but there is only one stall which is unisex. However, as of February 2024, the lights are not working and the lock on the stall is broken, possibly due to a malfunction, so we recommend using the convenience store located about a 10-minute walk away. There is no closure at night, and the view is nice as it is by the sea. It seems to be a fishing spot, as there are many anglers in the early morning. There are only a few flat spaces at the back. Idling is strictly prohibited as there are houses nearby. (Submitted by: Sumishin, February 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料駐車場です。ただ2024年2月現在、建設中のため利用できませんが綺麗な公衆トイレが建てられていました。夜間閉鎖はありません、海の側なので景観は良いです。サーフィンスポットなので夏場は混みそうです。オフシーズンはかなり静かです、ただし潮と砂を被るのは覚悟してください。街灯ひとつないので治安は自己責任、コンビニは遠いです。ただし少し離れますが温泉街が徒歩圏内にあり日帰り湯をやっている宿がたくさんあります。（投稿：2024年2月、すみしん様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There is free parking. However, as of February 2024, it is under construction and unavailable, but a nice public restroom has been built. There are no nighttime closures, and the view is good as it is by the sea. It is a surfing spot, so it is likely to be crowded in the summer. It is quite quiet during the off-season, but be prepared to get covered in seawater and sand. There are no streetlights, so safety is your own responsibility, and convenience stores are far away. However, there is a hot spring town within walking distance, a little further away, and there are many inns that offer day-use hot springs. (Submitted by: Sumishin, February 2024)

properties.title_ja: 銚子塚古墳 駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料の駐車場とトイレ。駐車場が点在。北側の駐車場は甲府盆地一望、夜景が見れる。（投稿：2025年3月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Free parking and restrooms. Parking lots are scattered throughout the area. The parking lot on the north side offers a panoramic view of the Kofu Basin and night views. (Submitted by a reader in March 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 花鳥山展望台 駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料の駐車場とトイレ。リニアモーターが一望可能。やや傾斜あり。（投稿：2025年3月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Free parking and restrooms. A panoramic view of the linear motor. Slightly sloped. (Submitted by a reader in March 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 赤谷湖畔休石広場駐車場
properties.title_en: Akatani Lakeside Rest Area Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料の駐車場とトイレ。すぐそばにローソンあり。国道沿いだが、一段低い位置で多少音は軽減。砂利でほぼ平ら。（投稿：2025年5月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free parking and restrooms. There's a Lawson convenience store right nearby. It's along a national highway, but it's at a slightly lower elevation, which reduces the noise somewhat. It's mostly flat with gravel. (Submitted by a reader in May 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 精進湖観光協会前駐車場
properties.title_en: Parking lot in front of Shojiko Tourist Association
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料の駐車場です。トイレは道路の反対側の下に有り24時間使用できますが、寄付形式の有料？となっています。道路下の湖畔に駐車も可能です。星景写真のスポットで、平日でしたが10台以上の車が来ていました。近くにコンビニは無いので食事には注意が必要です。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There is free parking. The toilets are located below on the opposite side of the road and are available 24 hours a day, but they seem to be donation-based and require payment. Parking is also possible on the lakeside below the road. It's a spot for astrophotography, and even on a weekday, there were more than 10 cars there. There are no convenience stores nearby, so be careful about what you eat. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: Ｐ３ 元箱根観光駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料の駐車場。P2A、P2B、P3が無料。何故かP1は有料。P3は大型も可。箱根神社の鳥居が目印。トイレは有るが夜間照明がつかないのでライト必要。近くにコンビニ有り。少し先に日帰り入浴可能な龍宮殿本館有り。大人1994円。追記：トイレの照明は深夜についていました。多分、タイマー式で設定が大幅にずれたものと思います。金曜日夜数台だった車が土曜日早朝満車になっていました。多分登山者の様です。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free parking. P2A, P2B, and P3 are free. For some reason, P1 is paid. P3 can accommodate large vehicles. The torii gate of Hakone Shrine is a landmark. There are toilets, but the lights don't turn on at night so you need a flashlight. There is a convenience store nearby. A little further on is Ryuguden Honkan, where you can enjoy a day trip to the hot springs. 1994 yen for adults. Addendum: The toilet lights were on late at night. I think it was probably a timer that was set way off. There were only a few cars on Friday night, but it was full early Saturday morning. They were probably hikers. (Old post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料の水平な巨大砂利駐車場とトイレ。観光案内板と駐車場の看板が出てるので、公共駐車場と思われるが詳細不明。近隣に赤城温泉等もあるが道が険しい。標高688m（投稿：2025年3月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A huge, free, level gravel parking lot and toilets. There are tourist information boards and parking lot signs, so it seems to be a public parking lot, but details are unknown. Akagi Onsen and other attractions are nearby, but the roads are rough. Elevation: 688m (Submitted by a reader in March 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料の公園駐車場です。トイレ有。外灯有。飲料自販機有。飲水有。給水可。親子や高齢者の多い公園です。静かです。安心して車中泊できる雰囲気です。（投稿：2022年8月、s様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: This is a free park parking lot. There are toilets, streetlights, vending machines for drinks, drinking water, and water refills. It's a park frequented by families and the elderly. It's quiet. It has a safe atmosphere for overnight stays in a car. (Submitted by: s, August 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 一ノ宮海岸広場駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料。清潔なトイレあり。芝生広場や滑り台などがあってとてもいいところ。九十九里浜も近い。しかしサーファーが多く、まだ車中泊したことはないが、日中はサーファーのワンボックスカーがずらりと並び、ウェットスーツを干したりしていたので、車中泊、あるいは早朝から駐車しているサーファーも多いと思われる。（投稿：2021年5月、kangoo Tony様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free of charge. Clean toilets available. It's a great place with a grassy area and a slide. Kujukuri Beach is also nearby. However, there are many surfers, and although I haven't stayed overnight in my car yet, during the day there are rows of surfers' vans lined up, with people drying their wetsuits, so I think there are many surfers who stay overnight in their cars or park there from early in the morning. (Submitted by kangoo Tony in May 2021)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 美の山公園 第1駐車場
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：無料。山の上にある為最低限のトイレが有るのみ。土日は夜遅くまで夜景を見に来る人が来るのでエンジン音は少し気になる。（投稿：2021年3月、L様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレあり、駐車場無料。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: Free. Because it's on a mountaintop, there are only basic toilet facilities. On weekends, people come to see the night view until late at night, so the engine noise is a bit bothersome. (Submitted by L, March 2021)

■Report from our website reader: Toilets available, free parking. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_en: Hakone Town Branch Office Lower Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料。一部未舗装。入口が分かりずらい。公園のトイレまでは1～2分、コンビニまで2～3分。道路から少し離れていて若干聞こえるくらい。同様に釣りの方がいらっしゃる。（投稿：2022年8月、ttfromjn様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free. Partially unpaved. The entrance is difficult to find. It's a 1-2 minute walk to the park's toilets and a 2-3 minute walk to the convenience store. It's a little distance from the road, so you can hear the sounds of the road. There are also people fishing. (Submitted by ttfromjn in August 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 浜岡砂丘 市営無料駐車場
properties.title_en: Hamaoka Sand Dunes Municipal Free Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料、夜間閉鎖なし、水道、外シャワー（水）あり(12/30、冬で寒くて浴びることはありませんでしたが、使用可能)。夜間閉鎖なしの白浜公園併設のトイレを使えます。駐車場は、コンクリート部分と、砂利部分あり。夜間静かです。私たちが泊まった時2023年12/30は、他に誰も使用者がいなかったです。デメリットは、携帯の電波が入るが若干弱く、遅く感じます。丸々とした可愛い野良猫が数匹居ます🎵（投稿：2023年12月、オヨヨ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free, no nighttime closures, running water, and outdoor showers (cold water) available (on December 30th, it was too cold to shower, but they were usable). You can use the toilets attached to Shirahama Park, which are not closed at night. The parking lot has both concrete and gravel areas. It's quiet at night. When we stayed on December 30th, 2023, there were no other users. The downside is that while there is cell phone reception, it's a bit weak and feels slow. There are several plump and cute stray cats 🎵 (Posted by: Oyoyo, December 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: [標高1090ｍ]榛名湖 市営駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料、公衆トイレあり（少し古い）、静かでした。上段の駐車場は平ら、下段の駐車場は少し傾斜あり。比較的小さな駐車場です。（近くにも、もっと綺麗なトイレの市営駐車場あり、ただし駐車場に傾斜あり）（投稿：2023年6月、s様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Free, public restrooms available (a bit old), and quiet. The upper level parking lot is flat, while the lower level parking lot has a slight slope. It's a relatively small parking lot. (There is also a municipal parking lot nearby with cleaner restrooms, but that parking lot is sloped.) (Submitted by: s, June 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: [標高1090ｍ]県立榛名公園 観光案内所前駐車場
properties.title_en: [標高1090ｍ] Haruna Prefectural Park Tourist Information Center Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料、きれいな公衆トイレあり。比較的小さな駐車場です。駐車場に少し傾斜あり。（投稿：2023年6月、s様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There are free, clean public restrooms. The parking lot is relatively small. The parking lot has a slight slope. (Submitted by: s, June 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料、24時間、トイレ有り。普通車20台、大型トラック15台ほど駐車可。上下線それぞれ500mほどに24時間営業のコンビニ有り。国道6号沿いにあり昼夜問わずトラックの往来が多く騒音はある。また、大型トラックの出入りも多い。普通車の利用は少なめ。周囲に民家が少なくエンジン音は問題ないと思う。12月上旬全車エンジンかけっぱなしだった。（投稿：2023年12月、t様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free, 24 hours, toilets available. Parking available for about 20 regular cars and 15 large trucks. There are 24-hour convenience stores about 500m from each lane. Located along National Route 6, there is a lot of truck traffic day and night, so it is noisy. There is also a lot of large truck traffic. Regular cars use it less often. There are few houses nearby, so engine noise is not a problem. In early December, all the cars had their engines running. (Submitted by: t, December 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料　水道トイレあり　向かい側にイオンがあるので、食料調達にも便利です。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free, running water and toilet available, and there's an Aeon shopping mall across the street, making it convenient for grocery shopping. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無くなりました（投稿：2024年8月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: It's gone (Submitted by: n, August 2024)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無くなりました（水汲み者のマナーが悪いため閉鎖されたとの事）（投稿：2024年9月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: It's gone (apparently it was closed due to poor manners of people drawing water) (Submitted by: n, September 2024)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：本線の走行音が響いて少々うるさい。売店・フードコートは上り線側7:00〜22:00・下り線側7:00〜21:00営業。PAから外に出て徒歩約7分に24hコンビニがある。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: The noise from the trains on the main line is a bit loud. The shops and food court are open from 7:00 to 22:00 on the northbound side and from 7:00 to 21:00 on the southbound side. There is a 24-hour convenience store about a 7-minute walk from outside the rest area. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：本線の走行音が響いて少々うるさい。売店・フードコートは上り線側7:00〜22:00・下り線側6:30〜22:00営業。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: The sound of trains running on the main line is a bit loud. The shops and food court are open from 7:00 to 22:00 on the northbound side and from 6:30 to 22:00 on the southbound side. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：本線の走行音が響いて少々うるさい。売店・フードコート5:00〜21:00営業。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: The sound of trains running on the main line is a bit loud. The shop and food court are open from 5:00 to 21:00. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Campground + Shower
properties.title_ja: 日光だいや川公園オートキャンプ場
properties.title_en: [Paid] Nikko Daiya River Park Auto Campground
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：本格的な公営オートキャンプ場。ネットで予約可能。料金は4000円台〜と有料だが、ゴミ捨て、シャワー、洗濯、ブラック・グレータンクの処理、給電、給水、屋外調理も自由に出来る為、長期車中泊旅行の途中に寄って、リセットの場として活用するのも良いかも。料金詳細（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A full-fledged public auto campsite. Reservations can be made online. While there is a fee starting from around 4000 yen, you can freely use facilities such as garbage disposal, showers, laundry, black/gray tank disposal, electricity, water, and outdoor cooking. It might be a good place to stop and reset during a long road trip. (See older posts from before 2019 for detailed pricing information.)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.title_en: The brewing water of Yamanashi Meijo
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：北杜市の台ヶ原宿にある酒造詳細）の中。営業時間内の9:30〜16:30に汲める。駐車場は東側の台ヶ原宿跡にある。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website's readers: Details of the sake brewery located in Daigahara-juku, Hokuto City. You can draw sake during business hours, from 9:30 to 16:30. Parking is available at the site of Daigahara-juku on the east side.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：北側トイレが改修され綺麗で新しくなりました。巨大な展望台は老朽化のため利用不可。（投稿：2025年5月、読者様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場の南北に２か所トイレあり。南側の方が比較的きれい。公園から鹿島港が一望できる。（投稿：2022年5月、a様）
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: The north side toilets have been renovated and are now clean and new. The huge observation deck is unusable due to its age. (Submitted: May 2025, Reader)
■ Reader Report: There are two toilets, one on the north and one on the south side of the parking lot. The one on the south side is relatively cleaner. You can get a panoramic view of Kashima Port from the park. (Submitted: May 2022, a)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.title_ja: 駒木諏訪神社の自然水
properties.title_en: Natural water from Komaki Suwa Shrine
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：豊四季駅近く。流山市にある神社の本殿左側。水量少ない。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Near Toyoshiki Station. To the left of the main hall of a shrine in Nagareyama City. Low water level.

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：平日大人920円、詳細（投稿：2025年5月、ターナー様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Weekday adult ticket price 920 yen, details (Submitted by: Turner, May 2025)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：平塚漁港の食堂　 漁協直営の食堂。地元で獲れた新鮮な魚料理を提供する人気店。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Hiratsuka Fishing Port Restaurant A restaurant directly operated by the fisheries cooperative. A popular restaurant serving fresh fish dishes caught locally. Tabelog

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車サイズですが駐車場７台分の駐車スペース有。コインランドリー併設。500円、詳細
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: While it's a standard-sized car, there are 7 parking spaces available. A coin laundry is also available. 500 yen. Details

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車60台級の駐車場。トイレは水洗洋式で清掃状態も良好。難点として、駐車場に奥行きがなく、かつ、隣接する県道r14が快走路になっているため、車の走行音が気になる。うるさくて眠れないレベルではないものの、静かな夜を過ごしたい人にはオススメしない。（投稿：2025年3月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A parking lot that can accommodate about 60 regular cars. The toilets are flush toilets and are in good condition. The downsides are that the parking lot is not very deep, and the adjacent Prefectural Road r14 is a fast road, so the sound of cars driving by is noticeable. It's not so noisy that you can't sleep, but it's not recommended for people who want to spend a quiet night. (Submitted by: y, March 2025)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車60台級の駐車場。トイレは水洗洋式ウオシュレット付きで清掃状態も良好。駐車場に奥行きがあり、さらには隣接する県道も交通量は少ないので、夜の静かさは申し分ない。住宅街の中にあり、民家が隣接しているのがややイマイチ。（投稿：2025年5月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A parking lot that can accommodate about 60 regular cars. The toilets are flush toilets with bidet functions and are kept clean. The parking lot is deep, and the adjacent prefectural road has little traffic, so it is very quiet at night. The fact that it is located in a residential area and next to private houses is a slight drawback. (Submitted by: y, May 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車30～40台級の駐車場。隣にある未舗装のスペースも含めれば、100台くらいは駐車可能。トイレは水洗洋式ウオシュレット付きで清掃状態も良好。公衆トイレとしては文句なしのレベル。電灯の類はないので、トイレに行く際はスマホライト必須。百名山の甲斐駒ヶ岳の登山口でもあるので、早朝からの登山に向けて車中泊している登山者もいる。周辺に民家はなく、夜の静寂性はSランク級。標高は現地調べで788m。道の駅「はくしゅう」からの距離は3.5km。（投稿：2024年11月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: The parking lot can accommodate 30-40 regular cars. Including the unpaved space next to it, it can accommodate about 100 cars. The toilets are flush toilets with bidet functions and are in good condition. As a public toilet, it's excellent. There are no electric lights, so a smartphone flashlight is essential when going to the toilet. It is also a trailhead for Mt. Kaikomagatake, one of Japan's 100 Famous Mountains, so there are hikers who stay overnight in their cars in preparation for early morning climbs. There are no houses nearby, so the quietness at night is top-notch. The elevation is 788m according to our on-site survey. The distance from the roadside station "Hakushu" is 3.5km. (Submitted by: y, November 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車270台の広大な駐車場は素晴らしい。トイレは水洗洋式で清掃状態も悪くない。春分の日の夜に利用したが、独り占め状態で閑静な一夜を過ごせた。目の前が太平洋なので、波の音が苦手な人にはオススメしない。翌朝が日曜日なら、近所の大原漁港で朝市が開かれている。名物のタコ飯で朝食とするのも一興。（投稿：2025年3月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: The vast parking lot with space for 270 regular cars is fantastic. The toilets are flush toilets and are in good condition. I used it on the night of the spring equinox and had it all to myself for a peaceful night. It's right on the Pacific Ocean, so I wouldn't recommend it to people who don't like the sound of waves. If the next morning is a Sunday, there's a morning market at the nearby Ohara fishing port. Having the local specialty, octopus rice, for breakfast is a great idea. (Submitted by: y, March 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車150台級の広大な駐車場。トイレも綺麗に清掃されていて好印象。公園入口の交差点にコンビニもあるので便利。大型車も休憩しているが、駐車場が広いので離れたところに泊めれば気にならない。構造的には分離されているものの、それでも隣接するR51の走行音が聞こえるのがやや不満。（投稿：2022年11月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A vast parking lot that can accommodate about 150 regular cars. The toilets are also kept clean, which is a good impression. There is a convenience store at the intersection at the park entrance, which is convenient. Large vehicles also stop there for breaks, but since the parking lot is large, it is not a problem if you park further away. Although it is structurally separated, the sound of traffic from the adjacent R51 can still be heard, which is a slight complaint. (Submitted by: y, November 2022)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.title_ja: 姫の足湯（長岡総合会館アクシスかつらぎ）
properties.title_en: Hime no Ashiyu (Nagaoka General Hall Axis Katsuragi)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：敷地の北西に伊豆長岡温泉の飲泉所（と足湯）あり。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website readers: There is a drinking fountain (and footbath) of Izu Nagaoka Onsen on the northwest side of the property.

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.title_ja: 富士本栖湖リゾート（富士芝桜まつり）
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：富士本栖湖リゾート（富士芝桜まつり）詳細 4月中旬〜5月下旬に首都圏最大級のシバザクラを見ることができる。シーズン中は入園料600円、駐車場500円 8:00〜17:00。シーズン中（特に休日）は付近の国道が渋滞する。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website readers: Fuji Motosuko Resort (Fuji Shibazakura Festival) Details You can see one of the largest shibazakura (moss phlox) displays in the Tokyo metropolitan area from mid-April to late May. During the season, admission is 600 yen and parking is 500 yen. Open from 8:00 to 17:00. During the season (especially on holidays), nearby national highways become congested.

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：富士山の麓にある魚介料理の人気店。座布団サイズのかき揚げも名物。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A popular seafood restaurant at the foot of Mt. Fuji. Their cushion-sized tempura is a specialty. (Tabelog)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：富士山と高速道路のビューポイント。7台程度の駐車スペース。途中の道は対向車と交差できない狭さです。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A viewpoint overlooking Mt. Fuji and the highway. There is parking space for about 7 cars. The road leading there is too narrow for oncoming traffic to pass.

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：浜松餃子の発祥と言われる店。浜松SA上り線や浜松駅内にも支店あり。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: This restaurant is said to be the birthplace of Hamamatsu gyoza. They also have branches at Hamamatsu SA (outbound lane) and inside Hamamatsu Station. (Tabelog)

properties.label: Free Campground
properties.title_ja: 滝沢キャンプ場（無料キャンプ場）
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：浜松市滝沢キャンプ場の駐車場です。キャンプ場にきれいな水洗トイレがあります。テント泊で、滝沢キャンプ場を利用する場合は、浜松市北区役所へ使用届を出すことになっています。キャンプ場は、無料です。都田川のきれいな清流で水遊びができます。夏休みには、たくさんの家族が水遊びに来ます。（投稿：2023年12月、l様）
properties.desc_en: ■Reader Report: This is the parking lot at Takizawa Campground in Hamamatsu City. There are clean flush toilets at the campground. If you plan to camp at Takizawa Campground, you are required to submit a usage notification to the Hamamatsu City Kita Ward Office. The campground is free of charge. You can enjoy playing in the clean, clear waters of the Miyakoda River. During summer vacation, many families come to play in the water. (Submitted by: l, December 2023)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.title_ja: 浜松アクトタワー展望回廊
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：浜松アクトタワー展望回廊 詳細） 入場料500円（駐車場20分100円） 10:00〜18:00。静岡県で最も高い超高層ビル。 結婚式等で貸切になる事があるので事前に確認を。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website's readers: Hamamatsu Act Tower Observation Corridor (Details) Admission fee: 500 yen (Parking: 100 yen for 20 minutes) 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM. The tallest skyscraper in Shizuoka Prefecture. It may be closed for private events such as weddings, so please check in advance.

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：浜松SA西方の新東名高速道路の高架下にある。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website's readers: It is located under the elevated section of the Shin-Tomei Expressway, west of Hamamatsu SA.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 利根川水辺プラザ公園 駐車場
properties.title_en: Tonegawa Riverside Plaza Park Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：非常に静か。河川敷だが隣に老人介護施設、近くに民家も多数あり、不安になるような所ではない。（※夜間利用可否不明）（投稿：2023年11月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: It's very quiet. Although it's on a riverbank, there's a nursing home next door and many houses nearby, so it's not a place that would make you feel uneasy. (※Unknown whether it can be used at night) (Submitted by a reader in November 2023)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：八平の食堂、詳細 千葉県のご当地ラーメン「アリランラーメン」発祥の店。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Hachibei Shokudo, details. The birthplace of "Arirang Ramen," a local ramen dish from Chiba Prefecture. Tabelog

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：八代ふるさと公園詳細 古墳広場から甲府盆地の夜景を見られる。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website readers: Details of Yatsushiro Furusato Park You can see the night view of the Kofu Basin from the burial mound plaza.

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: みんみんラーメン本店
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：八王子市のご当地ラーメン「八王子ラーメン」の人気店。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A popular restaurant serving "Hachioji Ramen," a local ramen dish in Hachioji City. (Tabelog)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：函南駅の北方、かんなみ仏の里美術館の北東。道路脇のパイプから水が出ている。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: North of Kannami Station, northeast of Kannami Buddha Village Museum. Water is coming out of a pipe by the side of the road.

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.title_ja: 白州・尾白川天然水（道の駅 はくしゅう）
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：白州の“南アルプスの天然水”
■当サイト読者様レポート：道の駅の建物手前に水汲み場所が2ヶ所程ある。飲用のため消毒している。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website's readers: "Natural water from the Southern Alps" in Hakushu
■Report from our website's readers: There are about two water-drawing locations in front of the roadside station building. The water is disinfected for drinking.

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：白州・尾白の水 詳細） 白州・尾白の森名水公園「べるが」のセントラルゾーン駐車場近くにある。
■当サイト読者様レポート：この辺は多数の場所で名水が飲めますが 「尾白の水」は知りません。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website's readers: Hakushu-Ojira Water (Details) Located near the central zone parking lot of the Hakushu-Ojira Forest Famous Water Park "Beruga".

■Report from our website's readers: There are many places around here where you can drink famous spring water, but I'm not familiar with "Ojira Water".

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.title_ja: さくら玉子（杉山養鶏場）の水
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：売店横に水が流れるパイプがある。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There is a pipe with water flowing through it next to the shop.

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：売店・フードコートは上り線側6:00〜24:00、下り線側5:00〜23:00営業。他に下り線側には24h営業の牛丼屋あり。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: The shops and food court are open from 6:00 to 24:00 on the northbound side and from 5:00 to 23:00 on the southbound side. There is also a 24-hour gyudon (beef bowl) restaurant on the southbound side. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：売店・フードコート8:00〜20:00営業、下り線側には24hコンビニあり。上り線側は大型車と離れた所なら多少静か。下り線側は大型車の駐車スペースと接していて少々うるさい。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: The shops and food court are open from 8:00 to 20:00, and there is a 24-hour convenience store on the southbound side. The northbound side is relatively quiet if you stay away from the large vehicles. The southbound side is adjacent to the parking area for large vehicles and is a bit noisy. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：梅乃家、詳細、食べログ 千葉県のご当地ラーメン「竹岡ラーメン」発祥の店。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Umenoya, details, Tabelog. The restaurant that originated "Takeoka Ramen," a local ramen from Chiba Prefecture.

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：梅照院（新井薬師）の境内。大悲殿前の竜の像から水が流れているが水量少ない。鐘楼の隣に井戸と蛇口があり、ここからも汲める。境内へは北側の細い道から入れる（長時間の駐車お断りとの看板あり）。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: The grounds of Baishoin Temple (Arai Yakushi). Water flows from the dragon statue in front of the Daihiden Hall, but the water volume is low. There is a well and a tap next to the bell tower, from which water can also be drawn. The temple grounds can be accessed from a narrow path on the north side (there is a sign prohibiting long-term parking).

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 湧水の郷 しおや
properties.title_en: Roadside Station Yusui no Sato Shioya
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：廃校の中学跡地に出来た道の駅で広い芝生エリアあり。全て平坦。西端にある大型専用駐車場のトラックアイドリング音でやられる可能性の為、普通車は東端がおすすめ。名前の「湧水」が汲める所は場内には無い。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: This roadside station is built on the site of a former junior high school and has a large grassy area. It's all flat. Due to the possibility of being disturbed by the idling noise of trucks in the large vehicle parking lot at the western end, the eastern end is recommended for regular cars. There is no place to draw "spring water" as the name suggests on the premises. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: ラーメン二郎三田本店
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：熱狂的なファンも存在するラーメン店「ラーメン二郎」の本店。麺の量が普通の ラーメン店の倍以上なので注意（店員から聞かれた時に麺の量を減らす申告ができ る）。専用の駐車場無し。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: The main branch of "Ramen Jiro," a ramen shop with a passionate following. Be aware that the noodle portion is more than double that of a normal ramen shop (you can request a smaller portion when asked by the staff). No dedicated parking lot. Tabelog

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: 時代麺房 ライオン
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：忍者系ラーメン（遠州ブラック）の店。詳細、食べログ（投稿：2025年6月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A ramen shop specializing in ninja-style ramen (Enshu Black). Details on Tabelog (Posted by n, June 2025)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 大津漁村センタ－（ポ－トオオツ）
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：入浴11時～16時 220円、詳細。漁業者向け施設だが一般人も利用可（投稿：2025年5月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Bathing 11am-4pm, 220 yen, details. Although it is a facility for fishermen, it is also available to the general public (Submitted: May 2025, by a reader)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：入口前に普通車3～4台駐車可。550円（東京都銭湯価格）、詳細（投稿：2024年3月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Parking available for 3-4 regular cars in front of the entrance. 550 yen (Tokyo public bath price), details (Submitted by a reader in March 2024)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: （トイレの有無不明）陸上自衛隊北富士演習場内
properties.title_en: (Availability of restrooms unknown) Located within the Japan Ground Self-Defense Force North Fuji Training Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：日曜日0時から24時まで一般開放してますので時間内なら入場可能。砂利道で荒れている場所やクレパスもあるので注意。深夜着ならかなり明るいライトを持参し、周囲の状況を確認してから車中泊を。写真を撮りに来ている車両がまれに通る。道を覚えるまでは、細かい路地に入らない方がよい。鹿に注意。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: The park is open to the public from 0:00 to 24:00 on Sundays, so you can enter during those hours. Be careful as there are rough gravel paths and crevasses. If you arrive late at night, bring a very bright light and check your surroundings before sleeping in your car. Occasionally, vehicles carrying people taking pictures pass by. Until you know the way, it's best not to go down the narrow alleys. Watch out for deer.

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：日原鍾乳洞詳細 関東最大級の鍾乳洞は都内にある。入場料金700円、8:00-17:00（12〜3月は8:30-16:30）営業、年末年始休。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website readers: Details of Nippara Limestone Cave The largest limestone cave in the Kanto region is located in Tokyo. Admission fee: 700 yen, open from 8:00 to 17:00 (8:30 to 16:30 from December to March), closed during the New Year holidays.

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 両神温泉国民宿舎 両神荘
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：日帰り入浴可。900円、詳細。道の駅 両神温泉が火曜定休日の時はこちらへ。しかも火曜日は900円→700円に割引。露天風呂から渓谷の眺め良し。（投稿：2023年6月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Day trip bathing available. 900 yen, details. If Michi-no-Eki Ryogami Onsen is closed on Tuesdays, come here. Plus, on Tuesdays, the price is discounted from 900 yen to 700 yen. The view of the valley from the open-air bath is great. (Submitted by a reader in June 2023)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：日帰り入浴700円、詳細。12～20時。源泉が高温のため加熱、加水、循環無し硫黄臭のかけ流し温泉。館内の[ぎょうざの満州]で食事可能。（投稿：2025年4月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Day trip bathing 700 yen, details. 12:00-20:00. The hot spring water is free-flowing with sulfurous smell, as it is heated, diluted, and not recirculated due to the high temperature of the source. Meals are available at the [Gyoza no Manshu] restaurant inside the building. (Submitted by a reader in April 2025)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：日帰り入浴500円 火曜休み、詳細（投稿：2024年6月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Day trip bathing 500 yen, closed Tuesdays, details (Submitted: June 2024, by a reader)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: （日帰りシャワー）富士急ハイランドステーションイン
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：日帰り「温泉」ではなく「日帰りシャワー」という形態。富士五湖周辺、温泉が高額なので節約、浴槽に入る程でもない、という方へ。45分500円（税込）、受付時間6時～21時（10時～15時は清掃の為利用不可）タオル・アメニティ付、詳細（投稿：2023年9月、p様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A "day-trip shower" rather than a "hot spring." For those looking to save money on expensive hot springs around the Fuji Five Lakes area, or those who don't want to soak in a bath. 45 minutes for 500 yen (tax included), reception hours 6:00-21:00 (unavailable 10:00-15:00 for cleaning), towels and amenities included. Details (Posted by p in September 2023)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：二宮から入って、厚木方面へ約２km。アイドリングのトラックがいなければまずまず。２４ｈコンビニあり。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Entering from Ninomiya, head towards Atsugi for about 2km. It's pretty good if there aren't any idling trucks. There's a 24-hour convenience store. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：南房千倉大橋のたもとにある小さな公園。無料、清潔なトイレあり。橋をくぐれば外房の絶景。釣り人が多い。（投稿：2021年5月、kangoo Tony様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A small park located at the foot of the Chikura Bridge in Minamiboso. Free admission, with clean restrooms. A spectacular view of the outer Boso Peninsula can be seen once you pass under the bridge. There are many anglers. (Submitted by kangoo Tony in May 2021)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: 喰い道楽 すみよし
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：那珂湊焼きそばの店。詳細、食べログ（投稿：2025年3月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Nakaminato Yakisoba restaurant. Details, Tabelog (Posted: March 2025, by user n)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：道路挟んで向かいに男女別トイレあり(冬季閉鎖)たまに車が通るが非常に静か。川俣湖の展望あり（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There are separate men's and women's restrooms across the road (closed in winter). Cars pass by occasionally, but it is very quiet. There is a view of Lake Kawamata (older post from before 2019).

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：道路挟んで向かいに男女別トイレあり。すぐ横にダムの絶壁。ダムマニア向け。昼は観光客がひっきりなし。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There are separate men's and women's restrooms across the road. The cliff of the dam is right next to it. Perfect for dam enthusiasts. There are tourists all day long. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: （トイレ遠い）袋公園 駐車場
properties.title_en: (Toilets are far away) Fukuro Park Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：道路から離れているので静かだが、たまにDQN車とパトカーが入ってくる。自販機有、200ｍ離れた場所にトイレ有（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: It's quiet because it's away from the road, but occasionally cars driven by reckless drivers and police cars come in. There are vending machines and a toilet 200m away (older post from before 2019).

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：道を挟んで公衆トイレあり（※夜間利用可否不明）。幹線道路沿いでうるさい。（投稿：2025年4月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There is a public restroom across the street (※Uncertain whether it is available at night). It is noisy as it is located along a main road. (Submitted by a reader in April 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：道の駅混雑時の臨時駐車場としても機能。トラックしかおらず幹線道路沿いでうるさめ。（投稿：2025年5月、読者様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：震災後、使いにくい状況ではありますが、車中泊可能です。トイレはありますが、震災後は、整備されていません。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: Also functions as a temporary parking lot when the roadside station is crowded. Only trucks are there, and it's noisy as it's along a main road. (Submitted by a reader in May 2025)

■ Reader Report: Although difficult to use after the earthquake, overnight parking is possible. There are toilets, but they haven't been refurbished since the earthquake. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 天神東公園ほたるの里駐車場
properties.title_en: Tenjin Higashi Park Firefly Village Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：道の駅吉岡にうるさい車が多数おり(西側の大きな駐車場も)、避難し利用。道の駅隣接ですが車は直接行けず、迂回する形で道も分かり辛いので注意。夜間は静寂、朝は散歩の来場車あり。（投稿：2025年3月、読者様）
■※トイレは道の駅まで歩いて行く（遠い）。（2025年）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: There were many noisy cars at Michi-no-Eki Yoshioka (including the large parking lot on the west side), so we took refuge there. Although it is adjacent to the roadside station, cars cannot go directly there and you have to take a detour, and the road is difficult to find, so be careful. It is quiet at night, and there are cars of people walking in the morning. (Submitted by a reader in March 2025)
■*Toilets are a walk away from the roadside station (far away). (2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.title_ja: 東京ディズニーランド駐車場
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車料金2500円（投稿されている駐車料金は2000円でしたが、値上がりしていると思います。）　すでに投稿されておりますが、駐車場はディズニーランド閉演後いったん閉鎖されます。ディズニーランド駐車場へ夜に行った場合は駐車場が開いてないため駐車場ゲート前辺りで仮眠して（駐車場ゲート前も封鎖されてます）仮眠している車が多くなると駐車場ゲート前が開き移動の案内にディズニーランド駐車場スタッフが呼びに来てくれます。（私の場合、移動案内時間は午前3時20分でした。）その後、駐車場オープンまでは駐車場ゲート前で仮眠して、駐車場オープンを待ちます。（私の場合、駐車場オープン時間は午前7時でした。）ディズニーランド駐車場は車高2.9ｍ以下の車は立体駐車場を案内されます。2.9ｍ以上の車は青空駐車場になります。ディズニーランド駐車場周辺は車もあまり通らないため静かに仮眠できます。トイレは駐車場ゲート前へ移動案内された後はディズニーランド駐車場トイレを利用できます。近くにコンビニ等がありませんので、飲み物や食べ物（朝食）等はディズニーランド駐車場へ行く途中で購入して行くことをおすすめします。ディズニーランド駐車場移動案内や駐車場ゲートオープンの様子は、私のYouTubeをご視聴頂ければと思います。👉️詳細（投稿：2021年8月、沖縄ないちゃー様、Youtubeチャンネル）
■東京ディズニーランド駐車場のゲート前で、駐車場の仮オープンまで車中泊可能。トイレもゲートに隣接しており利用可能。駐車場仮オープンの時間は日によって違い、夜中の2時〜3時くらい。（ゲート前に車がたまってきたら仮オープンらしい。）連休、春休み、夏休みなどのときは0時とか早めの仮オープンになる。ちなみにTDLは22時に閉園で、駐車場の車は一旦すべて外に出される。その後、深夜に仮オープン。仮オープンで駐車場（一日2500円）に入った後は、余裕で車中泊可能。もちろんトイレも使える。車中泊車両は普通にいっぱいいます。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's readers: Parking fee 2500 yen (The parking fee posted was 2000 yen, but I think it has increased.) As already posted, the parking lot is temporarily closed after Disneyland closes. If you go to the Disneyland parking lot at night, the parking lot will not be open, so you will need to take a nap near the parking lot gate (the area in front of the parking lot gate is also blocked off). Once there are many cars taking naps, the parking lot gate will open and Disneyland parking staff will come to call you to guide you to move. (In my case, the guidance time for moving was 3:20 AM.) After that, you will need to take a nap in front of the parking lot gate until the parking lot opens. (In my case, the parking lot opened at 7:00 AM.) At Disneyland parking lot, cars with a height of 2.9m or less will be directed to the multi-story parking garage. Cars taller than 2.9m will be parked in the open-air parking lot. There is not much traffic around the Disneyland parking lot, so you can take a quiet nap. After being guided to move to the area in front of the parking lot gate, you can use the restrooms at the Disneyland parking lot. There are no convenience stores nearby, so we recommend purchasing drinks and food (breakfast) on your way to the Disneyland parking lot. For information on moving around the Disneyland parking lot and the opening of the parking lot gates, please check out my YouTube channel. 👉️Details (Posted: August 2021, Okinawa Naichaa, YouTube channel)
■ You can stay overnight in your car in front of the Tokyo Disneyland parking lot gate until the parking lot has a soft opening. Toilets are also available next to the gate. The soft opening time varies depending on the day, usually around 2-3 AM. (Apparently, they soft open when enough cars have gathered in front of the gate.) During long weekends, spring break, and summer vacation, the soft opening may be earlier, around midnight. Incidentally, TDL closes at 10 PM, and all cars in the parking lot are temporarily removed. Then, the soft opening takes place late at night. After entering the parking lot (2500 yen per day) during the soft opening, you can easily stay overnight in your car. Of course, toilets are available. There are usually plenty of cars parked there for overnight stays. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: "Times Station Ikebukuro" in Ikebukuro is now 3000 yen for 24 hours. (Submitted by: n, March 2025)
■Discovered a car camping spot in central Tokyo. Height limit 2.1m. The parking building has toilets and is suitable for car camping! Maximum 3000 yen for 24 hours. Details. How about using this as a base for sightseeing in Tokyo? Leave your car here and travel by train. There is also a public bath about a 15-minute walk away. The Yumenoshima Park parking lot in Shin-Kiba also allows car camping for 1000 yen for 24 hours, but it's a bit far from the city center and the safety is questionable, so paying an extra 1100 yen for comfortable car camping in Ikebukuro might not be a bad idea. If you consider train fares, the difference may be even smaller. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：千葉県 沖ノ島公園駐車場。沖ノ島公園よりも、鷹野島公園ですかね...。上地図でピンがある直線道路上で泊まれます。それよりも手前の道路にも結構車が止まってます。沖ノ島公園方向には、立ち入り禁止のフェンスがあるのでその手前までです。車の騒音等は少ないですが、波の音がします。うるさいという感じではなく、心地いい程度です。付近に街灯はなく、夜は完全に真っ暗になります。トイレ、自販機はすぐ近くにはありません。(歩けばセブンイレブンがあります。)沖ノ島公園 車中泊で検索するとやってる方がいますが、朝起きたら砂がすごかったそうです。私は南房パラダイスに移動してしまったので砂のことはわかりません。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Okinoshima Park parking lot, Chiba Prefecture. Actually, it's more like Takanoshima Park... You can park on the straight road marked with a pin on the map above. There are quite a few cars parked on the road before that as well. Towards Okinoshima Park, there's a no-entry fence, so you can only park up to that point. There's not much car noise, but you can hear the waves. It's not noisy, just pleasant. There are no streetlights nearby, so it gets completely dark at night. There are no toilets or vending machines nearby. (There's a 7-Eleven if you walk.) If you search for "Okinoshima Park car camping," you'll find people who have done it, and they said there was a lot of sand when they woke up in the morning. I moved to Minamiboso Paradise, so I don't know about the sand. (Older post from before 2019)

There is a handwashing area with running water next to the restrooms. There are 14 parking spaces. It is very quiet at night, and there are no houses nearby, so generators are OK. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: [標高1346ｍ]赤城山 おのこ駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：赤城山大沼が近い。無料、多機能トイレあり、２４時間利用可能。駐車場の近くの大沼側に店舗がありますが、駐車場と区切られているのでそんなに気にはならなかったです。（投稿：2023年6月、s様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: It's close to Lake Onuma on Mt. Akagi. It's free, has a multi-purpose toilet, and is open 24 hours. There's a shop on the Lake Onuma side near the parking lot, but it's separated from the parking lot, so it wasn't too bothersome. (Submitted by: s, June 2023)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：静岡名物とろろ汁（麦とろご飯）の元祖の店。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: The original restaurant for Shizuoka's specialty, Tororo-jiru (rice with grated yam and barley). Tabelog

properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website readers: A popular bakery in Shizuoka City with long lines. Open from 11:00 until sold out. Closed on Sundays and Mondays. For details, see Tabelog.

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：静岡県発祥のチェーン店、名物は駿河湾の桜えび・しらすのかき揚げそば。詳細、食べログ（投稿：2024年9月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A chain restaurant originating in Shizuoka Prefecture, famous for its tempura soba noodles with sakura shrimp and whitebait from Suruga Bay. For details, see Tabelog (Posted by n, September 2024)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：静岡県の観光名所。白糸の滝詳細） 富士山の湧水が滝になって横幅約150mに渡って流れ落ちている。見学料は無料だが駐車場代500円。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website readers: A tourist attraction in Shizuoka Prefecture. Shiraito Falls (details): Spring water from Mt. Fuji flows down as a waterfall over a width of approximately 150m. There is no admission fee, but there is a 500 yen parking fee.

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：静岡県の観光名所。河津七滝詳細） 伊豆半島の南東、河津町を流れる河津川の約1.5kmの間に存在するにある7つの滝。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: A tourist attraction in Shizuoka Prefecture. Details of Kawazu Nanataki (Seven Waterfalls of Kawazu) Seven waterfalls located along a 1.5km stretch of the Kawazu River in Kawazu Town, in the southeastern part of the Izu Peninsula.

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：静岡銀行熱海支店の北、小沢の湯詳細 入浴出来ないが温泉卵を作れる）の隣。丹那トンネルから湧いた水から作った水道水。なお当地には「名水百選」とあるが正確には「近代水道百選」の事。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Details of Ozawa no Yu, located north of Shizuoka Bank Atami Branch (You can't bathe here, but you can make hot spring eggs). The tap water comes from water that springs from the Tanna Tunnel. Although it is listed as one of the "100 Famous Waters" in this area, it is actually one of the "100 Modern Waterworks."

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：静岡駅南にあるまぐろ丼で有名な、焼津港みなみと清水港みなみを経営している丸入商店の本社敷地内にフードコートをオープンしました。詳細。こちらには駐車場があり種類も豊富でお勧めですが、駅南同様混みますので早めに訪問しないと駐車場に入れなくなり,限定が売り切れてしまいます。食べログ（投稿：2024年1月、やすすぎ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Maruiri Shoten, the company that operates Yaizu Port Minami and Shimizu Port Minami, famous for their tuna bowls located south of Shizuoka Station, has opened a food court on the premises of its headquarters. Details. This location has a parking lot and a wide variety of food, so it's recommended, but like the area south of the station, it gets crowded, so you need to visit early or you won't be able to find parking and the limited-time items will be sold out. Tabelog (Posted: January 2024, by Yasusugi)

properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: The brewing water used at Haginishiki Sake Brewery near Shizuoka IC. Details (Submitted by: n, September 2022)
