properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：西側の駐車場に比べ小さく、トイレもやや古い。ここの方が車の出入りが少なく落ち着けるかも。（投稿：2022年5月、a様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: It's smaller than the parking lot on the west side, and the toilets are a bit old. This one might be more peaceful because there's less traffic. (Submitted by: A, May 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 伊師浜海水浴場 駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：西奥の広い駐車場は夏季有料で夏季以外封鎖だが、ここは封鎖されない。トイレは道を渡った海岸にあり。隣の鵜の岬の日帰り温泉（鵜来来の湯十王）で入浴可。（投稿：2025年5月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: The large parking lot in Nishioku is a paid parking lot in the summer and closed outside of summer, but this one is not closed. There are toilets on the beach across the road. You can bathe at the day-trip hot spring (Ukurai no Yu Juo) at the neighboring Uno Cape. (Submitted by a reader in May 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：西伊豆の名勝地御浜岬沿いにある駐車場（夜間閉鎖なし）夕陽がとてもきれい、神社の鳥居越しの富士山の絶景（添付画像）。トイレは3ヶ所に点在し、洋式水洗、和式水洗が混在、清掃状況は比較的きれいに保たれています。（岬最奥の郷土資料博物館のトイレは古く匂いもきつい）夏場は海水浴場となるので混み合うと思います（海水浴場開設時の状況は不明）駐車場へ進入する道路は狭いので、大型のキャンピングカーは注意が必要（ハイエース級以上は行けないかも？）添付画像（投稿：2026年1月、とあるhappy1オーナー様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A parking lot located along Mihama Cape, a scenic spot in West Izu (no nighttime closures). The sunset is very beautiful, and there is a spectacular view of Mt. Fuji over the torii gate of a shrine (attached image). There are three toilets scattered around, a mix of Western and Japanese style flush toilets, and they are kept relatively clean. (The toilets at the local history museum at the very back of the cape are old and have a strong odor.) It will likely be crowded in the summer as it becomes a swimming beach (the situation when the beach is open is unknown). The road leading to the parking lot is narrow, so large campervans should be careful (vehicles larger than a Hiace may not be able to get through?). Attached image (Posted: January 2026, by a certain happy1 owner)

properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A restaurant specializing in Shimizu miso ramen (bean sprout miso ramen). Details on Tabelog (posted by n in June 2025).

properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：水シャワーあり。トイレは和式。水道は飲用不可。自治体がお金をかけ作った施設のようで、手入れ良し。ただ昼夜利用者が少なく、周囲に住人皆無で夜は寂しく、耐えられる自信がある人のみ可。タイヤ跡も無く超絶静か。（投稿：2025年6月、読者様）

properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: Cold showers available. Japanese-style toilets. Tap water is not potable. It seems to be a facility built by the local government with their own money, and it is well-maintained. However, there are few users day and night, and there are no residents nearby, so it is lonely at night. Only suitable for those who are confident they can tolerate this. There are no tire tracks and it is extremely quiet. (Submitted: June 2025, Reader)

■ Reader Report: Huge free parking lot and toilets. Panoramic view of Lake Kasumigaura. (Submitted: May 2025, Reader)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：神奈川県の絶景スポット。湘南平（高麗山公園） 詳細） 湘南地域の夜景が見られる。桜の名所としても有名。
properties.desc_en: ■Reader Report from this Site: A Scenic Spot in Kanagawa Prefecture. Shonan-daira (Koma-yama Park) Details) You can see the night view of the Shonan area. It is also famous as a cherry blossom viewing spot.

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：神奈川県 小田原市 石垣山一夜城 にて数時間仮眠しました。パトカーがやってきて、職務質問されました。 こちらが丁寧に出たからか、免許証等の確認をされただけで終わりました。巡回経路なのか、通報なのかは不明です。トイレは17時30分以降はシャッターが降りるため、利用できません。最寄りコンビニまで車で10分程です。神奈川の県西地域の数少ない車中泊スポットの情報のため、ぜひ追加よろしくお願いします。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: I took a short nap for a few hours at Ishigakiyama Ichiyajo Castle in Odawara City, Kanagawa Prefecture. A police car came and I was questioned. Perhaps because I was polite, they only checked my driver's license and other identification. It is unclear whether they were on a patrol route or if they had been reported. The toilets are closed after 5:30 PM and cannot be used. The nearest convenience store is about a 10-minute drive away. This is one of the few places in western Kanagawa Prefecture where you can stay overnight in your car, so please add it to your list of potential overnight parking spots.

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：深宗水 埼玉県道11号沿い、東秩父中学校の北東。2ヶ所の蛇口から汲める。水質検査済。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Fukamune Water Located along Saitama Prefectural Road 11, northeast of Higashichichibu Junior High School. Water can be drawn from two taps. Water quality has been tested.

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：新東名高速道路随一の絶景スポット。昼は駿河湾の景色、夜は沼津市の夜景を見る事ができる。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website readers: The best scenic spot on the Shin-Tomei Expressway. You can see the view of Suruga Bay during the day and the night view of Numazu City at night.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: びん沼自然公園 北側駐車場（土日祝その他有料）
properties.title_en: Binnuma Nature Park North Parking Lot (Paid parking on weekends, holidays, and other times)""
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：新設のため、やや汚めな既存のびん沼駐車場よりトイレも新しくきれい。キャンプ場（有料、詳細）併設で、深夜の駐車車両もあり安心。ただ原則平日(月～金)無料ですが、有料期間があるので注意。（投稿：2024年10月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: As it's newly built, the toilets are newer and cleaner than the somewhat dirty existing Binnuma parking lot. It's attached to a campsite (fee required, details below), and there are cars parked there overnight, so it feels safe. However, while it's generally free on weekdays (Monday to Friday), there are periods when it's a paid parking lot, so be careful. (Submitted by a reader in October 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：新設された24時間利用可能な綺麗なトイレあり。桜の季節は満車多し。（投稿：2023年6月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: There is a newly installed, clean restroom that is available 24 hours a day. The parking lot is often full during cherry blossom season. (Submitted by a reader in June 2023)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：常時アイドリングの大型トラックが多数。国道407号沿いのためうるさい。良い点は地面が水平、トイレが新しく綺麗。（投稿：2024年6月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There are many large trucks idling at all times. It's noisy because it's located along National Route 407. The good points are that the ground is level and the toilets are new and clean. (Submitted by a reader in June 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：乗用車の駐車区画は数十台程度であるうえ、数台を除き斜面で勧められない。（北側の３-4台分のみほぼ平ら）夜間の出入り車両は少ないが、面する国道（R349号）の深夜の交通量は少なくない。そのうえ、同国道が坂（南から北方面に下り坂）になっており、道路面に注意喚起のための細工が施されていることから、走行音が比較的大きく、走行車両のスピードも高い。（車に曳かれる夢を見たい読者は好都合かも・・・）ただし、駐車区画、トイレ（ウォシュレット付き）はもちろん、屋内休憩場所も一晩中照明が点灯しており、安心感はある。（なぜかBGMも）コンビニは北へ車で数分、温泉（ぬくもりの湯、詳細）は北に車で15分程度。道の駅併設のコーヒーショップ（店名：Streamer）が魅力的。朝7時から営業。直近、2025年8/6-7泊。（投稿：2025年8月、千葉県MO様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: There are only a few dozen parking spaces for passenger cars, and except for a few, they are on a slope and not recommended. (Only the 3-4 spaces on the north side are almost flat.) There are few vehicles coming and going at night, but the traffic volume on the adjacent national highway (Route 349) is not insignificant late at night. Moreover, the national highway is on a slope (downhill from south to north), and there are markings on the road surface to warn drivers, so the noise of the vehicles is relatively loud and the speed of the vehicles is high. (This might be convenient for readers who want to have nightmares about being hit by a car...) However, the parking spaces, toilets (with bidet functions), and indoor rest areas are lit up all night, so there is a sense of security. (There is even background music for some reason.) A convenience store is a few minutes' drive north, and a hot spring (Nukumori no Yu, details) is about 15 minutes' drive north. The coffee shop attached to the roadside station (name: Streamer) is attractive. It opens at 7 am. Most recently, stayed from August 6-7, 2025. (Submitted in August 2025 by MO from Chiba Prefecture)

properties.title_en: Numazu Port Large Observation Floodgate Viewo

properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website readers: Details of Numazu Port's large observation floodgate, Viewo) Admission fee: 100 yen. Open from 10:00 to 20:00 (Thursdays until 14:00). properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：初めまして。場所は小山運動公園です。駐車場は第5までありますが私が車中泊した時は第1に2台、第2に3台駐車アリ。それ以外の駐車場は閉まっていました。それでも第1駐車場239台、第2駐車場53台分あります。近くには自販機、トイレ、水道がありますが、国道4号線が近いのでトラック、車、バイク等の音がよく聞こえます。偶に防犯の為、パトカーの巡回アリ。職質を受けた時に駐車は大丈夫との事でした。（2019年以前の古い投稿）

There are five parking lots, but when I stayed overnight in my car, there were 2 cars parked in lot 1 and 3 in lot 2. The other parking lots were closed. Even so, there are still 239 spaces in lot 1 and 53 spaces in lot 2. There are vending machines, toilets and water nearby, but since it is close to National Route 4, you can often hear the sounds of trucks, cars, and motorcycles. Occasionally, police cars patrol for security reasons. When I was stopped and questioned by the police, they said it was okay to park there. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.title_ja: グランディーパーク平潟町
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：車中泊料金1泊500円、夜間21時から8時：60分100円(夜間最大料金21時から8時：500円）　昼間8時から21時：30分200円（昼間最大料金8時から21時：1100円）　トイレは徒歩1分にコンビニファミリーマートがあります。（お買い物ついでに）　車中泊翌日八景島シーパラダイスに行くため高さ制限のない駐車場を探していた所、野島公園駅の目の前のこちらを見つけて車中泊しました。八景島シーパラダイスにもっと近いコインパーキングはありましたが、高さ制限があったり、高さ制限がない駐車場は満車だったりしてこちらで車中泊しました。（この辺りは釣り人に人気のエリアで小さいコインパーキングは満車状態が多かったです。）夜間最大料金が500円と、とてもコスパがよかったです。道路近くでしたが、夜はぐっすり眠ることができました。注意：駐車場の目の前の野島公園駅にトイレはありますが、改札入らないとトイレには行けません。こちらの駐車場の場所などの様子は、私のYouTubeをご視聴頂ければと思います。👉️詳細（投稿：2021年8月、沖縄ないちゃー様、Youtubeチャンネル）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Overnight parking fee: 500 yen per night, 100 yen for 60 minutes from 9 PM to 8 AM (maximum night rate: 500 yen from 9 PM to 8 AM), 200 yen for 30 minutes from 8 AM to 9 PM (maximum daytime rate: 1100 yen from 8 AM to 9 PM). There is a FamilyMart convenience store with a toilet a 1 minute walk away (perfect for shopping). I was looking for a parking lot without height restrictions because I was going to Hakkeijima Sea Paradise the day after staying overnight in my car, and I found this one right in front of Nojima Park Station and stayed overnight in my car. There were other coin parking lots closer to Hakkeijima Sea Paradise, but they had height restrictions, or the ones without height restrictions were full, so I stayed overnight here. (This area is popular with anglers, and many of the smaller coin parking lots were full.) The maximum night rate was 500 yen, which was very cost-effective. It was close to the road, but I was able to sleep soundly at night. Note: There is a toilet at Nojima Park Station in front of the parking lot, but you cannot access the toilet without going through the ticket gate. For details about the parking area and other information, please check out my YouTube video. 👉️Details (Posted: August 2021, Okinawa Naicha-sama, YouTube channel)

properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：車中泊マップに登録されている那珂川(那須塩原市と那須町の境)の那須大橋の横に有る「西岩崎ポケットパーク」ですが、この場所は、正直に言いますと「自◯の名所」です。今まで、この場所で3桁の方は、亡くなっています。近所に住んでいるので、朝の通勤で、何度も遭遇しています。このポケットパークに車を駐車し、亡くなった方も大勢います。(警察官が駐車している車の現場検証を何度も見ました) 那須山が一望できて、良い車中泊スポットなのですが、事情を知らないで車中泊をしている方を一度だけ見た事が有ります。記載は、お任せしますので、宜しくお願いします。（投稿：2023年7月、t様）

properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: The "Nishi-Iwasaki Pocket Park," located next to the Nasu Ohashi Bridge on the Nakagawa River (border of Nasu-Shiobara City and Nasu Town), which is registered on our car camping map, is, frankly speaking, a "suicide hotspot." Hundreds of people have died here. I live nearby and have encountered it many times on my morning commute. Many people have parked their cars in this pocket park and died there. (I've seen police officers investigating parked cars on the scene many times.) It's a nice car camping spot with a great view of Mount Nasu, but I've only seen one person camping there without knowing the situation. I'll leave the details to you, so please do so. (Submitted by: t, July 2023)

properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Gravel parking lot. Very quiet. Toilets are here 👉️ Details (Posted: October 2023, by a reader)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：今日は山梨県の道の駅 どうし の情報です。夜間は駐車場の一角が進入禁止になりますが、それでも30台はゆうに停められる規模の駐車場です。二輪も多く立ち寄っていました。そこまで広い範囲ではないので、夜間は音が気になるかもしれません。駐車場の場所によっては傾斜があるため、注意が必要です。24時間使えるトイレ、自販あり。道の駅の川向こうにはコインランドリーの文字があり。営業時間は未確認。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Reader Report: Today's information is about the Doshi Roadside Station in Yamanashi Prefecture. While a section of the parking lot is closed off at night, it's still large enough to accommodate 30 cars. Many motorcycles also stopped by. Because the area isn't very large, noise might be a concern at night. Some parts of the parking lot are sloped, so caution is advised. There are 24-hour restrooms and vending machines. Across the river from the roadside station, there's a sign for a coin laundry. Operating hours are unconfirmed. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：今までにいろいろな道の駅を使わせて頂きましたが今までで一番綺麗なトイレでした。清掃も素晴らしいでした。日曜の夜に車中泊をしましたが雨の影響？でだれも居ませんでした。道路には面していましたがとても静かです。裏側の渓谷も綺麗でした。（投稿：2022年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: I've used many roadside rest areas before, but this was the cleanest restroom I've ever seen. The cleaning was excellent. I stayed overnight in my car on a Sunday night, but there was no one there, perhaps due to the rain? It faced the road, but it was very quiet. The gorge on the other side was also beautiful. (Submitted by: M, June 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 公衆トイレと無料駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：国道沿いのためうるさい（※夜間利用可否不明）（投稿：2025年4月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: It's noisy because it's located along a national highway (※Uncertain whether it can be used at night) (Submitted by a reader in April 2025)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：国道沿いで爆音が酷く、隣の中宿歴史公園駐車場(砂利)の方が静か👉️詳細。南東側に新設の第二駐車場は、巨大で国道から遠く静かですが、夜間閉鎖され車中泊不可（夜間は入口にバリケード設置）（投稿：2023年11月、読者様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場が17号バイパスに面しているので爆音トラックが深夜でも通過していきます、駐車するならトイレから一番離れている場所がまだ静かだと思います。（投稿：2022年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: The noise from the trucks along the national highway is terrible, and the parking lot (gravel) at the neighboring Nakajuku Historical Park is quieter 👉️Details. The newly built second parking lot on the southeast side is huge, far from the national highway, and quiet, but it is closed at night and overnight parking is not allowed (barricades are set up at the entrance at night) (Posted: November 2023, reader)
■Report from a reader of this site: The parking lot faces the No. 17 bypass, so loud trucks pass by even in the middle of the night. If you're going to park, I think the spot furthest from the toilets is the quietest. (Posted: June 2022, m)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：国道から少し奥まったところに駐車場がある上、国道の夜の交通量が少ないので騒音に悩まされずに寝ることができる。歩いてすぐのところにローソンがあるので、買い出しも便利。ただし、暗い中ではトイレの場所が分かりにくいので、明るいうちに場所を確認しておくと良いかも。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: The parking lot is set back a little from the national highway, and since there is little traffic on the highway at night, you can sleep without being bothered by noise. There is a Lawson convenience store within easy walking distance, so shopping is convenient. However, it is difficult to find the toilet in the dark, so it may be a good idea to check its location in daylight. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：国道362号線と静岡県道77号線の交差点の少し北に車を停め、民家の脇から大井川に下りて行った所にある。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: It is located a little north of the intersection of National Route 362 and Shizuoka Prefectural Road 77, where you park your car and go down to the Oi River from beside a private house.

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.title_ja: クロナギの名水（杉の長命水）
properties.title_en: Kuronagi's famous spring water (Cedar's longevity water)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：国道362号沿い、篠原トンネルから東へ約1.6km。道路脇の壁面にある6本のパイプから水が出ている。付近は道が狭いので注意（この場所は少し道幅が広い）。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Along National Route 362, about 1.6 km east of the Shinohara Tunnel. Water is flowing from six pipes on the wall beside the road. The road is narrow in the vicinity, so be careful (this spot is slightly wider).

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：国道257号沿い、伊平郵便局の南東にある。広めの駐車帯の奥のパイプから水が出ている。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Located along National Route 257, southeast of Ihei Post Office. Water is coming out of a pipe at the back of a wide parking area.

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：国道120号線から丸沼高原スキー場駐車場の入り口に、「丸沼高原 涼水」の案内とともに設置されています。日光白根山の伏流水を水源とする配水池から引いてきたもので、2008年６月、環境省より「尾瀬の郷　片品湧水群」として「平成の名水百選」に選ばれました。 片品村全域の水道水もこの湧き水を原水としているので、そのままで飲料水に出来るようです。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website readers: It is located at the entrance to the Marunuma Kogen Ski Resort parking lot from National Route 120, along with a sign for "Marunuma Kogen Ryosui" (Marunuma Highlands Cool Water). The water is drawn from a reservoir that uses groundwater from Mount Nikko-Shirane as its source, and in June 2008, it was selected by the Ministry of the Environment as one of the "100 Famous Waters of the Heisei Era" as part of the "Oze no Sato Katashina Spring Water Group". The tap water throughout Katashina Village also uses this spring water as its source, so it seems that it can be used as drinking water as is.

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：高尾山詳細 世界一の登山者数。頂上からは関東平野を一望できる。駐車場は高尾山口にある薬王院祈祷殿駐車場（24時間500円）など。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website readers: Details of Mount Takao. The world's most visited mountain. From the summit, you can enjoy a panoramic view of the Kanto Plain. Parking is available at the Yakuoin Prayer Hall parking lot at Takaosanguchi (500 yen for 24 hours), etc.

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: フライ・焼そばの店 山下
properties.title_en: Fried food and yakisoba shop Yamashita
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：行田市のB級グルメ「行田フライ」（キャベツの無いお好み焼きのようなもの）の人気店。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: A popular restaurant in Gyoda City serving "Gyoda Fry" (a kind of okonomiyaki without cabbage), a local specialty of the city. (Tabelog)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：紅葉期は混雑。トイレ2か所あり。奥鬼怒温泉郷に行く人は、ここで自家用車を乗り捨て、専用バスで向かうため、夜もソコソコ駐車台数は有り。昼は温泉客、釣り客で賑わうが、夜は異常な静けさ。早朝は登山客で騒がしい。傾斜あり。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: It gets crowded during the autumn foliage season. There are two toilets. People going to Okukinu Onsenkyo leave their private cars here and take a dedicated bus, so there are a fair number of cars parked even at night. It's bustling with hot spring and fishing enthusiasts during the day, but it's unusually quiet at night. It's noisy with hikers in the early morning. There is a slope. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Nature Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：紅葉のきれいな渓谷です。添付画像（投稿：2022年10月、s様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A beautiful valley with autumn foliage. (Attached image, submitted by S in October 2022)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：江川海岸の海中電柱ですが、撤去されてしまったようです。木更津市のHPに記載あり。詳細。（電柱が倒壊し、安全のために撤去？）近場の久津間海岸の海中電柱は、今のところは健在のようです。（投稿：2021年4月、ななし〜様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：千葉県の絶景スポット。「日本のウユニ塩湖」として話題に。海上に電柱が並ぶ不思議な光景（電柱は今後 撤去されるとの事）。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: The underwater utility poles at Egawa Coast appear to have been removed. This is mentioned on the Kisarazu City website. Details. (The poles collapsed and were removed for safety reasons?) The underwater utility poles at the nearby Kutsuma Coast appear to be intact for the time being. (Posted: April 2021, by Nanashi~)

■Report from our site's reader: A scenic spot in Chiba Prefecture. It's gaining attention as "Japan's Uyuni Salt Flats." A strange sight of utility poles lined up in the sea (the poles are reportedly going to be removed in the future).

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：広大な土地に群生するススキ。秋のススキの見頃は9月下旬～11月上旬。詳細（投稿：2026年1月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Pampas grass growing in vast fields. The best time to see pampas grass in autumn is from late September to early November. Details (Submitted by: n, January 2026)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：広大な山々が見渡せます。夜間は下のゲートが閉じ入場不可。（投稿：2023年6月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: You can see vast mountains from here. The lower gate is closed at night and entry is not permitted. (Submitted by a reader in June 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：工事現場で使うようなトイレが点在してたくさんあります。水道は、１つだけです。手洗いや食器洗いぐらいしか使えないようです。カルキの匂いがすごいと聞きました。（投稿：2023年12月、l様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There are many toilets scattered around that look like they're used at construction sites. There's only one water tap. It seems they can only be used for washing hands or dishes. I heard the chlorine smell is really strong. (Submitted by: l, December 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：向かいに警察駐在所があり、何かと安心。トイレ👉️詳細 （投稿：2023年7月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There's a police station across the street, which is reassuring. Toilets 👉️ Details (Posted: July 2023, by a reader)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 全国育樹祭記念広場駐車場
properties.title_en: National Tree Planting Festival Memorial Plaza Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：公園内にトイレ有。自販機なし。天体観測に来ている方がいるので、灯りには注意。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There are toilets in the park. No vending machines. Be careful with lights as there are people there for stargazing. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：公園の駐車場です。トイレがあります。（投稿：2023年12月、l様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: This is a park parking lot. There are toilets. (Submitted by: l, December 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 神之池緑地公園駐車場
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：公園のトイレとしてはきれい。神之池緑地公園には駐車場が複数あり。ここは大型専用駐車場が５台分あり夜間トラックが仮眠してる。（投稿：2022年5月、a様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：公園無料Ｐ トイレ清潔。 夜間、パト定期巡回にて安心。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: The park toilets are clean for a park. There are multiple parking lots at Kaminoke Green Park. This one has a dedicated parking area for large vehicles with 5 spaces where trucks take overnight rests. (Submitted by: A, May 2022)

■ Reader Report: Free parking in the park. Clean toilets. Regular nighttime patrols provide peace of mind. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 尾島温泉 利根の湯
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：公営の温泉施設。客のほぼ全員が、知り合い同士の地元の高齢者。スーパー銭湯のような設備と温泉もしっかりしていて市外者500円。詳細（投稿：2023年10月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A publicly run hot spring facility. Almost all of the customers were local elderly people who knew each other. It has facilities and hot springs that are as good as a super sento (large public bathhouse), and it costs 500 yen for people from outside the city. Details (Submitted by a reader in October 2023)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 上尾市健康プラザわくわくランド
properties.title_en: Ageo City Health Plaza Wakuwaku Land
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：公営のお風呂。料金は上尾市民、市外関係なく600円。この値段でプールも入れる。詳細（投稿：2023年10月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Public bathhouse. The fee is 600 yen regardless of whether you are an Ageo resident or not. You can also use the swimming pool for this price. Details (Submitted by a reader in October 2023)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：御殿場駅近くの「新橋浅間神社」境内。水汲み場所は数ヶ所ある。
■当サイト読者様レポート：北側の県道から駐車場に入れる（「司旅館」の看板が目印）。水汲み時間7:00〜19:00との事。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Within the grounds of Shinbashi Sengen Shrine near Gotemba Station. There are several places to draw water.

■Report from a reader of this site: You can access the parking lot from the prefectural road on the north side (look for the "Tsukasa Ryokan" sign). Water is available from 7:00 to 19:00.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：湖畔に車乗り入れ可能。山中湖では珍しい。4WDで無くてもスタックしないが、湖近くまで行き過ぎるとはまる可能性あり。トイレは隣の平野ちびっこ広場公衆トイレ→詳細（投稿：2023年7月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: You can drive your car onto the lakeshore. This is rare for Lake Yamanaka. You won't get stuck even without a 4WD, but there's a possibility of getting stuck if you go too close to the lake. Toilets are available at the Hirano Children's Plaza public toilets next door → Details (Submitted by a reader in July 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：県道沿いにコンビニ有。少し離れた施設のトイレ利用。固く締まった砂なので砂浜に降りられるが場所にとってはスタック注意。波打ち際は満潮時危険。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There is a convenience store along the prefectural road. Use the toilets at a facility a little further away. The sand is hard and compacted, so you can go down to the beach, but be careful of getting stuck in some places. The waterline is dangerous at high tide. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：犬吠埼詳細 関東最東端の銚子半島に突出する岬。周囲の海岸には文人墨客の歌碑が立つ。近くを走る銚子電鉄は資金不足でぬれ煎餅をを販売している詳細
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Details of Inubosaki A cape jutting out from the Choshi Peninsula, the easternmost point of the Kanto region. The surrounding coastline is lined with monuments inscribed with poems by literary figures and artists. The nearby Choshi Electric Railway is selling wet rice crackers due to financial difficulties.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：権現堂公園のあちこちに無料駐車場とトイレ（※夜間利用可否不明）。花見シーズンは有料かつ大変混雑。（投稿：2025年5月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There are free parking lots and restrooms scattered throughout Gongendo Park (※availability at night is unknown). During cherry blossom season, they are paid and extremely crowded. (Submitted by a reader in May 2025)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 季楽里あさひ
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：建物正面駐車場はトラックと区別されている。建物裏側駐車場が道路やトラックから離れているのでお勧め区画。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■H27年10月17日オープン！
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: The parking lot in front of the building is separated from the truck parking lot. The parking lot at the back of the building is recommended because it is further away from the road and trucks. (Older post from before 2019)
■Opened October 17, 2015!

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：圏央道の菖蒲PA外回り、について。夜間は乗用車エリアにもトラックがエンジンをかけたままで停車しています。PAエリア全体にエンジン音が響き渡り、排気ガスでどこにいても息苦しい感じがしました。本線上からPAエリアに入る道路から本線に戻る道路までトラックが一杯で危険な感じもしました。（投稿：2021年3月、M様）
■2015/10/31オープン！本線と分離でなかなか良さそう。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Regarding the Shobu PA (outbound lane) on the Ken-O Expressway. At night, trucks are parked with their engines running even in the passenger car area. The engine noise echoes throughout the entire PA area, and the exhaust fumes made it feel suffocating no matter where you were. There were so many trucks on the road from the main highway to the PA area and back to the main highway that it felt dangerous. (Submitted by M in March 2021)
■Opened on October 31, 2015! Seems quite good with separation from the main highway.

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：月島もんじゃ焼きの老舗。平日17:00～22:00、土休日11:30～22:00営業。専用の駐車場無し。詳細、食べログ（投稿：2024年5月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A long-established monjayaki restaurant in Tsukishima. Open weekdays 17:00-22:00, weekends and holidays 11:30-22:00. No dedicated parking. For details, see Tabelog (posted by n in May 2024).

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：月までもうすぐです、写真を撮って楽しみました。近くの「夢のかけ橋」とセットで見学しました。添付画像、添付画像、添付画像、添付画像（投稿：2022年11月、s様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: The moon is almost here, and I enjoyed taking pictures. I also visited the nearby "Bridge of Dreams." (Attached images, attached images, attached images, attached images) (Submitted by: s, November 2022)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 あぐりーむ昭和
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：傾斜地にあるため、全体的にゆるい傾斜あり。南側に一部やや平らな所もあるが、トラックが近くなる。春は向かいの工場の桜並木が見事。（投稿：2025年4月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Due to its location on a slope, the entire property has a gentle incline. There is a slightly flatter area on the south side, but trucks are close by. In spring, the row of cherry trees at the factory across the street is magnificent. (Submitted by a reader in April 2025)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: フリアンパン洋菓子店
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：群馬県名物みそパンの店。詳細、食べログ（投稿：2025年3月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A shop selling Gunma Prefecture's famous miso bread. Details on Tabelog (Posted by n in March 2025)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：群馬県発祥のチェーン店、名物は鳥めし（弁当もあり）。詳細、食べログ（投稿：2024年8月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A chain restaurant originating in Gunma Prefecture, famous for its chicken rice (bento boxes also available). For details, see Tabelog (posted by n in August 2024).

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: シャンゴ 問屋町本店
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：群馬県発祥のチェーン店、名物はシャンゴ風スパゲッティ（トンカツとミートソースが乗ったスパゲッティ）。食べログ、詳細（投稿：2024年9月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A chain restaurant originating in Gunma Prefecture, famous for its Shango-style spaghetti (spaghetti topped with tonkatsu and meat sauce). Tabelog, details (Posted by: n, September 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：群馬県道55号沿い。詳細（投稿：2025年8月、n様）

properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There is a south parking lot facing a main road and a north parking lot facing a residential area. I stayed in the north parking lot and it was quiet so I slept well. There is a police box near the south parking lot, so if you prioritize safety even if it's a little noisy, the south might be better. Idling is strictly prohibited in the north parking lot because it is close to houses. There is no closure at night, and the toilet is a Western-style multipurpose toilet, but the lights were not on at night. There were several other cars parked there, but there is a sign asking people not to park at night, so park at your own risk. (Submitted by: Sumishin, March 2024)

properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: The price has increased from 1000 yen per vehicle regardless of the number of people to an additional charge of 300 yen per person. Details (Submitted July 2024, by a reader)
■ Reader Report: Kusatsu Onsen Tenguyama 5th Parking Lot is now officially permitted for overnight parking (1000 yen per night and up). Details. Image of the parking lot entrance. Tenguyama 1st Parking Lot, a popular spot for overnight parking in Kusatsu Onsen that had many problems, has been closed at night, effectively banning overnight parking. This is likely a consideration to prevent excessive gathering of excluded vehicles at the roadside station, making it difficult for regular cars to park. The 1st Parking Lot will now be exclusively for Nishinokawara Onsen guests, and during peak season, it is already a paid parking lot. Parking fees are refunded when you visit the hot springs (similar to Ootaki no Yu). Even after the pandemic ends, it seems unlikely that free overnight parking at the 1st Parking Lot will be possible again. (Submitted October 2021, by a reader)

■Report from our website's readers: Details of the Tabuchi Geomagnetic Reversal Stratum This stratum proves that the Earth's magnetic field last reversed approximately 770,000 years ago, which formed the basis of the "Chibanian" age. Since you will be walking along the river, be sure to wear comfortable shoes.

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：下道から入れる駐車場は、停められる台数がそれなりにある割に混雑しておらず、好きな場所を確保できた。山の中にあるため高速道路本線からも国道からも離れているので、夜はとても静か。トイレや売店はPAの綺麗な施設を利用できるし、フードコート閉店時間中は食事をする客もいないので、好きなようにテーブルを使うことができる。難点は、下道からの入り口が目立たないことか。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：大型車の駐車スペースと分離で良い。上下線とも24hコンビニあり、フードコートの一部店舗も24h営業。外部からも「ぷらっとパーク」の駐車場で車中泊が可能。清水区の市街地からは離れている。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: The parking lot accessible from the local road wasn't crowded despite having a decent number of spaces, so I was able to secure a spot I liked. Because it's located in the mountains, it's far from both the main highway and the national road, making it very quiet at night. You can use the clean facilities of the rest area for toilets and shops, and since there are no customers eating when the food court is closed, you can use the tables as you like. The only drawback is that the entrance from the local road isn't very noticeable. (Older post from before 2019)

■Report from a reader of this site: The separate parking spaces for large vehicles are a plus. There are 24-hour convenience stores on both the northbound and southbound sides, and some of the food court shops are also open 24 hours. Overnight parking is possible in the "Plat Park" parking lot, accessible from outside. It's far from the city center of Shimizu Ward. (Older post from before 2019)

(Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：茨城県大洗町の大洗海浜公園は無料(海水浴シーズンのみたしか５時〜１６時くらいまで有料です)で２４時間駐車OKでトイレもいつでも使えます。ただし、時期によっては若者が騒いていたりするので睡眠できなかったりします。大洗町全域で車上荒らし、車両の盗難が多発していますがこの場所は夜間定期的にパトロール車両が通るので比較的かもしれません。とはいえ油断は禁物ですが。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Oarai Seaside Park in Oarai Town, Ibaraki Prefecture, is free to park (though there is a fee during the swimming season, from around 5 am to 4 pm), has 24-hour parking, and toilets are available at all times. However, depending on the time of year, it can be noisy with young people, making it difficult to sleep. Car break-ins and vehicle thefts are frequent throughout Oarai Town, but this location may be relatively safer because patrol vehicles pass by regularly at night. Nevertheless, caution is still advised. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: 大洗アウトレット向かいP
properties.title_en: Parking available across from Oarai Outlet Park.
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：茨城県大洗町の大洗アウトレット向かいP(大洗町営第一駐車場)ですがこの駐車場に夜間車を止めていると隣接する特定の民家二階からレーザーポインターによる顔面(的確に眼球を狙ってくるとのこと)への攻撃があるとのことです。対策としてはその民家に向かって前方駐車をしない、フロントガラスにサンシェード等つける、特定民家の正面エリアに駐車しないなどですが、過去に同民家の住人から石やごみを投げつけられたなとどいううわさも聞き、また駐車場内を無駄に空ぶかししながらバイクで走行する輩がいる、そもそも大洗町では車上荒らしや車両そのものの盗難が相次いでいるところからこの場所で車中泊をするには相当の覚悟がいると思われます。
■当サイト読者様レポート：無料。トイレ無。近くに温泉あり。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our readers: Regarding the parking lot across from the Oarai Outlet Mall in Oarai Town, Ibaraki Prefecture (Oarai Town Municipal Parking Lot No. 1), there are reports of laser pointer attacks (precisely targeting the eyes) from the second floor of a nearby house when cars are parked there at night. Measures include not parking facing the house, using sunshades on the windshield, and not parking directly in front of the house. However, there are rumors of residents of the house throwing stones and garbage at the parking lot, and there are also people who needlessly rev their engines while riding motorcycles. Furthermore, Oarai Town has a history of frequent car break-ins and vehicle thefts, so it seems that considerable caution is needed if you plan to stay overnight in your car at this location.

■Report from our readers: Free. No toilets. Hot springs nearby.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 伊佐沼公園 西駐車場
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：伊佐沼公園　西駐車場にて車中泊を行ってみたところ、警察に「ここは公園の駐車場なので駐車は禁止されていないのですが、。。もごもご」なにか微妙な話しの始まりで職務質問が有りました。実際に公園としても問題は無いらしいですが、立地上もあり実質の付近の会社の駐車場として利用するのが日常の様で、他府県ナンバーは不審と通報する人がパトロールしているようです。　暇でしたので警察としばらく話をしていましたら、付近は自動車、トラックの盗難や自販機のこじ開け、会社への侵入が多いところだそうで警戒しているらしいです。　以上、微妙なお話しでしたが、車中泊も微妙？　伊佐沼公園でも工場側ではなくて池側の駐車場は解放されてるのでそちらの方が怪しまれにくいのかもしれません。（投稿：2025年4月、n様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：公園内にトイレあり（投稿：2023年6月、読者様）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: When I tried parking my car overnight in the west parking lot of Isanuma Park, the police stopped me for questioning, starting with something like, "This is a park parking lot, so parking isn't prohibited, but..." It seemed like a rather awkward conversation. Apparently, there's nothing wrong with it as a park, but due to its location, it's commonly used as a parking lot for nearby companies, and there are people patrolling who report cars with out-of-prefecture license plates as suspicious. Since I had some free time, I talked to the police for a while, and they said that the area has a high incidence of car and truck theft, vending machine break-ins, and company intrusions, so they're on high alert. That was a rather awkward conversation, but is parking overnight in a car also a bit awkward? At Isanuma Park, the parking lot on the pond side, not the factory side, is open, so that might be less suspicious. (Submitted: April 2025, by n)
■Report from a reader of this site: There are toilets in the park (Submitted: June 2023, by a reader)

The Takayama Fureai no Sato Observatory, featured in Laid-Back Camp, is about a 20-minute climb up the mountain. (Submitted by: l, December 2023)

properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Shower for 15 minutes, 300 yen (towel fee not included, tax included), 10:00-15:30, near the Fuji Five Lakes area. For those who want to save money because hot springs are expensive, or who don't feel like taking a bath. Parking available nearby. (Submitted by p in September 2023)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: さわやか御殿場インター店
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：さわやか御殿場インター店 詳細） 静岡県のみに展開するハンバーグレストランの人気店で最も東京に近い店舗。休日の昼は2時間以上並ぶ覚悟で。食べログ
■超人気店。平日でも普通に1時間待ち。ハンバーグはレアでも食べられる。よほど品質管理がしっかりしてないとハンバーグでレアは無理なので、なかなかすごい。味は普通にうまい。基本的にコスパが良い。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's readers: Sawayaka Gotemba Interchange Store (Details) This is the closest branch of a popular hamburger restaurant chain that only operates in Shizuoka Prefecture, located in the area closest to Tokyo. Be prepared to wait in line for over two hours on weekends. (Tabelog)

■An extremely popular restaurant. Even on weekdays, there's usually a one-hour wait. You can order the hamburger rare. It's quite impressive, as it's usually impossible to get a rare hamburger unless the quality control is very strict. The taste is simply delicious. It's generally good value for money.

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：さすけ食堂詳細 「黄金のアジフライ」で有名な人気店で週末には長蛇の列が出来る事もある。10:00〜18:00（食材が無くなり次第終了）・金〜月曜営業。
■店の入り口に名前書く紙があるので、土日は朝8時前には名前を書いておくのがよい（7:15ごろにウェイティングシートが表に出る）。10時ぴったりに開店。もの凄い行列になる。半フライ（アジフライ３つ）追加で500円。さすけ定食1500円＋アジフライ３つ追加500円、計2000円でおなかいっぱい。ここは本当に美味い。オススメ。食べログ
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: Details of Sasuke Shokudo A popular restaurant famous for its "golden fried horse mackerel," which can have long lines on weekends. 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM (closes when ingredients run out) - Open Friday to Monday.

■There's a sign-up sheet at the entrance, so it's best to write your name down before 8 AM on Saturdays and Sundays (the waiting sheet is put out around 7:15 AM). Opens exactly at 10 AM. There's a huge line. Adding half a portion (3 fried horse mackerel) is 500 yen. Sasuke set meal 1500 yen + 3 extra fried horse mackerel for 500 yen, total 2000 yen for a full meal. This place is truly delicious. Highly recommended. Tabelog

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 金谷海浜公園（さすけの裏）
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：さすけの横を通って、裏の奥に入れる。公衆トイレもある。国道沿いの公園駐車場は夜間閉鎖されるが、こっちは夜も入れる。交番のすぐ裏なので、治安も悪くないと思う。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: You can get in by going past Sasuke and going to the back. There are also public toilets. The park parking lot along the national highway is closed at night, but this one is open at night. It's right behind the police box, so I think the area is safe. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: （トイレ遠い、過去に襲撃事件）浜名湖西駐車場
properties.title_en: (Toilets are far away, there was an attack in the past) Hamana Lake West Parking Lot""
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：サーファー御用達駐車場 夏場のみ1000円/回 水、トイレなし 近くの公園まで行けば何とかなる。 過去に、付近に住む外人に、車中泊していたサーファーが襲われたケース有り。 夏場の人がそこそこ多い時期なら多少安全かも（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Surfer-favorite parking lot. 1000 yen/use only during summer. No water or toilets. You can manage if you go to the nearby park. In the past, there have been cases where surfers sleeping in their cars were attacked by foreigners living nearby. It might be somewhat safer during the summer when there are a fair number of people around (older post from before 2019).

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：こんにゃくパーク詳細）無料でこんにゃく製品の試食ができる他、こんにゃく製品の土産物が充実。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Konnyaku Park Details) You can sample konnyaku products for free, and there is a wide selection of konnyaku products available as souvenirs. (Tabelog)

properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A public bathhouse (not a hot spring) that uses waste heat from a garbage incineration plant. 600 yen for up to 4 hours. Details (Submitted by a reader in November 2023)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：ごみ処理の余熱を使った公共入浴施設。540円、詳細　詳細
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: A public bathing facility that uses waste heat from waste treatment. 540 yen, details details

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：この周辺の道路は８〜２０時限定で駐車禁止。夜間は駐車禁止が解除されるため車中泊が可能。トイレは公園にある。ただし、カップル覗きが徘徊しているという情報有り。治安的にはアレかも。あと職質もされるようです。
■公園内の有料駐車場は最初の1時間300円、以後30分毎に100円。上限なし！7：30-21：00以外出入り不可。詳細
■公園にはキャンプ場、オートキャンプ場がある（予約必須）。詳細
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website readers: Parking is prohibited on the surrounding roads from 8am to 8pm. The parking ban is lifted at night, allowing for overnight stays in vehicles. There are toilets in the park. However, there are reports of peeping Toms lurking around. The area might be a bit unsafe. Also, it seems you might be stopped and questioned by the police.

■The paid parking lot in the park costs 300 yen for the first hour, then 100 yen for every 30 minutes thereafter. No upper limit! Entry and exit are restricted outside of 7:30am-9pm. Details

■The park has a campground and an auto campground (reservations required). Details

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：ここまでの道が狭い。仮設トイレあり、ビューポイント。標高1320m（投稿：2025年4月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: The road leading up to this point is narrow. There is a temporary toilet and a viewpoint. Elevation 1320m (Submitted by a reader in April 2025)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：ここの鳥手羽唐揚げは、衣ナシの素揚げでメチャ旨です！食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: The fried chicken wings here are incredibly delicious, deep-fried without any batter! (Tabelog)

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.title_ja: 済美山運動場（和田堀公園 第２競技場）の駐車場
properties.title_en: Parking lot at Seibiyama Athletic Field (Wadahori Park 2nd Stadium)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：コインパーキングで、料金は全日 00:00～24:00、最初1時間まで 1時間 300円、以降20分 100円、入庫後12時間最大1,200円、上限最大料金 繰返しあり（詳細）。キャブコンOK（６m位まで）目の前がトイレ２４h（比較的綺麗です）。地面は傾斜無し、治安悪くないです。車や電車での都心部へのアクセスも良いし、徒歩圏内にコンビニ・駐在所・銭湯あります。また近くに大宮八幡宮や和田堀公園と観光スポットあります。地方からキャンパー仲間が来るとここに泊まってもらっています。住宅地に近い公園なのでゴミ捨てやアイドリングのマナーを守って利用しましょう。（投稿：2023年7月、f様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: This is a coin-operated parking lot. The rates are 300 yen for the first hour (up to 24:00) and 100 yen for every 20 minutes thereafter. There is a maximum charge of 1,200 yen for the first 12 hours after entry, with a repeatable maximum charge (details). Cabover campers are OK (up to about 6m). There is a 24-hour toilet right in front (it's relatively clean). The ground is flat and the area is safe. It has good access to the city center by car and train, and there are convenience stores, a police station, and a public bath within walking distance. There are also tourist spots nearby, such as Omiya Hachimangu Shrine and Wadabori Park. When fellow campers from out of town come to stay here. Since it is a park close to a residential area, please use it while observing proper etiquette regarding littering and idling. (Submitted by: f, July 2023)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：コインシャワーがあります。10分で500円、シャワー室は汚めと時々照明が切れる。（投稿：2026年2月、管釣りバーサーカー様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There are coin-operated showers. 500 yen for 10 minutes, the shower rooms are dirty and the lights sometimes go out. (Submitted by: Fishing Berserker, February 2026)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：コインシャワーがあり5分あたり100円で一般利用も可能。車中泊に関しては、元々トラックの休憩所のためじゃまにならないところでしたことあります。（投稿：2026年2月、管釣りバーサーカー様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There are coin-operated showers available for general use at 100 yen per 5 minutes. As for overnight stays in a car, I have done it before in a place where it wouldn't be a nuisance, as it was originally a rest stop for trucks. (Submitted by: Fishing Berserker, February 2026)

■Detailed report (2021)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：かまぼこのテーマパーク。直売所、レストラン、博物館など。詳細（投稿：2026年1月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A kamaboko (fish cake) theme park. Includes a direct sales store, restaurant, museum, etc. Details (Submitted by: n, January 2026)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：かねつき堂　詳細 　行田市のB級グルメ「ゼリーフライ」（おからやジャガイモ等を油で揚げたコロッケの一種）の人気店。「行田フライ」もある。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Kanetsukido Details A popular restaurant in Gyoda City specializing in "Jelly Fry" (a type of croquette made from deep-fried okara, potatoes, etc.), a local B-grade gourmet dish. They also serve "Gyoda Fry". Tabelog

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：お池の水（竹本の湧水） 鳩山町竹本地区にある。埼玉県道171号から脇道に入り約400m先の田んぼの脇に水が流れている。水質検査済。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Pond water (Takemoto spring water) Located in the Takemoto area of ​​Hatoyama Town. Turn off Saitama Prefectural Road 171 onto a side road and the water flows beside a rice field about 400m away. Water quality has been tested.

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: えびせんべいの里御殿場店
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：えびせんべいの里御殿場店詳細） 御殿場IC（第一出入口）近く、愛知名物の海老煎餅製造店「えびせんべいの里」で最も東京に近い店舗。海老煎餅の試食ができる。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Details of Ebisenbei no Sato Gotemba Store) Located near Gotemba IC (First Exit), this is the closest store to Tokyo to "Ebisenbei no Sato," a manufacturer of Aichi's famous shrimp crackers. You can sample the shrimp crackers. Tabelog

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：うるおいてい　詳細 富士宮市のB級グルメ「富士宮やきそば」発祥の店。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Uruoitei Details The restaurant that originated "Fujinomiya Yakisoba," a local specialty of Fujinomiya City. Tabelog

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 みのぶ 富士川観光センター（旧：道の駅 富士川ふるさと工芸館）
properties.title_en: Michi-no-Eki Minobu Fujikawa Tourist Center (formerly: Michi-no-Eki Fujikawa Furusato Craft Center)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：インフォメーションセンター前の駐車区画は平たんで大変静かな環境。（一段下の大型バス区画に隣接の区画はやや斜め）道の駅全体が幹線道路（国道52号線）より5分ほど急坂を上った大規模公園（富士川クラフトパーク）内にあるため、周囲に人家や道路はないので、やや寂しい環境。が、駐車場の照明灯は深夜も点灯。（トイレも24H使用可）駐車区画にはドリフト族などのタイヤ跡はなし。立ち寄り温泉は、車で10分ほどの「ヘルシースパサンロード しもべの湯」（詳細）直近、2025年6/20-21泊。（投稿：2025年8月、千葉県MO様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: The parking area in front of the information center is flat and very quiet. (The area adjacent to the large bus area one level down is slightly sloped.) The entire roadside station is located within a large park (Fujikawa Craft Park) about a 5-minute uphill climb from the main road (National Route 52), so there are no houses or roads nearby, making it a somewhat lonely environment. However, the parking lot lights are on even in the middle of the night. (Toilets are also available 24 hours a day.) There are no tire marks from drifters or other similar activities in the parking area. For a hot spring visit, there is "Healthy Spa Sunroad Shimobe no Yu" (details) about a 10-minute drive away. Most recently, I stayed there from June 20-21, 2025. (Submitted by MO from Chiba Prefecture, August 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：いつも人がおらず超静か。清流の真横で自然満喫。新し目のトイレがあるが、定期清掃がないようで中はやや汚め。携帯はdocomo、softbankは何とか圏内。au、楽天は圏外。（投稿：2024年6月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: It's always deserted and super quiet. You can fully enjoy nature right next to a clear stream. There's a relatively new toilet, but it doesn't seem to be cleaned regularly, so it's a bit dirty inside. Docomo and Softbank have reception, but au and Rakuten have no reception. (Submitted by a reader in June 2024)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：あんかけ風甘辛スープの担々麺「小田原系担々麺」発祥の店。食べログ（投稿：2021年8月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: The restaurant that originated "Odawara-style Tantanmen," a type of tantanmen with a thick, sweet and spicy soup. (Reviewed on Tabelog in August 2021 by user n)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.title_ja: あしかがフラワーパーク
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：あしかがフラワーパーク詳細 4月中旬〜5月中旬に天然記念物のフジが開花して藤まつりが開かれる他、冬季には イルミネーションが開かれる。入場料300〜1700円（季節により変動） 9:00〜18:00（11〜3月は10:00〜17:00）営業。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Ashikaga Flower Park Details From mid-April to mid-May, the wisteria, a natural monument, blooms and a wisteria festival is held. In addition, illuminations are held during the winter. Admission fee: 300-1700 yen (varies depending on the season). Open from 9:00 to 18:00 (10:00 to 17:00 from November to March).

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)

properties.title_en: Ashikaga Natural Water (in front of Ashikaga Station)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：あしかがの自然水（足利駅前）詳細） JR足利駅北口前に、地下水を汲める蛇口がある。駐車場は駅の脇に2台分あり。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Ashikaga Natural Water (in front of Ashikaga Station) Details) There is a tap where you can draw groundwater in front of the north exit of JR Ashikaga Station. There are two parking spaces next to the station.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：s級スポットが近いため穴場になってます。私が泊まった日は私一人でした。道路側には傾斜あり、奥の岬のヘリの4台分は平坦です。トイレはあまり綺麗ではありません。少し治安も気になるかも。夜寝る前にゴソゴソやってたらパトカーが来ました。ただuターンしていっただけですが状況によっては職質されるかも。朝起きた後に広がる絶景は一入です。おすすめです。（投稿：2023年3月、s様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：水洗和式トイレ有り。非常に静かで富士山の眺望が素晴らしい。近くに飲食店やスーパー、コンビニ、入浴施設は無いので要注意。（投稿：2021年5月、M様）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: This is a hidden gem because it's close to an S-class spot. I was the only one there the night I stayed. There's a slope on the road side, but the area around the edge of the cape at the back is flat, about the size of four cars. The toilets aren't very clean. You might be a little concerned about safety. I was rustling around before going to bed at night when a police car came by. They just made a U-turn, but depending on the situation, you might get stopped and questioned. The spectacular view that unfolds when you wake up in the morning is exceptional. Highly recommended. (Posted: March 2023, S)

■Report from our website reader: There is a flush toilet with a Japanese-style design. It's very quiet and the view of Mt. Fuji is wonderful. Be aware that there are no restaurants, supermarkets, convenience stores, or bathing facilities nearby. (Posted: May 2021, M)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：JR久留里線下郡駅近くの自噴井戸。標記の場所の他、南方にもう1ヶ所水汲み場がある。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: An artesian well near Shimogori Station on the JR Kururi Line. In addition to the location indicated, there is another water source to the south.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：GoogleMapの衛星画像で見るとわかりますけど、フルーツラインから西へ曲がった左手すぐにトイレと駐車場が有るので、そこに泊まりました。傾斜はほぼ平ら。近くを並走する国道411号よりは交通量は遥かに少なくて静かな場所です。21時くらいまでは若い人たちがいたりします。残念ながら楽天モバイルは入りませんでした。駐車場を出て西側の道路の端っこに徒歩で移動すると入ります（笑）この辺りでは貴重な車中泊スポットだと思います。（投稿：2025年11月、なこぎ様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：おすすめとは言い難いですがこの辺りに車中泊場所が少ないのでシェアします。フルーツライン沿いにある公園、結構交通量あり。名前通り夜景が綺麗なので暖かくなってきたらカップルが来そうです。夜間閉鎖なし、トイレは夜中電気つきません。男性トイレは水洗ですが和式、多目的トイレは洋式です。私が行ったときは紙が切れてました、メンテナンスはあまりされてないかも。。駐車場は全体的に斜傾あります。（投稿：2024年3月、すみしん様）
■標高501m
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: As you can see from the satellite image on Google Maps, there's a toilet and parking lot immediately to the left after turning west from Fruit Line, so I stayed there. The slope is almost flat. The traffic volume is far less than on National Route 411 which runs parallel nearby, making it a quiet place. There are young people there until around 9 PM. Unfortunately, Rakuten Mobile didn't work. If you leave the parking lot and walk to the edge of the road on the west side, it will work (lol). I think this is a valuable spot for overnight stays in your car in this area. (Posted: November 2025, Nakogi)

■Report from a reader of this site: I wouldn't necessarily recommend it, but I'm sharing it because there aren't many places to stay overnight in your car around here. It's a park along Fruit Line, and there's quite a bit of traffic. As the name suggests, the night view is beautiful, so couples will probably come when it gets warmer. It's not closed at night, but the toilet lights don't work at night. The men's toilet is a flush toilet but is a Japanese style, while the multipurpose toilet is Western style. When I went, they were out of toilet paper, so maintenance might not be very good. The parking lot is generally sloped. (Posted by Sumishin, March 2024)
■ Elevation: 501m

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 牛久沼水辺公園駐車場
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：9月28日(日）、牛久沼水辺公園駐車場にて車中泊しました。夜通し、明かりが点いていましたので車中泊可能です（添付画像）。私のほかには車中泊らしき車はなかったですが夕方から翌朝にかけて５～６台出入りしていました。静かで熟睡できました。翌朝、トイレの清掃が入りました。（毎朝かどうかは分かりません）添付の写真（添付画像）は清掃後ですが、本当に清掃したの？と思えるように汚れがこびり付いている感じがします。洗面台も汚れているように着色しています。私は男性ですので小便器のみを使用しました。また、別な方が駐車場のごみ拾いをしていました。（投稿：2025年10月、k様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2021年3月19日に宿泊。24時間利用可能。無料。新しいトイレもあり、こちらも24時間利用可能で夜もずっと点灯している。和式だが身障者用は洋式。ウォシュレットは無いが清潔でトイレットペーパーも十分。6号線から近いが車の音はまったく聞こえず、静かすぎるほど。金曜日の夜だったが車中泊していたのは私のほかに1台のみ。雲雀がさえずり、白鳥やカモ、ツグミやモズも見られる。（投稿：2021年3月、KangooTony様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：新しいトイレあり。無料駐車場。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: On September 28th (Sunday), I stayed overnight in my car at the Ushikunuma Lakeside Park parking lot. The lights were on all night, so it is possible to stay overnight in a car (attached image). There were no other cars that seemed to be staying overnight, but 5-6 cars came and went from evening to the next morning. It was quiet and I slept soundly. The next morning, the toilets were cleaned. (I don't know if this is done every morning.) The attached photo (attached image) is after cleaning, but it looks like the dirt is still caked on, making me wonder if it was really cleaned. The sinks also appear stained to look dirty. As I am a man, I only used the urinals. Also, someone else was picking up trash in the parking lot. (Submitted: October 2025, Mr. K)

■Report from a reader of this site: Stayed overnight on March 19th, 2021. Available 24 hours. Free. There are also new toilets, which are also available 24 hours and have the lights on all night. They are Japanese style, but the disabled-accessible toilet is Western style. There's no bidet, but it's clean and there's plenty of toilet paper. It's close to Route 6, but you can't hear any traffic noise at all; it's almost too quiet. It was Friday night, but besides mine, there was only one other car parked there overnight. Skylarks were singing, and swans, ducks, thrushes, and shrikes could be seen. (Posted: March 2021, KangooTony)

■Report from a reader of this site: New toilet available. Free parking. (Older post from before 2019)

The fee is 700 yen for up to 3 hours (extendable by 1 hour if you eat). There is an EV Quick in the parking lot. After eating and bathing here, I drove to "Michi-no-Eki Kurohone Yamabiko" and slept in my car. (Submitted by: n, November 2024)

properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2025/1訪問。新しいきれいな道の駅。伊豆縦貫自動車道天城北道路(E70)月ケ瀬ICに隣接、駐車スペースは100台前後。治安：キャンピングカー含む車中泊あり自己判断だが問題ないと思われる。DQN訪問もない、大型車は奥のほうで車中泊が基本となっている。自動車道出口併設で若干の音。軍か自衛隊のヘリがこの辺でホバリングしている方が気になった。トイレ=室内、ウオシュレット（24H利用OK確認済）　WIFI：Wimax=アンテナ１本、ほぼ繋がらない、♨近隣：湯の国会館(源泉、つるつる系)　￥880/第２・４水休。スーパー＆コンビニ＝LOWSON/300M＆マックスバリュー/車5分（投稿：2025年2月、クリッパーのぐっさん様）
■2019年12月14日オープン
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: Visited 2025/1. A new and clean roadside station. Located next to the Tsukigase IC on the Amagi North Road (E70) of the Izu Jukan Expressway, with parking space for around 100 cars. Safety: Overnight stays in vehicles, including campervans, are permitted, but it seems fine based on personal judgment. No visits by troublemakers, and large vehicles generally stay overnight in the back. There is some noise due to its proximity to the expressway exit. I was more bothered by military or Self-Defense Force helicopters hovering around here. Toilets: Indoors, with bidet (confirmed to be available 24 hours a day). WIFI: WiMAX = 1 bar of signal, almost no connection. Nearby hot springs: Yunokai Kaikan (natural hot spring, smooth-feeling type) ¥880/closed 2nd and 4th Wednesdays. Supermarkets & convenience stores: Lawson/300M & MaxValu/5 minutes by car (Posted: February 2025, by Clipper's Gussan)
■Opened December 14, 2019

properties.title_ja: 道の駅 ひたちおおた
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2025/1記載、併設のコンビニ（ヤマザキデイリー）は閉店、近隣200Ｍに7-11あり。トイレは２か所。館内トイレは18時で閉鎖、もう一方は外トイレと言いながら建物と併設24時間利用可で中は空調・ウオシュレットあり。東京行バスの停留所併設のため朝方、声・車の駐車で少々だが騒がしい。国道沿いだが概ね静か、ただし、DQNが1便当駅に到着（21－22時くらい）すぐ発車、私的には問題なし。近隣に温泉施設あり（太田温泉やまぶきの湯、詳細）便利。北海道にしかないセイコーマートが近隣に数か所、夕飯は北海道モードが良いならホットシェフおすすめ。（投稿：2025年1月、クリッパーのぐっさん様）
■2016年7月オープン。幹線国道沿いなのでうるさそう。茨城の珍走DQNが走ってそう。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Written January 2025. The attached convenience store (Yamazaki Daily) has closed, but there is a 7-Eleven 200m away. There are two toilets. The indoor toilet closes at 6pm, while the other, although called an outdoor toilet, is attached to the building and is available 24 hours a day, with air conditioning and a bidet. Because it is adjacent to a bus stop for buses going to Tokyo, it is a little noisy in the mornings due to voices and parked cars. It is along a national highway but is generally quiet, however, one bus with a rowdy driver arrives at this station (around 9-10pm) and departs immediately, but personally, it is not a problem. There is a hot spring facility nearby (Ota Onsen Yamabuki no Yu, details), which is convenient. There are several Seicomart stores nearby, which are only found in Hokkaido, and if you want Hokkaido-style dinner, Hot Chef is recommended. (Posted: January 2025, by Clipper's Gussan)
■Opened July 2016. It is located along a main national highway, so it seems noisy. Looks like the kind of delinquent, reckless drivers from Ibaraki would ride around here.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2025-9-22 現地確認　伊豆半島西海岸の景勝地です。トイレは2h使えます。駐車場はどこも少し傾斜がありますが、さほど気になるものではありません。辺鄙な場所ですが、朝夕、美しい景色が楽しめます。また北側には富士を遠望できます。ただし、岬なので強風時は注意が必要でしょう。添付画像、添付画像、添付画像、添付画像（投稿：2025年9月、tossan様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: September 22, 2025 (On-site verification) This is a scenic spot on the west coast of the Izu Peninsula. The toilets are available for 2 hours. The parking lots are all slightly sloped, but not too much of a problem. It's a remote location, but you can enjoy beautiful scenery in the morning and evening. You can also see Mount Fuji in the distance to the north. However, since it's a cape, caution is needed during strong winds. Attached images (Posted by tossan, September 2025)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2024年11月の平日に利用。目の前に妙義山の威容。下界の風景も楽しめます。夜半過ぎに騒がしい一団が来て10分間ほどワイワイやっていましたが、耳栓のお陰で問題なく休めました。EV Quickがありますが、珍しい従量制です。近くの「もみじの湯」までは700ｍほど。（投稿：2024年11月、n様）
■標高は430mと意外と低い（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Used on a weekday in November 2024. The majestic Mt. Myogi is right in front of you. You can also enjoy the scenery of the world below. A noisy group came after midnight and made a racket for about 10 minutes, but thanks to earplugs, I was able to rest without any problems. There is an EV Quick, but it is an unusual pay-per-use system. It is about 700m to the nearby "Momiji no Yu" hot spring. (Posted by: n, November 2024)

■The elevation is surprisingly low at 430m (older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2024年11月の平日に利用。 「満願の湯」で食事と入浴の後にここで車中泊。入口は大きな交差点ですが、駐車場は裏手なので静かです。トイレはキレイで快適。EVの200V充電器が2基あります。無料で時間無制限！助かります。（投稿：2024年11月、n様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場が水平。静かなのは一段高い第二駐車場？新設のトイレがきれい。（投稿：2024年6月、読者様）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: Used on a weekday in November 2024. After eating and bathing at "Mangan-no-Yu," I stayed overnight in my car here. The entrance is at a large intersection, but the parking lot is in the back, so it's quiet. The toilets are clean and comfortable. There are two 200V EV chargers. Free and unlimited time! Very helpful. (Submitted by: n, November 2024)

■Report from our website reader: The parking lot is level. Is the second parking lot, which is slightly higher, quieter? The newly built toilets are clean. (Submitted by: reader, June 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2023年開園の新しい綺麗な駐車場とトイレ（※夜間利用可否不明）。14台駐車可能。（投稿：2023年10月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A new, clean parking lot and restrooms at the park that opened in 2023 (※Availability at night is unknown). Parking available for 14 cars. (Submitted by a reader in October 2023)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 いちごの里 よしみ
properties.title_en: Roadside Station Ichigo no Sato Yoshimi
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：２０２３年９月の平日に利用。ちょっと変わった作りになっていて、売店から敷地内通路（片側１車線）を挟んだ東側が駐車場とトイレです。敷地南側に広い第２Pもあります。静かで快適ですが、その敷地内通路付近は絶えず出入りするクルマの音が聞こえます。EV Quickがトイレの前にあります。（投稿：2023年10月、n様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：管理人さんも書いてるように、南側の第二駐車場(砂利)は大型車禁止でアイドリングトラックも皆無で非常に静か。夜中は巨大な駐車場に数台しか居ないため間隔広めの駐車で他車の音等が気になりにくく、地面も水平。道の駅では熟睡度トップランクと言ってもいいかも。夜２台並べてアイドリングしてる車は、ほぼ地元のデートの男女で、就寝の頃には帰るため心配無用。（投稿：2023年6月、読者様）
■広い駐車場で、南側は静かで良い。トイレから遠くなるが、ココにある未舗装の第二駐車場が静かで良かった。耳栓すれば朝まで爆睡。（2023年5月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Used on a weekday in September 2023. It has a slightly unusual layout; the parking lot and restrooms are on the east side of the site, across a pathway (one lane in each direction) from the shop. There is also a large second parking lot on the south side of the site. It is quiet and comfortable, but you can constantly hear the sound of cars coming and going near the pathway. There is an EV Quick in front of the restrooms. (Submitted by: n, October 2023)

■Report from a reader of this site: As the administrator also wrote, the second parking lot on the south side (gravel) is off-limits to large vehicles and there are no idling trucks, making it very quiet. At night, there are only a few cars in the huge parking lot, so the parking is spaced far apart and you are less bothered by the sound of other cars, and the ground is level. It might be one of the best roadside stations for a good night's sleep. The two cars idling side by side at night are almost always local couples on dates, and they leave by bedtime, so there is no need to worry. (Submitted by: reader, June 2023)

■It has a large parking lot, and the south side is quiet and nice. Although it's further from the restrooms, the unpaved second parking lot here is quiet and nice. With earplugs in, I slept soundly until morning. (Confirmed by the caretaker in May 2023)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2023年9月の週末に利用。東北道で最大級のSAです。広くて空きスペースもあり、快適に休めました。フードコートの奥の方にある餃子専門店でいただいた宇都宮餃子は餡がペースト状で食べやすかった。EV Quickがありますが、出口手前を左に登る坂の上にあるので見つけにくいです。（投稿：2023年10月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Used on a weekend in September 2023. This is one of the largest service areas on the Tohoku Expressway. It's spacious with plenty of open space, making for a comfortable rest. The Utsunomiya gyoza I had at the gyoza specialty shop at the back of the food court had a paste-like filling, making it easy to eat. There is an EV Quick, but it's difficult to find as it's located on a slope to the left just before the exit. (Submitted by: n, October 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 富士山 御殿場口新五合目駐車場
properties.title_en: Mount Fuji Gotemba New 5th Station Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2021年改修の水洗トイレがきれい。一番上の第一駐車場はバス、タクシー専用。第二駐車場は狭い＆早朝登山者で騒がしいため、広く空いてる第三駐車場がおすすめ。車中泊はチラホラ見かける程度。非常に静かですが、時々、自衛隊の砲撃演習の爆音が響く。訓練日時は事前に自衛隊公式HP（詳細）で確認可能。（投稿：2023年7月、読者様）
■無料駐車場とトイレ。夜間もトイレ利用可能で車中泊できたという報告あり。4つある富士山五合目駐車場のうち、ここだけ夏季の交通規制がないため、夏でも車中泊が可能。空が東京方面に開けており、東京方面は夜でもメチャクチャ明るいので天体観測には向かない。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: The flush toilets, renovated in 2021, are clean. The top-most parking lot (Parking Lot 1) is for buses and taxis only. Parking Lot 2 is small and noisy with early morning climbers, so the spacious and less crowded Parking Lot 3 is recommended. Overnight parking is only seen occasionally. It's very quiet, but sometimes the sound of artillery fire from Self-Defense Forces exercises can be heard. Exercise dates and times can be checked in advance on the official Self-Defense Forces website (details). (Posted: July 2023, by a reader)

■Free parking and toilets. There are reports that toilets are available at night and that overnight parking is possible. Of the four parking lots at the 5th station of Mt. Fuji, this is the only one without summer traffic restrictions, making overnight parking possible even in summer. The sky opens up towards Tokyo, and Tokyo is extremely bright even at night, so it's not suitable for stargazing. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: 天狗山第１駐車場 天狗山スキー場P
properties.title_en: Tenguyama 1st Parking Lot, Tenguyama Ski Resort Parking""
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2020年8月に訪問したら、夜間封鎖されるようになってました。駐車場に残ってると追い出されます。残念。
■無料駐車場とトイレ。西の河原露天風呂に便利。きれいなトイレが新設されました。車中泊に最適。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: When I visited in August 2020, it was closed at night. If you stay in the parking lot, you'll be kicked out. Disappointing.

■Free parking and toilets. Convenient for the Nishinokawara Open-Air Bath. Clean toilets have been newly installed. Ideal for overnight stays in your car.

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：２０１８年8月の平日に利用。「車中泊もできなくはない」という印象です。料金２５００円。10km下の尾瀬第１Pからバス等で来るよりここに駐める方が安いです。ここは早朝６時前後に満車になってしまうのと、日付が変わるとまた同じ料金がかかるので、夜半直後に入って翌日に備えるのが良さそうです。ただ、ここの簡易トイレは２０２３年夏現在使用不可との情報あり。100ｍほど先の休憩所にトイレと洗面所がありますが、道中にも現地にも夜間照明はありません。もっと安心と快適さを求めるなら、20kmほど下ったところの「道の駅 尾瀬かたしな」がお勧めです。（投稿：2023年10月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Used on a weekday in August 2018. "It's not impossible to stay overnight in your car." The fee is 2500 yen. It's cheaper to park here than to come by bus from Oze No. 1 P 10km down. This place fills up around 6am, and the same fee is charged again once midnight, so it's best to arrive right after midnight to prepare for the next day. However, there is information that the portable toilets here are unusable as of summer 2023. There are toilets and washrooms at a rest area about 100m away, but there is no nighttime lighting along the way or at the site. If you are looking for more safety and comfort, we recommend "Michi-no-Eki Oze Katashina" about 20km downhill. (Submitted by: n, October 2023)

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：1泊(19～7時)200円で23区内では激安（詳細）。トイレは目の前に公園のトイレあり。すぐ隣にスーパーまいばすけっと、徒歩圏内に銭湯さつき湯（詳細）あり。（投稿：2024年3月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: 200 yen for one night (7pm to 7am) is incredibly cheap for a hotel in the 23 wards of Tokyo (details). There are toilets in the park right in front of the hotel. There is a My Basket supermarket right next door, and Satsuki-yu public bathhouse within walking distance (details). (Submitted by a reader in March 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 神栖中央公園南駐車場
properties.title_en: Kamisu Central Park South Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：126台駐車可。神栖中央公園には3つ駐車場があり、全てトイレあり。（投稿：2022年5月、a様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：無料駐車場とトイレ。定期的にパト巡回にて安全。すぐ近くに繁華街。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: 126 parking spaces available. Kamisu Central Park has three parking lots, all with restrooms. (Submitted by: A, May 2022)
■ Reader Report: Free parking and restrooms. Regular patrols ensure safety. A bustling downtown area is nearby. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 温泉バルコニー キング&クィーン
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：1100円、詳細　受付内に食堂・休憩室あり。（投稿：2025年2月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: 1100 yen, details available. There is a cafeteria and rest area inside the reception area. (Submitted by: n, February 2025)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：詳細 　伊豆名物の生わさびを使った生わさび丼の店。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Details A restaurant specializing in raw wasabi rice bowls made with fresh wasabi, a specialty of Izu. Tabelog

properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Details A popular restaurant serving Chichibu's specialty "walnut soba" (soba noodles served with a dipping sauce containing ground walnuts). Tabelog

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：詳細 　焼津港等から直送の魚介類が揃う市場。食堂もある。焼津IC近く。9:00〜17:00営業。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Details A market offering fresh seafood delivered directly from Yaizu Port and other locations. There is also a restaurant. Located near Yaizu Interchange. Open from 9:00 to 17:00.

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: レストラン大手門（城址公園 市民会館いわつきの中）
properties.title_en: Restaurant Otemon (located inside the Iwatsuki Civic Hall in the castle ruins park)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：詳細 　さいたま市のご当地ラーメン「豆腐ラーメン」発祥の店。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Details The restaurant that originated "Tofu Ramen," a local ramen dish from Saitama City. (Tabelog)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：詳細 　日本最大の中華街。中華料理店が200軒以上集まる。専用の駐車場無し。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Details Japan's largest Chinatown. Over 200 Chinese restaurants are located here. No dedicated parking available.

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：詳細、浜松市で500円で海鮮丼が食べられる、特に学生に人気の店。11:30〜売り切れ次第終了 平日は城北支店など、土日は富塚本店が営業。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Details, a popular restaurant in Hamamatsu City where you can eat a seafood rice bowl for 500 yen, especially among students. Open from 11:30 until sold out. The Johoku branch is open on weekdays, and the Tomizuka main store is open on weekends. Tabelog

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：詳細　 藤枝名物朝ラーメン発祥の店。温かいラーメンと冷たいラーメンの2杯食べるのが地元流。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Details The restaurant that originated Fujieda's famous morning ramen. Eating two bowls, one hot and one cold, is the local custom. (Tabelog)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：詳細　 国道1号沿い、伊豆縦貫自動車道の三島塚原IC近く。季節によりイチゴやメロン狩りができる他、えびせんべいの試食ができる。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Details Located along National Route 1, near the Mishima Tsukahara Interchange of the Izu Jukan Expressway. Depending on the season, you can pick strawberries and melons, and sample shrimp crackers. Tabelog

properties.label: Restaurant

properties.title_en: The Yoshimura family, the head temple of the family lineage.""
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：詳細 　横浜発祥の豚骨醤油ラーメン「横浜家系ラーメン」の総本山。専用の駐車場無し。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Details The main branch of "Yokohama Iekei Ramen," a tonkotsu soy sauce ramen originating in Yokohama. No dedicated parking available. Tabelog

properties.title_ja: サイボクハム日高本店 レストラン サイボク
properties.title_en: Saiboku Ham Hidaka Main Store Restaurant Saiboku
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：詳細　 精肉や農産物の直売所。バーベキューレストランや温泉も併設。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Details A direct sales store for meat and agricultural products. Also features a barbecue restaurant and hot springs. (Tabelog)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.title_ja: 清水渓流広場（濃溝の滝・亀岩の洞窟）
properties.title_en: Shimizu Stream Plaza (Nomizo Falls, Kameiwa Cave)""
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：詳細。「まるでジブリ映画の世界」とネットで話題。余りの混雑のため、近くの道の駅から無料シャトルバスが出る事がある。清水渓流公園の中、濃溝温泉千寿の湯近く。詳しくは濃溝の滝で検索。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Details. It's become a hot topic online, described as "like something out of a Ghibli movie." Due to the extreme crowds, a free shuttle bus sometimes runs from a nearby roadside station. It's located within Shimizu Keiryu Park, near Nomizo Onsen Senju no Yu. For more information, search for Nomizo Falls.

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.title_ja: 特P ユー企画 稲取唐沢駐車場（トイレはドラッグストア利用）
properties.title_en: Special Parking (Yu-Kikaku) Inatori Karasawa Parking Lot (Restrooms are available at the drugstore)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：料金詳細。当駐車場は国道135号線沿いの稲取高校下交差点（唐沢交差点）に位置しており、高台にあることから相模湾を一望することが出来ます。日の出や月を拝むことが出来、初日の出や満月の日は特に景色を楽しむことが出来るのではないかと思われます。また、開催場所にもよりますが、稲取の花火大会も楽しむことが可能です。近隣にはドラッグストアや飲食店があることから、日用品や食料品の調達、食事などが可能な環境にあります。敷地内の水道は利用可能ですが、甚だ恐縮ながら、トイレと入浴施設は御座いませんので、ご自身でご用意いただくか、近隣の施設をご利用いただきたく存じます。トイレに関しましては、隣地がドラッグストアですので、営業時間内に買い物ついでに利用が可能であると思われます。また、車で2～3分の場所には24時間営業のコンビニエンスストアがありますので、そちらのトイレも利用可能です。入浴施設に関しましては、近隣に日帰り温泉（黒根岩風呂、大川露天風呂、河津町の踊り子温泉会館など）があります。一区画の大きさは、幅3m長さ6mですので、大型車も駐車可能です。施設面で足りない点は多々あるのですが、気軽な車中泊スポットとしてご利用頂ければと考えております。（投稿：2024年10月、駐車場運営会社担当者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website readers: Price details. Our parking lot is located at the Inatori High School intersection (Karasawa intersection) along National Route 135, and because it is on a hill, you can enjoy a panoramic view of Sagami Bay. You can watch the sunrise and the moon, and the view is especially enjoyable on the first sunrise of the year and on full moon nights. Depending on the location, you can also enjoy the Inatori Fireworks Festival. There are drugstores and restaurants nearby, so you can purchase daily necessities and groceries and have meals. Water is available on the premises, but unfortunately there are no toilets or bathing facilities, so please bring your own or use nearby facilities. Regarding toilets, there is a drugstore next door, so you should be able to use it while shopping during business hours. There is also a 24-hour convenience store a 2-3 minute drive away, so you can use the toilet there as well. Regarding bathing facilities, there are day-trip hot springs nearby (Kurone Iwa-buro, Okawa Open-Air Bath, Kawazu Town's Odoriko Onsen Kaikan, etc.). Each parking space measures 3m wide and 6m long, so even large vehicles can be parked there. While there are many shortcomings in terms of facilities, we hope you will use it as a convenient spot for overnight stays in your vehicle. (Posted: October 2024, by a representative of the parking lot management company)

If you prefer a Western-style toilet with a bidet, you can use the toilets at nearby convenience stores and supermarkets (Daiei). It's quiet and nice at night with little traffic. properties.desc_en:
■Highly praised by numerous hot spring enthusiasts. 1500 yen, details
■Manager's rating ★4.4 (Spring quality 4.2, Scenery 0.2) First of all, the spring water is colorless and transparent, with a mild scent and no distinctive characteristics. It feels like the hot springs in Izu. If you pursue the ultimate in hot springs, you'll probably end up with this kind of alkaline simple spring, but honestly, it's just average. The building is a cultural property and certainly impressive, but you can only see a little of it if you're a day visitor. You probably can't appreciate its charm unless you stay overnight.

properties.desc_en: ■It springs up within the grounds of a shrine in Matsuzaki Town. It's near the parking lot across from the "Chohachi Memorial Hall".

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)

properties.desc_ja: ■小田原市の井細田駅近く、商店街の中にある寺の境内にある。自然に流れている水の量は少ないが、隣の蛇口から水が汲める。

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■春は桜、秋は紅葉が楽しめます。冬の空気の澄んだ日には新宿の高層ビル群や東京スカイツリー、富士山が一望できます。ただし22:00〜6:00が通行禁止になるため、車中泊等は不可。
properties.desc_en: ■ You can enjoy cherry blossoms in spring and autumn leaves in fall. On clear winter days, you can see the skyscrapers of Shinjuku, Tokyo Skytree, and Mount Fuji. However, the road is closed to traffic from 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM, so overnight parking is not permitted.

properties.desc_ja:
■車中泊評価【良😊】74点👉️採点詳細と詳細案内図はこちら。（2024年12月）
■当サイト読者様レポート：国道沿いなのでまあまあうるさい。道沿いより建物裏の川側(北側)が若干静かだが勾配少しあり。大型トラックは道挟んで隣「川の駅」へ誘導されるためトラックはほぼ無し。「川の駅」にシャワー室あり（380円/回）9:00～、詳細、近くの佐原の町は飲食チェーン店はほぼ網羅、商業施設も充実してるので、食事買い物補給に便利。（投稿：2022年5月、a様）
properties.desc_en:
■Car Camping Rating: [Good 😊] 74 points 👉️Click here for detailed scoring and detailed map. (December 2024)
■Report from a reader of this site: It's fairly noisy as it's along the national highway. The river side (north side) behind the building is slightly quieter than the road side, but there is a slight slope. Large trucks are directed to the adjacent "River Station" across the road, so there are almost no trucks. There is a shower room at the "River Station" (380 yen/use) from 9:00, details: The nearby town of Sawara has almost all chain restaurants and plenty of commercial facilities, making it convenient for eating, shopping, and replenishing supplies. (Posted: May 2022, by A)

■入浴♨️：隣接の日光アストリアホテルで入浴可能。しかも本物の名湯。1000円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：こうやって（添付画像）、キャンピングトレーラー切り離してどこかへ行っちゃってる輩、最近多いですよね。ここも、そろそろ完全封鎖ですね、きっと。（投稿：2020年9月、M様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：基本静かだったが、ネットで知れ渡り、穴場では無くなった。休日は禁止事項の車外にイステーブルを広げ、オートキャンプ行為が目立つようになり、酒も入って夜大声で話す輩が増えた。うるさいかはその日の運次第。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Car Camping Rating [Excluded Rank 😅] 77 points 👉️ Click here for detailed scoring and detailed map. (September 2024)
■Bathing ♨️: Bathing is possible at the adjacent Nikko Astoria Hotel. Moreover, it's a genuine hot spring. 1000 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: Recently, there are many people who detach their camping trailers like this (attached image) and go off somewhere. This place will probably be completely closed off soon. (Posted: September 2020, Mr. M)
■Report from our site's reader: It used to be quiet, but it's become known online and is no longer a hidden gem. On holidays, people are setting up chairs and tables outside their cars, which is prohibited, and auto camping activities are becoming more noticeable, and there are more people who talk loudly at night after drinking. Whether it's noisy or not depends on the day. (Older post from before 2019)
