properties.title_ja: 道の駅 つどいの郷むつざわ
properties.title_en: [S-Rank] Roadside Station Tsudoi no Sato Mutsuzawa
properties.desc_ja:
■車中泊評価【Sランク🤩】89点👉️詳細案内図、採点詳細と詳細案内図はこちら。（2024年12月現地確認）
■入浴♨️：「むつざわ温泉 つどいの湯」800円、詳細
■5chレポート：道の駅関東第二位の人気 保田小学校なのだが、俺的には道の駅 むつざわつどいの郷が関東屈指に入らないのが不思議。保田小学校より良いぞ？車中泊マップのS級に認定されてもおかしくない。サウナ付温泉併設で近隣にコンビニもある。あの、濱口優も紹介してたわw ただし！夜中とかオブジェにイタズラするアホンダラいるようで注意書きしてあった。車中泊禁止になるのも時間の問題かもしれん。（投稿：2023年12月）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2019年9月から、新規施設で営業しています。千葉では貴重な、温泉施設付きの道の駅となりました。近場でコンビニ2つ、コインランドリー、スーパー等、徒歩圏内に便利な施設が多いです。ただし、駐車場は水はけのためか、目視で分かるほどの傾斜あり。駐車位置に注意が必要となります。あと、千葉ですので珍走の方が…（夕方に単独で見かけた）。2020年6月の土曜に車中泊しましたが、キャンピングカーがいっぱいで、治安的には大丈夫そうかな。（駐車場にタイヤ痕は見当たらず）（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Car Camping Rating [S Rank 🤩] 89 points 👉️Detailed map, scoring details and detailed map are here. (Confirmed on site in December 2024)
■Bathing ♨️: "Mutsuzawa Onsen Tsudoi no Yu" 800 yen, details
■5ch Report: Hota Elementary School is the second most popular roadside station in Kanto, but I find it strange that Mutsuzawa Tsudoi no Sato roadside station isn't among the best in Kanto. It's better than Hota Elementary School! It deserves to be certified as S-rank on the car camping map. It has a hot spring with a sauna and a convenience store nearby. Even Hamaguchi Yu introduced it lol However! There seems to be some idiot vandalizing the sculptures at night, so there are warning signs. It might only be a matter of time before car camping is prohibited. (Posted: December 2023)
■Report from our site's reader: New facility operating since September 2019. This roadside station in Chiba is a rare find, featuring a hot spring facility. There are many convenient facilities within walking distance, including two convenience stores, a laundromat, and a supermarket. However, the parking lot has a noticeable slope, possibly for drainage. Careful parking is needed. Also, as this is Chiba, there are some reckless drivers... (I saw one alone in the evening). I stayed overnight in my car on a Saturday in June 2020, and there were lots of campervans, so it seemed safe. (No tire tracks were visible in the parking lot) (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station + Onsen
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 こぶちさわ
properties.desc_ja:
■車中泊評価【Sランク🤩】87点👉️採点詳細と詳細案内図はこちら。（2024年10月）
■入浴♨️：《スパティオ小淵沢「延命の湯」》 830円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：スパティオ小淵沢の温泉が夜10時まで利用可能。温泉利用の車、バイクが遅くまで出入りするため、早く寝たい人にはお勧めできない。早く寝たい人は、温泉から離れた所に停めた方が良い。温泉営業終了後は非常に静か。ローソンまで車で 2 分。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：きれいなトイレ完備。宿泊施設が併設されていて、温泉【有料💰️】を利用可能です。足湯（無料）有。週末は結構混雑します。最寄りのコンビニまで徒歩5分程度。周辺を散策するととても気持ちいいですが、時々熊の糞を見かけます。（実際遭遇したことはないですが...（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Car Camping Rating [S Rank 🤩] 87 points 👉️ Click here for detailed scoring and detailed map. (October 2024)
■Bathing ♨️: 《Spatio Kobuchizawa "Enmei no Yu"》 830 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: The hot spring at Spatio Kobuchizawa is available until 10 pm. Cars and motorcycles come and go late into the night to use the hot spring, so it's not recommended for people who want to go to bed early. If you want to go to bed early, it's better to park further away from the hot spring. It's very quiet after the hot spring closes. 2 minutes by car to Lawson. (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from our site's reader: Clean toilets are available. Accommodation is attached, and you can use the hot spring [for a fee 💰️]. There is a footbath (free). It gets quite crowded on weekends. The nearest convenience store is about a 5-minute walk away. It's very pleasant to stroll around the area, but you sometimes see bear droppings. (I've never actually encountered this myself, though... (an older post from before 2019))

properties.label: Roadside Station + Onsen
properties.desc_ja:
■車中泊評価【Sランク🤩】87点👉️採点詳細と詳細案内図はこちら。（2024年10月）
■入浴♨️：《富士眺望の湯 ゆらり》1700円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：《富士眺望の湯 ゆらり》：道の駅なるさわの観光案内所に100円割引券が置いてある事も。19時以降の入場で割引料金。静かな端の第三駐車場は夜トイレがシャッター封鎖。夜トイレまで歩くのが苦で無い人は静かで、富士山一望、コンビニも近くおすすめだが、平日早朝5時頃から、違法無線らしきアンテナ装備のダンプ、トラック達(お察し下さい)が集結し、アイドリング地獄に。（投稿：2023年7月、読者様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：車中泊料金無料　駐車場はとても広く停める場所は選び放題です。夜はとても静かでぐっすり眠ることができました。施設参考URL：詳細、道の駅なるさわでの車中泊の様子は、私のYouTubeをご視聴頂ければと思います。ただこの日は天気が悪く雨での道の駅なるさわの様子になります。👉️詳細（投稿：2021年8月、沖縄ないちゃー様、Youtubeチャンネル）
■幹線国道から完全分離。名水汲めます。裏に温泉施設あり。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：売店9:00〜18:00、レストラン（食券式）9:30〜17:30営業（夏季は営業時間延長あり）。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Car Camping Rating [S Rank 🤩] 87 points 👉️ Click here for detailed scoring and detailed map. (October 2024)
■Bathing ♨️: "Fuji View Hot Spring Yurari" 1700 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: "Fuji View Hot Spring Yurari": Sometimes a 100 yen discount coupon is available at the tourist information center at Michi-no-Eki Narusawa. Discounted rates apply for entry after 7 PM. The quiet third parking lot at the edge has its toilets shuttered off at night. If you don't mind walking to the toilets at night, it's quiet, offers a panoramic view of Mt. Fuji, and is recommended as there's a convenience store nearby. However, from around 5 AM on weekdays, dump trucks and other trucks equipped with what appear to be illegal radio antennas (you can imagine) gather, creating an idling nightmare. (Posted: July 2023, by a reader)
■Report from our site's reader: Free car camping. The parking lot is very large, so you can choose where to park. It was very quiet at night, and I was able to sleep soundly. Facility Reference URL: For details and a video of my overnight stay at Michi-no-Eki Narusawa, please watch my YouTube video. However, the weather was bad and it was raining on this particular day, so the video shows Michi-no-Eki Narusawa in those conditions. 👉️Details (Posted: August 2021, Okinawa Naichaa, YouTube channel)
■Completely separated from the main national highway. You can draw pure spring water. There is a hot spring facility behind it. (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from a reader of this site: Shop 9:00-18:00, Restaurant (ticket system) 9:30-17:30 (Extended hours in summer). (Older post from before 2019)

■入浴♨️：《薬師の湯》700円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：併設の温泉は2023年6月から600円→700円に値上げ。毎早朝、土砂運搬のダンプカー軍団の待ち合わせ、タンクローリーの時間調整場になってるようで、アイドリング音で叩き起こされます。ネットでもくさいと評判の悪い北側トイレより、南側のトイレの方が新しく清潔👉️詳細（投稿：2023年7月、読者様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：奥の方に静かな駐車場（第二駐車場）がありますが、21時～9時は駐車禁止の看板があります（車中泊排除の為？）（投稿：2023年6月、読者様）
■奥の方に静かな駐車場あり。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:

■Bathing ♨️: "Yakushi no Yu" 700 yen, details

Every early morning, it seems to be a meeting place for a group of dump trucks transporting soil and a time adjustment point for tank trucks, and you'll be woken up by the sound of idling engines. The toilets on the south side are newer and cleaner than the north side toilets, which have a bad reputation online for being smelly 👉️ Details (Posted: July 2023, reader)
■Report from our site's reader: There is a quiet parking lot (second parking lot) in the back, but there is a no-parking sign from 9 PM to 9 AM (to prevent car camping?) (Posted: June 2023, reader)
■There is a quiet parking lot in the back. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station + Onsen

properties.desc_ja:
■車中泊評価【Aランク😄】83点👉️採点詳細と詳細案内図はこちら。（2024年9月）
■入浴♨️：《かわば田園温泉 楽楽の湯》1000円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：第1～7駐車場あり、第4以上は番号が高い程静寂性が上がる(第7が一番静か)がトイレが遠くなる。ゆるい傾斜があるが、比較的平らな所は第4～6、第2の北東＝トイレ前。併設温泉が高額、3km先のいこいの湯が安い(440円)⇨詳細（投稿：2025年4月、読者様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場広い上に点在しており、落ち着く場所多数。国道から離れており、夜は大変静か。但し、近隣にコンビニ等なし。トイレ24時間、きれい。遊具多数、子供も大満足。季節次第で夜、明かりにハエが多数来るので注意。明るくなり始めると団体客が集まり出す。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■いつの間にか温泉施設ができてました。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Car Camping Rating [A Rank 😄] 83 points 👉️ Click here for detailed scoring and detailed map. (September 2024)
■Bathing ♨️: Kawaba Denen Onsen Rakuraku no Yu 1000 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: There are parking lots 1-7. From lot 4 onwards, the higher the number, the quieter it becomes (lot 7 is the quietest), but the toilets are further away. There is a gentle slope, but the relatively flat areas are lot 4-6, and the northeast of lot 2 = in front of the toilets. The attached hot spring is expensive, but Ikoi no Yu 3km away is cheaper (440 yen) ⇨ Details (Posted: April 2025, by a reader)
■Report from our site's reader: The parking lot is large and scattered, with many quiet spots. It is away from the national highway, so it is very quiet at night. However, there are no convenience stores nearby. The toilets are 24 hours and clean. There are many playground equipment, so children will be very happy. Depending on the season, be careful as many flies are attracted to the lights at night. As it starts to get light, tour groups begin to gather. (Older post from before 2019)
■A hot spring facility has appeared out of nowhere. (Older post from before 2019)

■Car Camping Rating [A Rank 😄] 83 points 👉️ Click here for detailed scoring and detailed map. (September 2024)
■Bathing ♨️: Oze Purari-kan, Adult 600 yen, Details
■Report from our site's reader: This is a parking lot for people going hiking and mountain climbing. People start moving around before sunrise to wash their faces and use the toilets. Buses heading to the trailhead start moving around 4am. If you avoid the area near the entrance as the parking lot is not sloped, it is very quiet. Parking fees are ¥1000 for 24 hours. From Friday 11pm to Sunday 3pm, it's ¥2000 for 40 hours. I've camped in my car more than 10 times, but I've never been stopped by the police. The toilets are available 24 hours a day, and the lights turn on when you open the door. (Posted: May 2024, Liberty cafe)

■当サイト読者様レポート：町営駐車場の脇に水汲み場所あり。町営駐車場は有料（1回200円）だが4〜5台分無料の駐車スペースあり。
properties.desc_en:
■The spring is located in a park along National Route 1. You can also collect water from it.

■Report from a reader of this site: There is a water collection point next to the town-operated parking lot. The town-operated parking lot is paid (200 yen per use), but there are 4-5 free parking spaces available.

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■国道140号線から滝沢ダム下流広場に入る。駐車場近くの「不動堂」手前に水が流れる蛇口がある。
properties.desc_en: ■Enter the Takizawa Dam downstream plaza from National Route 140. There is a water tap just before the "Fudo-do" (Fudo Hall) near the parking lot.

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■合角ダムから埼玉県道282号線（細いので注意）を奥に進む。水汲み場が整備されている。
properties.desc_en: ■From Gōkaku Dam, proceed further along Saitama Prefectural Road 282 (be careful as it is narrow). A water source is available.

properties.title_en: Spring water at the mouth of Hebitaki Falls
properties.desc_ja: ■高尾山の北側。国道20号線西浅川交差点から西へ約1.4km。
properties.desc_en: ■ North side of Mount Takao. Approximately 1.4 km west from the Nishi-Asakawa intersection on National Route 20.

properties.desc_ja:

properties.desc_en:
■Famous spot for autumn foliage
■Detailed report from our site's readers: One of Japan's three great waterfalls. The waterfall sometimes freezes over in winter. Admission fee: 300 yen. Open from 8:00 to 18:00 (9:00 to 17:00 from November to April).

properties.desc_ja: ■紅葉の名所。登りと下りでそれぞれ一方通行。下りの方が絶景。下りの方がおすすめ。
properties.desc_en: ■A famous spot for autumn foliage. The trail is one-way for both ascending and descending. The view is more spectacular on the way down. Going down is recommended.

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■皇室の方も来られるレストラン。夜は要予約。駐車場５台。値段もそれほど高くない。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■A restaurant frequented by members of the Imperial Family. Reservations required for dinner. Parking available for 5 cars. Prices are not too high. (Tabelog)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.title_en: Spring water at the mountain pass
properties.desc_ja: ■甲州市の「大菩薩の湯」近く、国道411号線から細い道に少し入った所の橋の脇にある。
properties.desc_en: ■Located near "Daibosatsu no Yu" in Koshu City, next to a bridge, a short distance down a narrow road off National Route 411.

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■江戸前鮨の超人気店。観光客が多いが手抜きはなく本物。それでいてお値段は7000円程度とお手頃。これを新橋、有楽町あたりで食べると倍は取られる。詳細、食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■ An extremely popular Edo-style sushi restaurant. While it attracts many tourists, there's no cutting corners; it's authentic. And yet, the price is reasonable at around 7000 yen. Eating something similar in Shinbashi or Yurakucho would cost at least double that. For details, see Tabelog.

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: 天ぷら割烹 天冨久(てんふく)
properties.desc_ja: ■江戸前天ぷらの天丼ランチが超人気。おすすめ。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■The Edo-style tempura rice bowl lunch is extremely popular. Highly recommended. (Tabelog)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja:
■江戸時代から続く老舗のうなぎ屋。ここは看板倒れではなく、本当に美味いです。
■かなり並ぶので、開店前に順番待ちの紙に名前を書いて順番を取っておく。電話でも時間指定で順番を取ることが出来るので、電話予約をしておくことをおすすめします（開店20分前くらいに電話して予約しておくのがおすすめ）。電話番号055-975-4520、 駐車場は近くの「シンコウパーク」に停めれば、食事後に１時間分の駐車券をもらえる。 食べログ
properties.desc_en:
■A long-established eel restaurant that has been around since the Edo period. This place is not just a facade; the food is truly delicious.

■There is usually a long line, so write your name on the waiting list before opening time to secure your place. You can also reserve a time slot by phone, so we recommend making a reservation by phone (we recommend calling about 20 minutes before opening). Phone number: 055-975-4520. If you park at the nearby "Shinko Park," you will receive a parking ticket for one hour after your meal. Tabelog

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 水上町水紀行館
properties.desc_ja: ■広大な駐車場。奥の方は静か。ここ、オススメです。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■A huge parking lot. It's quiet in the back. I recommend this place. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■広大な河川敷公園、トイレ有り、コンビニ徒歩5分（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■ Spacious riverside park, with restrooms, convenience store within a 5-minute walk (older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■広い駐車場。幹線道路から距離が有る。wimaxも利用可能。車中泊車両非常に多い。トイレ棟もきれいなのが新築された。ここはトラックがマナーが悪いのが多く、普通車エリアのど真ん中までやってきて延々とアイドリングするのが多い。あまりおすすめという感じはない。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Large parking lot. Located some distance from the main road. WiMAX is available. Many vehicles are parked here overnight. A new, clean toilet building has been constructed. However, many trucks here have poor manners, often driving right into the middle of the regular car area and idling for extended periods. I wouldn't particularly recommend it. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■厚木市の広沢寺温泉から林道を不動尻方面に進み、車両通行止めのゲートの手前を少し川へ降りた所にある。
properties.desc_en: ■It is located a short distance down to the river just before the gate where vehicle access is prohibited, after taking the forest road from Hirosawaji Onsen in Atsugi City towards Fudōjiri.

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■厚木シロコロホルモンの超人気店。「シロコロ」は一人一人前限定だが、「シロ」も非常に美味いのでオススメ。管理人お気に入り。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■ An extremely popular restaurant specializing in Atsugi-style shirokoro hormone (pork intestines). While "shirokoro" is limited to one serving per person, the "shiro" (pork intestines) is also highly recommended as it's very delicious. A favorite of the site administrator. (Tabelog)

properties.title_ja: 常磐公園周辺のコインパーキング
properties.title_en: Coin-operated parking lots around Tokiwa Park
properties.desc_ja: ■公園周辺のコインパーキングで車中泊可能。詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。徒歩圏内に銭湯♨️あり。（2025年3月現地調査）
properties.desc_en: ■ Overnight parking is possible in coin-operated parking lots around the park. Detailed map and photos of toilets 🚻 are available. There is a public bath ♨️ within walking distance. (Survey conducted in March 2025)

properties.desc_en: ■There are public restrooms in the park. There are many coin-operated parking lots nearby with a maximum charge of around 1000 yen for 24 hours. Look for a coin-operated parking lot in this area. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Paid Parking

properties.title_en: North side of Ayase Station, around Gobei Park""

properties.desc_en: ■There are public restrooms in the park. There are many coin-operated parking lots nearby with a maximum charge of around 1000 yen for 24 hours. Look for a coin-operated parking lot in this area. Ayase Station is very convenient as it can be used for both Tokyo Metro subway and JR lines. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_en: ■Near Keio Yomiuri Land Station. The road to the shrine's parking lot is narrow, so please be careful. "Please boil the water."

properties.label: Car Camp Spot

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■牛久大仏（うしくだいぶつ、正式名称：牛久阿弥陀大佛）は、日本の茨城県牛久市にあるブロンズ（青銅）製大仏立像で、全高120メートル（像高100メートル、台座20メートル）あり、立像の高さは世界で6番目。ブロンズ立像としては世界最大。Wikipedia
properties.desc_en: ■ The Ushiku Daibutsu (officially known as the Ushiku Amida Daibutsu) is a bronze standing Buddha statue located in Ushiku City, Ibaraki Prefecture, Japan. It stands 120 meters tall (100 meters for the statue itself, 20 meters for the base), making it the sixth tallest standing Buddha statue in the world. It is the largest bronze standing Buddha statue in the world. (Wikipedia)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.desc_ja: ■久しぶりに来てみたら、入り口が夜間閉鎖されるようになっていた。（2022年10月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en: ■When I visited again after a long time, I found that the entrance was now closed at night. (Confirmed by the administrator in October 2022)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.desc_ja:
■久しぶりに来たら、河川敷への進入口が鍵付きの鎖で閉鎖されていた。残念。（2023年11月管理人現地確認）
■超絶穴場を発見。河川敷の無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレは駐車場から少し歩くが、土手の上に水洗洋式の公衆トイレがある（詳細）。夜間超絶静か。携帯電波OK。治安については自己責任。河川敷への進入口はココ。河川敷なので増水、大地震の津波には要注意。※雨が降っている場合、上記の進入口が鎖で閉鎖されている場合がある（カギが掛けられるわけではなく、実は手動で外せる）。（2023年4月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■When I visited after a long time, the entrance to the riverbank was closed with a locked chain. What a shame. (Administrator's on-site confirmation, November 2023)
■I discovered an amazing hidden gem. Free parking and public toilets on the riverbank. Confirmed that it is not closed at night. The toilets are a short walk from the parking lot, but there are flush toilets with Western-style toilets on top of the embankment (details). Extremely quiet at night. Cell phone reception is OK. Safety is at your own risk. The entrance to the riverbank is here. Since it is a riverbank, be careful of flooding and tsunamis from major earthquakes. *If it is raining, the above entrance may be closed with a chain (it is not locked, but can actually be unlocked manually). (Administrator's on-site confirmation, April 2023)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: 辰起町緑地スポーツ広場
properties.title_en: Tatsuki Town Green Space Sports Field
properties.desc_ja:
■久しぶりに来たら、河川敷への進入口が鍵付きの鎖で閉鎖されていた。残念。（2023年11月管理人現地確認）
■河川敷の無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレは仮設の和式ポットンで臭い。バイパスの走行音が響いている。治安については自己責任。河川敷への進入口はココ。河川敷なので増水、大地震の津波には要注意。（2022年10月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■When I visited after a long time, the entrance to the riverbank was closed with a locked chain. Disappointing. (Administrator's on-site confirmation, November 2023)
■Free parking and public toilets on the riverbank. Confirmed they are not closed at night. The toilets are temporary Japanese-style pit toilets and smell bad. The sound of traffic from the bypass is audible. Safety is at your own risk. The entrance to the riverbank is here. Since it's a riverbank, be careful of flooding and tsunamis from major earthquakes. (Administrator's on-site confirmation, October 2022)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■丸一系の総本山。今の店主は創業者の息子。蒲田の丸一は創業者の弟子。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■The main branch of the Maruichi chain. The current owner is the founder's son. The Maruichi in Kamata is run by the founder's disciple. Tabelog

■Report from a reader of this site: You can get water from the tap (behind the purification fountain) on the grounds of a shrine near Futtsu Chuo Interchange along National Route 127. Water quality has been tested.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 塩原元湯温泉 大出館
properties.desc_ja:
■温泉マニア絶賛。900円、詳細
■管理人評価★5満点（泉質4.5、景色0.5）泉質、眺望、ともに至高。男性の日帰りは5つのお風呂に入れる。黒い墨の湯、うぐいす色の五色の湯、乳青白色の御所の湯、眺望最高でうぐいす色の露天風呂岩の湯、貸し切り風呂の藤の湯（空いていれば入れる）。泉質がきわめて優れている。紅葉もすばらしい。文句なしで至高の名湯。
properties.desc_en:
■Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. 900 yen, details
■Manager's rating ★5 out of 5 (Spring quality 4.5, Scenery 0.5) Both the spring quality and the view are superb. Men on day trips can use five baths. The black Sumi-no-yu, the鶯色 Goshiki-no-yu (bush warbler green Goshiki-no-yu), the milky blue Gosho-no-yu (imperial palace bath), the鶯色 (bush warbler green) open-air Iwa-no-yu (rock bath) with the best view, and the private Fuji-no-yu (wisteria bath) (available if free). The spring quality is extremely good. The autumn foliage is also wonderful. Undoubtedly a superb hot spring.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■温泉マニア絶賛。700円。詳細
■管理人評価★4.5（泉質4.5満点、景色0）香りはやや弱いが、美しい琥珀色で、析出物もみとめられる。飲泉も可能で、鉄味がする。さらに、炭酸も含有しており、アワが大量に付着し、湯につかった身体部位がジンジンする。こういう美しい炭酸泉は非常に珍しい。傑出した湯であると思います。泉質は満点評価。景色は、住宅街の中ということで眺望が無いため加点無し。
properties.desc_en:
■Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. 700 yen. Details
■Manager's rating ★4.5 (Spring quality 4.5 out of 5, view 0) The scent is somewhat weak, but it is a beautiful amber color and mineral deposits can be seen. It is also possible to drink the water, and it has an iron taste. Furthermore, it contains carbon dioxide, so a lot of bubbles adhere to the body, and the parts of the body that are immersed in the water tingle. Such a beautiful carbonated spring is extremely rare. I think it is an outstanding hot spring. Spring quality gets a perfect score. The view does not receive any points because it is in a residential area and therefore has no view.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■温泉マニア絶賛。700円、詳細
■管理人評価★4.7（泉質4.3、景色0.4）ここは来るのが大変。日帰り客は送迎の車を利用できないため、基本的には下の駐車場に車を置いて、歩いて上がる必要がある。（運が良ければ、ハイエースの送迎車に乗せてもらえる。）歩いて上がると30分以上かかる。険しい山道で、熊が出る可能性があるので、普通の人にはお勧めはできない。泉質は無色透明でクセのない湯。味、香りは弱め。析出物は認められる。湯上がりのすがすがしさは素晴らしい。4.3点と評価。また景色も風呂の窓を開けると露天的に楽しめる。紅葉が美しい。また、この旅館の建物自体が凄い味わい深く良い。総合的に判断して、景色は0.4と評価。合計4.7点の名湯。あまりにも秘湯過ぎてアクセスが非常に大変なので、詳しくは旅館のHPを見てください詳細
properties.desc_en:
■Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. 700 yen, details
■Manager's rating ★4.7 (Spring quality 4.3, Scenery 0.4) This place is difficult to get to. Day-trippers cannot use the shuttle service, so you basically have to park your car in the lower parking lot and walk up. (If you're lucky, you might get a ride in the Hiace shuttle.) It takes more than 30 minutes to walk up. It's a steep mountain path, and there's a possibility of encountering bears, so it's not recommended for the average person. The spring water is colorless, transparent, and has no distinctive characteristics. The taste and scent are weak. Mineral deposits are present. The refreshing feeling after bathing is wonderful. Rated 4.3 points. You can also enjoy the scenery as if you were in an open-air bath by opening the bath window. The autumn leaves are beautiful. Also, the building of this inn itself is very tasteful and wonderful. Judging from the overall evaluation, the scenery is rated 0.4 points. A famous hot spring with a total score of 4.7 points. It's such a secluded hot spring that access is extremely difficult, so please check the inn's website for details.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 那須 北温泉 北温泉旅館
properties.title_en: Nasu Kita Onsen Kita Onsen Ryokan
properties.desc_ja:
■温泉マニア絶賛。700円、詳細
■管理人評価★4.9（泉質4.4、景色0.5）無色透明だが、味、香りともに濃厚で、析出物ガッツリ。透明の湯としては最高レベル。飲泉も可能。景色も紅葉が非常に美しい。0.5満点。
properties.desc_en:
■Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. 700 yen, details
■Manager's rating ★4.9 (Spring quality 4.4, Scenery 0.5) The water is colorless and transparent, but the taste and aroma are rich, and there are plenty of mineral deposits. It's top-level for a transparent hot spring. Drinking the water is also possible. The scenery, especially the autumn foliage, is extremely beautiful. 0.5 is the maximum score.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 大沢温泉 大沢荘山の家
properties.desc_ja:
■温泉マニア絶賛。600円、詳細。
■管理人評価★4.5（泉質4.3、景色0.2）泉質は無色透明のカルシウム・ナトリウム硫酸塩泉。ここは男湯と女湯の境のあたりから、源泉がもの凄い勢いで噴出している。いわゆる足下自噴というやつ。非常に珍しい。湧出温度は４７度で、はっきり言って結構熱い。秋、冬に来ると良いでしょう。析出物と足下自噴を評価して、泉質は4.3点と評価。景色は気持ちの良い露天風呂という感じで0.2点。合計4.5点と評価。
properties.desc_en:
■ Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. 600 yen, details.

■ Manager's rating ★4.5 (Spring quality 4.3, Scenery 0.2) The spring water is a colorless, transparent calcium-sodium sulfate spring. Here, the spring water gushes out with tremendous force from around the boundary between the men's and women's baths. It's what's called a foot-level spring. It's very rare. The spring temperature is 47 degrees Celsius, which is quite hot to be honest. It would be good to come in autumn or winter. Evaluating the deposits and the foot-level spring, the spring quality is rated at 4.3 points. The scenery is like a pleasant open-air bath, so it gets 0.2 points. Total rating: 4.5 points.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 那須湯本温泉 鹿の湯
properties.title_en: Nasu Yumoto Onsen Shika no Yu
properties.desc_ja:
■温泉マニア絶賛。500円、詳細
■管理人評価★4.7（泉質4.5、景色0.2）泉質は乳青白色の美しい湯。満点評価。景色は、建物と湯小屋の雰囲気が味があるので0.2評価。一度は来たほうがいいでしょう。
properties.desc_en:
■Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. 500 yen, details
■Manager's rating ★4.7 (Spring quality 4.5, Scenery 0.2) The spring water is a beautiful milky-blue color. Perfect score. The scenery gets a 0.2 because the atmosphere of the building and bathhouse has character. You should definitely come at least once.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 宝川温泉、汪泉閣（宝川山荘）
properties.desc_ja:
■温泉マニア絶賛。1500円、詳細。※2019/4より、混浴露天における湯浴み着の着用が男女とも義務化👉️詳細 。※全国から変態が集まっていたため。
■管理人評価★4.9（泉質4.3、景色特別加算0.6）値段は高いがその価値あり。特に紅葉が非常に素晴らしい。まず泉質は無色透明だが、味、香りがあり、析出物もみとめられる。4.3点。そしてここは景色が素晴らしい。秋の紅葉が絶品。そしてここは露天風呂が混浴で、老若男女が入り乱れている。女性は基本的に湯衣を着用して入っているが、オッサンたちはみんな全裸。中には、わざと股を広げて通行人に見せつけている変態さんもいて面白い。若い女性も多数で面白い。かなり気に入りました。休憩室も完備。
properties.desc_en:
■ Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. 1500 yen, details. *As of April 2019, wearing a bathing suit is mandatory for both men and women in the mixed-gender open-air bath 👉️ details. *Because perverts gathered from all over the country.

■ Manager's rating ★4.9 (Spring quality 4.3, special bonus for scenery 0.6) It's expensive, but worth it. The autumn foliage is especially magnificent. First of all, the spring water is colorless and transparent, but it has a taste and scent, and mineral deposits can be seen. 4.3 points. And the scenery here is magnificent. The autumn foliage is superb. And the open-air bath here is mixed-gender, with men and women of all ages mingling. Women generally wear bathing suits, but the old men are all naked. There are some perverts who deliberately spread their legs and show off to passersby, which is amusing. There are also many young women, which is interesting. I really liked it. A rest room is also available.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■温泉マニア絶賛。1500円、詳細
■管理人評価★4.5（泉質4.3、景色0.2）泉質は、無色透明だが、味、香り濃厚で、析出物もみとめられる。成分が濃い感じ。4.3点。景色は重要文化財の建物が大変良い。0.2点。入浴すれば建物の中を見学できる。三階の客室も見学できる。値段は高いが、マニアなら一度はこないとだめでしょう。
properties.desc_en:
■Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. 1500 yen, details
■Manager's rating ★4.5 (Spring quality 4.3, Scenery 0.2) The spring water is colorless and transparent, but has a strong taste and aroma, and mineral deposits can be seen. It feels like the minerals are concentrated. 4.3 points. The scenery is excellent, with the building being a designated Important Cultural Property. 0.2 points. If you bathe, you can tour the inside of the building. You can also tour the guest rooms on the third floor. It's expensive, but if you're an enthusiast, you should definitely come at least once.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 奈良田温泉 白根館
properties.desc_ja:
■温泉マニア絶賛。1000円、詳細
■管理人評価★4.85（泉質4.45、景色0.4）無色透明だが、硫黄の香りとヌルヌル感がもの凄い。含食塩、硫黄泉とのこと。析出物もみとめられる。湧出温度49℃というのも凄い奇跡的。透明の湯としては最高レベルかと思います。泉質は4.45評価。下呂温泉の次元を一つあげた感じ。とりあえず、普通の湯ではないです。傑出したものを感じる。景色は、露天風呂から山が見えるが、杉主体で、山全体が紅葉に彩られるという感じではない。景色は0.4評価。合計4.85の極上名湯。
properties.desc_en:
■Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. 1000 yen, details
■Manager's rating ★4.85 (Spring quality 4.45, Scenery 0.4) It's colorless and transparent, but the sulfurous smell and slippery feel are incredible. It's said to be a sodium chloride and sulfur spring. Precipitates can also be seen. The fact that the spring temperature is 49℃ is also miraculous. I think it's the highest level for transparent hot spring water. The spring quality is rated 4.45. It feels like it's taken Gero Onsen to a whole new level. In any case, it's not an ordinary hot spring. You can feel something outstanding. As for the scenery, you can see the mountains from the open-air bath, but it's mainly cedar trees, and it doesn't feel like the entire mountain is colored with autumn leaves. Scenery is rated 0.4. A superb hot spring with a total rating of 4.85.

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 蓮台寺河内温泉 金谷旅館千人風呂
properties.title_en: Rendaiji Kawachi Onsen Kanaya Ryokan Sennin-buro (Thousand-Person Bath)
properties.desc_ja:
■温泉マニア絶賛。1000円、詳細

properties.desc_en:
■This place is the best. You can barely hear the ocean waves, and it's incredibly quiet at night. The toilets are flush toilets and clean. There are Western-style toilets too. WiMAX is fully usable. It's really the best. There are houses nearby, so idling is absolutely forbidden. Idling enthusiasts, please don't come here. It seems like a lot of troublemakers will gather here during the summer swimming season, so you should probably avoid this place (actually, it's too hot in the summer, so I don't think anyone would camp in their car here). (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: ほったらかし温泉（駐車場での車中泊は禁止）
properties.title_en: Hottarakashi Onsen (Overnight parking in vehicles is prohibited)
properties.desc_ja:
■900円、詳細。日没時間の30分前に入場して、夕景の赤富士⇨夜景を見るのがオススメ。ロッカーが100円の有料なのでジップロック持参オススメ。
■管理人評価：★4.5（泉質3.5、景色特別加算1） ここには何回来たかわからないくらい通っています。管理人も大好きな温泉です。新しい温泉ですが、眺望が最強すぎる。今後、新しい形の名湯として名を残すことになると思います。日没時間を調べて、日没時間の30分前から入って、夕景→夜景を見るのがおすすめ。泉質は正直特筆するものがない普通の単純泉（塩素臭のする循環）ですが、眺望は全国最強クラスです。ここのほうとうが結構美味いです。泉質は★3.5 昼は富士山、夜は夜景が美しい。残念ながら駐車場での車中泊は禁止されている。
properties.desc_en:
■900 yen, details. It's recommended to enter 30 minutes before sunset to see the sunset view of Mount Fuji, then the night view. Lockers cost 100 yen, so bringing a Ziploc bag is recommended.

■Manager's rating: ★4.5 (Spring quality 3.5, View special bonus 1) I've been here so many times I've lost count. It's one of my favorite hot springs. It's a relatively new hot spring, but the view is absolutely amazing. I think it will become a famous hot spring in a new style. It's recommended to check the sunset time and enter 30 minutes before sunset to see the sunset view, then the night view. The spring quality is honestly nothing special, just an ordinary simple spring (circulated with a chlorine smell), but the view is among the best in the country. The Hoto noodles here are quite delicious. Spring quality ★3.5. Mount Fuji is beautiful during the day, and the night view is beautiful at night. Unfortunately, overnight parking is prohibited.

properties.desc_en:
■700 yen, details
■Report from a reader of this site: The map information says that "you can stay overnight in your car if you use the hot springs," so I inquired whether it was actually possible to stay overnight in my car. The reply I received is attached to the email below. "Thank you for using the hot springs and meals for a day trip. We also operate a hotel on the premises. You mentioned that it was written online that you can stay overnight in your car, but we do not permit that. After our facility closes, our staff records the license plates of any cars remaining in the parking lot. We would be delighted if you would stay at Hotel Arai. Also, there is a nearby "Success Mountain Auto Campground," which we also recommend." This was a rather strong denial, so please correct the wording. (Posted: May 2021, Mr. T)

properties.title_ja: 道の駅 那須高原友愛の森
properties.title_en: Roadside Station Nasu Kogen Yuai no Mori
properties.desc_ja:
■2025年9月管理人現地確認：車中泊評価【良😊】70点👉️現地の写真・詳細案内図はこちら
■大規模な道の駅。売店の自家製ポテトコロッケが異常にうまい。奥の方は静かで良い。2023年9月、久しぶりに来たら北側の駐車場（詳細）は夜間も開放されて車中泊可能になっていた（トイレは遠くなるが夜間非常に静か）。標高は471mと結構高い。（2023年9月管理人現地確認）
■給水場所あり。向かいのコンビニは廃業してました。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Administrator's On-Site Verification, September 2025: Car Camping Rating [Good 😊] 70 points 👉️ Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■A large roadside station. The homemade potato croquettes at the shop are exceptionally delicious. The back area is quiet and nice. In September 2023, when I visited again after a long time, the north parking lot (details) was open at night and car camping was possible (the toilets are further away, but it's very quiet at night). The elevation is quite high at 471m. (Administrator's On-Site Verification, September 2023)
■Water supply available. The convenience store across the street had closed down. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 日光 日光街道ニコニコ本陣
properties.title_en: [B-Rank] Roadside Station Nikko Nikko Kaido Nikko Honjin
properties.desc_ja:
■2025年9月管理人現地確認：車中泊評価【Bランク】69点👉️現地の写真・詳細案内図はこちら
■当サイト読者様レポート：2022年8月の日曜夜に利用。市街地のど真ん中ですが、幸い眠りを妨げられるような騒音もなく、ゆっくり休めました。トイレが広くてキレイです。すぐ東隣の第3駐車場にEVの急速充電器がありますが、稼働は900-1830のみです。（投稿：2022年9月、n様）
■H27.4.27オープン。街中の道の駅。wimax2も電波OK。100mほど西に臨時駐車場があり、そこの奥は非常に静かで良い（当然だがトイレは遠くなる）。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：道の駅 日光（栃木）の情報です。町中に有り、混雑していました。アイドリング状態で車中泊していたり、ボリュームを上げて音楽を聴いているDQNもいました。少し離れた　道の駅 湧水の郷しおやの方が広くて空いていることが多いようです。2018/8/15確認しました。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：西側の臨時駐車場について。本当の道の駅は駅前、セブンイレブン駐車場も兼ね、収用能力を超過。昼間は空き待ちの列が車道にはみ出す程で、100m程離れているこちらが空いていて静か平坦でおすすめ。夜は車道交差点の赤信号待ち車のライトがまぶしいので、窓ガラスに目隠し必須。砂利駐車場。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2015年春にオープンした道の駅。コンビニ併設。R120沿いの市街地にある上、駐車場も奥行きがないので、時期によっては少し騒々しいかも。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■September 2025 Administrator's On-site Verification: Car Camping Rating [Rank B] ​​69 points 👉️Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■Report from our site's reader: Used on a Sunday night in August 2022. It's right in the middle of the city, but fortunately there was no noise that disturbed my sleep, and I was able to rest well. The toilets are spacious and clean. There is an EV fast charger in the 3rd parking lot immediately to the east, but it is only operational from 9:00 to 18:30. (Posted: September 2022, by n)
■Opened April 27, 2015. A roadside station in the middle of town. WiMAX2 signal is OK. There is a temporary parking lot about 100m to the west, and the area at the back of it is very quiet and nice (naturally, the toilets are farther away). (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from our site's reader: Information on Michi-no-Eki Nikko (Tochigi). It is located in the middle of town and was crowded. There were some people camping in their cars with their engines idling, and some inconsiderate people listening to music at high volume. The roadside station, Yusui no Sato Shioya, located a little further away, seems to be larger and often less crowded. (Confirmed on August 15, 2018.) (Older post from before 2019)

There are several large bucket-shaped trash cans, which my buddy loves. The souvenir shop has a wide selection of items (from Shizuoka and Hakone) and is open for long hours (7:00-20:00). The restaurant also offers breakfast and dinner at reasonable prices (8:00-20:00, last order 19:00). It's very noisy, so it's only suitable for a short nap. (Posted: September 2022, by s)

■ Report from our site's reader: A vast roadside station with parking for over 1000 cars. There is a hot spring facility called "Yudokoro Agri" on the premises (510 yen for adults, 400 yen with JAF discount). If noise is a concern, parking lot 3, which is located separately, is quieter. Unfortunately, there is no WiMAX signal. There is a restaurant in the commercial facility next to parking lot 1. The brewery prices are also reasonable. The bakery serves delicious, freshly baked bread. (Older post from before 2019)

■入浴♨️：徒歩5分のところに「寄居山温泉ほっこりの湯♨️」650円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：2022年8月の平日に利用。尾瀬ヶ原への入口にある鳩待峠駐車場までは30分で行けます。鳩待峠は早朝に行かないと満車になるので、ここは前線基地として便利。幹線道路脇ですが、奥側のマスで静かに休めました。トイレが広くてキレイです。建屋裏側のテラスからは尾瀬方面の見事な景色が楽しめます。EVの急速充電器が無料で使えます。充電ケーブルのつなぎ方手順が独特ですが、本体貼付の取説に従えば大丈夫です。（投稿：2022年9月、n様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：道の駅には入浴施設がありませんが、至近距離に二か所あります。寄居山温泉ほっこりの湯　花の駅片品花咲の湯。道の駅のトイレは極めてきれい。特に女性用はいいらしい。トイレ近くの駐車場は国道に近いので、人によってはうるさいかもしれません。その場合は50ｍほど奥に第二駐車場があるのでそちらを使えばいいでしょう。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■2018年7月21日オープン。 水くみ場では、１００％天然水で平成の名水百選に選ばれている天然のわき水「花の谷湧水（ゆうすい）」を自由に持ち帰ることができる。眺望テラスそばには、尾瀬の景色を眺めながらの足湯を楽しめる。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■September 2024 Administrator's On-site Verification: Car Camping Rating [A Rank 😄] 84 points 👉️ Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■Bathing ♨️: "Yoriyama Onsen Hokkori no Yu ♨️" 650 yen, 5 minutes on foot, details
■Report from a reader of this site: Used on a weekday in August 2022. It takes 30 minutes to reach the Hatōmachi Pass parking lot at the entrance to Oze Marsh. Hatōmachi Pass gets full unless you go early in the morning, so this is a convenient base camp. It's next to a main road, but I was able to rest quietly in the back area. The toilet is spacious and clean. You can enjoy a magnificent view of the Oze area from the terrace on the back side of the building. EV fast chargers are available for free. The procedure for connecting the charging cable is unique, but it's fine if you follow the instruction manual attached to the unit. (Posted: September 2022, by n)
■Report from a reader of this site: There are no bathing facilities at the roadside station, but there are two nearby: Yoriyama Onsen Hokkori no Yu and Hana no Eki Katashina Hanasaku no Yu. The toilets at the roadside station are extremely clean. The women's toilets are especially nice. The parking lot near the toilets is close to the national highway, so it might be noisy for some people. In that case, there is a second parking lot about 50m further in, so you can use that. (Older post from before 2019)
■Opened on July 21, 2018. At the water drawing area, you can freely take home natural spring water "Hananotani Yusui," which is 100% natural water and has been selected as one of the 100 best waters of the Heisei era. Near the observation terrace, you can enjoy a footbath while viewing the scenery of Oze. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_ja:
■2024年12月管理人現地確認：車中泊評価【良😊】71点👉️現地の写真・詳細案内図はこちら
■当サイト読者様レポート：2025/2訪問。国道１号バイパス沿い、既に記載通りDQN多数、随時。夜間は場内7-11のみ営業している。食堂は朝８時から朝定食のみで開始。魚（時間によって変わります）、サラダ＆ごはん、みそ汁、香の物とあり。９時になると喫茶、そばの店が開店する。大幹線の割には夜間の周辺騒音は気にならない。ただ、宿泊に適しているのか車中泊初心者らしき車が一晩中間欠的にアイドリングしてそちらのほうがかなり気になった。（投稿：2025年3月、クリッパーのぐっさん様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：20年ほど前から何度か利用しています。地元産の野菜や加工品の直売所が素晴らしい。新鮮で安い！食堂は2店。うどん屋さんと、好きなものを選ぶメシ屋さん。道の駅では珍しいスタイルですね。さらに24Hのコンビニもあるので便利です。EV用の急速充電器があります。なお、バイパス本線へ戻る出口への案内が不親切です。上り側であれば、東側駐車場の奥を右へグルっと回り込んで合流していきます。（投稿：2020年9月、N様）
■セブンイレブンあり。広い駐車場。上り側はトラックとも完全分離。下り側はトラックと近くうるさいので、上り側に移動するのがおすすめ。下り側の駐車場の奥から上り側に行ける。トイレはウォシュレットでキレイ。ゴミ捨ても可能。Wimaxも利用可能。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■車中泊者非常に多い。上り側の駐車場は目の前にセブンイレブンがあり、コンビニWifiもバッチリ使える。さらにWimax2も余裕で使える。ほんとココは便利ですね。ただ、コンビニがあるので夜中まで車の出入りが結構多く、うるさい。爆音のDQN車も多い。エンジン音をうならせるアホがたまに来る。コンビニ併設は利便性が高くなるのも確かですが、夜中までDQNが集まってくるという諸刃の剣ですね。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■December 2024 Administrator's On-site Verification: Car Camping Rating [Good 😊] 71 points 👉️Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■Report from a reader of this site: Visited in February 2025. Located along National Route 1 Bypass, as already mentioned, there are many troublemakers, at all times. At night, only the 7-Eleven on the premises is open. The cafeteria opens at 8am with only breakfast sets. It includes fish (which changes depending on the time), salad & rice, miso soup, and pickles. At 9am, the coffee shop and soba noodle shop open. Despite being on a major highway, the surrounding noise at night is not bothersome. However, perhaps because it is suitable for overnight stays, a car that seemed to belong to a first-time car camper idled intermittently throughout the night, which was quite bothersome. (Posted: March 2025, by Gussan of Clipper)
■Report from a reader of this site: I have used it several times over the past 20 years. The direct sales store for locally produced vegetables and processed goods is wonderful. Fresh and cheap! There are two restaurants. A udon noodle shop and a restaurant where you can choose your own dishes. It's an unusual style for a roadside station. Furthermore, there's a 24-hour convenience store, which is convenient. There's a fast charger for EVs. However, the directions to the exit back to the main bypass are unclear. If you're going northbound, you have to go around to the right at the back of the east parking lot to merge. (Posted: September 2020, Mr. N)
■There's a Seven-Eleven. Large parking lot. The northbound side is completely separated from trucks. The southbound side is close to trucks and noisy, so it's recommended to move to the northbound side. You can access the northbound side from the back of the southbound parking lot. The toilets are clean and have bidet functions. Trash disposal is possible. WiMAX is also available. (Older post from before 2019)
■There are many people staying overnight in their cars. The northbound parking lot has a Seven-Eleven right in front, and the convenience store Wi-Fi works perfectly. Furthermore, WiMAX2 works easily. This place is really convenient. However, because there's a convenience store, there's a lot of car traffic until late at night, which is noisy. There are a lot of loud, obnoxious cars driven by delinquents. Occasionally, idiots who rev their engines loudly show up. Having a convenience store attached certainly increases convenience, but it's a double-edged sword as it attracts delinquents until late at night. (Older post from before 2019)

■当サイト読者様レポート：トラックの通行量多く、Ｐが国道脇なので上下線とも非常にうるさいです。地元としてお勧めできません。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Administrator's On-Site Verification, December 2024: Car Camping Rating [Excluded Rank 😅] 60 points 👉️ Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■Report from a Reader of This Site: Used in August 2020. There are several signs in the parking lot saying, "Please refrain from parking for long periods of time as it causes inconvenience." When camping in your car, be sure to enter late at night and leave early in the morning. There is a fast charger for EVs. The "Shizuoka Oden" at the cafeteria is delicious. The menu only lists set meals, but they also sell individual ingredients for 120 yen each. Also, there is a pedestrian bridge at the western end of the site that allows you to go back and forth between the uphill and downhill sides. There is only a toilet on the uphill side, so if you want to have a light meal, you can use this to come to the downhill side. Also, there is no merging lane when returning to the main bypass, so you have to suddenly pull out amidst cars whizzing by from around a blind spot on a gentle curve. (Posted: September 2020, Mr./Ms. N)
■Report from a reader of this site: There is a lot of truck traffic, and the parking lot is next to the national highway, so it is very noisy on both sides. As a local resident, I cannot recommend it. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_ja:
■2024年12月管理人現地確認：車中泊評価【Bランク】64点👉️現地の写真・詳細案内図はこちら
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレがあります。食事もできます。食材も売っています。足湯もあります。裏側の駐車場の方が静かで安眠できます。（投稿：2023年12月、l様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ有、外灯有、飲料自販機有。R1長距離移動での中継点として最適。静岡県西端の道の駅です。当初より思い入れの強い道の駅で利用回数も最多です。トイレは海の匂いがします。歩いて海に行けます。過去にはレトロ自販機(給湯機能付きカップ麺自販機)があり深夜に食べました。売店のお土産(静岡・浜松)の品ぞろえが豊富です(8:00~18:00)。お勧めはうなぎパイ。食堂は朝定あり価格もリーズナブル(8:30~18:30ラストオーダー18:00)。お勧めは浜名湖産うな丼(1,680円)。騒音は大です仮眠程度で。出口の表示が浜松方面・豊橋方面と表記されています(初見殺し食らいました)。添付画像1、添付画像2、添付画像3（投稿：2022年9月、s様）
■相変わらずバイパスの走行音うるさい。車いっぱい。夜中にも爆音バイクや爆音DQN車が道の駅に入ってくる。アクセスが遠回りになるが、道の駅の東側（ココ）にも駐車場があり、そこは比較的静か（バイパスの走行音はガッツリ聞こえる）。基本的に車中泊用にはおすすめできない。（2021年11月管理人現地確認）
■当サイト読者様レポート：国道１号線潮見バイパス上下線から駐車場まで直結、食堂は8:00〜18:30(アサリ汁が美味かった) トラックが多いので、熟睡は無理。交通量も多いので、駐車スペースは無い。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■風が強い日は車体がメチャメチャ揺れる。たまに珍走ボーイが来る。あまりおすすめはしない。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■December 2024 Administrator's On-site Verification: Car Camping Rating [Rank B] ​​64 points 👉️Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■Report from our site's reader: There are toilets. You can eat meals. They also sell groceries. There is also a footbath. The parking lot on the back side is quieter and better for a good night's sleep. (Posted: December 2023, by l)
■Report from our site's reader: There are toilets, streetlights, and vending machines for drinks. It's ideal as a stopover point for long-distance travel on Route 1. It's a roadside station at the westernmost tip of Shizuoka Prefecture. It's a roadside station I've been particularly attached to since the beginning and have used the most. The toilets smell of the sea. You can walk to the sea. In the past, there was a retro vending machine (a cup noodle vending machine with a hot water dispenser) which I used to eat late at night. The shop has a wide selection of souvenirs (Shizuoka/Hamamatsu) (8:00~18:00). I recommend the eel pie. The cafeteria offers a breakfast set at a reasonable price (8:30 AM - 6:30 PM, last order 6:00 PM). The recommended dish is the Hamana Lake eel rice bowl (1,680 yen). It's very noisy, so it's only suitable for a short nap. The exit signs indicate "Hamamatsu direction" and "Toyohashi direction" (I was fooled on my first visit). (Attached images 1, 2, and 3 - posted September 2022 by user s)

■The bypass traffic noise is still very loud. There are lots of cars. Even in the middle of the night, loud motorcycles and loud, rowdy cars enter the rest stop. Access is a detour, but there's also a parking lot on the east side of the rest stop (here), which is relatively quiet (though you can still clearly hear the bypass traffic noise). Basically, it's not recommended for overnight stays in your car. (Administrator's on-site verification, November 2021)
■Report from a reader of this site: Direct access from both directions of the Shiomi Bypass on National Route 1 to the parking lot. The restaurant is open from 8:00 to 18:30 (the clam soup was delicious). There are many trucks, so deep sleep is impossible. There is also heavy traffic, so there is no parking space. (Older post from before 2019)
■On windy days, the car shakes violently. Occasionally, reckless drivers come. Not highly recommended. (Older post from before 2019)

There's a supermarket, and you can drink famous water 24 hours a day. I recommend staying overnight in your car after visiting the nearby day-trip hot spring, "Ojiro no Yu." (Older post from before 2019)
■ Elevation: 617m

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja:
■2023年現在は予約のみの営業。👉️詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：整理券無しで平日の11時頃に並んだら2時間待ち。ラーメンやつけ麺を2杯食べる人も多い。
■超絶うまい。究極の醤油ラーメンと言える。麺（自家製麺）、スープ、チャーシュー、そしてご飯まで、全てに極限までこだわり抜いている。手抜きが一切無い（普通はラーメン屋ならご飯くらいは手を抜くものだが、ここはわざわざご飯をかまどで炊いている）。執念が尋常じゃ無い。はっきり言って日本トップクラス。女性スタッフも超美人（たぶんどっかの事務所所属のモデル）。なんでこんな田舎にこんな凄い店が・・・という驚き。正直、毎週通いたいレベル。残念ながら醤油ラーメンでは関西にはここまで美味い店は無い。管理人が人生で食べた醤油ラーメンでここが一番うまい。平日なら9:50くらいに来て、整理券をもらって、車の中で待ってれば良い。土日は、７時前か８時前には来て整理券をもらうと良い。（整理券の配布は、朝7時、8時、9時、10時、10時半の5回）トイレは開店まで店のトイレは使えない。コンビニまで歩く必要があるので、ここに来る前にトイレに行っておきましょう。営業時間11:00〜15:00頃（麺が切れたら終わり）、月曜休み（不定休有り）。臨時休業が結構あるのでHPを確認してから行くのがよい。詳細、食べログ
properties.desc_en:
■As of 2023, they are open by reservation only. 👉️Details
■Report from a reader of this site: If you line up around 11am on a weekday without a numbered ticket, you'll wait for two hours. Many people eat two bowls of ramen or tsukemen.

■Absolutely delicious. It can be called the ultimate soy sauce ramen. Everything, from the noodles (homemade noodles), soup, char siu, and even the rice, is made with the utmost care. There is absolutely no cutting corners (normally, ramen shops would cut corners on the rice, but here they go to the trouble of cooking the rice in a traditional stove). Their dedication is extraordinary. Frankly speaking, it's one of the best in Japan. The female staff are also extremely beautiful (probably models belonging to some agency). It's surprising that such an amazing shop exists in such a rural area. Honestly, it's the kind of place I'd want to go to every week. Unfortunately, there are no soy sauce ramen shops this delicious in Kansai. This is the best soy sauce ramen I've ever eaten in my life. If you go on a weekday, arrive around 9:50am, get a numbered ticket, and wait in your car. On weekends, it's best to arrive before 7 or 8 AM to get a numbered ticket. (Tickets are distributed five times a day: 7 AM, 8 AM, 9 AM, 10 AM, and 10:30 AM.) The shop's restrooms are unavailable until opening time. You'll need to walk to a convenience store, so use the restroom before coming here. Opening hours are 11:00 AM to around 3:00 PM (closes when noodles run out), closed on Mondays (occasional irregular closures). There are quite a few temporary closures, so it's best to check their website before going. For details, see Tabelog.

■入浴♨️：《ふれあいの泉》820円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：2021年10月の平日に利用。トイレの近くは幹線道路に近いですが、騒音は特に気にならず寝られました。敷地内の温泉「ふれあいの泉」は全面源泉かけ流し。露天風呂は湯温が4段階に分かれていて、ぬる湯から熱湯まで好みに応じて楽しめます。JAF割利用の場合はチケットは自販機ではなくカウンターで申し出ること。食堂「萌」（もえぎ）はメニュー・味・ボリューム・価格、どれもリーズナブルだと思います。EV用の急速充電器が隣接した川根温泉ホテルの敷地内にありますが、道の駅からも僅か10mほどの場所で行き来も自由だったので利用させてもらいました。（投稿：2021年10月、N様）
■温泉あり。奥の方は非常に静か。温泉としてのレベルも高い。源泉掛け流し。タイミングがよければ露天風呂からSL（汽車）が見える。川根温泉（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■2009 Administrator's On-Site Verification: Car Camping Rating [Excluded Rank 😅] 77 points 👉️ Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■Bathing ♨️: "Fureai no Izumi" 820 yen, details
■Report from a reader of this site: Used on a weekday in October 2021. The area near the toilet is close to a main road, but the noise wasn't particularly bothersome and I was able to sleep. The on-site hot spring "Fureai no Izumi" is entirely free-flowing from the source. The open-air bath has four temperature settings, so you can enjoy it according to your preference, from lukewarm to hot. If using the JAF discount, please request the ticket at the counter, not the vending machine. I think the restaurant "Moegi" is reasonable in terms of menu, taste, volume, and price. There is an EV fast charger on the grounds of the adjacent Kawane Onsen Hotel, but it is only about 10m from the roadside station and you can go back and forth freely, so I used it. (Posted: October 2021, Mr. N)
■Hot spring available. The back area is very quiet. The hot spring itself is of a high standard. The water flows directly from the source. If you're lucky, you can see a steam locomotive (SL) from the open-air bath. Kawane Onsen (older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_ja:
■1000円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：2022年5月の日曜に利用。昭和っぽいホテルのお風呂。1000円ですがJAF会員証で2割引になります。20時ごろでしたが、暗くて入口を見つけるのに苦労しました。風呂は内風呂が1個と露天が2個。露天風呂は広く温度が低めで、ゆっくり浸かれます。深夜25時までやっているので、遅くに着いても大丈夫です。町が管理運用しているというEV用の普通充電器が２基ありますが、TOYOTAの決済アプリを使っている人でないと使用するのは困難です。（投稿：2022年5月、n様）
properties.desc_en:
■1000 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: Used on a Sunday in May 2022. A hotel bath with a Showa-era feel. It costs 1000 yen, but you get a 20% discount with a JAF membership card. It was around 8 PM, and it was dark, so I had trouble finding the entrance. There is one indoor bath and two outdoor baths. The outdoor baths are spacious and the temperature is low, so you can soak for a long time. It is open until 1 AM, so it is OK even if you arrive late. There are two EV chargers managed and operated by the town, but it is difficult to use unless you are using the TOYOTA payment app. (Posted by: n, May 2022)

(Posted by: n, March 2025)

properties.title_ja: 草津温泉 大滝乃湯
properties.desc_ja:
■1,200円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：2022年8月の平日に利用。JAF会員証で100円も割引になります。食堂は17:30がラストオーダーです。4種類の湯温の浴槽（40℃～46℃ぐらいか）を順に入る合わせ湯はなかなかGoodです。（投稿：2022年9月、n様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：凄い温泉でした。少しでも傷があればビリビリ滲みて効果有りそうです。食堂有り、休憩室有り、露天有り。
■西の横綱有馬温泉に対して、東の横綱草津温泉。名実ともに、日本最高峰の温泉だと思います。有馬は正直看板倒れ的な感じがありますが、草津はお湯も本物です。草津に入らずして温泉を語ることはできません。草津温泉の共同浴場。無料駐車場あり。地蔵の湯はここのすぐ近く。
■管理人評価：★4.9（泉質4.5、景色0.4）
properties.desc_en:
■1,200 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: Used on a weekday in August 2022. A JAF membership card gives a 100 yen discount. The restaurant's last order is at 17:30. The combination bath, where you sequentially enter four baths with different water temperatures (around 40℃ to 46℃), is quite good. (Posted: September 2022, by n)
■Report from our site's reader: This was an amazing hot spring. Even a small cut would sting and seem effective. There's a restaurant, a rest area, and an open-air bath.

■To the "Yokozuna" (grand champion) of the west, Arima Onsen is the "Yokozuna" of the east, Kusatsu Onsen. It truly is the finest hot spring in Japan. Arima is honestly a bit of a disappointment, but Kusatsu's water is the real deal. You can't talk about hot springs without experiencing Kusatsu. A public bath in Kusatsu Onsen. Free parking available. Jizo-no-Yu is very close by.

■Administrator's rating: ★4.9 (Water quality 4.5, Scenery 0.4)

properties.title_ja: 日暮里南公園 周辺のコインパーキング
properties.title_en: Coin-operated parking lots near Nippori Minami Park
properties.desc_ja:
■この周辺のコインパーキングを探す
■当サイト読者様レポート：日暮里南公園の公衆トイレ（詳細）は、多目的トイレを除き24時間利用可能。少し古いですが日々清掃されており清潔感はあります。近隣にコインパーキングが複数あります。例：三井のリパーク 東日暮里５丁目第４、三井のリパーク 東日暮里５丁目第８、コインパーク 東日暮里５丁目第４、パラカ東日暮里第９など。夜間料金設定あり、300円〜500円が相場（IN 18：00〜20：00 OUT 6：00〜8：00）。近隣に9：30〜24：00まで空いているライフ（駐車場あり）やコンビニ、コインランドリー、銭湯（萩の湯）などが複数あり都心からも近く非常に便利な穴場スポットです。大通りから中に入った住宅街の静かな環境のため、アイドリングは厳禁です。（投稿：2022年2月、MMC0624様）
properties.desc_en:
■Find coin-operated parking lots in this area
■Report from a reader of this site: The public toilets at Nippori Minami Park (details) are available 24 hours a day, except for the multi-purpose toilet. They are a little old, but are cleaned daily and are in good condition. There are several coin-operated parking lots nearby. Examples: Mitsui RePark Higashi Nippori 5-chome No. 4, Mitsui RePark Higashi Nippori 5-chome No. 8, Coin Park Higashi Nippori 5-chome No. 4, Paraca Higashi Nippori No. 9, etc. There are night-time rates, with prices ranging from 300 to 500 yen (IN 18:00-20:00 OUT 6:00-8:00). There are several Life supermarkets (with parking) open from 9:30 to 24:00 nearby, as well as convenience stores, laundromats, and public baths (Hagi no Yu). It is a very convenient hidden gem close to the city center. Due to the quiet environment of the residential area set back from the main road, idling is strictly prohibited. (Posted: February 2022, MMC0624)

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.desc_ja:
■料金詳細（※2025年から最大料金廃止なので要注意）
■当サイト読者様レポート：最大料金と宿泊料金の廃止だそうです。よろしくお願いします。（投稿：2025年9月、l様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2020年11月4日に利用しましたが、5時間超は、2000円。宿泊する場合＋1000円追加。合計で、一泊3000円になりました。さすがに、この値段では私以外に車中泊している車はいませんでした。なお、21:00から7:30まではゲートが締まり、駐車場の出入りはできなくなります。江ノ島自体も22:00から5:00まではゲートが締まります。マフラーを改造した騒々しいDQNの（関東一の）巣窟エリアですが、この時間帯は完璧に静になるので安眠できました。（投稿：2020年11月、Paco様）
■5時間超2000円、宿泊料金は＋1000円追加。3000円で一泊可能。トイレあり。高さ制限2.1ｍ。車中泊利用は公認だが、警備員に一言言わないといけない。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Price Details (Note: Maximum charge will be abolished from 2025)
■Report from our site's reader: It seems that the maximum charge and overnight stay charges will be abolished. Thank you. (Posted: September 2025, l)
■Report from our site's reader: I used it on November 4, 2020. It was 2000 yen for more than 5 hours. An additional 1000 yen was charged for overnight stays. In total, it came to 3000 yen for one night. As expected, at this price, there were no other cars parked overnight besides mine. Note that the gate is closed from 21:00 to 7:30, and entry and exit to the parking lot are not possible. Enoshima itself is also closed from 22:00 to 5:00. It is an area that is a hotbed of noisy DQNs (the most numerous in the Kanto region) with modified mufflers, but it becomes perfectly quiet during this time, so I was able to sleep soundly. (Posted: November 2020, Paco)
■2000 yen for more than 5 hours, plus an additional 1000 yen for overnight stays. It costs 3000 yen for one night's stay. There is a toilet. There is a height restriction of 2.1m. Overnight stays in vehicles are permitted, but you need to inform the security guard. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■料金・営業詳細
■680円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：2022年8月の日曜に利用。隣（背中合わせ）の和食店「昔ばなし」で食事の後にここで入浴。その後、道の駅日光で一晩お世話になりました。内湯の浴槽ひとつだけですが、加水なしの源泉掛け流しで疲れを癒してもらいました。畳敷きの広い休憩室も良いですね。（投稿：2022年9月、n様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：平日500円、土日祝日600円。シャンプー.ボディソープ、100円バック式無料ロッカー、ドライヤー有り。源泉掛け流し、加水なし。カラオケボックス兼務の珍しい温泉。別棟プレハブの無料休憩室（約24畳程）あり。キンキンに冷えた無料の冷水が用意されていたり、カラオケのフード・ドリンクが注文出来たり、掃除も行き届いて清潔感もあり、かなり飲食サービス業を分かってる方が経営されているもよう。詳細
properties.desc_en:
■Price and Business Details
■680 yen, Details
■Report from our website reader: Used on a Sunday in August 2022. After eating at the Japanese restaurant "Mukashibanashi" next door (back to back), I took a bath here. Afterwards, I stayed overnight at the Nikko Roadside Station. There is only one indoor bath, but the free-flowing hot spring water without added water soothed my fatigue. The spacious tatami-floored rest room is also nice. (Posted: September 2022, by n)
■Report from our website reader: 500 yen on weekdays, 600 yen on weekends and holidays. Shampoo, body soap, free 100 yen bag-type lockers, and hair dryers are available. Free-flowing hot spring water, no added water. A rare hot spring that also serves as a karaoke box. There is a separate prefabricated free rest room (approximately 24 tatami mats). Free ice-cold water is provided, you can order food and drinks from the karaoke, and it is very clean and well-maintained, suggesting it is run by someone who understands the food and beverage service industry very well. Details

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: 東京三大煮込み、岸田屋
properties.title_en: Kishidaya, one of Tokyo's three best stewed dishes.""
properties.desc_ja:
■食べログ
■東京三大煮込みの一つ。もつ煮込みがハンパなく美味い！もつ煮込み＋ご飯が最高に美味い。かなりおすすめ。飲み屋さんなのでアルコールも頼みましょう。17時開店だがもの凄い行列になるので16時から並んだ方がいい。先頭の方はイスが7つくらいあるので待つのは苦ではない。子供連れお断りの張り紙あり。腹一杯食べて飲んで3000円くらい。非常に満足度高い。
properties.desc_en:
■Tabelog (restaurant review site)
■One of Tokyo's three best stewed dishes. The stewed offal is incredibly delicious! The stewed offal with rice is absolutely amazing. Highly recommended. Since it's a bar, you should order some alcohol too. It opens at 5pm, but there's a huge line, so it's best to line up from 4pm. There are about 7 chairs at the front of the line, so waiting isn't a problem. There's a sign saying no children allowed. You can eat and drink to your heart's content for around 3000 yen. Very satisfying.

properties.desc_ja:
■食べログ
■当サイト読者様レポート：桜ｴﾋﾞどんぶりがおいしいよ。桜エビのシーズンは、春漁は3月中旬〜6月初旬、秋漁は10月下旬〜12月下旬のみ　 公式サイト
■当サイト読者様レポート：桜エビのかき揚げを食べたが、正直、絶品という感じは無いかな（汗）。昼の行列に並んで食べたのに、揚げたてではなく、揚げ置きのを回された。その後、もう一度訪問して「桜えびの沖漬け丼」を食べたらこれが当たりでうまかった。かきあげは正直イマイチだが、沖漬け丼はオススメできます。
properties.desc_en:
■Tabelog
■Report from our site's reader: The sakura shrimp rice bowl is delicious. The sakura shrimp season is only from mid-March to early June for the spring fishing season, and from late October to late December for the autumn fishing season. Official website
■Report from our site's reader: I ate the sakura shrimp tempura, but honestly, it wasn't anything special (lol). I waited in line for lunch, but they served me pre-fried tempura instead of freshly fried. Afterwards, I visited again and ate the "sakura shrimp marinated rice bowl," which was a hit and delicious. The tempura is honestly not that great, but I can recommend the marinated rice bowl.

■朝8時〜夕方5時ごろまでは駐車場に管理人が常駐しているので、昼は車上荒らしなどは大丈夫っぽい。DQNがいなければ快適。駅前にはコンビニも完備。なかなか良いところ。ただし、首都高の走行音などで静かとは言い難い。（耳栓つければ快眠可能）（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■JRの「都区内パス」で23区内JR乗り放題１日750円。東京メトロ24時間券で東京メトロ地下鉄600円で乗り放題。＋300円出して900円で都営地下鉄も乗り放題になる券もあり。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is permitted. (On-site survey conducted in December 2024)
■Bathing ♨️: Surprisingly, bathing is possible at the adjacent Tokyo Sports and Culture Center: 690 yen, details
■Parking fee details. Both the first and second parking lots have toilets. The station (Shin-Kiba Station, accessible via both Tokyo Metro and JR) is nearby, making it a good base for sightseeing in Tokyo. It can also be used as a base for Disneyland and Comiket (Comic Market). There have been incidents of attacks by delinquent youths in the past 👉️ details.

■A caretaker is stationed in the parking lot from 8 am to around 5 pm, so car break-ins seem unlikely during the day. It's comfortable if there aren't any troublemakers. There's also a convenience store in front of the station. It's a pretty good place. However, it's not exactly quiet due to the noise from the Metropolitan Expressway. (You can sleep soundly if you wear earplugs) (Older post from before 2019)
■ With the JR "Tokyo Metropolitan Area Pass," you can ride JR lines within the 23 wards of Tokyo for 750 yen per day. The Tokyo Metro 24-hour ticket allows unlimited rides on the Tokyo Metro subway for 600 yen. There's also a ticket that allows unlimited rides on the Toei Subway for an additional 300 yen, totaling 900 yen. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_en:

The locking and unlocking times seem to vary slightly depending on the season and day of the week, but depending on the time you leave, you may not be able to get your car out. The roundabout is fine, but it is unclear whether parking is prohibited there. There were quite a few cars parked in the roundabout. (Older post from before 2019)

■入り方が非常に分かりにくいので、夜は地元民以外は来ない（逆に言えば、車中泊車両は地元民には全力で警戒される）。トラックも来ない。トイレは夜間も使える＆超きれい。高速道路の車の走行音が響くが、耳栓をすればどうということはない。Wimaxも利用可能。ここは本当に穴場。見つけた人すごいｗ（2019年以前の古い投稿）

■Detailed map and photo of the toilet 🚻. Overnight parking is possible. (On-site survey November 2025)
■A real hidden gem. Toilets available, and a large outdoor sink with running water. (Older post from before 2019)
■The entrance is very difficult to find, so no one but locals comes at night (conversely, vehicles parked overnight are viewed with extreme caution by locals). No trucks come either. The toilets are usable at night and are super clean. You can hear the sound of cars from the highway, but it's not a problem if you wear earplugs. WiMAX is also available. This is truly a hidden gem. The person who found it is amazing lol (Older post from before 2019)

There are coin-operated showers at the adjacent "Teganuma Shinsui Hiroba Mizu no Yakata" (details) for 100 yen/5 minutes (7:30-17:00 on open days, 8:30-17:00 on closed days) details. Suitable for those who don't want to go all the way to Teganuma Onsen. (Posted: May 2022, by user a)

properties.desc_ja:
■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2025年10月現地調査）
■当サイト読者様レポート：利用日　2023/10/13（金）。非常に静か、夜間何台か駐車されているものの無人車両も散見される。（近隣住民のものかも？）　海岸沿いだが波消しブロック配置エリアのためか釣り客なし。西から海岸沿いにアプローチする道は夜間わかりづらい。一部道幅狭くすれ違い不能な部分あり注意を要する。北からアクセスすべき。（投稿：2023年10月、ジル415様）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレはキレイな水洗洋式で最高。津波が来たら終わりなので、携帯の緊急地震速報は必ずオンにしておくこと。（2021年11月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is permitted. (On-site survey, October 2025)
■Report from a reader of this site: Date of visit: October 13, 2023 (Friday). Very quiet; although several cars were parked overnight, unoccupied vehicles were also observed. (Perhaps belonging to local residents?) Although it is along the coast, there were no anglers, possibly due to the presence of breakwater blocks. The road approaching the coast from the west is difficult to find at night. Some sections of the road are narrow and impassable, so caution is required. Access should be from the north. (Submitted by: Jill415, October 2023)
■Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. The toilets are clean, flushable Western-style toilets, which is great. Since it would be over if a tsunami hit, be sure to turn on your mobile phone's earthquake early warning system. (On-site verification by administrator, November 2021)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 甲州市 柳沢峠 市営駐車場
properties.title_en: Koshu City, Yanagisawa Pass, Municipal Parking Lot""
properties.desc_ja:
■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2025年11月現地調査）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2021年6月10日宿泊。24時間利用可能　無料。トイレも24時間利用可能。トイレは特にきれいとか不潔とかいうことはなく、峠の駐車場としては普通。トイレットペーパーは十分に備えられている。夜間は駐車場もトイレも照明が全くなく、真っ暗になるのでヘッドライト、ランタン、懐中電灯などの照明器具は必須。スマホのライトでトイレに入ることはできても、用を足すのにスマホでは厳しい。宿泊したのは平日の木曜日だったので他には1台しかいなかったが、バードウォッチングのメッカなので、GWから初夏にかけての週末はそれなりに車中泊する人は多いのではないかと思われる。茶屋の前からは富士山が望める。（投稿：2021年6月、Kangoo Tony様）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is permitted. (On-site survey conducted November 2025)
■Report from a reader of this site: Stayed on June 10, 2021. Available 24 hours a day, free of charge. Toilets are also available 24 hours a day. The toilets are neither particularly clean nor dirty, just average for a mountain pass parking lot. There is plenty of toilet paper. At night, there is absolutely no lighting in the parking lot or toilets, so it becomes pitch black, making lighting equipment such as a headlamp, lantern, or flashlight essential. You can enter the toilet with the light from your smartphone, but it's difficult to use your phone to relieve yourself. I stayed on a weekday Thursday, so there was only one other car, but since it's a mecca for birdwatching, I imagine there are quite a few people who stay overnight in their cars on weekends from Golden Week to early summer. Mount Fuji can be seen from in front of the tea house. (Posted by Kangoo Tony, June 2021)

■詳細案内図
■2025年1月管理人現地確認：車中泊評価【Sランク🤩】87点👉️現地の写真・詳細案内図はこちら

■当サイト読者様レポート：上下線とも売店・コンビニ・フードコートの一部店舗は24h営業。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：ぷらっとパークについて。足柄ＳＡに直結していて東名高速道路を利用しなくても車中泊が可能。大型トラックがいないのと、人の出入りがほとんどないので話し声なども聞こえずＳＡ内よりもこちらのほうが快適かも。ドッグランはぷらっとパークに隣接しているのでペット連れの人には便利。足柄ＳＡ内では名水「足柄の水」が無料で給水出来るのも嬉しい。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：下り側のぷらっとパークはまだ利用していないので分かりませんが、上り側のぷらっとパークは夕方から翌日の明け方までひっきりなしに車の出入りがあり駐車スペースを確保するのにも一苦労、夜明けの５時頃でさえも３０台以上ある駐車スペースがほぼ満車状態。SA施設の換気扇や電気施設が常に稼働しておりうるさい。神経質な方は全く熟睡できないと思います。それらを気にしない方なら最高の車中泊スポットだと思います。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■管理人も下り側のぷらっとパークで車中泊してみました。下り側はアクセスが悪い＆トイレまで遠いのが難点ですが、逆にそれが幸いして下り側に来る人は少ないようで、比較的静かです。なかなか良いです（トイレが遠い点には注意。徒歩3分ほどかかります）。人の出入りが少なく、耳栓して寝たら朝まで爆睡できました。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed Map
■January 2025 Administrator's On-site Verification: Overnight Car Stay Evaluation [S Rank 🤩] 87 points 👉️Click here for on-site photos and detailed map
■Bath ♨️: 《Upbound side: Kintoki-yu》 810 yen, details
■Bath ♨️: 《Downbound side: Ashigara Roman-kan Ashigara-yu》 810 yen, details
■Super huge service area. Completely separated from trucks. Free 24-hour Wi-Fi (older post from before 2019)
■Report from our site's readers: Some shops in the shops, convenience stores, and food court on both the upbound and downbound sides are open 24 hours. (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from our site's readers: About Puratto Park. It is directly connected to Ashigara SA, so overnight car stays are possible even without using the Tomei Expressway. There are no large trucks and there is almost no coming and going of people, so you can't hear conversations, and it may be more comfortable than inside the service area. The dog run is adjacent to Puratto Park, so it is convenient for people with pets. It's also nice that you can get free water from the famous "Ashigara Water" at Ashigara Service Area. (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from a reader of this site: I haven't used the downbound Plat Park yet, so I don't know about that, but the upbound Plat Park has a constant stream of cars coming and going from evening until dawn the next day, making it difficult to secure a parking space. Even at 5 AM, the parking space, which has more than 30 spaces, is almost full. The ventilation fans and electrical equipment in the service area are constantly running and noisy. I think people who are sensitive to noise won't be able to sleep soundly at all. If you don't mind those things, I think it's the best spot for sleeping in your car. (Older post from before 2019)
■I, the administrator, also tried sleeping in my car at the downbound Plat Park. The downbound side has the drawbacks of poor access and being far from the toilets, but conversely, it seems that fewer people come to the downbound side, so it's relatively quiet. It's pretty good (note that the toilets are far away; it takes about 3 minutes on foot). There are few people coming and going, and I was able to sleep soundly until morning with earplugs in. (Older posts from before 2019)

■当サイト読者様レポート：砂利の駐車場。トイレあり。夜は暗い。県道341号から国道1号線の下をくぐるように入る。アクセスしやすい国道1号線の上下線に自販機とトイレがある道の駅があるので、あえてここを選ぶ理由はないが選択肢のひとつに。土日祝は目の前のグラウンドで早朝からなにかと行事があるので、平日がよい。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:

■Free parking and public toilets (👉️Photos of toilets 🚻 and detailed map are here (taken March 2025)). It's a vast riverside park, and parking is available everywhere. Temporary toilets are also scattered throughout. It's quiet at night if you choose your spot carefully, but there are safety concerns. (On-site confirmation by administrator, October 2020)
■Report from a reader of this site: Gravel parking lot. Toilets available. Dark at night. Access is via Prefectural Road 341, going under National Route 1. There are roadside stations with vending machines and toilets on both sides of National Route 1, which are easily accessible, so there's no particular reason to choose this place, but it's one option. There are various events on the grounds in front from early morning on weekends and holidays, so weekdays are better. (Older post from before 2019)

■Report from our site's reader: The Oku-Nikko Yumoto Hondori Lakeside Parking Lot in Tochigi Prefecture is designated as A-rank, but last autumn there were many signs posted prohibiting overnight parking nearby. There were also signs warning that overnight parking vehicles should have their license plates noted and be spoken to, so we would like to report this. (Submitted: January 2026, by s)
■Report from our site's reader: [Information on Oku-Nikko Yumoto Onsen] The overnight parking map lists "Yumoto Hondori North Parking Lot," but it is only used by large tour buses and day-trippers, with almost no overnight parking. Long-term overnight parking is mostly done at "Yumoto Hondori Lakeside Parking Lot (in front of the Volunteer House)." Details: You can get a signal from the free Wi-Fi of the adjacent "Nikko Yumoto Visitor Center" (NikkoCityWi-Fi, SSID "0000FLETS-PORTAL", "National park wifi") in the parking lot. Anyone can use it. There is a small Yamazaki convenience store inside the adjacent "Ooruri Sanso". (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_en:
■Detailed Map
■Discovered a hidden gem. Free parking and public toilets (👉️Photos of the toilets 🚻 and detailed map are here (taken in January 2025)). There is a paid campsite attached (campsite details). The official website states that "accommodation is only available from July 1st to September 30th," but when I visited in late October, everyone was camping normally, and the toilets were available at night. Cell phone reception is OK. The parking lot near the toilets is full of campers and noisy, but this more distant parking lot is quiet until late at night (the toilets are far away). Toilets and water 👉️Detailed location. Rental bicycles and ferry are free! (Posted by a reader in June 2024)

■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ隣接はテニスコート隣の駐車場（詳細）のみだがトイレが臭う。他の駐車場は200m位暗い夜道を歩く事に。温泉～風車の駐車場が明るいが、夜中中国人や他外人達の謎の出入りが多い。隣接芝生広場で若者の打ち上げ花火あり。体育館から道を渡った大型の砂利駐車場は催事以外は封鎖？。全体的に静かで良い所です。（投稿：2025年6月、読者様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：大きい風車がランドマークになっている公園で敷地内に何箇所も駐車場があります。風車近くの砂利駐車場に泊まりましたが夜間封鎖ありませんでした。体育館前の駐車場は夜間封鎖されるようです、他にもあるかもしれないので注意ください。トイレも洋式水洗で何箇所もありました。敷地内に410円で入浴できる施設やBBQ可能な場所（洗い場あり）があったりとかなりおすすめの施設です。BBQはカセットコンロのみ、ゴミは持ち帰り、社会実験として2024年3月31日まで無料で利用できるようです。（投稿：2024年3月、すみしん様）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is possible. (On-site survey, January 2025)
■Bathing ♨️: "Kasumigaura no Yu" 410 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: The only toilet adjacent to the park is the one next to the tennis court (details), but the toilet smells. Other parking lots require a 200m walk down a dark road at night. The parking lot between the hot spring and the windmill is well-lit, but there's a lot of mysterious coming and going of Chinese and other foreigners at night. There were fireworks being set off by young people in the adjacent lawn area. The large gravel parking lot across the road from the gymnasium seems to be closed except for events? Overall, it's a quiet and nice place. (Posted: June 2025, reader)
■Report from our site's reader: This park has a large windmill as a landmark and several parking lots on the grounds. I stayed in the gravel parking lot near the windmill and it wasn't closed at night. The parking lot in front of the gymnasium seems to be closed at night; there may be others, so please be careful. There were also several Western-style flush toilets. This facility is highly recommended, as it has a bathing area on the premises for 410 yen and a BBQ area (with washing facilities). BBQ is limited to portable gas stoves only, and you must take your trash with you. As a social experiment, it seems to be free to use until March 31, 2024. (Posted by: Sumishin, March 2024)

■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。非常にオススメ。（2024年12月現地調査）
■当サイト読者様レポート：メインエリアのほか、ホテル側のエリアも止められる、トイレに近い。虫が多い。早朝からは釣りの方が多くいらっしゃる。（投稿：2022年8月、ttfromjn様）
■箱根のベスト車中泊スポット。無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。夜間静か。携帯電波OK。良い。（2021年11月管理人現地確認）
■当サイト読者様レポート：箱根駅伝の往路ゴール、復路スタートの地。24時間使える駐車場とトイレ。駐車場は国道から離れているため比較的静か。広さも十分あり目の前が芦ノ湖というロケーションもいい。トイレは夜8時過ぎくらいになると電気が消されてしまうので懐中電灯が必須。かなり暗いです。車で数分のところにコンビニもあります。2回ほど車中泊に使いましたが職質やDQNもいませんでした。時期によっては来るかもしれません。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■標高725m
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is possible. Highly recommended. (On-site survey, December 2024)
■Report from our site's reader: In addition to the main area, you can also park in the area on the hotel side, and it's close to the toilets. There are a lot of insects. Many people come fishing from early in the morning. (Submitted by ttfromjn, August 2022)
■The best overnight parking spot in Hakone. Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed that it is not closed at night. Quiet at night. Cell phone reception is OK. Good. (On-site verification by administrator, November 2021)
■Report from our site's reader: The finish line for the outbound leg and the start line for the return leg of the Hakone Ekiden. 24-hour parking and toilets. The parking lot is relatively quiet because it is away from the national highway. There is plenty of space and the location with Lake Ashi in front is also good. The lights in the toilets are turned off after 8 pm, so a flashlight is essential. It is quite dark. There is a convenience store a few minutes away by car. I've used it for overnight stays in my car a couple of times, and I haven't encountered any police questioning or troublemakers. They might come around depending on the time of year. (Older post from before 2019)
■ Elevation: 725m

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2024年12月現地調査）
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ有、外灯有、飲料自販機無、コンビニ有(隣接地)。R1 藤枝バイパスのPAです。R1からは谷稲葉IC出口に向かいランプの途中です。一般道からの入り口は谷稲葉IC入り口とは別の所です。トイレしかありません。ほぼ大型車用の設備です。普通車は工事中の為15台位しか駐車スペースがありません。隣にミニストップ 藤枝谷稲葉IC前店があります。大型車駐車場からはコンビニ利用に便利な歩行者通路があります。普通車はコンビニ駐車場に車で行った方が良いと思います。一般道からPAに戻る時は入り口が別なので気を付けて下さい。藤枝バイパスに直接行く場合は谷稲葉IC入口から入ります。騒音は中以上で駐車台数も少ないので仮眠程度が良いと思います。（投稿：2022年9月、s様）
■下道バイパスのPA。無料駐車場とトイレ。交通量が多く、うるさい。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is permitted. (On-site survey conducted in December 2024)
■Report from a reader of this site: Toilets available, streetlights available, no vending machines for drinks, convenience store available (adjacent). This is a rest area on the R1 Fujieda Bypass. From R1, it's on the way to the Taniinaba IC exit ramp. The entrance from the general road is separate from the Taniinaba IC entrance. There are only toilets. The facilities are almost entirely for large vehicles. Due to ongoing construction, there are only about 15 parking spaces for regular cars. There is a Ministop Fujieda Taniinaba IC store next door. There is a pedestrian walkway from the large vehicle parking area that is convenient for using the convenience store. Regular cars should probably drive to the convenience store parking lot. When returning to the rest area from the general road, be careful as the entrance is separate. If you are going directly to the Fujieda Bypass, enter from the Taniinaba IC entrance. The noise level is moderate to high and there are few parking spaces, so it's best suited for a short nap. (Posted by: s, September 2022)
■Rest area on a local road bypass. Free parking and toilets. The traffic is heavy and it's noisy. (Older post from before 2019)

■ここで撮影された天の川写真を見てみる
■当サイト読者様レポート：工事現場によくある簡易トイレをグレードアップしたような非水洗のトイレが２機新設されました。ちゃんとしたコンクリート基礎の上に設置済ですが、冬季積雪時にもあるかは不明。さすが標高2000m超え、夏の猛暑も全く無縁。夜間通行する車も少なく静か。星も綺麗に見えます。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■天体観測スポット。日本国道標高最高地点。標高はなんと2165m。南東の空は東京の光害でバカみたいに明るいが、天候良ければ天の川は見えるらしい。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photo of toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is possible. (Survey conducted September 2024)
■See photos of the Milky Way taken here
■Report from a reader of this site: Two non-flush toilets, similar to the simple toilets often found at construction sites but upgraded, have been newly installed. They are installed on proper concrete foundations, but it is unclear whether they will be there during winter snowfall. As expected at an altitude of over 2000m, it is completely unaffected by the intense summer heat. There are few cars passing through at night, making it quiet. The stars are also beautifully visible. (Older post from before 2019)
■Astronomical observation spot. The highest point on a Japanese national highway. The altitude is an astonishing 2165m. The southeastern sky is ridiculously bright due to light pollution from Tokyo, but apparently the Milky Way is visible on a clear day. (Older post from before 2019)
