■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2025年9月現地調査）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2022年8月の平日に利用。温泉街へは徒歩か巡回バスを利用する手もありますが、温泉街の本町無料駐車場（17時まで）を利用して温泉を楽しんでからここへ移動するのも良いかと思います。（本町無料駐車場：詳細）道の駅のメイン駐車場の反対側に奥行きのある駐車場があります。静かでした。「長期停泊・長期駐車はしないで」という表示があります。公共マナーを守って一晩だけお世話になるのは大丈夫。EVの急速充電器が無料で使えますが、稼働は900-1700のみです。（投稿：2022年9月、n様）
■道沿いで走行音うるさい。しかし、夏〜秋は駐車場はいつも車中泊の車でいっぱい。大人気である。ここに車を置いて、草津温泉湯畑〜無料温泉巡りをするのもおすすめ。この道の駅から、湯畑まで徒歩20分。下り坂なので楽。帰りは上り坂のため結構大変だが、巡回バスが湯畑〜道の駅まで１００円で乗れるので、それを利用するとよい。帰りの時刻表を事前に確認しておきましょう。なお、草津温泉街の駐車場は、二時間500円。夏でも夜は涼しくて快適。草津の無料温泉について：詳細（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is permitted. (On-site survey conducted in September 2025)
■Report from a reader of this site: Used on a weekday in August 2022. While you can walk to the hot spring town or take the shuttle bus, it's also a good idea to enjoy the hot springs at the Honmachi free parking lot (until 5 PM) in the hot spring town before coming here. (Honmachi Free Parking Lot: Details) There is a deep parking lot on the opposite side of the main parking lot of the roadside station. It was quiet. There is a sign that says "No long-term parking or overnight stays." It's fine to stay for just one night as long as you follow public manners. An EV fast charger is available for free, but it only operates from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. (Posted by: n, September 2022)
■The road is noisy due to traffic. However, from summer to autumn, the parking lot is always full of cars parked overnight. It's very popular. It's also recommended to park your car here and tour the Kusatsu Onsen Yubatake and other free hot springs. It's a 20-minute walk from this roadside station to the Yubatake (hot spring field). It's downhill, so it's easy. The return trip is uphill and quite strenuous, but you can take the shuttle bus from Yubatake to the roadside station for 100 yen, so it's a good idea to use that. Be sure to check the return timetable in advance. Also, parking in the Kusatsu Onsen area costs 500 yen for two hours. Even in summer, the nights are cool and comfortable. For more information about Kusatsu's free hot springs: see older posts from before 2019.

■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2024年9月現地調査）
■当サイト読者様レポート：日光 三本松茶屋 の追加情報。情報通り駐車場は広いし、トイレも24時間使用可能ですが、夜間真っ暗です。他に車中泊仲間が居れば良いのですが、一人ではとても居られないです。トイレも簡易水洗で今一つです。売店、食堂は19時くらいまで営業していそうです。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■ここで撮影された天の川写真を見てみる
■天体観測ポイント。南天は東京の光害で明るいが、北天はまあまあ。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photo of toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is possible. (Survey conducted in September 2024)
■Report from a reader of this site: Additional information on Nikko Sanbonmatsu Chaya. As reported, the parking lot is large and the toilets are available 24 hours a day, but it is pitch black at night. It would be fine if there were other people staying overnight in their cars, but it would be impossible to stay there alone. The toilets are simple flush toilets and not very good. The shop and restaurant seem to be open until around 7 PM. (Older post from before 2019)
■See photos of the Milky Way taken here
■Astronomical observation point. The southern sky is bright due to light pollution from Tokyo, but the northern sky is fairly good. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■【名水百選】秦野盆地湧水群の１つ。神奈川県道70号線、ヤビツ峠の北にある。駐車場・水汲み場が整備され、特に休日にポリタンク族多い。
properties.desc_en: ■ [One of Japan's Top 100 Famous Waters] One of the springs in the Hadano Basin. Located north of Yabitsu Pass on Kanagawa Prefectural Road 70. There is a parking lot and a water collection area, and it is especially crowded with people filling up with plastic containers on weekends.

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■【名水百選】秦野盆地湧水群の１つ。「表丹沢野外活動センター」から細い山道を登った先にある。駐車場・水汲み場が整備され、特に休日にポリタンク族多い。
properties.desc_en: ■ [One of Japan's Top 100 Famous Waters] One of the springs in the Hadano Basin. It is located at the top of a narrow mountain path from the "Omote-Tanzawa Outdoor Activity Center". There is a parking lot and a water collection point, and it is especially crowded with people filling up with water in plastic containers on weekends.

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■【名水百選】秦野盆地湧水群の１つ。「寿湘ヶ丘老人ホーム」への看板に従って進む途中にある。水質検査済だが「煮沸して下さい」との案内あり。
properties.desc_en: ■ [One of Japan's Top 100 Famous Waters] One of the springs in the Hadano Basin. It is located along the way to the "Kotobuki Shogaoka Nursing Home" following the signs. The water has been tested for quality, but there is a sign that says "Please boil it."

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■【平成の名水百選】上総掘りによる自噴井戸から水が汲める。井戸は久留里地区に何ヶ所かある。
properties.desc_en: ■ [One of Japan's Top 100 Famous Waters of the Heisei Era] Water can be drawn from a self-flowing well dug using the Kazusa-bori method. There are several such wells in the Kururi area.

properties.desc_en: ■Also known as "Futago Spring." It is located down the slope near the Numataguchi bus stop on Shizuoka Prefectural Road 394, cross the Kise River, and turn left onto a gravel road. Abundant water flows from several pipes.

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)

■生で飲んでみました。お腹の調子は全く問題なし。
properties.desc_en:
■Located on the grounds of "Michi-no-Eki Chichibu" (a roadside rest area). The water comes from a water treatment plant. In short, it's tap water, so you can drink it raw with peace of mind.

■I tried drinking it raw. My stomach was perfectly fine.

■シャワー🚿あり：一回300円（9時～17:30最終受付）
■当サイト読者様レポート：追加情報　2025・5・9に車中泊　Ｐは全体がわずかに傾斜しています。とても広いし、第２Ｐ(砂利敷)もあるので繁忙期でも大丈夫でしょう。トラックエリアとは完全分離。駐車場ではないですが屋根付スペースが広く、Wi-Fi、椅子やテーブルもあるので、雨天時などは重宝しそうです。裏手の河川敷にあるマットゴルフ場の情報に追加：地面は未舗装です・仮設トイレがあります・テントがあります・土手から下りるところに鎖があるので常時進入できるとは限りません。・地元のマットゴルフクラブの管理ですから、部外者の目的外使用は避けるべきでしょう。（投稿：2025年5月、tossan様）

■2018/4/27 グランドオープン！幹線県道からは離れており静かで良さそう。
properties.desc_en:
■ Showers available: 300 yen per use (9:00 AM - 5:30 PM, last entry)
■ Reader report from this site: Additional information - Overnight stay in a car on May 9, 2025. The entire parking area is slightly sloped. It's very spacious, and there's also a second parking area (gravel), so it should be fine even during peak season. Completely separate from the truck area. It's not a parking lot, but there's a large covered space with Wi-Fi, chairs and tables, so it would be useful in rainy weather. Additional information on the mat golf course on the riverbank behind: The ground is unpaved. There are temporary toilets. There are tents. There's a chain where you descend from the embankment, so it's not always possible to enter. It's managed by the local mat golf club, so unauthorized use by outsiders should be avoided. (Posted: May 2025, by tossan)
■ Reader report from this site: It's relatively quiet at night with little traffic (it gets a little noisy when trucks or motorcycles pass by). Furthermore, there's a park golf parking lot along the riverbank on the west side, which is incredibly quiet and wonderful (though the restrooms are far away). It's famous for its matsutake mushroom sales in the autumn. (Older post from before 2019)
■2018/4/27 Grand Opening! It's away from the main prefectural road, so it seems quiet and nice.

■ Report from a reader of this site: The road surface is flat, and the adjacent road (National Route 418) is not a main road, so it is quiet at night. There are houses nearby, so it is safe. The downside is that the toilet is small (the men's toilet has one urinal and one sink) (but there are few users, so it is not a problem). There are no convenience stores nearby, but there is a restaurant (name: Arigato) a 1 minute walk southeast along the adjacent national highway. There is no sign indicating that it is a Michi-no-Eki. I heard that the signage would have cost 20 million yen, so they cut costs and built a 400 million yen athletics stadium instead. It's unclear if it's suitable for overnight stays in a car. It's about 1 km away from Urugi Onsen Komadori no Yu. (Older post from before 2019)

■2023年9月、道の駅としての供用開始。公式サイト。駐車場がガッツリ幹線国道沿い。
■当サイト読者様レポート：和田宿ステーション：道の駅ではありませんが、飲食店・農産物販売所・観光案内所・24時間利用可能トイレがあり、ほぼ道の駅です。すぐ裏に町が管理する入浴施設「ふれあいの湯」があります。コンビニもすぐ近くにあります。道の駅「マルメロの駅ながと」が近くにあります。個人的にはAランクで、「マルメロの駅」より好きです。旧和田宿に近接しており歩いてすぐ。本陣は日本で最も原型を残してるらしく、必見。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: During Golden Week, I stayed overnight in my car on my way to the "Takayama Obsidian Experience Museum." The parking lot was flat and available for overnight use, and the toilets were clean. Although it's along National Route 142, the noise wasn't bothersome. The nearby "Wadajuku Onsen Fureai no Yu" is also good. The nearest convenience store is "Seven-Eleven Nagawa-machi Store," about an 8-minute drive away. (Posted: May 2026, by Numa)

■Opened as a roadside station in September 2023. Official website. The parking lot is right along the main national highway.

■Report from a reader of this site: Wadajuku Station: Although not a roadside station, it has restaurants, a farm produce shop, a tourist information center, and 24-hour toilets, making it practically a roadside station. The town-managed bathing facility "Fureai no Yu" is right behind it. There's also a convenience store nearby. The roadside station "Marumero no Eki Nagato" is nearby. Personally, I'd rank it A, and I like it more than "Quince Station." It's close to the old Wada-juku post town, just a short walk away. The main inn is said to be the most well-preserved in Japan and a must-see. (Older post from before 2019)

■2018年4月、管理人も見てきましたが、車中泊禁止みたいな掲示は無くなってました。おばちゃんに話を聞いたら、昔汚い車（一見してヤバそう）がこの道の駅に住み着いていて、その対策的な意味で掲示していたそうです。今は、夜は車中泊の車がたくさんいます。幹線道沿いですが広い駐車場で奥は比較的静かだしGood。wimaxも利用可能。奥の公園みたいなとこで水道水の給水も可能。また、川沿いの第二駐車場も公園みたいになってて簡易トイレあり車中泊が可能。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：大きな国道のそばですが、駐車場がとても広く、車を国道から離れて停める事が出来ます。トイレの入口に長時間駐車禁止ナンバーチェックすると掲示･･、トイレに監視カメラ？車中泊する気なくして帰ることに･･、広い駐車場に他県ナンバーなくガラガラ。（2019年以前の古い投稿）

■ There is a sign prohibiting long-term parking. (Information provided by a reader of this site: September 2021, i)
■ Report from a reader of this site: I stayed overnight in my car at Niigata Furusato Village in early July, and several large trailers were using it, so I think car camping is possible. However, the toilets do not have bidets, so it might be better to use the nearby home center if you go early. (Older post from before 2019)
■ In April 2018, the administrator also checked, and the sign prohibiting car camping was gone. When I spoke to an older woman, she said that in the past, a dirty car (which looked suspicious at first glance) had taken up residence at this roadside station, and the sign was posted as a countermeasure. Currently, there are many cars parked overnight. It's along a main road, but the large parking lot is relatively quiet in the back, which is good. WiMAX is also available. Tap water is available in the park-like area at the back. Additionally, the second parking lot along the river is also like a park with a simple toilet, making it suitable for overnight parking. (Older post from before 2019)

■Report from a reader of this site: Although it's near a major national highway, the parking lot is very large, allowing you to park away from the highway. There's a sign at the toilet entrance indicating that long-term parking is prohibited and license plate checks are conducted... and there's a surveillance camera in the toilet? I lost interest in overnight parking and decided to leave... The large parking lot was practically empty with no out-of-prefecture license plates. (Older post from before 2019)

The fried chicken with sweet and sour sauce set meal was delicious, but it was a little hot in the summer because there was no air conditioning. properties.desc_ja: ■翌朝うずら家のそばを食べる時限定。朝5時くらいに従業員の人が来て、ウェイティングシートが店頭に置かれて、名前を書いて順番を取れるので、そのために駐車場で車中泊して待つ。連休時は壮絶な順番取りになる。トイレは戸隠神社中社の鳥居の奥に水洗洋式のトイレがある（詳細場所）。朝5時に起床してウェイティングシートに名前を書き、トイレに行って9:30まで二度寝。開店5分前から店員さんの案内が始まる（※連休時等は10時開店なので注意、営業日カレンダー詳細）。（2022年9月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en: ■This is only for those who plan to eat soba noodles at Uzura-ya the next morning. An employee comes around 5am and places a waiting sheet in front of the store, where you can write your name down to get a place in line, so you have to stay overnight in your car in the parking lot to wait. During long weekends, getting a place in line is extremely competitive. There is a flush toilet with Western-style toilet behind the torii gate of Togakushi Shrine's Chusha (details of location). Wake up at 5am, write your name on the waiting sheet, go to the toilet, and then go back to sleep until 9:30am. The staff will start guiding you in 5 minutes before opening (※Note that they open at 10am during long weekends, see the business calendar for details). (Confirmed on-site by the administrator in September 2022)

■管理人評価★4.6（泉質4.5、景色0.1）管理人は大湯、麻釜の湯、松葉の湯の三つに入りましたが、泉質は松葉の湯が一番だと感じました。やや緑がかった濁り湯で大変すばらしい温泉です。大湯は建物がシンボル的建築物で美しい。道が細くて駐車場がないので、歩いて回りましょう。露天風呂はないが全体の雰囲気を評価して景色は0.1加算。総合で4.6との評価。名湯。
properties.desc_en:
■A tour of Nozawa Onsen's public baths. 13 locations. Highly praised by numerous hot spring enthusiasts. Detailed map 👉️ Details
■Manager's rating ★4.6 (Spring quality 4.5, Scenery 0.1) The manager visited three baths: Oyu, Magama-no-yu, and Matsuba-no-yu. I felt that Matsuba-no-yu had the best spring quality. It's a wonderful hot spring with slightly greenish, cloudy water. Oyu's building is a symbolic and beautiful structure. The roads are narrow and there's no parking, so you should walk around. There's no open-air bath, but I added 0.1 for scenery to reflect the overall atmosphere. Overall rating of 4.6. A famous hot spring.

■併設の「すずらんの湯」は2024年3月に閉館。
■2021年4月、久しぶりに来てみたが、M様が投稿してくれた白い看板（車中泊禁止の看板）は無かった。「オートキャンプ行為は禁止」という昔からある看板はあった。公衆トイレは水洗洋式もあり快適で良かった。人が集まる夏になったらまた車中泊禁止の看板が置かれるのかもしれない。いずれにせよ、車外でバーベキューをしたり、洗濯物を干したり、タープ広げて、イス、テーブル置いて宴会したりするのは厳禁です。（2021年4月管理人現地確認）
■当サイト読者様レポート：新しく看板が増やされ、完全に車中泊禁止となりました。添付画像参考。（添付画像）以前より、マナーの悪化が著しかったのでやむを得ない処置と思われます。（投稿：2020年8月、M様）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。標高1423mで夏も快適！（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■幹線道路から離れており、夜は静かである。堂々のAランク車中泊スポットである。いちおう、「オートキャンプ行為は禁止」との看板あるが、車中泊はいっぱいいる。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■The adjacent "Suzuran no Yu" hot spring will close in March 2024.

■In April 2021, I visited again after a long time, but the white sign (prohibiting overnight parking) that Ms. M posted about was gone. The old sign that says "Auto camping is prohibited" was still there. The public toilets were flush toilets and Western-style, which was nice and comfortable. Perhaps the "no overnight parking" sign will be put up again when summer arrives and more people gather. In any case, barbecuing outside your car, hanging laundry, setting up a tarp, and having a party with chairs and tables is strictly prohibited. (Confirmed on-site by the administrator in April 2021)

■当サイト読者様レポート：八ヶ岳登山口にある通年営業の有料駐車場、トイレあり、風呂あり、標高1485m。最寄りの諏訪南ICから10km。駐車場は八ヶ岳山荘で受付。駐車１日800円（一泊すると2日分で1600円）。平日6時〜18時、土日祝5〜18時。受付は翌朝でもok。駐車券が無料のコーヒー1杯チケットになる。営業時間同上。トイレは八ヶ岳山荘でチップ制(100円)。正面入り口は閉まっているが左の方の戸が24時間空いておりそこから入れる。営業時間内ならカレー、もつ煮、揚げパン等の美味しい軽食とお酒の提供、缶ビールやジュースの自販機あり。以上全て少し高めの値段設定(山料金)。近くにコンビニなし。春〜秋の週末は登山客の車中泊で賑わう。冬は氷点下だが客あり。スタッドレス必須。対策しないと2Lペットボトルの水が全て凍りつく。隣に美味しいレストランあり。詳細。ステーキやパスタ、コーヒー、お酒など。夜八時まで営業。入浴八時まで可、770円。食事をした人は入浴料半額。登山客多数だが観光で来る人もそこそこあり。別荘地があるから？（投稿：2020年12月、ガチ雪山登山者様）
properties.desc_en:
■Bath♨️: 700 yen, details
■Overnight stay in car rating: 74 points 👉️Click here for detailed scoring and detailed map. (July 2024)
■Report from our site's reader: A year-round paid parking lot at the Yatsugatake trailhead, with toilets and a bath, at an altitude of 1485m. 10km from the nearest Suwa-Minami IC. Parking is handled at Yatsugatake Sanso. Parking is 800 yen per day (1600 yen for two days if you stay overnight). Weekdays 6am-6pm, weekends and holidays 5am-6pm. Check-in is OK the next morning. The parking ticket becomes a ticket for one free cup of coffee. Same hours as above. Toilets are at Yatsugatake Sanso and are tip-based (100 yen). The main entrance is closed, but the door on the left is open 24 hours and you can enter from there. During business hours, they offer delicious light meals such as curry, motsuni (offal stew), and fried bread, as well as alcohol, and there are vending machines for canned beer and juice. All of the above prices are a bit on the high side (mountain rates). There are no convenience stores nearby. It gets crowded with hikers sleeping in their cars on weekends from spring to autumn. It's below freezing in winter, but there are still customers. Snow tires are a must. If you don't take precautions, a 2L bottle of water will freeze completely. There is a good restaurant next door. Details: Steaks, pasta, coffee, alcohol, etc. Open until 8 pm. Bathing is available until 8 pm, 770 yen. Bathing is half price for those who have eaten there. There are many hikers, but also a fair number of tourists. Is it because there is a villa area nearby? (Posted: December 2020, by a serious snow mountain climber)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：料金は無料で、24時間使える公衆トイレもありますがそこそこ綺麗です、ほかにも公衆トイレが公民館前にもあります。バスフィッシングのポイントなので時期によっては早朝から車の動きが激しいかもしれませんが湖畔の朝の景色はとても綺麗です。路面も場所によっては傾斜があります。温泉は車で20分程度の場所に赤倉温泉郷があります。夏でも朝晩はとても冷えますのでご注意ください。（投稿：2022年7月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There is a public toilet that is free to use and available 24 hours a day, and it is reasonably clean. There is also another public toilet in front of the community center. It is a bass fishing spot, so there may be a lot of traffic from early morning depending on the season, but the morning scenery by the lake is very beautiful. The road surface is sloped in some places. For hot springs, there is Akakura Onsenkyo, about a 20-minute drive away. Even in summer, it gets very cold in the mornings and evenings, so please be careful. (Submitted by: M, July 2022)

properties.label: Campground + Shower
properties.title_ja: まつもと里山キャンプ場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：利用料金¥1500～、夜間閉鎖無、ウォシュレットトイレ有、流し台有、シャワー有（別料金）、高台に有り、北アルプスと松本平の眺望がオススメ。夜間は車の往来無く静か。詳細、車中泊駐車場からの景色（投稿：2024年6月、ミック様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Usage fee from ¥1500, no closure at night, toilet with bidet, sink available, shower available (extra charge), located on a hill, recommended for its views of the Northern Alps and Matsumoto Plain. Quiet at night with no car traffic. Details, view from the car camping parking lot (posted by Mick in June 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 いくさかの郷
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：利用料金 無料、トイレ有(綺麗) 施設規模は大きくないと思いますが新しく綺麗です。(オープンは2019年4月のようです) Pはどこに停めてもトイレまで歩くのが苦にならない程度。2023.09.17(連休の中日)に車中泊で利用しました。20時すぎに到着した時点で車は他に2台のみ。いづれも車中泊利用のようでした。幹線道路(R19)から分かれて1.2kmほどの場所にあるためか、夜間の交通量がほぼなかったです｡停める場所は照明がある場所と無くて暗い場所ありますが、いづれも道路から見えるので不安はないです。お好みで。非常に静かで快適に眠れました。（投稿：2023年9月、@やす様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free to use, toilets available (clean) The facility isn't very big, but it's new and clean. (It seems to have opened in April 2019) No matter where you park, it's not a problem to walk to the toilets. I used it for an overnight stay in my car on September 17, 2023 (the middle day of a long weekend). When I arrived a little after 8 PM, there were only two other cars. Both seemed to be used for overnight stays in their cars. Perhaps because it's located about 1.2 km off the main road (Route 19), there was almost no traffic at night. There are some parking spots with lights and some that are dark without, but both are visible from the road, so there's no need to worry. It's up to your preference. It was very quiet and I was able to sleep comfortably. (Posted by: @yasu, September 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: きらりうむ佐渡（相川浜公園）
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車100台級以上の広大な無料駐車場。トイレは水洗洋式のウオシュレット付きで綺麗に清掃されている。主要道路から裏手に入った立地なので、行き交う車も少なく閑静な一夜を過ごせる。徒歩圏内にローソンとドラッグストアがあり、さらには相川の商店街も近いので居酒屋飲みも可能。かなり好条件の揃った車中泊スポットでオススメ。（投稿：2023年10月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A vast free parking lot with space for over 100 regular cars. The toilets are clean and equipped with flush toilets and bidets. Located off the main road, there is little traffic, making for a peaceful night's sleep. There is a Lawson convenience store and a drugstore within walking distance, and the Aikawa shopping street is also nearby, so you can enjoy drinks at an izakaya (Japanese pub). This is a highly recommended spot for overnight stays in your car, with many excellent conditions. (Submitted by: y, October 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車100台級以上の広大な無料駐車場。トイレは水洗洋式で綺麗に清掃されている。道路を挟んで飲食店もあるので、居酒屋飲みも可能。隣接する道路は直線の快走路で車が通るとやや騒々しいが、夜間は交通量も少ないので静かな夜を過ごせる。（投稿：2023年10月、y様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ設備も問題なし。周囲は、静かで、波音が心地良かった。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: A vast free parking lot with space for over 100 regular cars. The toilets are flush toilets and kept clean. There are restaurants across the road, so you can enjoy drinks at an izakaya (Japanese pub). The adjacent road is a straight, pleasant road, and while it can be a bit noisy when cars pass by, traffic is light at night, so you can enjoy a quiet evening. (Posted by: y, October 2023)

■Report from our website reader: The toilet facilities are fine. The surroundings are quiet, and the sound of the waves was soothing. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：南長野運動公園と並ぶ、巨大運動公園。ここも長野に点在するオリンピック会場の一つ。長野マラソンのスタート地点でもある。駐車場が常に解放されていて、トイレもある。月曜日が施設の休業日だが、駐車場にはいつでも入れる。少し北に車を走らせれば、夜12時まで営業しているスーパー銭湯がある。食事も周辺に夜遅くまで営業している美味しい味噌ラーメン屋あり。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Reader Report: A huge sports park, comparable to Minami-Nagano Sports Park. This is also one of the Olympic venues scattered throughout Nagano. It's also the starting point for the Nagano Marathon. The parking lot is always open, and there are restrooms. The facility is closed on Mondays, but you can enter the parking lot anytime. If you drive a little further north, there is a public bathhouse that is open until midnight. There are also delicious miso ramen restaurants in the area that are open late into the night. (Older post from before 2019)

The staff's explanations will increase your knowledge of salt and may even change your eating habits. Details (Posted by: Migratory Bird Travelogue, April 2021)

properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：同敷地内に駐車場に隣接して「真野漁港キャンプ場」(オートキャンプ場15区画、1区画10×10ｍ、電源無し)　もあり、無料だが2022年頃からサイトと炉では利用届の提出が必要（詳細）。提出先は真野行政サービスセンター（詳細）で、メール往復での提出が可能（メール記入ページ）。ただし記入した(電子又は紙面)文書を送る必要があるためスマホのみでは完結困難。（投稿：2024年9月、草の湯様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレあり。自販機あり。バーベキュー設備あり。管理人不在。無料。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Adjacent to the parking lot on the same premises is the "Mano Fishing Port Campground" (15 auto campsites, 10x10m per site, no electricity). It is free, but from around 2022, it is necessary to submit a usage application for the site and fireplace (details). The application should be submitted to the Mano Administrative Service Center (details), and it is possible to submit it via email (email entry page). However, since you need to send the completed (electronic or paper) document, it is difficult to complete using only a smartphone. (Submitted: September 2024, Kusanoyu)

■Report from a reader of this site: Toilets available. Vending machines available. BBQ facilities available. No caretaker. Free. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_ja:

■温泉マニア絶賛。入浴料金５００円、営業時間１０：００−１５：００、定休日：無休
■管理人評価★5.0（泉質4.5、景色0.5）泉質は、内風呂が緑色の濁り湯。露天風呂が乳青白色。何も言うことなし。満点。露天風呂の景色も、紅葉と渓流の音が心地よい。満点。値段も500円と良心的。何も言うことなし。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: I was refused entry to the Goshiki no Onsen Ryokan in Okuyamada, Takayama Village, Kamitakai District, Nagano Prefecture, as they said they haven't offered day-use bathing for the past three years. July 15, 2018. Please update the map.

■Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. Bathing fee: 500 yen, Opening hours: 10:00-15:00, Closed: None

■Administrator's rating: ★5.0 (Spring quality 4.5, Scenery 0.5) The spring quality: The indoor bath has cloudy green water. The open-air bath has milky bluish-white water. Nothing to complain about. Perfect score. The view from the open-air bath is also pleasant, with autumn leaves and the sound of the stream. Perfect score. The price is also reasonable at 500 yen. Nothing to complain about.

properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: I stayed overnight in my car in Obuse, Nagano Prefecture today (February 2023). In the summer, it's a paid parking lot, 500 yen for regular cars, from 9:00 to 17:00. It's free during the winter. Obuse Onsen is a 5-minute drive away. The toilets are clean and have bidet functions, and are available 24 hours a day. It's in the center of Obuse, so you can eat out. There are no supermarkets or convenience stores nearby. Attached image (Posted by: ☆☆Yoshi★★, February 2023)

This means there will be no more public baths nearby, but there are several day-trip hot spring facilities if you drive a bit further. However, the bookstore will remain open 24 hours and the restrooms are available, and there is also a McDonald's. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：先週の連休に車中泊しました。道の駅付随の(逆かも)町営施設の裏は本当に静かでした。日中は連日猛暑でしたが、ちょうど裏は朝日と反対側で建物も高く、10時位までは日陰で涼しかったです。出来たばかりの施設なので当然のように設備は綺麗。立地はバイパス下のガードをくぐって駅まで徒歩５分。夜は新潟市街地に電車で繰り出し、終電まで居酒屋でした(1人)。コンビニもあるし良いところでした。車中泊マップのおかげです。いつもありがとうございます。（投稿：2021年7月、じゅげむ様）
■2020年10月28日オープン。幹線道沿いだが、広大な駐車場で建物の裏の方は静かで良さそう。期待の新人！
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: I stayed overnight in my car during last week's long weekend. The area behind the town-run facility attached to the roadside station (or maybe the other way around) was really quiet. It was scorching hot every day during the day, but the back of the building was on the opposite side of the rising sun, and the tall building kept it cool and shady until around 10am. Since it's a newly built facility, the equipment is naturally very clean. The location is great; it's a 5-minute walk to the station after going under the overpass beneath the bypass. At night, I took the train to downtown Niigata and stayed at an izakaya (alone) until the last train. There's a convenience store nearby, so it was a good place. Thanks to the car camping map! Thank you as always. (Posted: July 2021, Jugemu)

■Opened October 28, 2020. It's along a main road, but the area behind the building seems quiet and nice with its vast parking lot. A promising newcomer!

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: [標高1360ｍ] 十石峠展望台駐車場
properties.title_en: [標高1360ｍ] Jikkoku Pass Observation Deck Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：水洗トイレありますが、山奥なので虫が多い。ここに来るまでの国道299号が険しく酷道。携帯の電波は各社ギリギリか圏外。冷たい湧き水ありますが、飲用不可の掲示。展望台あり。ビューポイント。標高1360ｍ。（投稿：2024年6月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There are flush toilets, but there are a lot of insects because it's deep in the mountains. National Route 299 leading up to this place is a rough and treacherous road. Cell phone reception is weak or nonexistent for all carriers. There is a cold spring, but a sign indicates it is not for drinking. There is an observation deck. A viewpoint. Elevation 1360m. (Submitted by a reader in June 2024)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: フレンド 喜多町店
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：新潟県のソウルフード「イタリアン」を長岡市で提供する店で、日本のドライブスルー発祥の店とも言われる。詳細、詳細、食べログ（投稿：2023年6月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A restaurant in Nagaoka City that serves "Italian," a soul food of Niigata Prefecture, is said to be the birthplace of drive-thru restaurants in Japan. Details, details, Tabelog (Posted: June 2023, by n)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：新潟県のソウルフード「イタリアン」を考案した新潟市の店。万代シテイバスセンターの2階にある。詳細、食べログ（投稿：2023年6月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: The restaurant in Niigata City that invented "Italian," a soul food of Niigata Prefecture. It is located on the 2nd floor of the Bandai City Bus Center. For details, see Tabelog (Posted by n, June 2023)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：新潟タレかつ丼発祥の店。詳細、食べログ（投稿：2025年10月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: The restaurant that originated Niigata-style tarekatsudon (pork cutlet rice bowl with sauce). Details on Tabelog (Posted by: n, October 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_en: Hanatomo no Sato Temporary Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：情報が古くて申し訳ないが、去年（2023年）の4月28日に花桃の里に行った時に車中泊しました。開催期間限定の臨時駐車場かも知れません。トイレ有りです。他にも20台ほど車中泊していました。シーズンになると周辺は激混みで、遅い時間に行くと身動きが取れないので前日にここに停めて会場まで距離があるので、朝早くに会場近くの屋台村駐車場（詳細）に移動しました。（それでも朝6時頃でギリギリ停めれましたが・・・）夜間は無料開放なので駐車料金は移動後に停めた1000円だけでした。 駐車場を出る時に徴収されます。（投稿：2024年1月、やすすぎ様）
■標高764m
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: I apologize that the information is outdated, but I stayed overnight in my car when I went to Hanatomo no Sato on April 28th last year (2023). It might be a temporary parking lot only for the duration of the event. There are toilets. There were about 20 other cars parked there overnight. During the season, the surrounding area gets extremely crowded, and if you go late, you won't be able to move, so I parked here the day before and moved to the food stall village parking lot (details) near the venue early in the morning because it's a distance away. (Even then, I barely managed to park around 6am...) It's free to park overnight, so the only parking fee I paid was 1000 yen for the parking I paid after moving. It's collected when you leave the parking lot. (Posted: January 2024, Yasusugi)
■Elevation 764m

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 乗鞍高原 第3駐車場 (やまぼうし駐車場)
properties.title_en: Norikura Kogen 3rd Parking Lot (Yamaboshi Parking Lot)
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：乗鞍高原　第3駐車場(やまぼうし駐車場)は、今回車中泊禁止の看板は見当たりませんでした。やまぼうしRVサイトは終了しており、トイレも利用出来ました(夜は未確認)。（投稿：2025年8月、h様）
■トイレあり。標高1575mで夏も涼しい。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: At Norikura Kogen's 3rd parking lot (Yamaboshi parking lot), we didn't see any signs prohibiting overnight parking. The Yamaboshi RV site was closed, but the toilets were usable (not checked at night). (Submitted by h, August 2025)

■Toilets available. At an altitude of 1575m, it's cool even in summer. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: 乗鞍高原 第2駐車場 (金山駐車場)
properties.title_en: Norikura Kogen 2nd Parking Lot (Kanayama Parking Lot)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：乗鞍高原 第1駐車場に、夜間はこちらへ駐車するよう案内看板が出てましたが「車中泊禁止」の看板（添付画像）が掲示され車中泊禁止になったようです。（投稿：2022年7月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There used to be a sign directing people to park in the Norikura Kogen No. 1 parking lot at night, but now a "No Overnight Parking" sign (attached image) has been posted, and it seems that overnight parking is now prohibited. (Submitted by a reader in July 2022)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_en: Parking lot in front of the tourist information center
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：乗鞍高原 第1駐車場に、夜間はこちら（観光案内所前駐車場）へ駐車するよう案内看板が出てましたが、「車中泊禁止 近隣のオートキャンプ場をご利用下さい」の看板（添付画像）が掲示され車中泊禁止になったようです。（投稿：2022年7月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: At Norikura Kogen's No. 1 parking lot, there used to be a sign directing people to park here (in front of the tourist information center) at night, but now a sign (attached image) has been posted saying "No overnight parking. Please use nearby auto campgrounds," so it seems that overnight parking is now prohibited. (Submitted by a reader in July 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 小布施総合公園 駐車場
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：上信越自動車道の小布施ハイウェイオアシス(上り)に隣接しています。広い駐車場で車中泊のご同類もそこそこ多いですが、静かに休めました。トイレは大きな歩道橋を越えた向こう側ですが、歩道橋の近く（駐車場の北半分）に駐めれば遠くありません。歩道橋からは黒姫や妙高などの雄大な姿が望めます。EV Quickが駐車場の奥（南側）、ハイウェイオアシス側と共用する形で設置されています。（投稿：2024年11月、n様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：直近のJA直売所北隣のトイレは解体。道の駅のトイレを利用するよう案内板が出てます。（投稿：2024年9月、読者様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：南側半分に夜間閉鎖の看板出てますが、閉鎖されていないようです。夜中も様々な車(お察し下さい)の出入りが激しく、早朝も乗り合い、乗り捨ての方々等、車中泊には非快適かも。トイレ→詳細（投稿：2024年2月、読者様）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: It is adjacent to the Obuse Highway Oasis (northbound) on the Joshinetsu Expressway. There are quite a few other people staying overnight in their cars in the large parking lot, but I was able to rest quietly. The toilets are on the other side of a large pedestrian bridge, but they are not far if you park near the bridge (northern half of the parking lot). You can see the magnificent scenery of Kurohime and Myoko from the pedestrian bridge. An EV Quick is installed at the back of the parking lot (south side), shared with the highway oasis side. (Submitted: November 2024, by n)

■Report from a reader of this site: The toilets next to the JA direct sales store to the north have been demolished. There are signs directing people to use the toilets at the roadside station. (Submitted: September 2024, by a reader)

■Report from a reader of this site: There is a sign indicating that the southern half is closed at night, but it does not seem to be closed. There is a lot of traffic of various cars (you can imagine) coming and going even at night, and in the early morning there are people carpooling and dropping off their cars, so it may not be comfortable for overnight stays in a car. Toilet → Details (Posted by a reader in February 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 松原湖湖畔近くの広い町営駐車場
properties.title_en: A large town-operated parking lot near the shore of Lake Matsubara
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：松原湖湖畔近くの広い町営駐車場（無料）トイレ有り。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■標高1134m
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: A large, free, town-operated parking lot near the shore of Lake Matsubara with restrooms. (Older post from before 2019)
■Elevation: 1134m

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 小布施マレットゴルフ場の駐車場
properties.title_en: Parking lot at Obuse Mallet Golf Course
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：小布施ハイウェイオアシスに150泊程していましたがそこから1Km程北上したところにあります。トイレは男女それぞれ1で+共用の洋式があります、24ｈ利用可能。水飲み場も併設されており半年間で2～3度車中泊車を見かけました。（投稿：2025年3月、k様）
■無料駐車場とトイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないが、早朝から全力で監視される。地元民からしたら、なぜ道の駅で車中泊せずにここで？怪しい！という感じなのかな。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: I stayed at Obuse Highway Oasis for about 150 nights, and this place is about 1 km north of there. There is one toilet each for men and women, plus a shared Western-style toilet, and it is available 24 hours. There is also a drinking fountain, and I saw cars parked there overnight 2-3 times in the past six months. (Posted by: k, March 2025)

■Free parking and toilets. It is not closed at night, but it is heavily monitored from early morning. From the perspective of locals, they probably think, "Why park here instead of staying overnight at a roadside station? Suspicious!" (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Paid Campground
properties.title_ja: かじかの里公園（キャンプ場）
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：車中泊禁止の看板あり。キャンプ場料金1人500円。詳細（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: There is a sign prohibiting overnight parking. Campsite fee is 500 yen per person. Details (Submitted by: m, June 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 ふるさと豊田
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：車中泊マップ既に記載の長野県「道の駅ふるさと豊田」。国道沿いですが、割と静か。無料wifi「Nakano_city_free_wi-fi」設置。みやげ物売り場付近に親機があるようで、その近くなら駐車場の車内でも電波キャッチできます。1回のログインで1時間まで利用可能。タイムアウトしても再ログインで、3回/日までOK。詳細（投稿：2020年9月）
■当サイト読者様レポート：フリースポットあり、店舗営業時間外でも使えました(2010年5月時点)（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: "Michi-no-Eki Furusato Toyoda" in Nagano Prefecture, already listed on our car camping map. It's located along a national highway, but relatively quiet. Free Wi-Fi ("Nakano_city_free_wi-fi") is available. The base station seems to be near the souvenir shop, and you can pick up the signal even inside your car in the parking lot if you're nearby. One login allows for up to one hour of use. Even if you time out, you can log in again up to three times a day. Details (Posted: September 2020)

■ Reader Report: Free Wi-Fi available, usable even outside of store hours (as of May 2010) (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 FARMUS 木島平
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：車中泊マップ既に記載の長野県「道の駅 FARMUS 木島平」。あまり車の通らない国道沿いなのと、出来て間もないためか、広大な敷地内にトラックを含めほぼ車が止まっておらず静か。工場跡地を転用してるため、巨大なタンクがそのままだったり、駐車場の舗装もボコボコだったりしますが、一部は改修して、トイレも新しく建物内で冬も暖かくかなり綺麗です。無料wifiあり。建物の近くなら駐車場の車内でも電波キャッチできます。車で10分程の所に眺望の良さで有名な馬曲温泉(日帰り入浴可、詳細)あり。（投稿：2020年9月）
■H27.5オープン。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: Nagano Prefecture's "Michi-no-Eki FARMUS Kijimadaira," already listed on our car camping map. Because it's located along a national highway with little traffic and is relatively new, the vast grounds are almost completely empty of vehicles, including trucks, making it very quiet. Since it's a repurposed factory site, huge tanks remain, and the parking lot pavement is uneven, but some areas have been renovated, the toilets are new, and the building is warm and clean even in winter. Free Wi-Fi is available. You can even get a signal inside your car in the parking lot if you're near the building. About 10 minutes away by car is Magome Onsen (hot spring), famous for its great views (day-use bathing available, details). (Posted: September 2020)
■Opened May 2015.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：車中泊は可能ですが、トイレは男性用（小ｘ１）、身障者用（大ｘ１、洗面所）しかありませんので、ご注意下さい。また、福祉センターの駐車場を兼ねていますので、平日８時すぎになると、職員の方たちがおおぜい駐車しにきます。（投稿：2025年5月、h様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：無料駐車場とトイレ。標高630m（投稿：2024年10月、読者様）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Overnight parking is possible, but please note that there are only two toilets: one for men (urinal x 1) and one for people with disabilities (stall, washbasin). Also, since it is shared with the welfare center's parking lot, many staff members come to park there after 8:00 AM on weekdays. (Submitted by: h, May 2025)

■Report from a reader of this site: Free parking and toilets. Elevation 630m (Submitted by: reader, October 2024)

properties.label: Campground + Shower
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：車中泊が好きすぎてアプリと予約専用駐車場を作りました。もちろんコンセント付駐車場です。コンセント付駐車場ｘ3台分　トイレ（駐車場を予約した人に限り）・シャワールーム（駐車場を予約した人に限り）、料金詳細。（投稿：2022年7月、当スポット運営会社様よりご投稿いただきました）
properties.desc_en: ■Reader Report from Our Site: I love car camping so much that I created an app and a reservation-only parking lot. Of course, it's a parking lot with power outlets. 3 parking spaces with power outlets, toilet (for those who have reserved a parking space only), shower room (for those who have reserved a parking space only), detailed pricing. (Submitted in July 2022 by the company operating this spot)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 上山田温泉 湯元 かめ乃湯
properties.title_en: Kamiyamada Onsen Yumoto Kame no Yu
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：市外者400円、詳細（投稿：2024年10月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: 400 yen for non-residents, details (Submitted: October 2024, by a reader)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：細い山道を登った先にある無人駅。線路が駅舎から長いトンネルを下った先にあり。夜間も列車の通過音に悩まされず就寝できます。24時間利用可能なトイレあり、駅前は普通車で6台ほど駐車可能。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: An unmanned station located at the top of a narrow mountain road. The tracks descend from the station building through a long tunnel. You can sleep without being bothered by the sound of passing trains at night. There is a toilet that can be used 24 hours a day, and there is parking space for about 6 regular cars in front of the station. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：砂利の駐車場。国道と上信越道に挟まれているため、そこそこ音はします。（投稿：2024年2月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Reader Report: Gravel parking lot. It's sandwiched between a national highway and the Joshinetsu Expressway, so it's quite noisy. (Submitted by a reader in February 2024)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：黒崎PA(下り)2019年10月利用。大型車/小型車は広い通路で分けられているものの、大型車マスの数が多くてたくさんのトラックが駐まっているため（特に平日）、耳栓などの騒音対策が有効です。実は、メイン駐車場の先（GSの手前）に小型車専用の回廊式駐車場があって、20台近く駐められます。メイン駐車場から完全に分離しているため、車中泊にはここが最適です！（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Kurosaki PA (downbound), used in October 2019. Although large and small vehicles are separated by wide aisles, there are many spaces for large vehicles and many trucks are parked there (especially on weekdays), so noise reduction measures such as earplugs are effective. Actually, there is a corridor-style parking lot for small vehicles beyond the main parking lot (before the gas station) that can accommodate nearly 20 cars. Since it is completely separate from the main parking lot, this is the perfect place for overnight stays in your car! (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 雪のふるさと やすづか
properties.title_en: Roadside Station Yuki no Furusato Yasuzuka
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：国道沿いですが夜間の交通量わずかで非常に静か。寝やすい良い環境の道の駅。24時間利用可能なトイレあり（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Although it's located along a national highway, traffic is light at night and it's very quiet. A roadside station with a good environment for sleeping. There are toilets available 24 hours a day (older post from before 2019).

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 南長野運動公園第四駐車場
properties.title_en: Minami Nagano Sports Park Fourth Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：国道に近く、スケートボード場隣接のためややうるさい。東側の第三駐車場の方が静か。（投稿：2024年10月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: It's a bit noisy because it's close to the national highway and next to a skateboard park. The third parking lot on the east side is quieter. (Submitted by a reader in October 2024)

properties.label: Paid Campground
properties.title_ja: 北信濃ふるさとの森文化公園 オートキャンプ場
properties.title_en: Kitashinano Furusato no Mori Cultural Park Auto Campground
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：高規格オートキャンプ場。各サイトに水、電源付で1区画2500円。要予約。ネット予約可能。（詳細）（投稿：2023年9月、匿名希望様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A high-quality auto campsite. Each site has water and electricity, and costs 2500 yen per site. Reservations required. Online reservations are available. (Details) (Submitted: September 2023, anonymous)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 諸上寺公園 展望台
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：行き止まりの為、通過車両もなく非常に静か。水洗トイレあり。なお、途中の道はすれ違い不可。（投稿：2023年6月、l様）
■標高60m
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: It's a dead end, so there are no passing vehicles and it's very quiet. There is a flush toilet. However, it is impossible to pass other vehicles on the way. (Submitted by: l, June 2023)
■Elevation: 60m

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：広い駐車場白線は百数十台分引いてあり、公称３００。白線のない空地が相当ある。左右対称の建物左半分は麻痺。右半分にお土産屋、トイレ、遊覧船の切符販売。一角にラーメン屋、蕎麦屋、コンビニ。アバウトな人にピッタリ。いつか夏限定の車中泊の聖地になるかも？冬場は除雪は無理かも？wifiは結構遠くまで届いている。対岸の温泉も当日の朝、入れるか電話確認、時間も不定期。（投稿：2021年4月、渡り鳥漫遊記様）
■川の対岸にある咲花温泉は共同浴場は無く、旅館の日帰り入浴のみ。入浴前に要問い合わせ。咲花温泉について詳細
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: The large parking lot has white lines marking space for over 100 cars, officially rated at 300. There is a considerable amount of open space without white lines. The left half of the symmetrical building is paralyzed. The right half has a souvenir shop, toilets, and a ticket counter for the sightseeing boat. There is a ramen shop, a soba shop, and a convenience store in one corner. Perfect for easygoing people. Maybe it will become a summer-only sanctuary for car camping someday? Snow removal may be impossible in winter? The Wi-Fi reaches quite far. The hot spring on the opposite bank requires a phone call on the morning of the day to check if it is open, and the hours are irregular. (Submitted by: Migratory Bird Travelogue, April 2021)
■Sakihana Onsen, located on the opposite bank of the river, does not have a public bathhouse; only day-use bathing at the inn is available. Inquiries are required before bathing. More details about Sakihana Onsen

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：公衆トイレあり。湧き水をくむ事ができます。（投稿：2020年10月、A様）
■標高1331m
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: Public toilets available. You can collect spring water. (Submitted by: Ms. A, October 2020)
■Elevation: 1331m

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：公園の駐車場。近くにトイレあり。手前の区画は24時間利用可能。奥の区画は8:30〜16:00のみ。朝8時頃に駐車車両のナンバーチェックあり。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Park parking lot. There are toilets nearby. The front section is available 24 hours. The back section is only available from 8:30 to 16:00. There is a license plate check of parked vehicles around 8:00 AM. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 北信濃ふるさとの森文化公園
properties.title_en: Kitashinano Furusato no Mori Cultural Park
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：近くの農園の害獣除けの空砲が一日中（夜中も）数分おきに爆音で響き安眠は難しいかも。同敷地内のオートキャンプ場も、同様の苦情クチコミが散見される。（投稿：2023年9月、匿名希望様）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。車中泊可能との報告あり。テントを張る場合は有料。駐車場車中泊の場合は無料で、炊事場の利用は無料！これは凄い。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Blank shots used to deter pests from a nearby farm blast loudly every few minutes throughout the day (even at night), making it difficult to get a good night's sleep. Similar complaints have been seen in reviews regarding the auto campsite on the same premises. (Submitted: September 2023, anonymous)
■Free parking and public toilets. Reports indicate that overnight stays in vehicles are permitted. There is a fee for pitching tents. Parking is free for overnight stays in vehicles, and the use of the cooking area is also free! This is amazing. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 南長野運動公園第三駐車場
properties.title_en: Minami Nagano Sports Park Third Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：既出の東側の第二駐車場より利用者が少なく、静かでおすすめ。かなり長細い駐車場のため煩い車から遠ざかる事も可能。地元サッカーチーム試合日前後に、夜間閉鎖される事があるので注意。（投稿：2024年10月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: This parking lot is less crowded and quieter than the previously mentioned second parking lot on the east side, making it highly recommended. Because it's quite long and narrow, it's possible to stay away from noisy vehicles. Note that it may be closed at night before and after local soccer team matches. (Submitted by a reader in October 2024)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: 一茶ゆかりの里駐車場
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：観光で訪れましたが、駐車場付近にトイレはありませんでした。また、「防犯対策上、入館者以外駐車お断り」「ここは、一茶館の入館者のための駐車場です。毎日１７時（休館日は終日）閉鎖します」と掲示されており、ロープも設置されていました。ただ、翌朝７時頃に前を通過した際には閉鎖されていませんでした。（投稿：2025年5月、h様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：休日に訪れたことはありませんが、来訪者は多い方ではない静かな所です。トイレ併設の無料の駐車場があり高地にあるので夏場は避暑にも向いています（標高523m）。施設開館中の長時間駐車はモラルの範疇と考えています。（投稿：2025年3月、k様）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: I visited as a tourist, but there were no restrooms near the parking lot. Also, there were signs saying, "For security reasons, parking is prohibited for anyone other than visitors," and "This is a parking lot for visitors of Issakan. It will be closed at 5 PM daily (all day on closed days)," and ropes were also set up. However, when I passed by around 7 AM the next morning, it was not closed. (Submitted by: h, May 2025)

■Report from a reader of this site: I have never visited on a holiday, but it is a quiet place with not many visitors. There is a free parking lot with restrooms, and since it is located at a high altitude, it is suitable for escaping the summer heat (elevation 523m). I believe that long-term parking while the facility is open is within the realm of morality. (Submitted by: k, March 2025)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 やまのうち
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：幹線道路に面してるのでうるさいです。特に道路に段差があるためか、車のタイヤがごとごとと音を立てかなりうるさいです。しかしコンビニも敷地横にあるため便利です。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: It's noisy because it faces a main road. In particular, there's a bump in the road, so the car tires make a loud rattling noise. However, there's a convenience store next to the property, which is convenient. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 越後出雲崎 天領の里
properties.title_en: Roadside Station Echigo Izumozaki Tenryo no Sato
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：幹線道路と言っても、大型はおろか乗用車もたいして通らず、静かなもんです。北國街道　芭蕉、良寛、石油、金山他盛り沢山。波の音こそうるさいかも？（投稿：2021年4月、渡り鳥漫遊記様）
■駐車場が全面的に幹線道沿いでうるさい。静かな場所がない。ここはやめたほうがいい。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Even though it's a main road, not many large vehicles or even passenger cars pass by, so it's quiet. Hokkoku Kaido Road: Basho, Ryokan, oil, gold mines, and much more. The sound of the waves might be the loudest thing? (Submitted by: Migratory Bird Travelogue, April 2021)
■The parking lot is entirely along the main road and it's noisy. There's no quiet place. You should avoid this place. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：幹線国道であるR49のSA/PA的な道の駅。構造的に分離されているせいか、R49の車の走行音はそれほど気にならない。駐車場は普通車150台級の規模で、大型車ゾーンとの住み分けも良好。奥の方に駐車すれば、トラックのアイドリングに悩まされる事はない。トイレは水洗洋式ウオシュレット付きでめちゃくちゃ綺麗。道の駅のトイレとしては最上級レベル。平日の夜に利用したが、同好の車も多数いた。（投稿：2024年10月、y様）
■2022年8月5日オープン。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: A roadside station similar to a service area/parking area on National Route 49, a major national highway. Perhaps due to its structural separation, the noise from cars on Route 49 is not too bothersome. The parking lot is large enough for about 150 regular cars, and the separation from the large vehicle zone is good. If you park in the back, you won't be bothered by the idling of trucks. The toilets are flush toilets with bidet functions and are extremely clean. They are top-notch for a roadside station toilet. I used it on a weekday evening, and there were many other cars with similar interests. (Submitted by: y, October 2024)
■Opened August 5, 2022.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: ダック・菅池 公衆トイレ
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：夏、先日トイレ夜間も空いてました。男性個室はウォッシュ。駐車スペースもバスの転回を邪魔しないよう注意しましょう（コーンが立ってますので、その指示に従う）。（投稿：2024年8月、h様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: In the summer, the toilets were open even at night the other day. The men's stalls have washlets. Be careful not to obstruct buses turning around in the parking spaces (there are cones, so follow their instructions). (Submitted by: h, August 2024)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：下り側について。広い駐車場の割に利用者が少なくて、他車と十分スペースを空けて車中泊できました。全体に軽い傾斜があるので（特に奥のほう）、クルマを駐める向きに注意です。SAの建屋の手前に展望公園があって、善光寺平の美しい風景を楽しめます。EV Quickがトイレの奥にあります。（投稿：2024年11月、n様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：姨捨SA 下り。建物の前はフラット。トイレより奥は傾斜あり。トラック少ない(5月の金曜日)。夜は夜景がキレイで静かだったけど、朝はトイレヘの立ち寄りが多くてザワザワし始めると起きてしまった。（投稿：2024年7月、たもたえ様）
properties.desc_en:
■Reader Report from this Site: Regarding the Downbound Side. Despite the large parking lot, there were few users, and I was able to park my car overnight with plenty of space between it and other vehicles. There is a slight slope throughout (especially towards the back), so be careful about the direction in which you park your car. There is an observation park in front of the SA building where you can enjoy the beautiful scenery of the Zenkoji Plain. EV Quick is located behind the toilets. (Submitted by: n, November 2024)

■Reader Report from this Site: Obasute SA Downbound. The area in front of the building is flat. There is a slope beyond the toilets. There were few trucks (Friday in May). At night the night view was beautiful and it was quiet, but in the morning there were many people stopping to use the toilets and it started to get noisy, which woke me up. (Submitted by: tamotae, July 2024)

properties.label: Camp Spot + Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：温泉施設公認の駐車場で車中泊可。https://agri-yu.com/qa/「Q. 駐車場で車中泊はできますか　A.可能です。お風呂や食事は是非ご利用ください。事前連絡をいただければ24時間対応可能なトイレがあります。」（投稿：2025年12月、a様）
■入浴♨️：あぐりの湯こもろ、700円、詳細
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: Overnight parking is permitted in the parking lot officially approved by the hot spring facility. https://agri-yu.com/qa/ "Q. Can I stay overnight in my car in the parking lot? A. Yes, you can. Please feel free to use the baths and meals. There is a toilet that is available 24 hours a day if you contact us in advance." (Posted: December 2025, by user A)
■Bathing♨️: Agri-no-Yu Komoro, 700 yen, details

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：横尾に続きここも「車中泊禁止」の看板が設置されました。多分、夏季のみで冬季は有料で車中泊OKかも…。添付画像（投稿：2022年8月、読者様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：野沢温泉の３つのスポットはすべて車中泊禁止になっています。なお、その他の駐車場も車中泊禁止、または夏期閉鎖です。（野沢温泉観光協会ＨＰの情報👉️詳細）したがって、野沢温泉でＰ泊可能な場所はありません。（投稿：2022年8月、tossan様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：スキー期は日帰り無料、車中泊＝1500円です。オフシーズンは無料。近くに無料の公衆温泉浴場多数あり。詳細
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: Following Yokoo, a "No Overnight Parking" sign has also been erected here. Perhaps it's only during the summer, and overnight parking is allowed in winter for a fee… (See attached image; posted August 2022, by a reader)

■ Reader Report: All three spots in Nozawa Onsen prohibit overnight parking. Other parking lots also prohibit overnight parking or are closed during the summer. (Information from the Nozawa Onsen Tourism Association website 👉️ Details) Therefore, there are no places in Nozawa Onsen where overnight parking is permitted. (Posted August 2022, by tossan)

■ Reader Report: During the ski season, day trips are free, and overnight parking costs 1500 yen. It's free during the off-season. There are many free public hot spring baths nearby. Details

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：以前旅館だった施設が日帰り専用で営業中。600円、詳細。（投稿：2023年9月、匿名希望様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A former inn is now operating as a day-trip-only facility. 600 yen, details. (Submitted: September 2023, anonymous)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: 松本市 美ヶ原温泉駐車場 白糸の湯駐車場
properties.title_en: Matsumoto City Utsukushigahara Onsen Parking Lot Shiraito no Yu Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：マップを頻繁に利用しています。 2017-06-11 17時半ごろ白糸の湯の駐車場にいきました。駐車場は、白糸の湯を利用する人は無料、と書いてありました。それ以外は200円と書いてありましたが、17時を過ぎていたせいか、受付は無人でした。公衆トイレは17時以降、翌朝9時まで施錠されるとなっており、その通りになっていました。男子小用のみ、終夜利用可能でした。 夫婦での旅行でしたので、利用しませんでした。 現在の記述は間違いでは無いと思いますが、トイレが終日利用可能と誤解してしまいました。変更した方がいいように思います。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: I frequently use the map. I went to the Shiraito no Yu parking lot around 5:30 PM on June 11, 2017. It said that parking was free for those using Shiraito no Yu. It also said that it cost 200 yen for others, but perhaps because it was past 5 PM, the reception was unmanned. The public toilets were locked from 5 PM until 9 AM the next morning, and that was indeed the case. Only the men's urinal was available all night. Since I was traveling with my spouse, we did not use it. I don't think the current description is wrong, but I misunderstood that the toilets were available all day. I think it should be changed.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：フェリーターミナルの隣にある埠頭公園で、駐車スペースはかなり広い。トイレは水洗洋式のウオシュレット付きで綺麗に清掃されている。街中にあるが、夜は行き交う車も少なく閑静な一夜を過ごせる。小木港近くの居酒屋で一杯やるのも可能。（投稿：2023年10月、y様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレあり。自販機あり。地元の若者が夜までたむろしていてうるさいことがある。無料。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Reader Report: The pier park next to the ferry terminal has a fairly large parking area. The toilets are flush toilets with bidet functions and are kept clean. Although it's in the city center, there are few cars passing by at night, making it a quiet place to spend the night. It's also possible to have a drink at an izakaya near Ogi Port. (Submitted by: y, October 2023)

■Reader Report: Toilets available. Vending machines available. Local young people hang out there until late at night, which can be noisy. Free of charge. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：ビーナスライン沿いにある運動公園の駐車場です。蓼科や北八ヶ岳方面へのアクセスが良く、道の駅がないこの周辺では貴重な車中泊スポットです。駐車場とトイレは24時間使用可、ただしトイレの照明がないので懐中電灯は必携。ビーナスラインは夜間でも結構交通量があり、坂の途中なのでエンジン音が大きめです。車で10分以内に日帰り温泉3ヶ所とコンビニがあり、非常に便利な立地なのでおすすめ。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■標高978m
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: This is the parking lot of a sports park along the Venus Line. It has good access to Tateshina and the northern Yatsugatake area, and is a valuable overnight parking spot in this area where there are no roadside rest areas. The parking lot and toilets are available 24 hours a day, however, there is no lighting in the toilets so a flashlight is essential. The Venus Line has a fair amount of traffic even at night, and the engine noise is loud because it is on a slope. There are three day-trip hot springs and a convenience store within a 10-minute drive, making it a very convenient location and highly recommended. (Older post from before 2019)
■Elevation 978m

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: （<font color="red">トイレ無し</font>）湯川ふるさと公園第四駐車場
properties.title_en: （<font color="red">トイレ無し</font>）湯RiverふるさとPark第四Parking
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：となりの軽井沢 湯川ふるさと公園 北側駐車場は大人気です。トイレなし、民家近い。新幹線下で前後の通りは通行量多め。個人的にはとなりの駐車場より開放感があって好きでした。（投稿：2024年8月、j様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: The north parking lot at Yukawa Furusato Park, next to Karuizawa, is very popular. There are no restrooms, and it's close to private houses. It's under the Shinkansen tracks, and the surrounding streets have heavy traffic. Personally, I liked it better than the parking lot next door because it felt more open. (Submitted by j, August 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレや自動販売機完備です。長野オリンピックの開会式場だった所です。国道から少し離れているため静かです。お風呂は近場に日帰り施設があるのでそちらを利用するといいでしょう。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: It has toilets and vending machines. It was the venue for the opening ceremony of the Nagano Olympics. It's quiet because it's a little away from the national highway. For bathing, there are day-use facilities nearby, so you should use those. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 小布施総合公園東側駐車場
properties.title_en: Obuse General Park East Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレは公園内にあり。犬散歩の方の利用が多い。入口に防犯カメラ設置。（投稿：2024年2月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: There are toilets inside the park. They are frequently used by people walking their dogs. There is a security camera at the entrance. (Submitted by a reader in February 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 いりひろせ
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレウォッシュレットでない。洋式１和式１。男性用トイレから女性が出てきた。女性用も少ないのでは？wifiも届きが悪い（投稿：2021年5月、渡り鳥漫遊記様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: The toilets do not have bidet functions. There is one Western-style toilet and one Japanese-style toilet. A woman came out of the men's toilet. There seem to be few women's toilets as well. The Wi-Fi signal is also poor. (Submitted by: Migratory Bird Travelogue, May 2021)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 信越さかえ
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレウォッシュレット３。坂の途中にあるため傾斜あり。交通量も多い。道の反対側が崖のため音の反射もある。久しぶりにうるさい。近くにコンビニがないためトイレ休憩が多い。（投稿：2021年5月、渡り鳥漫遊記様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Toilet with bidet 3. It's on a slope because it's located on the side of a hill. There's a lot of traffic. There's also sound reflection because there's a cliff on the other side of the road. It's been a while since I've heard such noise. There are no convenience stores nearby, so I have to stop for toilet breaks often. (Submitted by: Migratory Bird Travelogue, May 2021)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレあり。夏は水シャワーが無料で使える。海の目の前なので景観が良い。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: There are toilets. Cold showers are available for free in the summer. The view is great as it's right in front of the sea. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 松ヶ崎ヒストリーパーク
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレあり。夏は水シャワーが無料で使える。キャンパーも多いが、うるさくはない。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There is a toilet. Cold showers are available for free in the summer. There are many campers, but it's not noisy. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：つくばいの水（参照詳細） 安曇野市にある菓子店「開運堂あづみの菓遊庭」詳細）の敷地内にある。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website readers: Tsukubai water (see details) Located on the grounds of the confectionery shop "Kaiundo Azumino Kayutei" in Azumino City.

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：サービスエリアとは名ばかりでトイレと自販機しか無い。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: It's a service area in name only; all it has are toilets and vending machines. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：こじんまりしている。トイレ洋式２、ウォッシュレットでない。wifiなし。水道あり。蛙の鳴き声を騒音ととれば相当数の蛙が大合唱。国道、線路隣接。ちょっと離れた所を高速トンネルが近いのか音が届く。傾斜なし。（投稿：2021年5月、渡り鳥漫遊記様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: It's small and cozy. There are two Western-style toilets, but they don't have bidets. No Wi-Fi. There is running water. If you consider the sound of frogs croaking as noise, there is a considerable chorus of frogs. It is adjacent to a national highway and railway tracks. You can hear the sound from a nearby highway tunnel a little further away. There is no slope. (Submitted by: Migratory Bird Travelogue, May 2021)

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.title_ja: CamPark（キャンパーク）STAYPORT 車中泊場
properties.title_en: CampPark STAYPORT (Overnight parking area for vehicles)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：くるま旅パークなので有料（詳細）ですが、電源付き駐車場です。1200Wまで使用可能。無人のため気兼ねなく車中泊ができます。住宅街なのでとっても静かです。ただ、キャンプ場ではないため、外での調理や、アイドリングしての駐車は近所迷惑になり禁止されています。トイレも24時間使用可能、水汲み、排水も使えて、無料でフリーWi－Fiも使えて充実しています。上限ありで30分単位での金額なので、少ない時間での利用はお得になります。静かに泊まりたい人向けの車中泊場です。大型サイト 税込み165円/30分 1番、2番サイト。小型サイト税込み132円/30分　3番サイト。アプリを使って予約と決済をします。現地についてからアプリを使って電源のスイッチを入れます。Bluetoothを使って電源装置と通信します。ホームページとアプリダウンロード、【くるま旅パーク】CamPark（キャンパーク）STAYPORT 車中泊場（投稿：2023年4月、s様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: This is a car travel park, so there is a fee (details), but it is a parking lot with electricity. Up to 1200W can be used. It is unmanned, so you can stay overnight in your car without worrying about disturbing others. It is in a residential area, so it is very quiet. However, since it is not a campsite, cooking outside and parking with the engine idling are prohibited as they would disturb the neighbors. The toilets are available 24 hours a day, water can be drawn and drained, and there is free Wi-Fi, so it is well-equipped. There is a cap and the price is in 30-minute increments, so it is economical to use for short periods of time. This is a car camping spot for people who want to stay overnight in peace. Large sites: 165 yen (tax included)/30 minutes, sites 1 and 2. Small sites: 132 yen (tax included)/30 minutes, site 3. Reservations and payments are made using the app. Once you arrive at the site, you turn on the power switch using the app. It communicates with the power supply using Bluetooth. Homepage and app download, [Car Travel Park] CamPark STAYPORT overnight parking area (Posted: April 2023, by user s)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 オアシスおぶせ
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：お食事処 (道の駅 オアシスおぶせ)の駐車場（詳細場所）について。一般的に小布施の道の駅と言うと県道343号線と高速道路の間のを利用される方が多いのですが、高速出口を北に進んだ所（詳細場所）から入場すると大型トラックが侵入してこない駐車スペースがあります。更に高床式のレストラン/売店下の駐車スペースは雨天時には快適に過ごせます。レストランも平日は18:00、土日祝日は20:00には閉店するのでトイレ（24ｈ可）にも近いので夜間の利用にはお勧めです。（無料）（投稿：2025年3月、k様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：ゴミ箱は2階トイレ前にありますが、飲食店の閉店時間は店の中へ格納され使用不可。休日前夜は、車中泊車でほぼ満車になり、多数ある隣接駐車場の方が快適。（投稿：2024年9月、読者様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：第二駐車場は右折車線なし。駐車場入口段差あり。駐車場路面はがたがた。白線はほとんど消えかかっている。トイレは二階で足の具合が悪い人は大変。ごみ箱なし。注意：PAとの境の歩道ちょっと高い。先人の爪痕無数。これだけ管理が悪いと車中泊しやすい。トイレはウォッシュレット３。緑に囲まれそんなにうるさくない。（投稿：2021年5月、渡り鳥漫遊記様）
■駐車場は広くていいんだけど、トイレがやや遠いのが難点。あと変な街宣車が何台も放置されている。wimaxも建物が邪魔をしているのか使えない。車中泊車両多数。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：道の駅オアシスおぶせですが、K343の西側の大きな駐車場は車も多くトイレも遠いですが、東側のレストランなどがある建屋直下の駐車場は雨の時に便利な、軒下のPがありますし、 大型車も入ってこないので、結構いいです。ただし背の高いキャンカーは、軒下には入れません。トイレは２Fに上がりますが、売店入口のトイレが24h使えます。（情報提供感謝します。）（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: Regarding the parking lot (detailed location) at the restaurant (Roadside Station Oasis Obuse). Generally, when people think of the roadside station in Obuse, they often use the parking area between Prefectural Road 343 and the expressway. However, if you enter from the area north of the expressway exit (detailed location), there is a parking space where large trucks cannot enter. Furthermore, the parking space under the elevated restaurant/shop is comfortable even in rainy weather. The restaurant closes at 6:00 PM on weekdays and 8:00 PM on weekends and holidays, and it's close to the toilets (24-hour access), making it recommended for nighttime use. (Free) (Submitted: March 2025, by K)

■ Reader Report: There are trash cans in front of the toilets on the second floor, but they are stored inside the restaurant and unusable when the restaurant closes. On the eve of holidays, the parking lot is almost full with cars parked overnight, making the numerous adjacent parking lots more comfortable. (Submitted: September 2024, by a reader)

■ Reader Report: The second parking lot does not have a right-turn lane. There's a step at the parking lot entrance. The parking lot surface is bumpy. The white lines are almost completely faded. The toilets are on the second floor, which is difficult for people with mobility issues. There are no trash cans. Note: The sidewalk bordering the PA is a little high. There are countless traces of previous visitors. With such poor maintenance, it's easy to stay overnight in your car. The toilets have three washlets. Surrounded by greenery, it's not too noisy. (Posted by: Migratory Bird Travelogue, May 2021)
■The parking lot is spacious and nice, but the toilets are a bit far away, which is a drawback. Also, there are several strange propaganda vans abandoned there. WiMAX is unusable, possibly due to the building blocking it. Many vehicles are parked overnight. (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from a reader of this site: At Michi-no-Eki Oasis Obuse, the large parking lot on the west side of K343 has many cars and the toilets are far away, but the parking lot directly below the building with the restaurant on the east side has a covered parking area which is convenient when it rains, and large vehicles don't come in, so it's quite good. However, tall campervans cannot fit under the eaves. Toilets are located on the second floor, but the toilets at the shop entrance are available 24 hours a day. (Thanks for the information.) (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：800円、詳細。 日帰り温泉です。泉質は、乳白色で温泉らしい匂いのする湯です。斜め向の観光センターで車中泊出来るので徒歩でも行けます。食事も出来るのですが、ピザとパスタだけのようです。入浴と食事のセットも有ります。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: 800 yen, details. This is a day-trip hot spring. The water is milky white and has a typical hot spring smell. You can park your car overnight at the tourist center diagonally across the street, so you can also go on foot. They also serve food, but it seems they only have pizza and pasta. There is also a set that includes bathing and a meal.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 高遠・弁財天河原駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2023年3月末の平日に利用。高遠城址公園で開かれるさくら祭りの期間中に臨時駐車場（無料）になるようです。24時間無料開放、イベント会場でよく見るBOXトイレが4つと、簡易水道が1個だけ。洗面設備はありません。まあ、車中泊できないことはないというところですが、安全面が心許なければ、5㎞ほど南の美和湖畔にある道の駅 南アルプスむら長谷に前泊して、朝早くにこの駐車場に移動してからさくら祭りに行くのが賢明かもです。（投稿：2023年4月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Used on a weekday at the end of March 2023. It seems to become a temporary (free) parking lot during the cherry blossom festival held at Takato Castle Ruins Park. It is open 24 hours a day and free of charge, with only four box toilets (the kind you often see at event venues) and one simple water tap. There are no washbasin facilities. Well, it's not impossible to stay overnight in your car, but if you are worried about safety, it might be wise to stay overnight at the roadside station Minami Alps Mura Hase, located about 5 km south on the shores of Lake Miwa, and then move to this parking lot early in the morning before going to the cherry blossom festival. (Submitted by: n, April 2023)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 南アルプスむら長谷
properties.title_en: Roadside Station Minami Alps Mura Hase
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2023年3月末の平日に利用。「日本三大桜の名所」のひとつ、高遠城址公園のさくら祭りのために前泊しました。公園まで5㎞ほどです。この時期はご同類のクルマも多いだろうと思いきや、意外にもこの日は数台だけでした。食事や買い物などの施設が揃い、新しくて広いトイレはお湯も出て、交通量は少なくて静か。快適な一夜でした。城址公園のさくら祭りは満開前後は朝6時開園になるため、ここを早朝に出て城址公園の麓、高遠大橋の袂にある弁財天河原の無料駐車場に移動。そこから会場までは徒歩15分ほどで、途中の川筋にも見事な桜が並びます。（投稿：2023年4月、n様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2019年6月3日(月)道の駅「南アルプスむら長谷」パン屋ががすごい。予約注文の数が半端でないし、訳あり商品を無料で試食させたり、一度寄ってみる価値があります。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■標高830m
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: Used on a weekday at the end of March 2023. I stayed overnight for the cherry blossom festival at Takato Castle Ruins Park, one of Japan's three most famous cherry blossom viewing spots. It's about 5km to the park. I expected there to be many cars like mine at this time of year, but surprisingly there were only a few that day. There are facilities for eating and shopping, the new and spacious toilets have hot water, and the traffic is light and quiet. It was a comfortable night. The cherry blossom festival at the castle ruins park opens at 6am around the time the blossoms are in full bloom, so I left early in the morning and went to the free parking lot at Benzaitengawara, at the foot of the castle ruins park, near the Takato Ohashi Bridge. From there it's about a 15-minute walk to the venue, and there are magnificent cherry blossoms lining the river along the way. (Submitted by: n, April 2023)

■Report from our website reader: June 3, 2019 (Monday) The bakery at the roadside station "Minami Alps Mura Hase" is amazing. The number of pre-orders is incredible, and they offer free samples of their discounted products, so it's definitely worth a visit. (Older post from before 2019)
■ Elevation 830m

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 花の駅千曲川
properties.title_en: Roadside Station Hana no Eki Chikuma River
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2023年1月に利用。幹線道路沿いであるが、夜は交通量が少なく静か。隣にはスーパー（20時まで営業）があり買い物にも困らない。冬季の夜間は駐車場に凍結防止の散水がされるので、トイレ等の際は靴に注意。駐車場奥側（スーパー側）は下水のような匂いが漂っており気になった。駐車場道路側だと匂いはなかった。（投稿：2023年2月、f様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Used in January 2023. Although it is located along a main road, traffic is light and it is quiet at night. There is a supermarket next door (open until 8pm), so shopping is convenient. Water is sprayed on the parking lot at night during the winter to prevent freezing, so be careful of your shoes when using the restroom, etc. There was a sewage-like smell in the back of the parking lot (the supermarket side), which was bothersome. There was no smell on the road side of the parking lot. (Submitted by: f, February 2023)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2022年オープン。電源付で3300円～（オフシーズン2200円～）、詳細（投稿：2022年7月、読者様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Opened in 2022. Includes power outlets, starting from 3300 yen (2200 yen during the off-season). Details (Posted by a reader in July 2022).

properties.title_ja: 篠ノ井中央公園駐車場
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2019年5月利用。公園内に3か所ある駐車場のうち、南東のスペースで泊まりました。国道18号バイパスの脇ですが、100mぐらい離れているので十分静かでした。駐車場の奥数十mにキレイなトイレがありますが、夜間は照明が点きません。でも、スグ外にある終夜照明灯の光が中にも入るので、大きな支障はなかったです。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。車中泊可能との報告あり。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Used in May 2019. I stayed in the southeastern of the three parking lots in the park. It's next to National Route 18 bypass, but it's about 100 meters away, so it was quiet enough. There's a clean toilet a few dozen meters behind the parking lot, but the lights don't come on at night. However, the light from the 24-hour streetlights just outside reaches inside, so it wasn't a major problem. (Older post from before 2019)

■Free parking and public toilets. Reports indicate that overnight parking is possible. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot

■当サイト読者様レポート：実質道の駅。公衆トイレ2箇所有り。夜間交通量皆無。（2019年以前の古い投稿）

■Report from a reader of this site: On May 17, 2019, I stopped by Kinasato Roadside Station and saw a sign in front of the direct sales store that read, "Please refrain from overnight stays in campervans or other vehicles, and from making noise." (Older post from before 2019)

■Report from a reader of this site: Essentially a roadside station. There are two public toilets. There is virtually no traffic at night. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：１１月９日　新潟県　栃尾道の駅（道の駅 R290とちお）に泊まりました。近くに　温泉があります。あまり大きくはありませんが、なんと　高齢者６５歳以上は　２５０円です。（投稿：2022年11月、t様）
■名物の油揚げが美味い。駐車場はかなり広く、トイレは遠くなるが奥の川沿いの駐車場（詳細）が非常に静かで良い。（2022年6月管理人現地確認）
■当サイト読者様レポート：R290に隣接しているが、駐車場に奥行きがあり、奥の方なら騒音はそれほど気にならない。名物の栃尾油揚げは、定食（焼）がオススメ。（投稿：2021年11月、y様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレはウォッシュ２、和式３。国道から離れているが、案内標識が少なく小さい。見過ごすおそれ大。秋葉の火祭りの町。２９０号は冬季通行止め。（投稿：2021年5月、渡り鳥漫遊記様）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: On November 9th, I stayed at the Tochio Roadside Station (Roadside Station R290 Tochio) in Niigata Prefecture. There is a hot spring nearby. It's not very big, but surprisingly, it's only 250 yen for seniors 65 and over. (Submitted: November 2022, by t)
■The local specialty, fried tofu, is delicious. The parking lot is quite large, and although the toilets are far away, the parking lot along the river at the back (details) is very quiet and nice. (Administrator's on-site verification, June 2022)
■Report from our website reader: Although it is adjacent to R290, the parking lot has depth, and the noise is not so noticeable in the back. For the local specialty, Tochio fried tofu, the grilled set meal is recommended. (Submitted: November 2021, by y)
■Report from our website reader: The toilets have 2 washlet toilets and 3 Japanese style toilets. It is away from the national highway, but there are few small signs. There is a high risk of missing it. It is the town of the Akiba Fire Festival. Route 290 is closed in winter. (Posted by: Migratory Bird Travelogue, May 2021)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：１０月３０日宿泊。道の駅あらいに比べれば、規模が小さいですが全体的にとっても静かで薄暗いので安眠できるかも？ただし、食事の施設が近辺に無いので道の駅あらいに比べれば満足感は少ないかな？当日はコンビニ弁当での食事としました。（投稿：2025年11月、山びこ様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：夜間利用者が極端に少なくひっそり静か。ただ一晩中アイドリングの大型トラックはいるので、奥の野菜直売所側が建物陰で遮音、駐車車両もほぼ無く静か。トイレが新しく奇麗。標高700mで涼しい。（投稿：2024年8月、読者様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：土曜の夜でしたがかなりの台数の車中泊の方々がおりましたが、全車両の方々のマナーが良かったです。とても静かで良い場所ですね。朝になると道の駅の農産物直売所にたくさんの人が来て新鮮な野菜を購入されていました。（投稿：2022年6月、m様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2019年5月利用。広大で静かな駐車場、トイレも快適です。EV用の急速充電器あり。眼前に望む妙高山と黒姫山が見事です。車中泊後、朝イチに野尻湖周辺、その後戸隠神社、長野市内と回りました。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：長野県 道の駅 しなの の情報です。駐車場は広いし静かです。売店は19時まで営業ですが、食堂は17時までのようです。車載ＴＶは全局視聴可能。フリーWIFI有り。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Stayed on October 30th. Compared to Michi-no-Eki Arai, it's smaller in scale, but it's very quiet and dimly lit overall, so you might be able to sleep well? However, there are no dining facilities nearby, so it might be less satisfying than Michi-no-Eki Arai? I ate a convenience store bento box that day. (Submitted by: Yamabiko, November 2025)

■Report from a reader of this site: Extremely few nighttime users, making it very quiet. However, there are large trucks idling all night, so the vegetable direct sales area at the back is in the shade of the building and provides sound insulation, and there are almost no parked vehicles, making it quiet. The toilets are new and clean. It's cool at an altitude of 700m. (Submitted by: Reader, August 2024)

■Report from a reader of this site: It was Saturday night, but there were quite a few people staying overnight in their cars, and everyone's manners were good. It's a very quiet and nice place. In the morning, many people came to the agricultural product direct sales area of ​​the roadside station to buy fresh vegetables. (Posted: June 2022, by M)
■ Reader Report: Used in May 2019. Spacious and quiet parking lot, comfortable restrooms. Fast charger for EVs available. The view of Mt. Myoko and Mt. Kurohime is magnificent. After spending the night in the car, I visited the area around Lake Nojiri first thing in the morning, then Togakushi Shrine and Nagano City. (Older post from before 2019)
■ Reader Report: Information on Michi-no-Eki Shinano in Nagano Prefecture. The parking lot is spacious and quiet. The shop is open until 7 PM, but the restaurant seems to close at 5 PM. All channels are viewable on the car TV. Free Wi-Fi available. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：１０月２９日宿泊。広大な駐車場を備える道の駅で若干傾斜はありますがほとんど気にする必要が無いレベルです。敷地内には飲食店が多数有り（回転寿司、有名食堂、ラーメン店、コンビニ等々。おまけにモンベルショップも）、食事には困りません。入浴施設も車で１０分程度のところに「釜ぶたの湯」（ヌルヌルとした泉質、詳細）があり４８０円で入浴できます。（投稿：2025年11月、山びこ様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：元々、巨大道の駅でしたが、国道東側にも施設が新設され「超巨大道の駅」へ進化。東側駐車場の方がトイレも新しく駐車台数が少なく静か。（投稿：2024年8月、読者様）
■ハイウェイオアシスと併設。コンビニあり。お風呂は無し！惜しい！（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: Stayed on October 29th. This roadside station boasts a vast parking lot with a slight slope, but it's hardly noticeable. There are numerous restaurants on the premises (conveyor belt sushi, famous restaurants, ramen shops, convenience stores, etc. Plus, a Montbell shop!), so finding food is no problem. There's also a bathing facility, "Kamabuta no Yu" (with its slippery water quality, details) about a 10-minute drive away, where you can bathe for 480 yen. (Posted: November 2025, Yamabiko)

■ Reader Report: Originally a huge roadside station, it has evolved into a "super-huge roadside station" with the addition of new facilities on the east side of the national highway. The east side parking lot has newer toilets, fewer cars, and is quieter. (Posted: August 2024, Reader)

■ Located next to a highway oasis. Convenience store available. No baths! What a shame! (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■重要文化財だが、日帰り入浴が可能。850円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：国指定の重要文化財になっている昭和初期建築の洋館。風呂は「千人風呂」という名前（実際は最大100人程度か）の大理石の大きな浴槽ひとつだけですが、彫刻やステンドグラスもあって雰囲気満点です。「テルマエロマエII」のロケ地にもなったそうです。浴槽は深さが110cmあり、底面には敷石が敷いてあるだけなので立って歩くと川の中のようです。お湯の中で足ツボマッサージができます。入館は20:30まで、閉館は21時。料金は終日750円に変わっています。
properties.desc_en:
■Although it is a nationally designated Important Cultural Property, day-use bathing is possible. 850 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: A Western-style building constructed in the early Showa period that is a nationally designated Important Cultural Property. There is only one large marble bathtub called "Senjin-buro" (Thousand-Person Bath) (actually probably only fits about 100 people), but it has sculptures and stained glass and is full of atmosphere. It was also a filming location for "Thermae Romae II". The bathtub is 110cm deep, and the bottom is only covered with paving stones, so walking around standing up feels like being in a river. You can get a foot reflexology massage in the hot water. Last entry is at 8:30 PM, closing at 9:00 PM. The price has changed to 750 yen for the whole day.
