properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■温泉マニア大絶賛。700円、詳細
■管理人評価★4.7（泉質4.5満点、景色0.2）まず泉質は、濃いモスグリーンの濁り湯で、泉質、析出物、ともに島根の温泉津温泉とそっくり。泉質はとりあえず何も言うことなし満点。景色は露天がないが、析出物の感じが面白いのと、文化財登録されている建物の雰囲気が大変良いので、景色として0.2点加算。合計4.7の名湯。
properties.desc_en:
■Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. 700 yen, details
■Manager's rating ★4.7 (Spring quality 4.5 out of 5, Scenery 0.2) First of all, the spring quality is a dark moss-green cloudy water, and both the spring quality and the deposits are very similar to Yunotsu Onsen in Shimane. The spring quality is simply perfect, nothing to complain about. There is no open-air bath, but the appearance of the deposits is interesting, and the atmosphere of the building, which is registered as a cultural property, is very nice, so 0.2 points are added for the scenery. A superb hot spring with a total score of 4.7.

properties.desc_en: ■Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. A rich, dark brown hot spring. 500 yen, details

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 赤倉温泉 板倉旅館
properties.desc_ja:
■温泉マニア絶賛。日帰り入浴500円、詳細　※要事前問合せ
■管理人評価★4.5（泉質4.4、景色0.1）色は透明に近く無数の湯の華が舞っている。硫化水素の濃密な香りと味。床はマーブル模様の析出物。極上の名湯である。泉質4.4、景色は窓を開けると露天的に楽しめるが、景色が特に優れているわけではないので0.1加算。合計4.5と評価させていただきました。
properties.desc_en:
■Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. Day trip bathing: 500 yen. Details: *Advance inquiry required.
■Manager's rating: ★4.5 (Spring quality 4.4, Scenery 0.1) The water is nearly transparent with countless mineral deposits floating in it. It has a strong scent and taste of hydrogen sulfide. The floor is covered with marble-patterned deposits. It is a superb hot spring. The spring quality is 4.4, and while the scenery can be enjoyed like an open-air bath by opening the window, the scenery is not particularly outstanding, so 0.1 was added. The total rating is 4.5.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 地獄谷温泉 後楽館
properties.desc_ja:
■温泉マニア絶賛。日帰り入浴1200円、詳細。駐車場がなんと有料！500円。ちなみに猿の入浴を見学するとさらに500円。金にがめつすぎ・・・。
■管理人評価★4.9（泉質4.4、景色0.5）泉質は、無色透明だが味、香りともに濃厚で、析出物もガッツリ。また、露天風呂は天然記念物の噴泉の蒸気を全身で浴びることができる。透明の湯としては最高評価の4.4点と評価。景色は地獄谷を一望でき、天然記念物の噴泉を間近で見ることができる。満点評価。ここに来る道はちょいきつい。有名な猿の入浴も有料500円、駐車場500円、温泉600円。温泉は良いのですが、ちょっと銭ゲバですね。あと露天風呂は観光客に丸見えで、露出マニアにはたまらないでしょう。
properties.desc_en:
■Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. Day trip bathing is 1200 yen, details. Surprisingly, parking is charged! 500 yen. Incidentally, watching the monkeys bathe costs another 500 yen. They're a bit too greedy for money...

■Manager's rating ★4.9 (Spring quality 4.4, Scenery 0.5) The spring water is colorless and transparent, but both the taste and aroma are rich, and there are plenty of mineral deposits. Also, in the open-air bath, you can be bathed in the steam from the natural monument fountain. It receives the highest rating of 4.4 points for transparent water. The scenery offers a panoramic view of Jigokudani (Hell Valley), and you can see the natural monument fountain up close. A perfect score. The road to get here is a bit tough. The famous monkey bathing is also charged 500 yen, parking 500 yen, and the hot spring 600 yen. The hot spring is good, but they're a bit greedy for money. Also, the open-air bath is completely visible to tourists, which would be irresistible to exhibitionists.

properties.title_ja: 松川渓谷温泉 滝の湯
properties.desc_ja:
■温泉マニア絶賛。800円、詳細
■管理人評価★4.9（泉質4.4、景色0.5）湯は、ベースは無色透明だが、味、香りが濃厚で、析出物ガッツリ。湯の花が大量に舞っている。透明の湯としては最高レベル。4.4点。景色も非常にすばらしい。秋の紅葉と渓流を一望できる。0.5満点。しかもこの手の秘湯には珍しく、鍵付きのロッカーが無料で、休憩所も完備。これで500円は大満足。かなりおすすめ。湯のベースが無色透明なのでこの評価だが、満点をつけてもいいレベル。
properties.desc_en:
■Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. 800 yen, details
■Manager's rating ★4.9 (Spring quality 4.4, Scenery 0.5) The water is colorless and transparent at its base, but the taste and aroma are rich, and there are plenty of mineral deposits. A large amount of mineral deposits are floating in the water. It is the highest level for transparent hot spring water. 4.4 points. The scenery is also very wonderful. You can see the autumn foliage and the mountain stream. 0.5 points out of 500. Moreover, unusually for this type of secluded hot spring, there are free lockers with keys and a rest area. All this for 500 yen is very satisfying. Highly recommended. This rating is due to the water being colorless and transparent at its base, but it is at a level where it could be given a perfect score.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■温泉マニア絶賛。800円、詳細。マークは正確な位置に置いています。
■管理人評価★4.9（泉質4.5、景色0.4）泉質は硫黄臭のする濁り湯で、なんと緑色。非常に濃厚。泉質は非常に素晴らしく何も言うことなしの満点。非常に珍しいお湯です。景色も外の野天風呂からの眺めが気持ちよい。秋の紅葉が大変美しい。合計4.9点。
properties.desc_en:
■ Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. 800 yen, details. Marks are placed in the correct locations.

■ Manager's rating ★4.9 (Spring quality 4.5, Scenery 0.4) The spring water is cloudy with a sulfurous smell and is surprisingly green. Very concentrated. The spring water quality is superb, a perfect score with nothing to complain about. It's a very rare type of hot spring. The view from the outdoor open-air bath is also pleasant. The autumn foliage is very beautiful. Total 4.9 points.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■温泉マニア絶賛。300円、詳細。
■【木曽義仲ゆかり葵の湯-北条氏ゆかりの湯】木曽義仲がはるか上洛の機をうかがっていた頃、愛妾葵の御前としばしば入浴していたので「葵の湯」とよばれていました。その後、北条義政が浴室を建て、北条湯ともよばれていましたが、後にその溢れ出る湯の量の多さから「大湯」と改められました。
■管理人評価★4.4（泉質4.3、景色0.1）建物がいい感じ。泉質は透明な単純硫黄泉。田沢温泉有乳湯と似ているが、有乳湯よりも濃厚な感じでワンランク上という印象。多少析出物も見られる。湧出温度は50℃という最適な温度。泉質は4.3点と評価。 景色は雰囲気のある建物を評価して0.1加算、合計4.4点。
properties.desc_en:
■ Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. 300 yen, details.

■ [Aoi no Yu - Hot Spring Associated with Kiso Yoshinaka and the Hojo Clan] When Kiso Yoshinaka was awaiting his long-distance march to Kyoto, he often bathed here with his beloved concubine, Aoi no Gozen, hence the name "Aoi no Yu" (Aoi's Hot Spring). Later, Hojo Yoshimasa built a bathhouse here, and it was also called Hojo Yu, but later, due to the large volume of overflowing hot spring water, it was renamed "Oyu" (Great Hot Spring).

■ Manager's Rating ★4.4 (Spring Quality 4.3, Scenery 0.1) The building has a nice feel. The spring water is a clear, simple sulfur spring. It's similar to Tazawa Onsen Yuchiyu, but it feels richer and a step above Yuchiyu. Some mineral deposits are visible. The spring temperature is an optimal 50℃. The spring water quality is rated 4.3 points. 0.1 points are added for the scenery due to the atmospheric building, for a total of 4.4 points.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■温泉マニア絶賛。300円、詳細
■管理人評価★4.5（泉質4.4、景色0.1） ものすごい場所にあります。場所は超わかりにくくて、民家の中？にあります。藤森さんという表札がかかっているおうちです。玄関の横に細い路地があり、そこから奥に入っていきます。湯は硫黄臭のする本物。少し緑がかった硫黄泉です。析出物は無しですが、極上の温泉です。景色としては、街の中の秘湯という感じで非常に面白いので0.1加算。合計4.5の極上銭湯です。
properties.desc_en:
■Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. 300 yen, details
■Manager's rating ★4.5 (Spring quality 4.4, Scenery 0.1) It's in an incredible location. The location is extremely difficult to find, it's inside a private house? It's a house with a nameplate that says Fujimori. There's a narrow alley next to the entrance, and you go in from there. The water is the real deal, smelling of sulfur. It's a slightly greenish sulfur spring. There are no deposits, but it's a superb hot spring. As for the scenery, it's very interesting as a hidden hot spring in the middle of town, so I'll add 0.1. A superb public bath with a total rating of 4.5.

properties.title_ja: 白骨温泉 泡の湯旅館
properties.title_en: Shirahone Onsen Awa no Yu Ryokan
properties.desc_ja:
■温泉マニア絶賛。1000円、詳細
■管理人評価★5満点（泉質4.5、景色0.5）白骨温泉でここがいちばんおすすめ。風呂は、内湯と野天風呂の二カ所。泉質は、濃厚な乳青白色の濁り湯で満点。内湯と野天風呂の風情も素晴らしい。紅葉が美しい。ここは本館と土日営業の外湯があるが、断然本館がおすすめ。大変素晴らしい湯でした。ちなみにここは乳青白色ですが、白骨らしい白濁した濁り湯は新宅旅館なので、可能であれば、ここと新宅旅館両方入った方が良いと思います。
properties.desc_en:
■Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. 1000 yen, details
■Manager's rating ★5 out of 5 (Spring quality 4.5, Scenery 0.5) This is the best recommendation in Shirahone Onsen. There are two baths: an indoor bath and an open-air bath. The spring quality is perfect, with a rich, milky-white cloudy water. The atmosphere of both the indoor and open-air baths is also wonderful. The autumn leaves are beautiful. There is a main building and an outdoor bath that is open on weekends, but the main building is definitely recommended. It was a truly wonderful bath. By the way, this place has milky-white water, but the Shirahone-style milky-white cloudy water is at Shintaku Ryokan, so if possible, I think you should visit both this place and Shintaku Ryokan.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 蓮華温泉 蓮華温泉ロッジ
properties.desc_ja:
■温泉マニアが絶賛の名湯。1000円、詳細
■管理人評価★5至高（泉質4.5、景色0.5）至高の温泉。ここは内湯と、山道を登っていく野湯群の二つがあります。まず内湯は青い濁り湯で、ほのかな良い香りがする。窓の外には山の風景が見える。これだけでも極上ですが、ここの真骨頂は野湯にあります。上まで登ると25分ほどかかる、正直結構きつい道ですが、超極上温泉が４つ管理されています。四つともいずれも１００％源泉掛け流しの露天野湯で、特に上の二つが景色が凄すぎで、秋の紅葉はさぞかしキレイだろうなという感じです。泉質、眺望、ともに傑出した最高レベルの名湯かと思います。ザ・至高の名湯。
properties.desc_en:
■A famous hot spring highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. 1000 yen, details
■Manager's rating ★5 Supreme (Spring quality 4.5, Scenery 0.5) A supreme hot spring. This place has two types of baths: an indoor bath and a group of wild hot springs reached by climbing a mountain path. First, the indoor bath has cloudy blue water with a faint, pleasant fragrance. You can see the mountain scenery outside the window. This alone is superb, but the real highlight of this place is the wild hot springs. It takes about 25 minutes to climb to the top, and to be honest it's quite a strenuous path, but there are four superb hot springs managed there. All four are 100% natural hot spring open-air wild hot springs, and the top two in particular have amazing scenery, making you imagine how beautiful the autumn foliage must be. I think this is a top-level famous hot spring with outstanding spring quality and scenery. The ultimate famous hot spring.

■750円、詳細。温泉は硫黄の匂い漂う掛け流しで、他に食事処あり。特筆すべきは、駐車場に『キャンピングカー専用駐車場』の看板があり、穴観音の湯利用者に限り1泊無料で利用できます。希望者の方は事前にフロントに申し出くださいとのこと。※外にトイレは無いので注意。

■750 yen, details. The hot spring is free-flowing with sulfurous water, and there is also a restaurant. Notably, there is a sign for "campervan-only parking" in the parking lot, and it is free for one night for users of Anakannon-no-Yu. Those wishing to use it should inform the front desk in advance. *Note that there are no toilets outside.

■Report from a reader of this site: I recently visited Anakannon-no-Yu in Obuse, Nagano Prefecture, which is listed on our car camping map. When I inquired at the front desk about the campervan-only parking, I was told there are no toilets or water facilities. They said it's okay to use the toilets inside the building while the hot spring is open. (Thank you for the information.)

properties.desc_en:
■600 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: A very clean public inn. Day-use hot spring entry is until 9:30 PM. The facility closes at 10:00 PM. The hot spring water is a free-flowing, golden color, rich in carbon dioxide, calcium, iron, and salt, and has an open-air bath. The restaurant is only open during the daytime.

■６００円。見晴らしの良い露天風呂あり。サウナあり。広大な休憩所があり、コンセントでパソコンの充電なども可能。しかも水、茶が無料。wimax2も電波OK。非常に満足度が高い。
properties.desc_en:
■600 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: Used on a weekday at the end of March 2023. JAF discount available (declare at the counter, not the ticket machine). The indoor baths include a large (hot) and small (lukewarm) bath, a reclining bath, a waterfall bath, a sauna, and a small open-air bath. The water was slightly slippery and seemed to be weakly alkaline, making for a very pleasant bath. However, the restaurant is currently closed due to a shortage of staff! (Posted: April 2023, by n)
■600 yen. There is an open-air bath with a great view. There is a sauna. There is a large rest area where you can charge your laptop with an outlet. Moreover, water and tea are free. WiMAX2 signal is also OK. Very satisfying.

But, while the restaurants at day-trip hot springs are often disappointing, this place was satisfying in both quality and quantity. The parking lot is also spacious, so it would be great if you could stay overnight in your car here, but there didn't seem to be any toilets nearby.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■600円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：料金600円になっていました。場所がトンネルとトンネルの僅かな間にあり、長野県側から行くと標識すら無く非常に分かりにくい場所でした。秘湯の会の温泉なので有名なのか結構客が来てました。内風呂は二階、露天風呂は沢の下に降りていくのですが、当サイト情報とうり泉質も景色も良かったです。入浴だけが目的ならば、上高地観光の駐車場がある沢渡エリアに日帰り温泉が沢山有りました。
■温泉マニア絶賛。600円、営業時間11:00〜16:00（閉館）休業日は不定休 電話番号0263-95-2453
■管理人評価★4.9（泉質4.4、景色0.5）まず泉質は無色透明だが濃厚な塩化物泉。析出物が湯船にゴロゴロついている。透明の湯としては最高レベル。そしてここは露天風呂が非常に凄い。眺望が非常に素晴らしい。四国の祖谷温泉みたいな絶景。V字の壮大な渓谷に広葉樹が一面に生い茂っており、新緑と紅葉が非常に美しい。景色は文句なしの満点。合計4.9点という名湯。
properties.desc_en:
■600 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: The price was 600 yen. The location is in a small space between two tunnels, and if you come from the Nagano Prefecture side, there are no signs, making it very difficult to find. It seems to be a famous hot spring, as it is part of the "Secret Hot Spring Association," and there were quite a few customers. The indoor bath is on the second floor, and the open-air bath is down in the stream, but as our site's information stated, the water quality and scenery were excellent. If your only purpose is bathing, there are many day-trip hot springs in the Sawando area where the Kamikochi tourist parking lot is located.

■Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. 600 yen, business hours 11:00-16:00 (closing time), irregular closing days, phone number 0263-95-2453
■Administrator's rating ★4.9 (Water quality 4.4, scenery 0.5) First of all, the water quality is colorless and transparent, but it is a concentrated chloride spring. There are many deposits in the bathtub. It is the highest level for transparent water. And the open-air bath here is amazing. The view is absolutely wonderful. A breathtaking view reminiscent of Iya Onsen in Shikoku. Broadleaf trees grow profusely throughout the magnificent V-shaped valley, and the fresh greenery and autumn foliage are incredibly beautiful. The scenery is absolutely perfect. A superb hot spring with a total score of 4.9 points.

After entering the large toilet, there was a sign saying the bidet was out of order. As I was pulling up my pants after finishing, hot water gushed out of the nozzle. Be careful not to get your clothes wet. The multipurpose toilet is OK. There is a ramen shop that serves udon-like noodles in one corner, and a convenience store on the opposite side. The Wi-Fi is strong near the convenience store. I think it's relatively quiet. (Posted: April 2021, by Wataridori Manyuki)
■ Opened March 25, 2016. Seems good because it's a distance from the main national highway.

■2024年9月管理人現地確認：車中泊評価【Sランク🤩】86点👉️現地の写真・詳細案内図はこちら
■入浴♨️：《長門温泉やすらぎの湯》 600円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：長野 道の駅マルメロの駅ながとに「奥の方に非常に静かな駐車場あり」と画像入りで場所が紹介されてますが、その場所のプレハブに「駐車場内車中泊禁止」の掲示あり👉️添付画像。奥の方は従業員さんが駐車してるようなので、あまり奥に入り込んで駐車しない方が良いかもしれません。（投稿：2023年6月、名無し様）
■標高636m
■当サイト読者様レポート：道の駅マルメロの駅ながと：2019年11月　非常に評価の高い場所なので行きました。大きな工事が始まっていて、工事車両でいっぱいでした。工事内容は農産物販売所の建て替え、工事期間の表示は見当たりませんでした。非常に広い駅で、日帰り温泉・飲食店土産物店コンビニ・農産物販売の三つのエリアになってました。24時間利用可能のトイレは農産物販売のエリアにあり、工事中も利用可能でしたが、工事が終わるまでは見つけにくいと思います。日帰り温泉は人気があるようで車の出入りが大変多かったです。入浴施設エリアに止まってる車は多かったです。その隣に、飲食店土産物店コンビニのエリアがあり、それぞれの店が個別に独立して建っています。このエリアにも駐車場があります。このエリアの隣が農産物販売所のエリアですが、工事中で駐車場も工事車両で埋まっていました。車中泊する場合は、飲食店土産物店エリアの駐車場に止めることになりますが、看板がかかっており、飲食店土産物店エリアの駐車場なので長時間駐車はしないで下さいという趣旨の文言がありました。ここに長時間車を止めるとなると、観光に出歩くところもないので車中泊のことを示してると感じました。営業中の店のすぐそばで車中泊するのは中止し移動しました。なお、表示を無視してるのかどうか、車中泊するつもりの車が何台かありました。ほかの方の情報と異なってしまいました。工事が終わればSランクに相当するかもしれませんが、工事期間中は店の迷惑になりそうなので車中泊すべきでないと思います。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2019年5月利用。他のレポートにあるように、広い駐車場の周囲に諸施設が揃っていて利便性の高い道の駅です。大型車も多いですが、普通車エリアからは少し離れています。EV用の急速充電器が2基設置されているので、先客がいても待たされることはまずないと思われます。ここは標高700ｍ近いので、下界より気温は若干低めです。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：情報通り駐車場も広い、コンビニ有り、温泉有り、特Aランクと思います。温泉は道の駅内ではなく右横に隣接です。(分からなくて探しました)大きいし立派です。サウナ有り、露天有り、安い、泉質は温泉なのか、ただの地下水なのかと言う程度です。ローソンとの取り決めなのか自販機がありません。大型トラックが多数いてアイドリングしています。車載ＴＶは期待できません。商工会館前フリーWIFI有り。ソニー、パナソニックアプリで自宅レコーダー視聴可能。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■静かで寝やすいです。敷地内にローソンあり。トイレもきれいです。 奥に静かな駐車場所あり。温泉あり。いいですね。Aランク評価とさせていただきます。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：標高636m。温泉併設。コンビニ併設。道の駅のレストランは22時まで営業中。（2019年以前の古い投稿）

■Report from our site's reader: The Nagano roadside station Marumero no Eki Nagato is introduced with a picture and states that "there is a very quiet parking lot in the back," but there is a sign on the prefabricated building at that location that says "No car camping in the parking lot" 👉️ Attached image. It seems that employees park in the back, so it might be better not to park too far in. (Posted: June 2023, Anonymous)
■Elevation 636m
■Report from our site's reader: Roadside Station Marumero no Eki Nagato: November 2019 I went because it was a highly rated place. Large construction had started, and it was full of construction vehicles. The construction was for rebuilding the agricultural product sales area, and there was no indication of the construction period. It's a very large station, divided into three areas: a day-trip hot spring, restaurants, souvenir shops, a convenience store, and an agricultural product sales area. The 24-hour restrooms are located in the agricultural product sales area and were usable even during construction, but I think they'll be hard to find until the construction is finished. The day-trip hot spring seemed popular, with a lot of cars coming and going. There were many cars parked in the bathing facility area. Next to that was the area with restaurants, souvenir shops, and a convenience store, each building independently. There is also a parking lot in this area. Next to this area is the agricultural product sales area, but it was under construction and the parking lot was filled with construction vehicles. If you plan to stay overnight in your car, you'll have to park in the parking lot of the restaurant and souvenir shop area, but there was a sign that said something to the effect of "Please do not park for long periods of time as this is the parking lot for the restaurant and souvenir shop area." I felt that the sign was referring to people staying overnight in their cars, as there aren't many places to go sightseeing if you park your car there for a long time. I decided against staying overnight in my car right next to the shops that were open and moved. However, there were several cars parked there, seemingly ignoring the sign or perhaps intending to stay overnight. My information differs from other people's. It might be equivalent to an S rank once the construction is finished, but during construction, I don't think you should park your car overnight as it would be a nuisance to the store. (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from a reader of this site: Used in May 2019. As other reports mention, it's a very convenient roadside station with various facilities surrounding a large parking lot. There are many large vehicles, but they are a little distance from the regular car area. There are two EV fast chargers, so you probably won't have to wait even if there are other people there. Since it's nearly 700m above sea level, the temperature is slightly lower than in the lowlands. (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from a reader of this site: As the information said, the parking lot is large, there's a convenience store, there's a hot spring, I think it's a top A rank. The hot spring isn't inside the roadside station but adjacent to the right. (I had to look for it because I couldn't find it.) It's large and impressive. There's a sauna, an open-air bath, it's cheap, and the water quality is such that you can't tell if it's a hot spring or just groundwater. There are no vending machines, perhaps due to an agreement with Lawson. There are many large trucks idling. Don't expect to have a TV in your car. Free Wi-Fi is available in front of the Chamber of Commerce building. You can watch TV from your home recorder using Sony and Panasonic apps. (Older post from before 2019)
■Quiet and easy to sleep. There's a Lawson convenience store on the premises. The toilets are clean. There's a quiet parking area in the back. There's a hot spring. It's great. I'll give it an A rating. (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from a reader of this site: Elevation 636m. Hot spring attached. Convenience store attached. The roadside station restaurant is open until 10pm. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_en:

■Report from a reader of this site: A vast parking lot with space for 160 regular cars. The toilets are extremely clean, with flush toilets and bidet functions. If you try to avoid the noise by staying away from the national highway, you get closer to the large vehicle zone, and vice versa, so there isn't a really good spot. ■入浴♨️：ぽかぽかランド美麻、650円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：あくまでも私個人の感想です。個人的にはSランクです。売店食堂温泉併設の道の駅で、車中泊の場合は駐車位置が指定されています。食堂温泉の入り口から離れたところですが屋外トイレの近くです。交通量の多い県道沿いで、夜8時9時だとトラックがよく通るので静かではありませんが、私は気にせず睡眠できます。日付が変わるころには台数も減りますが一時間に三台くらいはトラックが通る感じです。駐車場は十分に広く、何度も利用していますが毎回20台近くが車中泊しています。屋外のトイレはきれいに清掃されていますが匂いがきついです。トラックの車中泊はありませんが、おそらくトラックは3分くらい離れた所にあるさんさんランドという大きな駐車場に止まってるようです。さんさんランドは広い駐車場がありトイレもあります。眼前には後ろ立山の山々が大きくきれいに見えます。朝の景色は絶景です。道の駅にある入浴者用の和室休憩室は夜8時まで利用可能で、弁当などの持ち込みも可能です。フロントで持ち込みを確認しました。（投稿：2025年10月、t様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：幹線道沿いでうるさいかもしれませんが、駐車場は広いのでトイレから離れたところなら、多少静かになります。私が行ったときは交通量は少なかったです。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■県道沿いだが、この地方の幹線道路のようで大型トラックが爆走してうるさい。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻 (On-site survey, April 2025)
■Bathing ♨️: Pokapoka Land Mima, 650 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: This is purely my personal opinion. Personally, I would rank it S. It's a roadside station with a shop, restaurant, and hot spring, and if you're staying overnight in your car, your parking spot is designated. It's a bit far from the entrance to the restaurant and hot spring, but it's near the outdoor toilets. It's along a busy prefectural road, and it's not quiet at 8 or 9 pm because trucks pass by frequently, but I can sleep without being bothered. The number of vehicles decreases around midnight, but it feels like about three trucks pass by per hour. The parking lot is quite large, and I've used it many times, and each time there are nearly 20 cars staying overnight. The outdoor toilets are kept clean, but they have a strong smell. There are no trucks staying overnight, but it seems that trucks are probably parked in a large parking lot called Sansan Land, about 3 minutes away. Sansan Land has a large parking lot and toilets. You can see the Tateyama Mountains in front of you, and they are large and beautiful. The morning view is spectacular. The Japanese-style rest area for bathers at the roadside station is available until 8 PM, and you can bring in your own food, such as bento boxes. I confirmed this at the front desk. (Posted: October 2025, by T)
■Report from a reader of this site: It might be noisy as it's along a main road, but the parking lot is large, so it's somewhat quieter if you park away from the toilets. Traffic was light when I went. (Older post from before 2019)

Quietness: Very quiet with no traffic ⭐5. Parking lot closures: Open 24 hours. Notes: Only available during the facility's operating season. Comments: Overnight stays in vehicles are generally OK in any parking lot, but access to the toilets is best from parking lots 1 to 2. There are various restaurants and other establishments if you drive a short distance into town. (Posted by K, May 2021)

■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真（2025年4月現地調査）
■入浴♨️：八方の湯、1000円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：白馬の各スキー場の近くにある大きな駐車場。『キャンプ・車中泊禁止』の看板がありますが車中泊の車がたくさんいます。駐車場内に常時使えるトイレもあります。静かで使いやすかったです。（投稿：2025年4月、村田様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：無料の駐車場で、2022年9月に利用しました。ほとんど車中泊の利用者が無く、登山者の駐車車両もほんの数台でした。　トイレがリニューアルしておりとても綺麗になっていました。近くに「八方の湯」が有り、登山者用の駐車場が併設してありますが、そちらはトイレが古くさく、結構沢山駐車しており、場所確保が難しいです。（投稿：2023年6月、h様）
■標高738m
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of toilets 🚻 (On-site survey, April 2025)
■Bathing ♨️: Happo-no-Yu, 1000 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: A large parking lot near the various ski resorts in Hakuba. There is a sign that says "No camping or overnight parking," but there are many cars parked there overnight. There is also a toilet that can be used at all times within the parking lot. It was quiet and easy to use. (Posted by Mr. Murata, April 2025)
■Report from our site's reader: A free parking lot, used in September 2022. There were hardly any overnight parking users, and only a few cars parked by hikers. The toilets had been renovated and were very clean. There is a "Happo-no-Yu" nearby with an attached parking lot for hikers, but the toilets there are old-fashioned, and there are quite a lot of cars parked there, making it difficult to secure a spot. (Posted by Mr. h, June 2023)
■Elevation 738m

properties.desc_ja:
■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真（2025年4月現地調査）
■入浴♨️：八方の湯、1000円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場はとても静か、駐車場は傾斜なし、温泉施設は八方の湯、トイレは24時間使用可能、道路を挟んでコンビニが有ります。車中泊の皆様は　ゴンドラリフトの始発に合わせ出掛けて行きました。 山で聞いた話しです。"八方の湯駐車場で職質に合いましたが、トレッキングウエアーを着て寝ていたら人違いで終わった。"との事。駐車場やトイレに車中泊禁止看板は有りませんが、公式サイトに車中泊のNG記載有り（詳細：「本ページでご案内の駐車場は通年で車中泊をお断りしております。」）。8月第1週の平日に5台程泊まっていました。（投稿：2024年10月、Liberty  cafe様）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。車中泊可能との報告あり。入浴施設あり。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■標高743m
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of toilets 🚻 (On-site survey, April 2025)
■Bathing ♨️: Happo-no-Yu, 1000 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: The parking lot is very quiet, the parking lot has no slope, the hot spring facility is Happo-no-Yu, the toilets are available 24 hours, there is a convenience store across the road. Those staying overnight in their cars left to coincide with the first gondola lift departure. This is a story I heard on the mountain: "I was stopped and questioned by the police at the Happo-no-Yu parking lot, but it turned out to be a case of mistaken identity because I was sleeping in trekking clothes." There are no signs prohibiting overnight parking in the parking lot or toilets, but the official website states that overnight parking is not allowed (details: "Overnight parking is prohibited year-round at the parking lot introduced on this page."). About 5 cars were parked there on a weekday in the first week of August. (Posted by: Liberty cafe, October 2024)
■Free parking and public toilets. Reports indicate that overnight parking is possible. There are bathing facilities. (Older posts from before 2019)
■ Elevation 743m

properties.title_en: [S-Rank] Kiso Komagatake Reisui Park Free Auto Campground, Kiso Komagatake Kogara Trailhead Parking Lot""
properties.desc_ja:
■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真（2025年4月現地調査）
■2025年4月管理人現地確認：車中泊評価【Sランク🤩】97点👉️現地の写真・詳細案内図はこちら
■入浴♨️：「ペンション アルパイン」500円、詳細。コインランドリーもある。
■入浴♨️：貸切風呂、1時間1000円
■当サイト読者様レポート：2025年11月現在、管理棟トイレは暗証番号入力は廃止されました。何時でも利用可！またアルパインの風呂(@500円)は休止となっています。（投稿：2025年11月、m様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：水源と自然を守るコンセプトで、支援寄付とボランティアで運営と整備がされている、高規格無料の民間のオートキャンプ場。なので、車中泊はテントなしのオートキャンプと考えればいいと思います。公園は365日24時間オープンしており無料でご利用可能。（綺麗なトイレ、無人のセルフレジ売店）あり。・トイレは、入り口のＱＲコードで、LINEで友達登録して鍵のナンバーＧＥＴ。・売店の価格は少し高めですが、キャンプ用品等の忘れ物があった場合にすぐに手に入るので便利。・売店の収益を運営費用の一部にあてるビジネスモデルのようです。・キャンプ場代が無料なので、その分で、高級シャンプーや高級なお肉などを買いましょう（笑）・お金を払ったら２４時間何回でも利用できるセルフ風呂、湯船にお湯が無ければ自分で給湯、ぬるければ加温。・お風呂は一人500円（18歳未満は無料）購入から24時間（複数回）利用可能。利用時間は9:00-21:00。・つまり、到着時に入浴して、車中泊、出発前にもう一度入ってから出発等が可能。・洗濯機400円（2台）、乾燥機400円（2台）あり。24時間利用可能。・超人気なので、キャンプサイト鋭意増設中のようです（2023/6）・参考ＵＲＬ：kisokomareisui.com/（投稿：2023年6月、s様）
■無料キャンプ場。無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。利用方法などがあるので公式サイトを一読必須👉️詳細。ペンション「アルパイン」で入浴が可能（500円）。標高1290m
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of toilets 🚻 (On-site survey April 2025)
■Manager's on-site confirmation April 2025: Car camping evaluation [S rank 🤩] 97 points 👉️ On-site photos and detailed map here
■Bathing ♨️: "Pension Alpine" 500 yen, details. There is also a coin laundry.

■Bathing ♨️: Private bath, 1000 yen for 1 hour
■Report from our site's reader: As of November 2025, the PIN code entry for the management building toilets has been abolished. Available anytime! Also, the Alpine bath (@500 yen) is closed. (Posted: November 2025, by m)
■Report from our site's reader: A high-standard, free private auto campsite operated and maintained with the concept of protecting water sources and nature, through support donations and volunteers. Therefore, you can think of car camping as auto camping without a tent. The park is open 24 hours a day, 365 days a year and is free to use. (Clean toilets, unmanned self-checkout shop) available. ・To use the toilets, scan the QR code at the entrance to add them as a friend on LINE and get the key number. ・The shop prices are a little on the high side, but it's convenient if you forget camping equipment or other items. ・It seems to be a business model where the shop's profits are used to cover part of the operating costs. ・Since the campsite is free, use that money to buy some high-quality shampoo or meat (lol). ・For a fee, you can use the self-service bath as many times as you like for 24 hours. If there is no hot water in the bathtub, you can fill it yourself, and if it is lukewarm, you can heat it up. ・The bath costs 500 yen per person (free for those under 18) and can be used for 24 hours (multiple times) from the time of purchase. Operating hours are 9:00-21:00. ・In other words, you can take a bath upon arrival, sleep in your car, take another bath before departing, etc. ・Washing machines (400 yen, 2 units) and dryers (400 yen, 2 units) are available. Available 24 hours a day. * It's extremely popular, so it seems they're diligently expanding the campsite (June 2023). *Reference URL: kisokomareisui.com/ (Posted: June 2023, by S)
* Free campsite. Free parking and public toilets. Please read the official website for usage instructions 👉️ Details. Bathing is available at the "Alpine" pension (500 yen). Elevation: 1290m

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja:
■詳細案内図（2025年4月現地調査）
■残念ながら併設温泉♨️は2026年1月末で閉業。詳細
■下道用の「ぷらっとパーク」について。上り側（場所はココ）は傾斜がある上に2台分しか無く、長時間利用禁止という看板があるので無理。下り側（場所はココ）も高速道路本線に近くうるさいのでやめたほうがいい。（2020年9月管理人現地確認）
■当サイト読者様レポート：ぷらっとパーク（下り）の情報。下道からの進入路が大変分かりにくい。湖畔の石舟渡交差点の山側にある丁字路から南東50ｍのところから、坂を登る細い道に入ります。「ぷらっとパーク」の案内板はありません。これを辿って高速の下をくぐり、さらに左に少し上ると、左側にぷらっとパークへの導入口があります。お客様用駐車スペースは、坂を登り切る直前にある道端の2台分のみ。坂の途中なので、フルフラットで寝る車は要注意です。坂の頂上の平面スペースにも駐車スペースがありますが、ここはどうやら従業員用のようです。駐車場からぷらっとパークに入ったところにハイウェイ温泉。その先のバルコニーからフードコートの中を通り抜けるとトイレ。バルコニーから諏訪湖が一望できます。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed Map (On-site survey, April 2025)
■Unfortunately, the attached hot spring ♨️ will close at the end of January 2026. Details
■Regarding the "Plat Park" for lower roads. The uphill side (location here) is sloped and only has space for two cars, and there is a sign prohibiting long-term use, so it's not feasible. The downhill side (location here) is also close to the main highway and noisy, so it's best to avoid it. (On-site confirmation by administrator, September 2020)
■Report from a reader of this site: Information on Plat Park (downhill). The access road from the lower road is very difficult to find. From the T-junction on the mountain side of the Ishifune-do intersection by the lake, go 50m southeast and take the narrow road that goes uphill. There is no sign for "Plat Park". Follow this and go under the highway, then go up a little further to the left and you will find the entrance to Plat Park on the left. There are only two parking spaces for customers on the side of the road just before you reach the top of the slope. Since it's on a slope, be careful if you're using a car with a fully reclined sleeping area. There's also parking space on the flat area at the top of the slope, but it seems to be for employees only. Highway Onsen is located just inside the park entrance from the parking lot. If you go through the food court from the balcony further on, you'll find the restrooms. You can enjoy a panoramic view of Lake Suwa from the balcony. (Older post from before 2019)

■入浴♨️：「健康スタジアム」で入浴が可能。2時間740円、詳細

■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレはキレイな水洗で洋式もあり。携帯電波OK。夜間非常に静か。穴場。治安については自己責任。（2022年6月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■November 2024 Administrator's On-Site Verification: Car Camping Rating [Rank B] ​​64 points 👉️Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■Bathing♨️: Bathing is available at "Health Stadium". 2 hours for 740 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: The facility itself costs 700 yen for 2 hours or 1000 yen for 3 hours (up to 4 hours for an additional 300 yen), which may seem a bit expensive if you only want to use the bath. However, if you bring a swimsuit, swimming cap, indoor shoes, and training wear or equivalent in addition to your bathing supplies, you can make full use of the facility, and the massage chairs are free, making it a hidden gem. Recommended for people who are car camping at multiple nearby spots. (For those who are traveling around the Hokuriku + Hokushinetsu region to some extent, it is even more recommended as it is eligible for a 50% discount with the "Hot Spring Hopping Passport" (details) booklet.) *Toyama Health Park → Details (Posted: September 2023, yuko)
■Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. The toilets are clean flush toilets, and there are also Western-style toilets. Mobile phone reception is OK. It's extremely quiet at night. A hidden gem. Safety is at your own risk. (Confirmed on-site by the administrator in June 2022)

properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is permitted. (On-site survey conducted in May 2026)
■Report from a reader of this site: Free parking, no nighttime closures. The parking spaces are arranged in a U-shape relative to the parking lot, and since it slopes downwards towards the back, you will feel a slight incline if you park on the left or right side. There are toilets (flush toilets, Japanese style, available 24 hours, generally clean). There are vending machines, but no shops nearby. It is quiet with little traffic at night. The parking lot is large, but speed bumps are installed, so drifters should avoid it. (Submitted by: A, April 2025)

■当サイト読者様レポート：利用料金は無料です（車中泊不可の看板はなし）。トイレのキレイさは標準的な道の駅です。歩いて行けるところには何もありません。代わりに多くの自動販売機が設置されており、また朝９時から道の駅がオープンします（１７時閉店）。５月の平日で、他に車中泊らしき車が１台おりました。土地柄バイク乗りが結構多く、静けさを求める人はトイレ近辺と道路沿いを避ける方が良いと思います（水車側ではなく、ダム側が静かでした）。（投稿：2022年5月、忍者トックリくん様）
properties.desc_en:
■ May 2026 Administrator's On-Site Verification: Overnight Parking Rating [Rank B] ​​69 points 👉️ Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■ Report from a Reader of This Site: There is no charge for use (no signs prohibiting overnight parking). The cleanliness of the toilets is standard for a roadside station. There is nothing within walking distance. Instead, there are many vending machines, and the roadside station opens at 9 am (closes at 5 pm). On a weekday in May, there was one other car that appeared to be parked overnight. Due to the area, there are quite a few motorcyclists, so those seeking quiet should avoid the area near the toilets and along the road (the dam side was quieter than the waterwheel side). (Submitted by: Ninja Tokkuri-kun, May 2022)

■ Report from our site's reader: Regarding the northbound side. There is a hot spring facility on the southbound side, and the post mentioned that it is noisy due to the proximity of large vehicles. However, the northbound side is structured so that large vehicles cannot enter the parking spaces for small vehicles, and large vehicles were not parked nearby. On the northbound side, the structure is designed so that large vehicles cannot enter the parking spaces for small vehicles. Also, since the day I stayed overnight was a weekday, there were few small vehicles parked, and half of the spaces were empty, with a considerable distance between the parking spaces for large vehicles, making it a quiet place to stay overnight in a car at a service area or parking area. properties.desc_en:

■Free parking and toilets. It's quite cool even in summer. During the water lily and autumn foliage seasons, it gets incredibly crowded with tourists and becomes extremely congested, so it's best to camp here in your car and observe and photograph carefully in the early morning. It's more beautiful when there's no direct sunlight. The road leading here is narrow and gets very congested, so it's best to go up before the tourists arrive and the traffic jam starts. properties.desc_ja:
■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2026年3月現地調査）
■当サイト読者様レポート：伊勢参りで利用させていただきました。大きい駐車場ではないですが、キレイな水洗トイレあります。電気は自動ではないらしく、点いてなければトイレ入り口にスイッチがあります。また山の中にあるため交通量も少なく静かです。場所の名前通り朝熊ヶ岳という登山口ですが歩いていくと、「お伊勢参らば朝熊をかけよ、朝熊かけねば片参り」で有名な金剛證寺へも行けます。車で行くとなると有料道路経由になりますが、歩いていけば無料ですのでよければ是非（※登山道）。注意点は登山口駐車場なので朝は出入りがありますのでご注意ください。（投稿：2022年11月、k様）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is permitted. (On-site survey conducted in March 2026)
■Report from a reader of this site: I used this place when visiting Ise Shrine. The parking lot isn't large, but there are clean flush toilets. The lights don't seem to be automatic, so if they're not on, there's a switch at the toilet entrance. Also, because it's in the mountains, there's little traffic and it's quiet. As the name suggests, it's a trailhead for Mt. Asama, but if you walk, you can also reach Kongoshoji Temple, famous for the saying, "If you visit Ise, climb Mt. Asama; if you don't climb Mt. Asama, your pilgrimage is incomplete." If you go by car, you'll have to take a toll road, but it's free if you walk, so please do if you'd like (※hiking trail). One thing to note is that it's a trailhead parking lot, so there's traffic coming and going in the morning. (Posted by: k, November 2022)

■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2025年10月現地調査）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2026/4/20に行きました。西側未舗装駐車場ですが、下見で日中は入れましたが、夜間到着時(21:30)はポールの車止めがあっては入れませんでした。車は1台もありませんでした（追い出しがあるのかな？）隣の舗装の駐車場で車中泊しました。23:00以降は公園の電灯も消えて、トイレ横の自販機の灯のみでした。トイレは開いていました、電気も自動で点きました。朝（9:50）でもまだポールがありました。添付画像（投稿：2026年4月、富八様）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is permitted. (On-site survey conducted in October 2025)
■Report from a reader of this site: I went on April 20, 2026. The unpaved parking lot on the west side was accessible during the daytime during a reconnaissance, but upon arrival at night (9:30 PM), there were bollards blocking entry. There were no cars there (perhaps they were being chased away?). I stayed overnight in the adjacent paved parking lot. After 11:00 PM, the park lights were turned off, with only the light from the vending machine next to the toilets providing illumination. The toilets were open, and the lights turned on automatically. The bollards were still there in the morning (9:50 AM). Attached image (Posted by: Tomihachi, April 2026)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2026年3月現地調査）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2024/9/16　横山展望台P1（詳細場所）で停車してハッチバックをあけて車中泊の準備をしていたら、午後5時半頃トイレの鍵を閉めにきた男性に「こちらでキャンプするのか？」と聞かれました。「車中泊しようと思います」というと「国立公園内なのでやめて欲しい。道の駅に行ってください」と言われて車中泊できませんでした。イオン阿児店前の阿児ふるさと公園テニスコート用駐車場に移動して問題なく車中泊できました。阿児ふるさと公園テニスコート用駐車場は、テニスコート利用者が夜にいなくなり、朝8時に学生を乗せた親御さんが駐車場に子供を乗せて大挙してきましたが、日没後から朝8時まではほとんど人がいなくて静かでした。トイレは駐車場からスロープあるいは階段をあがったテニスコートと同じ高さにあります。男女ともに和式のみ2か所。古くて見た事のない操作の水洗式。夜は照明無し。向かいのイオンが徒歩3分、朝8時から夜10時まで営業なので買物がてらトイレも使わせてもらいました。（投稿：2024年9月、a様）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレは坂を上がった上に簡易水洗和式の公衆トイレがある。向かいにイオンがあり便利。町中のため人の出入りは多い。（2022年3月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is possible. (On-site survey in March 2026)
■Report from a reader of this site: On September 16, 2024, I was parked at Yokoyama Observatory P1 (detailed location) and had the hatchback open, preparing to camp overnight, when around 5:30 PM, a man came to lock the toilet and asked me, "Are you camping here?" When I replied, "I'm planning to camp overnight," he said, "Please don't, this is in a national park. Please go to a roadside station," and I was unable to camp overnight. I moved to the parking lot for the tennis courts at Ago Furusato Park in front of Aeon Ago store and was able to camp overnight without any problems. The parking lot for the tennis courts at Ago Furusato Park was quiet from sunset until 8 AM, although there were hardly any people there. The toilets are at the same level as the tennis courts, accessed by a slope or stairs from the parking lot. There are two Japanese-style toilets for both men and women. An old, unfamiliar flush toilet. No lighting at night. The Aeon across the street is a 3-minute walk away and is open from 8 am to 10 pm, so I was able to use the toilet while shopping. (Posted by: A, September 2024)
■Free parking and public toilet. Confirmed that it is not closed at night. There is a simple flush toilet (Japanese style) at the top of a hill. Conveniently located across from Aeon. There is a lot of foot traffic as it is in the middle of town. (Confirmed on-site by administrator in March 2022)

Plans that include the annex also offer a Korean-style dome sauna, bedrock bath, and radon inhalation bath. The restaurant is also well-equipped. An RV park is also located on the premises. Details (Posted: April 2026, by n)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 クレール平田
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2026年4月の平日に利用。堤防上にある南北に細長い道の駅。トイレ等の建物はその南端にあるため、北側に駐めると遠くなります。トイレはちょっと年季が入っていて狭い。本線はトラックの往来も多いが、堤防のフチ側（陸側）の駐車枠であれば耳栓が有効。地元の新鮮野菜が格安で買える物産店と洒落たカフェのモーニングが人気。営業は8時~17時。（投稿：2026年4月、n様）
■幹線道沿いで一晩中トラックの走行音、アイドリング音がうるさい。おすすめできない。道挟んで向かいにある川原の公園駐車場が静かで良さそうだが、夜間門扉が閉鎖されるので利用不可。（2020年10月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Used on a weekday in April 2026. A long, narrow roadside station located on a levee. The toilets and other facilities are at the southern end, so parking on the north side means a long walk. The toilets are a bit old and cramped. While there's a lot of truck traffic on the main road, earplugs are effective if you park on the levee edge (land side). The local produce shop, where you can buy fresh local vegetables at bargain prices, and the stylish cafe's breakfast are popular. Open from 8 am to 5 pm. (Submitted by: n, April 2026)

■The noise from trucks and idling is loud all night long along the main road. Not recommended. The park parking lot across the road by the river seems quieter and better, but the gates are closed at night, making it unusable. (Administrator's on-site verification, October 2020)

■当サイト読者様レポート：下り側について。過去5～6回利用。本線からの奥行きが狭く、その分かなり細長いレイアウト。しかし平日は多数のトラックが普通車枠まで大きく浸食して駐めるので、大型車から離れることは難しい。そのためある程度のエンジン音などは不可避だが、耳栓で軽減できる。フードコートが24H営業。（投稿：2026年4月、n様）

Therefore, some engine noise is unavoidable, but it can be reduced with earplugs. The food court is open 24 hours. (Submitted by: n, April 2026)

I stopped at Yoro SA (southbound) from Puratto Park as a rest stop near Sekigahara. It is a facility where you can use the SA/PA from the general road. I arrived after driving a considerable distance on narrow general roads. I was hoping to buy a souvenir that can only be bought here (Akabuku from Ise), but I couldn't. I used the toilet and took a nap for about an hour before departing. (Submitted by: S, September 2022)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2026年4月訪問。24時間300円の有料コインパーキングで、24時間入出庫可能。駐車場内は夜間も明るい照明が付き、24時間カメラ監視中の看板もあるので、治安の不安は少ないですが自己責任で。トイレは、徒歩一分の近鉄大和上市駅のトイレを利用するのですが、電車の運行時間以外は電源が落ち、トイレの水や洗面台の水も止まりますので、男の小便ならまだしも、夜間にトイレに行きたくなった場合は600メートル先のローソンなどを頼ることになります。また、駐車場出入り口の幅が門型洗車機並みに狭く、運転に自信の無い方などは気を付けた方が良いです。吉野の桜で有名な吉野駅から2駅隣で、パーク＆ライドに便利です。添付画像、添付画像、添付画像（投稿：2026年4月、S様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Visited in April 2026. This is a paid coin parking lot costing 300 yen for 24 hours, with 24-hour entry and exit. The parking lot is brightly lit even at night, and there are signs indicating 24-hour camera surveillance, so there are few safety concerns, but use at your own risk. For toilets, you have to use the toilets at Kintetsu Yamato-Kamiichi Station, which is a one-minute walk away. However, the power is cut off outside of train operating hours, and the water in the toilets and sinks stops, so while it's manageable for men to urinate, if you need to use the toilet at night, you'll have to rely on a Lawson convenience store 600 meters away. Also, the width of the parking lot entrance and exit is as narrow as a gantry car wash, so those who are not confident in their driving skills should be careful. It is two stations away from Yoshino Station, famous for its cherry blossoms, making it convenient for park and ride. Attached images, attached images, attached images (Posted by: Mr. S, April 2026)

■当サイト読者様レポート：レポートにあったファミマは2025/8/31を以て閉店、9/19から森のコンビニとして7～19時営業となる。トイレはJR駅側にあり、そちらのトイレも兼用。ウォシュレットあり。めん処では舞茸の乗った麺類などがあり、直売所のお弁当持ち込みは公認(食べた弁当は下のゴミ箱へ、とある) あとジョロキアの七味やら一味というとんでもないものが、直売所にいるのですが…(めん処でお試し可能)（投稿：2026年4月、yuko様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2019/8/13道の駅内にファミマが開店(営業時間６時〜２２時)周辺にはこの時間まで営業している店はこの一店舗しかないので非常に便利になりました。真夏のお盆に利用しましたが夜間は涼しく過ごしやすかったです。走行音についてはトラックは時々通りますが自分は気にならないレベルでした。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：盆休みの福井県車中泊ドライブ２泊目に利用しました。駐車場が国道に沿って細長いのと、国道も福井県と岐阜県を結ぶ幹線で夜間の交通量も多く、走行音がかなりうるさいです。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Reader Report: The FamilyMart mentioned in the report will close on August 31, 2025, and will reopen as a convenience store in the forest from September 19, operating from 7 am to 7 pm. The toilets are located on the JR station side and are shared with the FamilyMart. They have bidet toilets. The noodle shop offers noodle dishes topped with maitake mushrooms, and bringing in bento boxes from the direct sales store is permitted (please put your eaten bento in the trash can below). Also, the direct sales store has some incredible things like shichimi and ichimi made with jolokia peppers... (you can try them at the noodle shop) (Submitted by: yuko, April 2026)

■Reader Report: A FamilyMart opened inside the roadside station on August 13, 2019 (open from 6 am to 10 pm). Since this is the only store open until this time in the area, it has become very convenient. I used it during the Obon festival in mid-summer, and it was cool and comfortable at night. Regarding traffic noise, trucks pass by occasionally, but it wasn't bothersome to me. (Older posts from before 2019)
■Report from a reader of this site: I used this parking lot for the second night of my road trip in Fukui Prefecture during the Obon holiday. The parking lot is long and narrow along the national highway, and the highway is a main road connecting Fukui and Gifu prefectures, so there is a lot of traffic at night, and the traffic noise is quite loud. (Older posts from before 2019)

■当サイト読者様レポート：2024/9/14 五十鈴公園北側P（詳細場所）で車中泊しようと停車していたら夜10時半頃に係の人が訪ねてきて「車中泊禁止なので今から別の場所に案内します」と車で誘導されました。誘導されたの五十鈴公園北側Pの南側の五十鈴公園駐車場。駐車場入口の「公園利用者駐車場」の看板には白いシールがはって目隠しされており、今は色んな事情の人が駐車する場所として利用しているようです。無料でしたが案内する男性は「今回はここに駐車することで目をつぶってあげるから」と言っていたのが気になりました。トイレは公園内を2分歩いて五十鈴公園北側Pのを使うしかありませんので、やや不便です。夜間は我々以外は1台のキャンピングカーのみ。翌朝日曜日は朝6時くらいから公園ランナーや犬の散歩の人が4-5台。日中はそのまま車を置いて徒歩で観光して午後3時頃に戻ったら他県ナンバーで満車状態でした。伊勢神宮やおかげ横丁周辺の駐車は通常1000円です。無料で観光できる駐車場として穴場的に人気があると思います。（投稿：2024年9月、a様）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is permitted. (On-site survey conducted in March 2026)
■Report from a reader of this site: On September 14, 2024, I was parked in the north parking lot of Isuzu Park (detailed location) intending to stay overnight when around 10:30 PM an attendant came to my door and said, "Overnight parking is prohibited, so I will guide you to another location." I was then directed to the Isuzu Park parking lot south of the north parking lot. The "Park Users Parking" sign at the entrance to the parking lot was covered with a white sticker, and it seems that it is currently being used as a parking area for people with various reasons. It was free, but I was concerned when the man who guided me said, "I'll turn a blind eye to it this time if you park here." The only toilets available are those in the north parking lot of Isuzu Park, which are a 2-minute walk inside the park, so it's somewhat inconvenient. At night, there was only one other camper van besides ours. The next morning, Sunday, there were 4-5 cars with park runners and people walking their dogs from around 6 AM. I left my car there during the day and went sightseeing on foot. When I returned around 3 PM, the parking lot was full of cars with out-of-prefecture license plates. Parking around Ise Grand Shrine and Okage Yokocho usually costs 1000 yen. I think this is a hidden gem and popular as a free parking lot for sightseeing. (Posted by A, September 2024)

■当サイト読者様レポート：利用日　2024年５月３日。小さめだけれど良い道の駅。売店は19時に閉まるけど、お刺身や生肉、餃子など車中泊向けの食材多数。何も買っていかなくてもここだけでなんとかなる程度には揃う。バイクの出入りが多少うるさかったが比較的静か。駐車場は平らでは無くゆるい傾斜面が結構あるので、気にする人はレベラー持参のこと。（投稿：2024年5月、zil 415様）
■2016.4.24にオープン。バイパスのPA的道の駅。夜中まで出入り多い。wimax 電波ok。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■March 2026 Administrator's On-site Verification: Car Camping Rating [Good 😊] 71 points 👉️ Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■Report from a reader of this site: Date of use: May 3, 2024. A small but good roadside station. The shop closes at 7 PM, but they have plenty of food items suitable for car camping, such as sashimi, raw meat, and dumplings. You can manage with just what you have here without buying anything beforehand. It was relatively quiet, although there was some noise from motorcycles coming and going. The parking lot is not flat and has quite a few gentle slopes, so those who are concerned should bring a leveler. (Posted: May 2024, zil 415)
■Opened on April 24, 2016. A roadside station that's like a rest area on a bypass. There is a lot of traffic until late at night. WiMAX signal OK. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.title_ja: 浜詰園地(夕日公園) 駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2026年2月訪問。トイレ・駐車場ともに夜間利用可。車中泊可能です。複数の洗面台と洋式トイレが整備されており、快適な部類かと思います。夜間も照明がついていますが、朝6時頃に照明が消え、一時的に暗い時間帯もありました。県道に面していますが、割と交通量が少ないのと、駐車場と高低差があるおかげか、比較的静かだと思いました。自分のほかに十数台駐車していましたが、近隣の方が駐車しているのか人の気配の無い車両が多かったです。（投稿：2026年3月、S様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Visited in February 2026. Both the toilets and parking lot are available for use at night. Overnight stays in vehicles are permitted. There are multiple sinks and Western-style toilets, making it quite comfortable. The lights are on at night, but they turn off around 6 AM, resulting in a period of darkness. Although it faces a prefectural road, the traffic volume is relatively low, and perhaps due to the difference in elevation between the parking lot and the road, it felt relatively quiet. There were about a dozen other cars parked besides mine, but many of them seemed to belong to local residents, as there was no sign of anyone inside. (Submitted by: Mr. S, March 2026)

It faces a prefectural road, but traffic is quite light even during the day. However, because it faces a sandy beach, the sound of waves can be heard constantly. (Attached image: Posted by Mr. S, March 2026)

properties.title_ja: 道の駅 あいの土山
properties.desc_ja:
■2026年2月管理人現地確認：車中泊評価【良😊】76点👉️現地の写真・詳細案内図はこちら
■男子トイレに「無料の洗髪コーナー」あり！ ※風呂、シャワーは無い
■当サイト読者様レポート：2025年8月にリニューアルオープンしたようでとても綺麗です。夜間閉鎖もなく車中泊禁止等の案内も見当たりませんでした。トイレは水洗洋式ウォシュレット、夜間はセンサー式で照明が点きますが、妻の話では女子トイレの個室はセンサー範囲から外れており長時間滞在すると消灯した後再点灯しないので注意が必要との事です。男子トイレは個室利用していないので未検証です。朝8時頃にトイレ掃除の方が来ていました。愛想が良く元気に挨拶してくれました。男子トイレには洗髪シャワー洗面台(床屋さんみたいな)が設置されており、電気温水器があるのでお湯が出ます。女子トイレにはないそうです。平日の夜、２度車中泊に訪問しましたがトラックも車中泊利用者も少なく、目の前は東海道ですが通行車も多くないので奥の方なら静かに過ごせました。（投稿：2026年2月、たいちゅん様）
properties.desc_en:
■ February 2026 Administrator's On-Site Verification: Car Camping Rating [Good 😊] 76 points 👉️ Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■ There is a "free hair washing corner" in the men's restroom! * There are no baths or showers
■ Report from our site's reader: It seems to have been renovated and reopened in August 2025, and it is very clean. There are no nighttime closures, and we did not see any signs prohibiting car camping. The toilets are flush toilets with bidet functions, and the lights turn on at night with a sensor, but according to my wife, the individual stalls in the women's restroom are outside the sensor range, so be careful as the lights will not turn back on after being turned off if you stay for a long time. We did not use the individual stalls in the men's restroom, so this has not been verified. A toilet cleaner came around 8am. They were friendly and greeted us cheerfully. The men's restroom has a hair washing shower sink (like in a barber shop) and an electric water heater so hot water is available. Apparently, the women's restroom does not have this. I visited twice for overnight stays in my car on weekday nights, and there were few trucks or other people staying overnight in their cars. Although it's right on the Tokaido highway, there isn't much traffic, so I was able to spend a quiet time in the back. (Posted by: Taichun, February 2026)

■当サイト読者様レポート：2025年4月23日来訪。人通りはありませんが、駐車場のすぐ近くが住宅街になっています。騒がしくした場合は、通報される可能性が高いです。私の他3台ほど夜間に車が止まっていましたが、静かでした。駐車場のすぐそばにトイレがあります。（夜間閉鎖無し）人が少ない為、多目的トイレを使用しやすいのがよいです。多目的トイレは、水洗洋式で綺麗でした。朝7時頃トイレ掃除をしていましたので、出発前にはトイレに行きませんでした。朝になると近所の方が散歩しています。（投稿：2025年5月、のんのん様）

(Not closed at night) Because there are few people, it is easy to use the multipurpose toilet. The multipurpose toilet was a clean Western-style flush toilet. They were cleaning the toilet around 7 AM, so I didn't go to the toilet before leaving. In the morning, local residents take walks. (Posted by Nonnon, May 2025)

■入浴♨️：《香肌峡温泉 いいたかの湯》 870円、 詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：2026-３月　平日利用 ①建物の西側トイレ近くに駐車　一晩中静かだった　大型車とは離れており　エンジン音は気にならない　道路を走る車の音も小さかった　②いいたかの湯は珍しい蒸し湯など有り　ゆっくり楽しめた　③休憩館は　温泉受付の外に有るので　いつでも利用できそうだったが　④レストランは　麺類の提供は17時迄との案内があった　⑤トイレの洗面台は一つ(男女共に)なので朝は混雑していた（投稿：2026年3月、k様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2025年1月の週末に利用。駐車場は21時に温泉施設が閉まるとがら空きになる。今回はそこから外れたレストラン東側の駐車場で安眠できた。Wi-Fiは建物を出ると弱くなり、TV・ラジオも難しい。レストランはL.O.18時半だが、人気のジビエ料理は早めに売り切れるらしい。温泉は循環消毒で少し塩素臭あり。24Hトイレは建物の西端にあり、1個しかない洗面はお湯出ず。EV Quickが2台ある。設備等には若干不満があるも、伊勢鳥羽方面の車中泊場所としては悪くない。（投稿：2025年2月、n様）
■奥の方は非常に静か！標高は144m。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■ October 2024 Administrator's On-site Verification: Car Camping Rating [S Rank 🤩] 89 points 👉️ Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■ Bathing ♨️: "Kohadakyo Onsen Iitaka no Yu" 870 yen, Details
■ Report from our site's reader: March 2026, Weekday use ① Parked near the toilet on the west side of the building. It was quiet all night. It was far from large vehicles, so engine noise wasn't a problem. The sound of cars on the road was also low. ② Iitaka no Yu has unusual features such as a steam bath, which was enjoyable. ③ The rest area is outside the hot spring reception, so it seemed like it could be used anytime. ④ The restaurant had a notice that noodle dishes were only served until 5 PM. ⑤ There is only one sink in the toilet (both men's and women's), so it was crowded in the morning (Posted: March 2026, by k)
■ Report from our site's reader: Used on a weekend in January 2025. The parking lot becomes completely empty when the hot spring facility closes at 9 PM. This time, I was able to sleep soundly in the parking lot on the east side of the restaurant, away from the main area. The Wi-Fi weakens outside the building, and TV and radio reception is also poor. The restaurant's last order is at 6:30 PM, but popular game dishes apparently sell out earlier. The hot spring water is circulated and disinfected, and has a slight chlorine smell. The 24-hour toilet is at the western end of the building, and the single sink doesn't have hot water. There are two EV Quick parking spaces. While there are some minor complaints about the facilities, it's not a bad place to stay overnight in a car on the way to Ise-Toba. (Posted: February 2025, by n)

■The back area is extremely quiet! The elevation is 144m. (Older post from before 2019)

■当サイト読者様レポート：2026-３月　平日利用。①トイレ近くに駐車　他の車は少なく　横の道路を走る車も少なく　静かだった　②温泉の休憩室はテレビがあり　ゆったり過ごせた　③レストランは14時に営業終了していた　平日と休日で営業時間が違う ④｢車がうるさい｣と言う評価が多かったが　とても静かだった　季節や平日か休日で違うものかと感じた（投稿：2026年3月、k様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：隣接する「おくとろ温泉」で入浴、食事、コンビニが完結する。温泉は単純硫黄泉で比較的ぬるい温度だが露天風呂から夜空が見える。駐車場の照明が明るいので残念ながら天体観測には不向き。トイレは温水便座付きの洋式と和式で24時間利用可。（投稿：2021年10月、くぅくん様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：何と、道の駅なのに土日祝日が休業になっていました。ただ車中泊は可能、トイレもあります。静かです。そして、隣接の「温泉おくとろ」は営業している（食堂も）ので、不自由はありません。公園の眼下の瀞峽と川べりの桜が大変見事でした。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Car Camping Rating [A Rank 😄] 84 points 👉️Click here for detailed scoring and detailed map. (April 2025)
■Bathing ♨️: 《Okutoro Onsen》 700 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: March 2026, weekday use. ①Parked near the toilet. Few other cars, and few cars on the adjacent road, so it was quiet. ②The hot spring's rest room had a TV, so I could relax. ③The restaurant closed at 2 PM. Business hours differ between weekdays and holidays. ④Many reviews mentioned "noisy cars," but it was very quiet. I felt it might differ depending on the season or whether it was a weekday or holiday (Posted: March 2026, k)
■Report from our site's reader: Bathing, meals, and convenience store are all available at the adjacent "Okutoro Onsen." The hot spring is a simple sulfur spring and is relatively lukewarm, but you can see the night sky from the open-air bath. Unfortunately, it's not suitable for stargazing because the parking lot lighting is bright. The toilets are Western-style with heated seats and Japanese-style toilets, and are available 24 hours a day. (Posted by: Kuu-kun, October 2021)
■Report from a reader of this site: Surprisingly, despite being a roadside station, it was closed on weekends and holidays. However, overnight parking is possible, and there are toilets. It's quiet. Also, the adjacent "Onsen Okutoro" is open (including the restaurant), so there are no inconveniences. The Torokyo Gorge below the park and the cherry blossoms along the riverbank were magnificent. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_ja: ■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレはダムの管理棟に夜間も利用可能でキレイな水洗洋式トイレがある（冬季閉鎖）。夜間超絶静かだが、残念ながら携帯が圏外。（2022年12月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en: ■Free parking and public restrooms. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. There are clean, flushable Western-style toilets in the dam's management building that are available at night (closed in winter). It is extremely quiet at night, but unfortunately, there is no cell phone reception. (Confirmed on-site by the caretaker in December 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレはこんな場所なのにキレイな水洗で洋式もあり、ビックリ。駐車場はフラットに整地されている。夜間超絶静か（悪天候の場合はたまにスピーカーで「○○警報が出ています」みたいなのが流れる）。唯一の難点としては、携帯電波がギリギリ（ドコモ、SBともに）。（2023年6月管理人現地確認）
■当サイト読者様レポート：無料で20台程度の乗用車やキャンパーなど駐車できます。トイレも24時間公園で使用可能ですし、給水も出来る水道あり。歩きでは少し距離がありましたが、大谷温泉と言う施設がありました。皮膚病に良い温泉だそうで食事もできます。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Free parking and public restrooms. Confirmed they are not closed at night. Surprisingly, the restrooms are clean, flush toilets, and even Western-style, considering the location. The parking lot is level and flat. Extremely quiet at night (occasionally, during bad weather, announcements like "○○ warning issued" are broadcast over the loudspeaker). The only drawback is that cell phone reception is very weak (both Docomo and SoftBank). (Confirmed on-site by administrator in June 2023)
■Report from a reader of this site: There is free parking for about 20 cars and campers. Restrooms are available 24 hours a day in the park, and there is also a water tap where you can get water. It's a bit of a walk, but there is a facility called Otani Onsen. It is said to be a hot spring good for skin diseases, and you can also have a meal there. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレはこんな山奥なのにきれいに管理された簡易水洗の洋式。駐車場もフラットに整地されている。夜間メチャクチャ静かで最高。携帯電波はドコモがギリギリで、SBは○。標高654m。難点としては、ここに至る道が非常に細く曲がりくねっており、対向車が来ると非常に面倒くさいことになる。大型車は来るのはやめたほうが良い。（2023年6月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en: ■Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. Despite being so deep in the mountains, the toilets are clean, well-maintained, and are Western-style simple flush toilets. The parking lot is also level and flat. It's incredibly quiet at night, which is great. Cell phone reception is barely available for Docomo, but good for SoftBank. Elevation: 654m. The downside is that the road leading here is very narrow and winding, making it very inconvenient if you encounter oncoming traffic. Large vehicles should probably avoid coming here. (Confirmed on-site by administrator in June 2023)

properties.desc_ja:
■入浴♨️：近くに銭湯「石田湯」（詳細）あり。
■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車料金　駐車後24時間　最大料金880円、詳細。この駐車場は交通ICパーク&ライドを推奨しているようで、ﾀｲﾑｽﾞｸﾗﾌﾞｶｰﾄﾞで最大料金220円優待、地下鉄烏丸線十条駅、京阪鳥羽街道駅をPiTaPa/ICOCAでご降車の方、駐車料金330円ご優待。つまり観光後どちらかの駅で下車して、出庫時にﾀｲﾑｽﾞｸﾗﾌﾞｶｰﾄﾞと併用して清算すれば550円引きの330円で24時間駐車出来ます。私はSuicaしか持っていないので、ﾀｲﾑｽﾞｸﾗﾌﾞ割引で660円でした。地下鉄十条駅は西に徒歩4分350Mで、京阪本線鳥羽街道駅は東に徒歩9分700Mになります。市営バスを利用したいのであれば、西に徒歩2分160M　市営81　十条竹田街道、東に徒歩8分550M　市営南5　十条相深町があります（この周辺のバス停を探す）。トイレは駐車場内にあります。男性用と身障者用があり男性用しか見ていませんが、水洗洋式で大、小一つずつありました。ウォシュレットはありませんでしたが十分綺麗でした。外に手洗い場がありそこで水も汲めるのですが、東に500Mほどの所に相深公園がありそちらでも汲めます。駐車場内は概ねフラットで約60台駐車出来るそうですが、土曜日の夜の割にはそんなに停まっていませんでした。ﾀｲﾑｽﾞｸﾗﾌﾞのHPでは高さ制限が2.1Mとのことですが、上にバーもなくキャブコンも車中泊していたので特に制限はないと思われます。お風呂は西に徒歩4分280Mのところに石田湯（詳細）という銭湯があります。（月曜日から土曜日15時00分～23時00分、日曜定休日）今回行く予定でしたが、酒を飲んで爆睡してしまい確認できませんでした。ランプ下とのことで騒音が心配でしたが、周りに民家もなく、夜になると交通量が減り快適に寝ることが出来ました。駐車場内はロック版式ではないので、寝る前に奥の方に移動したのも良かったかもしれません。車中泊場所の少ない京都で、京都駅や祇園に行くのも便利だし、駐車料金も安いのでいいんじゃないでしょうか。こちらのゆきみち夫婦様のHP（詳細）を参考にさせていただきました。（投稿：2023年3月、やすすぎ様）
properties.desc_en:
■Bathing♨️: There is a public bathhouse "Ishida-yu" nearby (details).

■Report from our site's reader: Parking fee - 24 hours after parking - maximum charge 880 yen, details. This parking lot seems to encourage IC card park & ​​ride, with a 220 yen discount for Times Club cardholders, and a 330 yen discount for those who alight at Jujo Station on the Karasuma Subway Line or Tobakaido Station on the Keihan Line using PiTaPa/ICOCA. In other words, if you alight at either station after sightseeing and pay using your Times Club card in conjunction with the discount upon exiting, you can park for 24 hours for 330 yen, a 550 yen discount. I only have a Suica card, so with the Times Club discount it was 660 yen. Jujo Subway Station is a 4-minute walk (350m) west, and Tobakaido Station on the Keihan Main Line is a 9-minute walk (700m) east. If you want to use the city bus, the City Bus No. 81, Jujo Takeda Kaido, is a 2-minute walk (160m) to the west, and the City Bus Minami 5, Jujo Aifukacho, is an 8-minute walk (550m) to the east (look for bus stops in this area). There are toilets in the parking lot. There are men's and disabled-accessible toilets, but I only saw the men's toilet. It was a flush toilet with one stall each for urinals and urinals. There was no bidet, but it was clean enough. There is a handwashing area outside where you can get water, but you can also get water at Aifuka Park, about 500m to the east. The parking lot is mostly flat and can accommodate about 60 cars, but there weren't that many cars parked there considering it was Saturday night. The Times Club website says there is a height restriction of 2.1m, but there was no bar above, and there were campervans parked there overnight, so there doesn't seem to be any particular restriction. For bathing, there is a public bath called Ishida-yu (details) a 4-minute walk (280m) to the west. (Monday to Saturday 3:00 PM - 11:00 PM, closed Sundays) I had planned to go this time, but I drank too much and fell fast asleep, so I couldn't check. I was worried about the noise since it's under a ramp, but there are no houses nearby, and the traffic decreases at night, so I was able to sleep comfortably. The parking lot doesn't have a locking system, so it was probably a good idea to move to the back before going to sleep. In Kyoto, where there are few places to park overnight, it's convenient for going to Kyoto Station and Gion, and the parking fee is cheap, so I think it's a good choice. I referred to the website (details) of the Yukimichi couple. (Posted: March 2023, Yasusugi)

■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場は広め。町の中心部に近いため、近くにスーパーやコンビニもあります。小浜線の三方駅も徒歩10分ほどで行けます。（以下は施設内の張り紙にて見た情報なので、詳細は現地で確認してください）3500円（5枚入浴券付）を購入・フロントに連絡することで車中泊が可能。燃えるゴミ1袋200円で引き取ってもらえる模様（1日単位なのか、何日か置いても料金が変わらないかは不明）営業時間内は施設内のトイレ利用可/時間外は別のトイレの案内がある模様。車中泊時に購入した入浴券の期限は特にない。（投稿：2024年5月、C様）
properties.desc_en:
■Bath♨️: 650 yen, details
■About overnight stays in vehicles [Paid💰️] 👉️Official information
■Report from our site's reader: The parking lot is spacious. It's close to the town center, so there are supermarkets and convenience stores nearby. You can also walk to Mikata Station on the Obama Line in about 10 minutes. (The following information was seen on a notice posted inside the facility, so please check the details on-site.) Overnight stays in vehicles are possible by purchasing 3500 yen (includes 5 bath tickets) and contacting the front desk. It seems that they will take away one bag of combustible garbage for 200 yen (it is unclear whether this is per day or if the price does not change even if you leave it for several days). Toilets inside the facility are available during business hours / outside of business hours, there seems to be a guide to another toilet. There is no particular expiration date for the bath tickets purchased when staying overnight in a vehicle. (Posted: May 2024, C)

properties.desc_en:
■Bath♨️: 480 yen, details

Located next to Kawakami Villa Historical Park, with toilets, running water, and streetlights. (Older post from before 2019)

■入浴♨️：1000円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：HP(詳細)での予約が必要。電源はファミリーサイトのみだが、1～最大3人のソロ、デュオサイトはソロの平日だと｢当日＆翌日入り放題入浴料込1500円＋環境協力費100円｣とかなりの破格。※入浴料は通常平日は1回800円（詳細）この施設は非加熱かけ流し源泉浴槽が良質すぎるため、本当にオススメ。（投稿：2023年9月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en:
■Bathing♨️: 1000 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: Reservations are required via the website (details). Power is only available at the family sites, but the solo and duo sites for 1 to 3 people are incredibly cheap for solo campers on weekdays: "1500 yen + 100 yen environmental cooperation fee for unlimited use of the bath on the day and the next day." *The usual weekday bathing fee is 800 yen per visit (details). This facility is highly recommended because the unheated, free-flowing hot spring bath is of exceptionally high quality. (Posted by yuko, September 2023)

properties.label: Camp Spot + Hot Spring

properties.title_en: Coin parking lot next to Tateba

■8-20時最大900円、夜間20-8時最大500円。タテバ（銭湯、520円）利用で1時間無料。夜間静か。らんたいむ氏が車中泊した場所。トイレはちょっと北（徒歩3分）のファミマを利用する。あるいは、タテバが朝5時まで営業しているので使わせてもらう（風呂に入るときに、隣で車中泊するのでトイレを貸して欲しいと言っておく）。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Bathing♨️: "Healthy Hot Spring Tateba" 600 yen, details
■Maximum 900 yen from 8am to 8pm, maximum 500 yen from 8pm to 8am. One hour free with Tateba (public bath, 520 yen) usage. Quiet at night. This is where Rantime stayed overnight in his car. Use the FamilyMart toilet a little to the north (3-minute walk). Alternatively, you can use Tateba as it's open until 5am (when you go to take a bath, ask to use the toilet as you'll be staying overnight in your car next door). (Older post from before 2019)

■Detailed YouTube report on overnight parking here

properties.label: Camp Spot + Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■入浴♨️：《アクアイグニス　片岡温泉》800円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：一泊2000円で車中泊が可能。添付画像。だが車中泊車は道路と線路を隔てた駐車場へ案内され、トイレまでは徒歩3-4分かかる。ゴミは当然持ち帰り。線路脇の駐車場となるため電車の音はかなり響く。5時台の始発の音で叩き起こされた。温泉は落ち着いていて良いしいちご狩りやオシャレレストラン、パン屋など併設されていて雰囲気は良いが、車中泊は一考の余地あり。他に選択肢があるなら他の場所の方が良いと思う。（投稿：2024年5月、zil415様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：以前は車中泊無料だったようですが、2022年7月から有料になったようです。1泊2,000円／1台、詳細（投稿：2023年2月、h様）
■日帰り入浴施設で車中泊が可能。夜間利用可能なトイレも完備。受付が必ず必要。詳細レポート（2020年）
properties.desc_en:
■Bathing♨️: Aqua Ignis Kataoka Onsen, 800 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: Overnight parking is possible for 2000 yen per night. See attached image. However, overnight parking vehicles are directed to a parking lot separated from the road and railway tracks, and it takes 3-4 minutes to walk to the toilet. Garbage must be taken with you, of course. As the parking lot is next to the railway tracks, the sound of trains is quite loud. I was woken up by the sound of the first train at 5 AM. The hot spring is calm and nice, and there are strawberry picking, a stylish restaurant, a bakery, etc. attached, so the atmosphere is good, but overnight parking is something to consider carefully. If there are other options, I think other places are better. (Posted: May 2024, zil415)
■Report from our site's reader: It seems that overnight parking used to be free, but it has been charged since July 2022. 2,000 yen per night/vehicle, details (Posted: February 2023, h)
■Overnight parking is possible at a day-trip bathing facility. Restrooms are available for use at night. Registration is required. Detailed report (2020)

Water is also available in the footbaths. (Older post from before 2019)

■Elevation: 682m

■内宮目の前の駐車場。トイレあり。駐車場は最大料金無し！青天井！（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■24時間営業。入庫後1時間無料。7-17時：1時間500円、以降30分ごとに100円。17-7時：1時間100円、以降30分ごとに100円。複雑でややこしいが、たとえば19時入庫で翌朝7時出庫の場合、19-20は無料、20-21は100円、21-7時が10時間で2000円、合計2100円となる。結構高いっすね。なお、この付近の市営駐車場はすべて料金同じ。参考ページ（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Parking lot right in front of the Inner Shrine. Toilets available. No maximum charge for parking! Open to the sky! (Older post from before 2019)
■Open 24 hours. First hour free after entry. 7am-5pm: 500 yen for the first hour, then 100 yen for every 30 minutes thereafter. 5pm-7am: 100 yen for the first hour, then 100 yen for every 30 minutes thereafter. It's complicated and confusing, but for example, if you enter at 7pm and leave at 7am the next morning, 7pm-8pm is free, 8pm-9pm is 100 yen, and 9pm-7am is 10 hours for 2000 yen, totaling 2100 yen. That's quite expensive. Note that all municipal parking lots in this area have the same rates. Reference page (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_en: ■Maximum 600 yen per day, 1200 yen per night. Unfortunately, there are no toilets available for use at night, so it's not suitable. (Confirmed on-site by the manager in October 2021)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：和歌山・奈良・三重にまたがる秘境で、まるで山水画の世界。渡れる吊り橋がある。無料駐車場あり。「道の駅おくとろ」から15分程度なのでぜひ立ち寄りたい場所（投稿：2021年10月、くぅくん様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A hidden gem spanning Wakayama, Nara, and Mie prefectures, like something out of a traditional Japanese landscape painting. There's a suspension bridge you can cross. Free parking is available. It's only about 15 minutes from "Michi-no-Eki Okutoro," so it's definitely a place worth visiting (Submitted by: Ku-kun, October 2021)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：霊峰・立山の登山拠点となる巨大な無料駐車場。メインのP1だけで収容200台。トイレは駐車場の入口から道路を渡った先にあり、水洗洋式で綺麗に清掃されている。昼間は満車でも、登山客が帰った夕方以降は空きができるので問題なく利用できる。夜間は駐車場が6割くらい埋まっていたが、泊まり掛けの登山客のものらしく人の気配はなかった。立山駅ケーブルカーの始発が休日6:40・平日7:00で、その時間近くになると登山客が続々と乗り込んで来て騒がしくなる。（投稿：2025年10月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A huge free parking lot that serves as a base for climbing the sacred mountain, Mt. Tateyama. The main P1 alone can accommodate 200 cars. The toilets are located across the road from the entrance to the parking lot and are clean, flush toilets. Even if it's full during the day, there are spaces available in the evening after the climbers have left, so it can be used without any problems. At night, the parking lot was about 60% full, but it seemed to be occupied by climbers staying overnight, and there was no sign of people. The first cable car from Tateyama Station departs at 6:40 on holidays and 7:00 on weekdays, and as it approaches that time, climbers start boarding in droves, and it gets noisy. (Submitted by: y, October 2025)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 宿場町ひらふく
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：隣接の国道R373は、夜間もそれなりに交通量があり、その走行音が気になる。国道に面した第一駐車場よりは、少し離れたところにある第二駐車場（展望台駐車場）の方がまだマシだが、それでも走行音が気になる。静かな夜を過ごしたい人にはオススメしない。（投稿：2023年4月、y様）
■佐用のホルモンうどん巡りの拠点に（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: The adjacent National Highway R373 has a fair amount of traffic even at night, and the noise from the vehicles is bothersome. The second parking lot (observation deck parking lot), which is a little further away, is better than the first parking lot which faces the national highway, but the noise from the vehicles is still noticeable. Not recommended for those who want to spend a quiet night. (Submitted by: y, April 2023)
■A base for exploring Sayo's hormone udon (older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 十二町潟オニバス発生地公衆トイレ
properties.title_en: Public toilets at the habitat of the giant water lily in Jūnimachi-gata
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：料金：無料。十二町潟水郷公園内のスポットだが、表側からは公園内の橋を徒歩か何かで渡るか、車で大回りするしか行く手段がないため普段は人がいない。(但しオニバス開花時期除く？)　トイレは水洗和式以外に多目的の洋式水洗がある。表側よりはるかに静かで昼間でも寝られます(笑)（投稿：2022年4月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Price: Free. This spot is located within the Jūnimachigata Suigo Park, but the only way to get there from the front is to cross a bridge within the park on foot or take a long detour by car, so it's usually deserted. (Except during the blooming season of the giant water lilies?) In addition to flush toilets, there are also multi-purpose Western-style flush toilets. It's much quieter than the front and you can even sleep there during the day (lol) (Submitted by yuko, April 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：料金：無料。高速インターからすぐ、の立地ながら森に囲まれてる感じのため静か。テニスコート前の駐車場が洋式ウォシュレットのトイレに近く便利だが、より静かさを求めるなら和式水洗トイレになるが陸上競技場側もあり。私が行った夕方でも施設使用されてなければ静かだったので、オススメ！（投稿：2022年4月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Price: Free. Despite being located right off the highway interchange, it feels quiet because it's surrounded by a forest. The parking lot in front of the tennis courts is convenient as it's close to the Western-style toilets with bidets, but if you're looking for even quieter facilities, there are also Japanese-style flush toilets on the athletics field side. Even when I went in the evening, it was quiet because the facilities weren't being used, so I recommend it! (Posted by yuko, April 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 富山新港元気の森公園
properties.title_en: Toyama Shinminato Genki no Mori Park
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：料金：無料、トイレ：有。パークゴルフ場側駐車場は和式と普通の洋式水洗だが、公園側の管理棟側トイレの多目的がウォシュレットで早朝6時頃でも入ったら自動点灯する。駐車場はかなり広いが、海側の一部は17〜9時閉鎖とある。実はその閉鎖ゾーン前の側が綺麗なウォシュレットありトイレに近くお勧め。車中泊でなく早朝に来たが、新湊大橋からは多少離れていて静か。ここからもう少し行ったところに海老江海浜公園があるが、夏期は夜間閉鎖、監視カメラありとおすすめが正直できない。（投稿：2022年4月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Price: Free, Toilets: Available. The parking lot on the park golf course side has Japanese-style and regular Western-style flush toilets, but the multipurpose toilet on the management building side of the park has a bidet and the light turns on automatically when you enter, even as early as 6am. The parking lot is quite large, but part of the seaside is closed from 5pm to 9am. Actually, the area just before that closed zone is close to a nice toilet with a bidet and is recommended. I came early in the morning, not for overnight parking, and it was quiet as it is a little distance from the Shinminato Bridge. Ebie Seaside Park is a little further from here, but it is closed at night during the summer and has surveillance cameras, so I honestly can't recommend it. (Submitted by yuko in April 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：料金：無料、トイレ：あり。来たのは夕方だが、止まってる車がまず少なかった。トイレは男女別が和式で、多目的が洋式だが、電気がつかなかった。車中泊の場合懐中電灯かヘッドライト必須。地図は野球場側だが、もう少し国道寄りのプール側でもできそう。（投稿：2022年4月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Price: Free, Toilets: Available. I arrived in the evening, but there were hardly any cars parked there. The toilets are separate for men and women and are Japanese style, while the multipurpose toilet is Western style, but the lights didn't work. A flashlight or headlamp is essential if you plan to stay overnight in your car. The map shows the baseball field side, but it seems like it would also be possible to use the pool side, which is closer to the national highway. (Submitted by yuko, April 2022)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：料金：550円、公式サイト。営業時間：10:00～21:00、2人用と小さいがサウナあり、お湯は源泉掛け流し。（投稿：2025年4月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Price: 550 yen, official website. Opening hours: 10:00-21:00, there is a small sauna for two people, and the hot spring water is free-flowing. (Submitted by: yuko, April 2025)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: グランスパ かの苑
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：料金：500円。営業時間：11:00～23:00(最終入館22:00)　公式サイト。駐車場が普通車120台分と広く、停め方ルールはあるが大型車も駐車可能。(つまりトレーラーやバスコンも行ける)　お風呂自体は源泉2本あり、湯使いとしては加水加温半循環。コインランドリーも併設で22時まで営業。マッサージ機、チェアは無料。（投稿：2025年3月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Price: 500 yen. Opening hours: 11:00-23:00 (last entry 22:00). Official website. The parking lot is spacious with space for 120 regular cars, and although there are parking rules, large vehicles can also park there. (In other words, trailers and bus conversions can also go.) The bath itself has two hot spring sources, and the water is heated, diluted, and partially recirculated. There is also a coin laundry on-site, open until 22:00. Massage chairs and massage machines are free of charge. (Submitted by: yuko, March 2025)

properties.label: Campground + Shower
properties.title_ja: AYABE PEACE Park&Camp（あやべピースパークアンドキャンプ、キャンプ場）
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：料金：￥8,800+施設利用料、料金詳細。高さ制限：なし。施設（すべて２４H対応）：トイレ、シャワー、多目的トイレ、炊事場　（電源はサイトによる）。ゴミ：受け入れ可。施設内での車の出入り：7時～22時（投稿：2025年7月、やま様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Price: ¥8,800 + facility usage fee, detailed price information. Height restriction: None. Facilities (all 24-hour): Toilets, showers, multi-purpose toilets, cooking area (power supply varies by site). Garbage: Accepted. Vehicle access within the facility: 7am to 10pm (Posted by: Yama, July 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：利用料金（無料)、駐車場が夜間閉鎖されない。トイレのスペック（水洗洋式)。トイレが夜間閉鎖されない。（投稿：2025年10月、テツシ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Usage fee (free), parking lot is not closed at night. Toilet specifications (flush toilet, Western style). Toilets are not closed at night. (Submitted by: Tetsushi, October 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：利用料金：無料です。トイレの有無：駐車場内に公衆トイレがあります。 使い終わったら消灯にご協力お願いします。静かさ：私が行った日の夜景は絶景でした。 山頂なので静かですけど、アベックのデートコースですね。その他ポイントなど1kmほど下にきららオートキャンプ場があります。 管理人のおっちゃんに聞いたところ、営業期間は5/1-10/30とのこと。 新しい施設ですし見晴らしもいいです。入浴施設日帰り入浴も可能な「ささみね」が4km下にあります。詳細 19:00-21:00来場の場合は200円引の410円で入浴可能です。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■標高643mで夏も涼しそう。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's readers: Usage fee: Free. Toilet availability: There is a public toilet in the parking lot. Please cooperate by turning off the lights after use. Quietness: The night view on the day I went was spectacular. It's quiet because it's on a mountaintop, but it's a great date spot for couples. Other points: About 1km down is Kirara Auto Campground. I asked the caretaker, and he said the operating period is from May 1st to October 30th. It's a new facility and the view is great. Bathing facilities: There is a bathhouse called "Sasamine" 4km down which also offers day-use bathing. Details: If you arrive between 19:00 and 21:00, you can bathe for 410 yen (200 yen discount). (Older post from before 2019)
■At an altitude of 643m, it seems like it would be cool even in summer. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Camp Spot + Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 市営下呂温泉第3駐車場
properties.title_en: [Paid] Municipal Gero Onsen Parking Lot No. 3
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：夕方の６時ごろから翌日の11時まで駐車しました。1500円、入庫２４時間まで。市の観光課に24時間まで1500円確認済み、平日に停めて自分以外は2台停めてました。トイレは綺麗なトイレあり、男　小３　大１、女は不明。たぶん、他の市営も24時間最大料金1500円だと思います。近くに24時間営業のやまざきのコンビニあり。標高370m。（投稿：2025年6月、TOM様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: I parked from around 6 PM until 11 AM the next day. 1500 yen, for up to 24 hours. I confirmed with the city's tourism department that it's 1500 yen for up to 24 hours. I parked on a weekday and there were only two other cars parked there besides mine.
