There are clean toilets; men's: 3 urinals, 1 stall; women's: unknown. I think other city-run parking lots probably also have a 1500 yen maximum charge for 24 hours. There is a 24-hour Yamazaki convenience store nearby. Elevation: 370m. (Submitted by TOM, June 2025)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：友ヶ島詳細 旧日本軍の砲台跡等の見所あり。本土（和歌山加太港：駐車料金1日500円）から船で往復2000円。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Details of Tomogashima Island There are sights to see, such as the remains of former Japanese military gun emplacements. Round trip by boat from the mainland (Wakayama Kada Port: parking fee 500 yen per day) costs 2000 yen.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 石垣池公園 鈴鹿の車中泊スポット
properties.title_en: Ishigaki Pond Park, a car camping spot in Suzuka""
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：夜間閉鎖の看板＆チェーン等は無かったので車中泊は可能かと思われる。県道沿いに駐車場はありますがお勧めは北東側の住宅街側の駐車場。歩けていける範囲にコンビニやファミレス有り。F1や8耐拠点に良さそう。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There were no signs or chains indicating a nighttime closure, so it seems possible to park overnight. There is a parking lot along the prefectural road, but the recommended one is the parking lot on the northeast side, near the residential area. There are convenience stores and family restaurants within walking distance. Seems like a good base for F1 or the Suzuka 8 Hours endurance race. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：夜間でも駐車場・トイレは閉鎖されません。突き当りの駐車場はトイレに近く道路から離れているため静か。時間によってはセントレア発着の飛行機が上空飛ぶためちょっとうるさい。女性用のみ確認ですがトイレは水洗、洗面所、石鹸あり。和式1、洋式1でキレイ。夜間も照明消されません。飲み物自販機あり。夜間の注意点として、駐車場からトイレへ向かう通路にチェーンが張られていて暗くてよく見えないので引っ掛けて転ばないように。夜間は真ん中もチェーン張られています。昼間の状態→詳細。倉庫地帯という場所柄夜間は人気がなく治安は自己責任。（投稿：2023年7月、s様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: The parking lot and restrooms are not closed at night. The parking lot at the end of the road is quiet as it is close to the restrooms and away from the road. Depending on the time, planes taking off and landing at Chubu Centrair International Airport fly overhead, so it can be a bit noisy. I only checked the women's restroom, but it has flush toilets, a sink, and soap. There is one Japanese-style toilet and one Western-style toilet, and they are clean. The lights are not turned off at night. There is a vending machine for drinks. A word of caution at night: there is a chain stretched across the path from the parking lot to the restrooms, and it is dark and hard to see, so be careful not to trip over it and fall. There is also a chain in the middle at night. Daytime conditions → details. Due to the location being a warehouse area, there are not many people around at night, so safety is your own responsibility. (Submitted by: s, July 2023)

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.title_ja: 住之江公園駅付近駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：夜間21:00-8:00 180分100円（3時間で100円）、8:00-21:00 60分200円 の駐車場あり。お風呂:スパスミノエは夜12時までで駐車場完備。お手洗い:近くのファミマにお手洗いあり(のちのために、利用時、お買い物はしましょう)。お手洗い2:駅前のドン・キホーテが朝五時まで営業。松屋も入ってるビルのためもしかしたら朝5時以降も利用可能。お買い物:ドン・キホーテがあるので、朝食パンや飲み物、洗面道具を揃えるのにも最適。駐車場:選べばわりかし静かなところも。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: There is a parking lot available at night from 9:00 PM to 8:00 AM for 100 yen for 180 minutes (100 yen for 3 hours), and from 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM for 200 yen for 60 minutes. Bath: Spa Suminoe is open until midnight and has a parking lot. Restrooms: There are restrooms at the nearby FamilyMart (please make a purchase when using them for future reference). Restroom 2: Don Quijote in front of the station is open until 5 AM. Since it is in the same building as Matsuya, it may be usable even after 5 AM. Shopping: With Don Quijote nearby, it is ideal for stocking up on breakfast bread, drinks, and toiletries. Parking: If you choose carefully, you can find relatively quiet spots. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.title_ja: 大須大光院 コインパーキング
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：明王殿の西側の有料駐車場。夜間18:00-8:00の料金が200円でした。夜間だけなら大須最安値？添付画像（投稿：2021年12月、参拝業者えーご様）
■トイレは近隣のコンビニか、この周辺に公衆トイレがいくつかある（詳細）。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Paid parking lot west of Myo-o-den. The fee was 200 yen for nighttime hours (18:00-8:00). Perhaps the cheapest in Osu if only for nighttime? (Attached image, posted by: Eigo, a pilgrimage service provider, December 2021)

■For toilets, there are several public toilets in the vicinity, either at a nearby convenience store (details).

properties.label: Highway Rest + Shower
properties.title_ja: 大津SA（下り側にシャワーあり）
properties.title_en: Otsu Service Area (showers available on the southbound side)
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：名神高速 大津SA 下り線(大阪方面行き)について。小型車と大型車が完全に分離されているので、深夜の大型トラック占拠に悩むことがないです。ただしたまに4ｔ車ぐらいは入ってきます。小型車用の駐車場の一番奥にもトイレあり。24h営業のマクドナルドあり。SAなので基本的に騒がしいですが、ずいぶんマシだと思います。（投稿：2023年11月、d様）
■下り側にコインシャワー（300円/10分、24時間営業）、コインランドリーあり。詳細
■高速本線から分離は良いのだが、SA利用車両が非常に多く、一晩中騒がしい。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Reader Report: Regarding the Meishin Expressway Otsu Service Area (downbound, towards Osaka). Small and large vehicles are completely separated, so you don't have to worry about large trucks occupying the space late at night. However, occasionally a 4-ton truck will enter. There are also toilets at the very back of the small vehicle parking area. There's a 24-hour McDonald's. It's a service area, so it's generally noisy, but it's much better than that. (Submitted by: d, November 2023)

■Coin-operated showers (300 yen/10 minutes, 24-hour operation) and a coin laundry are available on the downbound side. Details

■The separation from the main expressway is good, but there are a lot of vehicles using the service area, making it noisy all night long. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 滑川市スポーツ・健康の森公園
properties.title_en: Namerikawa City Sports and Health Forest Park
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。この場所以外にもかなり大きい駐車場があるが、添付画像（添付画像）のポールらしきものがあり、もしかして夜間閉鎖かもしれない。(立て看板等の特記はなしなので、閉鎖されないかもしれないが不明) ここはそのようなもの見当たらず夜間も使える。トイレはどちらも駐車場内かほぼ隣接で、ウォシュレットと普通の洋式水洗だった。男女別＋多目的と使いやすい。（投稿：2023年2月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free parking and public restrooms. There are other fairly large parking lots besides this one, but there are pole-like structures as shown in the attached image (attached image), so they might be closed at night. (There are no signs or anything special indicating that they are closed, so it's unclear whether they are closed or not.) There are no such structures here, so they are usable at night. Both restrooms are either inside the parking lot or almost adjacent to it, and they have bidet toilets and regular Western-style flush toilets. They are separate for men and women, plus a multi-purpose restroom, making them easy to use. (Submitted by yuko in February 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 県道沿いの無料駐車場
properties.title_en: Free parking along the prefectural road
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料駐車場とトイレ。ただし、駐車場内には「長時間利用・車中泊の自粛をお願いします」の看板がある。交通量は少ないが道路沿いなのでうるさいかも。（投稿：2021年10月、くぅくん様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free parking and restrooms. However, there is a sign in the parking lot asking people to refrain from using the parking lot for extended periods or staying overnight in their vehicles. Although traffic is light, it may be noisy as it is located along a road. (Submitted by: Kuu-kun, October 2021)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_en: Tsueishi Agricultural and Forestry Products Direct Sales Outlet
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料駐車場。夜間は、トイレのみです。止めている車は大変少なく、静かな夜を過ごしたい方向け。国道の交通量も夜間は少なめです。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free parking. Only the toilets are available at night. There are very few cars parked there, making it ideal for those who want a quiet night. Traffic on the national highway is also light at night. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料駐車場、トイレ有り、但し、駐車場に外灯なし（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Free parking and restrooms available, however, there are no streetlights in the parking lot (older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料の駐車場でトイレは一応ありますが、砂が入ってくるのであまり綺麗とは言えませんが水洗です。駐車場には店舗が２店ほどありますが、夕方早くには閉めてしまいます。多くの方は伊良湖先端の道の駅「クリスタルポルト」に行くのでたいへん静かです。夏の早朝は釣り客が多いです（土日限定ですが）。このすぐ上に伊良湖ビューホテルがあり、そこのお風呂が使えます。値段は１６００円（税込み）、13:00〜24:00。コンビニは車で５分ほどにあります。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There is a toilet in the free parking lot, but it's not very clean as sand gets in, although it is a flush toilet. There are a couple of shops in the parking lot, but they close early in the evening. Most people go to the roadside station "Crystal Port" at the tip of Irago, so it's very quiet. There are many anglers in the early morning during the summer (weekends only). The Irago View Hotel is just above here, and you can use their bath. The price is 1600 yen (tax included), from 13:00 to 24:00. There is a convenience store about a 5 minute drive away. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.title_ja: 奥びわ湖パークウェイつづら尾崎展望台
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料の広い駐車場とトイレ。海津大崎からのワインディングロードを登った展望台で、長浜市方面が一望できる。20時〜翌8時が通行止めとなるので、その間は駐車場から出入りはできない。車中泊禁止の看板は見当たらなかったが、キャンプ・焚火禁止の看板はあった。下りは2021年9月現在、岩熊方面行きの道路が工事通行止めとなっているので、来た道を海津大崎方向に戻ることとなる。冬季は通行止めとなるので紅葉シーズンまでが見頃。（投稿：2021年10月、くぅくん様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There is a large free parking lot and restrooms. The observation deck, reached by climbing the winding road from Kaizu-Osaki, offers a panoramic view of Nagahama City. The road is closed from 8 PM to 8 AM the following day, so you cannot enter or exit the parking lot during that time. There were no signs prohibiting overnight parking, but there were signs prohibiting camping and bonfires. As of September 2021, the road towards Iwakuma is closed for construction, so you will have to return the way you came towards Kaizu-Osaki. The road is closed during the winter, so the best time to visit is during the autumn foliage season. (Submitted by: Ku-kun, October 2021)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料トイレあり。夜はとても静かです。温泉は4.3km離れた白龍の湯があります。駐車場は狭いので大型キャンピングカーは、昼間に行くといいかも。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free toilets available. It's very quiet at night. The nearest hot spring is Hakuryu-no-Yu, 4.3km away. The parking lot is small, so it might be better to go during the day if you have a large campervan. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 福井県大野市市役所（<font color="red">※トイレ不明</font>）
properties.title_en: 福井 Pref.大野-shi-shi役所（<font color="red">※トイレ不明</font>）
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料で開放しています。※冬の大雪には注意。駐車場内を除雪されるかは分かりません。（投稿：2024年2月、h様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: It's open to the public for free. *Be careful during heavy snow in winter. It's unclear whether the parking lot will be cleared of snow. (Submitted by: h, February 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料：会館の外にトイレあり。また、キャンピングカー専用のトイレが海側に完成。騒音等の心配なし 静か 市祭６月第１土日、輪島大祭８月２３〜２５は駐車できない。マリンタウンも同じ。海釣り可能（４月中旬〜１月初旬）。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Free: There are toilets outside the hall. Also, a toilet specifically for campervans has been completed on the seaside. No worries about noise, it's quiet. Parking is not available during the city festival on the first Saturday and Sunday of June, and during the Wajima Grand Festival from August 23rd to 25th. The same applies to Marine Town. Sea fishing is possible (mid-April to early January). (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料：トイレはキリコ会館又はキャンピングカー専用を使用 静か。海釣り可能（４月中旬〜１月初旬）。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Free: Toilets are available at Kiriko Hall or exclusively for campervans. Quiet. Sea fishing is possible (mid-April to early January). (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: （トイレ無し）マリンタウン右端の駐車場
properties.title_en: (No restrooms) Parking lot at the far right of Marine Town
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料：トイレ、水道なし 静か。海釣り可能（４月中旬〜１月初旬）。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Free: No toilets or running water. Quiet. Sea fishing possible (mid-April to early January). (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料：トイレ、水道あり。トイレはあまりよくない。海釣り可能（４月中旬〜１月初旬）。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Free: Toilets and running water available. Toilets are not very good. Sea fishing is possible (mid-April to early January). (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: ふるさと体験実習館横駐車場
properties.title_en: Parking lot next to the Hometown Experience Training Center
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料：トイレ、水道あり 静か。海釣り可能（４月中旬〜１月初旬）。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Free: Toilets and running water available. Quiet. Sea fishing possible (mid-April to early January). (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料：トイレ、水道あり 静か。ここからも歩いて７〜８分でキリコ会館に行けます。近くにお食事処「のと一」があります。輪島の海山川の幸が安く味わえます。※輪島市や奥能登の道の駅は、他所の道の駅の感覚で訪れるとがっかりします。車中泊は可能です。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Free: Toilets and running water available. Quiet. You can walk to Kiriko Hall in 7-8 minutes from here. There is a restaurant called "Notoichi" nearby. You can enjoy Wajima's seafood, mountain and river delicacies at reasonable prices. *If you visit roadside stations in Wajima City or Oku-Noto with the same expectations as other roadside stations, you will be disappointed. Overnight parking is possible. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料：トイレ、水道あり 静か 夕日がきれい。海釣り可能（４月中旬〜１月初旬）。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Free: Toilets and running water available. Quiet. Beautiful sunsets. Sea fishing possible (mid-April to early January). (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 道下サンセットパーク
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料：トイレ、水道あり 国道沿いだが、田舎なので静か。海釣り可能（４月中旬〜１月初旬）。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Free: Toilets and running water available. Located along a national highway, but quiet because it's in the countryside. Sea fishing is possible (mid-April to early January). (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料：トイレ、水道あり ６台しか駐車できない 夏場は海水浴客がうるさいかも。それ以外は静か。垣根で１台ごと仕切られています。海釣り可能（４月中旬〜１月初旬）。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Free: Toilets and running water available. Only 6 parking spaces. May be noisy with swimmers in the summer. Quiet otherwise. Each space is separated by a hedge. Sea fishing is possible (mid-April to early January). (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料、トイレ有り。交通量は少なめの為、静か。眺めの良い海岸沿い、但し遊泳不可。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Free, toilets available. Quiet due to light traffic. A scenic coastal area, but swimming is prohibited. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: （夜間閉鎖）三木総合防災公園東ゲートメイン駐車場
properties.title_en: (Closed at night) Miki Comprehensive Disaster Prevention Park East Gate Main Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料、トイレありです。ゲートがあり8:45-17:30は入門できる（時間外出れるかは分からない）。車中泊車無かったのと時間外出れるか分からないのでよう泊まれませんでした。（投稿：2025年9月、タコラ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: It's free and has toilets. There's a gate, and you can enter from 8:45 to 17:30 (I'm not sure if you can go outside of those hours). There weren't any cars parked overnight, and I wasn't sure if I could go outside of those hours, so I couldn't really stay overnight. (Posted by Takora in September 2025)

properties.label: Free Campground
properties.title_ja: 勢和村キャンプ場（無料キャンプ場）
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料・トイレ有・５０台ほど収容可能・火気使用可能・川で遊泳可能 （水はとてもきれい）・夏場はオートキャンプの車でにぎわう・（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Free, toilets available, can accommodate about 50 cars, open fires allowed, swimming in the river is possible (the water is very clean), gets crowded with campers in the summer (older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 海南サクアス
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：本日、和歌山県の【道の駅 海南サクアス】に来ております。2023/9/2にオープンしたばかりということでもちろん綺麗です。大型車と小型車離れられるので静かに過ごせると思います。駐車場は割とフラットだと思います。トイレは感知式で電灯が点きます。隣にデイリーヤマザキがありまして、店外にゴミ箱があります。物産館が9:00～17:00で営業です。館内にゴミ箱があるので、営業時間中に来れば捨てられます。（投稿：2023年9月、m様）
■2023年9月2日オープン。公式サイト
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: Today I'm at the [Michi-no-Eki Kainan Sakuas] in Wakayama Prefecture. It just opened on September 2nd, 2023, so of course it's very clean. Large and small vehicles are separated, so it's a quiet place to relax. The parking lot is fairly flat. The toilets have motion-activated lights. There's a Daily Yamazaki convenience store next door, and there are trash cans outside. The local products shop is open from 9:00 to 17:00. There are trash cans inside the shop, so you can dispose of your trash if you come during business hours. (Submitted by: m, September 2023)

■Opened September 2nd, 2023. Official website

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 木場潟公園 西園地
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：北陸新幹線の高架に隣接した立地なので、新幹線が通るたびに轟音が響く。以前は閑静な立地だったが、現在はかなり騒々しい環境。新幹線マニアでもない限りはオススメできない。（投稿：2024年6月、y様）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間もあいてる。トイレは超キレイな水洗洋式ウォシュレットで夜も電気つく。22時以降は超静かで最高。ただし人気が無いので逆に治安的な不安あり。少し傾斜あり。（2020年4月管理人現地確認）
■当サイト読者様レポート：広い駐車場と充実した設備を持つ公園。日没後は公園のライトアップもあり人が多数いますが、深夜は幹線道路からも離れているため静か。24時間利用可能なトイレあり、駐車場閉鎖なし。展望休憩所付近では6〜22時まで小松市公衆無線LANサービス利用可（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Located next to the elevated tracks of the Hokuriku Shinkansen, it roars every time a Shinkansen passes by. It used to be a quiet location, but now it's quite noisy. Not recommended unless you're a Shinkansen enthusiast. (Posted: June 2024, by y)

■Free parking and public toilets. Open at night. The toilets are super clean, flushable Western-style toilets with bidet functions, and the lights are on at night. It's incredibly quiet after 10 PM, which is great. However, because there are so few people, there are safety concerns. There's a slight slope. (Administrator's on-site verification, April 2020)

■Report from a reader of this site: A park with a large parking lot and excellent facilities. There are many people after sunset due to the park's lighting, but it's quiet late at night because it's away from the main road. There are 24-hour toilets, and the parking lot is never closed. Komatsu City's public Wi-Fi service is available near the observation rest area from 6 AM to 10 PM (older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 水口スポーツの森駐車場
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：防災公園も兼ねた広大な敷地の公園。駐車場は各所に分散してあるが、トイレが併設されている第三駐車場(P3)がオススメ。トイレは水洗ウオシュレット付きで綺麗に清掃されている。公衆トイレとしては申し分ないレベル。夜は訪れる人もなく、閑静な一夜を過ごせる。駐車場の電灯が煌々と灯っていたが、22:30に消灯された。（投稿：2025年5月、y様）
■標高184m
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: A vast park that also serves as a disaster prevention park. While parking is scattered throughout the area, the third parking lot (P3), which has restrooms, is recommended. The restrooms are clean and equipped with flush toilets and bidets. They are more than adequate for public restrooms. At night, there are no visitors, allowing for a peaceful evening. The parking lot lights were brightly lit but were turned off at 10:30 PM. (Submitted by: y, May 2025)
■Elevation: 184m

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：菩提寺ＰＡ（名神上り）最近、施設が改装され、トイレがきれいになりました。手前の草津ＰＡ、次の黒丸ＰＡにはコンビニがあるので利用客が多いのですが、ここはショップ・フードコートも7:00〜20:00までしか営業しておらず、比較的利用者が少ない穴場的ＰＡです。上り線だけは普通車と大型車が分離されているので車中泊には意外と良いかも。手前の草津ＰＡにはコンビニやシャワーがあるので、立ち寄って買い物やシャワーを済ませた後に菩提寺に移動して寝る手もありかな。ここのちゃんぽんは美味しくてボリュームもあるのでお勧めです。昼過ぎに売り切れることもあり人気メニューです。びっくりうどんはかきあげがアホみたいにデカイが味は普通。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Bodaiji PA (Meishin Expressway, northbound) The facilities were recently renovated, and the toilets are now clean. The nearby Kusatsu PA and the next Kuromaru PA have convenience stores and are therefore used by many people, but this PA is relatively less crowded, as the shops and food court are only open from 7:00 to 20:00. The northbound side is separated into regular cars and large vehicles, so it might be surprisingly good for overnight stays in your car. The nearby Kusatsu PA has a convenience store and showers, so you could stop by there to do some shopping and take a shower before heading to Bodaiji to sleep. The champon here is delicious and has a generous portion, so I recommend it. It's a popular menu item and sometimes sells out by early afternoon. The "Bikkuri Udon" has a ridiculously huge tempura, but the taste is just average. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 砺波総合運動公園 第5駐車場
properties.title_en: Tonami General Sports Park, Parking Lot 5""
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：別に紹介した｢砺波運動公園｣の河川敷グラウンドの駐車場です。前紹介した野球場の裏側になるが行くには遠回りしないといけない。トイレはあるが、黒いボタンを押すタイプの仮設の？和式水洗。添付画像1、添付画像2（投稿：2022年8月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: This is the parking lot for the riverside grounds at Tonami Sports Park, which we introduced separately. It's behind the baseball field we introduced earlier, but you have to take a roundabout route to get there. There are toilets, but they are temporary, Japanese-style flush toilets with a black button to press. Attached images 1 and 2 (Submitted by yuko in August 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 安宅海浜公園 駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：別に紹介されている安宅の関から小松市街方向へ直進し、曲がって(多少複雑なためナビ必須)住宅街通り抜けたところにある。見た目古そうな駐車場内トイレが和式で…と思って奥の｢洋式｣の室内見たらウォシュレットでまさかの良環境。駐車場もかなり大きく入口が複数あり、車止めも見当たらず夜間閉鎖はなさそう。看板見たところ｢調整池として設計されていて、大雨の場合水溜まり20cmになる場合ある｣とあったため天気予報注意。海にかなり近く、安宅の関と違い風や波の音は響く。👉️後日追記：泊まってみたが、数台車は置いてあるようだが車中泊してるのは恐らく私だけ。夜間にも多少車の出入りはあったり、朝に地元民がラジオ流しながら草むしりしていて気にはなったが、どちらもトイレより海側(そこは車いなかった)に止めるなどして多少の解決は可能。雰囲気的に車の中で注意して火器使う程度なら問題なし。トイレは点灯しないため、懐中電灯やライト必要。(LEDランタン持って入って用を済ませた)（投稿：2023年4月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: From Ataka no Seki, which is introduced separately, head straight towards Komatsu city center, then turn (it's a bit complicated, so navigation is essential) and you'll find it after going through a residential area. The toilet in the parking lot looks old and is a Japanese style... but when I looked inside the Western style toilet at the back, it had a bidet, which was a pleasant surprise. The parking lot is quite large with multiple entrances and no car stops, so it doesn't seem to be closed at night. A sign said that it is designed as a retention pond and that puddles can reach 20cm in the event of heavy rain, so check the weather forecast. It is quite close to the sea, and unlike Ataka no Seki, you can hear the wind and waves. 👉️Added later: I stayed there, and although there seemed to be several cars parked there, I think I was the only one sleeping in my car. There was some car traffic at night, and in the morning locals were weeding while listening to the radio, which bothered me, but both can be somewhat resolved by parking on the sea side of the toilet (where there were no cars). The atmosphere suggests that using fire in a car, as long as you're careful, shouldn't be a problem. The toilets don't have lights, so you'll need a flashlight or other light. (I brought an LED lantern and used it to relieve myself.) (Posted by yuko, April 2023)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: 能勢町役場 けやき資料館 駐車場
properties.title_en: Nose Town Hall Keyaki Museum Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：閉鎖されており使用できませんでした。（投稿：2022年10月、m様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：24時間トイレ&24時間無料駐車場。かなり快適です。（投稿：2021年11月、参拝業者えーご様）
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: It was closed and unusable. (Posted: October 2022, by Ms. M)
■ Reader Report: 24-hour toilets & 24-hour free parking. Quite convenient. (Posted: November 2021, by Eigo, a shrine visitor)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：伏見稲荷大社詳細 外国人観光客が選ぶ日本の観光地第1位（千本鳥居が特に人気）。境内に無料駐車場あり（年末年始閉鎖）。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website readers: Details of Fushimi Inari Taisha Shrine. Ranked No. 1 among Japanese tourist destinations chosen by foreign tourists (the Senbon Torii is particularly popular). Free parking available on the shrine grounds (closed during the New Year holidays).

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：舞鶴市の絶景ポイント。駐車場は下から大型車利用可能な第一、マイクロバス用、トイレと展望タワーのある第二と三箇所ありますが、第二駐車場は横方向への傾斜がきつく夜まで地元FMラジオを屋外スピーカーで流しているので車中泊するなら第一駐車場がベスト。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A scenic spot in Maizuru City. There are three parking lots: the first one for large vehicles, one for minibuses, and the second one with toilets and an observation tower. However, the second parking lot has a steep lateral slope and plays local FM radio on outdoor speakers until night, so the first parking lot is best if you plan to stay overnight in your car. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 日高川ふれあい水辺公園
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車90台級の駐車場。トイレは男・女・多目的がひとつずつあり、簡易的なトイレながら清掃状態は悪くない。高速道路がすぐ近くなので、大型車や爆音バイクが通るとやや騒々しいが、夜も更けると交通量も落ち着くので、安眠の妨げにはならない。（投稿：2025年5月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A parking lot that can accommodate about 90 regular cars. There is one men's, one women's, and one multipurpose toilet, and although they are simple toilets, they are not badly clean. The highway is very close by, so it can be a bit noisy when large vehicles and loud motorcycles pass by, but the traffic calms down as night falls, so it does not disturb a good night's sleep. (Submitted by: y, May 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車600台！の広大な駐車場は素晴らしい。トイレは綺麗な水洗洋式ウオシュレット付き。目の前の新湊大橋に向かう車の騒音は気になるが、夜が更ければ交通量も減るので安眠の妨げになるほどではない。また、新湊大橋は夜間ライトアップされるので、消灯時間の22時まではそれなりに人が来る。個人的には、トイレの裏・貴婦人館の裏にある駐車スペースがオススメ。※2024/5に利用（投稿：2024年6月、y様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：料金：無料、トイレ：有り。マップではトイレが臨時休業とあるが、見た感じ普通に使えそうだった。トイレはウォシュレットもあり、その点は良いが橋への道路に囲まれてるせいか車の音が気になる。ここも早朝に来た上での評価。別に道路挟んだ船のある側にも駐車場はあるがそこは見ていない。（投稿：2022年4月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: The vast parking lot with space for 600 regular cars is fantastic. The toilets are clean, flushable Western-style toilets with bidets. The noise from cars heading towards the Shinminato Bridge in front is noticeable, but the traffic decreases as night falls, so it's not enough to disturb sleep. Also, the Shinminato Bridge is lit up at night, so there are a fair number of people until the lights are turned off at 10 PM. Personally, I recommend the parking spaces behind the toilets and behind the Lady's Hall. *Used in May 2024 (Posted: June 2024, by y)

■Report from our website reader: Price: Free, Toilets: Available. The map shows the toilets as temporarily closed, but they looked like they were usable. The toilets have bidets, which is good, but the noise from cars is noticeable, probably because it's surrounded by roads leading to the bridge. This evaluation is based on visiting early in the morning. There is also a parking lot on the other side of the road where the boats are, but I didn't check that one out. (Posted: April 2022, by yuko)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車50台級の無料駐車場。トイレは水洗洋式の多目的トイレもあり、綺麗に清掃されている。公衆トイレとしては文句なしのレベル。夜は無人状態となるので、治安については自己責任。幹線道路から完全に分離されており、閑静な一夜を過ごせる。（投稿：2025年10月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A free parking lot with space for about 50 regular cars. The toilets are clean and have a multi-purpose toilet with flush toilets. As a public toilet, it's absolutely excellent. It's unmanned at night, so safety is at your own risk. It's completely separated from the main road, so you can spend a quiet night. (Submitted by: y, October 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車40台級の無料駐車場。トレイは水洗和式＋多目的の洋式で清掃状態も良好。多目的トイレはトイレ建屋の正面ではなく横面に設置されている。隣接する道路は夜間の交通量も少なく、静かな夜を過ごせる。※2024/5に利用（投稿：2024年6月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Free parking lot with space for 40 regular cars. The toilets are flushable Japanese style and a multi-purpose Western style, and are in good condition. The multi-purpose toilet is located on the side of the toilet building, not the front. The adjacent road has little traffic at night, allowing for a quiet evening. *Used in May 2024 (Posted: June 2024, by y)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車300台級の駐車場。トイレは水洗洋式で清掃状態も良好。広大な敷地の公園で、夜の静かさは申し分ない。駐車場は第一・第二・第三があるが、すべて夜間開放されている模様。投稿者は第二駐車場を利用したが、快適な一夜を過ごせた。（投稿：2025年5月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A parking lot with space for approximately 300 regular cars. The toilets are flush toilets and are in good condition. It's a vast park, and the quietness at night is exceptional. There are three parking lots (First, Second, and Third), and it seems that all of them are open at night. The poster used the Second parking lot and had a comfortable night. (Posted by: y, May 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車20台級の無料駐車場。トイレは水洗洋式で清掃状態も良好。山中にあるものの、石川県側からのアクセスルートは観光バスでもOKなレベルで整備されている。夜間は無人状態となるので閑静な一夜を過ごせる。熊が出没しそうな場所柄なので注意しましょう。※2024/5に利用（投稿：2024年6月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A free parking lot that can accommodate about 20 regular cars. The toilets are flush toilets and are in good condition. Although it is located in the mountains, the access route from the Ishikawa Prefecture side is well-maintained and can accommodate tour buses. It is unmanned at night, so you can spend a peaceful night. Be careful as it is an area where bears may appear. *Used in May 2024 (Posted: June 2024, by y)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車20台級の駐車場。トイレは水洗洋式ウオシュレット付きで清掃状態も良好。夜間は無人状態となるので、治安については自己責任。対面の工場の操業音が気になるが、車の窓を閉めておけば気にならないレベル。それも22時頃には操業終了したのか静かになった。1km圏内に巨大なショッピングモールがあり、買い出しに便利&フードコートで食事もできる。マイナスポイントとして、南海トラフ地震の津波が来たらヤバそうな立地ではある。（投稿：2025年5月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A parking lot that can accommodate about 20 regular cars. The toilets are flush toilets with bidet functions and are in good condition. It is unmanned at night, so safety is at your own risk. The noise from the factory across the street is noticeable, but it is not a problem if you close your car windows. It also became quiet around 10pm, presumably when operations ended. There is a huge shopping mall within 1km, which is convenient for shopping and you can eat at the food court. A negative point is that it is located in a potentially dangerous area in the event of a tsunami from a Nankai Trough earthquake. (Submitted by: y, May 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車15台の無料駐車場。トイレは水洗洋式ウオシュレット付きで清掃状態も良好。公衆トイレとしては文句なしのレベル。夜は行き交う車も少なく、閑静な一夜を過ごせる。（投稿：2025年10月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Free parking for 15 regular cars. The toilets are flush toilets with bidet functions and are in good condition. As a public toilet, it's absolutely perfect. There are few cars passing by at night, so you can spend a peaceful night. (Submitted by: y, October 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：飛騨古川から神岡に向かって神原峠を越えたところにある無料P。（新規の場所です）トイレあり。静かに安眠できます。でも周辺にはなんにもなく、寂しい場所が好きな人向き。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A free parking lot located after crossing the Kanbara Pass on the way from Hida-Furukawa to Kamioka. (This is a new location.) There is a toilet. You can sleep peacefully here. However, there is nothing around, so it is suitable for people who like secluded places. (Old post from before 2019)

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.title_ja: 鯖江市嚮陽会館 駐車場
properties.title_en: [Paid] Sabae City Kyoyo Kaikan Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：入浴は鯖江市地域交流センター 市民ホールつつじ（詳細）が近く、入浴＆休憩＋内履きシューズ持ち込みでジムも使えおススメ。(営業10:00～22:00、大人420円、休館日は木、年末年始) 詳細（投稿：2024年2月、yuko様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：当初、道の駅 西山公園での車中泊を予定していたが、夜の口(20:00位)の駐車台数が多く、車の出入りも多く、道の駅での車中泊を諦め、道の駅隣の、鯖江市嚮陽会館　駐車場（詳細）に移動。駐車料金：2時間まで無料、以降22時間まで300円。トイレ：道の駅のトイレは、水洗ウオシュレット、多目的トイレは、夜間使用禁止です。鯖江市嚮陽会館　駐車場から道の駅(トイレ）までは、徒歩約1分30秒(100m以内)でアクセス可能。道の駅の駐車場は、深夜には駐車台数が減少しますが、早朝(6:00)には、混雑し、車中泊には、お勧めできません。鯖江市嚮陽会館　駐車場は、駐車数台(3・4台）の駐車台数でした。車中泊０台。その他：近くにスーパー「ヤスサキワイプラザ グルメ館鯖江店」有り、徒歩約5分　9時00分～21時00分。（投稿：2023年10月、n様）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: For bathing, the Sabae City Community Exchange Center Shimin Hall Tsutsuji (details) is nearby. It's recommended because you can bathe and rest, and you can also use the gym if you bring your indoor shoes. (Open 10:00-22:00, 420 yen for adults, closed Thursdays and during the New Year holidays) Details (Posted: February 2024, by yuko)
■Report from a reader of this site: Initially, I planned to stay overnight in my car at the Michi-no-Eki Nishiyama Park, but there were many cars parked there at the beginning of the night (around 20:00), and there was a lot of traffic, so I gave up on staying overnight at the Michi-no-Eki and moved to the Sabae City Koyo Kaikan parking lot (details) next to the Michi-no-Eki. Parking fee: Free for up to 2 hours, 300 yen for up to 22 hours thereafter. Toilets: The toilets at the Michi-no-Eki have flush toilets with bidets, but the multipurpose toilet is closed at night. The Sabae City Koyo Kaikan parking lot is accessible from the roadside station (toilets) in about 1 minute and 30 seconds on foot (less than 100m). The roadside station parking lot has fewer spaces available late at night, but it gets crowded in the early morning (6:00), so it is not recommended for overnight stays in a car. The Sabae City Koyo Kaikan parking lot had space for only a few cars (3 or 4). There were no cars parked overnight. Other: There is a supermarket nearby, "Yasusaki Wai Plaza Gourmet Hall Sabae Store," about a 5-minute walk away, open from 9:00 to 21:00. (Posted by: n, October 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 尼御前岬駐車場（石川県）
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：尼御前岬SA下りぷらっとパークから徒歩1〜2分。トイレ有。ぷらっとパークの駐車場には普通車しか停められないので、キャンピングカー等はこちらが便利。買い物や休憩はSAで。（2022/3）（投稿：2022年3月、h様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A 1-2 minute walk from the Puratto Park at Amigozakisaki SA (downbound). Restrooms available. Only regular cars can park in the Puratto Park parking lot, so this is more convenient for campervans, etc. Shop and take a break at the SA. (March 2022) (Submitted by: h, March 2022)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：南行きのみ。利用後はその先にある料金所を必ず通過しなければならない。トイレ・自販機あり。駐車スペースはそれなりに広い。本線には近いが、交通量はそこまで多くない。（投稿：2024年6月、c様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Southbound only. After using this stop, you must pass through the toll booth further ahead. There are toilets and vending machines. The parking space is reasonably large. It is close to the main road, but the traffic volume is not that high. (Submitted by c, June 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 舟屋の里伊根
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：道の駅伊根の舟屋に車中泊しました。平日でもあり、ほとんど車中泊する人はいなかったです。道の駅の営業時間を過ぎると近場には食事をする所はないので、要注意。高台にあるので、伊根の町並みや海が一望できますので見晴らしは最高でした。階段から降りて伊根の町を探索でき、遊覧船に乗ってカモメに餌をあげる事もできます。トイレは普通です、ただ奥まった所にあるので女性一人では心細く思いました。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: I stayed overnight in my car at the Ine Funaya Roadside Station. It was a weekday, so there were hardly any other people staying overnight in their cars. Be aware that there are no places to eat nearby once the roadside station closes. It's located on a hill, so you can enjoy a panoramic view of the town of Ine and the sea, so the view was fantastic. You can explore the town of Ine by going down the stairs, and you can also take a sightseeing boat and feed the seagulls. The toilets are average, but they are located in a secluded area, so I felt a little uneasy as a woman traveling alone. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 シルクのまち かや
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：道の駅の建物まわりの駐車場はやや手狭。トイレは遠くなるが、道路を挟んで北側にある第二駐車場がオススメ。隣接する国道176号は夜間の交通量は少なめなので、それなりに静かな夜を過ごせる。※2024/5に利用（投稿：2024年6月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: The parking lot around the roadside station building is a bit cramped. The second parking lot on the north side across the road is recommended, although the toilets are further away. The adjacent National Route 176 has relatively little traffic at night, so you can enjoy a fairly quiet night. *Used in May 2024 (Posted by: y, June 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 清流白川クオーレの里
properties.title_en: Roadside Station Seiryu Shirakawa Cuore no Sato
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：道の駅とは名ばかり、スタンプラリー用の道の駅。大きな駐車場があるが、別の施設用。無料駐車場は道の駅の前の空地、白線もなければ数台しか止められない。寄り道の無駄。（投稿：2021年6月、渡り鳥漫遊記様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A roadside station in name only, it's just a roadside station for stamp rallies. There's a large parking lot, but it's for another facility. The free parking is in an empty lot in front of the roadside station, there are no white lines and only a few cars can park there. A waste of time to stop by. (Submitted by: Migratory Bird Travelogue, June 2021)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：道の駅っぽいが実際は違う。夜間閉鎖されるため、車中泊不可。（投稿：2024年6月、c様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: It looks like a roadside rest area, but it's not. It closes at night, so overnight parking is not possible. (Submitted by c, June 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 織姫の里なかのと
properties.title_en: Roadside Station Orihime no Sato Nakanoto
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：道の駅 織姫の里 について補足：現在はフードコートの蕎麦屋は臨時休業中で、和食、洋食の2店のみ営業。お惣菜も販売している織姫市場に関しては18:30までの営業。調理用の食材だけでなく、調味料も販売のため安心。（投稿：2022年11月、yuko様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：道路沿いにあるが、大型とも離れていて静か。ドッグランもあり、24時間使用可能(HPでは時間指定あり)。道路を隔てた先に大型スーパー、GS、マクドナルドあり。トイレも新設のため綺麗。道の駅のフードコートは時間内に行きましたが、なぜか閉まっている店がありました。利用の場合は事前に連絡推奨です。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■2014年04月17日オープン！
properties.desc_en:
■Reader Report from this Site: Additional Information about Michi-no-Eki Orihime-no-Sato: Currently, the soba noodle restaurant in the food court is temporarily closed, and only two restaurants (Japanese and Western) are open. Orihime Market, which also sells prepared foods, is open until 6:30 PM. They sell not only cooking ingredients but also seasonings, so it's reassuring. (Posted: November 2022, by yuko)

■Reader Report from this Site: Although located along the road, it's quiet and away from large vehicles. There's also a dog run, available 24 hours a day (though the website has time restrictions). Across the road are a large supermarket, gas station, and McDonald's. The toilets are newly built and clean. I went to the food court at the roadside station during opening hours, but for some reason, some shops were closed. It's recommended to contact them in advance if you plan to use their services. (Older post from before 2019)

■Opened April 17, 2014!

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 水橋フィッシャリーナ駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：当名の施設の駐車場だが、見た感じ夜間閉鎖もなさそうで、男子トイレと多目的洋式水洗。名称的に釣りスポットな感じなので、釣りの時期混むかもしれないが分からない。（投稿：2023年2月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: The parking lot of this facility doesn't seem to be closed at night, and it has a men's restroom and a multi-purpose Western-style flush toilet. The name suggests it's a fishing spot, so it might get crowded during fishing season, but I don't know. (Submitted by yuko in February 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：湯谷温泉の駐車場で車中泊ができます。きれいな水洗トイレがあります。水道もあります。駐車場の東側に湯谷温泉の足湯があります。すぐ近くに鳳来ゆーゆーありーなのお風呂があります。（投稿：2023年12月、l様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: You can stay overnight in your car in the parking lot of Yutani Onsen. There are clean flush toilets. There is also running water. There is a footbath of Yutani Onsen on the east side of the parking lot. The baths of Horai Yu-Yu Arena are very close by. (Submitted by: l, December 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_en: Parking lot for climbing Mt. Fujiwara
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：登山者用無料駐車場20台位。綺麗な便所24時間、休憩所有り。自販機無し、コンビニは近所にも無し。静かだが、11月休日朝は4時ごろから登山者が動き出し、6時ごろには満車だった。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Free parking for hikers with space for about 20 cars. Clean toilets available 24 hours, and there is a rest area. No vending machines, and no convenience stores nearby. It's quiet, but on a holiday morning in November, hikers start moving around 4am, and the parking lot is full by 6am. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：天川東公園で車中泊しました。3台くらい車を停める場所があります。新幹線のすぐそばです。自販機有り、綺麗な24時間トイレ有、コンビニが近くにあります。夕方は近所の人たちが公園で遊んでいます。（投稿：2024年9月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: I stayed overnight in my car at Tenkawa Higashi Park. There is space to park about three cars. It is right next to the Shinkansen (bullet train) tracks. There are vending machines, clean 24-hour toilets, and a convenience store nearby. In the evenings, local people play in the park. (Submitted by: n, September 2024)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：天空の茶畑詳細 山々に囲まれた茶畑の景色が「岐阜のマチュピチュ」だとネットで話題に。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Details of the tea plantation in the sky The scenery of the tea plantation surrounded by mountains has become a hot topic online, being called "Gifu's Machu Picchu."

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 阿蘇シーサイドパーク駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：天橋立を眼前に見渡せる24時間使える公園の無料駐車場です。広々していて傾斜もありません。駐車場横の公園管理事務所に駐車場にトイレがありますが、夜間は閉鎖。駐車場から若干離れた公園敷地内のトイレは24時間使用できるようです。車で2～3分のところに入浴施設あり（クアハウス岩滝、詳細）（投稿：2023年11月、すなごん様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: This is a free 24-hour parking lot in a park with a stunning view of Amanohashidate. It's spacious and flat. There are toilets in the parking lot, located at the park management office next to it, but they are closed at night. Toilets located within the park grounds, a short distance from the parking lot, appear to be open 24 hours. There is a bathing facility a 2-3 minute drive away (Kurhaus Iwataki, details) (Submitted by: Sunagon, November 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：釣りと車中泊ができるし、トイレもある。近くに入浴施設「サンライズ淡路」もある。マルナカスーパーやイオンも近い。難点としては、釣り人が夜中に出入りするので少し音が気になるかも。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: You can fish and camp in your car, and there are toilets. There is also a bathing facility called "Sunrise Awaji" nearby. Marunaka Supermarket and Aeon are also close by. The downside is that anglers come and go in the middle of the night, so the noise might be a bit bothersome. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 兵庫県播磨中央公園 第５駐車場
properties.title_en: Hyogo Prefecture Harima Central Park, Parking Lot 5""
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：通常は無料。桜のシーズンは駐車料500円だそうです。山の懐で住宅が途切れた場所にあります。トイレは古いけど掃除してありました、大の方は見ていません、ごめんなさい。早朝にクリーン作戦に参加していた人の話だと、トラックなども来ているそうなので運が悪いと遭遇してうるさいかも？平日に行った夜は5台くらいの車が居ましたが車中泊の車ではなかったかも？近くに闘竜灘があります。（投稿：2025年9月、キャタロー様、Youtubeチャンネル）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: It's usually free. During cherry blossom season, there's a 500 yen parking fee. It's located in the heart of the mountains, where the houses end. The toilets are old but clean; I didn't check the toilets for men, sorry. According to someone who participated in the early morning clean-up operation, trucks and other vehicles also come, so you might encounter some noise if you're unlucky. When I went on a weekday night, there were about 5 cars, but they might not have been cars parked overnight. Toryunada is nearby. (Posted: September 2025, by Catero, YouTube channel)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 奥伊勢おおだい
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：町役場に隣接している道の駅。近所にスーパー＆飲食店があるので便利。反面、少し騒々しいかも。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A roadside station adjacent to the town hall. It's convenient because there's a supermarket and restaurants nearby. On the other hand, it might be a little noisy. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 天神崎元島第一駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：町営の舗装された駐車場とトイレ（水洗洋式・男女別・障害者用）があります。ごみは捨てられません。目の前の長い防波堤にはこの駐車場を利用する釣り人が多くいました。釣り好きには絶好のポイントでしょう。ただ、釣り人が早朝に出入りするかも知れません。また、この向かい側に砂利敷の広い駐車場があり、静かに過ごしたい方には適地です。私有地ですが自由に無料で利用で利用でき、大型のキャンピングカーも大丈夫です。所有者は「セラ丸養殖（090-1583-6773）」看板には「キャンピングカーは２日間は無料です。」とありましたが、所有者の方は、何日でもいいとおっしゃっていました。（投稿：2023年10月、tossan様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There is a town-operated paved parking lot and toilets (flush toilets, Western style, separate for men and women, and accessible for people with disabilities). Littering is not allowed. Many anglers use this parking lot to access the long breakwater in front of it. It would be an excellent spot for fishing enthusiasts. However, anglers may be coming and going early in the morning. Also, across from this is a large gravel parking lot, which is suitable for those who want to spend time in peace and quiet. It is private property but can be used freely and free of charge, and even large campervans are allowed. The owner is "Seramaru Aquaculture (090-1583-6773)". The sign says "Campervans are free for two days", but the owner said it is fine for any number of days. (Submitted by tossan in October 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 大江河東公園駐車場北側奥
properties.title_en: Oe Kato Park parking lot north side back
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：町はずれの運動公園、道路は川の反対側なので静かです。近くの民家も少ない田舎です。駐車場は広くて誰もいない。トイレは和式　一応センサーライトの明かりは点きます、チカチカして壊れかけかな？自販機が2台。このあたりは道の駅がないのでトイレを検索して見つけました。2025年6月9日の夜中に来て休憩して明るくなる前に帰ったので早朝の様子はわかりません。朝早くからスポーツする人が来るかもしれません。（投稿：2025年6月、キャタロー様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: This sports park is on the outskirts of town, and the road is on the other side of the river, so it's quiet. There are few houses nearby, and it's a rural area. The parking lot is large and empty. The toilet is a Japanese style. The sensor light does turn on, but it flickers and seems to be on its way out. There are two vending machines. There are no roadside rest areas around here, so I searched for toilets and found this one. I came in the middle of the night on June 9, 2025, took a break, and left before it got light, so I don't know what it's like in the early morning. People might come to play sports early in the morning. (Submitted by: Catero, June 2025)

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車料金 7:00〜22:00 100円/30分、22：00〜7：00 50円/30分、上限1500円（24時間につき）、国道1号線沿いにバス駐車場（乗用車入場可）、東側から入場の乗用車駐車場の2つの駐車場があります。どちらにもトイレあり、普通に綺麗です。バス駐車場の方は国道1号線に面しているので、交通音が多少気になるかも。（ﾊｲｴｰｽにマルチシェード取付で気にならないレベルでした）名鉄東岡崎駅まで徒歩10分程度なので、飲食に便利です。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Parking fees are 100 yen/30 minutes from 7:00 to 22:00, 50 yen/30 minutes from 22:00 to 7:00, with a maximum of 1500 yen (per 24 hours). There are two parking lots: a bus parking lot (passenger cars allowed) along National Route 1, and a passenger car parking lot accessible from the east. Both have restrooms, which are generally clean. The bus parking lot faces National Route 1, so traffic noise might be a bit noticeable. (It wasn't noticeable with a multi-shade installed on a Hiace.) It's about a 10-minute walk to Meitetsu Higashi-Okazaki Station, making it convenient for dining out. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: トライアル滋賀大津店
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場は有料になりました。詳細（投稿：2025年5月、p様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：24時間営業。比較的新しい店舗なのかトイレもきれい。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: Parking is now charged. Details (Posted: May 2025, by p)
■Report from our website reader: Open 24 hours. The restrooms are clean, suggesting it's a relatively new store.

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場は若干広め。施設は自動販売機2台とトイレ。ゴミ箱は缶とペットボトルのみ（野鳥対策のため、舞鶴若狭道のPAでのゴミ箱はこのパターンが多い模様）（投稿：2024年5月、C様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: The parking lot is slightly spacious. Facilities include two vending machines and a toilet. The trash cans are only for cans and plastic bottles (this seems to be a common pattern for trash cans at rest areas on the Maizuru-Wakasa Expressway to deter wild birds) (Submitted by: C, May 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 三国海浜自然公園駐車場
properties.title_en: Mikuni Seaside Nature Park Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場は広く松林に囲まれ数か所に分かれていてトイレもきれい。（投稿：2022年9月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: The parking lot is spacious, surrounded by pine trees, and divided into several sections. The restrooms are also clean. (Submitted by: M, September 2022)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 とっとパーク小島
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場は狭いが夜は施設には入れないため釣り人は居ない。朝は釣りする人で賑わいます。トイレはあまり綺麗ではない。車中泊するなら一段上の駐車場が静かでおすすめ。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: The parking lot is small, but since the facility is inaccessible at night, there are no anglers. In the morning, it's bustling with people fishing. The toilets aren't very clean. If you're planning to sleep in your car, the parking lot one level higher is quieter and recommended. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 三国海浜自然公園前の駐車場
properties.title_en: Parking lot in front of Mikuni Seaside Nature Park
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場は10台程度　トイレは洋式、管理が行き届いている。目の前は芝生広場で展望デッキが設置されて見晴らし抜群です。（投稿：2022年9月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: There is parking for about 10 cars. The toilets are Western-style and well-maintained. There is a grassy area in front and an observation deck with a great view. (Submitted by: m, September 2022)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 紀伊長島マンボウ
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場が中央・南と分かれており中央は乗用車専用なので静か。夏など暖かい時期は照明に集まる虫が凄く多いので窓開ける方は注意。トイレは中央店舗外とヘリポートのある北東防災拠点にあり24時間利用可。水洗洋式和式(女子トイレのみ確認)です。トラック駐車スペースは南側です。（投稿：2021年10月、s様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: The parking lot is divided into central and south sections, with the central section being for passenger cars only, making it quiet. During warmer months like summer, there are a lot of insects attracted to the lights, so be careful if you open your windows. Toilets are located outside the central store and at the northeast disaster prevention base where the helipad is located, and are available 24 hours a day. They are flush toilets (Western and Japanese style, only confirmed in the women's toilet). Truck parking spaces are on the south side. (Submitted by: s, October 2021)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場が狭く駐車しにくい　向かいの施設には利用者以外お断りと看板が出てる（投稿：2025年5月、こうさぎ様）
■道の駅の駐車場は傾斜があり、夜間も高速バス等で人の出入りがあって騒がしい。道の駅の正面、道をはさんで対面に穴水町立図書館の駐車場（場所はココ）があり、そっちの駐車場は静かで非常に良いのでおすすめ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。（2020年11月管理人現地確認）
■平成27年12月オープン。鉄道駅と一体型。終着駅なので、夜間に貨物列車がうるさいということは無さそう。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: The parking lot is narrow and difficult to park in. There is a sign at the facility across the street saying "No entry for non-users" (Submitted by: Kousagi, May 2025)
■The roadside station's parking lot is sloped and noisy at night due to the coming and going of people, including express buses. Across the road from the roadside station is the Anamizu Town Library's parking lot (location here), which is quiet and very good, so we recommend it. We confirmed that it is not closed at night. (Administrator's on-site confirmation, November 2020)
■Opened in December 2015. Integrated with the train station. Since it is a terminal station, it seems unlikely that freight trains will be noisy at night.

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車スペースは、普通車5台×2列、大型車7台×1列。本線通行量は多くないが、大型車との距離が近くかなりうるさい。施設は自動販売機が1台とトイレのみ。地味にゴミ箱が缶とペットボトルのみなのは辛い（野鳥対策のため、舞鶴若狭道のPAでのゴミ箱はこのパターンが多い模様）（投稿：2024年5月、C様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: The parking area has space for 5 regular cars in 2 rows and 7 large vehicles in 1 row. The traffic on the main road is not heavy, but it is quite noisy due to the close proximity to the large vehicles. The only facilities are one vending machine and a toilet. It's a bit of a pain that the trash cans only accept cans and plastic bottles (apparently this is a common pattern for trash cans at rest areas on the Maizuru-Wakasa Expressway to deter wild birds) (Submitted by C in May 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_en: Kasumigajo Park (Forest of the Four Seasons)
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：昼でも比較的静かで、もし通行音などしていてもノイキャンイヤホン類つければあまり気になる感じはなく爆睡できた。あと、洋式トイレが全てウォシュレットだった(男女共、多目的は未確認) （投稿：2024年2月、yuko様）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレはキレイな水洗で洋式もあり（詳細）。夜間静かで非常に良い。（2021年12月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: It was relatively quiet even during the day, and even if there was some traffic noise, I was able to sleep soundly with noise-canceling headphones on. Also, all the Western-style toilets had bidet functions (both men's and women's; multi-purpose toilets were not checked). (Submitted by yuko, February 2024)
■Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. The toilets are clean, flush toilets, and include Western-style toilets (details). It is very quiet at night. (Administrator's on-site verification, December 2021)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 滝原ふれあいの里公園
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：中学校の正門の前の児童公園。トイレは新しく綺麗です。学校の近くのためかよく管理されている形跡があります。駐車場は６台ほどしかありません。夏休み中に利用しましたが、学校のあいてる期間なら不審車両として通報されるかもしれません。（投稿：2025年10月、TOM様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A children's park in front of the main gate of a junior high school. The toilets are new and clean. It appears to be well-maintained, perhaps because it is close to the school. There are only about six parking spaces. I used it during summer vacation, but if you park there during school hours, you might be reported as a suspicious vehicle. (Submitted by TOM, October 2025)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：中華麺に和風だしの組み合わせの姫路のソウルフード。食べログ、詳細。姫路駅南口の駐車場（自家用車整理場）は20分無料。（投稿：2025年10月、n様）
■「まねきのえきそば」を食べられる店
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: Himeji's soul food, a combination of Chinese noodles and Japanese-style broth. See Tabelog for details. Parking at Himeji Station South Exit (private car parking area) is free for 20 minutes. (Submitted by: n, October 2025)
■Restaurants where you can eat "Maneki no Ekisoba"

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 竹田城駐車場(山城の郷)
properties.title_en: Takeda Castle Parking Lot (Yamashiro no Sato)
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：竹田城観光の拠点駐車場。早朝雲海を見に竹田城に登る人のほとんどがこちらに前泊します。幹線道路からも離れているため静か。24時間利用可能なトイレあり、駐車場閉鎖なし。駐車場内は朝来市公衆無線LANサービス利用可（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■無料駐車場、トイレあり、携帯○（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website's readers: A base parking lot for sightseeing at Takeda Castle. Most people who climb Takeda Castle to see the sea of ​​clouds in the early morning stay here the night before. It's quiet because it's away from the main road. There are toilets available 24 hours a day, and the parking lot is never closed. Public Wi-Fi service from Asago City is available in the parking lot (older post from before 2019)
■Free parking, toilets available, mobile phone OK (older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: サンテパルク田原の駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：地元なので泊まったことは無いですが、サンテパルク田原の駐車場です。ここは「道の駅」にならないのが不思議なくらいの施設で、産直や食堂などがあります。トイレは駐車場から施設にわたる橋の下にあります。古い貨物列車の近くです。近くには風呂の施設もコンビニもありませんが静かです。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: I'm a local so I've never stayed there, but this is the parking lot of Santepark Tahara. It's such a great facility that it's surprising it's not a "roadside station," with a direct sales market and a restaurant. The toilets are located under the bridge that connects the parking lot to the facility. It's near an old freight train. There are no bathing facilities or convenience stores nearby, but it's quiet. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Campground + Shower
properties.title_ja: 袖ヶ浜海水浴場（シャワーは夏季のみ）
properties.title_en: Sodegahama Beach (showers available only during summer)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：第１駐車場は7/20〜8/14は有料、 それ以外は無料。トイレあり。第２駐車場は年中無料。二つは隣接しています。7/20〜8/14は温水シャワー３分１００円 、夏場は海水浴客がうるさいかも。それ以外は静か。夕日がきれい。海釣り可能（４月中旬〜１月初旬）。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Parking lot 1 is paid from July 20th to August 14th, but free at all other times. There are toilets. Parking lot 2 is free all year round. The two are adjacent to each other. Hot showers are 100 yen for 3 minutes from July 20th to August 14th, and it may be noisy with swimmers in the summer. It is quiet at other times. The sunset is beautiful. Sea fishing is possible (mid-April to early January). (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：第1駐車場から第12駐車場まで総計1200台の広大な駐車場。ただし、番号の大きい駐車場は夜間閉鎖となる模様。トイレは要所要所に設置されており、洋式あり＆清掃状態も良好だが、駐車場によってはトイレが遠い場合もある。投稿者は第1駐車場を利用したが、快適な一夜を過ごせた。（投稿：2023年10月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A vast parking lot with a total of 1200 spaces from Parking Lot 1 to Parking Lot 12. However, it seems that the parking lots with higher numbers are closed at night. Toilets are located at key points, and Western-style toilets are available and are in good condition, but in some parking lots, the toilets are far away. The poster used Parking Lot 1 and had a comfortable night. (Posted by: y, October 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 大島北野河川公園（トイレは冬季閉鎖）
properties.title_en: Oshima Kitano River Park (toilets are closed during winter)
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：大島北野河川公園→先日来たら、冬季(12～3月？)使用不可ということでトイレが板張りされていた。近くに代替トイレもないため(車で5分程度走ればファミマあるがそこくらい)冬季はトイレ付き車両推奨。（投稿：2023年2月、yuko様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：料金：無料、トイレ：あり。昼間でも知る人ぞ知る、という感じでかなり静か。本来はトイレは男女別和式＋多目的洋式水洗だが多目的が何故か使えなかった。来たのは昼間だが、車中泊にも使えそうな程人気がない。（投稿：2022年4月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: Oshima Kitano River Park → When I visited recently, the toilets were boarded up because they are unusable during the winter (December-March?). There are no alternative toilets nearby (there's a FamilyMart about a 5-minute drive away, but that's about it), so a vehicle with a toilet is recommended during the winter. (Submitted by: yuko, February 2023)

■Report from our site's reader: Price: Free, Toilets: Available. It's quite quiet, even during the day, as if only a few people know about it. Originally, there are separate men's and women's toilets (Japanese style) + a multi-purpose Western-style flush toilet, but for some reason the multi-purpose toilet was unusable. I visited during the day, but it's so unpopular that it seems suitable for overnight stays in a car. (Submitted by: yuko, April 2022)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 川北温泉「ふれあいの湯」
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：大人300円（サウナ込み）子供100円　備え付けの備品は無し（更衣室にドライヤーあり）詳細。町営の銭湯ですが、温泉成分も入っており、町民以外も普通に利用できます。石川県では一番安いのでは無いかと思います。（投稿：2023年12月、ま様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Adults 300 yen (including sauna), children 100 yen. No amenities provided (hair dryer available in the changing room). Details: It's a town-run public bath, but it contains hot spring water, and is open to non-residents as well. I think it might be the cheapest in Ishikawa Prefecture. (Posted by: Ma, December 2023)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 舞鶴港とれとれセンター
properties.title_en: Roadside Station Maizuru Port Toretore Center
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：大型駐車場 トイレ及び駐車場 24時間利用可能。トイレは洋式 ウォシュレット付き紙有り。駐車場は大型駐車可能。車で15分程行った所に 「光の湯」温泉施設あり。駐車場横は24時間営業のローソンあり。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：２４時間トイレ・ローソン、海鮮レストラン２０時まであり。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: Large parking lot, toilets and parking available 24 hours. Toilets are Western-style with bidet and toilet paper. Large vehicles can park. There is a "Hikari no Yu" hot spring facility about 15 minutes away by car. There is a 24-hour Lawson convenience store next to the parking lot. (Older post from before 2019)

■ Reader Report: 24-hour toilets and Lawson convenience store, seafood restaurant open until 8 PM. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: ファミリーマート小浜東市場店
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：大型トラックも数台泊まっていました。静かで夜中にトイレなど借りに入っても気持ちよく受け入れてくれました。（投稿：2025年6月、ドラえもん様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Several large trucks were also staying there. It was quiet, and they kindly allowed me to use the toilet in the middle of the night. (Submitted by: Doraemon, June 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：大きな公園です。夜間閉鎖なし、トイレも洋式で綺麗です。難点は近くに何もないこと、その分静かでよく眠れます。（投稿：2024年5月、すみしん様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: It's a large park. It's not closed at night, and the toilets are clean and Western-style. The downside is that there's nothing nearby, but on the other hand, it's quiet and you can sleep well. (Submitted by: Sumishin, May 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 播磨いちのみや
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：多目的トイレ有り。暗くて静か涼しめです。食事処と即売所があるようですが未体験です。（投稿：2024年8月、タコラ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There is a multipurpose restroom. It is dark, quiet, and cool. There seems to be a restaurant and a shop, but I haven't tried them. (Posted by Takora in August 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 熊野・板屋九郎兵衛の里
properties.title_en: Roadside Station Kumano Itaya Kurobei no Sato
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：側に国道は通っていますが昼間でも車は全く通らないのでゆっくり出来ます。連休中でも余裕で駐車できます。ただし近くに買い物が出来るところがないので42号線沿いで買い物してから来るべし。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■2018年4月7日グランドオープン。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Although a national highway runs nearby, there are no cars even during the day, so you can relax. There is plenty of parking even during long holidays. However, there are no shops nearby, so you should do your shopping along Route 42 before coming. (Older post from before 2019)
■Grand opening on April 7, 2018.

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 千枚田ポケットパーク
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：全体に傾斜アリ　ほぼ営業を再開　シーズン中は混みあうので譲り合いを（投稿：2025年5月、こうさぎ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There is a slope throughout the area; most of the facilities have reopened; it will be crowded during the season, so please be considerate of others (Submitted by: Kousagi, May 2025)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：先日利用した下記PAの情報を投稿致します。名神高速・桂川PA（下り）大型車スペースが大幅に不足しているようで、小型車スペースの多くがトラックに占領されています。どこに駐めてもトラックの近くになってしまうかもしれないですが、しっかりした耳栓があればエンジン音も気にならないでしょう。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: I'm submitting information about the following rest area that I used recently. Meishin Expressway, Katsuragawa PA (downbound): There seems to be a severe shortage of space for large vehicles, and many of the spaces for small vehicles are occupied by trucks. You might end up near a truck no matter where you park, but if you have good earplugs, the engine noise shouldn't be a problem. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 簡易パーキングエリア（豊岡市新堂）
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：静かに過ごせました。車の音はしますが、それほどうるさいと思いませんでした。傾斜は気にならないと思いました。トイレは比較的綺麗でしたが、便座が冷たかったです。すぐ近くにコンビニもあり不便は無かったです。（投稿：2025年6月、ドラえもん様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: I was able to spend my time in peace and quiet. There was some car noise, but I didn't find it too loud. I didn't find the slope to be a problem. The toilet was relatively clean, but the toilet seat was cold. There was a convenience store very close by, so it wasn't inconvenient. (Submitted by: Doraemon, June 2025)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：瀬戸市のソウルフード「瀬戸焼そば」の店。詳細、食べログ（投稿：2025年8月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A restaurant serving Seto City's soul food, "Seto Yakisoba." Details on Tabelog (Posted by n, August 2025)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：神明公園 西駐車場は、現在、調整池作成の為に閉鎖され、無くなりました。現地にて確認。神明公園 北駐車場は、16時閉鎖、航空館ｂｏｏｎ正面は、17時閉鎖。2023.10.29 （投稿：2023年10月、w様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: The west parking lot at Shinmei Park is now closed and no longer exists due to the construction of a retention pond. Confirmed on site. The north parking lot at Shinmei Park closes at 4 PM, and the area in front of the Aviation Museum BOON closes at 5 PM. 2023.10.29 (Submitted by: w, October 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：神戸では数少ない、無料の車中泊スポットです。水洗和式の公衆トイレがあり、その横に2台ほど停車できるスペースがあります。道路上なので自己責任で。あと、携帯の電波はほぼ圏外です。（投稿：2021年5月、加藤の乱様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: This is one of the few free overnight parking spots in Kobe. There is a flush toilet with a Japanese-style toilet, and space to park about two cars next to it. It is on the road, so use at your own risk. Also, there is almost no cell phone signal. (Submitted by: Kato no Ran, May 2021)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 北潟湖畔公園・サイクリングパーク第2駐車場
properties.title_en: Kitagata Lakeside Park/Cycling Park Parking Lot 2
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：真下に大きい第1駐車場もあるが、トイレが目の前と近いのはこの第2。多目的は便座壊れてて使えず、使った方で水洗洋式と和式。実は土曜昼間でも人がさほど多くなく、静けさに予想以上に寝まくってしまった(笑) 特に夜間閉鎖する感じはなく、足湯や温泉施設も車で10分程度とかなり便利(実はホテルがもっと近くにあるが、日帰り入浴11～15時…) シャワーだけでいいなら4月のオープン後は道の駅 蓮如の里あわらが近い。温泉施設→セントピアあわら（詳細）、足湯→芦湯（詳細）（投稿：2023年3月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There is a large parking lot 1 directly below, but this second one is closer to the toilets. The multipurpose toilet seat was broken and unusable, but the one I used had both flush toilets (Western and Japanese style). Actually, even on a Saturday afternoon, there weren't that many people, and I slept more than I expected because it was so quiet (lol). There was no sense that it was closed at night, and the footbath and hot spring facilities were only about a 10-minute drive away, which was very convenient (actually there is a hotel even closer, but day-use bathing is only from 11am to 3pm...). If you only need a shower, the roadside station Rennyo no Sato Awara is close after it opens in April. Hot spring facilities → Centopia Awara (details), footbath → Ashiyu (details) (Posted: March 2023, by yuko)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.title_en: Ibaraki Senteiji PA (both northbound and southbound)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：新名神高速道路延伸に伴い2017年12月10日オープン。茨木千提寺IC併設で、上下線ともPA利用後にICへの流出が可能だが、ICから進入後のPA利用は不可。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Opened on December 10, 2017, following the extension of the Shin-Meishin Expressway. Located next to the Ibaraki-Senteiji Interchange, it is possible to exit to the interchange after using the rest area on both the northbound and southbound lanes, but it is not possible to use the rest area after entering from the interchange. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Highway Rest + Shower
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：上り線にコインシャワー（24h営業　300円/10分）、24hコンビニは上下線にあり。（投稿：2024年9月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There are coin-operated showers on the northbound side (24-hour operation, 300 yen/10 minutes), and 24-hour convenience stores on both the northbound and southbound sides. (Submitted by: n, September 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：小浜市の街中でありながら無料、静か、きれいな洗浄機能付きトイレあり。24時間ＯＫ。場所は福井県小浜市小浜白鬚111-1（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A free, quiet, and clean toilet with a bidet function located in the heart of Obama City. Open 24 hours. Location: 111-1 Obama Shirahige, Obama City, Fukui Prefecture (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：小松基地や空港の裏手にあるテニスコート併設？の公園。夜間使用禁止などの表記はなく、団地含めた人家も道路を挟んでいるため使いやすそう。但しクチコミ見ると｢基地のイベント時に駐車場いっぱいか閉鎖の場合あり｣とあるため想定される騒音とそれが注意点か。トイレは｢女性用のみ｣ウォシュレットと和式があるが、男性用は和式のみのため使いたい方は恥をす…←(多目的は普通の洋式水洗) 今江温泉も車でわずか5分と近い利点多めスポット。(火曜でそこがダメでも、少し足を延ばすと木場温泉や片山津温泉がある)（投稿：2024年1月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A park with tennis courts located behind Komatsu Air Base and the airport. There are no signs prohibiting nighttime use, and it seems easy to use as there are houses, including apartment complexes, across the road. However, according to reviews, "the parking lot may be full or closed during base events," so noise is something to be aware of. The toilets have a bidet and a Japanese-style toilet in the women's restroom only, but the men's restroom only has a Japanese-style toilet, so those who want to use it should be embarrassed...←(The multi-purpose restroom has a regular Western-style flush toilet) It's also a convenient spot as Imaie Onsen is only a 5-minute drive away. (Even if that's closed on Tuesdays, you can go a little further to Kiba Onsen or Katayamazu Onsen) (Posted by: yuko, January 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 天神崎丸山灯台 前公衆トイレ
properties.title_en: Public toilets in front of Tenjinzaki Maruyama Lighthouse
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：小さいですが、きれいなトイレがあります。洋式、水洗、男女別、身障者用あり。また、トイレの外側にはシャワーと水栓があるので何かと便利です。ごみは捨てられません。天神崎の代表的なスポット「丸山」が目の前で写真撮影や釣りに最適です。なお、釣り人が早朝に出入りするかも知れません。駐車場は砂利ですが広いです。Googleストリートでよく見えます。前面の道路は、岬の北側にある「天神崎元島第一駐車場」に抜けられますが、何ヶ所か幅員狭小で離合が難しい所があります。（投稿：2023年10月、tossan様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There is a small but clean toilet. It is Western-style, flushable, separate for men and women, and has a disabled-accessible toilet. There is also a shower and faucet outside the toilet, which is convenient. You cannot throw away trash. Maruyama, a representative spot of Tenjinzaki, is right in front of the site, making it ideal for photography and fishing. Please note that anglers may be coming and going early in the morning. The parking lot is gravel but spacious. It is clearly visible on Google Street View. The road in front leads to the "Tenjinzaki Motoshima First Parking Lot" on the north side of the cape, but there are several places where the road is narrow and it is difficult for vehicles to pass each other. (Submitted by tossan in October 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：主に新穂高ロープーウェーの利用者への臨時駐車場。トイレあり夏でも涼しい。※夏はガードマンが来る時は注意が必要。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: A temporary parking lot mainly for users of the Shinhotaka Ropeway. There are toilets and it's cool even in summer. *Caution is needed when security guards are present in the summer. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：車泊可能スポットとして投稿されていますが、昨日（2019/10/15）訪問したところ車泊禁止・長時間車内滞在禁止の張り紙がありましたので車泊はできません。
■【平日】朝7時から深夜0時まで最大1200円、【休日】朝7時から深夜0時まで最大1500円、深夜0時から朝7時まで最大500円。１階にトイレあり車中泊が可能。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Although it was posted as a spot where overnight parking is permitted, when I visited yesterday (October 15, 2019), there was a sign prohibiting overnight parking and prolonged stays in vehicles, so overnight parking is not possible.

■[Weekdays] Maximum 1200 yen from 7 AM to midnight, [Weekends] Maximum 1500 yen from 7 AM to midnight, maximum 500 yen from midnight to 7 AM. There is a toilet on the first floor, and overnight parking is permitted.

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: （トイレが夜間閉鎖）石川県石引駐車場
properties.title_en: (Toilets closed at night) Ishibiki Parking Lot, Ishikawa Prefecture""
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：車中泊マップに「トイレが有り車中泊が可能との報告あり」と、あったので、１２／２１（火）に車中泊しました。夜中の２：３０頃にトイレに行ったが、施錠されており使えませんでした。ショック！（投稿：2021年12月、匿名様）
■最初の1時間200円、以降1時間ごと100円。料金詳細　トイレが有り車中泊が可能との報告あり。例えば19時入庫で翌朝8時出庫の場合、1400円。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: The car camping map indicated that there was a toilet and that car camping was possible, so I car camped there on December 21st (Tuesday). I went to the toilet around 2:30 AM, but it was locked and unusable. What a shock! (Submitted: December 2021, Anonymous)

■First hour: 200 yen, 100 yen for each subsequent hour. Fee details: There is a toilet and it has been reported that car camping is possible. For example, if you enter at 7 PM and leave at 8 AM the next morning, it would cost 1400 yen.

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 白崎海洋公園
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：車中泊する車も少なくおすすめ。ただし携帯電波は入りづらい。買い物できる場所が紀伊由良駅のローソンかＡコープくらいしかないので道の駅に行く前に買い物必須。津波の危険があるので地震発生時は青少年の家に避難。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■オートキャンプ場併設（シャワー🚿あり）：料金詳細
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: Recommended because there are few cars parked overnight. However, cell phone reception is poor. There are only a few places to shop, such as the Lawson at Kii-Yura Station or A-Coop, so shopping before going to the roadside station is essential. There is a risk of tsunamis, so evacuate to the youth center in the event of an earthquake. (Older post from before 2019)
■Attached auto campsite (showers available): Price details

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：実は公園敷地内でももう少し離れた場所にジム併設のプール（詳細）があり、ジム単独利用だと常時2時間100円、おそらくシャワーも後で使える超格安料金。プールも7～8月なら200円(他時期は倍の400円)だが、採暖槽(お風呂っぽいやつ)ありと隠れお得スポット。（投稿：2023年10月、yuko様）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。広大な公園で、あちこちに駐車場がある。航空写真マップで見るとわかりやすい。トイレはココ（水洗和式）とココ（水洗洋式）が夜間利用可能なことを確認。治安については自己責任。携帯電波OK。（2022年5月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: Actually, there's a pool with a gym (details) located a little further away within the park grounds. Gym use alone is always a very cheap 100 yen for 2 hours, and it seems showers are also available afterward. The pool is 200 yen in July and August (double at 400 yen at other times), but it has a warming bath (like a regular bath), making it a hidden gem. (Submitted by yuko, October 2023)

■Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed they are not closed at night. It's a vast park with parking lots scattered throughout. It's easy to understand using the aerial photo map. Confirmed that the toilets here (flush toilet, Japanese style) and here (flush toilet, Western style) are available at night. Safety is at your own risk. Mobile phone reception is OK. (Confirmed on-site by administrator, May 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：七尾城山インターから近い駐車場。見た感じは狭く見えるが、トイレ＋休憩所の建物裏も広大な駐車場になっている。トイレは綺麗なウォシュレットで、かなり新しくバッチリ作動。朝方は多少通行量あるが、おそらく夜は相当静かかと思う。コンビニも近くにあり、割合便利。（投稿：2023年9月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A parking lot close to the Nanao-Shiroyama Interchange. It looks small from the outside, but there is a vast parking area behind the building with the toilets and rest area. The toilets have clean bidet toilets and are quite new and in perfect working order. There is some traffic in the morning, but I think it is probably very quiet at night. There is also a convenience store nearby, making it fairly convenient. (Submitted by yuko in September 2023)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 奥伊勢木つつ木館
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：自販機前以外はとても静か。24時間利用できるトイレは奥に男女・多目的(水洗洋式)とあります。女子トイレは水洗和式(男子トイレはわかりません)営業時間中は店内トイレと奥の女性専用トイレ(水洗洋式あり)も利用できます。大型トラック駐車スペースはありません。北側の広い駐車場は瀧原宮用駐車場なので利用しないよう注意。（投稿：2021年10月、s様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: It's very quiet except in front of the vending machines. There are men's, women's, and multi-purpose (flush Western-style) toilets at the back that are available 24 hours a day. The women's toilet is a flush Japanese-style toilet (I don't know about the men's toilet). During business hours, you can also use the toilets inside the store and the women's-only toilet at the back (which has a flush Western-style toilet). There is no parking space for large trucks. Please note that the large parking lot on the north side is for Takihara Shrine, so do not use it. (Submitted by: s, October 2021)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: ちゃんぽん亭総本家 本店（ちゃんぽん亭 本店）
properties.title_en: Chanpontei Sohonten Main Store (Chanpontei Main Store)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：滋賀県発祥のチェーン店、名物は近江ちゃんぽん。詳細、食べログ（投稿：2024年9月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A chain restaurant originating in Shiga Prefecture, famous for its Omi Chanpon. Details on Tabelog (Posted by: n, September 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：私のおすすめは「道の駅　美濃白川」です。国道４１号沿いですが山間部ため夜間はそこまで交通量は多くないです。おすすめ車中泊ポイントは第二駐車場　歩道橋付近です。こちらは車内でもしっかりwi-fiが入ります。さらに第二駐車場には小さいですがトイレもあり　夜間も使用できます。このトイレ　しっかりと掃除されておりいつも綺麗です。夜間の第二駐車場利用者はあまりいないためおすすめです。（投稿：2022年4月、t様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: My recommendation is "Michi-no-Eki Mino-Shirakawa" (Roadside Station Mino-Shirakawa). It's located along National Route 41, but because it's in a mountainous area, there isn't much traffic at night. My recommended spot for overnight parking is near the pedestrian overpass in the second parking lot. You can get good Wi-Fi reception inside your car there. Furthermore, there is a small toilet in the second parking lot that can be used at night. This toilet is always kept clean and well-maintained. There aren't many people using the second parking lot at night, so I recommend it. (Submitted by: t, April 2022)

properties.label: Camp Spot + Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：市営駐車場を利用しました。トイレあり、24時間最大料金1500円でした。詳細（投稿：2024年4月、j様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: I used the municipal parking lot. It had restrooms, and the maximum charge for 24 hours was 1500 yen. Details (Submitted by: j, April 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：四日市追分郵便局向かい。国道1号線と三重県道407号線に挟まれた所にある。また、この場所は「日永の追分」として三重県指定記念物（史跡）となっている。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Located across from Yokkaichi Oiwake Post Office, between National Route 1 and Mie Prefectural Road 407. This location is also designated as a Mie Prefecture monument (historic site) as "Hinaga no Oiwake".

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: おにぎりの桃太郎 久保田本店
properties.title_en: Onigiri no Momotaro Kubota Main Store
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：四日市市発祥のおにぎり専門店。詳細、食べログ（投稿：2025年6月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A rice ball specialty shop originating in Yokkaichi City. Details on Tabelog (Posted: June 2025, by user n)

properties.label: Highway Rest + Shower
properties.title_en: Ogo PA (showers available both above and below)
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：山陽道・淡河PA（下り）について。2023年5月の土曜に立ち寄り。大型車枠が非常に多いので、トラックが小型車エリアに侵入してくるリスクは少ないと思われます。定食屋とコンビニもあります。EV Quickあり。（投稿：2023年5月、n様）
■上下、コインシャワーあり。24時間　300円/10分
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Regarding the Sanyo Expressway, Ogo PA (downbound). Visited on a Saturday in May 2023. There are many spaces for large vehicles, so the risk of trucks entering the small vehicle area seems low. There is also a restaurant and a convenience store. EV Quick is available. (Submitted by: n, May 2023)

■Coin showers available in both directions. 24 hours, 300 yen/10 minutes

properties.label: Roadside Station
