properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：山の中の小さめの駅です。街道沿いだが交通量はすくない。綺麗なトイレウォッシュレット２。近くにはなにもない。空気がきれい晴れたら星空がよく見えると思うが？（投稿：2021年6月、渡り鳥漫遊記様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: It's a small station in the mountains. It's along a main road, but traffic is light. There are two clean toilets with bidet functions. There's nothing nearby. The air is clean, and I think you can see the starry sky well on a clear day. (Submitted by: Migratory Bird Travelogue, June 2021)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：山の斜面にあるため、路面がやや傾斜になっているのはやむを得ないが、トイレ（たしかウォッシュレットなしかも・・・）は夜間も使え、駐車場灯も点灯。数キロ離れた天空の城址「竹田城」を見るため山腹に設置された駐車場につき、当然静か。地元の観光案内所で、“雲海に浮かぶ竹田城を見たい・・・”、と伝えたところ、混雑を避けるには夜のうちに上記駐車場へ行き、未明より展望台へ登るようアドバイスあり。よって車中泊は公認かと。立ち寄り温泉は車で10分ほど離れた「よふど温泉」（詳細）。私は、雲海が現れる確率が高い秋に利用したため、それ以外の時季に利用する場合は、観光案内所で要確認。（私が利用した日は日曜日の夜にも関わらず、明朝午前3時頃には駐車場は満車。）直近、2023年10/22-23泊。（投稿：2025年8月、千葉県MO様）
■無料駐車場、簡易トイレあり、竹田城を撮影するために多数の人が車中泊をしている。アイドリング厨も混じっているので、そういうのとは距離を置くのが正解。セダンはだいたい朝までアイドリング。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: As it is located on a mountain slope, the road surface is inevitably a little sloped, but the toilets (I think there might not be any bidets...) are usable even at night, and the parking lot lights are on. As it is a parking lot set up on the mountainside to view Takeda Castle, a castle ruin in the sky located several kilometers away, it is naturally quiet. When I told the local tourist information center that I wanted to see Takeda Castle floating in a sea of ​​clouds, they advised me to go to the above parking lot at night and climb to the observation deck before dawn to avoid the crowds. Therefore, I think overnight stays in cars are permitted. The nearest hot spring is Yofudo Onsen, about a 10-minute drive away (details). I used it in the autumn when the probability of a sea of ​​clouds appearing is high, so if you plan to use it at other times of the year, you should check with the tourist information center. (Even though I used it on a Sunday night, the parking lot was full by 3 a.m. the next morning.) Most recently, I stayed from October 22-23, 2023. (Posted: August 2025, MO from Chiba Prefecture)
■Free parking and portable toilets are available. Many people are staying overnight in their cars to photograph Takeda Castle. There are also some people who idle their engines excessively, so it's best to keep your distance from them. Sedans usually idle until morning. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.title_ja: セレパーク１８条東（大阪の車中泊スポット）
properties.title_en: Celepark 18-jo Higashi (a car camping spot in Osaka)
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：今大阪のセレパーク１８条東に来てました。北中島新温泉（520円、詳細）に入ってきました。（投稿：2024年5月、t様）
■コインパーキング。大阪の穴場車中泊スポット。公衆トイレ隣接！24時間最大600円（※最大料金は一回きりなので注意）と格安！地下鉄東三国駅まで徒歩10分！（電車一本で梅田、難波にアクセス可能。）交番隣接でDQNも集まらない！（職質の可能性ある諸刃の剣。）大阪観光の拠点にどうでしょうか。結構いいんじゃないでしょうか。夏は暑いので無理。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: I was just at Celepark 18-jo Higashi in Osaka. I went to Kitajima Shin Onsen (520 yen, details). (Posted: May 2024, by t)
■Coin parking. A hidden gem for overnight stays in your car in Osaka. Adjacent to public toilets! Very cheap at a maximum of 600 yen for 24 hours (Note: Maximum charge is only for one time)! 10-minute walk to Higashimikuni Subway Station! (Accessible to Umeda and Namba by train.) Adjacent to a police box, so no troublemakers gather! (A double-edged sword as you might get stopped and questioned by the police.) How about using it as a base for sightseeing in Osaka? It seems pretty good. It's too hot in the summer, so it's not suitable. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：国道バイパス沿いなので非常に混雑しますしうるさいので、とっとパーク小鳥の方をおすすめします。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■2017/4/1オープン。バイパス国道のPA的道の駅。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: It's located along the national highway bypass, so it gets very crowded and noisy. I recommend Totto Park Kotori instead. (Older post from before 2019)
■Opened on April 1, 2017. A roadside station/parking area on the national highway bypass.

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：国道に面しているが交通量は少ない。果樹園に囲まれた里山です。２４時間ウォッシュトイレ。なし狩り、葡萄狩り、桃狩り(予定)今は桃と桜が満開、秋は収穫。大型も泊められる。（投稿：2021年3月、渡り鳥漫遊記様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: It faces a national highway but traffic is light. It's a rural area surrounded by orchards. There are 24-hour washlet toilets. Pear picking, grape picking, and peach picking (planned). Currently, peaches and cherry blossoms are in full bloom, and harvesting will take place in the fall. Large vehicles can also be parked. (Submitted by: Migratory Bird Travelogue, March 2021)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 中居湾ふれあいパーク
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：国道249号線と中居湾との間にある無料駐車場です。普通車18台，大型車4台の駐車枠が設けられており、海に向かって下り傾斜ですが、非常に緩やかなので気にならないと思います。清潔なトイレが２４時間使用でき、朝5時半頃に掃除されていました。男：小3/大2，女：5，身障者用：1すべてウォシュレットで、便座も洗浄水も暖かくなっています。今回、車中泊者は私だけでしたが、街灯が４基あり明るいので不安感は全くありませんでした。夜間の交通量はほとんどないので、静かで快適に車中泊できました。当初、道の駅・あなみずで車中泊する予定でした。道の駅・あなみずはのと鉄道の穴水駅に併設されており、道の駅と鉄道の駅の駐車場の区別があいまいです。キャブコンやバンコンで車中泊するには駅利用者の目が非常に気になるので、穴水で車中泊する場合ここの駐車場をお勧めします。能登半島には、この種の駐車場が何か所もあるので、能登半島は車中泊しやすい環境だと思いました。（投稿：2020年10月、Y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: This is a free parking lot located between National Route 249 and Nakai Bay. There are 18 parking spaces for regular cars and 4 for large vehicles. It slopes downwards towards the sea, but it is very gentle so I don't think it will be a problem. Clean toilets are available 24 hours a day and were cleaned around 5:30 a.m. Men: 3 urinals/2 stalls, Women: 5 stalls, Accessible: 1 stall. All have bidet toilets, and both the toilet seats and the flushing water are heated. I was the only one staying overnight in my car this time, but there are four streetlights so it was bright and I didn't feel unsafe at all. There is almost no traffic at night, so I was able to stay overnight in my car in a quiet and comfortable environment. Initially, I had planned to stay overnight in my car at Michi-no-Eki Anamizu. Michi-no-Eki Anamizu is attached to Anamizu Station on the Noto Railway, and the distinction between the parking lot for the roadside station and the train station is unclear. If you are staying overnight in a campervan or van, you will be very concerned about the eyes of station users, so I recommend this parking lot if you are staying overnight in Anamizu. There are several parking lots of this kind on the Noto Peninsula, so I thought it was a good place to stay overnight in a car. (Posted by Mr. Y in October 2020)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：国道21号線岐大バイパスの南。田んぼの中にあるが周囲は駐車禁止。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: South of the Gifu Bypass on National Route 21. It's in the middle of rice fields, but parking is prohibited in the surrounding area.

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：高山ラーメン発祥の店。食べログ（投稿：2024年9月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: The restaurant where Takayama ramen originated. (Reviewed on Tabelog in September 2024 by user n)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：広くて誰もいないが、トイレがやや老朽化（投稿：2025年5月、こうさぎ様）
■無料駐車場とトイレ。車通り少なく静かです。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: Spacious and deserted, but the toilets are somewhat dilapidated (Submitted by: Kousagi, May 2025)
■Free parking and toilets. It's quiet with little traffic. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: 東福寺近くのコインパーキング
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：広い駐車場で奥地が静かで良いとのことでしたが、最近敷地に薬局が建ち道路に近いところでしか駐車ができなくなっていました。車中泊はやめましたが、ためしに駐車してみたところ車の走行音であまり快適ではないのではないかと思います。（投稿：2022年10月、m様）
■なんと公衆トイレ隣接で車中泊可能。夜間20-08時60分100円、24時間最大1800円。トイレが防音壁みたいになって、奥は静かでなかなか良い。駅もすぐ近く。銭湯（泉湯）も徒歩圏内にある。（京都の車中泊スポット）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: It was said that the large parking lot was quiet and nice in the back, but recently a pharmacy was built on the premises, and now parking is only possible near the road. I decided against car camping, but I tried parking there and I think it wouldn't be very comfortable due to the noise of cars driving by. (Submitted by: M, October 2022)

■Surprisingly, car camping is possible next to a public toilet. 100 yen for 60 minutes from 8 PM to 8 AM, 1800 yen maximum for 24 hours. The toilet acts like a soundproof wall, and the back is quiet and quite nice. The station is also very close. A public bath (Izumi-yu) is within walking distance. (Kyoto car camping spot)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 粟生運動公園 駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：工業団地内にある野球場やテニスコートのある運動公園の駐車場。もうひとつ駐車場はあるが、車はこの位置にも停められ、通路を挟んだところに入口に外鍵がない、24h使える男女別トイレがある。個室2つともウォシュレットで比較的綺麗。国道に多少近い立地だが、夜は工場の稼働なければ静かかも…(私は朝8時台にいたが、その時はトラックうるさかった…)（投稿：2023年6月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: This is the parking lot of a sports park with a baseball field and tennis courts located within an industrial park. There is another parking lot, but cars can also be parked here, and across the walkway there are separate men's and women's restrooms that are open 24 hours and have no external locks on the entrance. Both stalls have bidet toilets and are relatively clean. It is located somewhat close to the national highway, but it may be quiet at night if the factories are not operating... (I was there around 8am, and it was noisy with trucks then...) (Submitted by yuko, June 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: レクトピアパーク 駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：向かいにラピア鹿島という複合施設があり、そちらの駐車場もチェーン施錠などなく恐らく使用可能(開館中ならそこのウォシュレットありのトイレも使える、館内の図書館が19時までのためそれまでは確実) 以降はパーク内に男女＋多目的トイレがあるが、そちらは普通の水洗洋式。「織姫の里なかのと」からもかなり近く、トイレよりは周りの音が気になる方にはお勧め。(ラピア鹿島はスーパーのアルプラザの裏手)（投稿：2022年11月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Across the street is a complex called Rapia Kashima, and its parking lot is probably usable as it is not chained or locked (if it is open, you can also use the toilets there which have bidet toilets, and it is definitely usable until the library inside closes at 7pm). Further on, there are men's, women's, and multipurpose toilets in the park, but those are just regular flush toilets. It is also quite close to "Orihime no Sato Nakanoto," and is recommended for those who are more concerned with the surrounding noise than the toilets. (Rapia Kashima is behind the Alplaza supermarket) (Submitted by yuko in November 2022)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：湖西の数少ない観光スポットの一つ。白髭神社の前後で観光するも良し。池の淵に万葉歌碑がある。池の中央に架かる木製の橋だけでもインスタ映えする。池の西側に５台分の無料駐車場あり（トイレ併設）。駐車場までの道順が分かりにくいので事前にナビで調べておくとよい。（投稿：2021年10月、くぅくん様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: One of the few tourist spots on the west side of Lake Biwa. It's a good place to visit before or after visiting Shirahige Shrine. There is a Manyoshu poetry monument on the edge of the pond. The wooden bridge in the middle of the pond alone is Instagrammable. There is a free parking lot with space for 5 cars on the west side of the pond (with a restroom). The directions to the parking lot are difficult to find, so it's a good idea to check your navigation system in advance. (Submitted by: Kuu-kun, October 2021)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 新港の森スポーツ広場 駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：現在5月までの工事の関係で駐車スペースが狭くなっている。昼間に来たがそのせいで工事音が響く(これに関してはノイキャンイヤホン、ヘッドホンや耳栓で抑えられる、私はそれで食後もあり爆睡) 夜間閉鎖は入口見た感じなさそう。80m程度歩けば場内に自動点灯のトイレがあり、洋式(温便座)、和式…とウォシュレットあり。（投稿：2023年3月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Currently, due to construction work until May, the parking space is narrower. I came during the daytime, but the construction noise was loud (this can be blocked with noise-canceling earphones, headphones, or earplugs; I slept soundly with them, especially after eating). It doesn't look like the entrance will be closed at night. There are toilets with automatic lighting inside the site about 80m away, with Western-style (heated seats), Japanese-style, and bidet toilets. (Submitted by yuko in March 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 物見山運動公園 駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：県道から少し離れたところにある運動公園、車止めのポールあったが使ってない印象で夜も閉鎖しなさそう。トイレは園内通路挟んだ方にあり、通常の方は洋式水洗だが多目的はウォシュレット。ここも車で少し走れば足湯があり、近くに温泉浴場が複数ある。（投稿：2023年5月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: This sports park is located a little off the prefectural road. There were bollards to stop cars, but they didn't seem to be in use, and it didn't look like it would be closed at night. The toilets are across the park path; the regular ones are Western-style flush toilets, but the multi-purpose ones have bidet toilets. There is a footbath a short drive away, and several hot spring baths nearby. (Submitted by yuko in May 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：建物裏が富岩水上ラインの乗降場になっていて、そこへの通路に自動点灯のトイレがある。トイレは普通の洋式水洗だが、向かいにファミマがありそこでウォシュレット使用可能。お風呂はもう少し先に行くと日方江温泉（12:00～21:00 水曜休 470円、詳細、公式サイト）があり、さらに行くと飲用可の湧水が汲めるごくらくの湯(大きな休憩室あり、470円、詳細、公式サイト)がある。（投稿：2023年9月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Behind the building is the boarding and alighting point for the Fugan Water Line, and there is an automatically lit toilet in the passageway leading there. The toilet is a regular Western-style flush toilet, but there is a FamilyMart across the street where you can use a bidet. If you go a little further, you will find Hikatae Onsen (12:00-21:00, closed Wednesdays, 470 yen, details, official website), and even further on is Gokuraku no Yu (large rest room available, 470 yen, details, official website) where you can draw drinkable spring water. (Submitted by: yuko, September 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：景色は最高、駐車場は1〜4まであるので、移動も可能。道に暴走族対策あり。標高もあるので涼しく寝れます（標高239m）。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：最近、施設の改修があったようで24時間利用可能の公衆トイレがとにかく綺麗。しかもなんと公衆トイレの中から夜景が見えます。市が夜景スポットとして力を入れているようで、展望台への遊歩道はブラックライト？のようなもので足場の舗装面がキラキラ光りとても綺麗です。ただ、欠点は田原市には銭湯的なものが一切なく、お隣の豊橋市などで入浴してからしか行けないのが難点。 ※夜景スポットということは、週末はDQNが大集合する可能性あり。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: The view is amazing, and there are four parking lots (1-4), so it's easy to move around. There are measures in place to deter biker gangs. It's also at a good altitude, so it's cool enough to sleep in (239m above sea level). (Older post from before 2019)

■Report from our site's reader: It seems the facility has been renovated recently, and the 24-hour public toilets are incredibly clean. What's more, you can see the night view from inside the public toilets. The city seems to be putting effort into promoting it as a night view spot, and the paved walkway to the observation deck sparkles with something like black light, making it very beautiful. However, the downside is that there are no public baths in Tahara City, so you have to bathe in neighboring Toyohashi City or somewhere similar before going. *As it's a night view spot, there's a possibility that a lot of delinquents will gather there on weekends. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：携帯電話ドコモは入りますがソフトバンクは入りません。トイレは夜間の使わない時は電気を消してほしいとの張り紙があります。男子トイレは和式、多目的トイレは洋式、女子トイレはウォシュレット付きです。夜間の利用者は自分の他はいませんでした。（投稿：2024年8月、a様）
■無料駐車場とトイレ。ギリギリの県境でここは岐阜県。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：山中の為夜間は寂しすぎるが、 綺麗なトイレあり！（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: Docomo mobile phone service is available, but Softbank service is not. There is a sign asking people to turn off the lights in the toilets when not in use at night. The men's toilet is Japanese style, the multi-purpose toilet is Western style, and the women's toilet has a bidet. I was the only user at night. (Submitted by: A, August 2024)
■ Free parking and toilets. This is Gifu Prefecture, right on the border. (Older post from before 2019)
■ Reader Report: It's too lonely at night because it's in the mountains, but there are clean toilets! (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：携帯電波はau系ならほぼ問題ない域、Docomo系はギリギリ。ウォシュレットにはなっているが、肝心の機能が全く使えなかった…謎すぎ。（投稿：2023年9月、yuko様）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。山の中だが駐車場はフラットに整地されている。トイレも近年リフォームされたようで、こんな場所なのに水洗洋式ウォシュレットでビックリ。携帯電波もギリギリOK。夜間非常に静か。治安については自己責任。標高273m。（2022年5月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Mobile phone signal is almost fine for au, but barely for Docomo. It has a bidet function, but the crucial function didn't work at all... so mysterious. (Submitted by yuko, September 2023)

■Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed not to be closed at night. Although it's in the mountains, the parking lot is level and flat. The toilets seem to have been renovated recently, and I was surprised to find a flush toilet with a bidet in such a location. Mobile phone signal is barely OK. Very quiet at night. Safety is at your own risk. Elevation 273m. (Confirmed on-site by administrator in May 2022)

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.title_ja: ファミリーマート 郡上愛宕店
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：郡上おどりを見るときに利用しました。アキッパの予約駐車場になります（詳細）。車中泊で利用するため２日間で予約しました。コンビニの駐車場なので大変便利です。料金は２日分で1200円と消費税になります。（投稿：2025年8月、TOM様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: I used this when I went to see the Gujo Odori dance festival. It's an Akippa reserved parking lot (details). I reserved it for two days because I was going to stay overnight in my car. It's very convenient because it's a convenience store parking lot. The fee is 1200 yen plus tax for two days. (Posted by TOM in August 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 美術館手前無料駐車場
properties.title_en: Free parking available in front of the museum.
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：近露美術館の手前にある広い無料駐車場（利用料金無料）、トイレ有できれいです。全般に静かですが川沿いのほうは特に静かです。600ｍ北にひすいの湯がありますが、営業時間に注意。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There is a large free parking lot (free of charge) just before the Chikatsuyu Art Museum, and the restrooms are clean. It is generally quiet, but especially quiet along the river. There is a hot spring called Hisui-no-Yu 600m to the north, but be sure to check the opening hours. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: メロンファーム ハンバーガー
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：近くにマック(マクド)あるがそっち行くなら同じ位の金額だしこっちのがはるかに良い。セット＋100円でポテト多くでき、おなか一杯になるよ。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There's a McDonald's nearby, but it's about the same price, and this is far better. You can get extra fries for an extra 100 yen on top of the set, and you'll be full. Tabelog

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：京都府指定文化財(天然記念物及び名勝)、巨大な一枚岩です。マグマが冷えて固まる時に出来た普通輝石安山岩です。柱状の割れ目を持ち柱状節理という形状の巨岩です。砂州と陸繋島で歩いて行けます。添付画像1、添付画像2、添付画像3（投稿：2022年9月、s様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A massive monolith, designated as a cultural property (natural monument and scenic spot) by Kyoto Prefecture. It is augite andesite, formed when magma cooled and solidified. It is a giant rock with columnar cracks, exhibiting a columnar jointing structure. It can be reached on foot via a sandbar and a tombolo. Attached images 1, 2, and 3 (Submitted by: s, September 2022)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：規模のわりに駐車スペース広め。大型車と普通車との駐車スペースが若干離れている。国道の交差点沿いだが交通量は少なめ。交差点の角にコンビニあり。大型車も来るが、そんなにうるさくなかったです。トイレ前にテーブルあります。（投稿：2024年6月、c様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: The parking space is relatively large for its size. There is a slight gap between the parking spaces for large vehicles and regular vehicles. It is located along a national highway intersection, but traffic is relatively light. There is a convenience store on the corner of the intersection. Large vehicles do come by, but it wasn't too noisy. There is a table in front of the restrooms. (Submitted by c, June 2024)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：紀勢自動車道上り 奥伊勢パーキングエリアについて。施設が新しく、トイレもきれい。自動販売機がある。EV急速充電器も有り。交通量も少なく静か。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Reader Report: Regarding the Okuise Parking Area on the northbound Kisei Expressway. The facilities are new, and the restrooms are clean. There are vending machines. There is also an EV fast charger. Traffic is light and it is quiet. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: （夜間閉鎖の可能性あり）安宅の関 駐車場、安宅関跡
properties.title_en: (May be closed at night) Ataka Barrier Parking Lot, Ataka Barrier Ruins""
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：既存記事の訂正(恐らく車中泊不可) 2枚目の画像（添付画像）の通り、どうやら夜間閉鎖しているらしい。(車止めらしいものも見受けられた) なお、ファミマのある側の別の安宅の関駐車場（詳細）は夜間閉鎖はなさそう。(トイレは水洗和式と洋式、多目的も普通の水洗洋式)（投稿：2023年4月、yuko様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：無料駐車場（普通車100台）とトイレ。歌舞伎の「勧進帳」で有名な安宅関跡にある公園。閑静な立地で快適な一夜を過ごせそうだが、投稿者は昼間に訪れただけなので詳細は不明。（投稿：2021年11月、y様）
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: Correction to Existing Article (Likely Not Allowed for Overnight Parking) As shown in the second image (attached image), it appears to be closed at night. (Something resembling a car barrier was also visible.) Note that the other Ataka-no-Seki parking lot on the side with the FamilyMart (details) does not seem to be closed at night. (Toilets include flush toilets (Japanese and Western style), and the multi-purpose toilet is also a regular flush toilet (Western style)) (Submitted: April 2023, yuko)

■ Reader Report: Free Parking (100 regular cars) and Toilets. A park located at the site of Ataka-no-Seki, famous from the Kabuki play "Kanjincho." It seems like a quiet location where one could spend a comfortable night, but the poster only visited during the day, so details are unknown. (Submitted: November 2021, y)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: 岐阜タンメン岐阜本店
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：岐阜名物「岐阜タンメン」の店。食べログ（投稿：2022年3月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A restaurant serving Gifu's specialty, "Gifu Tanmen." (Reviewed on Tabelog in March 2022 by user n)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.title_ja: 賤母清水 道の駅賤母の水
properties.title_en: Shizumo Shimizu Roadside Station Shizumo no Mizu
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：岐阜の道の駅賤母に賤母清水として給水できる(24時間)給水スポットがあります。道の駅で使用する水を使っているそうです。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: There is a water refill station (24 hours) at the Shizumo Roadside Station in Gifu where you can get Shizumo Shimizu water. It seems they use the same water that the roadside station uses.

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：丸岡町より九頭竜川に沿って、永平寺から勝山市へ向かう県道17号線沿いの栃原口ポケットパークにあります。源流は鷲ケ岳の七合目から湧き出し、小公園の水場にタンタンとやさしい水音を立てて湧くところから、地元の人の間で「タンタン清水」と呼ばれるようになったそうです。別名は「栃原の瓜割清水」とも呼ばれています。この水を求めて、国道416号線からわざわざ県道を通るドライバーも多いらしいです。（投稿：2020年10月、Y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: This spring is located in Tochiharaguchi Pocket Park along Prefectural Road 17, which runs from Eiheiji Temple towards Katsuyama City, following the Kuzuryu River from Maruoka Town. The source of the spring is at the seventh station of Washigatake Mountain, and it is said that the locals have come to call it "Tantan Shimizu" (Tantan Spring) because it gushes out with a gentle tapping sound at the water source in the small park. It is also known as "Tochihara no Urikari Shimizu" (Tochihara's Melon Splitting Spring). It seems that many drivers make the effort to take the prefectural road from National Route 416 just to get this spring. (Submitted by: Y, October 2020)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: 喫茶マウンテン（昭和区）
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：甘口抹茶小倉スパゲティなど、奇食を出す喫茶店として有名。駐車場は10台程有り。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: This coffee shop is famous for serving unusual dishes such as sweet matcha red bean spaghetti. There is parking available for about 10 cars. (Tabelog)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 田原めっくんはうす
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：街中にあり、駐車場内は混雑、熟睡はできない。無線LAN 8:00〜19:00 休日：水曜日不定休（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Located in the city center, the parking lot is crowded, making it impossible to get a good night's sleep. Wi-Fi available from 8:00 to 19:00. Closed on Wednesdays (irregular closures). (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: （<font color="red">※トイレ無し</font>）スロープのある駐車場（海老江海浜公園）
properties.title_en: （<font color="red">※トイレ無し</font>）スロープのあるParking（海老江海浜Park）
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：海に繋がるスロープのある駐車場。結構広い。ただしトイレはなし、こちらは道の突き当たりの門で区切られたエリアと違い閉鎖対象になっておらず、禁止事項（添付画像）を見た感じ普通の車中泊は問題なさそう。トイレ必要な方は新湊大橋方面に少し戻ったところの方がオススメ。👉️詳細（投稿：2022年4月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A parking lot with a ramp leading to the sea. It's quite spacious. However, there are no toilets. Unlike the area separated by a gate at the end of the road, this area is not subject to closure, and judging from the prohibited items (attached image), it seems that normal overnight stays in a car are not a problem. If you need a toilet, it is recommended to go back a little towards the Shinminato Bridge. 👉️Details (Posted: April 2022, by yuko)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：仮設トイレのみ　販売店休業中　仮設トイレのみで良ければ車中泊可能（投稿：2025年5月、こうさぎ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Only a temporary toilet is available. The store is closed. If you're okay with just a temporary toilet, you can stay overnight in your car. (Submitted by: Kousagi, May 2025)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：下道用プラットパークは、小さな看板で長時間駐車は遠慮するようにと。下り側は数台で業務用と兼用？上り側は多いが斜面、県道622からの入り口は分かりづらい。SA駐車場と離れており静か。コンビニ有り。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: The parking area for local roads has a small sign asking people to refrain from parking for extended periods. The downhill side has only a few spaces and seems to be shared with commercial use. The uphill side has more spaces but is on a slope, and the entrance from Prefectural Road 622 is difficult to find. It's quiet as it's separate from the service area parking lot. There's a convenience store nearby. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：下り側について。2025年7月の平日に利用。小さいPAなので激混みを覚悟していましたが、意外にも半分ほど空いていました。メイン駐車場のすぐ手前（アプローチ部分）の駐車スペースのほうが静かです。朝食は24H営業の松屋で。ボリュームあって安くて、いいですね！（投稿：2025年7月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Regarding the southbound side. Used on a weekday in July 2025. I was prepared for it to be extremely crowded because it's a small rest area, but surprisingly, it was about half empty. The parking space just before the main parking lot (the approach area) is quieter. I had breakfast at Matsuya, which is open 24 hours. It's filling and cheap, great! (Submitted by: n, July 2025)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：下り側について。2023年11月の日曜に利用。中国道では大きな規模のSA。大型車もあまり多くなくてまあまあ静かでした。駐車場の西の端にEV Quickがあります。（投稿：2023年11月、n様）
■広大なSA 比較的静か 左の奥の方はトラック来にくいので良い ここはおすすめ（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Reader Report: Regarding the southbound side. Used on a Sunday in November 2023. A large-scale service area on the Chugoku Expressway. There weren't many large vehicles, so it was fairly quiet. There's an EV Quick at the western end of the parking lot. (Posted by: n, November 2023)

■Spacious service area, relatively quiet. The far left side is good because trucks don't come easily. Recommended here. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Highway Rest + Shower
properties.title_en: Toyota Kamigo SA (formerly known as Kamigo SA)
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：下り線にコインシャワー（24h営業　400円/20分　詳細）あり。上下線に24h営業のコンビニ・フードコートあり。（投稿：2022年10月、m様）
■下り側のぷらっとパークで車中泊したが、高速SAの建物の裏側になり、トラックのアイドリング音が遮断されて静かで最高。耳栓つけて寝たら朝まで爆睡。トイレめちゃキレイ。ここ最高です。お気に入りにいれました。なお、SA内はトラックだらけでアイドリング音が凄まじい。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: There are coin showers on the southbound side (24-hour operation, 400 yen/20 minutes, details available). There are 24-hour convenience stores and food courts on both the northbound and southbound sides. (Posted by: m, October 2022)
■I stayed overnight in my car at the "Plat Park" on the southbound side. It's behind the highway service area building, so the idling noise of trucks is blocked out, making it quiet and fantastic. I slept soundly until morning with earplugs in. The toilets are incredibly clean. This place is the best. I've added it to my favorites. However, the service area is full of trucks, and the idling noise is tremendous. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: ポケットパーク海岸桟敷のと七見
properties.title_en: Pocket Park Coastal Seating Area Noto Nanami
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：温泉施設が隣の最強スポット。(のと七見健康福祉の郷｢なごみ｣ ※2024年の震災で休業) 併設のトイレは水洗洋式ウォシュレット。早めに着いて施設寄りに止めて準備してお風呂に行き、19:30がラストオーダーのレストランで呑んだくれるのも乙かもしれない。（投稿：2023年5月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: The ultimate spot with a hot spring facility right next door. (Noto Nanami Health and Welfare Village "Nagomi" *Closed due to the 2024 earthquake) The attached toilets are flush toilets with bidet functions. It might be nice to arrive early, park close to the facility, get ready, go to the bath, and then drink your fill at the restaurant, which has a last order at 7:30 PM. (Submitted by yuko in May 2023)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：営業再開　トイレ24時間利用可能　日中はボランティアさんの休憩ポイント（投稿：2025年5月、こうさぎ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Business reopens, toilets available 24 hours a day, serves as a resting place for volunteers during the day (Submitted by: Kousagi, May 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 富山県総合運動公園 西駐車場
properties.title_en: Toyama Prefectural General Sports Park West Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：運動公園の多目的広場の駐車場、夜間も閉鎖しない。｢公園内でのテント張っての野営(宿泊)は禁止｣的な張り紙はあるが車中泊については明記なし。トイレはウォシュレットあり。朝営業やってる美味しいラーメン店が近くにある。（投稿：2023年4月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: The parking lot at the multi-purpose field in the sports park is open even at night. There are signs saying "Camping (overnight stays) in tents is prohibited in the park," but there is no mention of sleeping in cars. The toilets have bidet functions. There is a delicious ramen shop nearby that is open in the mornings. (Submitted by yuko, April 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: フラワーパーク沖塚原パークゴルフ場
properties.title_en: Flower Park Okitsukahara Park Golf Course
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：位置的には市の斎場のほぼ横で、駐車場も5時以降に入れたため夜間閉鎖無し。トイレは洋式水洗だが、ここ数年でできた新し目の施設で綺麗。国道8号からは少し離れているため、道の駅よりは静か。セブン、ローソン、スーパー銭湯が近い地味に良立地。天候などは考慮しないと朝に騒がしくなりそうではあるが…（投稿：2023年4月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: The location is almost right next to the city's crematorium, and the parking lot is open after 5 pm, so there are no nighttime closures. The toilets are Western-style flush toilets, and the facility is relatively new, having been built in the last few years, so it's clean. It's a little further from National Route 8, so it's quieter than a roadside station. It's a surprisingly good location, close to a 7-Eleven, Lawson, and a public bathhouse. It might get noisy in the mornings depending on the weather, though... (Submitted by yuko, April 2023)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.title_ja: 鳥川ホタルの里湧水群（延命水）
properties.title_en: Torikawa Firefly Village Spring Water Group (Water of Longevity)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：愛知県道377号線の交差点から約3km。岡崎市ホタル学校付近の交差点から細い道を進む。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website's readers: Approximately 3km from the intersection on Aichi Prefectural Road 377. Take the narrow road from the intersection near Okazaki City Firefly School.

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：愛知県道35号線沿い、国道473号線との交差点から西へ約1km（目印にバス停・多数の旗あり）。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Located along Aichi Prefectural Road 35, about 1km west from the intersection with National Route 473 (there is a bus stop and many flags as landmarks).

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 越前おおの 荒島の郷
properties.title_en: Roadside Station Echizen Ono Arashima no Sato
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：レストランは16時終了、モンベルに併設されたカフェは19時終了。きれいなトイレは24時間利用できる。RVパークがトイレから一番遠いのはなぜ？（投稿：2025年10月、a様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：この道の駅は広大な駐車場を備えており、夜間は駐車場内の街灯が三分の一程度しか点灯していないため道の駅建物近くは暗くて快適です。トラックとの駐車場所は分離されトラックのアイドリングの音もさほど気になりませんでした。また、近くに自動車道が通っていますが自動車道を建設した意味があるのかと思うほど昼夜間交通量はとても少ないです。難点は道の駅の駅の営業が終了するとコンビニ、食事場所、銭湯（約８Km)が近くに無いことです。（投稿：2024年9月、山びこ様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：最近できた道の駅。営業時間は9:00〜18:00で、短い。有料駐車場エリアもあり、そこはテントを立てることができ、電源も完備。（投稿：2024年2月、h様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：R158から完全に分離した広大な駐車場。快適な一夜を過ごせる。（投稿：2021年11月、y様）
■2021年4月22日グランドオープン。RVパーク併設。全体案内図
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: The restaurant closes at 4 PM, and the cafe attached to Montbell closes at 7 PM. Clean toilets are available 24 hours a day. Why is the RV park the furthest from the toilets? (Submitted by: a, October 2025)
■ Reader Report: This roadside station has a vast parking lot, and at night only about a third of the streetlights in the parking lot are lit, so it's dark and comfortable near the roadside station building. The parking area for trucks is separated, and the sound of trucks idling wasn't too bothersome. Also, although there is an expressway nearby, the traffic volume is very low day and night, making you wonder if there was any point in building the expressway. The downside is that once the roadside station closes, there are no convenience stores, restaurants, or public baths nearby (about 8 km away). (Submitted by: Yamabiko, September 2024)
■ Reader Report: A recently built roadside station. The operating hours are short, from 9 AM to 6 PM. There is also a paid parking area where you can pitch tents and there are power outlets. (Submitted by: h, February 2024)
■Report from our site's reader: A vast parking lot completely separated from Route 158. You can spend a comfortable night there. (Submitted by: y, November 2021)
■Grand opening on April 22, 2021. RV park available. Overall map

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 信楽焼ミュージアム横駐車場
properties.title_en: Parking lot next to Shigaraki Pottery Museum
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：ミュージアム隣接の誰でも利用可能な駐車場。幹線から一本入っているので靜かです。敷地にトイレがありますが24時間使えるかは不明。ウォシュレットのきれいなトイレです。50m範囲内にセブンイレブンあり。（投稿：2023年11月、g様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A parking lot adjacent to the museum that is open to everyone. It's quiet as it's set back from the main road. There are toilets on the premises, but it's unclear if they are available 24 hours a day. The toilets are clean and have bidet functions. There is a 7-Eleven within 50 meters. (Submitted by: g, November 2023)

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.title_ja: サニープレイス神戸三宮駐車場
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：マップには24時間800円の記載がありますが、本日行ったところ12時間1000円に改訂されていました。（投稿：2024年6月、すなごん様）
■三宮まで徒歩15分。トイレは少し歩くが南に隣接の「みなとのもり公園（神戸震災復興記念公園）」に公衆トイレ（水洗洋式あり）がある（詳細）。詳細レポート（2020年）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: The map shows a 24-hour rate of 800 yen, but when I went today, it had been revised to 12 hours for 1000 yen. (Submitted by: Sunagon, June 2024)
■15-minute walk to Sannomiya. A short walk to the south is needed for public restrooms (including flush toilets) in the adjacent "Minato-no-Mori Park (Kobe Earthquake Reconstruction Memorial Park)" (details). Detailed report (2020)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.title_ja: マキノ高原のメタセコイア並木
properties.title_en: Metasequoia tree-lined avenue in Makino Plateau
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：マキノ高原のメタセコイア並木詳細 延長2.4kmの直線道路の両側に植えられた約500本のメタセコイアの景観がSNS等で話題に。路上駐車や道路の真ん中での写真撮影等が問題になっているのでマナーに注意。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Details of the Metasequoia Avenue in Makino Highlands The scenery of approximately 500 metasequoia trees planted on both sides of a 2.4km straight road has become a hot topic on social media, etc. Please be mindful of manners, as on-street parking and taking photos in the middle of the road have become a problem.

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: （トイレ無し）ふるさと西別院の道路迎えの駐車場
properties.title_en: (No restrooms) Parking lot across the road from Furusato Nishibetsuin
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：ふるさと西別院の道路迎えの駐車場。ふるさと西別院に車中泊オッケーの了承はもらってます。トイレはなし。自販機あり。コンビニまで車で五分。駐車場に影になるところなし。地面は水平。駐車場奥に停めれば車の騒音もあまり気になりません。朝に美味しい卵と野菜も買えます。（投稿：2021年8月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Parking lot across the road from Furusato Nishibetsuin. We have received permission from Furusato Nishibetsuin to allow overnight parking in vehicles. There are no toilets. There are vending machines. A convenience store is a five-minute drive away. There is no shade in the parking lot. The ground is level. If you park at the back of the parking lot, the noise from cars is not too bothersome. You can also buy delicious eggs and vegetables in the morning. (Submitted by: y, August 2021)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 簡易パーキング ふじわら
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：フィッシングサンクチュアリでトラウトキング選手権大会などトーナメント開催される前日練習のときに車中泊で利用しました。国道沿いよりトイレ側の奥まったところが照明明るすぎず寝やすいと思います。トイレは夜利用するときは照明スイッチ入れないと暗いです。（投稿：2026年2月、管釣りバーサーカー様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: I used the Fishing Sanctuary for overnight stays in my car the day before tournaments such as the Trout King Championship. I think the area further back, closer to the toilets and not too brightly lit, is a good place to sleep. The toilets are dark at night unless you turn on the light switch. (Submitted by: Fishing Berserker, February 2026)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 安宅の関 東側駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：ファミマのある側の安宅の関駐車場は夜間閉鎖はなさそう。(トイレは水洗和式と洋式、多目的も普通の水洗洋式)（投稿：2023年4月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: The Ataka-no-Seki parking lot on the side with the FamilyMart does not appear to be closed at night. (The toilets include flush toilets (Japanese and Western style), and the multi-purpose toilet is also a regular flush toilet (Western style)) (Submitted by yuko in April 2023)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：バイパスが通ったおかげで夜は比較的静かになりますが駐車場が狭いのでトイレから離れますが川を渡った駐車場で寝るのがおすすめ。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■H29年8月11日オープン。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Thanks to the bypass, it's relatively quiet at night, but the parking lot is small, so it's recommended to sleep in the parking lot across the river, even though it's further from the toilets. (Older post from before 2019)
■Opened August 11, 2017.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：ハイシーズン以外はＯＫだと思います。トイレもあり、水道もあるので安心です。近くに公衆温泉とスーパーが有るので非常に便利です。ただ、私達が車中泊してた夜中に若者が自販機荒らしをやってた様なので注意が必要です。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: I think it's OK outside of peak season. There are toilets and running water, so it's safe. There is a public hot spring and a supermarket nearby, which is very convenient. However, it seems that some young people were vandalizing the vending machines the night we were staying in our car, so caution is advised. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：ど田舎だが、道沿いでうるさい（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：道の駅あまるべに、車中泊しました。昔、大きな事故があったので気乗りはしなかったが、何もなく静かな夜でした。トイレは手入れが行き届いていて、綺麗。海岸沿いなので散歩するのも良し。平日だったからか、殆ど車は通らずゆっくりできました。すぐそばに空の駅の展望台があり見晴らしは最高。餘部駅から電車に乗ってとんぼ返りするのも良し。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: It's in the middle of nowhere, but noisy because it's along the road (Older post from before 2019)
■ Reader Report: I stayed overnight in my car at the Amarube roadside station. I wasn't keen on going because there was a major accident there in the past, but it was a quiet night with nothing happening. The toilets were well-maintained and clean. It's along the coast, so it's good for a walk. Perhaps because it was a weekday, there were hardly any cars, so I was able to relax. There's an observation deck at the Sky Station right nearby, and the view is fantastic. It's also good to take the train from Amarube Station and come back right away. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：トラックの駐車スペースとは多少離れていて音はあまり気にならない。24hコンビニがある他、上り線には24h牛丼屋、下り線には「名古屋めし」を提供するフードコート（7:00〜22:00）あり。【下道用のぷらっとパーク24時間OK】（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■ぷらっとパークは上下とも24時間利用可能。上下ともwimax電波OK。上り側はコンビニもあるので夜中まで出入りが多くうるさい。下り側も出入り多い。あまりおすすめという感じはない。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: The truck parking area is somewhat far away, so the noise isn't too bothersome. There's a 24-hour convenience store, a 24-hour gyudon (beef bowl) restaurant on the northbound lane, and a food court (7:00 AM - 10:00 PM) offering "Nagoya cuisine" on the southbound lane. [Plat Park for local roads, 24-hour OK] (Older post from before 2019)

■Plat Park is available 24 hours a day on both the northbound and southbound lanes. WiMAX signal is available on both lanes. The northbound side is noisy with a lot of coming and going until late at night because there's a convenience store. The southbound side also has a lot of coming and going. Not really recommended. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ有り。夜間は夜釣りやカップルの車ぐらい。ただし夜明け前から釣りの車で満車になるのでそれに耐らえれるかどうか。津波の危険があるのですぐに逃げられるよう避難経路は要確認。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There are toilets. At night, it's mostly just cars belonging to people night fishing or couples. However, it gets full of fishing cars from before dawn, so you need to be able to tolerate that. There is a risk of tsunamis, so be sure to check evacuation routes so you can escape quickly. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: カフェサザンのある無料駐車場
properties.title_en: Free parking available at Cafe Southern
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ併設の無料駐車場。多目的は普通の水洗洋式、男女別は水洗和式だったと思います。（投稿：2022年4月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Free parking lot with attached toilets. The multi-purpose toilet was a regular flush Western-style toilet, and I believe the separate men's and women's toilets were flush Japanese-style toilets. (Submitted by yuko, April 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 南郷大橋近くのトイレ
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ付き駐車場、という感じで9時前だと結構車止まってた。トイレはリサイクル水洗(ずっと水が流れてるタイプ)で、多目的がウォームレット。車中泊に使えそうな感じもなくないが広くないので微妙。（投稿：2022年4月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: It's a parking lot with toilets, and there were quite a few cars parked there before 9am. The toilets are recycled flush toilets (the type where water runs continuously), and the multi-purpose toilet has a heated seat. It doesn't seem entirely unsuitable for overnight stays in a car, but it's not very spacious, so it's a bit questionable. (Submitted by yuko, April 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 富山南総合公園 北側駐車場
properties.title_en: Toyama Minami General Park North Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレをみたところ、和式水洗とウォシュレットだった。（投稿：2023年6月、yuko様）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレはキレイな水洗で洋式もあり。携帯電波OK。夜間非常に静か。穴場。治安については自己責任。（2022年6月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: I saw that the toilets were Japanese-style flush toilets and had bidet functions. (Submitted by yuko, June 2023)
■Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. The toilets are clean flush toilets, and there are also Western-style toilets. Cell phone reception is OK. Very quiet at night. A hidden gem. Safety is at your own risk. (Administrator's on-site verification, June 2022)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレよし、wifi非常によし、景色よし、明宝温泉は沸かし湯なのではいらず、国道は通行量が少なく大型車は殆ど通らない。（投稿：2021年6月、渡り鳥漫遊記様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Good toilets, very good Wi-Fi, good scenery, Meihō Onsen is heated water so I didn't go in, the national highway has little traffic and hardly any large vehicles. (Submitted by: Migratory Bird Travelogue, June 2021)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: ロードパーク なかうみの里
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレはウォシュレットで良さげだったが、やはりトラックのせいかうるさくは感じる。(夜でなく夕方訪問) ただ目の前のきのこの里のソフトクリームは美味しい(食べるのは店外かテイクアウトで) ここも近くにらんたいむ氏訪問地、ハニべ巌窟院がある（動画詳細）。入浴施設（ピュア涌泉寺、490円、詳細）かなり近くにあるのは便利かなと…（投稿：2023年10月、yuko様）
■無料駐車場、トイレあり、幹線道路沿いでうるさい（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: The toilet had a bidet, which was nice, but it was noisy, probably due to the trucks. (Visited in the evening, not at night) However, the soft serve ice cream at Kinoko no Sato right in front is delicious (eat outside or take out). Nearby is Hanibe Gankutsuin, a place visited by Rantime (see video for details). The fact that there's a bathing facility (Pure Yusenji, 490 yen, details) quite close by is convenient... (Posted: October 2023, by yuko)

■Free parking, toilets available, noisy due to being along a main road (older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 呉羽山公園都市緑化植物園東駐車場
properties.title_en: Kurehayama Park Urban Greening Botanical Garden East Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレにはウォッシュレット付き、と書いていますが、多目的、男性用、北側 東側共にウォッシュレットは付いていませんでした。2025 5/2 確認。（投稿：2025年5月、x様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：県道沿いにコンビニが目の前の北駐車場(気になる傾きはなし)もあるが、そこから離れた病院前のここの方が多少静か。トイレは洋式水洗とウォシュレットあり(北も同様) ただここはトイレ近くはあまり傾き感じなかったが、県道方向に傾き感じる場所もある。（投稿：2023年4月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Although it says that the toilets have bidets, there were no bidets in the multi-purpose toilet, men's toilet, or on the north or east side. Confirmed on May 2, 2025. (Submitted by: x, May 2025)

■Report from a reader of this site: There is also a north parking lot in front of a convenience store along the prefectural road (no noticeable tilt), but this location in front of the hospital, further away, is slightly quieter. The toilets have Western-style flush toilets and bidets (same for the north side). However, while there wasn't much of a noticeable tilt near the toilets here, there are places where you can feel the tilt towards the prefectural road. (Submitted by: yuko, April 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 寄り道パーキング美川大橋
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレと数台の駐車場…だが、その部分は横への傾きが強く寝るには適しない。紹介したいのは通路を下りた河原の広い駐車場？で、そこが傾きもなく良さそう。ほぼ真横に鉄橋がある。トイレは水洗和式と洋式だが、女子トイレは洋式壊れてて他は多目的の洋式のみ。車数分圏内に水汲みスポット(大浜の水、蓮池の水)や温泉(安産(やすまる)の湯や美川温泉元湯ほんだ)、コンビニやドラッグストアなどあり地味に便利。（投稿：2023年4月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There are toilets and a few parking spaces... but that area has a strong slope to the side and is not suitable for sleeping. What I would recommend is the large parking lot by the river down the path? It seems to be a good place as it is not sloped. There is a railway bridge almost directly next to it. The toilets are flush toilets, both Japanese and Western style, but the Western style toilet in the women's toilet is broken, and the others are only multi-purpose Western style toilets. Within a few minutes' drive there are water-collecting spots (Ohama water, Hasuike water), hot springs (Yasumaru no Yu and Mikawa Onsen Motoyu Honda), convenience stores and drugstores, so it is surprisingly convenient. (Submitted by yuko in April 2023)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 ロック・ガーデン ひちそう
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレウォッシュレット２。どこに車を止めてもトイレは遠い。使い勝手の悪い道の駅。渓流はきれいだが。（投稿：2021年6月、渡り鳥漫遊記様）
properties.desc_en: ■Reader Report: Toilet with Washlet 2. No matter where you park your car, the toilet is far away. An inconvenient roadside station. The stream is beautiful though. (Submitted by: Migratory Bird Travelogue, June 2021)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_en: Free parking on the shores of Lake Biwa
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレあり。無料駐車場。ベンチあり。琵琶湖畔で景色がいい。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Toilets available. Free parking. Benches available. Great view from Lake Biwa. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 つくで手作り村
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ：水洗。Wifi：コカ・コーラの自販機、パスワード入力が必要でパスワードは自販機に表記されています。自販機は、トイレの横にあります。(詳細)、添付画像（投稿：2023年10月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Toilets: Flush toilets. Wi-Fi: Coca-Cola vending machine; password required, password is displayed on the vending machine. The vending machine is next to the toilets. (Details), attached image (Submitted by: n, October 2023)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 海の京都 宮津
properties.title_en: Roadside Station Umi no Kyoto Miyazu
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：ショッピングモールMippleのスーパーは21:30までの営業。コンビニは南に5分ほど歩けばローソン有り。西にはマック有りますが23:00までの営業です。長期車中泊者の迷惑行為(盗電・盗難)があったのか長期車中泊お断りのビラが張りだれていました。営業時間外に来て搬入業者が来る前(7時前)に片づければば問題ないと思いますがルールとマナーを守りましょう。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：道の駅 海の京都宮津。 駐車場自体はスペース少なめ。隣接のショッピングモールMippleにて午前11時から午後11時までレストラン利用可能。 車で五分の天橋立駅敷地内に温泉施設あり(午後5時以降は近くの知恩寺駐車場が無料になるので利用可能。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■2015年11月オープン。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's readers: The supermarket at Mipple shopping mall is open until 9:30 PM. There's a Lawson convenience store about a 5-minute walk south. There's a McDonald's to the west, but it's open until 11:00 PM. There were flyers posted prohibiting long-term overnight stays in vehicles, possibly due to disruptive behavior (electricity theft, theft) by long-term overnight stays. I think it would be fine if you come outside of business hours and clean up before the delivery company arrives (before 7 PM), but let's follow the rules and manners. (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from our site's readers: Michi-no-Eki Umi no Kyoto Miyazu. The parking lot itself has limited space. The restaurant at the adjacent Mipple shopping mall is open from 11 AM to 11 PM. There is a hot spring facility on the grounds of Amanohashidate Station, a five-minute drive away (after 5 PM, the nearby Chionji Temple parking lot becomes free and can be used). (Older post from before 2019)
■Opened in November 2015.

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：さざれ石公園詳細 「君が代」に歌われている「さざれ石」。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Details of Sazareishi Park "Sazareishi" is the "small pebbles" sung about in the Japanese national anthem, "Kimigayo".

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：サーファー御用達駐車場 大体の駐車場が1000円/日 水はタダで貰えるが井戸水の可能性もあるため、要注意。 夜〜朝にかけては無人になる所が多く、タダで車中泊も可能。 トイレ有りの所多め（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Surfer-favorite parking lots. Most parking lots cost 1000 yen/day. Water is free, but be careful as it may be well water. Many places are unmanned from night to morning, so it is possible to park overnight in your car for free. Many places have toilets. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：サーファー御用達駐車場 夏場のみ1000円/日 トイレ有り（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A parking lot frequented by surfers, 1000 yen/day during the summer only, with toilets available (older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 八丁浜シーサイドパーク
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：サーファー御用達駐車場 トイレ有り 夏場は無料シャワーあったかも？（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: A parking lot frequented by surfers. Toilets available. There might have been free showers in the summer? (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：コンビニあり。意外と駐車場は広め。スマートインターもありますが、スマートインターからの入場時/退出時は施設利用は不可。燃えるゴミのゴミ箱もあります（野鳥対策のため、舞鶴若狭道のPAでのゴミ箱は缶とペットボトルしかない場合が多い模様）（投稿：2024年5月、C様）
■2014/7/20オープン！
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: There's a convenience store. The parking lot is surprisingly spacious. There's also a smart interchange, but facility use is not possible when entering/exiting from the smart interchange. There are trash cans for combustible waste (it seems that trash cans at rest areas on the Maizuru-Wakasa Expressway often only accept cans and plastic bottles to deter wild birds) (Submitted by: C, May 2024)
■Opened on 2014/7/20!

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 小松ふれあい健康広場駐車場
properties.title_en: Komatsu Fureai Health Plaza Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：ゴルフ場やキャンプ場(オートサイトあるが価格…)のある広場の駐車場。車止めはなさそうなので夜間使用もできそうだが詳しくは不明。トイレはウォシュレットが奥に1つあり、他は水洗で洋式と和式。安宅PA(ETC専用IC)からもかなり近い。（投稿：2023年4月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A parking lot in a plaza with a golf course and a campsite (there are auto campsites, but they are expensive...). There don't seem to be any wheel stops, so it looks like it could be used at night, but the details are unclear. There is one toilet with a bidet at the back, and the others are flush toilets, both Western and Japanese style. It is also quite close to Ataka PA (ETC-only IC). (Submitted by yuko in April 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：こちらはジビエカフェも併設されていて、道路を挟んで海がよく見える人気スポット。｢夜間駐車はエンジン止めて｣とあるので車中泊は想定内かと。トイレはウォシュレットだったが、肝心のウォシュレット機能が多目的でしか使えず(電源入ってなかった)（投稿：2023年5月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: This is a popular spot with a gibier (wild game) cafe attached, and a great view of the sea across the road. There's a sign that says "Please turn off your engine when parking overnight," so it seems that overnight stays in cars are expected. The toilet had a bidet, but the bidet function itself could only be used for multi-purpose use (the power wasn't on) (Submitted by yuko in May 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：コスモアイル羽咋(らんたいむ氏も訪問した、宇宙科学博物館と図書館の複合施設)の近くにある公園。昼訪問の評価になるが、車が動かなければ極端にうるさく無く、そこまで車通りも多くない。おそらく夜はかなり静か。トイレがウォシュレットというのも大きい。近くに武道館があり、夜10時頃まで市外の方でも150円でトレーニングルーム使用可能。（投稿：2023年10月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A park near Cosmo Isle Hakui (a complex facility housing a space science museum and library, which Rantime also visited). Based on a daytime visit, it's not extremely noisy when there's no traffic, and there isn't much traffic. It's probably quite quiet at night. The fact that the toilets have bidet functions is a big plus. There's a martial arts hall nearby, and even people from outside the city can use the training room until around 10 pm for 150 yen. (Submitted by yuko, October 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：ここは小さな公園です。トイレも有り。車もあまり走らず静かでよく寝れます。那智に行くにはとても良いですよ！　※近所の「やたがらすの湯」は無期限休業（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: This is a small park. There are toilets. There isn't much traffic, so it's quiet and you can sleep well. It's a great place to go to Nachi! *The nearby "Yatagarasu no Yu" hot spring is closed indefinitely (older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：キレイなトイレがあります。街灯は、ありません。静かに過ごせます。注意点は、場所まで行く道が少し狭めな道です。登山口である為休日とかの朝早い時間から登山者が車を停めに来ます。（投稿：2024年5月、2様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There are clean toilets. There are no streetlights. It's a quiet place to relax. The only thing to note is that the road leading to the location is a bit narrow. Because it's a trailhead, hikers come to park their cars there early in the morning on weekends and holidays. (Submitted by: User 2, May 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：かなり小さい道の駅。2時間以上駐車禁止の看板は見当たらず。ただし民家が至近にあり車中泊に対する住民の目が気になる。（投稿：2024年5月、zil415様）
■2時間以上駐車厳禁の看板あり。（当サイト読者様より情報提供：2021年9月、i様）
■町中の小規模な道の駅。駐車場は幹線道とは離れており比較的静かで悪くない。（2020年10月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: A fairly small roadside station. No signs prohibiting parking for more than 2 hours were found. However, there are houses very close by, and concerns about residents watching out for overnight parking are a concern. (Submitted by zil415, May 2024)
■There is a sign prohibiting parking for more than 2 hours. (Information provided by a reader of this site: i, September 2021)
■A small roadside station in the middle of town. The parking lot is away from the main road and is relatively quiet, which is not bad. (Confirmed on-site by administrator in October 2020)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：カツに卵のあんかけが載った岐阜の「あんかけかつ丼」の店。詳細、食べログ（投稿：2025年4月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A restaurant in Gifu that serves "Ankake Katsudon," a dish of pork cutlet topped with a thick egg sauce. Details on Tabelog (Posted by: n, April 2025)

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：お風呂に関してだが、こちらはアパスパ福井片町(アパホテル福井片町)（詳細）まで徒歩10分程度と便利。(6～24、最終受付23:30、1000円…だが湯めぐりパスポート対応)（投稿：2024年2月、yuko様）
■福井の中心街で車中泊。19-翌朝8時最大500円。1階に夜間も使えるトイレ（水洗和式）あり。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Reader Report: Regarding the bath, it's conveniently located about a 10-minute walk from Apa Spa Fukui Katamachi (APA Hotel Fukui Katamachi) (details). (6am-24pm, last entry 11:30pm, 1000 yen...but accepts the hot spring passport) (Posted: February 2024, by yuko)

■Overnight stay in a car in the center of Fukui. 1pm-8am the next morning, maximum 500 yen. There is a toilet (flush toilet, Japanese style) on the first floor that can be used at night. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: 柏川オートキャンプ場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：オートキャンプ場は閉鎖されたようです。駐車場での普通の車中泊が可能かどうかは、不明です。詳細「キャンプとＢＢＱ、永久禁止　揖斐川町の粕川オートキャンプ場」（投稿：2022年4月、h様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: It appears the auto campsite has been closed. It is unclear whether regular overnight stays in vehicles are permitted in the parking lot. Details: "Camping and BBQ permanently banned at Kasugawa Auto Campsite in Ibigawa Town" (Submitted by h, April 2022)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: えびせんべいの里刈谷オアシス店
properties.title_en: Ebisenbei no Sato Kariya Oasis Store
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：えびせんべいの里刈谷オアシス店詳細） 伊勢湾岸道刈谷PA併設だが一般道からも利用可。愛知名物の海老煎餅製造店「えびせんべいの里」で最も名古屋に近い店舗。海老煎餅の試食ができる。7:00〜22:00営業。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website readers: Details of Ebisenbei no Sato Kariya Oasis Store) Located next to the Kariya PA on the Ise Bay Expressway, but also accessible from local roads. This is the closest store to Nagoya to "Ebisenbei no Sato," a manufacturer of Aichi's famous shrimp crackers. You can sample the shrimp crackers here. Open from 7:00 to 22:00.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：ＷＣ併設、徒歩２分にて「いろり茶屋鮎の庄」あり　囲炉裏で焼く鮎を見ることが出来ます詳細　徒歩１５分の対岸には日帰り入浴可能な温泉施設「越中庄川荘」有り（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: There is a restroom attached to "Irori Chaya Ayu no Sho" a 2-minute walk away, where you can watch ayu (sweetfish) being grilled over a hearth. For details, there is a hot spring facility called "Etchu Shogawa-so" on the opposite bank a 15-minute walk away where you can enjoy a day trip to the baths (older post from before 2019).

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 太田リバーサイドパーク
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：ＷＣ・東屋併設。徒歩２分にて季節料理「魚安」有　詳細　季節毎様々な料理を楽しめるが鮎時期の鮎雑炊は秀逸（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Restrooms and a gazebo are available. Seasonal cuisine restaurant "Uoyasu" is a 2-minute walk away. Details: You can enjoy various dishes depending on the season, but the ayu (sweetfish) rice porridge during ayu season is outstanding (older post from before 2019).

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.title_en: Ichikawa Service Area (both northbound and southbound)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：SA自体がかなり狭く、駐車場の出入りから気を遣う。交通量は多く、本線ともかなり近いので車中泊には不向き。大型車と普通車との駐車スペースが建物を境目に別れているので、それだけは評価ポイント。（投稿：2024年6月、c様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: The service area itself is quite narrow, and you have to be careful when entering and exiting the parking lot. The traffic volume is high, and it's quite close to the main road, so it's not suitable for overnight stays in your car. The fact that the parking spaces for large vehicles and regular vehicles are separated by a building is the only positive point. (Submitted by c, June 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 フレッシュあさご
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：SA営業時間外に一般道側からのトイレ利用の際は、建物外側の入口からトイレに向かうことが可能です。一般道側は車中泊禁止の表示ありました。(2025/6/1確認)（投稿：2025年6月、c様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：実質播但道のSA。南行き側に施設あり、北行きはトイレ・自販機あり。また一般道側から施設利用できます。夜間は施設閉鎖されるため、播但道側はトイレ・自販機のみ利用可能、一般道側は駐車場以外使えない。利用者は多いですが、駐車スペースはそこまで多くない。本線とも近く、交通量はそれなりにあり。一般道側の車中泊利用は不向き。（投稿：2024年6月、c様）
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: When using the restrooms from the general road side outside of SA operating hours, it is possible to access the restrooms from the entrance outside the building. There was a sign indicating that overnight parking is prohibited on the general road side. (Confirmed 2025/6/1) (Submitted by: c, June 2025)

■ Reader Report: Essentially a service area on the Bantan Expressway. Facilities are located on the southbound side, while the northbound side has restrooms and vending machines. Facilities can also be accessed from the general road side. At night, the facilities are closed, so only restrooms and vending machines are available on the Bantan Expressway side, and only the parking lot is usable on the general road side. There are many users, but not many parking spaces. It is close to the main road, and there is a fair amount of traffic. It is not suitable for overnight parking on the general road side. (Submitted by: c, June 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.title_en: Delicious water in front of Uozu Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：R8から海側へ1.2kmと、R8から最もアクセスが良い水場です。水質検査も行われており、安全に飲めます。水場のすぐ前に駅の無料駐車場があります。詳細（投稿：2026年1月、tossan様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: This is the most easily accessible water source from Route 8, located 1.2km towards the sea. Water quality tests are conducted, and it is safe to drink. There is a free parking lot at the station right in front of the water source. Details (Posted by tossan, January 2026)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 馬瀬 美輝の里 南飛騨・馬瀬川温泉
properties.title_en: Michi-no-Eki Maze Mikinosato Minami Hida/Mazegawa Onsen
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：Aランクの道の駅でしたが、車中泊禁止の看板有りで、別の道の駅に移動しました。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：道の駅から車で５分ほど走った場所にある「ホテル美輝」内に「スパー美輝」があります。 以前は道の駅馬瀬内に入浴施設があったようですが、営業をやめ、足湯となっています。 また、車中泊禁止の張り出しがあります。施設はとてもきれいです。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: This roadside station was rated A, but there was a sign prohibiting overnight parking, so I moved to another roadside station. (Older post from before 2019)
■ Reader Report: "Spa Miki" is located inside "Hotel Miki," about a 5-minute drive from the roadside station. Previously, there was a bathing facility inside the Mase roadside station, but it has closed and is now a footbath. There is also a sign prohibiting overnight parking. The facility is very clean. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 下北山温泉 きなりの湯
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：900円、詳細。 加熱循環で源泉掛け流しではない。近隣の温泉地より営業時間は長い。レストランの質は良いみたい。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: 900 yen, details. It's a heated, circulating hot spring, not a free-flowing one. The opening hours are longer than nearby hot spring resorts. The restaurant seems to be of good quality.

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：800円、詳細、JAF会員証を提示で100円引き。国道から山1つ超えた場所にある。周りにお店はない。夜に温泉から国道に向かうと、竹田城跡のライトアップが見える。（投稿：2024年6月、c様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: 800 yen, details available, 100 yen discount with JAF membership card. It's located over a mountain from the national highway. There are no shops nearby. If you head towards the national highway from the hot spring at night, you can see the illuminated Takeda Castle ruins. (Submitted by: c, June 2024)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 松任海浜温泉 おつかりさま
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：530円、詳細。　この料金で広い休憩室(TVありと、小さめのテレビなしがあり)と食堂、別に建物内にラーメン店もあり、リンスインシャンプーやボディソープ備え付け！（投稿：2023年4月、yuko様）
■スーパー銭湯「松任海浜温泉」。徳光PAから歩いて行ける。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: 530 yen, details. For this price, you get a spacious rest area (with a TV and a smaller one without), a cafeteria, and a ramen shop inside the building, plus rinse-in shampoo and body soap! (Submitted by yuko, April 2023)
■Super public bath "Matsuto Kaihin Onsen". Within walking distance from Tokumitsu PA.

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：500円、詳細。モール泉の温泉ホテル、アメニティは持参を。（投稿：2023年4月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: 500 yen, details. Hot spring hotel with moor spring water; bring your own amenities. (Submitted by: yuko, April 2023)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 美川温泉 安産(やすまる)の湯
properties.title_en: Mikawa Onsen Yasumaru no Yu (Safe Childbirth Hot Spring)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：460円、詳細。熱めのモール泉掛け流し、アメニティは持参を。（投稿：2023年4月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: 460 yen, details. Hot, free-flowing moor spring water, bring your own amenities. (Submitted by: yuko, April 2023)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 もっくる新城
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：3/23に愛知県新城市の「道の駅もっくる新城」で車中泊した時の感想を送らせていただきます。評価的には悪く無く、設備面や立地も良く道路騒音は多少あるものの、当日はトラックのエンジン音も少なく、車中泊禁止等の表示も特にありませんでした。ただ、トイレや観光案内所付近は一晩中「イベント案内」や「迷惑な長時間駐車は禁止」と言ったアナウンスが結構な音量で15分おきくらいで放送されます。明らか車中泊等に対する対策と思われますのでおすすめできません。この様な道の駅は全国を回っても初めての事だったので報告させて頂きます。（投稿：2025年3月、t様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：無料WiFiあり。たまに電車が通る音が聞こえますが、静かな方と思います。敷地内にコンビニがありますが、24h営業ではない(7:00〜19:00)ので注意。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■平成27年3月オープン!
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: I'd like to share my experience of staying overnight in my car at "Michi-no-Eki Mokkuru Shinshiro" in Shinshiro City, Aichi Prefecture on March 23rd. Overall, it wasn't bad; the facilities and location were good, and although there was some road noise, there wasn't much truck engine noise on the day, and there were no signs prohibiting overnight parking. However, near the toilets and tourist information center, announcements about events and prohibiting inconsiderate long-term parking were broadcast at a fairly loud volume every 15 minutes or so throughout the night. This is clearly a measure against overnight parking, so I wouldn't recommend it. This was the first time I'd encountered such a roadside station in the entire country, so I wanted to report it. (Submitted: March 2025, t)

■Report from our website reader: Free WiFi available. You can occasionally hear trains passing by, but it's generally quiet. There's a convenience store on the premises, but it's not open 24 hours (7:00 AM to 7:00 PM), so be aware. (Older post from before 2019)

■Opened March 2015!

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 竹田城下町観光駐車場
properties.title_en: Takeda Castle Town Tourist Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：24時間利用可能なトイレと駐車場あり、250m先にローソンあり。ただし深夜も交通量の多い国道312号線沿いで車の通過音に悩まされます。早朝の竹田城登山には竹田城駐車場の利用がベスト。駅側から登りたい場合は起床後にこちらに移動を。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: There are 24-hour restrooms and parking available, and a Lawson convenience store 250m away. However, it is located along National Route 312, which has heavy traffic even at night, so you will be bothered by the noise of passing cars. For early morning climbs to Takeda Castle, using the Takeda Castle parking lot is best. If you want to climb from the station side, head here after waking up. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：24時間最大料金あり（料金詳細）、車中泊についての表示なし。宮川朝市最寄り、トイレは徒歩1分の「飛騨高山観光交流館　大政」24時間利用可（詳細）、入浴は徒歩15分程の「ゆうとぴあ稲荷の湯」（詳細）（投稿：2025年7月、とあるhappy1オーナー様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There is a 24-hour maximum charge (details on charges), but no information is provided regarding overnight parking. It is closest to Miyagawa Morning Market, and the toilets are available 24 hours a day at "Hida Takayama Tourist Exchange Center Omasa" which is a 1-minute walk away (details). Bathing facilities are available at "Yutopia Inari no Yu" which is about a 15-minute walk away (details) (Posted: July 2025, by a certain happy1 owner)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 神通川第二ダム駐車場
properties.title_en: Jinzu River Second Dam Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：２４時間開放のトイレあり。少し遅くなると比較的静か。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There are toilets that are open 24 hours a day. It's relatively quiet if you go a little later. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: ヤスサキワイプラザ グルメ館 新保店 周辺駐車場
properties.title_en: Parking near Yasusaki Wai Plaza Gourmet Hall Shinbo Store
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：24時間スーパーの駐車場。航空写真で見るとわかりやすいが、この周辺に広大な駐車場があり、夜間もいちいち閉鎖はされない（一応、21時以降は駐車禁止との看板はあるが、駐車車両は沢山ある）。トイレは24時間スーパーの中にあり夜間も利用可能なことを確認済み。水洗洋式ウォシュレットでキレイ。奥の方の駐車場は翌朝まで非常に静か。難点としては、早朝に警備の巡回があり、迷惑駐車やめろという警告文の張り紙を置いていかれる。（投稿：2020年12月、加藤の乱様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Parking lot of a 24-hour supermarket. As can be seen from the aerial photograph, there is a vast parking lot in this area, and it is not closed off at night (there is a sign that says no parking after 9 PM, but there are still many parked cars). The toilets are inside the 24-hour supermarket and have been confirmed to be usable at night. They are clean, Western-style flush toilets with bidet functions. The parking lot at the back is very quiet until the next morning. The downside is that security guards patrol in the early morning and leave notices warning against illegal parking. (Submitted by: Kato no Ran, December 2020)

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.title_ja: SOMEN コインパーキング
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：24時間900円。かなり広い駐車場で、大通りから離れた場所なら結構静かです。トイレは木場市場や近くのコンビニ等になるかと。難波は徒歩圏内ですし、大国町駅にも近いので梅田にも行きやすい。（投稿：2021年11月、参拝業者えーご様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: 900 yen for 24 hours. It's a fairly large parking lot, and it's quite quiet if you park away from the main road. Restrooms are available at Kiba Market or nearby convenience stores. Namba is within walking distance, and it's also close to Daikokucho Station, making it easy to get to Umeda. (Submitted by: Eigo, a shrine visitor service provider, November 2021)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：24h無料駐車場。やや平坦、砂利、区画なし、乗用車7台ぐらい可、木陰あり。24hトイレ、洋式水洗、多目的トイレあり、ウォシュレット無し。自販機あり、ゴミ箱なし、ベンチあり。※朝6時半頃訪問しました。来訪者がちょこちょこいます。（投稿：2025年8月、タコラ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: 24-hour free parking. Slightly flat, gravel, no designated spaces, can accommodate about 7 passenger cars, shade available. 24-hour toilet, Western-style flush toilet, multi-purpose toilet available, no bidet. Vending machine available, no trash cans, bench available. *Visited around 6:30 AM. There were a few visitors. (Submitted by Takora in August 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：24h無料駐車場、広くやや傾斜、利用者少ない、朝方木陰ポイントあり。24h利用可能トイレ、水洗和式、車椅子用洋式トイレあり、ウォシュレット無し。奥にもトイレ&自販機あり(17時〜8時閉鎖)。水洗洋式、多目的トイレはウォシュレット。暗くて自然が豊か、虫の声あり。屋根付きベンチ、自販機あり、ゴミ箱なし。（投稿：2025年7月、タコラ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: 24-hour free parking, spacious and slightly sloped, few users, shady spots in the morning. 24-hour toilets available, flush toilets (Japanese style) and wheelchair-accessible Western-style toilets, no bidet. There are also toilets and vending machines further inside (closed from 5pm to 8am). Flush toilets (Western style), and the multipurpose toilet has a bidet. Dark and surrounded by nature, with insect sounds. Covered benches and vending machines available, no trash cans. (Submitted by: Takora, July 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 藤ノ木山自然公園 駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：24h無料駐車場、広い、平坦、砂利、区画なし、利用者少ない。24h利用可能トイレ、虫多い。水洗洋式、多目的トイレあり、ウォシュレット無し。暗くて静か、自然が豊かなので虫対策必要、朝、鳥の鳴き声あり。屋根付きベンチ&テーブルあり。自販機、ゴミ箱無し。（投稿：2025年6月、タコラ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: 24-hour free parking, spacious, flat, gravel, no designated spaces, few users. 24-hour toilets available, lots of insects. Flush toilets, Western style, multipurpose toilet available, no bidet. Dark and quiet, abundant nature so insect repellent needed, birds chirp in the morning. Covered benches and tables available. No vending machines or trash cans. (Submitted by Takora, June 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：24h無料駐車場、区画なし、芝生、平坦。24hトイレ、和式、水洗ではなさそう、水は飲用不可。ゴミ箱なし、熊に注意。午前6時来訪。楽天モバイル圏外。入口に埋め込み式のチェーンポールがあるので閉鎖している時があるかもしれません。（投稿：2025年8月、タコラ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: 24-hour free parking, no designated spaces, grassy, ​​flat. 24-hour toilet, Japanese style, doesn't seem to be a flush toilet, water not potable. No trash cans, beware of bears. Visited at 6 AM. Rakuten Mobile service unavailable. There is a chain pole embedded in the ground at the entrance, so it may be closed at times. (Submitted by Takora, August 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 黒井城跡 無料駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：24h無料駐車場、狭い、傾斜あり。24h有料トイレ、金額はお気持ち（寄付）、ウォシュレット付き。ベンチ、自販機あり。8時に来訪。（投稿：2025年8月、タコラ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: 24-hour free parking, narrow and sloped. 24-hour paid toilets, fee is voluntary (donation), equipped with bidet. Benches and vending machines available. Visited at 8:00 AM. (Submitted by Takora, August 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 氷上さくら公園 駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：24h無料駐車場、やや傾斜、利用者多い。24hトイレ、多目的トイレあり、ウォシュレット付き。ゴミ箱なし、ベンチあり。7時半来訪。（投稿：2025年8月、タコラ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: 24-hour free parking, slightly sloped, busy. 24-hour toilets, including a multi-purpose toilet with a bidet. No trash cans, but benches are available. Visited at 7:30 AM. (Submitted by Takora, August 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 井ノ奥公園 駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：24h無料駐車場、やや傾斜、利用者少ない、朝方木陰ポイントあり。24h利用可能トイレ、水洗和式、車椅子用洋式トイレあり、ウォシュレット無し。暗くて自然が豊か、虫の声あり。屋根付きベンチ、自販機あり、ゴミ箱なし。（投稿：2025年7月、タコラ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: 24-hour free parking, slightly sloped, few users, some shaded spots in the morning. 24-hour toilets available, flush toilets (Japanese style) and wheelchair-accessible Western-style toilets, no bidet. Dark and surrounded by nature, sounds of insects. Covered benches and vending machines available, no trash cans. (Submitted by Takora, July 2025)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 山田錦発祥のまち・多可
properties.title_en: Roadside Station: Taka, the birthplace of Yamada Nishiki rice""
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：24h無料駐車場、やや傾斜、EV充電可。24hトイレ、水洗洋式、多目的トイレ・ウォシュレット付き。ゴミ箱なし、屋根付きベンチ・テーブルあり。（投稿：2025年8月、タコラ様）
■2015年11月オープン。元々「町の駅」として営業していたようです。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: 24-hour free parking, slightly sloped, EV charging available. 24-hour toilets, flush toilets (Western style), multi-purpose toilet with bidet. No trash cans, covered benches and tables available. (Submitted by Takora in August 2025)
■Opened in November 2015. It seems to have originally operated as a "town station".

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.title_ja: ザ・パーク 姫路花影町1丁目
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：24h400円の駐車場、現金のみ、舗装、平坦、（隣接する駐車場も同条件）向かいの公園にトイレ（和式水洗、ペーパー無し、照明無し）あり（投稿：2026年2月、タコラ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: 24-hour parking lot for 400 yen, cash only, paved, flat (same conditions for adjacent parking lots), toilet in the park across the street (Japanese style flush toilet, no toilet paper, no lighting) (Submitted by: Takora, February 2026)

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：24:00-8:00 夜間最大なんと20円。24時からと遅いのがネック。詳細（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■トイレは50mほど北のローソンにトイレがある。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's readers: 24:00-8:00, a maximum of only 20 yen for nighttime use. The late start time (midnight) is a drawback. Details (older post from before 2019)
■There is a toilet at the Lawson convenience store about 50m north. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.title_ja: コインパーキング ブレイク24
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：24:00-8:00 夜間最大なんと10円。24時からと遅いのがネック。詳細（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■トイレは隣接のローソンにトイレがある。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's readers: 24:00-8:00, a maximum of just 10 yen for nighttime use. The late start time (24:00) is a drawback. Details (older post from before 2019)
■There are toilets in the adjacent Lawson convenience store. (older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：21時半に施錠のため追い出されました（投稿：2025年6月、タコラ様）
■無料駐車場とトイレ。職質あり。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: I was kicked out at 9:30 PM because the doors were locked (Submitted by: Takora, June 2025)
■Free parking and restrooms. Police questioning is conducted.

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_en: Castle Town East Square Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2025年5月現在、トイレは夜間使用できません。（投稿：2025年6月、h様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレあり、無料　※冬の大雪には注意。駐車場内を除雪されるかは分かりません。（投稿：2024年2月、h様）
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: As of May 2025, the toilets are not available at night. (Submitted by: h, June 2025)
■ Reader Report: Toilets available, free of charge. *Caution regarding heavy snow in winter. It is unclear whether the parking lot is cleared of snow. (Submitted by: h, February 2024)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2025年1月の平日夕食。伊勢河崎商人館を見学後、許可を得て商人館の駐車場に駐めたままここを利用。牡蠣尽くしがたまらない。接客も丁寧。（投稿：2025年2月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Weekday dinner in January 2025. After visiting the Ise Kawasaki Merchant House, we used this restaurant while parked in the Merchant House's parking lot with permission. The oyster feast was amazing. The service was also polite. (Submitted by: n, February 2025)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 織部の里もとす
properties.title_en: Roadside Station Oribe no Sato Motosu
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2025GWに車中泊。前面道路の通行量少なく、アイドリング車も少なく、静寂快眠でした。トイレはきれい。朝5時くらいから少しずつ来訪車（観光客や道の駅の入荷）が増えてきます。（投稿：2025年5月、t様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: I stayed overnight in my car during Golden Week in 2025. There was little traffic on the road in front, and few cars idling, so it was quiet and I slept well. The toilet was clean. From around 5 AM, the number of visitors (tourists and people receiving deliveries at the roadside station) gradually increased. (Submitted by: t, May 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2025/6/4現地確認。大杉谷から大台ヶ原への、東からのアクセスルート上にあります。駐車可能台数はmax６台ほどですが（添付画像）、とても静かな環境です。前面道路は国道422ですが、先は実質行き止まり(先に続く県道603は険しいため崩落等でしばしば通行止めになる)なので、通行車両は非常に少ないです。トイレは温水洗浄、洋式男女別、障害者用、更衣室あり（添付画像）。24時間閉鎖されないことを管理者の大台町役場の方に確認しました。道路の向こう側が宮川の河川敷で、水遊びができるため更衣室があります。夏の休日は混雑するでしょう。隣接の四阿は食事や雨宿りに便利そうです。また、6.7km手前(下流側)咳の谷公園では清水を汲めます。（投稿：2025年6月、tossan様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Confirmed on site on June 4, 2025. It is located on the access route from the east to Odaigahara from Osugidani. There is a maximum of about 6 parking spaces (see attached image), but it is a very quiet environment. The road in front is National Route 422, but it is essentially a dead end (Prefectural Route 603 that continues further ahead is steep and is often closed due to landslides, etc.), so there are very few passing vehicles. There are toilets with heated bidets, separate Western-style toilets for men and women, a disabled-accessible toilet, and a changing room (see attached image). We confirmed with the Odai Town Hall, the administrator, that it is not closed 24 hours a day. Across the road is the Miyagawa riverbed, and there is a changing room because it is a place where you can play in the water. It will probably be crowded on summer holidays.
