The adjacent gazebo seems convenient for eating or sheltering from the rain. Also, you can draw fresh water at Sekinotani Park 6.7km downstream. (Submitted by tossan in June 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2025-11-04 現地確認　庄川のほとりにあり、とても静かな場所です。公園内のトイレは終日使えます。洋式ですが洗浄便座ではありません。毎朝掃除されていてきれいです。　駐車スペースは南北に分かれていて、北側にトイレがあります。南側には大きな屋根とウッドデッキがあり、雨天時は助かります。いずれも収容台数は十分で、フラットです。添付画像、添付画像、添付画像、添付画像（投稿：2025年11月、tossan様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: 2025-11-04 On-site verification: Located on the banks of the Shogawa River, it's a very quiet place. The toilets in the park are open all day. They are Western-style but do not have bidet seats. They are cleaned every morning and are very clean. The parking area is divided into north and south sections, with the toilets on the north side. The south side has a large roof and wooden deck, which is helpful in rainy weather. Both sides have ample parking space and are flat. Attached images (Posted by tossan, November 2025)

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.title_ja: トップワン西宮第１駐車場 阪神今津駅付近の有料コインパーキング
properties.title_en: [Paid] Top One Nishinomiya 1st Parking Lot: A paid coin-operated parking lot near Hanshin Imazu Station.
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2024年4月の平日、私も甲子園球場での野球観戦時に利用しました。今は24時間最大600円です（添付画像）。 駅前なので食堂・コンビニはあるし、トイレは駅の外に1か所（詳細）と駅構内（2F）にもあります。甲子園までも近いし、便利ですよ。（投稿：2024年4月、n様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：阪神今津駅付近の有料コインパーキング。トイレ:100m以内の所に駅前広場に有り！コンビニ:ファミマ。風呂:500m位の所にスーパー銭湯有り！（徒歩7分）　今回、100回記念大会の高校野球観戦の際に利用しました。駅前の割に静か、甲子園球場迄徒歩15分。人気カードは行列が出来るので、早めに並びたい方には、近くて良い。地方ナンバー多数散見、人気の駐車場でしょうか！（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Reader Report: I also used this parking lot on a weekday in April 2024 when watching a baseball game at Koshien Stadium. Currently, it's a maximum of 600 yen for 24 hours (see attached image). Since it's in front of the station, there are restaurants and convenience stores nearby, and there are toilets outside the station (details) and inside the station (2nd floor). It's close to Koshien and very convenient. (Posted: April 2024, by n)

■Reader Report: Paid coin parking lot near Hanshin Imazu Station. Toilets: Within 100m in the station square! Convenience store: FamilyMart. Bath: There's a public bathhouse about 500m away! (7-minute walk) I used this parking lot when watching the 100th anniversary high school baseball tournament. It's quiet despite being in front of the station, and a 15-minute walk to Koshien Stadium. For popular games, there are long lines, so it's convenient for those who want to line up early. Many cars with out-of-town license plates were seen; it seems to be a popular parking lot! (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.title_ja: 鈴鹿臨時駐車場 (下りのみ)（期間限定PA？）
properties.title_en: Suzuka Temporary Parking Lot (downbound only) (Limited-time rest area?)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2024年1月2日に車中泊しました。鈴鹿PAの大型車枠の改修の為の臨時駐車場なので期間限定かも知れません。大型車と小型車の枠が分離しており、小型車が15台ほど駐車出来ます。注意しなくてはいけないのは、東名阪道下りのみで電光掲示板等が無い為、PAの入り口が分かりにくいのと入ってすぐに左折しないで通過してしまうと2度と小型枠に駐車出来ません。詳細。トイレが200Mほど離れているのでやや不便ですが、フードコートや自販機すら無いので休憩するつもりがない人は（入口見落としてるだけかも？）直接トイレ前で駐車して用を足したらすぐ走り出すので、正月にもかかわらず私たち以外は居ませんでした。（車中泊当日大型車すら居ませんでしたが、平日は大型車エリアは混雑しているようです）本線の走行音がやや気になりますが、関西方面のサービスエリアはどこも混んでいるので候補にしても良いかも知れません。（投稿：2024年1月、やすすぎ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: We stayed overnight in our car on January 2nd, 2024. This is a temporary parking lot due to renovations to the large vehicle area at Suzuka PA, so it may only be available for a limited time. The parking areas for large and small vehicles are separated, and there is space for about 15 small vehicles. What you need to be careful about is that it is only on the southbound side of the Tomei-Hanshin Expressway, and there are no electronic signs, so the entrance to the PA is difficult to find, and if you pass it without turning left immediately after entering, you will never be able to park in the small vehicle area again. Details: The toilets are about 200m away, which is a bit inconvenient, but there is no food court or even vending machines, so people who do not intend to take a break (maybe they just missed the entrance?) park directly in front of the toilets, use the facilities, and drive off immediately, so despite it being New Year's, there was no one else there besides us. (There weren't even any large vehicles on the day we stayed overnight, but it seems that the large vehicle area is crowded on weekdays.) The noise from the main road is a bit bothersome, but since all the service areas on the Kansai side are crowded, it might be worth considering. (Posted by: Yasusugi, January 2024)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2024/9/16　横山展望台P1で停車してハッチバックをあけて車中泊の準備をしていたら、午後5時半頃トイレの鍵を閉めにきた男性に「こちらでキャンプするのか？」と聞かれました。「車中泊しようと思います」というと「国立公園内なのでやめて欲しい。道の駅に行ってください」と言われて車中泊できませんでした。（投稿：2024年9月、a様）
■車中泊可能との報告あり。詳細
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: September 16, 2024. While parked at Yokoyama Observatory P1 and preparing to camp overnight with the hatchback open, a man came to lock the toilet door around 5:30 PM and asked, "Are you camping here?" When I replied, "I intend to camp overnight," he said, "This is within a national park, so please don't. Please go to a roadside station," and I was unable to camp overnight. (Submitted by: A, September 2024)

■Reports indicate that overnight parking is possible. Details

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 犬ヶ岬園地（丹後松島展望所）
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2023年11月の平日に立ち寄り。丹後半島の名所「丹後松島」を観望するための駐車場（数台分）です。トイレがあります。街道沿いですが交通量は少ないです。朝8時前に3台ほどの車中泊車がいました。（投稿：2023年11月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Visited on a weekday in November 2023. This is a parking lot (for a few cars) for viewing Tango Matsushima, a famous spot on the Tango Peninsula. There is a restroom. It is located along a main road, but traffic is light. There were about three cars parked there overnight before 8 AM. (Submitted by: n, November 2023)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 瑞穂の里・さらびき
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：２０２３年１１月の平日に利用。比較的小規模の道の駅。敷地面積から言えばもっと収容台数を増やせるはずですが、駐車枠があるのはほぼ幹線道路沿いのみというレイアウトです。ただ、大型車と普通車のブロックは分かれているので、その点はラクです。建物の裏側（南側）にEV Quickがあります。（投稿：2023年11月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Used on a weekday in November 2023. A relatively small roadside station. Considering the site area, it should be able to accommodate more vehicles, but the layout means that parking spaces are almost exclusively along the main road. However, the blocks for large vehicles and regular vehicles are separated, which is convenient. There is an EV Quick on the back (south side) of the building. (Submitted by: n, November 2023)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2023年11月の平日に利用。新名神の中では大型の上下集約型SA。多くのSA/PAでは入口を左折した奥に普通車枠がありますが、このSAの上り側は入口をそのままストレートに進んだ奥が普通車枠です。左折して奥に行くと本線に戻る通路になってしまうので要注意。ここも大型車がいっぱいなのでそれなりの騒音はありますが、耳栓があれば大丈夫でした。上下ともに入口から進んで建物に差し掛かる場所にEV Quickがあります。（投稿：2023年11月、n様）
■トラックがもの凄く多く、うるさい。トラックと分離されてない。標高約300mで、夏でも夜になれば涼しい。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Used on a weekday in November 2023. This is a large, combined northbound and southbound service area on the Shin-Meishin Expressway. While many service areas/parking areas have regular car parking spaces located at the back after turning left from the entrance, at this northbound service area, the regular car parking spaces are located straight ahead from the entrance. Be careful, as turning left leads to a passage that returns you to the main road. There are many large trucks here, so it's quite noisy, but earplugs were sufficient. There are EV Quick stations on both the northbound and southbound sides, located near the building after entering from the entrance. (Submitted by: n, November 2023)

■There are a lot of trucks, and it's very noisy. There's no separation from the trucks. It's at an altitude of approximately 300m, so it's cool at night even in summer. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 丹後王国 食のみやこ（旧名称：道の駅 丹後あじわいの郷）
properties.title_en: Roadside Station Tango Kingdom Food Capital (formerly known as Roadside Station Tango Ajiwai no Sato)
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：２０２３年１１月の平日に利用。戸惑うくらいに広大すぎる駐車場です。傾斜があるので寝る方向を考えて駐めましょう。駐車場北端の階段を上がったところに売店とトイレがあります。周りに何もないので静寂の中で休めました。階段の下にEV Quickがあります。（投稿：2023年11月、n様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2023.08.03 利用。トイレ：水洗、駐車場から少し遠い(階段を上り約100m)　朝食：園内に7:00から営業している。卵かけご飯(食べ放題）のお店、「卵かけごはんくいや」があります。（投稿：2023年10月、n様）
■幹線道路から離れており良い。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場はやや傾斜有り。周囲にスーパーやコンビニ無いので事前買い出しか営業時間内に園内で買い物を済ますしか無い。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: Used on a weekday in November 2023. The parking lot is so vast it's almost bewildering. There's a slope, so consider which way you'll be sleeping when you park. There's a shop and toilets at the top of the stairs at the northern end of the parking lot. There's nothing around, so I was able to rest in silence. There's an EV Quick at the bottom of the stairs. (Posted: November 2023, by n)
■Report from our website reader: Used on August 3, 2023. Toilets: Flush toilets, a little far from the parking lot (about 100m up the stairs). Breakfast: There's a restaurant called "Tamago Kake Gohan Kuiya" that serves all-you-can-eat rice with raw egg, open from 7:00 AM inside the park. (Posted: October 2023, by n)
■Good because it's away from the main road. (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from our website reader: The parking lot has a slight slope. There are no supermarkets or convenience stores nearby, so you have to do your shopping beforehand or do it inside the park during business hours. (Older posts from before 2019)

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2023年10月の平日に利用。ここに駐めて甲子園で野球観戦！三宮まで戻って祝勝会の後に車中泊しました。三宮駅から徒歩10分なのに24H最大700円とはお得です（最近値下げしたとのこと）。目の前の生田川公園のトイレまで50ｍ。ただ、公園の簡易トイレなので夜間の安全面には注意が必要かも（女子トイレも開放的です）。トイレットペーパーも備え付けてありませんでした。（投稿：2023年10月、n様）
■神戸の車中泊スポットを発見。向かいの公園に公衆トイレあり。夜静か。24時間最大800円、20-8時最大400円。三宮まで徒歩11分！これは超穴場！（2021年10月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Used on a weekday in October 2023. Parked here and watched a baseball game at Koshien! Returned to Sannomiya for a victory celebration and then slept in the car. It's a great deal at a maximum of 700 yen for 24 hours, even though it's only a 10-minute walk from Sannomiya Station (apparently the price was recently lowered). The toilets at Ikutagawa Park, right in front, are 50m away. However, since it's a simple toilet in the park, caution may be needed regarding safety at night (the women's toilet is also open). There was no toilet paper provided. (Submitted by: n, October 2023)

■Discovered a car camping spot in Kobe. There are public toilets in the park across the street. Quiet at night. Maximum of 800 yen for 24 hours, maximum of 400 yen from 8pm to 8am. 11-minute walk to Sannomiya! This is a real hidden gem! (Administrator's on-site verification, October 2021)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2023/06/13に使用。駐車場有　公園西側と東側に2か所(無料)、トイレ（水洗）公園西側と東側の駐車場の近くにあり。Wifi　公園西側と東側のトイレの近くで使用可能。街灯は、23:00以降に消灯、街灯が消灯するとWifiも使用できなくなります。Wifiは、1時間毎に再ログインが必要。（投稿：2023年7月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Used on June 13, 2023. Parking available: Two locations on the west and east sides of the park (free). Toilets (flush toilets) are located near the parking lots on the west and east sides of the park. Wi-Fi is available near the toilets on the west and east sides of the park. Streetlights are turned off after 11:00 PM, and Wi-Fi becomes unavailable when the streetlights are off. Re-login is required for Wi-Fi every hour. (Submitted by: n, July 2023)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 ラステンほらど
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2022年9月の平日に利用。売店・食堂は改装工事のため2023年3月末まで休業中。トイレは使えるので車中泊できました。EVの充電器があります。（投稿：2022年10月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Used on a weekday in September 2022. The shop and restaurant were closed for renovations until the end of March 2023. The toilets were usable, so I was able to stay overnight in my car. There is an EV charger. (Submitted by: n, October 2022)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 夢さんさん谷汲
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2022年9月の平日に利用。山合いへ向かう途中のこじんまりした道の駅。EVの充電器があります。隣地の緑地公園でも車中泊ができそうです。但し、「キャンプ行為は禁止」という看板がありました。（投稿：2022年10月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Used on a weekday in September 2022. A small roadside station on the way to the mountains. There is an EV charger. It seems possible to park overnight in a car in the adjacent green space park. However, there was a sign that said "Camping is prohibited." (Submitted by: n, October 2022)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2022年7月の平日に利用。駐車場が大型車用（西側）と普通車用（東側）に分かれていて、とても静かに休めました。トイレは東側です。ただ、真夏の道の駅あるあるですが･･･、トイレが蚊の巣窟。大きなハエや小さなアマガエルもたくさんいました。西側Pの隅にEVの急速充電器があり、無料で使えます。（投稿：2022年8月、n様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：良くも、悪くも、車中泊地としては普通の道の駅。そこそこ田舎で、そこそこ不便で、そこそこ静か。隣接の県道は、交通量は少ないものの、通過する車は例外なくかっ飛ばしているので、閑静とまでは言い難い。（投稿：2020年11月、Y様）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Used on a weekday in July 2022. The parking lot is divided into a large vehicle area (west side) and a regular vehicle area (east side), and it was very quiet to rest. The toilets are on the east side. However, as is common at roadside rest areas in mid-summer... the toilets were a mosquito breeding ground. There were also many large flies and small tree frogs. There is an EV fast charger in the corner of the west side parking lot, which can be used for free. (Submitted: August 2022, by n)

■Report from a reader of this site: For better or worse, it's an average roadside rest area as a place to stay overnight in a car. It's somewhat rural, somewhat inconvenient, and somewhat quiet. The adjacent prefectural road has little traffic, but the cars that pass by are without exception speeding, so it's hard to call it tranquil. (Submitted: November 2020, by Y)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2022年11月の平日に利用。東濃や南信と遠州を結ぶ奥三河の街道にある新しい道の駅で、とても人気があります。本館前の駐車場はキャパが少ないですが、隣のサブ駐車場と道路向いの第2駐車場は十分な広さです。EV Quickがあります。（投稿：2022年11月、n様）
■2021年5月13日オープン。幹線国道沿い。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Used on a weekday in November 2022. This is a new roadside station located on the Okumikawa highway connecting Tono, Nanshin, and Enshu, and it is very popular. The parking lot in front of the main building has limited capacity, but the adjacent sub-parking lot and the second parking lot across the road are spacious enough. EV Quick is available. (Submitted by: n, November 2022)

■Opened on May 13, 2021. Located along a major national highway.

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 南飛騨小坂はなもも
properties.title_en: Roadside Station Minami Hida Osaka Hanamomo
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2022年11月の平日に利用。天然の高濃度炭酸泉というレアな温泉を堪能できる小坂温泉郷の入口です。小さな道の駅ですが売店は充実していて、地元の新鮮野菜がお安く買える他、肉・魚の加工品や飛騨の地酒も揃っています。駐車場は静かな環境でゆっくり休めました。周囲の山の紅葉が素晴らしい！EV Quickがあります。（投稿：2022年11月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Visited on a weekday in November 2022. This is the entrance to Kosaka Onsenkyo, where you can enjoy a rare hot spring with natural, high-concentration carbonated water. It's a small roadside station, but the shop is well-stocked, and you can buy fresh local vegetables at reasonable prices, as well as processed meat and fish products and local Hida sake. The parking lot is in a quiet environment where you can relax. The autumn foliage on the surrounding mountains is wonderful! There is an EV Quick. (Submitted by: n, November 2022)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2021年9月土木遺産に認定。かつては日本一長い吊り橋であった。橋を渡るのは無料だが村営駐車場は500円。かなり揺れるので高所恐怖症の人にはきついかも。渡るのなら運動靴を推奨する。（投稿：2021年10月、くぅくん様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Designated as a civil engineering heritage site in September 2021. It was once the longest suspension bridge in Japan. Crossing the bridge is free, but the village-run parking lot costs 500 yen. It sways quite a bit, so it might be tough for people with a fear of heights. If you plan to cross it, athletic shoes are recommended. (Submitted by: Ku-kun, October 2021)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 熊野・花の窟
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2021年1月利用。時期柄駐車場すいていました。夜間の間は、国道の交通量は少なく静かに眠れました。トイレはウォシュレットついておりキレイです。朝横断歩道を渡った海岸からきれいな朝日を見ることができ、世界遺産・花窟神社がすぐ隣なので朝参拝できます。隣にファミマがあるので、買い物も便利です。（投稿：2021年1月、I様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：側に42号線が通っているし駐車場も狭いので夜中も車の出入りや国道を飛ばすトラック等でうるさいです。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■2016年10月オープン。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: Used in January 2021. The parking lot was empty due to the time of year. Traffic on the national highway was light at night, so I was able to sleep peacefully. The toilets are clean and have bidet functions. In the morning, you can see a beautiful sunrise from the coast across the pedestrian crossing, and the World Heritage site, Hanaiwaya Shrine, is right next door, so you can visit in the morning. There is a FamilyMart next door, so shopping is convenient. (Posted by Mr./Ms. I, January 2021)

■Report from our website reader: National Route 42 runs nearby, and the parking lot is small, so it's noisy at night with cars coming and going and trucks speeding down the national highway. (Older post from before 2019)

■Opened in October 2016.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 大斎原入口・駐車場 狭い無料駐車場
properties.title_en: Osaihara Entrance/Parking Lot: Small free parking lot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2021年1月利用。7−8台の駐車場で熊野本宮大斎原入口にあります。季節柄空いていました。トイレは夜間照明あり、ウォシュレット付で綺麗。道路迎えに22時迄空いているレストランくまのこ食堂があるので、夜近辺で食事を済ますのに便利。大斎原入口の駐車場なので、翌朝一で大斎原観光も便利。（投稿：2021年1月、I様）
■本宮大社まで１００ｍぐらい。トイレあり 近くに温泉はいっぱいある。狭いので隣にアイドリング厨がきたら終了（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Used in January 2021. There's a parking lot for 7-8 cars, located at the entrance to Kumano Hongu Osaibara. It was empty due to the season. The toilets are clean, with nighttime lighting and bidet functions. There's a restaurant called Kumanoko Shokudo across the road that's open until 10 PM, making it convenient for dinner nearby. Since it's a parking lot at the entrance to Osaibara, it's also convenient for sightseeing in Osaibara first thing the next morning. (Posted by: Mr./Ms. I, January 2021)

■About 100m to Hongu Taisha. Toilets available. There are many hot springs nearby. It's small, so if someone idles their engine next to you, it's game over (older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2020年春にOPENした新しい施設。名産のイカに特化した特産品、食事等あります。九十九湾遊覧船の乗り場も兼ねています。周辺に店舗が少ないので、先に買い出しは必須かも知れません。（投稿：2020年11月、M様）
■トイレは非常にキレイで24時間利用可能との報告あり。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: A new facility that opened in the spring of 2020. It offers specialty products and meals focusing on squid, a local specialty. It also serves as a boarding point for the Tsukumo Bay sightseeing boat. There are few shops in the surrounding area, so it may be necessary to stock up on supplies beforehand. (Posted by Ms. M, November 2020)

■Reports indicate that the toilets are very clean and available 24 hours a day. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2019年5月、車中泊してみたが、前の道路がトラックの通行多く意外とうるさい。深夜までDQN車が出入り。耳栓は必須。トイレは情報通り夜間も利用可能だった。朝起きても迷惑駐車やめろ的な張り紙もされてなかった。翌朝、感謝の気持ちを込めて店で色々買い込んで立ち去った。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■2018年12月、マジで外のトイレは夜間も利用可能でした。これは凄い。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■24時間スーパー。駐車場無料。トイレは外にあるので利用しやすい。ただし、場所的に治安がアレかも・・・。トイレでヤンキーにからまれる＆襲撃される＆店に通報される可能性あり。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: In May 2019, I tried sleeping in my car, but the road in front was surprisingly noisy with a lot of truck traffic. DQN cars (cars belonging to delinquents) were coming and going until late at night. Earplugs are a must. The toilets were usable at night as expected. There were no signs telling people to stop illegal parking when I woke up in the morning. The next morning, I bought various things at the store as a token of my gratitude before leaving. (Older post from before 2019)

■December 2018: The outdoor toilets were indeed usable at night. This is amazing. (Older post from before 2019)

■24-hour supermarket. Free parking. The toilets are outside, making them easy to use. However, the location might be a bit unsafe... There's a possibility of being harassed/attacked by delinquents in the toilets and having the store called. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.title_ja: 宇奈月駅前の有料駐車場
properties.title_en: Paid parking lot in front of Unazuki Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：1日1000円（※普通車で1泊2日の場合1,500円、詳細）ですが、目の前にトロッコ列車の始発駅があり、とても便利です。24時間、駅のトイレ使用可能。静かで快適です。（投稿：2023年5月、デブお様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: It costs 1,000 yen per day (1,500 yen for a 1-night, 2-day stay in a regular car, see details), but it's very convenient as the starting station for the trolley train is right in front of it. The station toilets are available 24 hours a day. It's quiet and comfortable. (Posted by: Debuo, May 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：17：00以降無料。以前は閉鎖されていましたが八幡掘のライトアップに併せて解放されているようです。綺麗な公衆トイレあり。管理されている所に電話で確認しましたが、車中泊OKとのことでした。古くからの住宅地のど真ん中なので非常に静か。絶対に苦情の出ないような利用を。アイドリングなどは絶対に響いて駄目だと思います。（投稿：2024年6月、h様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free after 17:00. It used to be closed, but it seems to have been opened in conjunction with the illumination of Hachimanbori Canal. There is a clean public toilet. I called the management and they said that overnight parking is OK. It is in the middle of an old residential area, so it is very quiet. Please use it in a way that will not cause any complaints. Idling your engine would definitely be a problem as it would make noise. (Submitted by h in June 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：11月6日　能登島道の駅（道の駅 のとじま）に　泊まりました。近く２.５キロのところに　温泉があります。途中にファミリーマートがあり　よかった。ただ　男子トイレの照明が　少し暗い。（投稿：2022年11月、t様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：静かで広い駐車場。第2駐車場にトイレがあり夜間も使える。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Reader Report: November 6th - I stayed at the Notojima Roadside Station (Michi-no-Eki Notojima). There's a hot spring 2.5 km away. It was nice that there was a FamilyMart along the way. However, the lighting in the men's restroom was a little dim. (Submitted by: t, November 2022)

■Reader Report: Quiet and spacious parking lot. There's a restroom in the second parking lot that's usable at night. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: （変質者 出没注意）源氏浜 無料駐車場 琵琶湖
properties.title_en: (Caution: Suspicious individuals may be present) Genjihama Free Parking, Lake Biwa""
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：変質者が出たので注意喚起として初めてのコメントにてご連絡させて頂いてます。25/05/01　PM9:00頃　窓をノックされ「少しお話を」と言われる。当方女性で男の人が相手だったので窓は開けたくないと伝えるが開けて欲しいとの事で少しドアを開けると「この辺は自殺者が多いので見回りをしている者です」と言われました。一人かどうか確認された後、段々と卑猥な言葉を発し始めました。こちらが強めの言葉を発しドアを閉めてロックしたらトイレの方に消えて行きました。変質者が出たのでこの場所は女性の方は特に気を付けてください！ドアは絶対に空けないように！（投稿：2025年5月、yuki様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：無料駐車場トイレあり（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: I'm writing this as a warning because a pervert was spotted. Around 9:00 PM on May 1st, 2025, someone knocked on my window and said, "I'd like to talk for a bit." I'm a woman, and the person was a man, so I told him I didn't want to open the window, but he insisted. When I opened the door slightly, he said, "There are a lot of suicides around here, so I'm on patrol." After confirming I was alone, he gradually began using obscene language. I responded with firm words, closed the door, and locked it, and he disappeared towards the restroom. A pervert was spotted, so women should be especially careful in this area! Never open the door! (Posted by: yuki, May 2025)

■Report from our site's reader: Free parking and restrooms available (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：「台湾ラーメン」発祥の店。詳細、食べログ（投稿：2022年3月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: The restaurant where "Taiwanese Ramen" originated. Details on Tabelog (Posted by n in March 2022)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: 麺屋はなび 高畑本店
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：「台湾まぜそば」発祥の店。食べログ（投稿：2022年3月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: The restaurant where "Taiwanese mixed noodles" originated. (Tabelog review: March 2022, by user n)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: カレーのチャンピオン 野々市本店
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：「金沢カレー」元祖の店。詳細、食べログ（投稿：2025年8月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: The original "Kanazawa Curry" restaurant. Details on Tabelog (Posted: August 2025, by user n)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 銀の馬車道・神河
properties.title_en: Roadside Station Gin no Bashamichi Kamikawa
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：（昼間訪問のため、ロケーションのみ）国道と川に挟まれた場所、川の対岸に播但道が通っている。播但道の走行音も聞こえるが、川のせせらぎのほうが良く聞こえる。駐車スペースは、おおむね国道沿いが大型車、川側が普通車になっている。国道は峠越えの入口付近に位置している。交通量が多くなければそれなりに静かな環境になる。（投稿：2024年6月、c様）
■2017年11月25日オープン！
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: (Location only, as it was a daytime visit) Located between a national highway and a river, with the Bantan Expressway running on the opposite bank of the river. While the sound of traffic on the Bantan Expressway can be heard, the sound of the river is more clearly audible. Parking spaces are generally arranged with large vehicles along the national highway and regular cars on the river side. The national highway is located near the entrance to a mountain pass. If traffic is light, it's a fairly quiet environment. (Submitted by: c, June 2024)
■Opened November 25, 2017!

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：（株）イビコン大垣工場の西。水汲み場あり。水質検査済。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: West of Ibicon Co., Ltd.'s Ogaki factory. There is a water source. Water quality has been tested.

properties.label: Highway Rest + Shower
properties.title_ja: 鈴鹿PA（PIT SUZUKA）（新名神高速道路）
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：（下り側について）2019年12月の平日に利用。新しいPAなのに、もう夜になると大型車マスが不足していて、普通車マスの多くをトラックが占領していました。ただ、心配したほど騒音はなく、ゆっくり休めました。朝の空気が清々しくて気持ちいい。EV用の急速充電器があります。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：下道用プラットパークは入り口がわかりづらいし、小さな看板で長時間駐車は遠慮するようにと。　高速側駐車場は大型がいつも多く静かではない。　コンビニ、食堂、パン屋、F1実機展示有り。トイレも最新で快適だが、特殊な金具で洗顔はしづらい。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■上下コインシャワーあり！24時間、300円/10分
■上下ぷらっとぱーく24時間OK！
■2019年3月17日供用開始！
■標高157m
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: (Regarding the southbound side) Used on a weekday in December 2019. Despite being a new rest area, by nightfall there was a shortage of parking spaces for large vehicles, and many of the regular car spaces were occupied by trucks. However, it wasn't as noisy as I feared, and I was able to rest comfortably. The morning air was refreshing and pleasant. There is a fast charger for EVs. (Older post from before 2019)

■Report from our site's reader: The entrance to the local road rest area is difficult to find, and there's a small sign asking people to refrain from parking for extended periods. The highway side parking lot is always crowded with large vehicles and not quiet. There's a convenience store, a restaurant, a bakery, and an F1 car on display. The toilets are modern and comfortable, but the special fittings make washing your face difficult. (Older post from before 2019)

■Coin-operated showers available on both sides! 24 hours, 300 yen/10 minutes

■24-hour rest area access!

■Opened March 17, 2019!

■Elevation 157m

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：（下りについて）2019年8月投稿。阪神方面訪問時の前夜泊スポットとして度々利用します。半世紀以上前からの古参SAですが、さすがにもう手狭感が溢れています。特に平日は大型車がマスからはみ出しまくりで、小型車マスはおろか通路スペースまで多数駐まっています。耳栓必携が良いと思います。でも週末なら大型車が少ないので、かなり快適ですよ。EV用の急速充電機があります。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■2016年4月、車中泊車両を狙った強盗発生。要注意。関西はやっぱりヤバい。詳細記事
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: (Regarding the southbound lane) Posted in August 2019. I often use this as an overnight stop before visiting the Hanshin area. It's an old service area that's been around for over half a century, but it's definitely starting to feel cramped. Especially on weekdays, large vehicles spill out of the parking spaces, and many are parked not only in the small car spaces but also in the aisle spaces. I think it's a good idea to bring earplugs. However, there are fewer large vehicles on weekends, so it's quite comfortable. There is a fast charger for EVs. (Older post from before 2019)

■In April 2016, a robbery targeting vehicles parked overnight occurred. Be careful. Kansai is really dangerous. Detailed article

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.title_ja: 大府PA（下り側ぷらっとパーク24時間OK）
properties.title_en: Obu PA (downbound side, Plat Park available 24 hours)""
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート： (下り) 一般道側駐車場（ぷらっとパーク）について。無料、トイレ含め24時間利用可能。静かさ：高速から施設を挟んでいるため静かです。その他評価ポイント：白魦池に面しており朝散歩できます。隈研吾デザインのPA施設（笑）マイナス評価ポイント：7台分しかありません、入口に面している道路が狭いです。上り側ぷらっとパークは夜間閉まっていますので下り側だけになります。（投稿：2024年12月、十口様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: (Southbound) Regarding the general road side parking lot (Plat Park). Free, 24-hour access including restrooms. Quietness: It is quiet because the facility is separated from the highway. Other positive points: It faces Shirai Pond, so you can take a morning stroll. A PA facility designed by Kengo Kuma (lol). Negative points: There are only 7 parking spaces, and the road facing the entrance is narrow. The northbound Plat Park is closed at night, so only the southbound side is available. (Submitted by: Tokuchi, December 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート： ’25-10-17 現地確認　紀伊山地の奥部に位置し、標高404ｍ、夏でも涼しく、非常に静かなところです。Ｒ425は名だたる「酷道」ですが、この辺りはまだ幅員が広く安全です。昼夜とも、通行車両は少なく、安眠できます。駐車スペースはトイレ周辺でどこもフラットです。トイレ(添付画像、添付画像)は24h使え、身障者用のみ温水洗浄便座で、きれいにされています。水場もあります。近くに商店はありません。入浴は3.6km東に「きなりの湯」（詳細）（投稿：2025年10月、tossan様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: '25-10-17 On-site verification Located deep in the Kii Mountains, at an altitude of 404m, it is cool even in summer and very quiet. Route 425 is notorious as a "terrible road," but this area is still wide and safe. There is little traffic both day and night, so you can sleep soundly. Parking spaces are all flat around the toilets. The toilets (attached images) are available 24 hours a day, and only the disabled-accessible toilet has a heated bidet seat and is kept clean. There is also a water source. There are no shops nearby. For bathing, see "Kinari no Yu" 3.6km to the east (details) (Posted by: tossan, October 2025)

properties.desc_en: ■ Amanohashidate is a 3.6-kilometer-long sandbar at the mouth of Miyazu Bay and the inland sea of ​​Aso Bay in Miyazu City, Kyoto Prefecture. It is one of Japan's three most scenic spots, and in 2013, it was the number one tourist destination in Kyoto Prefecture excluding Kyoto City, with 1,781,900 visitors. Details

properties.desc_en: ■An extremely popular eel restaurant. The special set with 5 pieces of eel is a bargain at 2200 yen. Despite the low price, it's grilled over charcoal, not gas. Moreover, there's absolutely no strange smell. It's surprisingly delicious. A highly recommended restaurant. A word of caution: the large portion of rice is enormous, so you should probably avoid ordering the large size. Also, even on weekdays, there's a line before opening, so it's recommended to line up after 10am. They start letting people in around 10:30am. Tabelog

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■超穴場を発見。無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。非常に静かだが、当然ながら地元民には全力で警戒される。通報されて職質もあり。トイレは坂を上がった公園内にある。水洗洋式で非常にキレイで驚いた。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■I discovered a real hidden gem. Free parking and public toilets. It's extremely quiet, but naturally, the locals are on high alert. You might even get reported and questioned by the police. The toilets are located in a park at the top of a hill. I was surprised at how clean they were, with flush toilets and Western-style. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■超穴場を発見。無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。トイレは水洗和式できれいに手入れされている。携帯電波もOK。夜は誰も来ないので非常に静かで素晴らしい。（2020年11月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en: ■I discovered a real hidden gem. Free parking and public toilets. The toilets are flushable Japanese style and are kept clean. Cell phone reception is also OK. No one comes at night, so it's incredibly quiet and wonderful. (Confirmed on-site by the administrator in November 2020)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.desc_ja: ■超穴場を発見。無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。トイレは管理棟（シルバー人材センター）入り口の右側にあり、夜間も利用可能。駐車場は17:30〜翌朝9時まで閉鎖され、出入りできなくなる（年末年始はずっと閉鎖になるので注意）。駐車場入口の門扉の手前に数台停められるスペースが有り、そこで強引に車中泊も可能（若干の傾斜＆目の前の道路の走行音がややうるさい＆早朝に出ていく必要がある）。また、夜間閉鎖されるが隣接のイオン駐車場に車を停めて、ここのトイレを使うという手もある。
properties.desc_en: ■I discovered a hidden gem. Free parking and public restrooms. The restrooms are located to the right of the entrance to the administration building (Silver Human Resources Center) and are available even at night. The parking lot is closed from 5:30 PM to 9:00 AM the following morning, and you will not be able to enter or exit (note that it will be closed all year during the New Year holidays). There is space for a few cars to park just before the gate at the entrance to the parking lot, and it is possible to park there overnight (it is slightly sloped, the traffic noise from the road in front is a bit loud, and you will need to leave early in the morning). Alternatively, although it is closed at night, you can park your car in the adjacent Aeon parking lot and use the restrooms there.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■超穴場を発見。未舗装の無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレは仮設トイレだが、簡易水洗の和式でちゃんと管理されており、それほど臭くない。携帯電波OK。治安については自己責任。住宅街に近い公園なので、早朝から地元民が集まってくる。（2022年12月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en: ■A hidden gem discovered. Unpaved free parking lot and public toilets. Confirmed not to be closed at night. The toilets are temporary, but they are Japanese-style flush toilets that are properly maintained and don't smell too bad. Cell phone reception is OK. Safety is at your own risk. Since it's a park close to a residential area, locals start gathering there from early in the morning. (Confirmed on-site by administrator in December 2022)

properties.desc_ja:

■公式駐車場は夜間閉鎖されるが、ここの公衆トイレ（👉️詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真（2024年9月撮影））は夜も使える。このトイレ付近に路上駐車となるが、駐車禁止の標識は無い。山の上（標高311mと意外と高い）のため、夜は比較的涼しくなる。ただ人気が無いので、地元ヤンキーにおもしろ半分に襲撃される可能性あり。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■It's unclear if they're locals, but cars keep coming to check things out until late at night (they turn around and go back). It's creepy. I wouldn't recommend it for safety reasons. 👉️Apparently, this area is a Pokémon spot, which is why people come even at night. (Confirmed by administrator in May 2020)
■The official parking lot is closed at night, but the public toilets here (👉️Detailed map and photo of the toilets 🚻 (taken in September 2024)) are open at night. You'll have to park on the street near these toilets, but there are no no-parking signs. Because it's on top of a mountain (surprisingly high at 311m above sea level), it gets relatively cool at night. However, since there are no people around, there's a possibility of being attacked by local delinquents for fun. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_en: ■This is one of the most scenic spots in the entire country. The autumn leaves at the temples around here are incredibly vibrant. It gets extremely congested, so I recommend arriving the night before and staying overnight in a coin parking lot, or arriving early in the morning and waiting at the entrance to the municipal parking lot. A famous spot for autumn leaves.

properties.label: Roadside Station + Onsen
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 うみんぴあ大飯
properties.desc_ja:
■車中泊評価【Sランク🤩】89点👉️採点詳細と詳細案内図はこちら。（2024年11月）
■入浴♨️：シーサイドスパ おおいの湯、1200円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：2023.10.6利用。道の駅うみんぴあ大飯は、車中泊車でほぼ満車となり大型車エリアも車中泊車で占有され、車間(パーソナルスパース)が確保できず、車中泊にはおすすめ出来ません。対応として。。。。。ホテルうみんぴあ前のSEE SEA PARK(複合商業施設)駐車場（詳細）を利用しました、この駐車場には、駐車制限等が無く24h駐車可能です、道の駅(トイレ）にも１~2分でアクセス可能です。また、道の駅の道向かい、関電広報施設(エルガイアおおい）横の空き地（未舗装、砂利地）（詳細）も駐車制限がなさそうです。Wifi：SEE SEA PARK(複合商業施設）内のTHREE TIMES COFFEE。WAKASA(コーヒーショップ)の電波が受信可ですが、電波が弱く道を挟んで最短の位置に駐車が必要。入浴：シーサイドスパ おおいの湯（詳細）で入浴可能ですが、温泉ではありません。スーパー：サニーマート おおい店　徒歩5分。（投稿：2023年10月、n様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：非常に素敵な道の駅で、道の駅前の駐車スペースはそれほど多くはないのですが（20台位）、隣に大きな芝生の公園（成海緑地）があり、大きな駐車スペースがあります（50～60台位？）。国道から100mほど入った所にあり、芝生公園の先は釣り禁止のきれいな岸壁で、非常に静かな場所にあります。道の駅から3分は無理ですが、徒歩5分以内にスーパーと入浴施設“シーサイドスパおおいの湯”があります。道の駅のトイレは24時間使用可能です。芝生公園側にもトイレはありますが、夜間はシャッターが下りてました（空いてる時間は記載が無かったので分かりません）。今回別の所に宿泊予定でしたが、公園があまりに素敵だったので予定を変更して泊まりました。犬連れだったので、ゆっくり楽しむ事ができました。とても良いところです。私的にはAクラスでした。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Car Camping Rating [S Rank 🤩] 89 points 👉️ Click here for detailed scoring and detailed map. (November 2024)
■Bathing ♨️: Seaside Spa Oi no Yu, 1200 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: Used on October 6, 2023. Michi-no-Eki Uminpia Oi is almost full of cars parked overnight, and the large vehicle area is also occupied by cars parked overnight, making it impossible to secure personal space between vehicles, so it is not recommended for car camping. As a solution... . . . . I used the SEE SEA PARK (commercial complex) parking lot in front of Hotel Uminpia (details). This parking lot has no parking restrictions and is open 24 hours a day. It is also a 1-2 minute walk to the roadside station (toilets). Also, the vacant lot (unpaved, gravel) next to the Kansai Electric Power Company public relations facility (Elgaia Oi) across the road from the roadside station (details) also appears to have no parking restrictions. Wifi: THREE TIMES COFFEE inside SEE SEA PARK (a multi-purpose commercial complex). While WAKASA (a coffee shop) has a signal, it's weak and requires parking in the closest possible location across the street. Bathing: Bathing is available at Seaside Spa Oino-yu (details), but it's not a hot spring. Supermarket: Sunny Mart Oino-yu, 5-minute walk. (Posted: October 2023, by n)
■Report from our site's reader: This is a very nice roadside station. While there aren't many parking spaces in front of the station (around 20), there's a large grassy park next door (Narumi Green Space) with ample parking space (around 50-60 cars?). It's located about 100m from the national highway, and beyond the grassy park is a beautiful pier where fishing is prohibited, making it a very quiet location. While it's not quite 3 minutes from the roadside station, a supermarket and the bathing facility "Seaside Spa Oino-yu" are within a 5-minute walk. The toilets at the roadside station are available 24 hours a day. There are toilets on the lawn park side, but the shutters were down at night (there was no information about the opening hours, so I don't know). I had originally planned to stay somewhere else, but the park was so lovely that I changed my plans and stayed here. Since I had my dog ​​with me, I was able to relax and enjoy myself. It's a really great place. I would rate it an A-class. (Older post from before 2019)

■車中泊評価【Sランク🤩】87点👉️採点詳細と詳細案内図はこちら。（2025年5月）
■入浴♨️：《シーサイドヴィラ渤海》日帰り入浴600円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：2022年7月の平日に利用。幹線道路沿いながら、さほど騒音もなく休めました。ただ、真夏の道の駅あるあるですが･･、トイレが蚊の巣窟。夜だけでなく、朝も大変です。EVの急速充電器があります。北隣の「シーサイドヴィラ渤海」（ピラミッド型の屋根）に日帰り温泉「渤海温泉」があります。（投稿：2022年8月、n様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：日帰り温泉が隣にあります。日帰り温泉というより公営の宿泊施設のようで、大浴場は日帰り温泉施設としても営業。サイトの表示では入浴施設がありませんのでお知らせします。利用客が減っているのか露天風呂浴槽の一部は使用していません。ファミマも隣にあり、ファミマの先にはスーパーがあります。夕方になると弁当類が半額になります。ラーメン屋なども近くにありますが夜間は交通量が少なく静か。トイレが広くないのが欠点かもしれませんが、車中泊する人が少ないので支障ありません。車いす用のトイレもあり着替えなどに使えます。道の駅の裏は海岸で世界一長いベンチがあります。個人的にはSランクだと思います。ただし駐車場とトイレが小さいので人気が出ると困りますが・・・。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Car Camping Rating [S Rank 🤩] 87 points 👉️ Click here for detailed scoring and detailed map. (May 2025)
■Bathing ♨️: Seaside Villa Bohai - Day trip bathing 600 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: Used on a weekday in July 2022. Although it's along a main road, it wasn't too noisy and I was able to rest. However, as is common at roadside stations in mid-summer, the toilets are mosquito nests. It's terrible not only at night but also in the morning. There is an EV fast charger. To the north, at "Seaside Villa Bohai" (with a pyramid-shaped roof), there is a day-trip hot spring "Bohai Onsen". (Posted: August 2022, by n)
■Report from our site's reader: There is a day-trip hot spring next door. It seems more like a public accommodation facility than a day-trip hot spring, and the large bath also operates as a day-trip hot spring facility. I'm letting you know because the site doesn't show a bathing facility. It seems that the number of visitors has decreased, as part of the open-air bath is not in use. There is a FamilyMart convenience store next door, and a supermarket further down the street. In the evenings, bento boxes are half price. There are ramen shops and other restaurants nearby, but it is quiet at night with little traffic. The toilets are not very spacious, which may be a drawback, but it is not a problem as there are few people who stay overnight in their cars. There is also a wheelchair-accessible toilet that can be used for changing clothes. Behind the roadside station is the coast and there is the world's longest bench. Personally, I would rank it as S-rank. However, the parking lot and toilets are small, so it will be a problem if it becomes popular... (Older post from before 2019)

■車中泊評価【Bランク】57点👉️採点詳細と詳細案内図はこちら。（2024年11月）
■当サイト読者様レポート：古墳の湯：昨日、2025/3/31をもって閉館。車中泊は公園駐車場のため、お風呂が遠くなった以外は特段影響なさそう。そのため、車で10分程度の近くの入浴施設は ユーフォリア千里浜、里湯ちりはま（詳細）の2軒となります。（投稿：2025年4月、yuko様）

■当サイト読者様レポート：アイコンの場所は古墳公園のトイレになっていて、そこの前にも駐車は可能だが、もう少し良さそうなのは古墳の湯と古墳公園の共用の第2駐車場。公園で野営してた方もいたくらいなので、駐車場の夜間閉鎖もなさそう。男女別トイレは和式水洗と洋式水洗。(多目的は未確認)（投稿：2023年4月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en:
■Car Camping Rating [Rank B] ​​57 points 👉️Click here for detailed scoring and detailed map. (November 2024)
■Report from our site's reader: Kofun no Yu: Closed yesterday, March 31, 2025. Since car camping is in the park's parking lot, there doesn't seem to be any particular impact other than the bath being further away. Therefore, the nearest bathing facilities within about 10 minutes by car are Euphoria Chirihama and Satoyu Chirihama (details). (Posted by: yuko, April 2025)
■The adjacent "Kofun no Yu" will close in March 2025 😭. Details
■Report from our site's reader: The location of the icon is the toilet in Kofun Park, and parking is possible in front of it, but a slightly better option is the second parking lot shared by Kofun no Yu and Kofun Park. There were even people camping in the park, so it seems unlikely that the parking lot will be closed at night. The men's and women's toilets are separate, with Japanese-style and Western-style flush toilets. (Multipurpose use is unconfirmed) (Posted by: yuko, April 2023)

■入浴♨️：《いび川温泉 藤橋の湯》700円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：2023.10.4  17:00～23:00。入浴、休憩。隣接する、いび川温泉 藤橋の湯（詳細）で入浴が可能。街灯は、22:00位に消灯するが、国道街路灯があり、明るい。（投稿：2023年10月、n様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2022年9月の平日に利用。食事処ふじはし：あまご定食は異なる料理のあまごが3尾も！美味いし、しかも安い！新鮮な川魚に満足しました。 温泉：「内湯と露天風呂が温泉、他は白湯」という良心的な表示が好印象です。温泉はぬるめの源泉掛け流しです。駐車場：ちょっとだけ傾斜があります。トイレの近くに駐めましたが、地デジは入りませんでした。EVの充電器があります。（投稿：2022年10月、n様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレウォッシュレット３、wifiは遠くまで届く。国道に面しているが、静か、暴走族来なかった。四方を山に囲まれている、道の駅の名前が星のふる里、浮かんだ言葉が、井の中の・・・。岐阜県の道の駅の名前は不思議な名前が多い。（投稿：2021年6月、渡り鳥漫遊記様）
■星がきれいという宣伝だが、正直、たいしたことない。暴走族？走り屋？のたまり場になっているので車中泊はおすすめしない。温泉併設なのは良い。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■標高158m
properties.desc_en:
■Car Camping Rating [A Rank 😄] 83 points 👉️ Click here for detailed scoring and detailed map. (November 2024)
■Bathing ♨️: Ibigawa Onsen Fujihashi no Yu 700 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: October 4, 2023, 17:00-23:00. Bathing and rest. Bathing is possible at the adjacent Ibigawa Onsen Fujihashi no Yu (details). Streetlights are turned off around 22:00, but there are national highway streetlights, so it is bright. (Posted: October 2023, by n)
■Report from our site's reader: Used on a weekday in September 2022. Fujihashi Restaurant: The Amago set meal had 3 Amago fish prepared in different ways! Delicious and cheap! Satisfied with the fresh river fish. Hot Springs: The honest sign stating "The indoor and outdoor baths are hot springs, the others are regular hot water" left a good impression. The hot springs are lukewarm and free-flowing from the source. Parking: There is a slight slope. I parked near the toilet, but there was no digital TV reception. There is an EV charger. (Posted: October 2022, by n)
■Report from our site's reader: Three toilets with bidet functions, and the Wi-Fi reaches far. It faces a national highway, but it's quiet, and no biker gangs came. It's surrounded by mountains on all sides, the name of the roadside station is Hoshi no Furusato (Village of the Stars), the words that came to mind were "in a well..." Many roadside stations in Gifu Prefecture have strange names. (Posted: June 2021, by Wataridori Manyuki)
■It's advertised as having beautiful stars, but honestly, it's not that great. Biker gangs? Street racers? It seems to be a hangout, so I don't recommend staying overnight in your car. The fact that it has a hot spring is a plus. (Older posts from before 2019)
■ Elevation 158m

properties.title_en: Katsuura Port Pier Parking Lot, Katsuura Fishing Port Green Park (Free Parking)""
properties.desc_ja:
■桟橋入り口に「届出車両以外駐車不可」の看板があるが、これは桟橋入ってすぐの駐車スペースの話で、奥の「勝浦漁港緑地公園」は無料で駐車してもOK。詳細レポート（2020年）
■浦島、中之島温泉へはここに車を置いて、桟橋から船で行けばOK。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：17年4月29日の土曜日に行って来ました。しかし、桟橋の入り口に、「和歌山県で管理している月極駐車場のため、駐車禁止」との看板が出ていました。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：水洗WCあり 勝浦漁協市場近く無料「足湯」あり その近く、亀の無料送迎船にて「ホテル浦島（TEL:0735-52-1011）」日帰り入浴可 大￥1000、小￥500、幼￥無料、「大洞窟温泉忘帰洞」は一浴の価値有り、他全７カ所の風呂入浴可（入り放題、入浴時間注意）利用可時間9:00-19:00。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■There's a sign at the pier entrance that says "No parking except for registered vehicles," but this only applies to the parking space immediately inside the pier. Parking is free at the "Katsuura Fishing Port Green Park" further inside. Detailed report (2020)
■To get to Urashima and Nakanoshima Onsen, you can park your car here and take a boat from the pier. (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from a reader of this site: I went there on Saturday, April 29th, 2017. However, there was a sign at the pier entrance that said, "No parking as this is a monthly parking lot managed by Wakayama Prefecture." (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from our site's reader: Flush toilets available. Free "footbath" near Katsuura Fisheries Cooperative Market. Nearby, take the free turtle shuttle boat to "Hotel Urashima (TEL: 0735-52-1011)" for day-use bathing. Adults ¥1000, children ¥500, infants free. "Daidotsutsu Onsen Bokikyo" is worth a bath. You can also use all 7 other baths (unlimited use, be aware of bathing times). Available hours: 9:00-19:00. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)

properties.desc_ja: ■三井水とは「清浄水」「楊柳水」「吉祥水」の三つの井戸からなり、寺の名はこれに因んで名付けたとされている。 水汲み場所あり。寺としては生飲料は推奨してないみたい。
properties.desc_en: ■Mitsui-sui consists of three wells: "Seijo-sui" (Pure Water), "Yoryu-sui" (Willow Water), and "Kichijo-sui" (Auspicious Water). The temple is said to have been named after these three wells. There is a place to draw water. The temple does not seem to recommend drinking the water raw.

properties.title_en: Matabei Cherry Blossom Parking Lot (Parking fee: 500 yen per visit during cherry blossom season)
properties.desc_ja:
■桜シーズンは有料で一回５００円。公衆トイレ（水洗でキレイ）がすぐ近くにある。桜シーズンにはカメラマンが大集合。夜は管理員がいなくなるので、夜に入庫して車中泊、翌朝５：３０ごろに管理員が来るので、朝の又兵衛桜を撮影後に、出庫時に５００円払えばいい。駐車場は砂利敷で、夜中にカメラマンが続々とやってくるので静かではない（又兵衛桜＋天の川を撮影するために夜中にカメラマンが集まる）。耳栓したほうがいい。桜シーズン以外は超静かで最高（桜シーズン以外は無料）。（2019年4月管理人現地確認）
■標高385m
properties.desc_en:
■During cherry blossom season, there is a fee of 500 yen per visit. There is a public toilet (clean and flushable) very close by. During cherry blossom season, a large number of photographers gather. The caretaker is not on duty at night, so you can park there at night, sleep in your car, and the caretaker will come around 5:30 the next morning. After photographing the Matabei cherry tree in the morning, you can pay 500 yen when you leave. The parking lot is covered in gravel, and it's not quiet as photographers arrive in droves throughout the night (photographers gather at night to photograph the Matabei cherry tree and the Milky Way). It's best to wear earplugs. Outside of cherry blossom season, it's extremely quiet and wonderful (free outside of cherry blossom season). (Confirmed on-site by caretaker in April 2019)
■Elevation 385m

properties.desc_ja: ■黒門市場の東側のエリアに、24時間最大800円、当日最大700円など安いコインパーキングが多数ある。👉️この周辺のコインパーキングを探してみる。トイレは南側の「ファミリーマート 日本橋二丁目店」（詳細）にきれいな水洗洋式のトイレがある。公衆トイレは遠いが道頓堀まで歩けばある（詳細）。徒歩圏内に銭湯♨️「末広湯」もあり（詳細）。難波観光の拠点としてオススメの車中泊エリア。なおオススメ候補は、タイムズ日本橋２丁目第２、リパーク 日本橋２丁目第３、エコパーキング日本橋。（2023年2月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en: ■There are many inexpensive coin-operated parking lots in the area east of Kuromon Market, with rates such as a maximum of 800 yen for 24 hours and 700 yen for the day. 👉️Try searching for coin-operated parking lots in this area. There is a clean, flushable Western-style toilet at the FamilyMart Nihonbashi 2-chome store (details) on the south side. Public toilets are a bit far, but you can walk to Dotonbori (details). There is also a public bathhouse, Suehiro-yu, within walking distance (details). This is a recommended area for overnight stays in your car as a base for sightseeing in Namba. Recommended parking options include Times Nihonbashi 2-chome No. 2, Repark Nihonbashi 2-chome No. 3, and Eco Parking Nihonbashi. (Confirmed on-site by administrator in February 2023)

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 湯の峰温泉 つぼ湯、薬湯
properties.title_en: Yunomine Onsen: Tsuboyu (hot spring bath), Yakuyu (medicinal bath)""
properties.desc_ja:
■公衆浴場400円、くすり湯600円、つぼ湯800円、料金詳細
■【世界遺産】つぼ湯は、日本最古の温泉と言われる。しかもなんと世界遺産。お湯は白濁したお湯です。休日はかなり順番待ちになるので、朝一で来た方が良い。朝一の方がお湯も綺麗です。公衆浴場の薬湯もなかなか良いお湯です。
■管理人評価：★4.8（泉質4.5、景色は全体の雰囲気を評価して0.3）つぼ湯は珍しいということで一回入ればいいかなという感じ。併設共同浴場の薬湯のほうは普通にいい湯です。
properties.desc_en:
■Public bath 400 yen, medicinal bath 600 yen, pot bath 800 yen, price details
■【World Heritage Site】Tsuboyu is said to be the oldest hot spring in Japan. Moreover, it's a World Heritage Site. The water is cloudy white. There's quite a wait on weekends, so it's best to come first thing in the morning. The water is also cleaner in the morning. The medicinal bath in the public bath is also quite good.

■Manager's rating: ★4.8 (Spring quality 4.5, scenery 0.3 based on overall atmosphere) Tsuboyu is rare, so one visit is probably enough. The medicinal bath in the adjoining communal bath is just a normal, good bath.

properties.desc_en:
■Only 250 yen! Details
■Report from our site's reader: This is a heated swimming pool and bathing facility located inside the Kora Town Health and Welfare Center, 1.5km west (towards Lake Biwa) on Prefectural Road 227 from the Seseragi no Sato Kora Roadside Station. It's easy to find as it's across from Kora Town Municipal Kora Junior High School. The baths include an indoor bath and a small open-air bath. The bathing fee is a bargain at 250 yen, and it's great that rinse-in shampoo and body soap are provided. (Posted by: Y, March 2021)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja: ■こんな超絶山奥に温泉施設。800円、詳細。露天風呂が非常に素晴らしい！清流沿いで、対岸の広葉樹を一望できる。滝も流れている。風に揺れる葉をボーッと眺めていると心が安らぐ。一幅の絵画というか曼荼羅である。秋は絶景でしょうねこれは。休憩所も完備。休憩所にコンセントありPC充電可能。ペットボトルの水を露天風呂に持ち込んで、ゆっくりするのがおすすめ。非常に素晴らしい。
properties.desc_en: ■A hot spring facility in such an extremely remote mountain area. 800 yen, details. The open-air bath is absolutely wonderful! It's along a clear stream, offering a panoramic view of the broadleaf trees on the opposite bank. There's even a waterfall. Just gazing at the leaves swaying in the wind is incredibly peaceful. It's like a painting, or rather, a mandala. It must be a spectacular sight in autumn. There's also a rest area. There are power outlets in the rest area so you can charge your PC. I recommend bringing a bottle of water to the open-air bath and relaxing. It's truly wonderful.

properties.desc_ja: ■ここに来る時に高速道路から見える夜景が凄く綺麗。騒音は耳栓で我慢するとして、空中PAで揺れが結構あるのであまりおすすめできない。中島PA 湾岸の中島は天気のいい休み前の夜は 戦闘機みたいな音立てて300ｷﾛとかで 走る連中が集結してることがあるぞ 中島は走り屋が来ると辛いな 駐車場というよりも駐機場と化す さすがに２時を回るとおおむね静かになるけど【無線LAN 24時間 無休】（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■The night view from the highway when coming here is incredibly beautiful. While you can tolerate the noise with earplugs, the aerial rest area shakes quite a bit, so I wouldn't really recommend it. Nakajima PA: On clear nights before holidays, Nakajima on the bay area can be a gathering place for people driving at 300 km/h, making noises like fighter jets. Nakajima is tough when street racers show up; it becomes more like an apron than a parking lot. It does get relatively quiet after 2 AM, though. [Wi-Fi 24 hours a day, no holidays] (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 入の波温泉 山鳩湯
properties.title_en: Iri no Nami Onsen Yamabato Yu
properties.desc_ja:
■900円、詳細
■ここが近畿で最高の泉質という人が多い。「温泉教授」の松田先生も大絶賛。多数の温泉マニアが大絶賛。泉質はナトリウム−炭酸水素塩・塩化物泉。温泉の雰囲気は青森の古遠部、北海道の二股ラジウムと似た感じ。
■管理人評価：★4.75（泉質4.5→4.25、景色0.5）全国的に見てもトップクラスの温泉です。関西にもこんな凄い温泉があるのか！という驚きがあります。釜飯がまじでメチャクチャうまい。風呂に入る受付のときに、風呂上がりの時間指定で釜飯を予約しておくとよい。管理人は鴨の釜飯1500円が好きです。山菜釜飯も美味い。残念ながら、数年前から保健所の指導で塩素添加するようになったようです。かけ流しではあるが塩素添加ということで当サイトの規定により0.25点減点とさせていただきます。しかし、素晴らしい温泉であることには変わりありません。
properties.desc_en:
■900 yen, details
■Many people say this is the best quality hot spring in the Kinki region. Professor Matsuda, the "Hot Spring Professor," also highly praises it. Numerous hot spring enthusiasts highly praise it. The water quality is sodium bicarbonate-chloride spring. The atmosphere of the hot spring is similar to that of Furube in Aomori and Futamata Radium in Hokkaido.

■Administrator's rating: ★4.75 (Water quality 4.5 → 4.25, Scenery 0.5) This is a top-class hot spring even by national standards. You'll be surprised that there's such an amazing hot spring in Kansai! The kamameshi (rice cooked in a pot) is seriously delicious. It's a good idea to reserve the kamameshi when you check in for your bath, specifying the time you'll be finished after your bath. The administrator likes the duck kamameshi for 1500 yen. The wild vegetable kamameshi is also delicious. Unfortunately, it seems that they started adding chlorine a few years ago due to guidance from the public health center. Although it is a free-flowing hot spring, the addition of chlorine means we will deduct 0.25 points according to our site's regulations. However, it remains a wonderful hot spring.

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■800円、詳細
■【日本三古泉】【日本三名泉】【枕草子三名泉】西の横綱有馬温泉、東の横綱草津温泉。数々のビッグタイトルが並びます。とりあえず超超有名温泉ですね。金の湯は含鉄ナトリウム塩化物強塩高温泉。赤いお湯です。
■管理人評価★4.2 （泉質4.2、景色0）ここは源泉掛け流しで濃厚だが、塩素投入が残念。塩素のため香りが死んでいる。入浴者数が多いから仕方ないんでしょうが。あと、窓をあけることもできずひたすら暑い。長居してほしくないんでしょうね。元の温泉は素晴らしいものとは思いますが、この辺で減点。
properties.desc_en:
■800 yen, details
■【Japan's Three Oldest Hot Springs】【Japan's Three Famous Hot Springs】【The Three Famous Hot Springs of The Pillow Book】Arima Onsen, the Yokozuna of the West, and Kusatsu Onsen, the Yokozuna of the East. Numerous big titles are listed. In short, it's an extremely famous hot spring. Kin-no-Yu is a high-temperature, iron-containing sodium chloride strong saline hot spring. The water is red.

■Manager's Rating ★4.2 (Spring Quality 4.2, Scenery 0) This place has a rich, free-flowing hot spring, but the chlorine addition is disappointing. The chlorine kills the scent. It's probably unavoidable because of the large number of bathers. Also, you can't open the windows, so it's incredibly hot. They probably don't want people to linger. While the original hot spring is wonderful, points are deducted for these reasons.

■当サイト読者様レポート：お風呂・プール・スポーツなどが楽しめる複合型の温浴施設です。道の駅・浅井三姉妹の郷から6.4kmと少々離れていますが、お風呂は550円で利用できます。詳細。定休日は火曜日（火曜日が祝日の場合は翌日）です。お風呂は、炭酸泉風呂、天然鉱石SGE風呂、サウナ、露天風呂、また運動浴のバーデプールと特別浴SGEセラミックバスなどがあります。どれも健康効果が高いと評判です。道の駅・浅井三姉妹の郷の近くには、あねがわ温泉（1km），須賀谷温泉（3.5km）がありますが、各々入浴料金が865円，1000円です。これらに比べてお安く入浴できるのが魅力だと思います。（投稿：2021年3月、Y様）
properties.desc_en:
■700 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: This is a multi-purpose hot spring facility where you can enjoy baths, a pool, sports, and more. It's a little far from the roadside station Asai Sanshimai no Sato (6.4km), but you can use the baths for 550 yen. Details. Closed on Tuesdays (or the following day if Tuesday is a public holiday). The baths include a carbonated spring bath, a natural mineral SGE bath, a sauna, an open-air bath, as well as a Bade Pool for exercise and a special SGE ceramic bath. All of them are said to have high health benefits. Near the roadside station Asai Sanshimai no Sato are Anegawa Onsen (1km) and Sugatani Onsen (3.5km), but the entrance fees are 865 yen and 1000 yen respectively. I think the appeal is that you can bathe at a lower price compared to these. (Posted: March 2021, Y)

■管理人評価★4.6（泉質4.3 景色0.3）なかなかよいです。川沿いまで階段を下っていくという本格派。半透明で硫化水素臭がする、川湯温泉みたいな湯。洗い場には茶色の析出物がついている。窓をあけると川と紅葉が一望でき眺めもよい。名湯です。

properties.title_en: Hirayu Folk Museum Hirayu no Yu
properties.desc_ja:
■300円、詳細
■料金は寸志方式で300円以上をポストに入れる。茶色の濁り湯で源泉かけ流しの露天風呂。湧出温度47℃という奇跡的な適温をドバドバ投入してかけ流し。浴槽の温度は43℃という恐るべき適温。何も足さない、何も引かない。これが自然の偶然というのが凄い。無人のほったらかしでこれはメチャクチャ凄い。非常に素晴らしい。本物。泉質は文句なしの満点。
properties.desc_en:
■300 yen, details
■Payment is voluntary; put 300 yen or more in the postbox. An open-air bath with free-flowing, brownish, cloudy hot spring water. The miraculously perfect temperature of 47℃ at the spring source is poured in in abundance and continuously flowing. The temperature of the bathtub is an astonishingly perfect 43℃. Nothing is added, nothing is taken away. It's amazing that this is a natural accident. It's incredibly amazing that it's left unattended and unattended. It's truly wonderful. The real deal. The quality of the spring water is absolutely perfect.

■当サイト読者様レポート：10時〜18時まで日帰り入浴可能な個室貸し切り家族風呂（要電話予約）。天然温泉かけ流しの白濁湯だが加熱はしている。１室に４、５人が入浴可能で４部屋ぐらいあったと思う。料金は１時間１室2410円プラス１人につき50円の入湯税。宿泊も可能で屋外にはドッグランあり。月曜定休日。建物や設備は古めかしい感じがするが、浴室はそこそこ綺麗。浴室からガラス張りの外の坪庭に出ることもできるが、眺望があるわけではない。琵琶湖湖西には意外と日帰り入浴可能な温泉が少ないので重宝する。（投稿：2021年10月、くぅくん様）
properties.desc_en:
■ 3000 yen (private family bath), details
■ Report from our site's reader: A private family bath available for day use from 10am to 6pm (reservations required by phone). It's a natural hot spring with free-flowing, milky-white water, but it is heated. There are about four rooms, and each can accommodate 4 or 5 people. The price is 2410 yen per room for one hour, plus a 50 yen bathing tax per person. Overnight stays are also possible, and there is a dog run outside. Closed on Mondays. The building and facilities feel a bit old-fashioned, but the bathroom is reasonably clean. You can also go out to the glass-enclosed courtyard outside from the bathroom, but there is no view. It's a valuable find as there are surprisingly few hot springs available for day use on the west side of Lake Biwa. (Posted by: Kuu-kun, October 2021)

properties.desc_ja:
■2025年9月管理人現地確認：車中泊評価【Bランク】66点👉️現地の写真・詳細案内図はこちら
■当サイト読者様レポート：ウォッシュレット３ちょっと少ない。wifiあまりよくない。手洗いあたたかい。ごみ箱少ない。休憩所で充電できる。休憩所にも冷房。幹線道路ではないので大型車は少ない。暴走族来なかった、土曜日なのに。昼は満車近く混んでいた、大型車専用(１０台)、一杯にはならない。封鎖された駐車場はない。隣のガソリンスタンド、名古屋から此処までで一番安い。居心地がいいので、明日近くをまわり、また此処で泊まることにしよっと。（投稿：2021年6月、渡り鳥漫遊記様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：新しい道の駅なので設備は素晴らしいです。しかし残念なことに、夜中になると入れ替わり立ち替わり暴走族や爆音族がやってきて、車中泊車の真横に停車して爆音で空ぶかしします。深夜２時頃まで、それが何度も繰り返されます。明らかに恣意的に嫌がらせ（車中泊者の睡眠妨害）を楽しんでいるようです。建物から遠い駐車場があるのですが、暴走族のたまり場になっているとのことで管理者のよって夜間閉鎖されています。この道の駅は、ちょっとおすすめできません。DQNだらけで危険だし安眠不能です。（投稿：2020年11月、Paco様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：はす向かいにコンビニ、隣はセルフスタンド。トイレ大きくて超綺麗。前面道路の交通量はまぁまぁ多いが駐車場がだだっ広いので気にならない。かなりオススメ。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■2018年7月11日オープン。巨大な駐車場。
properties.desc_en:
■September 2025 Administrator's On-site Verification: Car Camping Rating [Rank B] ​​66 points 👉️Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■Report from our site's reader: Three washlets are a bit few. Wi-Fi is not very good. Handwashing facilities are warm. Few trash cans. You can charge your devices in the rest area. There is air conditioning in the rest area. Since it's not on a main road, there are few large vehicles. No biker gangs came, even though it was a Saturday. It was almost full during the day, but the large vehicle-only area (10 spaces) never gets completely full. There are no blocked-off parking areas. The gas station next door is the cheapest from Nagoya to here. It's comfortable, so I'll drive around the area tomorrow and stay here again. (Posted: June 2021, by Wataridori Manyuki)
■Report from our site's reader: Since it's a new roadside station, the facilities are excellent. Unfortunately, at night, biker gangs and loud-engine gangs come and go, parking right next to the cars where people are staying overnight and revving their engines loudly. This is repeated many times until around 2 AM. They clearly seem to be enjoying the harassment (disturbing the sleep of those staying overnight). There is a parking lot far from the building, but it is closed at night by the management because it is a hangout for biker gangs. I would not recommend this roadside station. It's full of delinquents, dangerous, and you can't get a good night's sleep. (Posted by Paco, November 2020)
■Report from a reader of this site: There is a convenience store across the street and a self-service gas station next door. The toilets are large and very clean. The traffic on the road in front is fairly heavy, but the parking lot is so large that it doesn't bother you. Highly recommended. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_en:

■Report from our site's reader: Wave Park Namerikawa Roadside Station in Namerikawa, Toyama Prefecture. It also has a facility called the Firefly Squid Museum. There are also shops and restaurants. The firefly squid exhibit is large. It's hard to notice from the roadside station, but there's a FamilyMart nearby. Within walking distance, in front of Namerikawa Station, there's the Citizen Exchange Plaza, and on the 5th floor is a day-trip hot spring called "Ai Love Yu". I discovered it by chance while looking for a place to rest. From the perspective of someone looking for a car camping spot, this place is quite easy to miss. The roadside station's parking lot is large and quiet at night. I haven't car camped there myself, but I think it's an excellent spot. (Older post from before 2019)

Trucks park in the south side parking lot, so many trucks don't use the idling stop rule, and the engine noise is a bit bothersome. Passenger cars camping there have their idling stops on. There's a hot spring inn called Tojo Onsen Todoroki-so (bathing fee 600 yen) about a 5-minute drive away. (Posted by: Mew, October 2021)

■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ有、外灯有、飲料自販機有。入口注意の道の駅です。R23 岡崎バイパスからの利用は下り線専用になります。R23 一般道からの利用では10分程度のタイムロスが発生します。道路からは若干の距離があり騒音は中程度です。トイレと1時間程度の仮眠をして出発しました。（投稿：2022年9月、s様）

properties.desc_en:

Access from the R23 Okazaki Bypass is limited to the southbound lane only. Access from the R23 general road will result in a time loss of about 10 minutes. It is a short distance from the road, so the noise level is moderate. I used the toilet and took a nap for about an hour before departing. (Posted: September 2022, by s)
■ Located near the bypass, so it is quite noisy at night with speeding cars passing by. Lots of trucks. (Older post from before 2019)
■ Report from our site's reader: No WiMAX2+ signal, AU WiFi available, car TV usable. Restaurant weekdays 9:00-19:00, weekends 7:00-19:00. It was said to be noisy, but it wasn't that bad. Maybe because it was Sunday? (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_ja:
■2025年11月管理人現地確認：車中泊評価【Aランク😄】77点👉️現地の写真・詳細案内図はこちら
■入浴♨️：南濃温泉 水晶の湯、750円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：2025年1月の平日に利用。大型エリアと小型エリアが完全分離でとても良い。幹線道路沿いだが夜間は交通量が少なくて静か。トイレは大きく新しくキレイ。物産店は朝8時、レストランは朝9時にオープン。EV Quickあり。（投稿：2025年2月、n様）
■夜になると暴走族がエンジンふかして暴れるとの報告あり。ソース（2022年5月）
■当サイト読者様レポート：トラック等大型車と一般車の駐車場は分けられており車中泊向けではありますが、一般車側トイレは夜間閉鎖されトラック側のみ24時間利用可能です。駐車場はフラットではなく、傾斜がありますが止め方次第です。レストラン併設ですが19時までの営業と短いです。すぐ近くに温泉施設がありますが、専用駐車場に止めてバス(無料)移動です。割と交通量のある国道258沿いですので若干音は気になりますが止める位置次第です。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■ November 2025 Administrator's On-site Verification: Car Camping Rating [A Rank 😄] 77 points 👉️ Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■ Bathing ♨️: Minamino Onsen Suisho no Yu, 750 yen, details
■ Report from our site's reader: Used on a weekday in January 2025. The large and small areas are completely separated, which is very good. It's along a main road, but traffic is light at night and it's quiet. The toilets are large, new, and clean. The souvenir shop opens at 8 am, and the restaurant at 9 am. EV Quick is available. (Posted: February 2025, by n)
■ There have been reports of biker gangs revving their engines and causing trouble at night. Source (May 2022)
■ Report from our site's reader: The parking areas for large vehicles such as trucks and regular cars are separated, making it suitable for car camping, but the toilets on the regular car side are closed at night, and only the truck side is available 24 hours a day. The parking lot is not flat, but slopes, but it depends on how you park. It has a restaurant attached, but its hours are short, closing at 7 PM. There's a hot spring facility nearby, but you have to park in their dedicated parking lot and take a free bus. It's located along National Route 258, which has a fair amount of traffic, so the noise can be a bit noticeable, but it depends on where you park. (Older post from before 2019)

It's along a main road, but the traffic volume isn't heavy, and you can rest quietly unless you're right next to a large vehicle. The toilets are spacious and clean. There's an EV Quick. (Posted: November 2022, n)
■ Report from our site's reader: Two toilets with washlets, convenience store not open 24 hours. Wi-Fi is available from the convenience store and roadside station. It faces the main road. There's a tatami mat area with a low table in the rest area. (Posted: June 2021, Wataridori Manyuki)

properties.desc_ja:
■2025年10月管理人現地確認：車中泊評価【Bランク】69点👉️現地の写真・詳細案内図はこちら
■確かに、奥の静かな駐車場への入口は23時には閉められていました。表の駐車場はコンビニもあるため夜中も出入りが多い。また、駐車場をぐるっと大型車が周回する構造になっており、静かな場所が無い。あまりおすすめとは言えない。（2020年10月管理人現地確認）
■当サイト読者様レポート：大型車進入禁止の奥が静かでいいとのことですが、現在夜間はそこが閉鎖されて出入りできなくなるようです（朝9時まで閉門とのこと）。特に注意されることも無くいつの間にか閉められたので驚きました。自分はそのまま奥に進んで開いていた裏のゲートから出ましたが、そこはいつも開いているのかたまたまなのか分かりません。もし普段は閉まっているなら9時まで出られない可能性がありますのでご注意を。（投稿：2020年3月、匿名希望様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：無料WiFiあり。静か。敷地内にコンビニあり。海鮮レストラン「敷島」で、400円で名古屋モーニングが食べれます(朝8:00〜10:30まで)。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■October 2025 Administrator's On-Site Verification: Car Camping Rating [Rank B] ​​69 points 👉️Click here for on-site photos and detailed map
■Indeed, the entrance to the quiet parking lot at the back was closed at 11 PM. The front parking lot has a convenience store, so there is a lot of traffic even at night. Also, the parking lot is designed so that large vehicles circle around it, and there is no quiet place. I wouldn't recommend it. (October 2020 Administrator's On-Site Verification)
■Report from a reader of this site: I heard that the back area where large vehicles are prohibited is quiet and nice, but it seems that it is currently closed at night and you cannot enter or exit (the gate is closed until 9 AM). I was surprised because it was closed without any warning. I continued further in and exited through the back gate that was open, but I don't know if it's always open or if it was just a coincidence. If it's usually closed, you may not be able to leave until 9 AM, so please be careful. (Posted: March 2020, Anonymous)
■Report from a reader of this site: Free WiFi available. Quiet. Convenience store on the premises. You can get a Nagoya-style breakfast for 400 yen at the seafood restaurant "Shikishima" (from 8:00 AM to 10:30 AM). (Older post from before 2019)

■ November 2024 Administrator's On-site Verification: Car Camping Rating [Good 😊] 73 points 👉️ Click here for on-site photos and detailed map
■ There is also a parking lot on the back (east side) of the building, and it is extremely quiet there. ( April 2020 Administrator's On-site Verification)
■ Report from a reader of this site: Since it is along a prefectural road, there is a fair amount of traffic even at night, but if you park behind the building, you won't be bothered by the traffic noise. There are supermarkets, home improvement stores, convenience stores, and family restaurants nearby, making it convenient. (Older post from before 2019)
■ There are two "Michi-no-Eki Sakai" in the whole country. The other one is in Ibaraki.

■幹線国道沿い。奥の方もトラックが近いのでアイドリングがうるさい。ここよりも、すぐ近くのチューリップ公園駐車場のほうが静かでおすすめ。（2019年以前の古い投稿）

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 越前たけふ
properties.desc_ja:
■2024年11月管理人現地確認：車中泊評価【良😊】71点👉️現地の写真・詳細案内図はこちら
■当サイト読者様レポート：2023/10/9に利用しました。新幹線開業前で静かかと思いましたが、平日にもかかわらず、珍走やたむろする若者たちで深夜まで騒がしく、安眠できませんでした。とてもきれいな施設なので残念です。偶然だと良いのですが...。駅に向かって右奥が、トラックと離れていて比較的静かです。ただ、武生ICから近いため、終夜、トラックの通行があります。ゴミ箱が設置されていたのはありがたかったです。（投稿：2023年10月、tossan様）
■2023年3月18日オープン。北陸新幹線「越前たけふ駅」と一体型の道の駅。
properties.desc_en:
■ November 2024 Administrator's On-site Verification: Car Camping Rating [Good 😊] 71 points 👉️ Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■ Report from a reader of this site: I used it on October 9, 2023. I thought it would be quiet before the Shinkansen opened, but despite it being a weekday, it was noisy until late at night with reckless drivers and young people loitering, and I couldn't get a good night's sleep. It's a shame because it's a very nice facility. I hope it was just a fluke... The back right side facing the station is relatively quiet as it's away from the trucks. However, because it's close to the Takefu Interchange, there is truck traffic all night long. I was grateful that there were trash cans installed. (Posted: October 2023, by tossan)
■ Opened March 18, 2023. A roadside station integrated with the Hokuriku Shinkansen "Echizen-Takefu Station".

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 若狭おばま
properties.desc_ja:
■2024年11月管理人現地確認：車中泊評価【良😊】71点👉️現地の写真・詳細案内図はこちら
■当サイト読者様レポート：去年、道の駅若狭おばまで車中泊しました。トイレは手入れが行き届いて綺麗でした。近くに海の駅があり、新鮮な海産物がいただけますし、入浴施設も海の駅にあり不自由しませんでした。が、交通量は意外に多く車の音が気になる方は寝付けないかもしれないです。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：構造的に静かです。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：盆休みの福井県車中泊ドライブ一泊目に利用しました。「長時間駐車ご遠慮下さい」の立札があったものの、すでにたくさんの車中泊車がいました。未舗装の長時間用駐車場所が、道の駅裏側に用意されており、脇道の交番の向こうから右に入った奥になります。交番隣で防犯上安心で、トイレも近く建物の陰で静かなので、車中泊におすすめです。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：バス・大型車7台、普通車71台 トイレ、駐車場は24時間。近くにコンビニと0時まで開いてるスーパーあり。夜間の交通量は少なく静か。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■November 2024 Administrator's On-site Verification: Car Camping Rating [Good 😊] 71 points 👉️Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■Report from a reader of this site: Last year, I stayed overnight in my car at Michi-no-Eki Wakasa Oba. The toilets were well-maintained and clean. There is a seaside station nearby where you can enjoy fresh seafood, and there are also bathing facilities at the seaside station, so I had no problems. However, the traffic volume is surprisingly high, and those who are sensitive to car noise may not be able to sleep. (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from a reader of this site: It is structurally quiet. (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from a reader of this site: I used it for the first night of a car camping drive in Fukui Prefecture during the Obon holiday. Although there was a sign that said "Please refrain from parking for long periods of time," there were already many cars parked overnight. An unpaved long-term parking area is provided behind the roadside station, located in the back, past the police box on the side road, to the right. Located next to a police box, it offers peace of mind in terms of security, and with toilets nearby and a quiet location behind a building, it's recommended for overnight stays in your car. (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from our site's readers: 7 buses/large vehicles, 71 regular cars. Toilets and parking are available 24 hours. There's a convenience store and a supermarket open until midnight nearby. Traffic is light and quiet at night. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area

properties.desc_ja:
■2024年11月管理人現地確認：車中泊評価【良😊】70点👉️現地の写真・詳細案内図はこちら
■当サイト読者様レポート：淡路ハイウェイオアシス(有料)について：淡路スマートIC、淡路SA(上り/下り）からアクセス可能。トイレ(ウォシュレット）有。夜間は、わざわざSAから訪れる車も少なく、10台程度(トラックを含む)の車が停車しました。駐車可能台数の割に非常に少ない台数で閑散としています。夜間はレストラン、売店は閉店、自販機のみ利用可能。（投稿：2023年7月、n様）
■久しぶりにここで車中泊したが、ハイウェイオアシスの駐車場がメチャクチャ静かで最高。翌朝まで爆睡してしまった。（2020年3月管理人現地確認）
■無料の無線LAN利用可能。トラックと分離。おまけにハイウェイオアシスの方に行けば静か。かなりおすすめ。淡路島ならココで決まりでしょう。かなり快適。【無線LAN 24時間 無休】（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■November 2024 Administrator's On-Site Verification: Car Camping Rating [Good 😊] 70 points 👉️Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■Report from our site's reader: About Awaji Highway Oasis (Paid): Accessible from Awaji Smart IC and Awaji SA (Upbound/Downbound). Toilets (with bidet) available. At night, few cars visit from the SA, and only about 10 cars (including trucks) were parked. It was very quiet with very few cars compared to the number of parking spaces. The restaurant and shops are closed at night, and only vending machines are available. (Posted: July 2023, by n)
■I stayed overnight in my car here for the first time in a while, and the Highway Oasis parking lot was incredibly quiet and great. I slept soundly until the next morning. (March 2020 Administrator's On-Site Verification)
■Free Wi-Fi available. Separated from trucks. Plus, it's quiet if you go towards the Highway Oasis. Highly recommended. If you're on Awaji Island, this is definitely the place to go. It's very comfortable. [24-hour Wi-Fi available] (Older post from before 2019)

■当サイト読者様レポート：越前海岸の302号線ぞい、福井テクノポートの入口にある道の駅市内からかなり離れている。（2019年以前の古い投稿）

■ Report from a reader of this site: It's far from the toilets, but if you stay at the very back, it's quiet and away from the road. The local fish at the nearby supermarket is incredibly delicious, so I recommend it. (Older post from before 2019)
■ Report from a reader of this site: A roadside station located along Route 302 on the Echizen coast, at the entrance to Fukui Technoport. It's quite far from the city. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■2024年11月管理人現地確認：車中泊評価【良😊】70点👉️現地の写真・詳細案内図はこちら
■当サイト読者様レポート：入浴は鯖江市地域交流センター 市民ホールつつじ（詳細）が近く、入浴＆休憩＋内履きシューズ持ち込みでジムも使えおススメ。(営業10:00～22:00、大人420円、休館日は木、年末年始) 詳細（投稿：2024年2月、yuko様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：当初、道の駅 西山公園での車中泊を予定していたが、夜の口(20:00位)の駐車台数が多く、車の出入りも多く、道の駅での車中泊を諦め、道の駅隣の、鯖江市嚮陽会館　駐車場（詳細）に移動。駐車料金：2時間まで無料、以降22時間まで300円。トイレ：道の駅のトイレは、水洗ウオシュレット、多目的トイレは、夜間使用禁止です。鯖江市嚮陽会館　駐車場から道の駅(トイレ）までは、徒歩約1分30秒(100m以内)でアクセス可能。道の駅の駐車場は、深夜には駐車台数が減少しますが、早朝(6:00)には、混雑し、車中泊には、お勧めできません。鯖江市嚮陽会館　駐車場は、駐車数台(3・4台）の駐車台数でした。車中泊０台。その他：近くにスーパー「ヤスサキワイプラザ グルメ館鯖江店」有り、徒歩約5分　9時00分～21時00分。（投稿：2023年10月、n様）
■奥の駐車場がめっちゃ静かで最高。Wimaxも利用可能。駐車場で道の駅のwifiも利用可能。非常に良いですココ。（2020年4月管理人現地確認）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2019/5/4に福井県鯖江市の西山公園に泊まろうとしたところ、つつじまつりの最中らしく、夜も人出が多く、駐車場も閉鎖されて臨時駐車場を離れた場所に設けているようでした。ゴールデンウィークは、ここは回避した方がよさそうです。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■2014年4月5日オープン！幹線道路から離れており静か。奥の方は特に静かで良い。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■November 2024 Administrator's On-site Verification: Car Camping Rating [Good 😊] 70 points 👉️Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■Report from our site's reader: For bathing, the Sabae City Regional Exchange Center Shimin Hall Tsutsuji (details) is nearby. It's recommended as you can bathe and rest, and also use the gym if you bring indoor shoes. (Open 10:00-22:00, 420 yen for adults, closed Thursdays and during the New Year holidays) Details (Posted: February 2024, by yuko)
■Report from our site's reader: Initially, I planned to camp in my car at the Michi-no-Eki Nishiyama Park, but there were many cars parked there at the beginning of the night (around 20:00), and there was a lot of traffic, so I gave up on camping at the Michi-no-Eki and moved to the Sabae City Koyo Kaikan parking lot (details) next to the Michi-no-Eki. Parking fee: Free for up to 2 hours, 300 yen for up to 22 hours thereafter. Toilets: The toilets at the roadside station are flush toilets with bidet functions. The multi-purpose toilet is closed at night. The roadside station (toilets) is accessible from the Sabae City Koyo Kaikan parking lot in approximately 1 minute 30 seconds on foot (less than 100m). While the number of parking spaces at the roadside station decreases late at night, it becomes crowded in the early morning (6:00 AM), and is not recommended for overnight stays in vehicles. The Sabae City Koyo Kaikan parking lot had a capacity of only a few cars (3-4). There were no overnight vehicles. Other: There is a supermarket nearby, "Yasusaki Wai Plaza Gourmet Hall Sabae Store," about a 5-minute walk away, open from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM. (Posted: October 2023, by n)
■The parking lot at the back is incredibly quiet and fantastic. WiMAX is also available. The roadside station's Wi-Fi is also available in the parking lot. This place is excellent. (Administrator's on-site verification, April 2020)
■Report from a reader of this site: On May 4, 2019, when I tried to stay at Nishiyama Park in Sabae City, Fukui Prefecture, it seemed that the azalea festival was in full swing, and there were many people even at night. The parking lot was closed, and it seemed that a temporary parking lot had been set up in a distant location. It would be best to avoid this place during Golden Week. (Older post from before 2019)
■Opened on April 5, 2014! It's quiet as it's away from the main road. The back area is especially quiet and nice. (Older post from before 2019)

■Report from a Reader of This Site: The parking lot is spacious, and there is almost no car traffic at night, so you can sleep peacefully. There were no large vehicles either. There are two day-trip hot springs within a 10-minute drive, which is convenient. It's noisy along Route 8, making it impossible to sleep, so this is a valuable spot in this area. (Older post from before 2019)

■当サイト読者様レポート：２０２３年９月の平日に利用。国道から一段下がっていて、離れた側（海側）であれば走行音は軽減されます。ただ小型車枠に比べて大型車枠が多めなので、複数のアイドリング音が常時聞こえます。広い休憩室が終夜開放されているのは便利。EV Quickが駐車場の南端（トイレの前）にあります。（投稿：2023年10月、n様）
■極めて交通量の多い幹線国道沿い。トラックだらけ。普通車もアイドリングだらけ。あまりおすすめという感じはない。（2021年12月管理人現地確認）
■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場:31台[大型車16台/普通車15台]、そんなに広くはないがトイレと駐車場は24時間。大型車がそれなりに泊まってます。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■November 2024 Administrator's On-Site Verification: Car Camping Evaluation [Excluded Rank 😅] 63 points 👉️ Click here for on-site photos and detailed map
■Report from our site's reader: Used on a weekday in September 2023. It's one level below the national highway, and the traffic noise is reduced if you park on the side further away (towards the sea). However, there are more spaces for large vehicles than for small vehicles, so you can constantly hear the sound of multiple idling engines. The large rest area being open all night is convenient. There is an EV Quick at the southern end of the parking lot (in front of the toilets). (Posted: October 2023, by n)
■Located along a major national highway with extremely heavy traffic. Full of trucks. Lots of regular cars idling as well. Not really recommendable. (December 2021 Administrator's On-Site Verification)
■Report from our site's reader: Parking lot: 31 spaces [16 for large vehicles/15 for regular vehicles], not that big, but the toilets and parking lot are open 24 hours. A fair number of large vehicles stay overnight. (Older posts from before 2019)
