■当サイト読者様レポート：福井市の一乗谷あさくら水の駅で車中泊し、翌日は朝倉氏の遺跡を巡ってきました。車中泊の方も既に居て、三連水車の前に停めてしまいましたが、いまの車の遮音が意外とよくなっているのか、水の音はさほど気になりませんでした。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：福井県の道の駅一乗寺あさくら水の駅はホタルのシーズンは駐車場に入ることも出来ないくらい混雑してます。ホタルのシーズンは避ける方が良いと思います。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：幹線道路から離れており車通りが少ないため静かで良いのですが、道の駅の敷地内に水量の多い川が流れており、常時ザーーーという川の流れる音がします。私は平気でしたが。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■平成27年4月4日オープン。駐車場がガッツリ県道沿い。
properties.desc_en:
■November 2024 Administrator's On-site Verification: Car Camping Rating [Excluded Rank 😅] 63 points 👉️Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■Report from a reader of this site: I camped in my car at Ichijodani Asakura Water Station in Fukui City, and the next day I visited the ruins of the Asakura clan. There were already other people camping in their cars, and I parked in front of the triple waterwheel, but the sound insulation of modern cars is surprisingly good, so the sound of the water didn't bother me too much. (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from a reader of this site: Michi-no-Eki Ichijoji Asakura Water Station in Fukui Prefecture gets so crowded during firefly season that you can't even get into the parking lot. I think it's better to avoid firefly season. (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from a reader of this site: It's quiet and nice because it's away from the main road and there's not much traffic, but there's a river with a large volume of water flowing through the roadside station grounds, so there's a constant rushing sound of the river. I was fine with it, though. (Older post from before 2019)
■Opened on April 4, 2015. The parking lot is right along the prefectural road.

■Report from our site's reader: As mentioned in the Google reviews, this roadside station is a hangout for reckless drivers and modified cars, making it completely unsuitable for car camping. They swarm like moths near the building, so the large vehicle area is relatively better, and we moved there, but it would have been better to move somewhere else if possible. There were many campervans, and I think everyone was fed up. I don't know about weekdays, but I think it's best to avoid weekends and holidays. (Posted: May 2025, Zil415)
■Report from our site's reader: The toilets are indoors, bright, and clean. Hot water is available for handwashing. No signs prohibiting this or that. It's spacious, so there are no noise problems. Large garbage bags are provided. In the middle of the night, despite the cold, there were roughly 30 or more cars, including several campervans. (Posted by: Migratory Bird Travelogue, April 2021)
■Grand opening on April 27, 2018.

The raw whitebait rice bowl can be eaten at both the flat-ground shop on the first floor (Ebisu Maru) and Kaikyoro on the second floor of the main building of the roadside station. Kaikyoro is a little more expensive, but it is recommended because the freshness is managed better and it tastes better. It is directly under the Akashi Kaikyo Bridge, but since there are no trains running on the Akashi Kaikyo Bridge, it is surprisingly not noisy. Not bad. ■当サイト読者様レポート：夜間利用可能なトイレがあるが清掃が行き届いておらず便器の故障が放置されている。多目的個室トイレは利用可能だった。トイレに近い場所は早朝から犬の散歩仲間が多数やってきて騒がしいので、できれば離れた位置に停めることを勧める。他の道の駅と違って物品販売所はなく単なる駐車場なので、飲食物等の必要な物はあらかじめコンビニで調達しておく必要がある。就寝場所としてなら静かでおすすめ。2021年9月現地確認。（投稿：2021年10月、くぅくん様）
■南の方の広大な駐車場で車中泊が可能。夜間利用可能なトイレもある（水洗洋式ウォシュレット）。入り方がわかりにくいので夜間休憩に寄る車もほとんどおらず、奥の方は静かで良い。道の駅としてはほとんど機能していない。詳細案内図。入浴については、いつの間にか宿泊者限定になっていた。車中泊者は風呂を利用不可。場所を選べば静かに車中泊が可能なので、車中泊スポットとしては悪くない。（2020年12月管理人現地確認）
■2018年7月25日、リニューアルオープン。道の駅として存続。高級グランピング施設（STAGEX高島）併設。詳細
properties.desc_en:
■November 2024 Administrator's On-Site Verification: Car Camping Rating [Rank B] ​​63 points 👉️Click here for on-site photos and detailed map
■Report from our site's reader: There is a toilet that can be used at night, but it is not cleaned properly and the toilet bowl is broken and left unattended. The multi-purpose individual toilet was usable. The area near the toilet is noisy from early morning when many people walk their dogs, so it is recommended to park in a more distant location if possible. Unlike other roadside stations, there is no shop selling goods and it is just a parking lot, so you need to purchase necessary items such as food and drinks at a convenience store in advance. It is quiet and recommended as a place to sleep. September 2021 On-site verification. (Posted: October 2021, by Kuu-kun)
■Car camping is possible in the vast parking lot on the south side. There is also a toilet that can be used at night (flush toilet with bidet). The entrance is difficult to find, so there are hardly any cars that stop by for a night break, and the back area is quiet and nice. It hardly functions as a roadside station. Detailed map. Regarding bathing, it seems that it has become limited to overnight guests. Those staying overnight in their vehicles cannot use the baths. It's not a bad spot for overnight stays in vehicles, as it's possible to stay quietly if you choose your location carefully. (Confirmed on-site by administrator in December 2020)
■Reopened on July 25, 2018. Continues to operate as a roadside station. Includes a luxury glamping facility (STAGEX Takashima). Details

■Report from a Reader of This Site: The road slopes down towards the lake, and the incline is steep. If you park on the lake side, the sound of the water is quite loud. There is a roof over the walkway, so if you park on the walkway side, you will hardly get wet in the rain! The toilets are available 24 hours a day, but they are motion-activated and the response is a little slow, so it is advisable to have a light or something at night. The men's toilet (confirmed) has 4 urinals, 2 stalls, Western-style toilets, and a washlet, as well as a Japanese-style toilet. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_ja:
■2024年11月管理人現地確認：車中泊評価【Aランク😄】74点👉️現地の写真・詳細案内図はこちら
■入浴♨️：《霞の郷温泉》：500円。無料ロッカー、露天風呂、サウナ完備で非常にキレイ。詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：2025/2/15～16に利用しました。大雪の後でしたが屋外のトイレ前までは除雪が入っていました。トイレは真っ暗ですが、センサーライトで点灯しました。概ね清潔で洋式もありますが洗浄はありません。駐車スペースは全面フラットで、とても静か、トラックもいません。温泉は低料金、大きな広間でくつろげてとても快適でした。（投稿：2025年2月、tossan様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：例の建物外トイレだが、確認したところ多目的がなんとウォシュレットと判明(故障もなくきちんと使用出来た) という訳で霞が城公園予定から変更し車中泊…かなり静かに寝られますし(12時頃まではまだ建物や外灯はついている)オススメです！（投稿：2024年4月、yuko様）
■公園と公営の温泉施設が一体になったような広大な施設。無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレはキレイな水洗で洋式もあり。夜間も電気付く。温泉の営業終了後は朝まで静かで非常に良い。超絶穴場。（2021年12月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■ November 2024 Administrator's On-site Inspection: Car Camping Rating [A Rank 😄] 74 points 👉️ Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■ Bathing ♨️: Kasumi no Sato Onsen: 500 yen. Free lockers, open-air bath, and sauna are available, and it's very clean. Details
■ Report from a reader of this site: Used on February 15-16, 2025. It was after a heavy snowfall, but the snow had been cleared up to the area in front of the outdoor toilets. The toilets were pitch black, but they turned on with sensor lights. They were generally clean, and there were Western-style toilets, but they didn't have flushing. The parking space was completely flat, very quiet, and there were no trucks. The hot springs were inexpensive, and it was very comfortable to relax in the large hall. (Posted: February 2025, by tossan)
■Report from a reader of this site: Regarding the outdoor toilets in question, upon checking, it was discovered that the multipurpose toilet actually has a bidet (it was working properly without any malfunctions). So, I changed my plans from Kasumigajo Park to sleeping in my car... It's very quiet and you can sleep peacefully (the building and streetlights are still on until around noon), so I recommend it! (Posted: April 2024, by yuko)
■A vast facility that combines a park and a public hot spring facility. Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed that it is not closed at night. The toilets are clean flush toilets, and there are also Western-style toilets. The lights are on at night. After the hot springs close, it is quiet until morning, which is great. An absolute hidden gem. (Confirmed on-site by administrator in December 2021)

■当サイト読者様レポート：目の前の駐車場が温浴施設(プール＆バーデ、ジム、温泉)の第2駐車場になっているが、入口が施設正面と横の道路からのふたつあり、夜間閉鎖もなさそう。トイレも女子トイレ入ってすぐにウォシュレットがあり、男子トイレも見えた感じ綺麗そうだった。入浴は目の前のウィンディ、近くのゆーとりあ越中で可能。ウィンディはレストラン休業中のため持ち込み可で、車内で先にご飯作るか他で購入し、必要なら飲料類も持ち込みすれば1日過ごせる。（投稿：2023年8月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en:
■November 2024 Administrator's On-Site Verification: Car Camping Rating [A Rank 😄] 74 points 👉️ Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■Bathing ♨️: Bathing is possible at Windy (bathing only, 750 yen, details) and Yutoria Etchu (850 yen, details).

■Report from our site's reader: The parking lot in front is the second parking lot for the hot spring facility (pool & spa, gym, hot springs), but there are two entrances, one in front of the facility and one from the road to the side, and it doesn't seem to be closed at night. The women's toilet has a bidet right inside the entrance, and the men's toilet also looked clean from what I could see. Bathing is possible at Windy in front and Yutoria Etchu nearby. Windy's restaurant is closed, so you can bring your own food. You can cook your meal in your car beforehand or buy it elsewhere, and if needed, bring your own drinks and you can spend the whole day there. (Posted: August 2023, yuko)

■有名天体観測スポット。ここが本州最強と言う人もいるようである。南向きに空が開けている。一応、携帯の電波も入る。一番奥の駐車場に行くと龍神スカイラインからも離れてメチャクチャ静かだが、人気も全くないので治安面で不安。いちおうトイレ（汚いポットン）あり車中泊も可能。（2020年6月管理人現地確認）

■See photos of the Milky Way taken here
■When I came back after a long time, the toilets (details) were closed. It's unclear whether they will reopen. The nearest public toilet is here. Also, cell phone reception is good for SoftBank, but poor for Docomo. (Administrator's on-site confirmation, October 2023)

The furthest parking lot is far from the Ryujin Skyline and extremely quiet, but there are no people around, so safety is a concern. There is a toilet (a dirty pit toilet), and overnight parking is possible. (Administrator's on-site confirmation, June 2020)

■道の駅としての開業当初は色々問題があったようだが、今はかなり改善されている。夜間トイレは「火の食堂」のトイレ（水洗洋式ウォシュレット）が夜間利用可能になっており、駐車場からのアクセスも階段が新設されそれほど苦にならない。夜間非常に静かで良い車中泊スポット。詳細案内図。（2023年6月管理人現地確認）
■シャワーについて👉️利用詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：市内の花山温泉から20分ほどの利便性で、県道から山手に約1km入っており夜は本当に静か。道の駅というよりは公園のアウトドア施設の建物。建物内のきれいなトイレ(温水便座付き)は24時間利用可。9時～17時は温水シャワーも利用可（3分間200円と高い）。広い駐車場が３か所あるが、建物から道路を挟んだ西側に停めるとトイレは少し不便。スロープを降りていく建物側の駐車場がトイレが近くて便利。ただし、豪雨時は駐車場が冠水しないか警戒が必要。コンビニは2km圏内にセブンイレブンがある。休日は朝から公園利用の家族連れが来るので早めに出発するとよい。2021年8月現地確認。（投稿：2021年10月、くぅくん様）
■2020年7月18日オープン。幹線道から離れた山の公園で、静かで良さげ。詳細
properties.desc_en:
■ October 2024 Administrator's On-Site Verification: Car Camping Rating [Good 😊] 74 points 👉️ Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■ It seems there were various problems when the roadside station first opened, but it has improved considerably now. The toilets at "Hi no Shokudo" (fire restaurant) (flush toilets with bidet) are available for use at night, and access from the parking lot is not too difficult as new stairs have been installed. It is a very quiet and good spot for car camping at night. Detailed map. (Administrator's On-Site Verification, June 2023)
■ About the showers 👉️ Usage details
■ Report from a reader of this site: Conveniently located about 20 minutes from Hanayama Onsen in the city, it is about 1km uphill from the prefectural road and is really quiet at night. It is more like an outdoor facility building in a park than a roadside station. The clean toilets inside the building (with heated toilet seats) are available 24 hours a day. Hot showers are also available from 9am to 5pm (expensive at 200 yen for 3 minutes). There are three large parking lots, but parking on the west side across the road from the building makes the restrooms a bit inconvenient. The parking lot on the building side, accessed by a ramp, is closer to the restrooms and more convenient. However, caution is needed regarding flooding in the parking lot during heavy rain. There is a 7-Eleven convenience store within a 2km radius. On weekends, families using the park come from the morning, so it's best to leave early. (Confirmed on-site in August 2021. Posted by: Ku-kun, October 2021)
■Opened July 18, 2020. A quiet and pleasant mountain park away from the main road. Details

The supermarket attached to the roadside station is open until 8 PM, making it convenient for shopping. As a negative point, although it is set back a little, it is along Route 9, so you can hear the sound of cars driving by. Also, large vehicles occasionally stop by for breaks. ■2024年10月管理人現地確認：車中泊評価【良😊】73点👉️現地の写真・詳細案内図はこちら
■当サイト読者様レポート：2024/01/07に泊まりました。静かで評判良さそうな書き込みだったので、安心して行ってみたら……。ここ、標高は低いですけど、駐車場の正面が夜景見られるようになってるんですよ。そのせいだと思うんですが、夜中の日付変わる頃まで、車が入れ代わり入ってきました。自分が止めた場所も悪かったと思うんですが、自分の隣にトナラーさんにも止められて、エアコン付けたままのアイドリング(カチッぶおーーん……カチッぶおーーん……カチッぶおーーん……)そして、最近よくあるハイブリッド車の、エンジンが掛かったり止まったりを繰り返すアイドリング。このダブルアイドリングに挟まれて、流石にギブアップ……、夜中に場所移動しました……。トナラーさんとアイドリング厨は、どこに行っても必ずいるので、運要素なんですけど、私にとってはここの場所は、ただの煩い車中泊スポットになりました。（投稿：2024年1月、m様）
■幹線国道から200mほど奥に入るので非常に静か。DQNとかトラックは道の駅かつらぎの方に行くので、こっちには来ません。めっちゃ静か。トイレもキレイ。車中泊車両多数ですが、アイドリングしてる素人は皆無！凄いです。車中泊のプロ（笑）が集まってますねココ。誰に言われずとも、駐車も一枠ずつあけて停めてるし、ほんと分かってる人が集まってますね。旅のプロが集まっているハイレベルな道の駅と感じました。なので、アイドリング厨は絶対来ないでください。なお、wimaxはギリギリ圏外。道の駅のwifiも夜は電源オフになってますね。こういう道の駅は貴重なので、ぜひ積極的にお金を使いましょう。あとすぐ近くのローソンにはイートインがあり、全席コンセント利用が可能。神。 （2020年5月管理人現地確認）
■当サイト読者様レポート：ここら辺では一番の車中泊スポット、同類の方も多く安心。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■標高は97m。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■October 2024 Administrator's On-Site Verification: Car Camping Rating [Good 😊] 73 points 👉️Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■Report from a reader of this site: I stayed here on 2024/01/07. I went there with peace of mind because the reviews said it was quiet and had good reputation... Although the elevation here is low, you can see the night view from the front of the parking lot. I think that's why cars kept coming and going until around midnight when the date changed. I think I parked in a bad spot, but someone parked right next to me and was idling with the air conditioner on (click-vroom...click-vroom...click-vroom...) and also the idling of a hybrid car, which is common these days, with the engine repeatedly starting and stopping. Sandwiched between these two idles, I finally gave up... and moved to another spot in the middle of the night... No matter where you go, you'll always find people who park too close or who idle their engines, so it's a matter of luck, but for me, this place has just become a noisy spot for overnight stays in a car. (Posted: January 2024, by m)
■It's very quiet because it's about 200m off the main national highway. Delinquents and trucks go to the Katsuragi roadside station, so they don't come here. It's really quiet. The toilets are clean too. There are many cars parked overnight, but there are no amateurs idling their engines! It's amazing. This is where car-camping pros (lol) gather. Without being told, they park with one space between each person, so it's really a place where people who know what they're doing gather. I felt that this is a high-level roadside station where travel pros gather. So, idlers, please don't come here. Also, WiMAX is just barely out of range. The roadside station's Wi-Fi is also turned off at night. Roadside stations like this are precious, so please actively spend money here. Also, there's a Lawson convenience store very close by with an eat-in area, and all seats have power outlets. Amazing. (Confirmed on-site by the administrator in May 2020)
■Report from a reader of this site: This is the best spot for overnight stays in a car around here, and there are many other people doing the same, so it's safe. (Older post from before 2019)
■The elevation is 97m. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_en:

You enter by crossing the railroad crossing from the intersection of National Routes 42 and 311, "Iwasaki" (details), but there are no signs on the national highway. After going up the slope from the railroad crossing, there is a tunnel that goes under the expressway. There is a small sign here directing you to the left. The back of the roadside station is beyond the next tunnel above. (Posted: October 2023, by tossan)
■ Report from our site's reader: A roadside station that functions like a highway rest area. If you are going to stay overnight in your car, the back parking lot for local road users is recommended. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 南紀勝浦温泉 ホテル浦島
properties.desc_ja:
■2,500円、日帰り入浴詳細
■南紀勝浦温泉。超巨大ホテル。ここの「忘帰洞」という天然洞窟の温泉が名物。温泉好きなら一回は入っておいたほうが良いと思います。詳細。送迎の船（変な亀形）は無料、駐車場は、近くに無料のがある。この温泉マップに記入してますので参照
■管理人評価★5（泉質4.5 景色0.5）満点。遊園地化しており秘湯という感じは皆無だが、忘帰洞はやはりすばらしいとしか言いようがない。白濁して硫化水素臭のする温泉も良い。湯の峰のつぼ湯と同じ感じの泉質。天然洞窟の景色も絶無ですばらしい。船で渡る演出も楽しい。満点です。日本人なら一回はここに来た方がいいですね。山上館の天海の湯も眺望が凄い。これなら1000円は納得。満足。南紀勝浦温泉に来たら、ホテル浦島に最優先で来るべき。かなりおすすめ。ネットでは色々悪口も書かれていますが、日帰り温泉施設と考えたら至高と言わざるを得ません。ちなみに風呂に入れる時間が細かく決まっているので、HPで調べてから行きましょう。全部温泉回ると丸一日かかります。詳細
properties.desc_en:
■2,500 yen, day trip bathing details
■Nanki Katsuura Onsen. A gigantic hotel. Its specialty is the natural cave hot spring called "Bokido". If you like hot springs, you should definitely try it at least once. Details. ■Report from our site's reader: About the perfect place to stay overnight in your car in Kinosaki Onsen. The overview is as described on the website (details). It's a small RV park run by a mother and son (both very kind and talkative, and they worked hard to assist us). It's also a liquor store, so there's a variety of delicious alcoholic beverages, and you can enjoy not only the hot springs but also the drinks. Also, in the sanitary building (which has toilets, washing machines, and dryers), there was information about a Chinese restaurant that delivers, so we ordered some. Kinosaki Onsen is close to the sea, so there are also fish shops in the hot spring town where you can take food home. As a result, we ended up with a surprisingly luxurious dinner of Chinese food, sashimi, and boiled fish. The best part was the late-night ramen. They said they would come if you ordered by phone, and on that day the son said, "I ordered some today," so I joined in and had ramen to finish off the meal, which was very satisfying. The next morning, I enjoyed the breakfast (bagels, toast, scrambled eggs, juice, etc.) that I had asked my mother to prepare for me, making it a very satisfying one-night stay. (Posted by: Ms. N, April 2022)

In section 117 of Sei Shonagon's The Pillow Book, it says, "The hot springs are Nanakuri no Yu, Arima no Yu, and Tamatsukuri no Yu." There are theories that "Nanakuri" refers to "Nanaguri," which is the present-day Sakakibara Onsen, or that it refers to "Yunomine Onsen (Wakayama)" or "Bessho Onsen (Nagano)."

■Manager's rating: ★4.4 (Spring quality 4.3, Scenery 0.1) It's clear and slippery. The source water is on the lower side. You can see the stream from the window, but it's not very clean. I thought it should be maintained. They should plant maple or cherry trees on the opposite bank. It needs a little more aesthetic sense.

properties.desc_en:
■Detailed Car Camping Report Video Available (2024)
■Report from a Reader of This Site: This is a paid parking lot, but it's only 300 yen for 24 hours. There's a Lawson convenience store a 1 minute walk away next to the parking lot, and Daichan Okonomiyaki Main Store (fluffy batter, cheap and incredibly delicious, the shop is small and a little dirty inside, but that's the kind of place that serves delicious food) a 1 minute walk away on the other side. It becomes an izakaya (Japanese pub) at night, so be sure to stop by. There are clean toilets in the parking lot. There are vending machines. Tatsuno City is a castle town, so park your car here and take a walk around the castle town. Drink at Daichan in the evening and go to sleep. It's the best. There are baths and supermarkets within driving distance. At night, there is less traffic and it is very quiet. Personally, I would rank it S. (Posted: September 2023, by m)

properties.desc_en:
■Check out the Milky Way photos taken here
■Discovered a great stargazing spot. Altitude 1150m. The southern sky is wide open and pitch black!! There are no toilets, so use the toilets at the roadside station before coming. There is no cell phone reception, so it is not suitable for overnight stays in your car. There seems to be a plaza further ahead, but the road was blocked by a chain and could not be entered. If you have the energy, you might want to carry your camera equipment and go to the plaza further in. This is definitely better than the Gomasan Sky Tower roadside station or Tsuruhime Park.

properties.desc_ja:
■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2025年11月現地調査）
■当サイト読者様レポート：石垣組んだ外観の変わったトイレです。男女別。女性用は水洗洋式2、個室内に除菌クリーナー、洗面所、石鹸あり。ウォッシュレットはないものの非常にキレイです。入口と内部に一応照明ありますがスイッチはなく、光は天井の明り取りからのみです。夕方照明が点き午後8時くらいに消灯されますので真っ暗で何も見えなくなります。駐車場階段に一ヵ所ある照明も消されると辺り一帯真っ暗になりますので、懐中電灯やランタンなど必須です。駐車場は傾斜ありますが停める場所によっては気になりません。トイレ近くは浄化槽用のポンプ？の音が凄くうるさいです。離れて停めれば静かで快適です。夜は人気ないですしトイレ内に熊出没注意の貼り紙あり猿も出ることありますので自己責任で。近くに水晶の湯という温泉があり平日650円土日祝750円で入浴できます。場所→詳細（投稿：2023年7月、s様）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is possible. (On-site survey conducted in November 2025)
■Report from a reader of this site: This is an unusual toilet with a stone wall exterior. Separate facilities for men and women. The women's toilet has two flush toilets, disinfectant cleaner, a sink, and soap inside the stalls. Although there is no bidet, it is very clean. There is lighting at the entrance and inside, but there is no switch, and the light comes only from the skylight in the ceiling. The lights come on in the evening and are turned off around 8pm, so it becomes pitch black and you can't see anything. The light on the parking lot stairs is also turned off, so the whole area becomes pitch black and a flashlight or lantern is essential. The parking lot is sloped, but it is not a problem depending on where you park. The sound of the septic tank pump? is very loud near the toilets. If you park further away, it is quiet and comfortable. It is not popular at night, and there is a sign in the toilet warning of bear sightings, and monkeys may also appear, so proceed at your own risk. There's a hot spring nearby called Suisho-no-Yu where you can bathe for 650 yen on weekdays and 750 yen on weekends and holidays. Location → Details (Posted by: S, July 2023)

■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2025年5月現地調査）
■当サイト読者様レポート：運動公園の駐車場。車止めがなく、おそらく夜間閉鎖もしない(向かいの陸上競技場の駐車場入口には車止めあり) トイレは徒歩2～3分程度離れた場所にあり、通常は和式水洗だが各性別の中の多目的が洋式水洗。朝9時頃でもトイレ内暗かったので、ライトは必須。コンビニも近く、有松温泉 れもん湯(490円、サウナ別)という温泉銭湯も近い。追記：トイレは、確認は女性用のみだが一番奥がウォシュレットになっていて他は和式と多目的の洋式水洗になっている。（投稿：2023年4月、yuko様）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is permitted. (On-site survey conducted in May 2025)
■Report from a reader of this site: The parking lot of the sports park. There are no car barriers, and it is unlikely that it will be closed at night (there are car barriers at the entrance to the parking lot of the athletics stadium across the street). The toilets are located about 2-3 minutes away on foot. They are usually Japanese-style flush toilets, but the multi-purpose toilets in each gender section are Western-style flush toilets. The toilets were dark even around 9 AM, so a flashlight is essential. There is a convenience store nearby, and a public bathhouse with hot springs called Arimatsu Onsen Lemon Yu (490 yen, sauna separate) is also nearby. Addendum: Regarding the toilets, I only checked the women's section, but the one at the very back has a bidet, while the others are Japanese-style and the multi-purpose toilet is a Western-style flush toilet. (Posted by yuko in April 2023)

properties.desc_ja:
■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2025年4月現地調査）
■吉野山の桜巡りの拠点。トイレは参道にありちょっと遠いが、車中泊も可能。桜のシーズンは、9-17時は車両進入禁止になるので注意。ここで車中泊するか、早朝５時頃に来るとよい。朝にここから車で下っていけば、奥千本、中千本、下千本を楽に鑑賞できます。もしくは、ここに車を置いて、徒歩で下って桜をゆっくり見て、下までおりたらバス（桜シーズンは15分くらいの間隔）で上がってくるという手もあります。※桜シーズンは交通規制があるので注意➾「吉野山 交通規制」で検索。（2020年4月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is possible. (On-site survey conducted in April 2025)
■A base for touring the cherry blossoms of Yoshino Mountain. The toilets are on the approach to the temple and a bit far, but overnight parking is possible. Note that vehicle entry is prohibited from 9 am to 5 pm during cherry blossom season. It is best to either park your car here overnight or arrive around 5 am. If you drive down from here in the morning, you can easily enjoy the Okusenbon, Nakasenbon, and Shimosenbon areas. Alternatively, you can park your car here, walk down to enjoy the cherry blossoms at your leisure, and then take a bus (which runs every 15 minutes or so during cherry blossom season) back up. *Note that there are traffic restrictions during cherry blossom season - search for "Yoshino Mountain traffic restrictions". (On-site confirmation by administrator in April 2020)

properties.desc_ja:
■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2025年3月現地調査）
■当サイト読者様レポート：南側駐車場すぐ北に男女別トイレ。女性用は水洗和式3、洗面所あり、照明なし。あまりキレイではなく臭います。私が確認した時は一個室しかペーパーが入ってなかった。水郷の塔から木曽川の眺望は一見の価値あり。国道1号線に続く堤防道路沿いなので結構車通りうるさい。路上生活者らしき車(最大3台確認)がいますので、あまりお勧めではないですが…（投稿：2023年7月、s様）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is permitted. (On-site survey conducted in March 2025)
■Report from a reader of this site: Separate men's and women's toilets are located just north of the south parking lot. The women's toilet has three flushable Japanese-style toilets, a sink, and no lighting. It's not very clean and smells bad. When I checked, only one stall had toilet paper. The view of the Kiso River from the Suigo Tower is worth seeing. It's located along the embankment road that leads to National Route 1, so it's quite noisy with a lot of traffic. There are cars that appear to belong to homeless people (up to 3 were observed), so it's not highly recommended... (Posted by: s, July 2023)

properties.title_en: Arakogawa Park (a spot for overnight parking in Nagoya)
properties.desc_ja:
■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2025年3月現地調査）
■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車スペースが広くトイレもヨシ、隣のパチ屋が閉まれば静かでヨシ、人気があり他の車中泊者も多いが、張り紙が貼られた長期の放置車両も多い。（投稿：2024年5月、長野の旅人様）
■戸田川緑地第2駐車場が夜間封鎖されるようになってしまったのでこちらに来たが、ここは今でも夜間封鎖されず車中泊可能。他にも車中泊車両ちらほら。朝まで静かで良かった。（2022年12月管理人現地確認）
■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車料金無料（とても広いです）　トイレは駐車場内にございます。男性トイレは和式トイレと小便器。女性トイレも和式だと思います。（確認しておりません。）車中泊翌日レゴランドへ行くため車中泊地を探していた所、車中泊マップからこちらを見つけて車中泊しました。私が探した中ではレゴランドから一番近い車中泊地でした。夜は静かで快適に眠ることができました。こちらの駐車場の様子は、私のYouTubeの後半をご視聴頂ければと思います。👉️詳細（投稿：2021年9月、沖縄ないちゃー様、Youtubeチャンネル）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレは水洗和式だがちゃんと清掃されていて悪くない。夜は比較的静かで、耳栓したら朝まで熟睡できた。（2021年5月管理人現地確認）
■無料駐車場とトイレ。名古屋の車中泊スポット。荒子川公園にはあちこちに駐車場＋トイレがあり、車中泊が可能である。荒子川公園について詳細（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is permitted. (On-site survey, March 2025)
■Report from a reader of this site: The parking space is large and the toilets are good. It's quiet when the pachinko parlor next door is closed. It's popular and there are many other people staying overnight in their cars, but there are also many long-term abandoned vehicles with notices posted. (Submitted by: Nagano Traveler, May 2024)
■I came here because the Todagawa Green Space No. 2 parking lot has been closed at night, but this place is still open at night and overnight parking is possible. There are a few other cars staying overnight as well. It was quiet until morning, which was great. (Administrator's on-site confirmation, December 2022)
■Report from a reader of this site: Parking is free (very spacious). There are toilets in the parking lot. The men's toilet has a Japanese-style toilet and urinals. I think the women's toilet is also Japanese-style. (Not confirmed.) I was looking for a place to stay overnight in my car because I was going to Legoland the next day, and I found this place on the overnight parking map and stayed overnight in my car. This was the closest overnight parking spot to Legoland that I could find. It was quiet at night, and I was able to sleep comfortably. You can see what this parking lot is like in the latter half of my YouTube video. 👉️Details (Posted: September 2021, Okinawa Naichaa, YouTube channel)
■Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed that it's not closed at night. The toilets are flush toilets (Japanese style), but they are clean and not bad. It was relatively quiet at night, and with earplugs, I was able to sleep soundly until morning. (Administrator's on-site confirmation, May 2021)
■Free parking and toilets. An overnight parking spot in Nagoya. Arakogawa Park has parking lots and toilets scattered throughout, making overnight parking possible. Details about Arakogawa Park (Older post from before 2019)

■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2025年3月現地調査）

■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is permitted. (On-site survey, March 2025)
■Free parking and public toilets (👉️Photos of the toilets 🚻 and detailed map are here (taken March 2025)). Confirmed that it is not closed at night. Note that the road leading here is closed to traffic from 11 PM to 5 AM (as a measure against reckless driving and biker gangs). Although it is supposed to be closed to traffic after 11 PM, loud cars occasionally come to see the night view until around 1 AM. There was no particular police patrol or surveillance. Management seems laxer than expected. Safety is entirely your own responsibility. (On-site confirmation by administrator, February 2024)

properties.title_ja: 姫路城 大手門駐車場
properties.title_en: Himeji Castle Otemon Gate Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja:
■詳細案内図、トイレの写真（2025年3月現地調査）
■２４時間最大９００円。トイレ完備（👉️トイレ🚻の写真と詳細案内図はこちら（2025年3月撮影））。なかなか良いんじゃないでしょうか。昔は近くに銭湯があったが、2015年に廃業してしまったので、風呂に入ってからここに来るのが良い。姫路城の桜を見るときはここで車中泊をしてそのまま車を置いて翌朝観光すると良い。車中泊時は静かな西側に駐車して、朝起きたら人通りが多い東側に移動すると良い（観光中の車上荒らし防止のため）。桜が満開のシーズンはメチャクチャな混雑になるので、姫路城の天守閣に登りたい場合は、姫路城の開場（9:00）の３０分前には受付のところに行って並んでおいた方が良い。（場合によっては8時開城になる場合もあるので公式HPで要確認詳細 ）（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and toilet photos (on-site survey in March 2025)
■Maximum 900 yen for 24 hours. Toilets available (👉️Toilet photos and detailed map here (taken in March 2025)). Seems pretty good. There used to be a public bath nearby, but it closed down in 2015, so it's best to take a bath before coming here. When viewing the cherry blossoms at Himeji Castle, it's a good idea to park your car here overnight and go sightseeing the next morning. When parking overnight, it's best to park on the quiet west side and move to the busy east side in the morning (to prevent car break-ins while sightseeing). During the peak cherry blossom season, it gets extremely crowded, so if you want to climb to the top of Himeji Castle's keep, it's best to go to the reception 30 minutes before Himeji Castle opens (9:00) and get in line. (In some cases, it may open at 8:00, so check the official website for details) (Older post from before 2019)

■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2024年11月現地調査）
■当サイト読者様レポート：夜中は街灯もほぼなく真っ暗。盲腸線の果てなので夜間は入ってくる車もほぼなくとても静かです。昼近くまで爆睡しました。警察の見回りがあるようで、日付変わる前後くらいに職質がきました。普通に対応していれば問題なしです。トイレはそこそこ。ウォシュレットはありません。駐車場はフラットですし夜景もちょっと見えますし飯食って寝るくらいならちょうどいいです。（投稿：2025年3月、匿名希望様）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ（👉️トイレ🚻の写真と詳細案内図はこちら（2024年11月撮影））。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。夜間は人気皆無で静かなのは良いが、治安については自己責任。たまにバイパスを爆走する珍走、珍車のエンジン音が聞こえる。山の中腹だが、ちゃんと整地されていてほぼ水平。携帯電波も問題なし。（2021年12月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is possible. (On-site survey November 2024)
■Report from a reader of this site: It's pitch black at night with almost no streetlights. Since it's at the end of a dead-end line, there are almost no cars coming in at night, so it's very quiet. I slept soundly until almost noon. There seems to be police patrol, and I was stopped and questioned around midnight. There's no problem if you respond normally. The toilets are decent. There's no bidet. The parking lot is flat, you can see the night view a little, and it's just right for eating and sleeping. (Posted: March 2025, anonymous)
■Free parking and public toilets (👉️Photos of the toilets 🚻 and detailed map are here (taken November 2024)). Confirmed that it's not closed at night. It's nice that it's quiet with no people around at night, but safety is your own responsibility. Occasionally you can hear the engine noises of reckless drivers and unusual cars speeding down the bypass. It's on the side of a mountain, but it's properly leveled and almost level. Cell phone reception is also fine. (Confirmed on-site by administrator in December 2021)

properties.title_en: Todagawa Green Space 2nd Parking Lot (Nagoya overnight parking spot)
properties.desc_ja:
■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2024年10月現地調査）
■「初夏の物語」（5月上旬の3日間）、「秋の物語」（10月上旬の3日間）というイベント期間中、駐車場は有料となり夜間閉鎖となるので注意（イベント期間中車中泊不可）。イベント詳細
■夜間も利用OKの無料駐車場で、公衆トイレも水洗でキレイで最高。洋式もあり。wimaxも電波OK。非常に良いです。この駐車場へのアクセスがわかりにくいし、定期的にパトカーの巡回（職質）があるので、爆音DQNとかも来ませんでした。ただ、基本的に人気（ひとけ）はないので、治安的な不安は残ります。不良外国人とかDQNに襲撃されたら終了。利用は自己責任で。助手席にバッグとか置かないほうがいいでしょうね。（2020年10月管理人現地確認）
■当サイト読者様レポート：第1駐車場から第5駐車場までありますが、24時間開放されているのは第2だけとのことです。トイレ、自販機ありました（トイレはあまり綺麗ではなかったです）近くにコンビニもありました。 こちらもご参照ください：詳細（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is permitted. (On-site survey, October 2024)
■During the "Early Summer Story" (3 days in early May) and "Autumn Story" (3 days in early October) events, the parking lot becomes paid and is closed at night, so please be aware (overnight parking is not permitted during the event period). Event details
■This is a free parking lot that can be used at night, and the public toilets are flush toilets and very clean. Western-style toilets are also available. WiMAX signal is OK. It's very good. Access to this parking lot is difficult to find, and there are regular patrol cars (for questioning), so loud, rowdy people didn't show up. However, there are basically no people around, so there are concerns about safety. If you are attacked by unruly foreigners or rowdy people, it's over. Use at your own risk. It's probably best not to put bags on the passenger seat. (On-site confirmation by administrator, October 2020)
■Report from a reader of this site: There are parking lots 1 through 5, but only parking lot 2 is open 24 hours. There were toilets and vending machines (the toilets weren't very clean). There was also a convenience store nearby. See also: Details (older posts from before 2019)

properties.desc_ja:
■下り側ぷらっとパークとシャワーの写真はこちら。車中泊可能。（2024年10月管理人現地確認）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2024年１０月１１日利用。上り側について。ＳＡ入口側にあるＥＶ充電施設（スポット）の一角が袋小路的になっているので大型車は入ることが出来ず、普通車両も頻繁に通過しません。ＥＶ充電施設の裏が小さめのトイレとなっていますが、充電施設が目隠しの役割をしているようで外からトイレの存在が分かりにくく利用者は少なめであまり汚れていません。大型のＳＡで三連休の初日で駐車場がほぼ満車の利用者多数でしたが、比較的静かに滞在できました。コンビニ、２４時間フードコートあり。（投稿：2024年10月、山びこ様）
■2023年5月、下り側にコインシャワー＆コインランドリーがオープン（300円／10分、詳細）。
properties.desc_en:
■Photos of the downbound "Plat Park" and showers are here. Overnight parking is permitted. (Administrator's on-site verification, October 2024)
■Report from a reader of this site: Used on October 11, 2024. Regarding the upbound side. A corner of the EV charging facility (spot) near the SA entrance is a dead end, so large vehicles cannot enter, and regular vehicles do not pass through frequently. Behind the EV charging facility is a small toilet, but the charging facility seems to act as a screen, making it difficult to see the toilet from the outside, resulting in few users and little dirt. It is a large SA, and on the first day of a three-day weekend, the parking lot was almost full and there were many users, but it was relatively quiet. There is a convenience store and a 24-hour food court. (Posted by: Yamabiko, October 2024)
■In May 2023, coin showers and coin laundry opened on the downbound side (300 yen/10 minutes, details).

properties.title_en: Amanogawa River Tunnel Free Parking (A hangout for biker gangs at night)
properties.desc_ja:
■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2024年10月現地調査）
■久しぶりに土曜の夜に来てみたが、相変わらず夜中の2時ごろまで爆音でこの周囲をグルグル走り回るDQN車、DQNバイクが大集合😅。ドリフトをしているのか、タイヤがキーッと鳴る音が響いている。週末はここはやめといたほうがいい。トイレも障害者用トイレのカギが破壊されていた。やばい。（2023年5月管理人現地確認）
■久しぶりに来たら、携帯電波がほぼ圏外になっていた。（2021年6月管理人現地確認）
■穴場発見。無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。少し傾斜あり。トイレは簡易水洗でちょっと汚い。携帯電波やや弱い。夜は人気が無いので治安的に不安あり。標高は137m。　※ここは夜は走り屋・暴走族のたまり場になっているようで、爆音のDQN車が集まってきた。おすすめできない。特に週末はえぐい。（2020年5月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is possible. (On-site survey, October 2024)
■I came here on a Saturday night for the first time in a while, and as usual, there was a large gathering of reckless drivers and motorcyclists driving around the area until around 2 AM 😅. I could hear the screeching of tires, perhaps from drifting. It's best to avoid this place on weekends. The lock on the disabled toilet was also broken. This is bad. (On-site verification by administrator, May 2023)
■When I came here for the first time in a while, there was almost no cell phone signal. (On-site verification by administrator, June 2021)
■Found a hidden gem. Free parking and public toilets. There is a slight slope. The toilets are simple flush toilets and a bit dirty. Cell phone signal is somewhat weak. It's deserted at night, so there are safety concerns. The elevation is 137m. *This place seems to be a hangout for street racers and biker gangs at night, and loud, rowdy cars have gathered here. Not recommended. It's especially bad on weekends. (Confirmed by the administrator in May 2020)

■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2024年9月現地調査）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2025年12月29日　夜23時頃に着きました。まずおすすめされていた北側駐車場に行ったところ、トイレの方で若者が大声で駄弁っていたので、治安の悪さを感じ、西側駐車場に移動して寝る準備をしていました。最初は私しかいなかったんですが、もう寝ようかという時に、遠くから爆音で走る車が近づいてきて、駐車場入口を少し過ぎた道路上で急停車し、バックで駐車場に入ってきて、わざわざ私の車の横に停め、低音のうるさい音楽をずっと鳴らしていました。さらに仲間の車があとから入ってきて、大声で話をひとしきりした後、しまいにはクラクションを鳴らしながら出ていきました。時間は深夜2時のことでした。あえて車中泊しているのを邪魔しようとする意思を感じ、さらにはまだ仲間の車が残っていたので、深夜でしたが私は移動することにしました。また、この公園の駐車場とトイレは、どれも100〜200メートルほど離れており地味に面倒ですし、夜景の見える展望台からの通り道になっているので、深夜でも車通りがうるさかったです。場所柄、治安の悪いうるさい車が多いのも拍車をかけていました。ここに泊まるくらいなら、もっとトイレの近い、別の駐車場に泊まることをおすすめします。（投稿：2026年1月、s様）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is permitted. (Survey conducted in September 2024)
■Report from a reader of this site: I arrived around 11 PM on December 29, 2025. I initially went to the north parking lot as recommended, but there were young people loudly chatting near the toilets, which made me feel unsafe, so I moved to the west parking lot to prepare for sleep. At first, I was the only one there, but just as I was about to go to sleep, a car with a loud engine approached from a distance, slammed on the brakes on the road just past the parking lot entrance, backed into the parking lot, parked right next to my car, and played loud bass music the whole time. Then another car with the driver's companions came in, they talked loudly for a while, and finally drove off honking their horns. It was 2 AM. I felt they were deliberately trying to disturb my overnight stay, and since their companions' car was still there, I decided to move despite the late hour. Furthermore, the parking lot and restrooms in this park are all about 100-200 meters apart, which is quite inconvenient. Also, because it's on the route from the observation deck with night views, it was noisy even late at night. The area's location, with its many noisy cars and poorly managed vehicles, only exacerbated the problem. If you're considering staying here, I recommend staying in a different parking lot with restrooms closer. (Posted by: s, January 2026)

■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2025年5月現地調査）
■当サイト読者様レポート：大山 桝水高原駐車場の北側駐車場です。5月29日に宿泊しました。同駐車場内の南側に公衆トイレ（Googleマップ上での説明）が有りましたが全て撤去され、管理人さんが現地調査でトイレの説明をされているトイレのみとなりました。　※管理人さんの北側駐車場とトイレの写真に左端に少し写っているトイレです。また、大きなトイレも内部は新しく改装されており昨年の様に異臭も無くなりました。参考ですが、この場所で夕日を眺めて、宿泊は南側の広い駐車場で車中泊しました。北側の駐車場はフラットな場所が少ないのと大山登山口に向かう道路と高低差が無いため早朝登山者の車が走行すれば走行音がよく聞こえてきます。また、登山者の車がトイレを利用するため立ち寄るのでちょっと気になります。なお、積雪が多い季節に車中泊をする人も少ないでしょうが、北側・南側の駐車場のトイレは冬期（期間不明）は閉鎖されているようです。（投稿：2026年6月、山びこ様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：昨日、利用しました。幹線道路沿いですが、２０：００～０６：００の間、車両の通過に気づきませんでした。大山観光のための道路のため行楽期の日中はツーリングバイクなどで車両が多数走行しますが、夜間は閑散とします。また、トイレは女性用が個室４，男性用が個室３小便器５で、暖房便座、ウォシュレット、便座クリーナーとフル装備そして綺麗に管理されていました。北東側にも桝水高原の無料駐車場があり、宍道湖、美保湾が望めますが、３台分を除いて傾きがあります。また、トイレは洋式で便座クリーナーは有りますが、他は何の装備もなく少し古くさいです。（投稿：2024年6月、山びこ様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：スキー場シーズン以外はガラガラで無料。最近出来たトイレも道の駅並みのトイレで広く綺麗です。車で１０分程度の大山寺には風呂（郷円湯院）などの格安入浴施設があり食事も取れます。大山登山口近くの駐車場に比べ早朝からの登山者の車の出入りも無く、トイレも使われることも無いので汚れること無く綺麗です。標高700m。（投稿：2022年5月、山びこ様）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight stays in vehicles are possible. (On-site survey in May 2025)
■Report from a reader of this site: This is the north parking lot of the Oyama Masumizu Plateau parking lot. I stayed there on May 29th. There used to be a public toilet (described on Google Maps) on the south side of the same parking lot, but it has all been removed, and only the toilet that the caretaker described in the on-site survey remains. *This is the toilet that is slightly visible on the far left of the caretaker's photo of the north parking lot and toilets. Also, the interior of the large toilet has been newly renovated, and the unpleasant odor that was there last year is gone. For reference, I watched the sunset at this location and stayed overnight in my car in the large parking lot on the south side. The north parking lot has few flat areas, and there is no difference in elevation with the road leading to the Oyama trailhead, so you can clearly hear the sound of cars driven by hikers in the early morning. Also, hikers' cars stop there to use the toilets, which is a bit bothersome. While few people would likely camp in their cars during the snowy season, the toilets in the north and south parking lots appear to be closed during the winter (duration unknown). (Posted: June 2026, Yamabiko)
■Report from a reader of this site: I used it yesterday. Although it's along a main road, I didn't notice any vehicles passing by between 8:00 PM and 6:00 AM. Because it's a road for sightseeing in Mt. Daisen, many vehicles, including touring motorcycles, travel on it during the day in the holiday season, but it becomes deserted at night. The toilets have four stalls for women and three stalls and five urinals for men, and are fully equipped with heated seats, bidet functions, and toilet seat cleaners, and are kept very clean. There is also a free parking lot at Masumizu Plateau on the northeast side, offering views of Lake Shinji and Miho Bay, but all but three spaces are sloped. The toilets are Western-style and have toilet seat cleaners, but otherwise they lack any equipment and are a bit old-fashioned. (Submitted by Yamabiko, June 2024)
■Report from a reader of this site: It's practically empty and free outside of the ski season. The recently built toilets are spacious and clean, comparable to those at a roadside rest area. There are inexpensive bathing facilities (Goen Yuin) and meals available at Daisenji Temple, about a 10-minute drive away. Compared to the parking lot near the Daisen trailhead, there is no traffic from hikers' cars coming and going from early morning, and the toilets are not used, so they are clean and untouched. Elevation 700m. (Submitted by Yamabiko, May 2022)

■2022年4月、久しぶりに来たが、相変わらず夜はDQNの運動会。延々とドリフト音やらバイクで走り回る音が鳴り響いていた。ここでの車中泊はやめたほうがいい。全国的にも最悪の部類。（2022年4月管理人現地確認）
■金、土、祝日の前日の19:30（5〜8月）、17:30（9〜4月、および12/28〜1/2）、に駐車場が閉鎖される（珍走の集会場のため）。翌朝5時まで閉鎖される。閉鎖されてもいいなら車中泊は可能。夕方以降は日陰ができるので涼しく過ごせる。瀬戸大橋の電車の音が結構でかい。夜中まで定期的に電車のごう音が響くのでここでの車中泊はおすすめはしない。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■夜は珍走の運動会。どうしようもない。ここでの車中泊は絶対やってはいけない。平日もたまり場になってる。今まで数え切れない場所で車中泊をしたが、ここがダントツで最悪。21〜23時は珍走の運動会、24時以降はトラックが集まってきてアイドリング大会（しかも車中泊らしき車を見つけるとわざわざ近くに停めにくる）。ここは最悪である。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:

■ The parking lot is closed at 19:30 (May-August) and 17:30 (September-April, and December 28th-January 2nd) on Fridays, Saturdays, and the day before holidays (because it's a gathering place for reckless drivers). It remains closed until 5 AM the next morning. Car camping is possible if you don't mind the closure. It gets shady in the evenings, so it's cool. The sound of trains on the Seto Ohashi Bridge is quite loud. The sound of trains roaring regularly until late at night, so car camping here is not recommended. (Older post from before 2019)
■At night it's a sports day for reckless drivers. It's hopeless. You absolutely should not camp in your car here. It's a hangout spot even on weekdays. I've camped in my car in countless places, but this is by far the worst. From 9pm to 11pm it's a sports day for reckless drivers, and after midnight trucks gather and have an idling competition (and if they spot a car that looks like it's being camped in, they'll even park nearby). This place is the worst. (Older post from before 2019)

■当サイト読者様レポート：昨年の夏、今年の夏、合計１０泊ほど使用しました。トイレは駐車場から歩いて1分、トイレの中に大きめの流しあり。飲用についてはわからないので、私は煮沸で使用しました。駐車場は、全面ほぼフラット。駐車枠の幅も広めなので止めやすい。そして目の前が海。週末も泊まったことありますが、DQNには遭遇してません。(たまたま？)コンビニ、ディスカウントストアなど近くにあります。平日でも駐車場が空になることはありません。恐らく釣り客でしょう。週末はほぼ埋まります。個人的には、非常に泊まりやすいお気に入りの場所です。（投稿：2022年10月、m様）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight stays in vehicles are permitted. (On-site survey conducted in April 2026)
■Showers 🚿 are only available during the summer.
■Report from a reader of this site: I used it for a total of about 10 nights last summer and this summer. The toilets are a 1-minute walk from the parking lot, and there is a large sink inside the toilets. I don't know about the potability of the water, so I boiled it before using it. The parking lot is almost completely flat. The parking spaces are also wide, making it easy to park. And it's right by the sea. I've stayed there on weekends too, but I haven't encountered any troublemakers. (Maybe it was just luck?) There are convenience stores and discount stores nearby. The parking lot is never empty, even on weekdays. Probably because of anglers. It's almost always full on weekends. Personally, it's one of my favorite places to stay. (Posted by: m, October 2022)

properties.title_en: Muroto City, Muroto Skyline, Takaoka Park Parking Lot""
properties.desc_ja:
■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2026年4月現地調査）
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレは綺麗、シンプルな洋式ウォシュレット無し。地面はほぼ水平です。展望台があって、夕日と朝日の両方見えます、お勧めの絶景！静かです。他にも車中泊の車が居ましたが爆音系は居ませんでした。（投稿：2026年4月、キャタロー様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレに寄ろうとしたら、テープで封鎖され、使用禁止と表示されていました(2025/2時点)。（投稿：2025年3月、h様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2024/3 /22、車中泊しました。24時間トイレ利用できます。駐車場多少傾斜地あります。ロケーション抜群！夕日と日の出のご来光が楽しめます。写真撮影お勧め。（投稿：2024年4月、h様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車30台級の無料駐車場。トイレはやや古いが、水洗洋式で定期的に清掃が入っている感じ。夜は無人状態となるので、治安については自己責任。標高250mくらいあり、南海トラフの津波が来ても直ちに影響はない。ネコ捨て山になっているらしく、わりと人懐っこいネコが十匹以上いた。ごはんをあげると、めちゃくちゃ擦り寄って来る。（投稿：2022年10月、y様）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight stays in vehicles are possible. (On-site survey, April 2026)
■Report from our website reader: The toilets are clean, simple Western-style toilets, no bidet. The ground is almost level. There is an observation deck where you can see both the sunset and sunrise, a recommended spectacular view! It's quiet. There were other cars parked overnight, but none were making loud noises. (Posted: April 2026, by Catarou)
■Report from our website reader: When I tried to use the toilet, it was sealed off with tape and marked as out of service (as of February 2025). (Posted: March 2025, by h)
■Report from our website reader: I stayed overnight in my car on March 22, 2024. The toilets are available 24 hours a day. The parking lot is slightly sloped. Excellent location! You can enjoy the sunset and sunrise. Recommended for photography. (Submitted by: h, April 2024)
■Report from a reader of this site: A free parking lot that can accommodate about 30 regular cars. The toilets are a bit old, but they are flush toilets and seem to be cleaned regularly. It is unmanned at night, so safety is at your own risk. It is at an altitude of about 250m, so it will not be immediately affected even if a tsunami from the Nankai Trough hits. It seems to be a place where cats are abandoned, and there were more than 10 cats that were quite friendly. If you give them food, they will rub against you a lot. (Submitted by: y, October 2022)

The only drawback is that there is almost no cell phone signal (you can get a weak signal in some places), so be aware of that. (Confirmed on-site by the caretaker in April 2022)

properties.title_ja: 道の駅 小豆島オリーブ公園
properties.desc_ja:
■2026年5月管理人現地確認：車中泊評価【Aランク😄】80点👉️現地の写真・詳細案内図はこちら
■入浴♨️：《サン・オリーブ温泉》1000円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：2025年5月の平日に利用。複数ある駐車場のうち、国道から坂を上る途中右側の広いところ（オリーブ園駐車場）です。道の駅の右奥の「サンオリーブ温泉」に浸かってからここで休みました。とっても静かで快眠。階段の上にあるトイレが若干の減点です。トイレシャワーがなく、清掃も今イチでした。EV Quickが上の駐車場（道の駅建屋の脇）にあります。稼働は830-1700で、道の駅スタッフに鍵を開けてもらいます。（投稿：2025年5月、n様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：香川県 道の駅小豆島オリーブ公園 ですが、トイレがわかりずらいです。坂上にある温泉のある施設の駐車場は夜間使えるトイレが無く、道路沿いの駐車場と道路と坂上の中間の駐車場は夜間も使えるトイレが有ります。周囲全てが道の駅のようです。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■ May 2026 Administrator's On-Site Verification: Car Camping Rating [A Rank 😄] 80 points 👉️ Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■ Bathing ♨️: "Sun Olive Hot Spring" 1000 yen, details
■ Report from our site's reader: Used on a weekday in May 2025. Of the multiple parking lots, it's the wide one on the right (Olive Garden Parking Lot) halfway up the hill from the national highway. I rested here after soaking in "Sun Olive Hot Spring" at the back right of the roadside station. It was very quiet and I slept well. The toilet at the top of the stairs is a slight drawback. There was no toilet shower, and the cleaning was not very good. EV Quick is in the upper parking lot (next to the roadside station building). It operates from 8:30-17:00, and you need to ask the roadside station staff to unlock it. (Posted: May 2025, Mr./Ms. n)
■ Report from our site's reader: Kagawa Prefecture Roadside Station Shodoshima Olive Park, but the toilets are hard to find. The parking lot at the hot spring facility at the top of the hill does not have toilets that can be used at night, but the parking lots along the road and the one halfway between the road and the top of the hill do have toilets that can be used at night. The whole surrounding area seems to be a roadside rest area. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.title_ja: 奥祖谷二重かづら橋駐車場
properties.title_en: Oku-Iya Double Vine Bridge Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場は斜めの所が多いけど、探せば何とか我慢できる角度の所もあります。トイレは古くて質素、一応洋式トイレ有り、交通量は僅かなのですが川の音がします。車中泊場所としてはBクラスですが、このかずら橋と周囲の自然が素晴らしいので車中泊の価値はあります。キャンプ施設も有り、有料ですが格安310円。キャンプ道具を運び込むにはかづら橋を渡らねばなりません。荷物を担いでかずら橋を渡る力量が必要ですｗ川の水はニコ淵や水晶淵の様に美しいです。もう一つの有名なかずら橋の様な観光客は居ません。平日の朝は僕の後に一組の御夫婦が来て、その後数人来てました。休日はある程度のお客さんが来るとの事です。ただしここに行くまでの道中が酷道439号線ですので大変な道です。朝8時半ころから受付のおばさんが一人で準備していました。お話ししてみましたが、のどかな田舎の雰囲気でした。（投稿：2026年4月、キャタロー様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Many of the parking spaces are on a slope, but if you look hard enough, you can find some at a tolerable angle. The toilets are old and simple, but there is a Western-style toilet. There is little traffic, but you can hear the sound of the river. As a place to park overnight, it's a B-class spot, but the Kazura Bridge and the surrounding nature are wonderful, so it's worth parking overnight. There is also a camping facility, which is a paid but cheap 310 yen. To carry your camping gear, you have to cross the Kazura Bridge. You need the strength to carry your luggage across the Kazura Bridge lol. The river water is as beautiful as Niko-buchi and Suisho-buchi. There are no tourists like at the other famous Kazura Bridge. On a weekday morning, one couple came after me, and then a few more people came after that. I was told that there are a fair number of customers on weekends. However, the road to get here is the notoriously difficult National Highway 439, so it's a tough road. An old lady was setting up the reception by herself from around 8:30 in the morning. I talked to her, and she had a peaceful, rural atmosphere. (Submitted by: Catero, April 2026)

Tabelog

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：令和八年三月二十九日車中泊しました。駐車スペースは軽自動車１０台程、普通車８台程でした。私は軽キャブコンでしたが５メートル以上あるキャンピングカーは厳しいかもしれません。トイレは目の前の橋脚の下にある公衆水洗トイレは２４時間使用できました。汚れありましたがAM４時ころには清掃されてきれいでした。歩いて２分の所にファミマがあります。ひろめ市場まで歩いて１２分です。（投稿：2026年4月、くろう様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: I stayed overnight in my car on March 29th, 2026. There was parking space for about 10 kei cars and about 8 regular cars. I was in a kei cabover camper, but it might be difficult for campervans longer than 5 meters. The public flush toilets under the bridge piers in front of the site were available 24 hours a day. There was some dirt, but they were cleaned around 4 AM and were clean. There is a FamilyMart convenience store a 2-minute walk away. It's a 12-minute walk to Hirome Market. (Submitted by Kuro in April 2026)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：大規模公園の駐車場で夜間施錠無し、小高い丘の上にあり円形に配置された広い駐車場です。駐車場端に男、女、多目的トイレあり、和式と洋式便座あり清潔に管理されている。水平線が見渡せ眺望も良い。周囲は幹線道路や民家は無く夜間は、ほとんど車通りが無く静か。約600m位の場所にホテル四万十の宿に併設された入浴施設が有ります（詳細）。さらにレストラン山川海もあり食事も可能です。ただしホテルの食事処と併用されている為予約で満席に成っていることも有るので確認が必要です。他5台車中泊利用者あり。2026.2.23利用（投稿：2026年4月、福山のモモ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: This is a large parking lot in a large park that is not locked at night. It is located on a small hill and is a spacious, circular parking lot. There are men's, women's, and multipurpose toilets at the edge of the parking lot, with both Japanese and Western-style toilets, and they are kept clean. The view of the horizon is excellent. There are no main roads or houses nearby, and it is quiet at night with almost no traffic. There is a bathing facility attached to the Hotel Shimanto about 600m away (details). There is also the Yamakawaumi restaurant where you can eat. However, since it is shared with the hotel's dining area, it may be fully booked, so it is necessary to check. There were 5 other people using the parking lot for overnight stays in their cars. Used on February 23, 2026 (Posted by Momo from Fukuyama, April 2026)

properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: The parking lot next to the toilet is free. The toilets are at a beach. There are Western-style toilets and a wheelchair-accessible toilet with a shower, the same type as those at roadside rest areas. There are coin-operated showers; cold water is free, but hot water is available for a fee and only 100 yen coins are accepted. It was usable on the night of March 14th. It is sandwiched between the beach and the road, but there is almost no traffic at night. You can hear the sound of the waves, but it is at the same level as the Seto Inland Sea. It is next to the parking lot that has already been posted about. This area must have good toilet facilities. (Posted by: Catero, March 2026)

■無料駐車場と超きれいな公衆トイレ（管理棟の一角が公衆トイレになっている。夜も利用可能で電気も付く）。なんとwimax電波OK。墓地のため周りはお墓だらけ。心霊スポットとかいうレベルではないｗ 明るいときからここに駐車していると、自○と間違われて通報される可能性があるので、寝る前の22時くらいにくると良い。22時以降は誰も来ないので非常に静かで最高。超穴場を見つけてしまいました。管理人は霊とか一切信じない人なので、朝まで快眠できました。ここ最高です。22時までふもとのハローズとかでのんびりして、22時にここに来ればOK。（2021年10月管理人現地確認）
■車中泊と心霊現象👻について
properties.desc_en:
■Free parking and a super clean public toilet (a corner of the administration building serves as the public toilet. It's usable at night and has lights). Amazingly, there's WiMAX signal. Because it's a cemetery, it's surrounded by graves. It's beyond just a haunted spot lol. If you park here during the day, you might be mistaken for a suicide victim and reported, so it's best to come around 10 PM before going to bed. Nobody comes after 10 PM, so it's incredibly quiet and fantastic. I've found a real hidden gem. The caretaker doesn't believe in ghosts at all, so I slept soundly until morning. This place is the best. Just relax at the Harrods at the foot of the mountain until 10 PM, then come here at 10 PM. (October 2021, caretaker's on-site verification)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.desc_ja: ■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。駐車場は21:30-翌朝9:00まで閉鎖され出入りできなくなる。年末年始は長期閉鎖されるので注意。詳細　管理棟のトイレは夜間閉鎖されるので、西側の小高いところにある公衆トイレを使う（和式の水洗）。閉鎖されるので当然ながら静か。wimax電波OK。閉鎖前に管理人のおじさんに閉鎖するけど大丈夫かと聞かれる。酒を飲んで車を動かせないとか言えばいい。管理人さんも仕事で聞いてるだけなのでそれ以上つっこんでこない。朝早く出なくていいなら良いかも。
properties.desc_en: ■Free parking and public toilets. The parking lot is closed from 9:30 PM to 9:00 AM the following morning, making it impossible to enter or exit. Note that it will be closed for an extended period during the New Year holidays. Details: The toilets in the management building are closed at night, so use the public toilets located on a small hill to the west (Japanese-style flush toilets). It is quiet because it is closed. WiMAX signal is OK. Before closing, the caretaker will ask you if it's okay that they are closing. You can say that you've been drinking and can't move your car. The caretaker is just asking as part of his job, so he won't press you further. It might be okay if you don't have to leave early in the morning.

properties.desc_ja:
■無料駐車場、トイレあり。奥の方は静か。標高は461mで夏も割りと涼しい。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■久しぶりに来たらトイレがリニューアルされて非常にキレイになってました。水洗洋式ウォシュレット。最高。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：元々交通量が少ない県道から更に奥まったところに駐車場があり静か標高もソコソコあって涼しい、トイレがウォシュレット付きで凄く綺麗に管理されていた。夜間照明もある、携帯電波は問題なし、周辺に売店が無いのがネック。車で5〜10分ほどの距離に三瓶温泉鶴の湯・亀の湯・熊谷旅館等温泉アリ（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Free parking and restrooms available. The back area is quiet. The elevation is 461m, so it's relatively cool even in summer. (Older post from before 2019)
■When I came back after a long time, the restrooms had been renovated and were very clean. Flush toilets with bidet functions. Excellent. (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from a reader of this site: The parking lot is located further back from the prefectural road, which originally had little traffic, so it's quiet, the elevation is decent and it's cool, and the restrooms have bidet functions and are very clean. There is also night lighting, and cell phone reception is fine, but the lack of shops nearby is a drawback. There are hot springs such as Sanbe Onsen Tsuru-no-yu, Kame-no-yu, and Kumagai Ryokan within a 5-10 minute drive. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_ja:
■入浴♨️：温泉は500円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：2025年5月の平日に利用。安芸市街地から直接登っていく道(非常に狭隘)と、少し東の伊尾木川沿いに登る道(普通に狭隘)があります・・。汲み上げた源泉（冷鉱泉）を加温してかけ流すお湯は身体によく馴染んでとても良い気分です。しかも500円！このコスパは凄い。地産食材豊富な食事も大満足、それにスタッフさんのおもてなしスピリットがとても嬉しい。マイベスト温泉のひとつになりました。（投稿：2025年5月、n様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：車中泊利用料金：有料　格安　1000円、飲食すれば500円、電源あり。トイレ：施設内にあり。入浴施設あり：料金大人500円　子供250円、営業時間11:00-19:00、定休日 火曜日、施設参考URL：//komadori-onsen.com、車中泊スペース参考URL：//posts.gle/4YXAfUebSuE5B7eQ7。コメント：単純硫黄泉のこじんまりした浴場と食事と休憩のできる施設、ウッドデッキテントサイトが併設され、薪の販売もあり。車中泊者への飲料水補給サービス、100V電源提供あり。食事は定食からおつまみ、アルコールの提供もあり。17：00頃に付けば一杯飲んで風呂に入ってゆっくりできる。店員さんたちは皆とても感じが良いです。（投稿：2022年6月、ゆったりドライバー様）
properties.desc_en:
■Bathing♨️: Hot spring bath is 500 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: Used on a weekday in May 2025. There is a road that goes directly up from Aki city center (very narrow) and a road that goes up along the Ioki River a little to the east (normally narrow)... The hot spring water (cold mineral spring) that is drawn up from the source is heated and flows freely, and it feels great on the body. And it's only 500 yen! The cost performance is amazing. The meals, which are full of local ingredients, are also very satisfying, and the hospitality spirit of the staff is very much appreciated. It has become one of my favorite hot springs. (Posted: May 2025, Mr./Ms. n)
■Report from our site's reader: Overnight stay fee: Paid, cheap, 1000 yen, 500 yen if you eat and drink, electricity available. Toilets: Available on the premises. Bathing facilities available: Adults 500 yen, Children 250 yen, Opening hours 11:00-19:00, Closed Tuesdays, Facility reference URL: //komadori-onsen.com, Overnight parking space reference URL: //posts.gle/4YXAfUebSuE5B7eQ7. Comments: A small bathhouse with a simple sulfur spring, a facility for eating and relaxing, and a wood deck tent site are attached. Firewood is also sold. Drinking water replenishment service and 100V power supply are available for those staying overnight in their vehicles. Meals range from set meals to snacks and alcohol is also available. If you arrive around 17:00, you can have a drink, take a bath, and relax. The staff are all very friendly. (Posted by: Yuttari Driver, June 2022)

There's a Lawson inside the roadside station building, but its operating hours are 7 AM to 9 PM, so it's not usable late at night or early in the morning. (Older post from before 2019)

There is a toilet, but please note that there is no toilet paper or soap for hand washing. It is located along a national highway and has a fair amount of traffic. There are also many large vehicles parked there. (Submitted: September 2020, anonymous)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 吉井川中流県立自然公園
properties.title_en: Yoshii River Middle Reaches Prefectural Natural Park
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：利用料金：無料、夜間閉鎖はされません。トイレ：夜間閉鎖はされません。男性は和式水洗トイレの個室のみ、女性兼多目的トイレは水洗洋式個室トイレでした。トイレットペーパーはどちらもほとんど満タンで、予備もいくつかあったので心配無用でしょう。センサー式の電灯がついているので夜間の利用も安心ですが、男子トイレは電気が消えるまでの時間が短く、また入口にセンサーがあるので夜間に大をするなら多目的トイレに入るのがいいでしょう。静かさ：ひと気は皆無で川のせせらぎと動物の鳴き声が多少するくらい。街灯もないので車に乗り込んで車内灯を消したら完全な静寂と闇になります。その他評価ポイント：人気がいないので睡眠を妨害される要素が全くない。完全に明かりが無くなるのでサンルーフがついてる車だと星空がきれいに見えそう。岡山国際サーキットと非常に近いのでそこに朝から行きたい場合は便利。マイナス評価ポイント（難点）：到達までに細い道を走る必要がある(人気皆無なので鉢合わせの心配はない)。若干の傾斜あり(正直気にならない)。人気がないので防犯面は自己責任(まあ荒らされることはないとは思うが)。駐車場が狭い(トイレ横に停めたが、2台分くらいしか余裕がない)。電波が弱い(4本中1本しかたたなかった)。百点満点で評価すると……　70点。加点理由：光源がなく静か、夜間でも使えるトイレがある、岡山国際サーキットと非常に近い。減点理由：電波が弱い、細い道を走る必要がある。車で20.5km(約30分弱)のところにある湯郷温泉が近辺の入浴施設としておすすめ。特に「湯郷　鷺温泉館」（詳細）がおすすめ。料金：大人1人800円(100円引きのJAF割があります)（投稿：2024年11月、ていとく様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Usage fee: Free, not closed at night. Toilets: Not closed at night. Men's toilets are only Japanese-style flush toilet stalls, while the women's/multipurpose toilet has a Western-style flush toilet stall. Both toilets were almost full of toilet paper, and there were several spares, so there's no need to worry. There are sensor-activated lights, so it's safe to use at night, but the men's toilet lights stay on for a short time and there's a sensor at the entrance, so if you need to go to the bathroom at night, it's best to use the multipurpose toilet. Quietness: There are no people around, only the sound of the river and some animal noises. There are no streetlights, so if you get in your car and turn off the interior lights, it becomes completely silent and dark. Other positive points: There are no people around, so there's absolutely nothing to disturb your sleep. Since there is absolutely no light, if your car has a sunroof, you'll probably get a beautiful view of the starry sky. It's very close to Okayama International Circuit, so it's convenient if you want to go there in the morning. Negative points (difficulties): You have to drive down narrow roads to get there (there are no people around, so there's no need to worry about bumping into someone). There is a slight slope (honestly, it doesn't bother me). It's not a popular spot, so security is your own responsibility (though I don't think it will be vandalized). The parking lot is small (I parked next to the toilet, but there was only room for about two cars). The cell phone signal is weak (only 1 out of 4 bars). On a scale of 100, I would rate it... 70 points. Points added: It's quiet because there are no artificial lights, there is a toilet that can be used at night, and it's very close to Okayama International Circuit. Points deducted: The cell phone signal is weak, and you have to drive down narrow roads. Yunogo Onsen, located 20.5km (about 30 minutes) away by car, is recommended as a nearby bathing facility. I especially recommend "Yunogo Sagi Onsenkan" (details). Price: 800 yen per adult (there is a 100 yen discount for JAF members) (Posted: November 2024, by Teitoku)

Nearby hot spring: Okutsu Onsen Hanabijin no Sato (details) is a 20-minute drive away, day-use bathing is 800 yen, details. Nearby convenience store: Seven-Eleven Tomano Kagamino-cho store is a 40-minute drive away. Quietness: Quiet, I woke up in the morning to the sound of deer from the mountains. Personal rating: 60 points, it's far from the hot springs and convenience store, but the quiet and clean toilets are appealing. (Submitted by: A, May 2024)

properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free parking and toilets available. However, they are dark and dirty. It's located right after exiting the tunnel, and the parking lot is right off the prefectural road, so you might easily drive right past it if you don't know where it is. As of November 2020, it is not possible to pass through to the north from here. The surrounding prefectural roads are also dangerous, so please be careful. (Submitted by: C, November 2020)

properties.label: Free Campground
properties.title_ja: 重信川かすみの森公園（無料キャンプ場）
properties.title_en: Shigenobu River Kasumi Forest Park (Free Campsite)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：無料キャンプ場が併設されている駐車場。大きな橋の下にある駐車場は横長で、50台くらいは止められそう。橋の下(3台ほど)なら、雨の日の車中泊でも濡れずに快適。そして、すべてフラット、幅も問題なし。10月に使用したが蚊が多かった。虫対策必須。トイレは駐車場から50メートルほどゆるい坂を登った所にある。そこに自販機もある。週末はキャンパーさんで駐車場も混み合うが、夜には静かになる。平日は1日非常に静かに過ごせる。水場が無いのと買い出しが少し遠いので、買い物済ませてから来る方が良い。個人的には非常に好きな穴場。キャンプ場に付いては、グーグルマップのクチコミを参考に。👉️詳細（投稿：2022年10月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A parking lot with an attached free campsite. The parking lot, located under a large bridge, is long and narrow and seems to be able to accommodate about 50 cars. If you park under the bridge (about 3 cars), you can stay dry and comfortable even if it rains while sleeping in your car. Also, it's all flat and the width is not a problem. I used it in October and there were a lot of mosquitoes. Insect repellent is a must. The toilet is about 50 meters up a gentle slope from the parking lot. There is also a vending machine there. On weekends the parking lot gets crowded with campers, but it becomes quiet at night. On weekdays you can spend the whole day in complete peace and quiet. There is no water source and shopping is a bit far, so it is better to do your shopping before coming. Personally, it is a hidden gem that I really like. For more information about the campsite, please refer to the reviews on Google Maps. 👉️Details (Posted: October 2022, by m)

■Elevation 612m

There are surveillance cameras installed, and maintenance staff come to do things like mowing the grass. (Posted: May 2025, by Catero, YouTube channel)

properties.title_en: Water supply station next to the shop (Beppu Benten Pond spring water)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：別府弁天池の入り口にある売店の横に水汲み場あり。駐車場からも近い。詳細（投稿：2022年4月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There is a water source next to the shop at the entrance to Beppu Benten Pond. It is also close to the parking lot. Details (Submitted by: n, April 2022)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.title_ja: 弁財天様 水くみ場（別府弁天池湧水）
properties.title_en: Benzaiten Shrine Water Drawing Area (Beppu Benten Pond Spring Water)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：別府厳島神社の中にある水汲み場。詳細（投稿：2022年4月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A water source located inside Beppu Itsukushima Shrine. Details (Submitted by: n, April 2022)

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.title_ja: （有料、夜間閉鎖）海田総合公園
properties.title_en: (Admission fee required, closed at night) Kaita General Park""
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車一回210円、大型車630円（翌朝までいても一回料金ポッキリ）の有料駐車場で、駐車場にきれいな水洗洋式のトイレがあります。駐車場料金は、東側にある管理棟入り口にメダル（210円）の自販機があるので、駐車場入ったら購入しておく（出るときにメダルを入れる方式）。携帯電波も問題ありません。一点注意しないといけないのは、夜間21時〜8時まで夜間閉鎖で、18時くらいに管理員の人が夜間閉鎖するけど大丈夫かと聞いてくる。このときにちゃんと返答しないと警察呼ばれて大騒ぎになります。ここは車内自殺の名所らしく、管理員さんもピリピリしてます。「すみません、酒を飲んでしまったので、明朝必ず出ていきます」と言えばOK。管理員としても顔チェックと自殺でないことの確認ができればそれ以上は聞いてこないです。（投稿：2021年12月、ひろき様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: This is a paid parking lot where regular cars cost 210 yen per entry and large vehicles cost 630 yen (the fee is fixed even if you stay until the next morning). There are clean, flushable Western-style toilets in the parking lot. Parking fees are paid by purchasing tokens (210 yen) from a vending machine at the entrance to the management building on the east side (you insert the tokens when you leave). Cell phone reception is also fine. One thing to be careful of is that the parking lot is closed at night from 9 PM to 8 AM, and around 6 PM an attendant will ask if it's okay that the parking lot will be closed at night. If you don't answer properly at this time, the police will be called and it will become a big fuss. This place is apparently known as a suicide spot in cars, so the attendant is on edge. If you say, "I'm sorry, I've been drinking, so I'll definitely leave tomorrow morning," it will be fine. As long as the attendant can check your face and confirm that it's not a suicide, they won't ask any further questions. (Submitted by Hiroki in December 2021)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 因島フラワーセンター
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車90台の広大な無料駐車場。水洗トイレは綺麗に清掃されており、洋式の多目的トイレもある。マイナスポイントとして、民家が隣接しているのでそれなりの気遣いが必要。（投稿：2023年10月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A vast free parking lot with space for 90 regular cars. The flush toilets are kept clean, and there is also a Western-style multipurpose toilet. A downside is that there are private houses next door, so some consideration is needed. (Submitted by: y, October 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車75台の無料駐車場。トイレは案内板にも表示がないので分かりにくいが、テニスコートの横にある。水洗洋式ウオシュレット付き、人を感知して自動でフタが開閉するタイプでビビった。公衆トイレとしては文句なしのレベル。夜は無人の貸し切り状態となり、閑静な一夜を過ごせる。（投稿：2025年10月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free parking for 75 regular cars. The toilets are hard to find as there are no signs, but they are located next to the tennis courts. I was surprised to find that they are flush toilets with bidet functions and the lids open and close automatically when they sense a person. As a public toilet, it's absolutely perfect. At night, it becomes deserted and you can have it all to yourself, allowing you to spend a peaceful night. (Submitted by: y, October 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車6台の無料駐車場。トイレは水洗洋式で清掃状態も良好。駐車場はやや傾斜があるが、神経質でなければ気にならないレベル。夕日スポットなので日没まではそれなりに人がいる。隠岐諸島を一望できる眺めは素晴らしいが、寝る事だけを考えたら他のスポットの方が良いかも。（投稿：2025年10月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free parking for 6 regular cars. The toilets are flush toilets and are in good condition. The parking lot has a slight slope, but it's not a problem unless you're particularly picky. It's a sunset spot, so there are a fair number of people until sunset. The view overlooking the Oki Islands is wonderful, but if you're only looking to sleep, other spots might be better. (Submitted by: y, October 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車50台級の無料駐車場。小型車専用の第一駐車場がオススメ。トレイは水洗洋式で多目的トイレはウオシュレット付き。R431に隣接した立地だが、防風林が音を遮ってくれるのか、車の走行音はそれほど気にならない。（投稿：2025年10月、y様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：無料 産業道路沿い 空港入り口信号を海側に入った駐車場でトイレは水洗 美保湾が見渡せて海水浴もできます。入浴施設はみなと温泉ほのかみ500円2.5km、皆生温泉おーゆランド350円12km、買い物はPLANT-5 ラ・ムー米子北店がお買い得 近くにP泊 地夢みなと公園駐車場 弓ヶ浜駐車場が有ります。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: Free parking lot with space for 50 regular cars. The first parking lot, which is for small cars, is recommended. The toilets are flush toilets, and the multipurpose toilet has a bidet. Although it is located next to Route 431, the windbreak trees seem to block out the sound, so the noise from passing cars is not too noticeable. (Submitted by: y, October 2025)

■Report from our website reader: Free parking lot along the industrial road. The parking lot is located on the ocean side of the airport entrance traffic light. The toilets are flush toilets. You can see Miho Bay and go swimming. For bathing facilities, Minato Onsen Honokami is 500 yen, 2.5km away, and Kaike Onsen Oyu Land is 350 yen, 12km away. For shopping, PLANT-5 La-Mu Yonago Kita store is a good deal. Nearby parking lots include Jimu Minato Park Parking Lot and Yumigahama Parking Lot. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 浦富海水浴場第一駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車50台以上の無料駐車場。トイレは水洗洋式で清掃状態も良好。隣接する国道R178は山陰道の無料区間と重複しているせいか、たまに地元車が通る程度。しっぽりと静かな夜を過ごしたい人には、近所の道の駅「岩美」よりも良いかも。※2024/5に利用（投稿：2024年6月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Free parking for over 50 regular cars. The toilets are flush toilets and are in good condition. The adjacent National Route 178 overlaps with the free section of the San'in Expressway, so only local cars pass by occasionally. For those who want to spend a quiet and peaceful night, this might be better than the nearby roadside station "Iwami". *Used in May 2024 (Posted by: y, June 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車50台の無料駐車場。トイレは水洗洋式で清掃状態も良好。すぐ近くの湖山池・福井駐車場と比べると、トイレも駐車場も新しめ。（投稿：2025年10月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Free parking for 50 regular cars. The toilets are flush toilets (Western style) and are in good condition. Compared to the nearby Koyamaike Fukui parking lot, both the toilets and the parking lot are newer. (Submitted by: y, October 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 足摺岬東側駐車場（※トイレ無し）
properties.title_en: Ashizuri Cape East Parking Lot (No restrooms available)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車50台くらいの無料駐車場。開放感のある環境はGoodだが、重大な欠陥としてトイレがない。トイレのある展望台駐車場までは600m程度離れている。展望台駐車場で寝る前のトイレを済ませてからココに移動するのが良いかも。（投稿：2023年10月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A free parking lot with space for about 50 regular cars. The open environment is good, but a major drawback is the lack of toilets. The observation deck parking lot, which has toilets, is about 600m away. It might be best to use the toilet at the observation deck parking lot before going to bed and then move here. (Submitted by: y, October 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 西郷岬灯台（夕日ヶ丘公園）
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車40台級の無料駐車場。トイレは水洗洋式で清掃状態も良好。夜は無人の貸し切り状態となり、閑静な一夜を過ごせる。フェリーターミナルからの距離は約6kmで、夕刻便で到着した後のP泊地としても好適。個人的には、隠岐・島後でいちばんオススメの車中泊スポット。（投稿：2025年10月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A free parking lot that can accommodate about 40 regular cars. The toilets are flush toilets and are in good condition. At night, it becomes deserted and you can have the place to yourself, allowing for a peaceful night's sleep. It is about 6km from the ferry terminal, making it a suitable place to park overnight after arriving on an evening ferry. Personally, it is my most recommended overnight parking spot in Oki/Dogo. (Submitted by y in October 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 石見海浜公園・花の中央広場
properties.title_en: Iwami Seaside Park, Central Flower Square""
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車40台くらいの無料駐車場。トイレは水洗洋式も清掃状態は良好。幹線国道のR9からは400mくらい離れているので、車の走行音は気にならない。春の日が沈み切らない19時頃にヤンチャな車が来たが、駐車場を一周ドリフトしたら満足したのか早々に帰っていった。※2024/5に利用（投稿：2024年6月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Free parking lot with space for about 40 regular cars. The toilets are flush toilets and are in good condition. It is about 400m away from the main national highway R9, so the noise of passing cars is not a problem. Around 7pm in spring, before the sun had completely set, a rowdy car arrived, but after drifting around the parking lot once, it seemed satisfied and left soon after. *Used in May 2024 (Posted: June 2024, by y)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車30台級の無料駐車場。トイレはやや古いが、水洗洋式もあり、きれいに清掃されている。湖山池のまわりは、他にも車中泊できそうな駐車場があるが、閑静な一夜を過ごしたい人にはココがベストチョイスと思われる。（投稿：2023年4月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A free parking lot that can accommodate about 30 regular cars. The toilets are a bit old, but there are flush toilets and they are kept clean. There are other parking lots around Lake Koyama where you could stay overnight in your car, but this seems to be the best choice for those who want to spend a quiet night. (Submitted by: y, April 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車30台くらいの無料駐車場。トイレは水洗洋式で清掃状態も良好。隣接する道路（くにびきシーサイドライン）は、交通量が多くて真夜中になるまで落ち着かない。余りオススメはしないが、一応車中泊は可能。※2024/5に利用（投稿：2024年6月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Free parking lot with space for about 30 regular cars. The toilets are flush toilets and are in good condition. The adjacent road (Kunibiki Seaside Line) has heavy traffic and is not peaceful until midnight. I don't really recommend it, but it is possible to stay overnight in your car. *Used in May 2024 (Posted by: y, June 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車20台くらいの無料駐車場。トイレは水洗洋式で清掃状態も良好。ケータイの電波はギリギリ届いている。山口市の中心部に近く、国道R9から約1kmの立地ながらも、夜は静かで申し分ない。アクセスルートについて、R9を曲がっってから宅街を抜けるまでの200m区間はすれ違い困難な狭隘路となるが、住宅街を抜けた後は道幅も回復するので心配ない。※2024/5に利用（投稿：2024年6月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: There is free parking for about 20 regular cars. The toilets are flush toilets and are in good condition. Cell phone reception is just barely available. It is close to the center of Yamaguchi City and is located about 1km from National Route 9, yet it is quiet at night and perfectly fine. Regarding the access route, the 200m section from where you turn off Route 9 until you get out of the residential area is a narrow road where it is difficult for cars to pass each other, but the road width improves after you get out of the residential area, so there is no need to worry. *Used in May 2024 (Posted: June 2024, by y)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車20台くらいの無料駐車場。トイレは建物に年季が入っているものの、水洗洋式のウオシュレット付き。地の果てのような立地なので、閑静な一夜を過ごせる。（投稿：2023年10月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There is free parking for about 20 regular cars. The toilets are in an older building, but they are flush toilets with bidet functions. It's in a remote location, so you can spend a quiet night. (Submitted by: y, October 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車20~30台くらいの無料駐車場。トイレは水洗洋式のウオシュレット付きで、綺麗に清掃されている。駐車場の奥側に駐車すれば、隣接の民家は木立が目隠しとなるので気にならない。夜の静かさは申し分ないレベル。一応は有料観光施設の駐車場なので、営業時間外に慎ましく利用する程度に留めましょう。（投稿：2023年10月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There is a free parking lot that can accommodate about 20-30 regular cars. The toilets are flush toilets with bidet functions and are kept very clean. If you park at the back of the parking lot, the trees block the view of the adjacent houses, so it's not a problem. The quietness at night is excellent. Since it is technically a parking lot for a paid tourist facility, please use it discreetly outside of business hours. (Submitted by: y, October 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車20~30台くらいの無料駐車場。トイレは管理棟に併設されており、夜間も利用可能で水洗洋式もある。夜間は無人状態で、閑静な一夜を過ごせる。（投稿：2023年10月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There is a free parking lot that can accommodate about 20-30 regular cars. The toilets are located next to the management building, are available at night, and include flush toilets (Western style). It is unmanned at night, so you can spend a quiet night. (Submitted by: y, October 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車15台くらいの無料駐車場。水洗洋式の多目的トイレが男用と女用でひとつずつあり、清掃状態も良好。隣接する県道は夜間の交通量が途絶える上、周辺は街灯もない鬱蒼とした森の中なので、怖いくらいに静かな夜を過ごせる。（投稿：2023年10月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There is a free parking lot that can fit about 15 regular cars. There is one Western-style flush toilet each for men and women, and they are in good condition. The adjacent prefectural road has no traffic at night, and the surrounding area is a dense forest with no streetlights, so you can spend a night that is eerily quiet. (Submitted by: y, October 2023)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：美しい登れる灯台です。景色も最高です。添付画像、添付画像（投稿：2022年11月、s様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A beautiful lighthouse that you can climb. The view is also superb. (Attached images, attached images) (Submitted by: s, November 2022)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: 尾道ラーメン 太華園
