properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：尾道ラーメンといえば朱華園が有名ですが尾道から離れた竹原にもあります、休日は行列が出来るほどの有名店です。尾道ラーメンは当然ですがお勧めはチャーハン。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: When it comes to Onomichi ramen, Shukaen is famous, but there is also one in Takehara, far from Onomichi, and it is a famous restaurant that has long lines on weekends. Onomichi ramen is a given, but the fried rice is highly recommended. Tabelog

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 三日月公園駐車場（無料）
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：飯梨川をはさんで「道の駅 広瀬・富田城」の対岸にある公園の駐車場です。道の駅よりも静かです。きれいなトイレがありますが、長居をすると人感センサーでカッコーの鳴き声が、もっと長居をするとビバルディの四季が流れます（笑）。 川沿いに気持のいい遊歩道もあります。徒歩すぐのところにスーパーと、飲食店もいくつかあります。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: This is the parking lot of a park located across the Iinashi River from the "Hirose-Tomita Castle Roadside Station." It's quieter than the roadside station. There are clean toilets, but if you stay too long, a motion sensor will activate the sound of a cuckoo, and if you stay even longer, Vivaldi's Four Seasons will play (lol). There is also a pleasant promenade along the river. There is a supermarket and several restaurants within easy walking distance. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 大津泊庭園無料駐車場 2
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：泊まってはいないが、車中泊出来そうです。利用料金︰無料。夜間閉鎖されないようです。水洗洋式(ウォシュレット無し)トイレ有り、非常にキレイ。静かさは、幹線道路の脇ですが交通量がそれほど多く無いので静かです。公園側に止めると静かです。海からは100m離れています。海抜は3.5mです。風が強い日は、海側の駐車場より良いかも。（投稿：2023年12月、naka0514k様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: I didn't stay overnight, but it looks like it's possible to park overnight in a car. Usage fee: Free. It doesn't seem to be closed at night. There is a flush toilet (no bidet) and it is very clean. It is quiet because although it is next to a main road, the traffic volume is not that high. It is quiet if you park on the park side. It is 100m away from the sea. The elevation is 3.5m above sea level. On windy days, it may be better than the parking lot on the sea side. (Posted by naka0514k in December 2023)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: 宇部ラーメン 大阪屋
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：濃厚豚骨ラーメンの「宇部ラーメン」元祖の店。駐車場なし。詳細。食べログ（投稿：2023年5月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: The original "Ube Ramen" restaurant, famous for its rich pork bone broth. No parking available. Details. Tabelog (Posted by n, May 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 安芸広域公園・川のゾーン駐車場
properties.title_en: Aki Wide Area Park - River Zone Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：入口付近に10台分、トイレ脇の道を下った先に20台分の駐車スペースがある。トイレはやや古いが、水洗洋式もあり、定期的に清掃が入っている感じ。隣接する県道は夜間の交通量も途絶えるので、閑静な一夜を過ごせる。入口付近の駐車場は、朝夕はウォーキング等の利用者でそれなりに車の出入りがある。奥側の駐車場がオススメだが、そこに至る道は車一台分の道幅なので運転注意。（投稿：2023年10月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There are 10 parking spaces near the entrance and 20 more down the road next to the toilets. The toilets are a bit old, but they have flush toilets and seem to be cleaned regularly. The adjacent prefectural road has no traffic at night, so you can spend a quiet night. The parking lot near the entrance has a fair amount of traffic in the mornings and evenings from people walking and doing other activities. The parking lot at the back is recommended, but the road leading to it is only wide enough for one car, so drive carefully. (Submitted by: y, October 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 境港 夢みなと公園
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：日曜日の夜に利用したが、翌日が平日にもかかわらず、頻繁に釣り人が出入りするので落ち着かない。個人的には、すぐ近くの美保湾展望駐車場の方が好み。（投稿：2025年10月、y様）
■無料駐車場。公衆トイレはちょっと歩くが公園内にある。徒歩5分のところに温泉あり。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: I used it on a Sunday night, but even though the next day was a weekday, there were frequent anglers coming and going, making it unsettling. Personally, I prefer the nearby Miho Bay Observation Parking Lot. (Posted by: y, October 2025)

■Free parking. Public restrooms are a short walk away but located within the park. There is a hot spring a 5-minute walk away. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：日本三名園の一つ。入園料500円。詳細（投稿：2025年3月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: One of Japan's three most famous gardens. Admission fee: 500 yen. Details (Submitted by: n, March 2025)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：内湯のみ700円　サウナ利用800円　8:00～24:00　詳細　受付内に休憩室あり。（投稿：2024年6月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Indoor bath only 700 yen, sauna use 800 yen, 8:00-24:00, details: There is a rest room inside the reception area. (Submitted by: n, June 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：苫田ダムのトイレも行きましたがとても綺麗でした。（投稿：2025年6月、おしょー様）
■管理所の前に無料駐車場とトイレ。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: I also went to the toilets at Tomata Dam and they were very clean. (Submitted by: Osho, June 2025)
■Free parking and toilets in front of the management office. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 みなとオアシス 八幡浜みなっと
properties.title_en: Roadside Station Minato Oasis Yawatahama Minatto
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：読者さんがSランクに推薦されていましたが、ここは大型トラックが駐車場のど真ん中まで入ってきて場所によってはエンジン音、冷凍機の音がかなりうるさいです。耳栓がいります。以前から利用させてもらっていて読者さんが言うように　少し改善されたのかなと思って利用しましたが、相変わらずうるさくて、加えて　朝早くから魚市場の人や近隣の老人たちの運動などにぎやかで　Sランクはどうかなと思いメールしました。一晩中静かでは決してないです。このサイトユーザーからです。（投稿：2020年10月、K様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：標記の場所に今年の夏、三泊し、ここはSランクとして推薦します。 理由 【１】トイレは大変綺麗だし、大型フェリー岸壁の脇で、港と山みかん畑の景色がきれい。長崎国際港のスモール版）【２】道の駅に「どーや食堂」があり、海鮮丼（７００~１３００円）は美味い。他に、海産物の炭火焼きを隣接する海産物市場で購入してここで食べれる。もちろん、特産店、パン屋喫茶、交流館もある。【３】道の駅の隣は「水産物地方卸市場」で見学可能【４】道の駅から１００ｍ行くと「フジグランド北浜」という大型スーパーがあり、大変便利。【５】道の駅から１３０ｍ行くと「八幡浜黒湯温泉みなと湯」（６００円）の日帰り温泉がある。私は気に入って３泊、毎朝 海鮮丼（７００円）を食べる。風呂にも入り、スーパーの本屋で立ち読み。 ここは昔からトロール漁船の湊町でお魚がおいしい。 以上（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■無料Wifiも利用可能なようです。（1日最大60分（15分×4回））調べたら銭湯へは徒歩10分ほどかかる（700m）ようです。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: A reader recommended this place as S-rank, but large trucks drive right into the middle of the parking lot, and in some places the engine noise and refrigeration noise are quite loud. You'll need earplugs. I've used this place before, and I thought it might have improved a little as the reader said, but it's still noisy, and in addition, it's lively from early in the morning with people from the fish market and elderly people from the neighborhood exercising, so I wondered if it deserved an S-rank and decided to email you. It's definitely not quiet all night. From a user of this site. (Posted: October 2020, Mr. K)

■Report from our site's reader: I stayed at the above-mentioned place for three nights this summer, and I recommend it as S-rank. Reasons: [1] The toilets are very clean, and it's next to a large ferry pier, so the view of the port and mountain mandarin orange groves is beautiful. (A smaller version of Nagasaki International Port) [2] There's a restaurant called "Doya Shokudo" at the roadside station, and the seafood bowls (700-1300 yen) are delicious. In addition, you can buy charcoal-grilled seafood at the adjacent seafood market and eat it here. Of course, there are also specialty shops, a bakery, a cafe, and a community center. [3] Next to the roadside station is the "Local Wholesale Market for Seafood," which is open for tours. [4] 100m from the roadside station is a large supermarket called "Fuji Grand Kitahama," which is very convenient. [5] 130m from the roadside station is the "Yawatahama Kuroyu Onsen Minato-yu" (600 yen), a day-trip hot spring. I liked it so much that I stayed for three nights and ate a seafood bowl (700 yen) every morning. I also took a bath and browsed books at the supermarket's bookstore. This area has long been a port town for trawlers, so the fish is delicious. (Older post from before 2019)
■Free Wi-Fi is also available. (Maximum 60 minutes per day (15 minutes x 4 times)) I checked and it seems to take about 10 minutes to walk to the public bath (700m). (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：道路と線路の真横なのでかなりうるさい。トイレあり。DQNがバイクを乗り回していたので、泊まらずに別のスポットへ移動した。（投稿：2021年11月、c様）
■7月〜9月の海水浴シーズン以外は駐車場が24時間無料開放されている。釣り客の車中泊も結構いる。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: It's quite noisy because it's right next to the road and train tracks. There are toilets. There were some rowdy people riding motorcycles, so I didn't stay and moved to another spot. (Posted by c, November 2021)
■The parking lot is open 24 hours a day and free of charge except during the swimming season from July to September. There are quite a few anglers who stay overnight in their cars. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 来夢とごうち
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：道の駅の建物がある敷地は普通車３０台程度の狭い駐車場とトイレとなっていますが、国道を挟んだ向かい側はコンビニ（セブンイレブン）と屋台的な麺類や弁当類を販売する店舗があります。さらにそれらの店舗の裏側が道の駅の広大な駐車場とトイレがあるので車中泊するならそちらの駐車場の方が車両の出入りも少なく快適です。日帰り入浴施設は「グリースパつつが」（５分）、「いこいの村ひろしま」（２５分）があります。（投稿：2024年6月、山びこ様）
■広大な駐車場でとても静か。セブン隣接。５分くらいのところに温泉（筒賀温泉グリーンスパつつが、６５０円、１８：３０まで）がある。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: The site where the roadside station building stands has a small parking lot that can accommodate about 30 regular cars and a toilet, but across the national highway there is a convenience store (Seven-Eleven) and a food stall selling noodles and bento boxes. Furthermore, behind those shops is the roadside station's vast parking lot and toilet, so if you're planning to stay overnight in your car, that parking lot is more comfortable with less vehicle traffic. Day-use hot spring facilities include "Green Spa Tsutsuga" (5 minutes) and "Ikoi no Mura Hiroshima" (25 minutes). (Submitted by Yamabiko, June 2024)

■Very quiet with a large parking lot. Adjacent to Seven-Eleven. There is a hot spring (Tsutsuga Onsen Green Spa Tsutsuga, 650 yen, until 18:30) about 5 minutes away. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: みつの里(車中泊不適)※トイレはコンビニ利用
properties.title_en: Mitsunosato (Not suitable for overnight stays in a car) *Toilets are available at the convenience store.
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：道の駅ではないです。日中は飲食店もありますが、ほとんどコンビニの駐車場と思っていいかも。道の両側に駐車場がありますが、すぐ近くに民家があります。少し休むのは良いですが、車中泊の場所としては不適です。※トイレはコンビニ利用（投稿：2020年10月、C様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: This is not a roadside rest area. There are restaurants during the day, but it's mostly like a convenience store parking lot. There are parking lots on both sides of the road, but there are private houses very close by. It's fine for a short rest, but it's not suitable for overnight stays in your car. *Toilets are available at the convenience store (Reported by C, October 2020)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 宮地やすらぎの里(車中泊不適)※公衆トイレあり
properties.title_en: Miyaji Yasuragi no Sato (Not suitable for overnight stays in vehicles) *Public restrooms available
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：道の駅くめなんのそばに、案内の看板があります。道中、交差点には案内の看板が何か所かありますが、車高制限2.5m、道も狭いです。付近には民家もあり、車中泊の場所としては不適です。※公衆トイレあり（投稿：2020年10月、C様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: There is a signpost near the Kumenan roadside station. There are several signsposts at intersections along the way, but the road is narrow and has a height restriction of 2.5m. There are also private houses nearby, making it unsuitable as a place for overnight stays in a vehicle. *Public toilets are available (Submitted by C in October 2020)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：道の駅きくがわ・小月ICの北、湯の原ダムの東側道路の脇にある。詳細（投稿：2023年1月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Located north of Michi-no-Eki Kikugawa/Ozuki IC, on the side of the road east of Yunohara Dam. Details (Submitted by: n, January 2023)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：道の駅 内に足湯あり。近くのいりすの丘に温泉 美人の湯 あり（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：WiMAX2+ 中freeWiFi 有り（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: Footbath available at the roadside station. Nearby, at Irisu-no-Oka, there is a hot spring called "Bijin-no-Yu" (Beauty Hot Spring) (Older post from before 2019)
■ Reader Report: Free WiMAX2+ available (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：透き通る水がコバルトブルーに見える、神秘的な美しさをもつ池。近くに水汲み場あり。詳細（投稿：2022年5月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A pond with mystical beauty, where the crystal-clear water appears cobalt blue. There is a water source nearby. Details (Submitted by: n, May 2022)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：湯ノ峠駅から南に約200m、道幅が広くなった所の道路下にある。詳細（投稿：2022年5月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: It is located about 200m south of Yunotoge Station, under the road where it widens. Details (Submitted by: n, May 2022)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 遊YOUさろん東城
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：東城インター近くで、夜遅くでも走行音・車の出入りが気になるかもしれませんので、奥まった駐車区画に駐めた方が良いでしょう。両脇にコンビニと中華料理店、その向こうに夜９時まで営業のスーパーがあります。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Near the Tojo Interchange, you might be bothered by traffic noise and cars coming and going even late at night, so it's best to park in a more secluded parking space. There are convenience stores and a Chinese restaurant on either side, and a supermarket that's open until 9 PM beyond them. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: 香橋池パーキングエリア（トイレなし）
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：津山方面→岡山方面行きの進行方向にあり。分離帯有。駐車スペースは道路側(右側・分離帯側)になります。交通量も多く、大型車等の利用も多いです。お店が少し離れた場所になりますが、市内で停められる箇所がほとんどないので、市内直前の貴重な無料駐車スペースになります。トイレなし。（投稿：2020年11月、C様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Located in the direction of travel from Tsuyama to Okayama. There is a median strip. Parking spaces are on the road side (right side, median strip side). There is a lot of traffic, and it is often used by large vehicles. The shop is a little distance away, but there are almost no places to park in the city, so it is a valuable free parking space just before the city center. No toilet. (Submitted by: C, November 2020)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：直島島内に何箇所かある町営駐車場の一つ。夜間閉鎖なし。トイレは洋式水洗（ウォッシュレット）夜間静かだが、向かいに町営の宿泊施設とキャンプ場があり、駐車場は共用のようです。最寄のコンビニまで車で10分程、営業時間（6:30〜21:00）入浴は銭湯「I♡湯」車で12〜3分。直島観光の拠点として最高の場所です。（投稿：2026年1月、o様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: One of several town-operated parking lots on Naoshima Island. No closures at night. The toilets are Western-style flush toilets (with bidet). It's quiet at night, but there is a town-operated accommodation facility and campground across the street, and it seems the parking lot is shared. The nearest convenience store is about a 10-minute drive away, and its operating hours are 6:30 AM to 9:00 PM. For bathing, the public bath "I♡Yu" is a 12-13 minute drive away. It's the perfect base for sightseeing on Naoshima. (Submitted by: o, January 2026)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：鳥取県の大山にあります。無料、夜も開放されています。トイレも24時間使えます、但し昆虫が多くて男子用しか使う気になれなかった。超静か　誰も来ない　幸いな事に野生動物も来なかった。でも静かすぎて寂しい。電波は微妙。（投稿：2025年9月、a様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: It's located in Mt. Daisen, Tottori Prefecture. It's free and open at night. The toilets are also available 24 hours a day, however there were so many insects that I only felt like using the men's toilet. It's extremely quiet, nobody comes, and luckily no wild animals came either. But it's so quiet it's lonely. The cell phone reception is poor. (Submitted by: a, September 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 尾道トラックステーション
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：長距離トラックの仮眠のための施設で24時間出入り自由。敷地内にサウナや入浴施設があるらしいが、利用可否は未確認。駐車場の利用のみなら無料。ファミリーマートがあり、トイレは借りれます。トラックのエンジン音が少し気になりますが、安心して眠れます。車中泊施設がほとんどない尾道でお薦めです。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: This facility is for long-haul truck drivers to take naps and is open 24 hours a day. There seems to be a sauna and bathing facilities on the premises, but their availability is unconfirmed. Parking is free. There is a FamilyMart convenience store and you can use the restroom. The sound of truck engines is a little noticeable, but you can sleep peacefully. Recommended in Onomichi, where there are hardly any facilities for sleeping in your vehicle. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：眺め最高、夕日絶景ポイント、釣りＯＫ、水洗トイレ有り、入り口に食材販売激安店、カッパ市有り（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Great view, spectacular sunset spot, fishing allowed, flush toilets available, cheap food store at the entrance, Kappa Market (older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Free Campground
properties.title_ja: 宮崎の河原キャンプ場の駐車場（無料キャンプ場）
properties.title_en: Parking lot at Kawara Campground in Miyazaki (free campground)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場無料。なお、隣接する河川敷のキャンプ場も無料で、四駆であれば車で河川敷に降りていける。トイレ、水道あり。屋根付きの東屋あり。夏のハイシーズンはキャンパーや車中泊の人々で若干混み合うが、それ以外は空いていて静かに過ごすことができる。車の走行音ほぼなし。川向いにAコープあり。（投稿：2021年6月、二日酔いのさすらい人様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free parking. The adjacent riverside campground is also free, and you can drive down to the riverside if you have a 4WD vehicle. There are toilets and running water. There is a covered gazebo. It gets a little crowded with campers and people sleeping in their cars during the peak summer season, but at other times it is quiet and peaceful. There is almost no traffic noise. There is an A-Coop across the river. (Submitted by: Hangover Wanderer, June 2021)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 清流茶屋かわはら
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場内に24時間営業のコンビニ「ファミマ」があり、山陰道（無料区間）からアクセスできるSA的な道の駅ですが、ファミマには酒類を販売していました。山陰道沿いですが日本一人口の少ない県と言われているためか、夜間は交通量が少なく余り気になりませんでした。トイレ（洋式２内一つは故障中、和式１）も施設内にありますが自由に利用できます。温泉は車で10分程度のところに「八上比売の美肌の湯　湯谷荘」（詳細、詳細場所）が420円で20時まで利用できます。洗い場は4人までですが利用者が少ないので問題ありませんでした。（投稿：2023年6月、山びこ様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：ランチバイキングがお勧め。そばにコンビニ有り。駐車スペースは少ない。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: There's a 24-hour convenience store (FamilyMart) in the parking lot. It's a roadside station similar to a service area, accessible from the San'in Expressway (free section), and FamilyMart sells alcohol. Although it's along the San'in Expressway, perhaps because it's said to be the prefecture with the smallest population in Japan, traffic was light at night and not much of a concern. There are toilets (two Western-style, one out of order; one Japanese-style) on the premises, which can be used freely. For hot springs, "Yagami Hime no Bihada no Yu Yutani-so" (details, detailed location) is about a 10-minute drive away and can be used until 8 PM for 420 yen. The washing area can accommodate up to four people, but there were few users, so it wasn't a problem. (Posted: June 2023, Yamabiko)

■Report from our website reader: The lunch buffet is recommended. There's a convenience store nearby. Parking space is limited. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 にちなん日野川の郷
properties.title_en: Roadside Station Nichinan Hinogawa no Sato
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場はそれほど広くないのですが、旧道沿いで通過車両はバイパスを通るので、夜は静かだと思います。隣にローソンがあるので、買い物に便利でしょう。（投稿：2020年8月、Y様）
■2016年4月オープン。ローソン隣接で便利。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: The parking lot isn't very big, but it's located along the old road and passing vehicles use the bypass, so I think it's quiet at night. There's a Lawson convenience store next door, so it's convenient for shopping. (Submitted by: Y, August 2020)
■Opened in April 2016. Conveniently located next to a Lawson convenience store.

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 サンエイト美都
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場に傾斜が付いているのでおすすめはしません。近くの美都温泉駐車場がおすすめです。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: I don't recommend this parking lot because it's sloped. I recommend the nearby Mito Onsen parking lot instead. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場が平らなところが少ないので利用しませんでした。道路沿いですが夜間は閑散としそうです。また、車で5分程度のところに「八頭地域福祉センター（鍛冶屋温泉　久遠の湯）（詳細、詳細）がありますが、利用時間は平日17時までで福祉センターの施設内に有り、余りにもローカル色が強いので利用を控えました。（投稿：2023年6月、山びこ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: I didn't use it because there were few flat parking spaces. It's along the road, but it seems like it would be deserted at night. Also, there is the Yazu Regional Welfare Center (Kajiya Onsen Kuon no Yu) (details, details) about a 5-minute drive away, but the operating hours are until 5 PM on weekdays, and it is located inside the welfare center facilities, and it is too local so I refrained from using it. (Submitted by Yamabiko in June 2023)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場あり。蛇口をひねるタイプ。詳細（投稿：2024年6月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Parking available. Tap-operated type. Details (Submitted by: n, June 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車スペースが道路に近いので走行音が気になるかもしれませんが、トイレ左側の少し奥まった場所に駐められれば、マシかもしれません。休憩所に無料wifiスポットがあります。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: The parking spaces are close to the road, so you might be bothered by the noise from passing cars, but it might be better if you park in the slightly recessed area to the left of the restrooms. There is a free Wi-Fi spot in the rest area. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 北の関宿 安芸高田
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：中国道の高田ICに隣接した道の駅。高速道路の本線とは距離があるので、その騒音は気にならない。夜間は高田ICから出入りする車も少ないので、落ち着いた夜を過ごせる。ローソン併設で便利だが、夜間の来訪者はローソンが目当てで来るので、少し距離を置いた場所に駐車するのが良い。（投稿：2023年10月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A roadside station adjacent to the Takada Interchange on the Chugoku Expressway. It's a bit far from the main highway, so the noise isn't a problem. There are few cars coming and going from the Takada Interchange at night, so you can enjoy a peaceful evening. It's convenient because it has a Lawson convenience store, but nighttime visitors come specifically for the Lawson, so it's best to park a little further away. (Submitted by: y, October 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 中筋川ダムお遍路さん休憩所横駐車場
properties.title_en: Parking lot next to the pilgrim rest area at Nakasujigawa Dam
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：中筋川ダムのそばにあるトイレ付きの駐車場です。24Hトイレで洋式です。駐車場は全体に傾斜があります。県道からは外れているので夜は静かです。（投稿：2025年8月、キャンプおやじ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: This is a parking lot with a toilet located near the Nakasujigawa Dam. The toilet is Western-style and is open 24 hours. The parking lot is sloped overall. It is off the main road, so it is quiet at night. (Submitted by: Camp Oyaji, August 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：地図近くの歴史民俗資料館の駐車場にも止めれて、そこの屋外トイレが２４時間使えたと思うが最近行かないので不明。歴史好きには良いのでは？（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: You can also park in the parking lot of the nearby historical and folk museum, and I think the outdoor toilets there are open 24 hours, but I haven't been there recently so I'm not sure. It might be good for history buffs? (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：地場スーパー「ウェスタまるき下関形山店」駐車場にある水汲み場。詳細、詳細（投稿：2022年4月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Water source located in the parking lot of the local supermarket "Westa Maruki Shimonoseki Katayama Store". Details, details (Submitted by: n, April 2022)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：地場スーパー「ウェスタまるき下関一の宮店」駐車場にある水汲み場。詳細、詳細（投稿：2022年4月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A water source located in the parking lot of the local supermarket "Westa Maruki Shimonoseki Ichinomiya Store". Details, details (Submitted by: n, April 2022)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 清流の里ひじかわ
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：第一駐車場は国道に面していますが、建物側の区画に駐めれば夜間交通量も少なくそんなに走行音が気になりませんでした。建物の向こう側にある第二駐車場は静かですが、照明がなく暗いため防犯上不安でしたので、駐めませんでした。敷地内にあるヤマザキコンビニ併設の酒屋が朝７時には開店していたので、朝食の調達がここでできます。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■【RVパーク道の駅 清流の里ひじかわ】1泊1500円／1台(トレーラー含む)、電源込み　詳細
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: The first parking lot faces the national highway, but if you park in the section on the building side, there is little traffic at night and the noise from passing vehicles is not too bothersome. The second parking lot on the other side of the building is quiet, but it is dark and lacks lighting, so we did not park there as we were concerned about security. The liquor store attached to the Yamazaki convenience store on the premises opens at 7 am, so you can get breakfast there. (Older post from before 2019)
■【RV Park Michi-no-Eki Seiryu-no-Sato Hijikawa】1500 yen per night / per vehicle (including trailer), power included Details

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：第一駐車場50台・第二駐車場50台の無料駐車場。トレイは建物こそ古いが、水洗洋式の便器は新しめで清掃状態も良好。夜は無人状態となるので、閑静な一夜を過ごせる。トイレがあるのは第一駐車場だが、第二駐車場でも階段を使えばトイレへのアクセスは悪くない。（投稿：2023年10月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Free parking available in two parking lots, each with 50 spaces. Although the building itself is old, the toilets are relatively new and clean. The facility is unmanned at night, allowing for a peaceful overnight stay. While the toilets are located in the first parking lot, access to the toilets from the second parking lot is not difficult if you use the stairs. (Submitted by: y, October 2023)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：第1駐車場で車中泊（詳細場所）。道の駅駐車場のため無料です。綺麗なトイレも近くにあります。とにかく静かで快適でした。近くを高速が通っていますが音など全く気になりません。有名らしい霧の森大福(カフェは4:30ラストオーダー)を頂いてゆっくりするのもありです。入浴施設も近くにあるようですが、臨時休業でした。（投稿：2024年6月、w様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Overnight stay in the first parking lot (details of location). It's free as it's a roadside station parking lot. There are clean restrooms nearby. It was incredibly quiet and comfortable. The highway runs nearby, but the noise wasn't noticeable at all. It's also a good idea to relax and enjoy the famous Kirinomori Daifuku (last order at the cafe is 4:30). There seems to be a bathing facility nearby, but it was temporarily closed. (Submitted by: w, June 2024)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: セブンイレブン駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：大型車駐車場に車中泊できる。トラックが多く、騒音はあるが、広いので場所を探せば寝られる。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: You can sleep in your car in the large vehicle parking lot. There are many trucks and it is noisy, but it is spacious so you can find a place to sleep.

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 風早の郷・風和里
properties.title_en: Roadside Station Kazahaya no Sato Fuwari
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：族の集会所になってます。車中泊は不可能かと。（投稿：2025年8月、t様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ24時間使用可能。海が目の前。駐車場は2箇所に分かれていて、一つは道の駅のお店の目の前。もう一つは道路沿いに細長くありました。夜は暗く、店舗前の駐車場に気付かず、道路沿いに停車しました。道路が真横で、暴走族のバイクが走ると煩かったです。多分この道の駅で車中泊慣れしている人は、トイレから遠いけど駐車場の端の方に停めているようでした。そちらは灯りも少なく、静かそうでした。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: It's become a meeting place for biker gangs. Overnight stays in a car are probably impossible. (Submitted by: T, August 2025)
■Report from a reader of this site: Toilets are available 24 hours a day. The sea is right in front. The parking lot is divided into two sections; one is in front of the roadside station's shops. The other is a long, narrow section along the road. It was dark at night, and I didn't notice the parking lot in front of the shops, so I parked along the road. The road was right next to me, and it was noisy when biker gangs rode by. It seemed that people who are used to overnight stays in their cars at this roadside station park at the edge of the parking lot, even though it's far from the toilets. There were fewer lights there, and it seemed quieter. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：蔵本駅の駅前に水汲み場がある。駅前駐車場は30分100円。詳細、詳細（投稿：2024年1月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There is a water source in front of Kuramoto Station. Parking in front of the station costs 100 yen for 30 minutes. Details, details (Posted by: n, January 2024)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：壮大なお社を参拝させて頂きました。御砂も頂きました。ウサギが沢山います。添付画像、添付画像、添付画像、添付画像、添付画像（投稿：2022年11月、s様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: I had the pleasure of visiting a magnificent shrine. I also received some sacred sand. There are lots of rabbits. (Attached images, attached images, attached images, attached images, attached images) (Submitted by: s, November 2022)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: ぶっかけうどん ふるいち 仲店
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：倉敷名物「ぶっかけうどん」発祥の店。食べログ、詳細（投稿：2025年11月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: The restaurant that originated Kurashiki's famous "Bukkake Udon". Tabelog, details (Posted: November 2025, by n)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 ごいせ仁摩
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：石見銀山を見学するために前日乗りで道の駅　ごいせ仁摩で2023年4月30日に車中泊をしました。とても広い駐車場です。　臨時の駐車場も？（砂利エリア） 道路に近い駐車場に車を止めて車中泊をしました。夜間は無料の高速道路を使う車以外ほぼ通る車はありませんでしたので、静かに快適に過ごせました。（無料の高速道路が道の駅の前から乗れます。）キャンピングカーなどもけっこう車中泊をしていました。新しい道の駅なので、トイレも綺麗でした。（投稿：2023年6月、s様）
■2022年1月29日オープン。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: I stayed overnight in my car at the Goise Nima roadside station on April 30, 2023, the day before visiting the Iwami Ginzan Silver Mine. The parking lot is very spacious. There seems to be a temporary parking area as well (gravel area). I parked my car in a parking area close to the road and stayed overnight. There were almost no cars passing by at night except for those using the free expressway, so it was quiet and comfortable. (You can access the free expressway from in front of the roadside station.) Quite a few campervans were also staying overnight. Since it's a new roadside station, the toilets were clean. (Submitted by: s, June 2023)
■Opened January 29, 2022.

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：静かな港です。トイレは近くの施設に24時間開放（詳細不明）。居酒屋とイタリアン有。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: It's a quiet port. Toilets are available 24 hours a day at a nearby facility (details unknown). There is an izakaya (Japanese pub) and an Italian restaurant.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 岡山 津山 勝北総合スポーツ公園
properties.title_en: Okayama Tsuyama Katsuhoku General Sports Park
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：静かで広大な駐車場。トイレ有り（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Quiet and spacious parking lot. Restrooms available (older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 白島（白島崎）展望台の駐車場
properties.title_en: Parking lot at Shirashima (Shirashima Cape) Observation Deck
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：静か、無料、トイレ(きれい)（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Quiet, free, clean toilets (older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 菱浦港(モンニャモニャセンター)駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：静か、無料、トイレ(きれい)（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Quiet, free, clean toilets (older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：西条駅近く、西条酒蔵通りにあり、日本酒の仕込み水を汲める。近くにある他の酒蔵にも水汲み場あり。詳細、詳細（投稿：2024年6月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Located near Saijo Station on Saijo Sake Brewery Street, you can draw water used for brewing sake. There are also water-drawing points at other nearby sake breweries. Details, details (Posted by: n, June 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 石見銀山駐車場（五百羅漢のところ）
properties.title_en: Iwami Ginzan Silver Mine parking lot (near the Five Hundred Arhats)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：世界遺産、石見銀山の駐車場。無料、閉鎖無し。トイレあり。車中泊できそうだけど、確実に職務質問されそう。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Parking lot at the Iwami Ginzan Silver Mine, a World Heritage Site. Free, never closed. Toilets available. Looks like you could stay overnight in your car, but you'd definitely get stopped and questioned by the police. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：世界の名画を陶板で原寸大再現。3300円　9:30～17:00　月曜休。詳細（投稿：2024年1月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: World-famous paintings reproduced in their original size on ceramic panels. 3300 yen, 9:30 AM - 5:00 PM, closed Mondays. Details (Posted by: n, January 2024)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: 水島中央公園(車中泊不可)
properties.title_en: Mizushima Central Park (Overnight parking not permitted)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：水島地区の真ん中にある公園。緑豊かな場所ですが、夜間閉鎖のため車中泊はできません。（投稿：2020年11月、C様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A park located in the heart of the Mizushima area. It's a lush green space, but it's closed at night, so overnight parking is not possible. (Submitted by: C, November 2020)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 大社ご縁広場
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：水洗トイレ、街灯、自販機あり。道の駅は夕方で閉まりますがトイレは使えます。道の向かいにローソン、はす向かいにセブンあり。出雲大社へ歩いて参拝出来ます。平日なので空いていました。ローソンに近い位置に停めるとFreeWIFIがぎりぎり入ります(買い物してから使いました)。2025年4月利用（投稿：2025年4月、totomo様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ有、外灯有、飲料自販機有。コンビニ有(隣接地)。出雲大社の観光で深夜から早朝にかけて利用しました。騒音低で安眠出来ました。出雲大社参拝後に出雲そばを頂きました。お土産もこちらで購入しました。添付画像（投稿：2022年10月、s様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ新・旧2か所あり。道路を挟んでローソンあり。出雲大社まで歩いても行ける距離にあります。２００台程度止めれる広い駐車場ですが、週末や観光シーズン等はよく満車になるようです。資料館・観光情報コーナーあり、物産所はありません。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Flush toilets, streetlights, and vending machines are available. The roadside station closes in the evening, but the toilets are still usable. There is a Lawson across the road and a 7-Eleven diagonally across. You can walk to Izumo Taisha Shrine. It was quiet because it was a weekday. If you park close to Lawson, you can just barely get free Wi-Fi (I used it after shopping). Used in April 2025 (Posted by totomo, April 2025)

■Report from a reader of this site: Toilets available, streetlights available, beverage vending machines available. Convenience store available (adjacent). Used from late night to early morning while sightseeing at Izumo Taisha Shrine. It was quiet and I was able to sleep well. I had Izumo soba after visiting Izumo Taisha Shrine. I also bought souvenirs here. Attached image (Posted by s, October 2022)

■Report from a reader of this site: There are two toilets, old and new. There is a Lawson across the road. It is within walking distance of Izumo Taisha Shrine. It's a large parking lot that can accommodate about 200 cars, but it seems to get full often on weekends and during tourist season. There is a museum and tourist information corner, but no souvenir shop. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: 尾道ラーメン 東珍康
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：人気店のようで夕方には列が。尾道ラーメンおいしかったです。駐車場は隣のパーキングで。駐車券くれるので無料に。（投稿：2022年5月、h様）
■食べログ
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: It seems to be a popular restaurant, as there was a line in the evening. The Onomichi ramen was delicious. Parking is available in the adjacent parking lot. They give you a parking ticket, so it's free. (Posted by: h, May 2022)
■Tabelog

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：新築のトイレあります。大変きれいです、24時間使用可。車中泊の予定でしたが、風が強く断念して移動しました。（投稿：2024年4月、h様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: There is a newly built toilet. It is very clean and available 24 hours a day. I had planned to stay overnight in my car, but the wind was too strong so I gave up and moved on. (Submitted by: h, April 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：浄化センターと小公園に隣接した24時間利用可能な駐車場とトイレ。大山に上る朝日がきれい。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A 24-hour parking lot and restrooms adjacent to a wastewater treatment plant and a small park. The sunrise over Mt. Oyama is beautiful. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：上下線両方共、トイレと自動販売機のみ。大型車との駐車区画は離れていません。ただ利用者は多くないので、そこまで気にならないのかも?（投稿：2020年11月、C様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Both the inbound and outbound lanes only have toilets and vending machines. The parking spaces for large vehicles are not far apart. However, there aren't many users, so maybe it's not that much of a concern? (Submitted by: C, November 2020)

properties.label: Highway Rest + Shower
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：上下線にコインシャワー（24時間営業、300円/10分）、コインランドリー、24hコンビニあり。詳細（投稿：2024年9月、n様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：中国道・安佐SA（下り）大きなSAで大賑わい。平日深夜過ぎでもほぼ満車でした。大型車が何台か普通車エリアに侵入していて、もし間に挟まれるとちょっとうるさいかもです。GSはENEOS WING。EV用急速充電器あり。（2019年4月利用）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: Coin showers (24-hour operation, 300 yen/10 minutes), coin laundry, and 24-hour convenience store available on both the inbound and outbound sides. Details (Submitted: September 2024, by n)
■Report from our website reader: Chugoku Expressway, Asa SA (inbound) A large service area that was bustling with activity. It was almost full even late at night on a weekday. Several large vehicles had entered the regular car area, so it might be a bit noisy if you're stuck between them. The gas station is ENEOS WING. There is a fast charger for EVs. (Used in April 2019)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：上り側について。車の出入りが多く、駐車場はやや傾斜がある。少し落ち着かない。（投稿：2022年5月、h様）
■広大、本線から距離あり、奥の方は比較的静かでなかなかよい、やはり中国道より山陽道の方がPAが良いですね。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Regarding the northbound side. There is a lot of traffic, and the parking lot is slightly sloped. It's a little unsettling. (Submitted by h, May 2022)
■Vast, far from the main road, relatively quiet in the back, quite nice. The rest areas on the Sanyo Expressway are definitely better than those on the Chugoku Expressway. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: （トイレ無し）みそのお遺跡公園
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：小さな駐車スペース(6台分？)があります。トイレはなく、少し汚いですが屋根付きのベンチがあります。隣の土地にトラックがあるので、時間帯によってはうるさいかも。山中の工業団地にあり、幹線からは離れていますが、トラック等の走行があるので注意してください。（投稿：2020年9月、匿名希望様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There is a small parking space (for 6 cars?). There is no toilet, but there is a covered bench, although it is a bit dirty. There are trucks on the neighboring property, so it may be noisy at certain times of the day. It is located in an industrial park in the mountains, away from the main road, but please be careful as there are trucks and other vehicles passing by. (Submitted: September 2020, anonymous)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：春来軒は創業者が亡くなったあとにお家騒動の分裂騒動があったようで、地元民の間では弟子筋の「元祖 春来軒」が一番人気になってます。食べログ（投稿：2023年1月、加藤の乱様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：山口県独特の麺料理「バリそば」発祥の店。（投稿：2022年5月、n様）
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: After the founder's death, Shunraiken apparently experienced a family dispute and split, and among locals, the "Original Shunraiken" run by a disciple is the most popular. (Tabelog, posted January 2023, by Kato no Ran)

■ Reader Report: The restaurant that originated "Bari Soba," a unique noodle dish from Yamaguchi Prefecture. (Posted May 2022, by n)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: ラフォーレつるぎ山への分岐路の路肩
properties.title_en: Shoulder of the road at the fork leading to Laforet Tsurugiyama
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：臭くて汚い公衆トイレあり。道沿いに数台置けそう。一応車中泊できそう。夜に剣山に来る車も結構多いのでうるさいですが（国道438は道が狭くて走りにくいので、夜に来る車が多い）。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There is a smelly and dirty public toilet. There seems to be space to park a few cars along the road. It seems possible to stay overnight in a car. There are quite a few cars coming to Mt. Tsurugi at night, so it is noisy (National Route 438 is narrow and difficult to drive on, so many cars come at night). (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：秋吉台の地下に広がる日本屈指の大鍾乳洞。入場料1300円、駐車場500円。詳細（投稿：2022年5月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: One of Japan's largest limestone caves, located beneath Akiyoshidai. Admission fee: 1300 yen, parking fee: 500 yen. Details (Submitted by: n, May 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：周辺の道路からは「まんさく運動公園」の表示が目印。無料で24時間出入り可能。駐車場から50mほどで24時間利用可能なトイレ・自販機あります。無名で車中泊利用はかなり少ないです。新見観光の際に便利。夜間照明切れますので深夜のトイレ利用には懐中電灯をご用意ください。（投稿：2021年10月、ユユルン様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Look for the "Mansaku Sports Park" sign on the surrounding roads. Free 24-hour access. There are 24-hour toilets and vending machines about 50m from the parking lot. It's relatively unknown and very few people use it for overnight parking. Convenient for sightseeing in Niimi. The lights are turned off at night, so bring a flashlight if you need to use the toilet late at night. (Submitted by Yuyurun, October 2021)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 日吉夢産地
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：周りの塀を壊してしまい、幹線道路沿いの為、音が気になり車中泊断念しました。（投稿：2025年8月、t様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2024/3 /21、車中泊しました。建物で囲まれた駐車場です、トイレ24時間利用可。（投稿：2024年4月、h様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：道の駅・日吉夢産地　に　2021年11月19日に車中泊した時の情報をお知らせします。道の駅の一角に「コインランドリー」があります。トイレはウォシュレットで、非常にきれいに掃除されていました。この辺りは、夜間は交通量もほとんどなく、快適に車中泊できました。（投稿：2022年1月、m様）
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: The surrounding wall was damaged, and because it's along a main road, the noise was a concern, so I gave up on staying overnight in my car. (Submitted: August 2025, by T)
■ Reader Report: I stayed overnight in my car on March 21, 2024. It's a parking lot surrounded by buildings, and the toilets are available 24 hours a day. (Submitted: April 2024, by H)
■ Reader Report: Here's information about my overnight stay at Michi-no-Eki Hiyoshi Yumesanchi on November 19, 2021. There's a coin laundry in one corner of the roadside station. The toilets have bidet functions and were very clean. There's hardly any traffic at night in this area, so I was able to comfortably stay overnight in my car. (Submitted: January 2022, by M)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 高梁市民プール駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：主要道路の対岸にある駐車場で比較的静か。高梁市観光の際に最適。出入口すぐの駐車場を100mほど奥に進んで、グランド手前を右に曲がるとさらに8台ほど止めれるマスがあります。その先に少し歩いて進むと24時間利用可能なトイレ・自販機があります。周辺クルマ通り少なく非常に静かです。遅い時間は街灯切れますので深夜のトイレ利用は懐中電灯があると安心です。（投稿：2021年10月、ユユルン様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: This parking lot is relatively quiet as it's located across from the main road. It's ideal for sightseeing in Takahashi City. If you go about 100m further into the parking lot right by the entrance, and turn right just before the sports field, there are about 8 more parking spaces. If you walk a little further from there, you'll find a 24-hour restroom and vending machines. There is little traffic in the surrounding area, so it is very quiet. The streetlights turn off late at night, so it's a good idea to bring a flashlight if you're using the restroom late at night. (Submitted by Yuyurun in October 2021)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：車中泊出来そうです。民家からは遠いですが、隣が工場なので、平日昼間はうるさそうです。夕方は、犬を散歩させる人が駐車して多少の出入りがありますが、夜中は非常に静かでしょう。利用料金︰無料。看板等も無く、夜間閉鎖されないようです。水洗和式トイレ、多目的トイレは水洗洋式トイレ(ウォシュレット無し)、キレイ。（投稿：2023年12月、naka0514k様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: It looks like it's possible to stay overnight in a car. It's far from houses, but there's a factory next door, so it's probably noisy during the day on weekdays. In the evenings, people park there to walk their dogs, so there's some coming and going, but it should be very quiet at night. Usage fee: Free. There are no signs, and it doesn't seem to be closed at night. There is a flushable Japanese-style toilet, and a flushable Western-style toilet (no bidet), and it's clean. (Posted by naka0514k in December 2023)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 あわくらんど
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：車中泊禁止のポスターがトイレ前に貼ってました。（投稿：2020年10月、風来坊様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A poster prohibiting overnight parking was posted in front of the toilet. (Submitted by: Furai-bo, October 2020)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：車中泊できます。夜中でも車の出入りはありました。駐車場が少し斜面になってます。24時間トイレはあるが紙は設置されていません。（投稿：2024年3月、神社参拝のえーご様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: You can stay overnight in your car. There was car traffic even at night. The parking lot is slightly sloped. There is a 24-hour toilet, but no toilet paper is provided. (Submitted by: Eigo, who visited the shrine in March 2024)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: やまみ三原運動公園 北側駐車場
properties.title_en: Yamami Mihara Sports Park North Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：車中泊しようとしたところ、警察を呼ばれて大騒ぎになりました。ここでの車中泊はだめです。（投稿：2023年12月、マッスル竹田様）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。駐車場は21時〜翌朝8時まで閉鎖され、出入りできなくなるが、車中泊は可能。管理員になんか言われたら、酒を飲んでしまったとか言えばいい。閉鎖されるので逆にめちゃめちゃ静かで最高。wimaxも電波OK。非常に良い。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: I tried to sleep in my car, but the police were called and it became a big commotion. Sleeping in your car here is not allowed. (Submitted by: Muscle Takeda, December 2023)
■Free parking and public toilets. The parking lot is closed from 9 PM to 8 AM the next morning, and you cannot enter or exit, but sleeping in your car is possible. If the attendant says something to you, just say you've been drinking. Because it's closed, it's incredibly quiet, which is great. WiMAX signal is also OK. Very good.

properties.label: Camp Spot + Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 風の国グランドゴルフ駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：施設内の駐車場ですが、風の国のレストランや温泉♨️（900円、詳細）を利用し、フロントに車中泊をお願いすると許可がおりました。外にトイレの建物もあり、快適に車中泊出来ました。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Regarding the parking lot within the facility, I used the restaurant and hot springs (900 yen, details) at Kaze no Kuni and asked the front desk for permission to park my car overnight, which was granted. There is also a toilet building outside, so I was able to park my car comfortably overnight. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：山陽道・福山SA（下り）について。2023年5月の土曜に利用。SAの建物の端だけでなく駐車場の奥（大型車枠の近く）にもトイレがあって、小型車エリアの2列目・3列目からも便利です。この日は車中泊車両は少なめで、静かに休めました。朝定食の豚汁の具が多く、サバも肉厚、白飯も美味くてとてもGoodでした。前述のトイレの隣にEV Quickがあります。（投稿：2023年5月、n様）
■普通に快適。トラックと分離で良い（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Regarding Fukuyama SA (downbound) on the Sanyo Expressway. Used on a Saturday in May 2023. There are toilets not only at the end of the SA building but also at the back of the parking lot (near the large vehicle area), making it convenient for those in the second and third rows of the small vehicle area. There were few vehicles parked overnight that day, so I was able to rest quietly. The pork miso soup in the breakfast set had plenty of ingredients, the mackerel was thick and meaty, and the white rice was delicious – very good. There is an EV Quick next to the aforementioned toilets. (Posted by: n, May 2023)

■Simply comfortable. Good separation from trucks (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：山陽自動車道奥屋PAにある水汲み場。上下線両方にある。詳細、詳細（投稿：2024年2月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Water source at Okuya PA on the Sanyo Expressway. Available on both the northbound and southbound lanes. Details, details (Submitted by: n, February 2024)

properties.label: Highway Rest + Shower
properties.title_ja: 佐波川SA（上り側にシャワー）
properties.title_en: Sabagawa Service Area (showers available on the northbound side)
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：山陽自動車道・佐波川SA（上り）2019年4月利用。コインシャワーは24H利用できます。フードコートは20時までですが、吉野家が夜半過ぎまで営業。コンビニもあり。EV用急速充電器あり。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■上り線側にはシャワー🚿（24時間営業、300円/10分）、コインランドリーあり、下り側からも階段でアクセス可能
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: Sanyo Expressway, Sabagawa SA (outbound), used in April 2019. Coin showers are available 24 hours. The food court closes at 8 PM, but Yoshinoya is open until after midnight. There is also a convenience store. There is an EV fast charger. (Older post from before 2019)

■On the outbound side, there are showers 🚿 (open 24 hours, 300 yen/10 minutes), a coin laundry, and it is also accessible from the outbound side via stairs.

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.title_ja: ホルンフュルス断層、須佐ホルンフェルス
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：山口県萩市須佐から日本海に突き出た島状の所を海沿いに進む。食堂、駐車場あり。他所では見られない綺麗な地層、近くまで行けるが波の高い時は危険。（投稿：2021年3月、渡り鳥漫遊記様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: From Susa in Hagi City, Yamaguchi Prefecture, head along the coast to an island-like area jutting out into the Sea of ​​Japan. There is a restaurant and parking available. Beautiful geological formations that cannot be seen anywhere else. You can get close, but it is dangerous when the waves are high. (Submitted by: Migratory Bird Travelogue, March 2021)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：山口県道36号に青い「水」の看板あり。集落の中にある水汲み場、駐車場あり。詳細（投稿：2022年5月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There is a blue "Water" sign on Yamaguchi Prefectural Road 36. There is a water source and parking lot in the village. Details (Submitted by: n, May 2022)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：山口県道36号から細い道（途中に山口県道280号の看板あり）を進む。目印が無いのでグーグルマップを参照すると良い。駐車場あり。詳細（投稿：2022年5月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Take a narrow road from Yamaguchi Prefectural Road 36 (there is a sign for Yamaguchi Prefectural Road 280 along the way). There are no landmarks, so it is best to refer to Google Maps. Parking is available. Details (Posted by: n, May 2022)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.title_ja: 湯谷温泉 温泉水汲場
properties.title_en: Yutani Onsen Hot Spring Water Drawing Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：山口県道33号から細い道を少し進んだ先。細部はマップ参照。詳細（投稿：2022年5月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A short distance down a narrow road off Yamaguchi Prefectural Road 33. See map for details. Details (Submitted by: n, May 2022)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：山口県道27号沿い。ホースから水が出ている。ここから東側の道は非常に細いので注意。詳細（投稿：2023年2月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Along Yamaguchi Prefectural Road 27. Water is coming out of a hose. The road to the east from here is very narrow, so be careful. Details (Submitted by: n, February 2023)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.title_ja: 僧都地蔵の水（霊鷲山の湧水）
properties.title_en: The water of the Monk Jizo (spring water from Mt. Vulture Peak)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：山口県道246号から平家塚・霊鷲山への道にある（細部は地図参照）。詳細（投稿：2022年10月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Located on the road from Yamaguchi Prefectural Road 246 to Heikezuka and Ryōjūzan (see map for details). Details (Submitted by: M, October 2022)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：山口県警本部の前から細い道を通った先。駐車場から80m歩く。水質検査済。詳細、詳細（投稿：2023年2月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Located down a narrow road in front of the Yamaguchi Prefectural Police Headquarters. 80m walk from the parking lot. Water quality tested. Details, details (Submitted by: n, February 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：山の中の無料駐車スペースと汚い公衆トイレ。トイレは当然ながら汚いポットントイレ。人気皆無で超静かな穴場だが、悪意のある人間に襲撃されたら終了。自○と間違われて通報される可能性あり。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A free parking space in the mountains and a dirty public toilet. The toilet is, of course, a dirty pit toilet. It's a hidden gem with no people around and super quiet, but it's all over if you get attacked by someone with malicious intent. There's a possibility of being mistaken for a suicide victim and reported. (Old post from before 2019)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: 奥吉備街道駐車場(仮称)※トイレ無し
properties.title_en: Okukibi Road Parking Lot (tentative name) *No restrooms
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：山の中の広域農道で、周りは山。民家はなく、明かりもありません。道のすぐそばにありますが、交通量はほとんどありません。むしろ鹿など、野生の動物のほうが心配かも。※トイレ無し。（投稿：2020年10月、C様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: It's a wide agricultural road in the mountains, surrounded by mountains. There are no houses and no lights. It's right next to the road, but there's hardly any traffic. In fact, wild animals like deer might be more of a concern. *No toilets. (Submitted by C in October 2020)

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：昨年暮れ忘年会に車で行った際車中泊しました。24時間毎に600円でした。近くに24時間使える公衆トイレ、洋式水洗があります。30台は停められる駐車場ですが駐車は３台で朝まで静かでした。住宅に隣接しているため、アイドリングや音出しはNGです。隣に葬儀社があるので、葬儀があればそれなりに人の出入りがありそうです。近くの道の駅は、車の出入りが多くて落ち着かないです。街に飲みに行くならここがベストだと思います。（投稿：2024年1月、キャンプおやじ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: I stayed overnight in my car when I drove there for a year-end party last year. It cost 600 yen for every 24 hours. There is a 24-hour public toilet with a Western-style flush toilet nearby. The parking lot can accommodate 30 cars, but there were only 3 cars parked there, so it was quiet until morning. Since it is adjacent to a residential area, idling and making noise are not allowed. There is a funeral home next door, so there will likely be a fair amount of people coming and going if there is a funeral. The nearby roadside station is noisy with a lot of cars coming and going. If you are going out for drinks in town, I think this is the best place. (Submitted by: Camp Oyaji, January 2024)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: おかもと仕出し店(グルメ)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：今では懐かしい、自動販売機でのうどんが食べられます。日中であれば店内で食べることができ、だしを濃くすることもできます。食べログ（投稿：2020年11月、C様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: You can eat udon noodles from a vending machine, a nostalgic item these days. During the daytime, you can eat inside the shop and even request a stronger broth. (Review by C, posted on Tabelog in November 2020)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：国道沿いに駐車場有。ダムを渡った側には駐車場なし。駐車場の横には小さな公園有。トイレはありません。国道沿いですが、交通量は少なめ。お店・コンビニから結構離れています。（投稿：2020年12月）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: There is a parking lot along the national highway. There is no parking lot on the other side of the dam. There is a small park next to the parking lot. There are no toilets. It is along the national highway, but the traffic volume is relatively low. It is quite far from shops and convenience stores. (Posted: December 2020)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：国道を挟んで、岡山・津山方面、両方向に駐車場・トイレがあります。国道のすぐそばに駐車場がありますが、交通量はそれほどありません。ただ、大型トラックの利用がそれなりにあります。コンビニ等は近くにないので、事前の準備が必要です。また朝7時、17時(？)には、スピーカーから大きな音楽が流れてきます。（投稿：2020年9月、匿名希望様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There are parking lots and restrooms on both sides of the national highway, towards Okayama and Tsuyama. The parking lot is right next to the national highway, but the traffic volume is not that high. However, there are a fair number of large trucks using it. There are no convenience stores nearby, so you need to prepare in advance. Also, loud music is played from speakers at 7am and 5pm (?). (Submitted: September 2020, anonymous)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：国道の側にありますが、交通量は少なめ。駐車区画は若干狭い(県北基準・通常であれば十分な広さ)です。高速道路のインターチェンジから離れているので、大型車もそれほどいませんでした。すぐ近くにはコンビニがありません。また車の出入り口は1か所のみです。（投稿：2020年11月、C様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: It's located next to a national highway, but traffic is relatively light. The parking spaces are a bit narrow (by northern prefecture standards; normally, they're spacious enough). Since it's far from the highway interchange, there weren't many large vehicles. There are no convenience stores nearby. Also, there is only one entrance/exit for cars. (Submitted by: C, November 2020)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: 御津宇垣駐車場（トイレなし）
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：国道と川に挟まれた駐車スペース。分離帯なし。国道は直線部分とはいえ、横幅が狭いので、追突される可能性もあります。それでも時々大型車が夜間停車することがあります。トイレなし。（投稿：2020年11月、C様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A parking space sandwiched between a national highway and a river. There is no median strip. Although the national highway is a straight section, it is narrow, so there is a possibility of being rear-ended. Nevertheless, large vehicles sometimes park there at night. There are no toilets. (Submitted by: C, November 2020)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：国道すぐ脇でカーブ外側に位置するため、夜中に通行するトラックなどのハイビームにモロに照らされるので明かりや音に敏感な人は避けた方が良い。wifiは24時間開設の観光案内所内では可能だが、駐車場までは届かない（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Located on the outside of a curve right next to the national highway, it is directly illuminated by the high beams of trucks passing by at night, so people sensitive to light and noise should avoid it. Wi-Fi is available inside the 24-hour tourist information center, but it does not reach the parking lot (older post from before 2019).

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 川柳公園(車中泊不適)※トイレあり
properties.title_en: Senryu Park (Not suitable for overnight parking) *Restrooms available
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：国道53号、久米南町役場付近の信号から1km以上入ったところにある公園です。狭い道を登っていき、袋小路のところにあります。景色は良いですが、近くに民家もあり、駐車場が分かりにくいです。また、駐車場にはゴミステーションが設置されており、回収日にはゴミ収集車も来ます。車中泊の場所としては、不適です。※公衆トイレありソース（投稿：2020年10月、C様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: This park is located more than 1km from the traffic light near the Kumenan Town Hall on National Route 53. You have to go up a narrow road and it's at a dead end. The view is nice, but there are houses nearby and the parking lot is hard to find. Also, there is a garbage collection point in the parking lot, and garbage trucks come on collection days. It is not suitable as a place to stay overnight in your car. *There is a public toilet. Source (Posted by C in October 2020)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：国道489号から急坂を上った先にある。駐車スペースあり。詳細（投稿：2023年9月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Located at the top of a steep slope off National Route 489. Parking available. Details (Submitted by: n, September 2023)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.title_ja: 観音菩薩座像 水汲み場
properties.title_en: Seated statue of Kannon Bodhisattva, water drawing area""
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：国道316号から集落に下りた所、細部はマップ参照。駐車場あり。詳細（投稿：2022年5月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Located at the bottom of the village off National Route 316. See map for details. Parking available. Details (Submitted by: n, May 2022)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：国道180号から集落に入った所にある水汲み場。（投稿：2024年2月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A water source located at the entrance to the village from National Route 180. (Submitted by: n, February 2024)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：高梁SA（下り）。総社PAで仮眠後立ち寄りましたが、駐車場が本線から離れており、大型車駐車区画も分離されているので、小型車駐車区画の端であればかなり静かでした。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■本線から離れており大変良い！（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Takahashi SA (downbound). I stopped by after taking a nap at Soja PA. The parking lot is set back from the main road, and the parking areas for large vehicles are separated, so it was quite quiet if you parked at the edge of the small vehicle parking area. (Older post from before 2019)
■It's set back from the main road, which is great! (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：高地にあり涼しい（標高258m）。さらに上り側は本線から離れていて静か。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: It's cool because it's located at a high altitude (258m above sea level). Furthermore, the uphill side is quiet as it's away from the main line. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：高知道・南国SA（下り）2025年5月の週末に利用。静かで快適でした。早朝からシラスとかつおタタキをいただきました。EV Quickがちょっと中途半端な場所にあります。（投稿：2025年5月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Kochi Expressway, Nangoku SA (downbound) - Used on a weekend in May 2025. It was quiet and comfortable. I had whitebait and seared bonito early in the morning. The EV Quick is in a slightly inconvenient location. (Submitted by: n, May 2025)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 たたらば壱番地
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：高速道路の無料区間のPA的な道の駅。駐車場も広く、19：30まで営業しているので便利。道の駅の裏側にチェーン脱着場があり、大型車はそちらに多く駐車していた。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A roadside station similar to a rest area on a free section of the highway. It has a large parking lot and is open until 7:30 PM, making it convenient. There is a chain fitting area behind the roadside station, and many large vehicles were parked there. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: 院庄インター駐車場（トイレ利用可否不明）
properties.title_en: Innosho Interchange Parking Lot (Availability of restrooms unknown)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：高速バス利用者のための駐車場と思われますが、実際には待ち合わせの場所として利用されています。交通量も多いため、車中泊の場所にはなりませんが、付近のお店に立ち寄るために駐車したり、分乗してきた場合に、合流して乗り合わせるなどの使い道はあります。（投稿：2020年11月、C様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: This appears to be a parking lot intended for highway bus users, but in reality, it's used as a meeting place. Due to the heavy traffic, it's not suitable for overnight stays in vehicles, but it can be used for parking while stopping at nearby shops, or for people who have arrived in separate cars to meet up and carpool. (Submitted by: C, November 2020)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：香川県のB級グルメ「かしわバター丼」発祥の店。詳細、食べログ（投稿：2025年5月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: The restaurant that originated "Kashiwa Butter Donburi," a local specialty of Kagawa Prefecture. Details on Tabelog (Posted by n, May 2025)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：広島高速1号線下り線（広島市中心部方面）のみ設置。トイレ・自販機だけの施設。（投稿：2021年8月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Only available on the southbound lane of Hiroshima Expressway No. 1 (towards central Hiroshima city). The facility consists only of toilets and vending machines. (Submitted by: n, August 2021)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：広島つけ麺（広島冷麺）発祥の店。食べログ（投稿：2025年7月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: The restaurant that originated Hiroshima Tsukemen (Hiroshima Reimen). Tabelog (Posted by n, July 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 音戸の瀬戸公園内・無料駐車場、音戸大橋料金所跡
properties.title_en: Free parking lot within Ondo-no-Seto Park, site of the Ondo Bridge tollbooth.""
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：広めの公衆便所（車椅子用の広い個室もあり）、自動販売機、日中は喫茶店？もあり駐車場は道路わきという一般道にあるPAといった趣き。ココ以外にも山のほうにも駐車場が数箇所あるけど夜間の利用の可否は不明。この駐車場には釣りに行く人の時間調整の仮眠なども多い。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：無料駐車場とトイレがあるが、夜間でも周辺の車の交通があるので多少煩いが、治安はいい。5月にはツツジの名所になる。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: It has a spacious public restroom (including a large stall for wheelchairs), vending machines, and a coffee shop during the day. The parking lot is right by the road, giving it the feel of a public rest area on a regular road. There are several other parking lots further up the mountain, but it's unclear whether they are open at night. Many people use this parking lot to take a nap while waiting for their fishing trip. (Older post from before 2019)

■Report from a reader of this site: There is free parking and a toilet. It's a bit noisy at night due to the surrounding car traffic, but the area is safe. It becomes a famous spot for azaleas in May. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: （トイレの有無不明）夢みなとタワー前駐車場
properties.title_en: (Availability of restrooms unknown) Yumeminato Tower Front Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：広くて快適。ゆっくり寝れます。風には注意。※トイレは仮設トイレがあるみたいですが、詳細不明。夢みなと公園まで行けばトイレはあるが、ここからは遠いっぽい。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Spacious and comfortable. You can sleep well. Be careful of the wind. *There seems to be a temporary toilet, but details are unknown. There is a toilet if you go to Yumeminato Park, but it seems far from here.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_en: Riverbed west of Monobe River Bridge
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：広い河川敷の車中泊スポットです。24H利用可能なトイレ(清潔感はまあまあかな)は土手の上にあります。昼間はバーベキュー利用や休憩利用で使われています。キャンプをしている人も見ました。河川敷ですが川遊びには向いていません（投稿：2025年8月、キャンプおやじ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: This is a great spot for overnight stays in your car on a wide riverbank. There's a 24-hour toilet (it's fairly clean) on top of the embankment. During the day, it's used for barbecues and taking breaks. I also saw some people camping. It's a riverbank, but it's not suitable for swimming in the river. (Submitted by: Camp Oyaji, August 2025)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: 水島緑地福田公園(車中泊不可)
properties.title_en: Mizushima Green Space Fukuda Park (Overnight parking not permitted)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：工業地帯の近くにある、整備された運動公園です。無料駐車場もありますが、夜の利用はできないため、車中泊不可です。（投稿：2020年11月、C様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: This is a well-maintained sports park located near an industrial area. There is free parking available, but it is not open at night, so overnight parking is not permitted. (Submitted by: C, November 2020)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_en: Parking lot in front of Iiyama Chaya
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：公衆トイレを併設しています。広い駐車場なので、夜間の交通量が少ないこともあり、道路から離れたところに駐めれば静かです。買物は東城のコンビニ・スーパーで、入浴は東城温泉でどうぞ。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There are public restrooms on-site. The parking lot is large, and since there's little traffic at night, it's quiet if you park away from the road. For shopping, please use the convenience stores and supermarkets in Tojo, and for bathing, please visit Tojo Onsen. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 鏡野町西屋 無料駐車場
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：公衆トイレは川沿いのためか虫が多かったですが問題なく使えました。（投稿：2025年6月、おしょー様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：公衆トイレあり（投稿：2020年9月、92様）
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: The public toilet had a lot of insects, probably because it was by the river, but it was usable without any problems. (Submitted by: Osho, June 2025)
■ Reader Report: Public toilet available (Submitted by: 92, September 2020)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_en: P next to the Hiwa specialty market
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：公衆トイレがありすごく静かな場所です。 風呂は近くにある比和温泉がおすすめです。（投稿：2021年12月、t様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: There are public restrooms and it's a very quiet place. For bathing, I recommend the nearby Hiwa Onsen. (Submitted by: T, December 2021)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：公衆トイレあり（投稿：2020年9月、92様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Public restrooms available (Submitted by: 92, September 2020)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：公園の無料駐車場、24Hトイレあり(洋式ウォシュレットなし)、飲み屋街まで徒歩圏内で静かです、民家が近いので騒音はNGな感じです、朝夕公園を散歩する地元の人がまあまあいます、駐車場は場所により多少の傾斜あります（投稿：2025年8月、キャンプおやじ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: The park has free parking, 24-hour toilets (Western-style, no bidet), is quiet and within walking distance of the bar district, noise is a problem as it's close to private homes, there are a fair number of locals taking walks in the park in the mornings and evenings, and the parking lot has a slight slope depending on the location (Submitted by: Camp Oyaji, August 2025)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 かもがわ円城
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：交通量の少ない山の中にある道の駅のため、非常に静かです。駐車場も第二駐車場があるため広く感じます。なお信号のある交差点から入った場合、道の駅の先にも道が続きますが、こちらは非常に危険で険しい県道(いわゆる険道)です。途中の引き返しが出来ないので、うっかり入らないようにしましょう。（投稿：2020年11月、C様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: This roadside station is located in the mountains with little traffic, so it's very quiet. The parking lot feels spacious, as there is also a second parking lot. However, if you enter from the intersection with traffic lights, the road continues beyond the roadside station, but this is an extremely dangerous and treacherous prefectural road (a so-called "dangerous road"). You cannot turn back midway, so be careful not to enter by mistake. (Submitted by: C, November 2020)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：呉冷麺の発祥の店。詳細、食べログ（投稿：2025年3月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: The restaurant where Kure Reimen (cold noodles) originated. Details on Tabelog (Posted by n, March 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 岡山県奥津湖の北側 箱の社公園のトイレ、奥津箱パーク公衆トイレ
properties.title_en: Toilets at Hakono-sha Park, north of Okutsu Lake, Okayama Prefecture; Okutsu Hako Park Public Toilets""
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：午後9時以降は電気が消えますがカギは無いので使えます。朝5時には中のセンサーライトは機能しました。平日はこの駐車場は静かで他の車も少ないので快適でした。トイレの下の河原の公園も無料で使えます。（川の音がゴーゴー言ってます）トレーラータイプでも入れる駐車場があります。（投稿：2025年12月、キャタロー様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：5/24では故障中なのか真っ暗な上テープで塞いでありました。Googleの口コミによると21時以降は消灯されるらしく車中泊には向かないと思われます。（投稿：2025年6月、おしょー様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：公衆トイレあり（投稿：2020年9月、92様）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: The lights go out after 9 PM, but there's no key, so you can still use it. The sensor light inside was working at 5 AM. On weekdays, this parking lot is quiet and there are few other cars, so it was comfortable. The park by the river below the toilet is also free to use. (You can hear the sound of the river roaring.) There is a parking area that can accommodate trailer-type vehicles. (Posted: December 2025, by Catarou)

■Report from our site's reader: On May 24th, it was completely dark and taped up, possibly due to a malfunction. According to Google reviews, the lights are apparently turned off after 9 PM, so it's probably not suitable for overnight stays in a vehicle. (Posted: June 2025, by Osho)

■Report from our site's reader: There is a public toilet. (Posted: September 2020, by 92)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: まちのえき「法勝寺まごころ市」
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：古いけど清潔に保たれたトイレがあります。幹線道路沿いですが夕方以降は交通量が少なく夜間は閑散としています。近くにコンビニや食事処もあります。また、「最近出来た「法勝寺温泉」（詳細）がありヌルヌルの湯で気持ちが良かったです。食事も出来ます。2月12日利用時の入浴料金は大人450円とリーズナブル。しかし、クルマで30分程度のところに「道の駅あらエッサ」があるなど、この場所を宿泊場所に選ぶ理由が無いかもしれません。（投稿：2024年2月、山びこ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There are old but clean toilets. It's located along a main road, but traffic is light after sunset and it's quiet at night. There are convenience stores and restaurants nearby. Also, there's the recently opened "Hoshoji Onsen" (details), where the slippery water felt great. You can also eat there. The bathing fee on February 12th was a reasonable 450 yen for adults. However, there's a "Roadside Station Araessa" about 30 minutes away by car, so there might not be much reason to choose this place as accommodation. (Submitted by: Yamabiko, February 2024)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：現在はPAに格下げされ自販機しか有りません。元SAのため駐車場は広大で高速道から離れて静かと言うより中国道は山陽道完成後交通量が激減しています。（投稿：2024年6月、山びこ様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：中国道・吉和SA（下り）2019年4月利用。名前は「SA」ながら、小さなPA並みの規模。GSは休業中。フードコートは20時閉店。大型車も普通車も利用者少なくてかなり寂しいが、その分とても静かです。ただ、中央の自販機コーナーで音楽が休みなく流れていて（音量は小さいが）、耳栓があったほうが良いかも。EV用急速充電器あり。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: Currently downgraded to a PA (parking area) and only has vending machines. Because it was formerly a SA (service area), the parking lot is vast, and it's quiet away from the highway. Rather than being quiet, traffic on the Chugoku Expressway has drastically decreased since the completion of the Sanyo Expressway. (Posted: June 2024, Yamabiko)

■Report from our site's reader: Chugoku Expressway, Yoshiwa SA (downbound), used in April 2019. Despite the name "SA," it's the size of a small PA. The gas station is closed. The food court closes at 8 PM. There are few users, both large and small vehicles, making it quite lonely, but it's very quiet. However, music plays continuously in the central vending machine area (though at a low volume), so earplugs might be a good idea. There is an EV fast charger. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：串に刺さっていない肉を鉄板で一気に焼き上げる今治焼き鳥の元祖（詳細）。食べログ（投稿：2025年5月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: The originator of Imabari yakitori, where meat is grilled quickly on a griddle without being skewered (details). Tabelog (Posted by: n, May 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：狭い山道の途中にある駐車場で、場所に不釣り合いなきれいなトイレ(車いす用もあり)があります。この付近にある「横野滝」を訪れる方に向けられた駐車場と思われます。駐車スペースは広いです。周りに何もなく、途中の道は危険(いわゆる「険道」)なので、車中泊のためだけに来るのはやめておいたほうが良いです。なおトイレは、冬季閉鎖される模様です。（投稿：2020年11月、C様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There is a parking lot located along a narrow mountain road that has a surprisingly clean toilet (including a wheelchair-accessible one). It seems to be a parking lot intended for visitors to "Yokono Falls" in the vicinity. The parking space is spacious. There is nothing around, and the road leading there is dangerous (a so-called "rough road"), so it is best to avoid coming here solely for overnight parking. Also, it appears that the toilet is closed during the winter. (Submitted by: C, November 2020)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：魚料理の定食屋。メガ盛りと店長の人格に要注意。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A fish restaurant serving set meals. Beware of the huge portions and the owner's personality. (Tabelog)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：宮本武蔵と佐々木小次郎が決闘したことで知られる無人島。下関港・門司港から船便（詳細）あり。詳細（投稿：2022年4月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Reader Report: An uninhabited island known as the site of the duel between Miyamoto Musashi and Sasaki Kojiro. Ferry service available from Shimonoseki Port and Moji Port (details). Details (Submitted by: n, April 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：久しぶりに来てみたら、駐車場にドリフト痕ができていた。また、展望台への階段に「小型車Pは午後6時に閉鎖します」との表示があった。どちらも前回2022年の利用時にはなかったもの。残念ながら、走り屋さんのたまり場になってしまったのかもしれない。大型車Pでの車中泊は可能だが、こちらにもドリフト痕がある。治安的な意味でオススメできないスポット。（投稿：2025年10月、y様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：瀬戸大橋の夜景で有名な展望台なので、夜中もそこそこ人が来る。投稿者が利用した夜は、23時頃まで車好きor夜遊び好きの若い男女がいた。（投稿：2022年10月、y様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：「非常に大きな駐車場があるが駐車場にはタイヤのスリップ痕が多数あり、夜はＤＱＮの巣窟かも」と表記されていましたが、数年前に舗装はすべて綺麗にされてDQNもほとんど現れません。24時間利用可能なトイレ、自動販売機があり瀬戸大橋と対岸の坂出の街並みを眺望できます。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: When I visited after a long time, there were drift marks in the parking lot. Also, there was a sign on the stairs to the observation deck that said, "The small car parking area closes at 6 PM." Neither of these were there when I last visited in 2022. Unfortunately, it may have become a hangout for street racers. Overnight parking is possible in the large car parking area, but there are drift marks there as well. It's not a recommended spot in terms of safety. (Submitted by: y, October 2025)

■Report from a reader of this site: This observation deck is famous for its night view of the Seto Ohashi Bridge, so quite a few people come even at night. On the night the poster visited, there were young men and women who liked cars or nightlife until around 11 PM. (Submitted by: y, October 2022)

■Report from a reader of this site: It was stated that "there is a very large parking lot, but there are many tire skid marks in the parking lot, and it may be a den of delinquents at night," but the pavement was completely cleaned up a few years ago, and delinquents hardly appear anymore. There are 24-hour restrooms and vending machines, and you can enjoy views of the Seto Ohashi Bridge and the town of Sakaide on the opposite shore. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 美馬リバーサイドパーク
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：吉野川の河川敷を利用した広大な多目的公園。敷地が広すぎて良く分からないが、普通車100台分はありそうな駐車スペース。本スポットへの唯一のアクセス路である、堤防道路から坂を下った先の右側にトイレがある。2023/3に新設されたもので、水洗洋式で清掃状態も良好。人気のない静かな場所でポツンと車中泊したい人には超絶オススメのスポット。（投稿：2023年11月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A vast multi-purpose park utilizing the riverbed of the Yoshino River. The grounds are so large that it's hard to tell exactly where it is, but there seems to be parking space for about 100 regular cars. There is a toilet on the right side at the bottom of the slope from the embankment road, which is the only access road to this spot. It was newly built in March 2023, is a flush toilet (Western style), and is in good condition. This is an extremely recommended spot for those who want to spend the night in their car in a quiet, secluded place. (Submitted by: y, November 2023)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：菊川町中心部から国道491号を北上すると、「大迫名水」の表示板が現れます。ここまでは、大型車も通れるほどの道幅で、バス停のあずま屋の前に駐車できます。昭和６３年、当地の個人宅で生活用水確保のためボーリングを始めたところ、地下約２０ｍのところから多量の地下水が噴出し始めました。水温は１５度で、たいへん美味しく、自家用に使うには充分すぎるほどの豊富な水量でした。現在の水汲み場は、平成１０年に源泉から１００ｍほど水を引き込んでつくられ、あずま屋も設置し、毎年１０月には「大迫名水まつり」を行うなど、県内有数の名水として知られ、遠方からも多くの汲み客が訪れています。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website's readers: If you head north on National Route 491 from the center of Kikugawa town, you will come across a sign for "Osako Meisui" (Osako Famous Water). The road is wide enough for large vehicles to pass through, and you can park in front of the bus stop gazebo. In 1988, when drilling began at a private residence in the area to secure water for daily use, a large amount of groundwater began to gush out from about 20 meters underground. The water temperature was 15 degrees Celsius, it was very tasty, and there was an abundant supply of water that was more than enough for personal use. The current water drawing area was created in 1998 by drawing water from about 100 meters from the source, and a gazebo was also installed. Known as one of the prefecture's leading famous water sources, the area is also known for the "Osako Meisui Festival" held every October, and many people come from far away to draw water.

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：帰路仮眠に立ち寄る。本線から近く狭いので、走行音がかなりうるさいです。大型車区画とも近いので、エンジンかけっぱなしのトラックが居ると最悪です。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: I stopped by for a nap on my way home. It's close to the main road and narrow, so the road noise is quite loud. It's also close to the large vehicle parking area, so it's the worst if there's a truck with its engine running. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：基本入浴500円、露天風呂・サウナ利用は追加料金、詳細　受付内に食堂あり。休憩室別料金。イオンモール広島祇園の敷地内。（投稿：2024年2月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Basic bathing fee 500 yen, additional charges for open-air bath and sauna use. Details: There is a cafeteria inside the reception area. Relaxation room is an additional charge. Located within the grounds of Aeon Mall Hiroshima Gion. (Submitted by: n, February 2024)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：岩国城・ロープウェイ・錦帯橋セットのお得なチケット有り。 ロープウェイは休日長蛇の列になるので8時過ぎにはロープウエイ駐車場に行き窓口で購入してから、岩国城→錦帯橋の順番に観光するのがベスト。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: There is a great value ticket set that includes Iwakuni Castle, the ropeway, and Kintaikyo Bridge. The ropeway gets very crowded on holidays, so it's best to go to the ropeway parking lot after 8am, purchase your ticket at the counter, and then visit Iwakuni Castle followed by Kintaikyo Bridge.

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: みち停「あさひ」（トイレあり(夜間の利用は不明)）
