properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：観光案内所のような場所で、日中は足湯もあります。夜間も駐車場には停められます。ただ隣には公民館・さらには小学校があるので、気をつけないと不審者と思われるかもしれません。トイレあり(夜間の利用は不明)。（投稿：2020年11月、C様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: It's like a tourist information center, and they have a footbath during the day. You can park in the parking lot at night too. However, there's a community center and even an elementary school next door, so you need to be careful not to be mistaken for a suspicious person. There are toilets (unknown if they are available at night). (Submitted by: C, November 2020)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：観光に立ち寄りお勧めです。道路沿いの休憩所、トイレあります夜間使用不明。（投稿：2024年4月、h様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Recommended as a stopover for sightseeing. There is a rest area and toilets along the road, but it is unclear whether they are available at night. (Submitted by: h, April 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 グリーンロード大和
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：幹線道路沿いにありますが三江線沿いなので車の通りは少ない(夕方の帰宅時間でも人通りが全くない)＆汽車の本数は少ないです。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Although it is located along a main road, it is on the Sanko Line, so there is little car traffic (no pedestrian traffic even during the evening rush hour) and the number of trains is infrequent. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 センザキッチン
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：幹線道路から離れていて、駐車場が広く建物の近くに停めてしまえば静かに寝れます。（投稿：2025年8月、t様）
■2018年4月20日グランドオープン！
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: It's away from the main road, and the parking lot is spacious, so you can park close to the building and sleep peacefully. (Submitted by: T, August 2025)
■Grand opening on April 20, 2018!

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：幹線道路から離れた静かな運動公園。野球場北側の広めの駐車場がトイレ併設。夜間閉鎖なし（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A quiet sports park away from the main road. There is a spacious parking lot north of the baseball field with restrooms. No nighttime closures (older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：釜玉が日本一うまい店、某観光地化したうどん店とは比べようもありません。日本一！
■超人気店。今は失われた讃岐うどんの原風景の一つ。食べログ
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: The best Kamatama udon in Japan. It's incomparable to a certain touristy udon shop. The best in Japan!

■An extremely popular restaurant. One of the original scenes of Sanuki udon that has now been lost. (Tabelog)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 防府天満宮 梅林駐車場
properties.title_en: Hofu Tenmangu Shrine Plum Grove Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：学問の神様、菅原道真公を御祭神とする防府天満宮の駐車場。静かな環境。24時間利用可能なトイレと駐車場あり、自販機と公衆電話あり。神前ですので、こちらを利用の際は天満宮に参詣を。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: The parking lot at Hofu Tenmangu Shrine, which enshrines Sugawara no Michizane, the god of learning. Quiet environment. There are 24-hour restrooms and parking, as well as vending machines and a public telephone. As it is in front of a shrine, please pay your respects at Tenmangu Shrine when using this parking lot. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: すし弁慶 道笑町店
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：回転寿司で地物の物が食べれるとの事で行ってみました。土曜日の夜ということもあり家族連れなどが多くやはりここは良い所なんだと席に着きました。女性の店員さんにサイドメニューをお願いするとすぐに出てきました。お寿司はいくつかレーンで回っている物も取りましたが直接おすすめを口頭で頼みました。地物の商品です。しかしこれが何分待っても出てこない。確認すると「もう少しなので」と言ってそれから数分してやっと出てきました。それからしばらくして最後に食べたいと再び口頭で注文したものがこれまた全く出てこない。確認すると今注文もらったかのような態度。そして結局出てくる事なくこちらはお店を出ました。店員さんは誰一人悪いと感じてないようです。お客全員に同じ態度ならまだしょうがないで終わったのですが、他の人が注文したのはどんどん手元に届いていました。今後二度と行く事はないしおすすめのお店で載せてほしくないというのが実際の所です。長くなって申し訳ありません。かなり期待して行ったもので残念感が半端なかったです。
■回転寿司。境港の地物の寿司を食べたいならココがおすすめ。安くはないが、手頃な値段で地物の寿司を食べられます。美味い。食べログ
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: I went to this conveyor belt sushi restaurant because I heard they serve local ingredients. It was Saturday night, so there were lots of families, and I sat down thinking it must be a good place. I asked a female waitress for a side dish, and it came out immediately. I took some sushi from the conveyor belt, but I also verbally ordered a recommended dish – a local item. However, it never arrived, even after several minutes. When I inquired, she said, "Just a little longer," and it finally arrived a few minutes later. Then, a little while later, I verbally ordered something else I wanted to eat last, but again, it never came. When I inquired, they acted as if I had just ordered it. In the end, it never arrived, and I left the restaurant. None of the staff seemed to feel any remorse. If they had treated all customers the same way, it might have been acceptable, but other people's orders were arriving one after another. I will never go there again, and I don't want it listed as a recommended restaurant. Sorry for the long post. I had high expectations, so I was extremely disappointed.

■Conveyor belt sushi. If you want to eat local sushi in Sakaiminato, this is the place to go. It's not cheap, but you can eat local sushi at a reasonable price. It's delicious. (Tabelog)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: （トイレ無し）三篠川の広くなってる場所
properties.title_en: (No toilets) Wider section of the Misasa River
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：夏場は近所の若人･家族連れの海水浴場(川水浴？)とかす場所(初めての場合暗くなってからは行かない方が良いと思われる。道が狭いので路肩へ落ちる危険があるため）トイレも無くお勧めはしないが一泊くらいは良いかも。近場にスーパー銭湯、飲食店･コンビニあり
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: In the summer, it's a place where young people and families from the neighborhood swim in the sea (or maybe the river?). (If it's your first time, it's probably best not to go after dark. The road is narrow and there's a risk of falling off the road.) There are no toilets, so I don't recommend it, but it might be okay for an overnight stay. There's a public bathhouse, restaurants, and convenience stores nearby.

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：夏でもエアコンなしで寝れるぐらいに涼しい+第2駐車場なら本当に静か、トイレも近いのでオススメです。※標高406m（投稿：2025年8月、t様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：GW四国周遊２泊目に利用しました。トイレ裏にある第二駐車場に入れれば、道路の走行音も気にならず静かに眠れます。ただし、朝六時に防災無線スピーカーからアマリリスの曲が大音量で流れるので、朝ゆっくり寝ていたい人には不向き。裏に小さな日本庭園があり、道向いの展望台から朝霧に包まれた高知県の山々が見渡せます。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: It's cool enough to sleep without air conditioning even in summer, and the second parking lot is really quiet. The toilets are also close, so I recommend it. *Elevation 406m (Posted: August 2025, by t)

■Report from a reader of this site: I used it for the second night of my Golden Week Shikoku tour. If you park in the second parking lot behind the toilets, you can sleep peacefully without being bothered by the noise of traffic. However, at 6am, the song "Amaryllis" is played at high volume from the disaster prevention radio speakers, so it's not suitable for people who want to sleep in late. There is a small Japanese garden behind the building, and you can see the mountains of Kochi Prefecture shrouded in morning mist from the observation deck across the road. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.title_ja: 大内ふれあい公園 河川敷
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：仮設トイレあり（投稿：2020年9月、92様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Temporary toilets available (Submitted by: 92, September 2020)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：下松牛骨ラーメン発祥の店。食べログ（投稿：2022年3月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: The restaurant that originated Kudamatsu beef bone ramen. (Reviewed on Tabelog in March 2022 by user n)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：下関市の神社で汲める御神水。詳細（投稿：2022年4月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Sacred water available at a shrine in Shimonoseki City. Details (Submitted by: n, April 2022)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：下関市にある寺院の中。駐車場あり。水量少ない。詳細（投稿：2022年10月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Inside a temple in Shimonoseki City. Parking available. Low water volume. Details (Submitted by: M, October 2022)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：下り側について。2023年11月の日曜日に利用。大きなSAではないが、普通車枠はたくさんあります。大型車枠は別ブロックになっているので騒音を気にせず休めました。大型枠の一角にEV Quickがあります。（投稿：2023年11月、n様）
■【下道用ウェルカムゲート 上り側のみ24時間OK】広くて良い 左奥がトラック来ないのでよい（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Reader Report: Regarding the Downbound Side. Used on a Sunday in November 2023. It's not a large service area, but there are plenty of spaces for regular cars. The spaces for large vehicles are in a separate block, so I was able to rest without worrying about noise. There is an EV Quick in one corner of the large vehicle space. (Posted by: n, November 2023)
■[Welcome Gate for Local Roads - Upbound Side Only, 24 Hours OK] Spacious and good. The far left is good because trucks don't come there. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Highway Rest + Shower
properties.title_ja: 小谷SA（下り側にシャワー）
properties.title_en: Kotani Service Area (showers on the southbound side)
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：下り側にコインシャワー🚿（24時間営業、300円/10分）とコインランドリーがあります、上りには無いので注意。上下線に併設されてる焼きたてパン屋さんのパンがおいしいのでお勧めです。トラックと離れていて快眠（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■下り側に下道用の無料Pあり！24時間利用可能！シャワーももちろん利用可能！（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: There are coin-operated showers 🚿 (24-hour operation, 300 yen/10 minutes) and a coin laundry on the southbound side, but not on the northbound side, so be aware. The freshly baked bread at the bakery located on both sides is delicious and highly recommended. You can sleep well as you are away from the trucks (older post from before 2019).

■ There is free parking for local road users on the southbound side! Available 24 hours a day! Showers are also available! (older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：岡山名物「デミカツ丼」発祥の店。食べログ、詳細（投稿：2025年11月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: The restaurant that originated Okayama's famous "Demi-glace Pork Cutlet Rice Bowl". Tabelog, details (Posted: November 2025, by n)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: 辛香トンネル前駐車場（トイレなし）
properties.title_en: Parking lot in front of the Karaku Tunnel (no restrooms)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：岡山方面→津山方面行きの進行方向にあり。分離帯有、公衆電話有。坂になっているが、駐車スペースは広め。大型車の利用も結構あります。交通量はそこそこあるので、騒音等の対策は必要です。トイレなし。（投稿：2020年11月、C様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Located in the direction of travel from Okayama to Tsuyama. There is a median strip and a public telephone. It is on a slope, but the parking space is quite large. It is also used by a fair number of large vehicles. There is a fair amount of traffic, so measures to reduce noise are necessary. There are no toilets. (Submitted by: C, November 2020)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：岡山市内から少し距離はあるが、お薦めの車中泊スポット。第１駐車場のみ有料で、第２、第３、第４駐車場は無料。第１、第２駐車場には、高さ制限あり。第３駐車場は、ターミナルに近いがほとんど満車状態。第４駐車場から歩く覚悟を。朝食は、朝６時１５分からレストランが営業。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Although it's a bit far from Okayama city, it's a recommended spot for overnight stays in your car. Only the first parking lot is paid; the second, third, and fourth parking lots are free. There are height restrictions in the first and second parking lots. The third parking lot is close to the terminal but is almost always full. Be prepared to walk from the fourth parking lot. Breakfast is served at the restaurant from 6:15 a.m.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：岡山県で星を見るのに有名な美星町にいくのに見つけた無料の車中泊スポットです。広い駐車場に自販機や、清潔で広い洋式トイレもあり、トイレは夜でも電気がずっと付いているので安心していけます。とても綺麗でオススメです。敷地内にお食事処もありお弁当も売っていてボリューミーで美味しかったです👍（投稿：2024年7月、u様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: This is a free overnight parking spot I found on my way to Bisei-cho in Okayama Prefecture, which is famous for stargazing. There is a large parking lot, vending machines, and a clean, spacious Western-style toilet. The toilet lights stay on even at night, so you can use it with peace of mind. It is very clean and highly recommended. There is also a restaurant on the premises that sells bento boxes, which are voluminous and delicious 👍 (Posted by: u, July 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 剣山 見ノ越第一駐車場、剣山リフト乗り場駐車場
properties.title_en: Mt. Tsurugi Minokoshi First Parking Lot, Mt. Tsurugi Lift Station Parking Lot""
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：以前の投稿のようにトイレが新しくなってシャワー・暖房便座でとても綺麗でした。ただし、男性用で大１，小３なのでシーズン中の休みは多くの方が利用し並ぶかも？５月の平日では数人のみが車中泊でした。地上の駐車場は少なからず平坦ではありませんが、立体駐車場部分の２階は平坦です。静かで夏場でも標高１３００はあるので涼しいでしょう。ただし近くにコンビニ等はありませんので食事や入浴は済ませて宿泊しましょう。（投稿：2025年5月、山びこ様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：先日（2021.6月）剣山リフト乗り場駐車場に行ったのですが、汚かったトイレが、キレイに改装されてましたので連絡いたします。（投稿：2021年7月、T様）
■無料駐車場、極めて静か。トイレあり。標高1359m（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: As mentioned in a previous post, the toilets have been renovated and are very clean with showers and heated seats. However, there is only one stall and three urinals in the men's restroom, so it may get crowded and crowded during peak season holidays. On a weekday in May, only a few people were staying overnight in their cars. The ground-level parking lot is not entirely flat, but the second floor of the multi-story parking garage is flat. It is quiet and cool even in summer because it is at an altitude of 1300m. However, there are no convenience stores nearby, so be sure to eat and bathe before staying overnight. (Posted: May 2025, Yamabiko)

■Report from our site's reader: I went to the Tsurugisan lift station parking lot the other day (June 2021), and I wanted to let you know that the dirty toilets have been beautifully renovated. (Posted: July 2021, T)

■Free parking, extremely quiet. Toilets available. Altitude 1359m (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: 百間川緑地公園・百間川緑地多目的広場(車中泊不可)
properties.title_en: Hyakkengawa Green Park / Hyakkengawa Green Multipurpose Plaza (Overnight parking not permitted)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：旭川・百間川ランニングコースそばの駐車場です。百間川の対岸にも、運動できる場所があり、駐車場も何か所かあります。公園に簡易トイレがあります。自動販売機などはありませんが、お店に近い場所もあります。幹線に近いですが、それほど大きな音はしないので、昼間の休憩には最適です。しかし夜間は閉鎖・利用禁止なので、車中泊はできません。（投稿：2020年10月、C様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: This is a parking lot near the Hyakken River running course in Asahikawa. There are also places to exercise on the opposite bank of the Hyakken River, and several parking lots there. There are portable toilets in the park. There are no vending machines, but there are some places close to shops. It is close to a main road, but it is not too noisy, so it is ideal for a daytime break. However, it is closed and closed to the public at night, so overnight parking is not possible. (Submitted by: C, October 2020)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 橘港中浦緑地公園の駐車場
properties.title_en: Parking lot at Tachibana Port Nakaura Green Park
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：阿南市橘町の港の埋立地にある運動公園の駐車場。橘市街地から橘大橋を渡ったところ。駐車場は2ヵ所有るが手前の方が良い(手前は身障者用洋式トイレ有、奥はトイレに洋式が無いのと管理事務所が有るから避けた方が無難)。駐車場無料、飲料自販機有、街灯少々有り、夜間は釣り人がたまにトイレに出入りするが他は静か、橘市街地に近くスーパーやコンビニが車で3分位で便利。夜間は岸壁にかなりの釣り人が居て無人地帯の恐さが無かったが、朝には皆引き揚げていた。駐車場は岸壁からちょっと離れているので釣り人が車でトイレにやってくるがそれ以外はほぼ人の出入りなく安眠出来る。音や人の気配が気になる方はトイレから少し離れた方が良いと思います。運動公園は周りを柵で囲まれて施錠され、あまり使われていない感じでした。添付写真（投稿：2021年9月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Parking lot at a sports park located on reclaimed land in the port of Tachibana-cho, Anan City. It's across the Tachibana Bridge from the Tachibana town center. There are two parking lots, but the one closer to the entrance is better (the one closer has a Western-style toilet for disabled people, the one further back doesn't have a Western-style toilet and has a management office, so it's best to avoid it). Parking is free, there are vending machines for drinks, and there are a few streetlights. At night, fishermen occasionally go in and out of the toilets, but otherwise it's quiet. It's close to the Tachibana town center, and supermarkets and convenience stores are about a 3-minute drive away, which is convenient. At night, there were quite a few fishermen on the quay, so it didn't feel like an uninhabited area, but everyone had left by morning. The parking lot is a little distance from the quay, so fishermen come by car to use the toilets, but otherwise there are almost no people coming and going, so you can sleep peacefully. If you are bothered by noise or the presence of people, you should stay a little further away from the toilets. The sports park is surrounded by a fence and locked, and it seemed like it wasn't being used very often. Attached photo (Submitted by: m, September 2021)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: 菅野駐車場（トイレなし）
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：ゆずりゾーンの先にある駐車スペース。分離帯なし。駐車スペースが狭く、坂になっている、後続車の追突の危険もあるため、車中泊箇所としては不適。トイレなし。（投稿：2020年11月、C様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Parking space beyond the passing zone. No median strip. The parking space is narrow and sloped, and there is a risk of rear-end collisions, making it unsuitable as a place to stay overnight in a car. No toilet. (Submitted by: C, November 2020)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 維新百年記念公園 P7 スポーツ文化センター東駐車場
properties.title_en: Meiji Restoration Centennial Memorial Park P7 Sports and Culture Center East Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：メイン駐車場等は夜間閉鎖されるが、ここは２４時間利用可能。トイレ有り。すき家、マクドナルド（いずれも２４時間営業）は徒歩圏内。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: The main parking lot and other areas are closed at night, but this area is open 24 hours. There are restrooms. Sukiya and McDonald's (both open 24 hours) are within walking distance. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：マヨネーズとトマトケチャップを混ぜたオーロラソースの「チキンナンバン」の店。詳細、食べログ（投稿：2025年7月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A restaurant serving "Chicken Nanban" with an aurora sauce made by mixing mayonnaise and tomato ketchup. Details on Tabelog (Posted by n, July 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：ボロいがトイレもあり良い。ただし女性は使いたがらないと思われる。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: It's run-down, but it has a toilet, which is good. However, it seems that women wouldn't want to use it. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: ホテル松尾 7Fレストラン
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：ホテル松尾の名物、海賊丼税込み1512円を食べました。うちわエビ等のっており豪快で見応え、食べ応えあり、美味しかったです。おかみさんが気さくで郷土に詳しく、料理の質問にもよく答えてくれます。美人です。7階レストランです、無料駐車場が道路挟んで向かいにあります。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: I ate Hotel Matsuo's specialty, the Pirate Bowl (1512 yen including tax). It was impressive and visually appealing, topped with slipper lobster and other ingredients, and it was delicious. The proprietress is friendly, knowledgeable about the local area, and answers questions about the food well. She's beautiful. It's a restaurant on the 7th floor, and there is free parking across the street. Tabelog

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：フードコート・売店　上り線（広島方面）7:00〜21:00、下り線（福岡方面）7:00〜20:00営業。（投稿：2022年4月、n様）
■大量のトラックがいて騒がしい。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: Food court/shops are open from 7:00 to 21:00 on the northbound lane (towards Hiroshima) and from 7:00 to 20:00 on the southbound lane (towards Fukuoka). (Submitted by: n, April 2022)
■There are a lot of trucks and it's noisy. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：フードコート・売店　24h営業（投稿：2023年2月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Food court/convenience store open 24 hours (Submitted by: n, February 2023)

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：ファミマのトイレに近い。アーケードまで30分徒歩圏内。アットパークJR松山駅前よりも少し、電車の音がましかな？￥500/24時間。（投稿：2022年10月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Close to the FamilyMart restroom. Within a 30-minute walk to the arcade. Slightly less noisy from trains than AtPark JR Matsuyama Station. 500 yen/24 hours. (Submitted by: m, October 2022)

properties.label: Free Campground
properties.title_ja: そうじゃ水辺の楽校（無料キャンプ場）
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：とても広大な川原のスポット。正式なキャンプ場ではないが、ここでテント張ってBBQしたりカヌー体験したり出来る場所。年中、キャンパーはいる。流しや水場は無い。トイレは簡易トイレだが、簡易洋式なので、臭くもなく特に不自由なく使える。ペーパーも補充されている。とにかくエリアが広いので、隣と適度な距離を保てる。ただし、無料なのでDQNが来ることがある。炭の放置、夜中までの大声、アイドリングなど。季節によってはDQNも増えるので注意。晴れていれば朝早くから日が当たるので、ポータブル電源をソーラー充電するのに丁度よい。川原なので、風が強い日もある。買い出しはすぐ近くにローソン、足を伸ばせば、激安スーパーのディオとか、色々ある。個人的に好きな場所。（投稿：2024年2月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A very vast riverside spot. It's not an official campsite, but it's a place where you can pitch tents, have BBQs, and try canoeing. There are campers all year round. There are no sinks or water sources. The toilets are portable toilets, but they are simple Western-style toilets, so they don't smell and are perfectly usable. Toilet paper is also replenished. The area is very large, so you can maintain a reasonable distance from your neighbors. However, since it's free, some troublemakers may come. Leaving charcoal unattended, making loud noises until late at night, idling engines, etc. Depending on the season, the number of troublemakers may increase, so be careful. If it's sunny, the sun shines from early in the morning, so it's perfect for solar charging portable power supplies. Since it's a riverside, it can be windy on some days. For shopping, there's a Lawson convenience store nearby, and if you go a little further, there's a discount supermarket called Dio, and various other options. Personally, I like this place. (Submitted by: m, February 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ有り、駐車スペース、トイレ共に夜間の閉鎖は無し。釣やキャンプをしてる人がいるが、夜間は静か。民家が近いのでマナーには気をつけたい。砂浜からの景色が良くのんびりとした瀬戸内海を味わえる。（投稿：2024年2月、k様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There are toilets, parking spaces, and neither the toilets nor the restrooms are closed at night. There are people fishing and camping, but it is quiet at night. Since there are houses nearby, be mindful of your manners. The view from the sandy beach is nice, and you can enjoy the relaxed atmosphere of the Seto Inland Sea. (Submitted by k, February 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 大津泊庭園無料駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレを使わせて頂いただけで泊まってはいないが、車中泊出来そうです。利用料金︰無料。夜間閉鎖されないようです。水洗洋式(ウォシュレット無し)トイレ有り、非常にキレイ。静かさは、幹線道路の脇ですが、交通量がそれほど無いので静かです。特に奥に止めると安眠できそうです。海からは50m離れています。海抜は3.7mです。（投稿：2023年12月、naka0514k様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: I only used the toilet and didn't stay overnight, but it seems like it would be possible to park here overnight. Usage fee: Free. It doesn't seem to be closed at night. There is a flush toilet (no bidet) and it is very clean. It is quiet despite being next to a main road, as there is not much traffic. You could get a good night's sleep if you park further back. It is 50m from the sea. The elevation is 3.7m above sea level. (Posted by naka0514k in December 2023)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: 伊方町観光交流拠点施設 佐田岬はなはな
properties.title_en: Ikata Town Tourism and Exchange Center Sadamisaki Hanahana
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレは施設営業時間外は施錠されています。周辺にはトイレありません。（投稿：2025年8月、にんじゃ様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：九四フェリ乗り場のすぐ隣でトイレはとても綺麗で24時間使用できます。施設の駐車場は狭いので、キャンピングカーは無理かと思います。フェリー乗り場の駐車場の隅の方なら可能かも知れませんね。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: The toilets are locked outside of the facility's operating hours. There are no toilets in the surrounding area. (Submitted by: Ninja, August 2025)
■ Reader Report: The toilets are very clean and available 24 hours a day, right next to the Kyushu-Shikoku Ferry Terminal. The facility's parking lot is small, so I don't think it's possible for a campervan. It might be possible in the corner of the ferry terminal's parking lot. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 リストアステーション（車中泊はご遠慮くださいの張り紙）
properties.title_en: Roadside Station Restore Station (Sign posted: Please refrain from overnight parking)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレに車中泊はご遠慮くださいとの張り紙がある。施設側としては、車中泊を歓迎していない模様。気付かずに一泊してしまったが、P泊地としては普通の道の駅。隣接するR425は夜間の交通量は少なめで、それなりに静かな夜を過ごせた。（投稿：2023年10月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There is a sign in the restroom asking people to refrain from staying overnight in their vehicles. It seems the facility does not welcome overnight stays in vehicles. I ended up staying overnight without noticing, but as a parking spot, it's a normal roadside station. The adjacent Route 425 has relatively little traffic at night, so I was able to spend a fairly quiet night. (Submitted by: y, October 2023)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレが22時-朝5時まで閉鎖になりました。スーパーは24時間営業のままです。(2017年11月確認)
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: The restrooms are now closed from 10 PM to 5 AM. The supermarket remains open 24 hours. (Confirmed November 2017)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 亀老山展望公園駐車場(しまなみ海道 大島)
properties.title_en: Kirosan Observation Park Parking Lot (Shimanami Kaido, Oshima Island)""
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレあり。このトイレに向かっていちばん右側前の区画に駐車すると車中から来島海峡大橋が眺められる。展望台の他に道路を1、2分下ったところに展望デッキもあり、さいさいきて屋(今治市内)や道の駅で地元のつまみを購入、夕景の来島海峡大橋を見ながらのビールは最高。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There is a restroom. If you park in the rightmost spot in front of the restroom, you can see the Kurushima Kaikyo Bridge from inside your car. In addition to the observation deck, there is also an observation deck a minute or two down the road, where you can buy local snacks at Saisaikiteya (in Imabari city) or the roadside station and enjoy a beer while watching the Kurushima Kaikyo Bridge at sunset. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ、自動販売機有。昔はトイレ以外なかったので利用しやすかったが、現在はお店ができているため、長時間の利用(車中泊)は控えたほうが良いかも。（投稿：2020年11月、C様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There are toilets and vending machines. In the past, there was nothing but toilets, so it was easy to use, but now that there are shops, it might be better to refrain from using it for long periods of time (overnight stays in your car). (Submitted by: C, November 2020)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ・自販機だけの施設。スマートIC（24h運用）併設。上下線ともスマートICからの退出時にはPAを利用できない（スマートICからの流入時はPA利用可）。（投稿：2022年5月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A facility with only toilets and vending machines. It is adjacent to a smart interchange (24-hour operation). The rest area cannot be used when exiting from the smart interchange on either the inbound or outbound lanes (the rest area can be used when entering from the smart interchange). (Submitted by: n, May 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：ダム湖である池田湖の湖岸にある公園で、普通車50~100台分くらいの駐車スペースがある。トイレは駐車スペースから北側へ50m程度の場所にあり、水洗で洋式もある。すぐ上を高速道路の徳島道が走っているが、意外にも車の走行音はそれほど気にならない。※トイレの場所👉️詳細（投稿：2023年11月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: This park is located on the shore of Lake Ikeda, a dam lake, and has parking space for about 50-100 regular cars. The toilets are located about 50m north of the parking area and are flush toilets, including Western-style ones. The Tokushima Expressway runs directly above, but surprisingly, the noise from passing cars is not that noticeable. *Toilet location 👉️Details (Posted: November 2023, by y)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：ダムの上下2か所に駐車場有。どちらにもトイレなし。ダムの上側の駐車場は管理事務所の前、少しそこまでの道が狭いです。ダムの下側の駐車場の前には、小さな公園がある。屋根着くのベンチ有。ただし「マムシ注意」の看板もあります。国道沿いですが、交通量はほとんどなく静かです。民家・お店・コンビニから結構離れています。（投稿：2020年12月）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There are two parking lots, one above and one below the dam. There are no toilets at either location. The parking lot above the dam is in front of the management office, and the road leading up to it is a little narrow. There is a small park in front of the parking lot below the dam. There are benches with roofs. However, there is also a sign warning of venomous snakes. It is along a national highway, but there is hardly any traffic and it is quiet. It is quite far from houses, shops, and convenience stores. (Posted: December 2020)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：サーファー御用達駐車場 トイレ有り水なし 駐車場が狭い為、秋〜冬の波乗りシーズンは夜に駐車しないとまず停めれない。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A parking lot frequented by surfers. Toilets available, but no running water. The parking lot is small, so during the autumn and winter surfing season, you'll almost certainly need to park at night to find a spot. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：サーファー御用達駐車場 トイレ有り、水なし 近くにあるサーファーが運営している飯屋が美味しい。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A parking lot frequented by surfers. Toilets available, but no running water. There's a delicious restaurant nearby run by surfers. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：コンビニが西側に数分走ったところにローソンが有ります。駅前にスーパーのAコープ有りますが19:00閉店と早いので注意。側に国道が走っているので多少交通量がありますが気になるほどではありません。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There is a Lawson convenience store a few minutes' drive to the west. There is an A-Coop supermarket in front of the station, but be aware that it closes early at 7:00 PM. There is some traffic as a national highway runs nearby, but it is not bothersome. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：コンビニがあります、朝7:30から夜6:00までオープン。弁当やビールが買えます。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There's a convenience store, open from 7:30 AM to 6:00 PM. You can buy bento boxes and beer. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：コメント：無料の駐車場で夜釣りしている人もたまにいます。釣り好きな方には車中泊しながら釣り🎣なんていいかもしれません。釣れるかどうかは不明です🙏 トイレは公園内にあります。所謂公園のトイレ！という感じですが清掃もされて綺麗に保たれてました。目の前は道路ですが音は気になりませんでした。比較的静かです。朝から散歩に来ている人もいて人気の公園のようでした。近くに二軒屋商店という有名なスーパーもあります。スーパーですが定休日アリ。気をつけてください。（投稿：2025年7月、かたかた様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Comment: Occasionally, you'll see people night fishing in the free parking lot. For fishing enthusiasts, it might be nice to camp in your car and fish 🎣. Whether you'll actually catch anything is unknown 🙏 There are toilets in the park. They're the typical park toilets, but they're cleaned and kept in good condition. There's a road right in front, but the noise wasn't noticeable. It's relatively quiet. There were people walking around from the morning, so it seems to be a popular park. There's also a famous supermarket nearby called Nikenya Shoten. It's a supermarket, but it has days off. Please be careful. (Posted by: Katakata, July 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: （暴走族の基地）宇佐竜の浜駐車場
properties.title_en: (Gang base) Usa-ryu no Hama parking lot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：ここの情報を参考に今年5月に泊まりましたが、夜はDQNのたまり場になっていて最悪でした。バイクや改造車がここを基地にして爆音で行ったり来たりしているのでとても寝られません。平日の夜でもダメです。この近くで泊まるなら、宇佐大橋の下にある無料の「井尻駐車場」（詳細）がおすすめです。24時間使えるトイレあり。結果的にそちらへ移動しました。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■海沿いの無料駐車場。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: I stayed here in May of this year based on the information here, but it was terrible. It was a hangout for delinquents at night. Motorcycles and modified cars were using it as a base, coming and going with loud noises, making it impossible to sleep. Even on weekday nights, it was no good. If you're staying nearby, I recommend the free "Ijiri Parking Lot" (details) under the Usa Bridge. There are 24-hour toilets. I ended up moving there instead. (Older post from before 2019)

■Free parking along the coast. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: スーパードラッグひまわり竹原店のコインシャワー
properties.title_en: Coin-operated showers at Super Drug Himawari Takehara store
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：コインランドリーにコインシャワー2室あり(24H営業)　300円／8分　シャンプー、石鹸とドライヤーあり（投稿：2025年6月、キャンプおやじ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There are two coin-operated showers at the laundromat (open 24 hours) - 300 yen/8 minutes - shampoo, soap, and hair dryer available (Submitted by: Camp Oyaji, June 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 久村海岸駐車場（トイレの北側エリア）（島根県 道の駅キララ多伎近くの海浜駐車場）
properties.title_en: Kumura Beach Parking Lot (Area north of the restrooms) (Seaside parking lot near Kirara Taki Roadside Station, Shimane Prefecture)""
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：きれいな公衆トイレ有。カップルの車が数台いるが深夜には貸し切り状態。道の駅より快適。お風呂は「多伎いちじく温泉」２ｋｍ。但し、花火禁止の看板があるので逆に夏の夜は若者に注意必要。（投稿：2022年7月、タケニィ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There are clean public restrooms. There are a few cars with couples in them, but it's like having the place to yourself late at night. More comfortable than a roadside station. For a bath, there's "Taki Ichijiku Onsen" 2km away. However, there's a sign prohibiting fireworks, so you need to be careful of young people on summer nights. (Submitted by Takenii in July 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 恐羅漢山 登山者用駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：かなり広大な駐車場、近くにスキーシーズン専用の駐車場が点在しています。スキーシーズンはスキー客用の駐車場ですがオフシーズンは登山者用駐車場となります。キャンプ場の管理棟の比較的綺麗なトイレ（和式）が深夜でも使えました。電気は自動点灯です。スキーシーズンは管理棟は閉鎖しており使えません。飲料水の自動販売機しかありませんが、広島県内では一番標高の高い駐車場ではないかな？登山目的なら利用できます。コンビニは20数キロ離れたところしかありません。（投稿：2022年8月、h様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There is a fairly large parking lot, and several parking lots nearby that are exclusively for the ski season. During the ski season, it is a parking lot for skiers, but during the off-season, it is a parking lot for hikers. The relatively clean toilets (Japanese style) in the campground's administration building were usable even late at night. The lights turn on automatically. The administration building is closed and unusable during the ski season. There is only a vending machine for drinks, but I think it is the highest elevation parking lot in Hiroshima Prefecture. It is usable if your purpose is hiking. The nearest convenience store is more than 20 kilometers away. (Submitted by: h, August 2022)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: 御津中山駐車場（トイレ利用可否不明）
properties.title_en: Mitsu Nakayama Parking Lot (Availability of restrooms unknown)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：カーブの途中にある駐車スペースで、坂になっています。分離帯なし。ショートカットする車がいると危険なので、車中泊箇所としては避けたほうが良いですが、時々大型車が停車しています。（投稿：2020年11月、C様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: This parking space is located on a slope in the middle of a curve. There is no median strip. It is dangerous if cars try to take a shortcut, so it is best to avoid it as a place to park overnight, but large vehicles are sometimes parked there. (Submitted by: C, November 2020)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：カーナビ検索用住所：山口県柳井市日積3061　国道437号から脇道に少し入る。詳細（投稿：2023年11月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Address for car navigation search: 3061 Hijiki, Yanai City, Yamaguchi Prefecture. Take a short detour off National Route 437. Details (Submitted by: Mr./Ms. N, November 2023)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: 和気のおいしいピザ屋 ピザキング
properties.title_en: Pizza King, a delicious pizza place in Wake""
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：おいしいピザ屋です！！是非！！ボリュームもあります！ただ、駐車場が狭いので気をつけて下さい。火曜日休み。
■平日ランチピザが非常にお得でオススメ。食べログ
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: This is a delicious pizza place!! Definitely check it out!! The portions are generous! However, be careful as the parking lot is small. Closed on Tuesdays.

■The weekday lunch pizza is a great deal and highly recommended. (Tabelog)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: 鳥取日吉津 新鮮市場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：イオンモール日吉津店の駐車場の一角にあります。店内には海鮮丼で有名な「山芳亭」がある他、鮮魚店、精肉店、天ぷら店が有ります。鮮魚店は境港のお魚センターや水産物加工センターに比べ鳥取境港産の鮮魚（夏は岩ガキ、マグロ、冬は松葉ガニ）が巨大スーパーの駐車場に併設と言うことも有り２割程度安く購入できます。また、午後５時には閉店するため、にぎり寿司、焼き魚、魚の揚物等の総菜も早い時間帯から半額で提供していました。（投稿：2024年6月、山びこ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: It's located in a corner of the parking lot of Aeon Mall Hiyoshizu. Inside, there's Yamayoshitei, famous for its seafood bowls, as well as a fish shop, a butcher shop, and a tempura shop. The fish shop sells fresh fish from Sakaiminato, Tottori Prefecture (rock oysters and tuna in summer, snow crab in winter) at about 20% cheaper than the fish market and seafood processing center in Sakaiminato, due to its location in the parking lot of a huge supermarket. Also, since it closes at 5pm, they offer prepared foods such as sushi, grilled fish, and fried fish at half price from early in the day. (Submitted by Yamabiko, June 2024)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 後楽温泉 ほのかの湯
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：900円、詳細　受付内に食堂・休憩所あり。（投稿：2024年2月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: 900 yen, details available. There is a cafeteria and rest area inside the reception area. (Submitted by: n, February 2024)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 天然温泉宮浜べにまんさくの湯
properties.title_en: Miyahama Benimansaku no Yu Natural Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：900円、詳細。食事もおいしかったです。宮島に近く車中泊前に良いかも。（投稿：2022年5月、h様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: 900 yen, details. The food was delicious. It's close to Miyajima, so it might be good before sleeping in your car. (Submitted by: h, May 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：8:30〜18:00の間は400円だが、18:00から22:30までの間の入場は無料。22:30から6:00まではゲートが閉まって入れなくなってしまうので桂浜を散歩するかそのまま寝てしまいましょう。事前精算なので一回入ってしまえば無料です。トイレは綺麗で自動照明の付いた物が園内に複数あります。駐車場の近くにも一つあります。観光案内所の近くに泊まれば弱いけどwifi も使えます。2月ごろ泊まりましたが、暗くて静かで良かったです。（投稿：2023年2月、k様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: The entrance fee is 400 yen between 8:30 and 18:00, but entry is free between 18:00 and 22:30. The gate closes between 22:30 and 6:00, so you can take a walk around Katsurahama or just go to sleep. Since payment is made in advance, once you're inside, it's free. There are several clean toilets with automatic lighting throughout the park. There's also one near the parking lot. If you stay near the tourist information center, you can use Wi-Fi, although it's weak. I stayed there around February, and it was nice because it was dark and quiet. (Posted by: k, February 2023)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：700円、詳細　食堂（食券式）あり。（投稿：2024年6月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: 700 yen, details: Cafeteria (ticket system). (Submitted by: n, June 2024)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 国民宿舎 サンロード吉備路
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：620円、施設のHP。こちらは宿泊施設ですが、日帰り入浴で利用しました。男湯と女湯が1日ごとに変わっていました。露天風呂もあります。混む時間だったのか、洗い場も脱衣所も混んでいましたが、近くに入浴施設がなかったので大変助かりました。（投稿：2024年10月、a様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: 620 yen, facility's website. This is an accommodation facility, but I used it for a day trip to the baths. The men's and women's baths alternated every day. There is also an open-air bath. It was crowded, probably because it was a busy time, but it was a great help as there were no other bathing facilities nearby. (Submitted by: A, October 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: なんちゃら大明神の駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：５台程の駐車場だがトイレがある。瀬戸大橋の真下なので多少騒音があるかも。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There is parking for about 5 cars, but there is a toilet. It is directly under the Seto Ohashi Bridge, so there may be some noise. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 あらエッサ
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：２月１３日利用。表の駐車場は以前利用したときより大型車のスペースが広くなっていましたが、大型車と小型車の進入・退出経路がポールで区別されていました。裏のＥＶ充電施設がある駐車場は街灯が無く暗くて静かでした。　また、トイレの洗面台には「宿泊目的の道の駅の利用は控えてください」、「ラーメンの汁を流さないでください」の小さな張り紙がありました。（投稿：2024年2月、山びこ様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：国道9号線沿いで、トラックの駐車スペースもあるのでややうるさい。とても広いが、深夜には駐車マスが全て埋まるほど車中泊の車両が多かった。裏の駐車スペースは静かだが、「深夜の休憩は防犯上ご遠慮下さい」の看板あり。（実際には車中泊車両で埋まっていましたが。）街灯も、表はあるが、裏には無し。トイレが綺麗。レストランは20：30まで営業、最寄りのコンビニ「ローソン 安来吉佐店」まで徒歩700m。（投稿：2021年5月、R様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：表側の駐車場は国道沿いだが、建物の裏側の駐車場は静か。古民家を移築した食事処がいい雰囲気。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Used on February 13th. The front parking lot had more space for large vehicles than when I used it before, but the entry and exit routes for large and small vehicles were separated by poles. The parking lot at the back with the EV charging facilities was dark and quiet as there were no streetlights. Also, there were small signs on the sinks in the toilets that said, "Please refrain from using the roadside station for overnight stays" and "Please do not pour ramen broth down the drain." (Submitted by Yamabiko, February 2024)

■Report from a reader of this site: It's located along National Route 9, and there are also truck parking spaces, so it's a bit noisy. It's very spacious, but at night all the parking spaces were filled with vehicles parked overnight. The parking space at the back is quiet, but there is a sign that says, "Please refrain from taking breaks at night for security reasons." (Although in reality it was filled with vehicles parked overnight.) There are streetlights at the front, but not at the back. The toilets are clean. The restaurant is open until 8:30 PM, and the nearest convenience store, "Lawson Yasugi Kisa Store," is a 700m walk away. (Posted by R in May 2021)
■Report from a reader of this site: The front parking lot is along the national highway, but the parking lot at the back of the building is quiet. The restaurant, which is a relocated old farmhouse, has a nice atmosphere. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 下津井祇園神社下の公園駐車場
properties.title_en: Parking lot at the park below Shimotsui Gion Shrine
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：24時間利用可能なトイレ有、自販機は東西どちらに歩いても徒歩5分圏内に多数あります。5台程度の駐車スペース釣り人などが昼夜問わず利用していますが、人 影は少ないのでゆっくり眠れます。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There are toilets available 24 hours a day, and there are many vending machines within a 5-minute walk in either direction (east or west). There is parking space for about 5 cars, which is used by anglers and others day and night, but there are few people around so you can sleep peacefully. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.title_ja: 四国中央市新町駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：24時間有料駐車場。最初の1時間100円、以降1時間50円。19時〜9時300円、現金のみ、千円札可。トイレは徒歩3分のセブンイレブンを利用。暗くて静か。（投稿：2025年2月、タコラ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: 24-hour paid parking lot. 100 yen for the first hour, 50 yen for each subsequent hour. 300 yen from 7 PM to 9 AM, cash only, 1000 yen bills accepted. Toilets are available at the 7-Eleven 3-minute walk away. Dark and quiet. (Submitted by Takora in February 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 寒川豊岡海浜公園駐車場
properties.title_en: Samukawa Toyooka Seaside Park Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：24時間無料駐車場&トイレ。屋外に無料の水シャワーあり（水着着て使用）。夜は暗く、風が強く車が揺れるしうるさい。（投稿：2025年2月、タコラ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: 24-hour free parking and restrooms. Free outdoor showers available (swimsuit required). It's dark at night, windy, and noisy, causing cars to shake. (Submitted by Takora, February 2025)

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.title_ja: 三井のリパーク 玉野市営宇野駅前駐車場
properties.title_en: [Paid] Mitsui RePark Tamano City Uno Station Front Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：24時間最大500円（詳細）、近傍に公衆トイレ（和式水洗、多目的は洋式水洗）、コンビニあり。周辺に居酒屋多数、夜間静かです。入浴は近傍にたまのゆ温泉、車で10分程の所に瀬戸内マリンビューホテルたまの温泉がある。（投稿：2026年1月、o様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: 24-hour parking for a maximum of 500 yen (details available), public toilets nearby (Japanese style flush toilets, multi-purpose toilets with Western-style flush toilets), convenience store. Many izakayas (Japanese pubs) in the area, quiet at night. For bathing, Tamano-yu Onsen is nearby, and Setouchi Marine View Hotel Tamano Onsen is about a 10-minute drive away. (Submitted by: Mr./Ms. O, January 2026)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：24時間トイレ利用可。釣り客が結構居る。電車と道路の走行音がうるさい。夏は水シャワーも利用可能だが、夏はクソ暑いので車中泊は厳しい。公園案内図、公式サイト（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Toilets are available 24 hours a day. There are quite a few anglers. The noise from trains and roads is loud. Cold showers are available in the summer, but it gets extremely hot in the summer, so overnight stays in a car are difficult. Park map, official website (older posts from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 山の神公園 駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：24h無料駐車場、傾斜大。24hトイレ、洋式水洗、ウォシュレット無し。屋根付きベンチあり、ゴミ箱なし。午前8時に来訪、※道幅ムチャ狭いです！高速道路沿いからの道推奨。（投稿：2025年8月、タコラ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: 24-hour free parking, steep slope. 24-hour toilet, Western-style flush toilet, no bidet. Covered bench available, no trash cans. Visited at 8 AM, *The road is extremely narrow! Recommended to take the road from the highway. (Submitted by Takora, August 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：24h無料駐車場、横方向に傾斜、朝方全体が山陰で快適。24hトイレ、和式水洗、多目的トイレ、ウォシュレット付き。虫が多い、屋根付きベンチ&テーブルあり。高速沿いからの道は狭く急坂。（投稿：2025年8月、タコラ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: 24-hour free parking, slopes laterally, comfortable in the shade in the morning. 24-hour toilets, Japanese-style flush toilets, multi-purpose toilets, with bidet. Lots of insects, covered benches and tables available. The road from the highway is narrow and steep. (Submitted by Takora, August 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：24h無料駐車場、やや傾斜あり。24hトイレ、水洗洋式、車椅子用トイレあり。ベンチ、自販機あり、グランド側にも駐車場とトイレあり。18時来訪（投稿：2025年8月、タコラ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: 24-hour free parking, slightly sloped. 24-hour toilets, flush toilets (Western style), wheelchair accessible toilet available. Benches and vending machines available, parking and toilets also available on the field side. Visited at 6 PM (Posted by Takora, August 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：24h無料駐車場、やや傾斜。24hトイレ、多目的トイレ、ウォシュレット付き。水道飲用不可。屋根付きベンチ、自販機あり、17時来訪。（投稿：2025年8月、タコラ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: 24-hour free parking, slightly sloped. 24-hour toilets, multi-purpose toilets, with bidet. Tap water is not potable. Covered benches and vending machines available. Visited at 5 PM. (Submitted by Takora in August 2025)

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：24Hまで680円の駐車場(24H)（詳細）、西条酒蔵通り公衆トイレ(24H)にも近い、酒蔵は早く閉まるが近隣に居酒屋多数　大声の酔客通行多少あり　地面傾斜少々あり（投稿：2025年6月、キャンプおやじ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Parking available for 680 yen for up to 24 hours (24H) (details), close to the Saijo Sake Brewery Street public toilets (24H), sake breweries close early but there are many izakayas nearby, some loud drunk people passing by, slight slope of the ground (Submitted by: Camp Oyaji, June 2025)

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：24Hまで400円の駐車場(24H営業)（詳細）、JR益田駅公衆トイレ(24H)にも近い、静か、場所により多少の傾斜あり（投稿：2025年6月、キャンプおやじ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Parking lot for 400 yen for up to 24 hours (open 24 hours) (details), close to JR Masuda Station public toilets (24 hours), quiet, slight slope in some areas (Submitted by: Camp Oyaji, June 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：24hスーパーや吉野家・マクドナルド・オートバックスが在る為車のトラブル時でも安心できる。車通りが少々多いので場所によって落ち着かない場合もある。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: The presence of a 24-hour supermarket, Yoshinoya, McDonald's, and Autobacs provides peace of mind in case of car trouble. However, the traffic can be a bit heavy, making some areas feel unsettled. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 邑南の里（オオナンノサト）（旧：道の駅 瑞穂）
properties.title_en: Roadside Station Ōnan-no-Sato (formerly Roadside Station Mizuho)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2025年8月4日リニューアルオープン。詳細。「道の駅 瑞穂」が移転リニューアル。（投稿：2025年12月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Reopening on August 4, 2025. Details. "Michi-no-Eki Mizuho" relocates and reopens. (Submitted by: n, December 2025)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 ハピネスふくえ
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2025年4月調査。22時に到着、建物に車中泊についての注意等を見つけることが出来なかった。23時以降は訪れる車は少ない。周辺の街灯がない・光が届かない事もあり、夜は真っ暗。建物全体どこも夜間は照明がなくトイレが何処にあるか初めてだとわかりにくい。そのトイレも人感式で照明が点灯する仕様。建物から山口県と萩市の合計2つのWi-Fiスポットが提供されているが、どちらも時間制限的なものがあり30分以上の接続維持は難しい。川など水に関するところに近いためかカエルの大合唱が夜鳴り響く、ここに到着するまでに道路には幾つものカエル（またはその死骸）を踏み越えることになる。他に車中泊目的の車はなかったが、何の目的か不明な車が入ってきたため10分ほど様子見。とくに動きが無かったが、自衛のために調査をうちきって移動。（投稿：2025年4月、movement様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Survey conducted in April 2025. Arrived at 10 PM, but could not find any notices or warnings about overnight parking in the building. Few cars visit after 11 PM. There are no streetlights or light reaching the surrounding area, so it is pitch black at night. There is no lighting anywhere in the building at night, making it difficult to find the toilets if it is your first time. The toilets are equipped with motion-activated lighting. Two Wi-Fi hotspots are provided from the building, one from Yamaguchi Prefecture and one from Hagi City, but both have time limits, making it difficult to maintain a connection for more than 30 minutes. Perhaps because it is close to a river or other body of water, a chorus of frogs can be heard at night, and you will step over many frogs (or their carcasses) on the road before arriving here. There were no other cars intended for overnight parking, but a car of unknown purpose entered, so we waited for about 10 minutes to see what would happen. Nothing particularly happened, but for our own safety, we stopped our investigation and moved on. (Submitted by: movement, April 2025)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2025年3月利用。2025年3月末で休館となります。詳細。この近辺で貴重な日帰り温泉施設なので、残念です。（投稿：2025年3月、h様）
■日帰り入浴600円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：2024/3月日帰り入浴、大浴場修理のため使用できません。工期：2023年11月1日～2024年4月19日予定　確認必要。👉️詳細（投稿：2024年4月、h様）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: Used in March 2025. The facility will be closed at the end of March 2025. Details. It's a shame, as it's a valuable day-trip hot spring facility in this area. (Posted: March 2025, h)
■Day-trip bathing: 600 yen, details
■Report from our website reader: Day-trip bathing in March 2024. The large bath is unavailable due to repairs. Construction period: November 1, 2023 to April 19, 2024 (planned). Confirmation required. 👉️Details (Posted: April 2024, h)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 めじかの里土佐清水
properties.title_en: Roadside Station Mejika no Sato Tosashimizu
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2025年3月泊。近隣に温泉がないことを除けば、車中泊に適していると思います。足摺観光後に入浴してから移動しました。夜間の交通量も少なく、駐車している大型車もなく、静かに眠れました。近隣にコンビニもあります。（投稿：2025年3月、h様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Stayed in March 2025. Aside from the lack of nearby hot springs, I think it's suitable for overnight stays in a car. I took a bath after sightseeing in Ashizuri before moving on. There was little traffic at night, and no large parked vehicles, so I was able to sleep peacefully. There's also a convenience store nearby. (Submitted by: h, March 2025)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 佐田岬半島ミュージアム（旧：瀬戸農業公園）
properties.title_en: Roadside Station Sadamisaki Peninsula Museum (formerly Seto Agricultural Park)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2025年12月泊。とにかく風が強いです。そのせいか、車中泊の車は２台のみで、トラックはいませんでした。最初はミュージアムの前に駐車し、あまりの風に驚きましたが、横の売店の前は少しましでした。翌日、進入路がわかりずらいのですが、ミュージアムの裏にも駐車場があるのに気づきました。照明がどうなのかわかりませんが、こちらの方が風は静かそうです。トイレはミュージアムの建物内のものが使用でき、とてもきれいでした。（投稿：2025年12月、h様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Stayed in December 2025. The wind is incredibly strong. Perhaps because of this, there were only two other cars parked overnight, and no trucks. I initially parked in front of the museum and was surprised by how strong the wind was, but it was a little better in front of the shop next door. The next day, I noticed that there is also a parking lot behind the museum, although the access road is difficult to find. I don't know what the lighting is like there, but the wind seemed calmer there. The toilets inside the museum building were available for use and were very clean. (Submitted by: h, December 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 厚狭川河畔寝太郎公園
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2024年4月に利用。普通車20～30台くらいの無料駐車場。トイレは水洗洋式で清掃状態も良好。国道R316からは少し距離があるので、車の走行音は気にならないレベル。1km圏内にスーパーがあり、買い出しも便利。（投稿：2024年6月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Used in April 2024. There is free parking for about 20-30 regular cars. The toilets are flush toilets and are in good condition. It is a little distance from National Route R316, so the noise from passing cars is not noticeable. There is a supermarket within 1km, making shopping convenient. (Submitted by: y, June 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 瀬戸展望休憩所（大久展望台）
properties.title_en: Seto Observation Rest Area (Okubo Observation Deck)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2024/3 /18車中泊しました。トイレ：24時間使えます。きれいに掃除がしてあります。朝高齢のご夫婦が清掃に来てました。建物の照明ブルーやピンク色など3～4色で照らしている、深夜1時まで点灯。駐車場：傾斜が少しあります。道路の交通量が少ないので比較的静かです。（投稿：2024年4月、h様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: I stayed overnight in my car on March 18, 2024. Toilets: Available 24 hours a day. They are kept very clean. An elderly couple came to clean them in the morning. The building is lit up in 3-4 colors, including blue and pink, and stays lit until 1 AM. Parking lot: There is a slight slope. It is relatively quiet because there is little traffic on the road. (Submitted by: h, April 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: ぐるっと竜串 ウエストパーク
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2024/3 /18、車中泊しました。24時間公衆トイレあります。大変きれい、掃除行き届いています。大駐車場あります。車中泊しました、国道沿いですが車両少なく比較的静か、お勧めです。（投稿：2024年4月、h様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: March 18, 2024, I stayed overnight in my car. There is a 24-hour public restroom. It is very clean and well-maintained. There is a large parking lot. I stayed overnight in my car; it is along a national highway but there is little traffic and it is relatively quiet. I recommend it. (Posted by h, April 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2023年5月の平日に利用。道の駅というより、大きめの駐車場を備えた産直店という感じ。売店の両側に駐車場があります。国道にへばりついているような立地なので耳栓推奨です。北側の駐車場にEV Quickがあります。（投稿：2023年5月、n様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：北側の広い駐車場の道路から遠い奧の区画に駐車したものの、冷凍トラックがエンジンかけたまま長時間駐まっていて逆にうるさい。夜中目覚めて建物に近い区画に移動して寝直したら、朝５時頃野菜市納品のおじさんらのしゃべり声で叩き起こされた。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Used on a weekday in May 2023. It felt more like a direct-from-the-farm store with a large parking lot than a roadside station. There are parking lots on both sides of the store. It's located right next to the national highway, so earplugs are recommended. There's an EV Quick in the north parking lot. (Submitted by: n, May 2023)

■Report from a reader of this site: Although I parked in a section far from the road in the large north parking lot, a refrigerated truck was parked there for a long time with its engine running, making it even noisier. I woke up in the middle of the night, moved to a section closer to the building, and went back to sleep, but was woken up again around 5 AM by the chatter of men delivering vegetables to the market. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 西いなば 気楽里
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：２０２３年11月の平日に利用。既出コメントのとおり、新しくて広くてキレイな施設。大型車と普通車のブロックが離れていて静か。普通車エリアも２つあって、奥のほうならさらに静かです。トイレも、こんなに要る？というぐらいの大キャパで、ゆったりした気分で時を過ごせました・・。普通車ブロックの北西端にEV Quickがあります。（投稿：2023年11月、n様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2023/7/5(水)に利用。共有スペース：24H使用可、畳のスペース有（DQNが朝まで仮眠に使用していました。）　トイレ：水洗（共有スペース奥に有り)。道の駅に隣接しファミマ有（24h営業)。Wifi：共有スペース付近にアクセスポイントが有る様で、駐車場からだと電波が弱く、届くか届かないか微妙です。届くとしたら　この辺がおすすめです。→詳細。近くの日帰り温泉：宝喜温泉館　(詳細)、温泉館ホットピア鹿野(詳細)（投稿：2023年10月、n様）
■2019年6月30日オープン。高速道路のPA的道の駅。幹線道から離れた奥にも駐車場ができるようで、期待の新人。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Used on a weekday in November 2023. As mentioned in previous comments, it's a new, spacious, and clean facility. The large vehicle and regular vehicle blocks are separated, making it quiet. There are also two regular vehicle areas, and the one further back is even quieter. The toilets are also huge—more than you'd expect—allowing for a relaxing stay. There's an EV Quick at the northwest end of the regular vehicle block. (Posted by: n, November 2023)

■Report from a reader of this site: Used on Wednesday, July 5, 2023. Shared space: Available 24 hours, with a tatami area (used by some troublemakers for a nap until morning). Toilets: Flush toilets (located at the back of the shared space). Adjacent to a roadside station with a FamilyMart (open 24 hours). Wifi: There seems to be an access point near the shared space, but the signal is weak from the parking lot, and it's uncertain whether it reaches there or not. If it does reach, this area is recommended. →Details. Nearby day-trip hot springs: Hoki Onsenkan (details), Hotpia Kano Onsenkan (details) (Posted: October 2023, by n)
■Opened June 30, 2019. A roadside station similar to a highway rest area. It seems that a parking lot will be built further back, away from the main road, making it a promising newcomer. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 比婆山立烏帽子駐車場
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2023年１１月８日確認。トイレはバイオトイレで比較的新しいのですが、場所柄枯れ葉が多量に吹き込んでおり、とっても使う気になりません。すぐ傍の小屋も老朽化で倒壊の恐れがあるため立ち入り禁止となっています。また、駐車場は若干傾斜があるため車中泊には不向きかと思います。（投稿：2023年11月、山びこ様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：広島県民の森、比婆山の最高峰、立烏帽子山の無料駐車場です。 小屋とトイレがあります。到着までにちょっと山道を苦労して登りますが植物ファンは「池の段」の植物に喜びます。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: Confirmed November 8, 2023. The toilet is a bio-toilet and relatively new, but due to its location, a large amount of fallen leaves have blown in, making it unsuitable for use. The nearby hut is also dilapidated and in danger of collapsing, so entry is prohibited. Also, the parking lot is slightly sloped, so I think it's unsuitable for overnight stays in a car. (Posted by: Yamabiko, November 2023)

■Report from our site's reader: This is the free parking lot for Mt. Tateeboshi, the highest peak of Mt. Hiba in Hiroshima Prefectural Forest. There is a hut and a toilet. You have to climb a mountain path a bit to get there, but plant enthusiasts will be delighted by the plants at "Ike no Dan". (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 きなはい屋しろかわ
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2023.05.13 利用。トイレ：水洗ウオシュレット。駐車場：駐車位置が国道に面した場所が多く、騒音が気になる場合は、国道から離れた場所への駐車がおすすめです、また　民家が隣接しているので、アイドリングにも注意してください。（投稿：2023年10月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Used on May 13, 2023. Toilets: Flush toilets with bidet functions. Parking: Many parking spaces face the national highway, so if noise is a concern, it is recommended to park in a location away from the highway. Also, there are private houses nearby, so please be careful with idling your engine. (Submitted by: n, October 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2021年1月利用。トレイと公園が駐車場から一段高いところにある為、トレイまで駐車場登る必要あります。トレイは多目的トレイが洋式。夜間照明あり。キレイです。だるま朝日の撮影ポイントのようで、朝方日の出の撮影の為に訪れている方がいました。防波堤裏なので波の音もせず静かです。（投稿：2021年1月、I様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Used in January 2021. The restrooms and park are on a higher level than the parking lot, so you need to go up to the parking lot to reach the restrooms. The multi-purpose restrooms are Western-style. There is nighttime lighting. It's clean. It seems to be a good spot for photographing the "Daruma sunrise," and there were people there in the morning to photograph the sunrise. It's quiet behind the breakwater, so there's no sound of waves. (Submitted by: Mr./Ms. I, January 2021)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2019年9月3連休の四国ドライブ時に利用。入って左側の一般車駐車場奥側は県道から離れて静かです。県道も夜間は交通量が少なくよく眠れました。新しい道の駅で、ウォシュレットや授乳室・幼児トイレもあり、子供連れの方は便利でしょう。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■2018/6/2オープン。奥の方は静かで良さそう。宇和島にある「道の駅みま」とは全く別の道の駅なので注意。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Used during a drive around Shikoku during the three-day weekend in September 2019. The back of the general parking lot on the left side after entering is quiet, away from the prefectural road. The prefectural road also has little traffic at night, so I was able to sleep well. It's a new roadside station, and it has a bidet toilet, nursing room, and children's toilet, so it would be convenient for people with children. (Older post from before 2019)

■Opened on June 2, 2018. The back area seems quiet and nice. Note that this is a completely different roadside station from "Michi-no-Eki Mima" in Uwajima. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2019年3月利用。車中泊車はほとんどなく、極めて静かに泊まれました。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Used in March 2019. There were hardly any other cars parked overnight, so it was extremely quiet. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2018年4月6日に立ち寄りました。高知県安芸市の観光名所である野良時計の駐車場です。20数台駐車できる規模ですが、満車になることはないようです。周囲にフェンスなど道とを遮るものはなく、24時間出入り可能です。トイレの便器の数は少ないものの、ウォシュレットで非常にきれいで清潔でした。幹線道路（国道55号）や鉄道（くろしお鉄道）から奥まった位置にあるので大変静かです。近くにスーパーマーケット（マルナカ）もあり、快適な車中泊スポットだと思います。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: I visited on April 6, 2018. This is the parking lot for Nora Tokei, a tourist attraction in Aki City, Kochi Prefecture. It can accommodate about 20 cars, but it never seems to be full. There are no fences or anything blocking the road around it, and it is accessible 24 hours a day. Although there are only a few toilets, they are very clean and have bidet functions. It is located far from the main road (National Route 55) and the railway (Kuroshio Railway), so it is very quiet. There is also a supermarket (Marunaka) nearby, so I think it is a comfortable spot for overnight stays in your car. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：２-３台、静か、無料、トイレ(きれい)、近くに立ち寄り湯ＯＫの「国賀荘」あり。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: 2-3 parking spaces, quiet, free, clean toilets, and there's a nearby hot spring facility called "Kuniga-so" where you can stop by. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 奥出雲おろちループ
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：１１月７日利用。付近は山間部でコンビニなど無し。道の駅には飲料水の自販機のみ。トイレは綺麗ですが、男性用は和式と洋式が各１箇所。施設の夜間も出入り自由な案内所内に男女兼用の洋式のトイレが１箇所あります。同道の駅は道路沿いの絶景ポイントで、スイッチバックの列車が見られるなど休日は観光客が多めですが、夜間はほとんど交通量が無いためとっても静かです。紅葉も綺麗でした。（投稿：2023年11月、山びこ様）
■標高668m
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Visited on November 7th. The surrounding area is mountainous with no convenience stores. The rest stop only has a vending machine for drinks. The toilets are clean, but the men's restroom has one Japanese-style and one Western-style toilet. There is one unisex Western-style toilet inside the information center, which is accessible even at night. This rest stop is a scenic spot along the road, and while it attracts many tourists on weekends due to the view of the switchback train, it is very quiet at night due to almost no traffic. The autumn foliage was also beautiful. (Submitted by: Yamabiko, November 2023)
■Elevation: 668m

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: 献上そば 羽根屋 大津店
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：11月17日に利用しました。本店は駅近くにありますが、比較的並びやすく、味もこちらが上だと聞いたので。今回の旅行で出雲そばを4回食べましたが、ここのそばはほんとの献上品と言っていいくらいに絶品の味でした。私の食べた蕎麦の中でも秀逸です。食べログ（投稿：2024年11月、s様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: I visited on November 17th. The main branch is near the station, but I heard that this branch is less crowded and the taste is better. I ate Izumo soba four times on this trip, but the soba here was so exquisite that I would say it was truly a tribute. It is the best soba I have ever eaten. (Tabelog review, posted November 2024, by s)

properties.label: Hot Spring

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■超穴場を発見！無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。山頂の駐車場でフラット、水平。トイレはこんな場所なのにきれいに管理された水洗洋式！かなり金かけて浄化槽等整備してます。非常に驚いた。標高約450mと結構高い。携帯電波（ドコモ、SB）もギリギリ利用可能。難点としては、有名な夜景スポットのためDQNが集まる可能性があるのと、人気（ひとけ）皆無のため治安についてはやや不安がある。（2021年10月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en: ■Discovered a hidden gem! Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed they are not closed at night. The parking lot at the mountaintop is flat and level. Despite being in such a remote location, the toilets are clean, well-maintained flush toilets! They must have spent a considerable amount of money on septic tanks and other facilities. I was very surprised. It's quite high up, at an altitude of about 450m. Cell phone reception (Docomo, SoftBank) is barely available. The downsides are that it's a famous night view spot so there's a possibility of attracting troublemakers, and the complete lack of people makes safety somewhat questionable. (Confirmed on-site by administrator in October 2021)

properties.desc_en: ■A real hidden gem! Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed not to be closed at night. The toilets are clean flush toilets, including Western-style. It's on the side of a mountain but the ground is flat and level. No one comes at night so it's very quiet. Cell phone reception is OK. Safety is at your own risk. A really great hidden gem. The fact that it's extremely quiet is a plus. Docomo signal is barely there, only one bar of signal.

■当サイト読者様レポート：私が実際に宿泊しました。警察署や税務署に隣接しており、とても静かな場所です。横の公園のトイレが使えます。春には桜が咲いていて、朝から散歩をするのもいいですよ。全体がフラットの平置き駐車場ですので、キャンピングカーやハイルーフ車も大丈夫です。温泉は徒歩13分くらいの所にしまなみ温泉喜助の湯(かなり評判の良い温泉とサウナ、詳細)があります。また、徒歩圏内にローソンと今治城もあります。私はお遍路の際に宿泊しましたが、この近くには札所が多くあり、ここを拠点に回るのもおすすめです。（投稿：2023年12月、c様）

■Report from a reader of this site: I actually stayed here. It's located next to a police station and tax office, making it a very quiet place. You can use the toilets in the park next door. In spring, the cherry blossoms bloom, and it's nice to take a walk in the morning. The entire area is a flat, open parking lot, so it's fine for campervans and high-roof vehicles. There's a hot spring, Shimanami Onsen Kisuke no Yu (a highly-rated hot spring and sauna, see details), about a 13-minute walk away. There's also a Lawson convenience store and Imabari Castle within walking distance. I stayed here during my pilgrimage, and there are many temples nearby, so it's a good base for visiting them. properties.label: Restaurant

properties.desc_ja: ■新鮮な生しらすが食べられる人気店。食べログ。高知市内にも支店あり👉️詳細。
properties.desc_en: ■A popular restaurant where you can eat fresh raw whitebait. (See Tabelog.) There's also a branch in Kochi City 👉️ Details.

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■新鮮なカツオの叩きや、8月末〜9月に食べられる、「めじかの新子」が絶品らしい。朝一ではなく、昼前ごろに朝採れた魚が並ぶらしい。久礼大正町市場アーケード内の鮮魚店では、春の初鰹、秋の戻り鰹を用いて藁焼きでカツオのタタキを造ります。すごく美味そう。
properties.desc_en: ■Apparently, fresh seared bonito and "mejika no shinko" (young skipjack tuna), which can be eaten from the end of August to September, are exquisite. The fish caught that morning are not sold first thing in the morning, but rather around midday. At the fish shop inside the Kure Taisho-machi Market arcade, they make seared bonito using straw-grilled bonito, using the first bonito of spring and the returning bonito of autumn. It sounds incredibly delicious.

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja:
■上り側PAは、全体的に傾斜＆トラックだらけでアイドリングがうるさい。（2022年4月管理人現地確認）
■上り側に下道用のウェルカムゲート24時間無料駐車場があるが、かなり強い文言で「1時間以上の駐車は厳禁!!!」と書いた張り紙がある。常識的に考えて車中泊は不可。😅（2022年4月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■The northbound rest area is generally sloped and full of trucks, making idling noises very loud. (Confirmed by administrator in April 2022)
■There is a 24-hour free parking lot with a welcome gate for local road users on the northbound side, but there is a sign that says "Parking for more than 1 hour is strictly prohibited!!!" in very strong language. Common sense dictates that overnight parking is not allowed. 😅 (Confirmed by administrator in April 2022)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■秋吉台（あきよしだい）は、山口県美祢市中・東部に広がる日本最大のカルスト台地。
properties.desc_en: ■ Akiyoshidai is Japan's largest karst plateau, located in the central and eastern parts of Mine City, Yamaguchi Prefecture.

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■周南市のコンビナート夜景が見える。駐車場２つあり、夜景は下の駐車場、トイレは山頂側の駐車場。寝るだけの車中泊ならいいかも。国立公園なので火は使えないはず。 ※夜景がキレイなのでDQNが集まってくる可能性あり。
properties.desc_en: ■ You can see the night view of the industrial complex in Shunan City. There are two parking lots; the lower one offers the night view, and the toilets are in the parking lot on the mountaintop side. It might be okay if you're just sleeping in your car. Since it's a national park, you probably can't use fire. *Because the night view is beautiful, there's a possibility that some troublemakers might gather.

properties.desc_en:
■Car Camping Rating: [Good 😊] 81 points 👉️Detailed scoring and detailed map here. (December 2024)
■Coin showers available! 200 yen for 3 minutes. Details
■Report from our site's reader: The content is the same as the previous post. There are three coin showers in the adjacent grounds, costing 200 yen for 3 minutes. The second parking lot across the road is an RV park with power outlets, but the toilets are far away, so it's suitable for campervans with toilets. (Posted: September 2022, by y)
■Report from our site's reader: It's very quiet as it's one street away from the national highway. Trucks and passenger cars are separated, so you can sleep soundly if you're far enough apart. The toilets are bright and very clean. There are many vending machines. Note that there are no convenience stores within walking distance. There is night lighting throughout the premises. Be careful of low temperatures in winter. Shops open from 9:30 in the morning. Freshly baked bread, light meals, local vegetables, and souvenirs are available (older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.title_ja: リム・ふくやま第３駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■自走式立体駐車場。上の方は静かで爆睡できた（エレベーター完備）。この駐車場のトイレは閉鎖されてしまったため、裏の公園のトイレを利用する（水洗和式）。料金は（8時〜18時）最大600円、（18時〜8時）最大500円、入庫後24時間最大700円。高さ制限2.1m。　※近くのリム・ふくやま第「２」駐車場は１階トイレが閉鎖されており、近くの公園トイレも閉鎖されているが、近くのセブンまで歩いていけばトイレがあるため、車中泊は一応可能。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Self-propelled multi-story parking garage. The upper levels were quiet and I was able to sleep soundly (elevator available). The toilets in this parking garage are closed, so you have to use the toilets in the park behind it (flush toilets, Japanese style). The fee is a maximum of 600 yen (8am-6pm), a maximum of 500 yen (6pm-8am), and a maximum of 700 yen for 24 hours after entry. Height limit 2.1m. *The toilets on the first floor of the nearby Rim Fukuyama No. 2 parking garage are closed, and the toilets in the nearby park are also closed, but there are toilets if you walk to the nearby 7-Eleven, so overnight parking is technically possible. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 キララ多伎
properties.desc_ja: ■国道９号沿いの道の駅 。歩いても７分程度のところにいちじく温泉あり。駐車場に、やゝ傾斜あり。広大な駐車場で静かなのはいいのだが、風が強い日は車体もグラグラするので安眠は難しい。意外とイマイチ。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■ A roadside station along National Route 9. Ichijiku Onsen (hot spring) is about a 7-minute walk away. The parking lot has a slight slope. The large, quiet parking lot is nice, but on windy days the car shakes quite a bit, making a good night's sleep difficult. Surprisingly, it's not that great. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■国道９号沿いの道の駅 。電車の音と車の音が結構うるさい。奥に遊歩道の入り口があり、そこに車を何台か置けるスペースがあり、そこまで行けばかなり静か。トイレは遠くなるが、静かさ重視の人はこちらがいいでしょう。ちなみになんとwimax利用可能で非常に便利。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■ A roadside station along National Route 9. It's quite noisy with train and car sounds. There's an entrance to a walking path further in, with space to park several cars, and it's much quieter once you get there. The toilets are further away, but this is a good option for those who prioritize quietness. Incidentally, it's very convenient as WiMAX is available. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■高知で一番うまいラーメン屋。自家製麺と濃厚なスープが非常に美味いです。四国No1かと思われます。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■The best ramen shop in Kochi. The homemade noodles and rich soup are incredibly delicious. I think it might be the best in Shikoku. (Tabelog)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■香川名物、骨付き鶏の代表的な店。無料駐車場完備。管理人的にはヒナがおすすめ。非常に美味いです。電話予約で持ち帰りもOK。ランチもやってます。ヒナ＋鳥めしでちょっと豪華なランチはいかが。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■A representative restaurant for Kagawa's specialty, bone-in chicken. Free parking available. The manager recommends the young chicken. It's extremely delicious. Takeout is also available with phone reservations. Lunch is also served. How about a slightly luxurious lunch with young chicken and chicken rice? Tabelog

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja:
■香川最高の店の一つ。天ぷらが最高に美味い。いかざる、天ざるがおすすめ。
■再訪。いかざる、天ざる、最高。何回食ってもうまい。
■食べログ
properties.desc_en:
■One of the best restaurants in Kagawa. The tempura is absolutely delicious. Ika-zaru (cold soba noodles with squid) and Ten-zaru (cold soba noodles with tempura) are highly recommended.

■Revisited. Ika-zaru and Ten-zaru are the best. Delicious no matter how many times I eat them.

■Tabelog (restaurant review site)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja:
■香川最高の店の一つ。釜揚げうどんの聖地。ダシはいりこのくさみが強いので、ショウガをたっぷり入れる。すると臭みが消え、うまみを純粋に味わえる。これが非常に美味い。慣れるとやみつきになる。食べログ
■再訪。かまあげ大。最高に美味い。何回食ってもうまい。
properties.desc_en:
■One of the best restaurants in Kagawa. A sacred place for kamaage udon. The broth has a strong fishy smell from the dried sardines, so add plenty of ginger. This eliminates the fishy smell, allowing you to purely enjoy the umami. This is incredibly delicious. Once you get used to it, you'll be hooked. Tabelog
■Revisited. Large kamaage udon. Absolutely delicious. It's delicious no matter how many times I eat it.

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja:
■香川最高の店の一つ。とにかく美味いとしか言いようがない。食べログ
■再訪。ぬる中、ゲソ天、半熟卵。最高に美味い。何回食ってもうまい。
properties.desc_en:
■One of the best restaurants in Kagawa. Simply put, it's incredibly delicious. (Tabelog)

■Revisited. Lukewarm udon, squid tempura, soft-boiled egg. Absolutely delicious. It's delicious no matter how many times I eat it.

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja:
■香川最高の店の一つ。ここはお揚げが異常に美味い。かけうどん＋お揚げ、ゲソ天、半熟卵がおすすめ。
■再訪。温かい小、あげ、ゲソ天、半熟卵、最高に美味い。村上春樹のエッセーにも登場する名店中の名店。何回食ってもうまい。
■食べログ
properties.desc_en:
■One of the best restaurants in Kagawa. Their fried tofu is exceptionally delicious. I recommend the kake udon with fried tofu, squid tempura, and a soft-boiled egg.

■Revisited. The small hot udon with fried tofu, squid tempura, and a soft-boiled egg was absolutely delicious. A truly famous restaurant, even featured in an essay by Haruki Murakami. It's delicious no matter how many times you eat it.

■Tabelog (Japanese restaurant review site)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja:
■香川最高の店の一つ。かま玉の聖地。釜玉用の特製だし醤油が異常に美味い。大量のだし醤油を毎朝作っているそうだ。
■再訪。釜玉。最高。何回食ってもうまい。
■食べログ
properties.desc_en:
■One of the best restaurants in Kagawa. A sacred place for Kamatama udon. The special dashi soy sauce for Kamatama udon is exceptionally delicious. Apparently, they make a large amount of dashi soy sauce every morning.

■Revisited. Kamatama udon. Superb. Delicious no matter how many times I eat it.

■Tabelog (restaurant review site)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■香川の人気パン屋さん。イートインスペースが有り、パンを購入するとコーヒーを無料で飲める。讃岐富士を眺めながらテラスでパンを食べることが出来る。香川の超人気店。管理人もお気に入り（ここのカレーパンがうまい）。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■A popular bakery in Kagawa. It has an eat-in space, and you get free coffee with your bread purchase. You can enjoy your bread on the terrace while overlooking Mount Sanuki Fuji. A super popular shop in Kagawa. The administrator also loves it (their curry bread is delicious). (Tabelog)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■広大な河川敷の無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレは河川敷に点々と仮設の和式ポットントイレが点在している。きれいなトイレとは言い難い。夜間は非常に静かで良いが、深夜に警察の巡回＆職質がある。治安については自己責任。携帯電波良好。河川敷のため増水には注意。（2022年4月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en: ■A vast free parking lot and public toilets are available along the riverbank. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. Temporary Japanese-style pit toilets are scattered throughout the riverbank. They are not exactly clean. It is very quiet at night, which is nice, but there are police patrols and questioning late at night. Safety is at your own risk. Cell phone reception is good. Be careful of flooding as it is a riverbank. (Confirmed on-site by administrator in April 2022)

However, it is intended for Yayoi Green Park users, so please do not linger. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.title_ja: 脇町・うだつの町並み
properties.desc_ja: ■吉野川北岸の主要街道の撫養街道と讃岐への街道が交差する交通の要衝であり、さらに吉野川に面するため舟運の利用にも適した位置にあります。この町並みは、脇城 の城下町として成立し、藍の集散地として発展したものです。現在は明治時代頃のものを中心として江戸中期～昭和初期の85棟の伝統的建造物が建ち並んでおり、近世・近代の景観がそのまま残されています。この町並みの大きな特徴は、町家の両端に本瓦葺きで漆喰塗りの「うだつ」が多くみられることであり、このことから「うだつの町並み」の通称で親しまれています。詳細
properties.desc_en: ■Located at a crucial transportation hub where the Muyō Kaidō, a major highway on the north bank of the Yoshino River, intersects with the road to Sanuki, and also situated on the Yoshino River, it is well-suited for river transport. This townscape originated as a castle town of Waki ​​Castle and developed as a center for the collection and distribution of indigo dye. Currently, 85 traditional buildings, mainly from the Meiji era, but also dating from the mid-Edo period to the early Showa period, stand side by side, preserving the landscape of the early modern and modern eras. A distinctive feature of this townscape is the abundance of "udatsu," plastered gable ends with tiled roofs, which have earned it the nickname "Udatsu Townscape." Details
