properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■温泉マニア絶賛。料金800円、詳細
■管理人評価★4.4（泉質4.3、景色0.1）まず泉質は無色透明、無味無臭のアルカリ性単純泉で、ヌルヌル感はない。また外の景色も見られず季節感も感じられない。だが、足元からものすごい勢いで源泉が湧出しており、岩風呂の湯船に軽く析出物が付着。風呂場自体が一つの景色を現出しているので景色加点0.1点。また、ここはアルカリ性単純泉だがPHが9.2とかなり高く、湯上りがすがすがしく気持ちがよい。また、足元湧出なのに、温度が４３度程度とほぼベストな温度なのも特筆すべき点である。普通はこんなに人間に都合のよい温度では出ない（笑）足下湧出というと普通はぬるすぎるか熱すぎるかなのです。奇跡の足下湧出。
properties.desc_en:
■Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. Price: 800 yen, details
■Manager's rating ★4.4 (Spring quality 4.3, Scenery 0.1) First of all, the spring water is colorless, transparent, tasteless, and odorless alkaline simple spring water, and it doesn't feel slimy. Also, you can't see the scenery outside, and you can't feel the seasons. However, the spring water gushes out from the ground with tremendous force, and a light deposit adheres to the rock bath. The bathhouse itself presents a scenery, so I'll add 0.1 points for scenery. Also, although it is an alkaline simple spring, the pH is quite high at 9.2, so you feel refreshed and good after bathing. Furthermore, it is noteworthy that even though it gushes out from the ground, the temperature is around 43 degrees Celsius, which is almost the perfect temperature. Normally, it doesn't come out at such a convenient temperature for humans (lol). When it gushes out from the ground, it is usually either too lukewarm or too hot. A miraculous spring gushes out from the ground.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■温泉マニア絶賛。600円、詳細
■管理人評価★4.7（泉質満点4.5、景色0.2）泉質は温泉津温泉と似た感じで、緑がかった濃厚な濁り湯。析出物もバッチリ。しかもここは炭酸も豊富に含んでおり、泉質については何も言うことなし。満点。ほかの客がいない場合は小さい窓を開けると景色も開けており、川と田舎の風景が見える。川のせせらぎの音が心地よい。レベル高し。山口県最高レベルの名湯です。
properties.desc_en:
■Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. 600 yen, details
■Manager's rating ★4.7 (Spring quality 4.5, Scenery 0.2) The spring quality is similar to Yunotsu Onsen, a thick, cloudy, greenish water. The mineral deposits are excellent. Moreover, it contains plenty of carbon dioxide, so there's nothing more to say about the spring quality. Perfect score. If there are no other guests, you can open the small window to see the scenery, including the river and rural landscape. The sound of the flowing river is soothing. High level. A top-class hot spring in Yamaguchi Prefecture.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■温泉マニア絶賛。250円、詳細
■管理人評価★4.2（泉質4.2、景色0）無色透明無味無臭のアルカリ性単純泉。奥津と同様にph値が9.4と高く、湯上がりが大変気持ちがよい。しかも湯温が40度前後という適温が、足元から自噴している（極めて珍しい）。すごすぎる。この人間にとって都合のよい最適な温度で自噴しているというのが奇跡的。phと足元湧出を評価して4.2と評価
properties.desc_en:
■Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. 250 yen, details
■Manager's rating ★4.2 (Spring quality 4.2, scenery 0) A colorless, transparent, tasteless, and odorless alkaline simple spring. Similar to Okutsu, the pH value is high at 9.4, making the feeling after bathing very pleasant. Moreover, the water temperature is a comfortable 40 degrees Celsius, and it gushes out from the ground (extremely rare). It's amazing. It's miraculous that it gushes out at this optimal temperature that is so convenient for humans. Rated 4.2 based on pH and the fact that it gushes out from the ground.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■温泉マニアが絶賛の名湯。電話予約制（0868-52-0602）。貸切料（1時間）1,100円 + 入浴料（大人1,100円、小人550円）、詳細
■管理人評価★4.8（泉質4.2、景色特別加算0.6）まず泉質は無色透明の単純泉、無味無臭、軽く析出物、当然源泉掛け流し。また、東和楼と同様にph値が高く湯上がりが非常にすがすがしく気持ちが良い。析出物が認められるのとPHの高さを評価して、泉質は4.2との評価だが、ここは景色が極めて素晴らしい。紅葉と天然の滝を一望できる絶景。秋田の鷹の湯温泉みたいな感じ。鷹の湯温泉は、滝が人工のコンクリートだが、こちらは完全に天然の岩石で構成された滝。非常に美しい。お湯の温度は39度ほどでやや低め。岡山にもこんな風雅な温泉があったんですね。秋が最高に美しいです。極上温泉ありがとうございます。ちなみに値段は一人1100円ですが、完全に貸し切り制なので仕方ないかとおもいます。
properties.desc_en:
■A famous hot spring highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. Reservations by phone (0868-52-0602). Private bath fee (1 hour): 1,100 yen + bathing fee (adults 1,100 yen, children 550 yen). Details
■Manager's rating ★4.8 (Spring quality 4.2, special bonus for scenery 0.6) First of all, the spring water is a colorless, transparent, simple spring, tasteless and odorless, with a slight deposit, and of course, it's a free-flowing hot spring. Also, like Towa-ro, the pH value is high, making the post-bath feeling very refreshing and pleasant. The spring quality is rated 4.2 due to the presence of deposits and the high pH, ​​but the scenery here is absolutely magnificent. A spectacular view overlooking the autumn leaves and a natural waterfall. It's similar to Takanoyu Onsen in Akita. While Takanoyu Onsen's waterfall is artificial concrete, this one is made entirely of natural rock. It's very beautiful. The water temperature is a little on the low side at around 39 degrees Celsius. I didn't know there was such an elegant hot spring in Okayama. Autumn is absolutely beautiful. Thank you for the superb hot spring. By the way, the price is 1100 yen per person, but I suppose that's unavoidable since it's a completely private experience.

properties.desc_ja:
■シャワー🚿：道路向かいの「IWADO BASE」にて一回500円で利用可能。シャワーのみOK。
■当サイト読者様レポート：無料駐車場、夜間閉鎖されない。トイレあり、水洗和式、夜間閉鎖されない。静か。海の横で海水浴など可能。暗いので星がきれいに見える。向かいにアウトドア施設があり、飲食（アルコール提供あり、テイクアウトあり）、酒類の販売、ＢＢＱ用品レンタル、ＢＢＱ食材販売、マリンアクティビティ用品レンタル、個室カラオケ、バレルサウナ、温水シャワーがある。（※追記：シャワーも有料（500円）で使えるようです。海水浴で使ってもいいとのことでした。ちなみに車中泊には必要ありませんが、コインロッカーもありました。）詳細。入浴施設の場合：徒歩約15分に温泉施設「砂丘温泉ふれあい会館」（中学生以上570円小学生以下230円、詳細）（投稿：2025年4月、l様）
properties.desc_en:
■ Showers 🚿: Available at "IWADO BASE" across the road for 500 yen per use. Shower-only use is OK.

■ Reader Reports: Free parking, not closed at night. Toilets available, flush toilets (Japanese style), not closed at night. Quiet. Swimming is possible as it's next to the sea. It's dark so you can see the stars beautifully. There is an outdoor facility across the street with food and drinks (alcohol available, takeout available), alcohol sales, BBQ equipment rental, BBQ food sales, marine activity equipment rental, private karaoke rooms, barrel sauna, and hot showers. (※Addendum: It seems that showers are also available for a fee (500 yen). It was said that they can be used for swimming. By the way, there were also coin lockers, although they are not necessary for overnight stays in your car.) Details. For bathing facilities: The hot spring facility "Sakyu Onsen Fureai Kaikan" is about a 15-minute walk away (570 yen for junior high school students and older, 230 yen for elementary school students and younger, details) (Posted: April 2025, by l)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.desc_ja: ■がっかり世界遺産。政治力で無理矢理登録をねじ込んだ感じ。期待せずに行くと楽しめるかも。京都や奈良みたいなのを期待していくとがっかりする。石見銀山を見に行くというよりも、この周辺に中国地方最高レベルの温泉が点在しているので、温泉のほうをメインに行くべき。
properties.desc_en: ■A disappointing World Heritage Site. It feels like it was forced into registration through political maneuvering. You might enjoy it if you go without expectations. You'll be disappointed if you go expecting something like Kyoto or Nara. Rather than going to see the Iwami Silver Mine, you should go mainly for the hot springs, as there are some of the best hot springs in the Chugoku region scattered around the area.

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: 薬研堀 八昌（お好み焼き有名店）
properties.desc_ja:
■カキのバター焼きが超絶うまい（冬季限定、３月末まで）。その他ホルモンミックス、牛バラ焼き、すじポンも最高。お好み焼きは、そば肉玉＋イカ天チーズがおすすめ。色々食べ歩くとここの凄さがわかります。当サイト管理人も毎年冬にリピート。
■食べログ
properties.desc_en:
■The butter-grilled oysters are absolutely delicious (winter only, until the end of March). Other excellent dishes include the mixed offal, grilled beef ribs, and beef tendon with ponzu sauce. For okonomiyaki, I recommend the soba, meat, and egg okonomiyaki with squid tempura and cheese. Trying various dishes will show you just how great this place is. The administrator of this site is a repeat customer every winter.

■Tabelog

properties.desc_en: ■A famous okonomiyaki restaurant. Apparently, it's the restaurant that invented Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki. One of the original Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki restaurants. There are three branches of Micchan: the main branch, Shintenchi Micchan, and Iseya. (Wikipedia, Tabelog)

properties.title_en: Osafune Service Area (Bizen Osafune Service Area)
properties.desc_ja:
■おさふねサービスエリアは建て替えのため2024年5月6日で閉館。リニューアルオープンは2026年中の予定。
■入浴♨️：長船温泉：690円、詳細
■国道沿い、新幹線うるさい、トラック大量でうるさい。
■当サイト読者様レポート：施設名:おさふねサービスエリア。 いわゆるドライブイン。入浴施設有り。 目の前が国道2号で交通量が多いので寝るのはお勧めしない。トイレは店外にも有る。 ※追記：先程のメール投稿で書き忘れが有ったのですが、寝るのはもう少し川沿いに上流に向かった所にある河川敷のキャンプ場の方が良さげです。(地元民なのでここでは寝たことがありませんが、時々キャンピングカーを見かけます)
properties.desc_en:
■Osafune Service Area will close on May 6, 2024 for reconstruction. The reopening is scheduled for sometime in 2026.

■Bathing♨️: Osafune Onsen: 690 yen, details

■Located along a national highway, noisy with Shinkansen trains and lots of trucks.

■Report from a reader of this site: Facility name: Osafune Service Area. A typical drive-in. Has bathing facilities. Not recommended for sleeping as it's right on National Route 2 with heavy traffic. Toilets are also available outside the building. ※Addendum: I forgot to mention this in my previous email submission, but a better place to sleep would be the campsite on the riverbank further upstream along the river. (I'm a local and have never slept here, but I occasionally see campervans.)

The water itself is not particularly impressive. It is free-flowing but chlorine is added (not recirculated).

■Manager's rating: ★4.25 (Water quality 3.75, scenery 0.5, overall atmosphere evaluation) This is a hot spring where you enjoy the atmosphere of the building, etc. Depending on the grade, it ranges from 400 yen to 1500 yen. A hot spring building that served as a model for Spirited Away.

properties.desc_ja:
■600円、不定休、詳細。※電話確認必須！多数の温泉マニア大絶賛。山陰最強の秘湯との評価。
■管理人評価★4.9（泉質文句なし満点4.5、景色0.4）般若寺温泉と並ぶ、中国地方最高レベルの名湯。まず泉質は、濃厚な鉄分含有の炭酸泉。大分の七里田温泉みたいな感じ。あちらはおっさんが狭い浴槽にぎゅうぎゅう詰めだが、こちらは500円で一つの湯船を1時間独占できる。管理人は左から三つ目の湯部屋を選択。この辺の仕掛けも面白い。浴槽は析出物がごっそりついているが、汚い感じは全くなく、入念に手入れされていることがよくわかる。非常に美しい。湯船に入ると炭酸の泡が沢山つく。窓を開けると露天に早変わり。紅葉がきれい。せせらぎの音も心地よい。極上と言うほか無い。幸せな1時間でした。かなりおすすめ。500円というのが申しわけない。日帰り客だけではこの施設を維持できないだろう。次は泊まって応援したいと思った。ここへのルートだが、北からアクセスする道はかなりやばいので南の三瓶山から回る道で来るのがよい。
properties.desc_en:
■600 yen, irregular closing days, details. *Phone confirmation required! Highly praised by many hot spring enthusiasts. Rated as the best hidden hot spring in the San'in region.

■Manager's rating ★4.9 (Spring quality: perfect 4.5, Scenery: 0.4) A top-level hot spring in the Chugoku region, on par with Hannyaji Onsen. First of all, the spring quality is a carbonated spring with a high iron content. It's similar to Shichirida Onsen in Oita. There, men are crammed into a small bathtub, but here you can have one bathtub all to yourself for an hour for 500 yen. The manager chose the third bath room from the left. This kind of setup is also interesting. The bathtub is covered in mineral deposits, but it doesn't feel dirty at all, and it's clear that it's meticulously maintained. It's very beautiful. When you get in the bath, lots of carbonated bubbles form. Open the window and it instantly becomes an open-air bath. The autumn leaves are beautiful. The sound of the stream is also pleasant. It's nothing short of superb. It was a blissful hour. Highly recommended. I feel bad paying only 500 yen. This facility probably can't be sustained with just day-trippers. I want to stay overnight next time to support them. As for the route to get here, the road from the north is quite dangerous, so it's better to come via the road that goes around from Mt. Sanbe in the south.

The mineral deposits in the bathtub are incredible. There's nothing more to say about the spring water quality. A perfect score without complaint. As for the view, there's a sheer cliff outside the window, so there's no view, but the building is nostalgic and interesting, the view from the bathtub itself is magnificent, and although unrelated to the hot spring, the view from the rooftop is nice, and I was happy that there was a coffee service, so I added 0.2 for that. I really liked it.

properties.desc_ja:
■500円、詳細
■多数の温泉マニアが大絶賛。駐車場 あり 10台（駐車料金 無料）
■管理人評価★4.6（泉質満点4.5、景色は露天風呂は無いが全体を評価して0.1）まず泉質は茶褐色の濁り湯で炭酸泉。そして特筆すべきは、なんと足下からプクプクと炭酸とともに沸いている！！ボーリングでは無く、なんと自然湧出だそうです。奇跡の温泉。管理人の知る限り、炭酸泉で足下から勢いよく炭酸のアワがプクプク沸いているのはココだけだと思います。これだけでも大満足だが、秋〜翌春は、炭酸泉だけでは寒いので、仕上げとして五右衛門風呂で加温した湯に入れる。これがマキを焚いて暖めるもので、そのマキを焚く香りが非常に素晴らしい。感激しました。露天風呂は無いので景色の加点は0.1だけなため4.6という評価ですが、ここは本物の極上温泉です。管理人（オーナー？）のお姉さんも気さくでいい人です。かなり気に入りました。山陰を代表する名湯の一つです。応援したくなる温泉です。
properties.desc_en:
■500 yen, details
■Highly praised by many hot spring enthusiasts. Parking available for 10 cars (free parking)
■Manager's rating ★4.6 (4.5 for water quality, 0.1 for scenery despite the lack of an open-air bath) First of all, the water quality is a cloudy, reddish-brown carbonated spring. And what's particularly noteworthy is that it bubbles up from the ground along with the carbonation! It's not drilled, but apparently it's a natural spring. A miraculous hot spring. As far as the manager knows, this is the only place where carbonated bubbles vigorously bubble up from the ground. This alone is very satisfying, but from autumn to the following spring, the carbonated spring alone is too cold, so as a finishing touch, you can soak in the heated water in the Goemon bath. This is heated by burning firewood, and the aroma of the burning firewood is absolutely wonderful. I was deeply impressed. There is no open-air bath, so the scenery score is only 0.1, hence the rating of 4.6, but this is a truly superb hot spring. The manager (owner?) is a friendly and nice lady. I really liked it. It's one of the most famous hot springs in the San'in region. It's a hot spring that makes you want to support it.

■管理人評価★4.6（泉質満点4.5、景色全体を評価して加算0.1）ここもノスタルジックで雰囲気が面白い。昭和の空気が漂っています。浴槽は物凄い析出物で、湯温はかなり高い。泉質は薬師湯とほぼ同じ。緑がかった高濃度の極上温泉。非常にすばらしい。泉質については何も言うことなし。窓をあけられないので景観はゼロだが、湯船自体の析出物の景色を評価して0.1加算。極上。管理人は薬師湯と両方はいりましたが、どちらか一つしか入れないと言われたら薬師湯を選びますかね。両方味わいがあるので両方入るのがおすすめです。
properties.desc_en:
■500 yen, details. Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. Parking available (20 spaces, free parking)
■Manager's rating ★4.6 (4.5 for water quality, 0.1 added for overall scenery) This place is also nostalgic and has an interesting atmosphere. It has a Showa era feel. The bathtub has an incredible amount of mineral deposits, and the water temperature is quite high. The water quality is almost the same as Yakushi-yu. A superb hot spring with a greenish tint and high concentration. Absolutely wonderful. Nothing more to say about the water quality. There is no view because the windows cannot be opened, but 0.1 added for the scenery of the mineral deposits in the bathtub itself. Superb. The manager has been to both Yakushi-yu and this one, but if told to go to only one, I would choose Yakushi-yu. Both have their own charm, so it is recommended to go to both.

Michi-no-Eki Hawaii is convenient with a Poplar convenience store attached, but there are too many idling trucks. It's a windy area, so I was able to sleep comfortably with the windows slightly open. For those car camping with young children, Michi-no-Eki Port Akasaki is recommended. There are playgrounds, a grassy park, and a restaurant serving seafood next door. Conveniently located between Tottori Sand Dunes, Matsue, Mt. Daisen, and Mt. Hiruzen (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_ja:

■幹線道から完全分離、トラックと完全分離、ここはすごい！かなり良い。しかも温泉施設も併設。ここまで車中泊に適した道の駅 はなかなかないです。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：元々交通量が少ない国道から更に奥まったところに駐車場があり静か。標高もソコソコあって涼しい(標高378m)、コンビニは車で5分くらいの距離。食堂は昼間しか開店していないが、21時まで温泉に入れるのが素晴らしい。温泉も泉質は普通ながら、五右衛門風呂や檜風呂などなかなか凝っている。車で30分圏内に「柚木慈生温泉」「木部谷温泉」と言った山陰でも指折りの温泉もある。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■ February 2025 Administrator's On-Site Verification: Car Camping Rating [S Rank 🤩] 86 points 👉️ Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■ Bathing ♨️: "Ganjoju Onsen" 520 yen, details
■ Completely separated from the main road, completely separated from trucks, this place is amazing! It's really good. Moreover, it has a hot spring facility attached. There aren't many roadside stations that are this suitable for car camping. (Older post from before 2019)
■ Report from our site's reader: The parking lot is located even further back from the national highway, which originally had little traffic, so it's quiet. The altitude is also decent and it's cool (altitude 378m), and there's a convenience store about a 5-minute drive away. The restaurant is only open during the day, but it's great that you can use the hot spring until 9pm. The hot spring water quality is ordinary, but it's quite elaborate with a Goemon bath and a cypress bath. Within a 30-minute drive there are also some of the best hot springs in the San'in region, such as "Yuzuki Jisei Onsen" and "Kibedani Onsen". (Older posts from before 2019)

■当サイト読者様レポート：絶景の夕日を見られる道の駅 。駐車場も広く、トイレ・土産物スペースも充実。パイパスのSA的な道の駅 。本線と完全分離で大変よいが海沿いで風の影響をモロに受ける。風が強いと車が揺れまくる。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：今月楽しみに行ってみたら、2Fレストランのバイキングつぶれたみたいで、イタリアンレストランと魚中心の和食レストランしかありませんでした。代わりにホテル松尾の名物、海賊丼税込み1512円を食べました。うちわエビ等のっており豪快で見応え、食べ応えあり、美味しかったです。おかみさんが気さくで郷土に詳しく、料理の質問にもよく答えてくれます。美人です。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■ February 2025 Administrator's On-Site Verification: Car Camping Rating [Rank B] ​​67 points 👉️ Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■ Report from our site's reader: A roadside station where you can see a spectacular sunset. The parking lot is spacious, and the toilets and souvenir area are well-equipped. It's a roadside station like a service area on a bypass. It's very good as it's completely separated from the main road, but it's right by the sea and is heavily affected by the wind. When the wind is strong, the car shakes a lot. (Older post from before 2019)
■ Report from our site's reader: I went there this month looking forward to it, but it seems the buffet restaurant on the 2nd floor has closed, and there was only an Italian restaurant and a Japanese restaurant mainly serving fish. Instead, I ate Hotel Matsuo's specialty, the Pirate Bowl, for 1512 yen including tax. It was topped with slipper lobster and other ingredients, was impressive and visually appealing, and very tasty. The proprietress is friendly, knowledgeable about the local area, and answers questions about the food well. She's beautiful. (Older post from before 2019)

There are two toilets, and the one on the right side of the main building was particularly impressive. There were no trash cans or water taps. For bathing, I recommend "Ryuzaki Onsen Chidori," which is a 10-minute drive away. Details. Also, along Prefectural Road 4, which runs along the southern coast of the island, there are many unmanned orange stands. This is likely due to aging facilities or issues with the designated manager, but currently, it seems safe to consider it effectively closed. Therefore, unfortunately, it is no longer a spot with bathing facilities. (Posted: April 2025, r)
■Report from our site's reader: I recently used the "Roadside Station Komatsu Oasis" in Ehime for free. Details. It was very quiet and free to use, which was great, but when I arrived in the evening, the toilets were usable, but when I went back around 10 PM, the shutters were closed and I couldn't use them. It was my first time at a roadside station where the toilets were unusable at night, so I was flustered. I wanted to let you know in case it is helpful for future users. (Posted: May 2023, by MiuMiu, a beginner at car camping)
■*Note from the administrator: The toilets in the central building appear to be closed at night. There are toilets available at night a short walk away on the parking lot side of the highway oasis. Detailed report blog

■入浴♨️：《天然温泉 香南楽湯》 700円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：追加情報　2025・5・15に現地確認。温泉隣接(￥700、65歳以上￥550)、徒歩圏内に7/11など、利便性はいいでしょう。ただ、駐車場は狭く、中心のトラックスペースを取り巻くように乗用車スペースがあるため、トラックが入ると騒音は避けられないでしょう。温泉前にもいい感じのＰはあるものの、「車中泊お断り」看板が林立しています。前面道路を隔てた第２Ｐも夜間閉鎖です。トイレはきれいです。（投稿：2025年5月、tossan様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：車中泊スポットとしてまだ穴場状態か？静かで快適でした。道の駅のレストラン（21時まで）以外に、温泉内にも食事処があります。（2019年3月利用）
■奥の方は静かで良い。温泉の質は至って平凡で特筆するものはないが、道の駅 併設というのはやはり便利である。九月末の訪問だが、すでに肌寒く、快適な車中泊ができた。wimaxの電波もOK （2019年以前の古い投稿）
■「香川Wifi」なる無料wifiが利用可能！一回30分を8回まで利用可能。駐車場の車の中から利用可能。これは便利。wimaxも利用可能。ただし、人気がありすぎて車中泊の車多すぎて奥に停められない可能性あり。道沿いはうるさい。温泉が営業終わるまでは人の出入りが多くうるさいが、23時を過ぎると県道の交通量も少なくなり、静かになる。ただし、駐車場中央部にトラック二台分の駐車場所があり、トラックが来るとアイドリングがうるさい。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■やはり、アイドリング厨のトラックが来るとうるさいですね。駐車場の中央にトラック駐車場がある構造が根本的な問題か。トラックが来るか来ないかで快適さが全然違う。Aランク取り消し。やはり、Aランクの条件として、「トラック駐車場と分離」は絶対ですね。（2019年以前の古い投稿）

■November 2024 Administrator's On-Site Verification: Car Camping Evaluation [Excluded Rank 😅] 80 points 👉️Click here for on-site photos and detailed map

■Report from our site's reader: Additional information. On-site verification on May 15, 2025. It's conveniently located next to a hot spring (700 yen, 550 yen for those 65 and older), with 7/11 within walking distance. However, the parking lot is small, and passenger car spaces surround a central truck space, so noise from trucks is unavoidable. There's a nice-looking parking area in front of the hot spring, but there are many "No Car Camping" signs. The second parking area across the road is also closed at night. The toilets are clean. (Posted: May 2025, by tossan)
■Report from our site's reader: Is this still a hidden gem as a car camping spot? It was quiet and comfortable. Besides the roadside station restaurant (open until 9 PM), there are also dining options within the hot spring facility. (Used in March 2019)
■The back area is quiet and nice. The quality of the hot spring is quite ordinary and nothing special, but the fact that it's attached to a roadside station is certainly convenient. I visited at the end of September, and it was already chilly, making for a comfortable overnight stay in my car. WiMAX signal was also OK. (Older post from before 2019)
■Free Wi-Fi called "Kagawa Wifi" is available! You can use it for 30 minutes at a time, up to 8 times. You can use it from inside your car in the parking lot. This is convenient. WiMAX is also available. However, it's so popular that there are so many cars parked overnight that you might not be able to park in the back. The roadside is noisy. It's noisy with a lot of people coming and going until the hot spring closes, but after 11 PM the traffic on the prefectural road decreases and it becomes quiet. However, there is parking space for two trucks in the center of the parking lot, and the idling noise from trucks is loud. (Older post from before 2019)
■As expected, it's noisy when trucks with idle engines come by. The fundamental problem is the structure of having a truck parking area in the middle of the parking lot. The level of comfort is completely different depending on whether trucks come or not. A-rank revoked. Surely, "separation from truck parking" is an absolute requirement for an A-rank. (Older post from before 2019)

■1000円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：２０２３年１１月の平日に利用。露天風呂番付で「西の横綱」にランクされた湯原温泉。しかし１００％の源泉かけ流しの施設は少なく、ここはその貴重な湯のひとつです。アルカリ性の柔らかい湯がガサ肌をツルツルにしてくれ、しかも低張性なのでじわじわと沁み込んだ成分が体の芯ポカ感をいつまでも保ってくれます。日帰り客の食事営業は今は休止中でした。向いの市営駐車場【有料💰️】に観光客用の無料駐車枠があります。（投稿：2023年11月、n様）
properties.desc_en:
■1000 yen, details
■Report from a reader of this site: Used on a weekday in November 2023. Yubara Onsen is ranked as the "Western Yokozuna" in the open-air bath rankings. However, there are few facilities with 100% free-flowing hot spring water, and this is one of those precious baths. The alkaline, soft water makes rough skin smooth, and because it is hypotonic, the components that slowly penetrate the body keep you warm from the core for a long time. The restaurant service for day-trippers was currently suspended. There are free parking spaces for tourists in the municipal parking lot across the street [paid 💰️]. (Posted by: n, November 2023)

properties.title_en: Kaminoseki Town, Kaminoseki Castle Mountain Historical Park""
properties.desc_ja:
■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2026年2月現地調査）
■当サイト読者様レポート：追加情報　’25・4・6に車中泊　前の方が書かれているとおり、とても静かで快適です。高台にあり、海の眺めがきれいです。西に開いているので夕暮れ時はとくに。入浴は2.7km戻ったところ、道の駅の近くに「鳩子の湯」（詳細）、「nifty温泉」にクーポンがあります（詳細）。付近に大きな食料品店はないので、島に渡る前（例えば柳井のトライアル）などで仕込みを。なお、道の駅裏の岸壁では波止釣りをする人たちがいました。餌の地アミを道の駅で売っています。（投稿：2025年4月、tossan様）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。トイレは超キレイな水洗洋式。夜間電気もつく。ドコモ電波OK。道の駅上関海峡が船のエンジン音が猛烈にうるさいのでこちらに避難。朝まで快眠でした。感謝。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is possible. (On-site survey February 2026)
■Report from our site's reader: Additional information. Overnight parking on April 6, 2025. As the previous person wrote, it is very quiet and comfortable. It is on a hill and has a beautiful view of the sea. It opens to the west, so it is especially nice at sunset. For bathing, there is "Hatoko no Yu" (details) near the roadside station, 2.7km back, and there are coupons for "nifty Onsen" (details). There are no large grocery stores nearby, so stock up before crossing to the island (for example, at Trial in Yanai). Also, there were people fishing from the pier behind the roadside station. Local krill for bait is sold at the roadside station. (Posted: April 2025, by tossan)
■Free parking and public toilets. The toilets are very clean flush toilets. Lights are on at night. Docomo signal OK. I took refuge here because the noise from the ship engines at the Kaminoseki Kaikyo roadside station was unbearably loud. I slept soundly until morning. Thank you. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_en:
■See photos of the Milky Way taken here

In autumn, the Tengudake mountain in front is adorned with vibrant red autumn leaves, making it incredibly beautiful. The sunrise is also beautiful. However, the climb is quite challenging. Mountain lodge rates start from 9000 yen, see details. Elevation 1900m.

properties.desc_ja:
■ここで撮影された天の川写真を見てみる
■天体観測スポット。無料駐車場とトイレがあり車中泊も可能。標高は461m。天頂〜北の暗さはなかなか良いが、南に広島市があり、南天が明るいので天の川鑑賞にはイマイチ。北天を見たい時に。
properties.desc_en:
■See photos of the Milky Way taken here
■Astronomical observation spot. Free parking and toilets are available, and overnight parking is possible. The elevation is 461m. The darkness from the zenith to the north is quite good, but Hiroshima City is to the south, and the southern sky is bright, so it's not ideal for viewing the Milky Way. Use it when you want to see the northern sky.

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.title_ja: ひろしま県民の森 スキー場
properties.desc_ja:
■ここで撮影された天の川写真を見てみる
■夏は天体観測スポットとして有名。空が開けている。標高810m。南天は明るいので北天用。
properties.desc_en:
■See photos of the Milky Way taken here
■Famous as a stargazing spot in summer. The sky is unobstructed. Altitude 810m. The southern sky is bright, so it's best for observing the northern sky.

properties.desc_ja:
■ここで撮影された天の川写真を見てみる
■無料駐車場、公衆トイレあり。ここに来るために通る石鎚スカイラインは通行可能な時間があるので注意👉️詳細。この辺（詳細場所）が南～西の視界が開けていて天の川観測におすすめ。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■See photos of the Milky Way taken here
■Free parking and public restrooms available. Note that the Ishizuchi Skyline, which you take to get here, has limited operating hours 👉️Details. This area (details) offers unobstructed views to the south and west, making it ideal for observing the Milky Way. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Camp Spot + Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■料金詳細
■入浴♨️：《天然温泉 尾道みなと館》751円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：24時間最大700円のコインパーキング。車中泊の後、徒歩で市内観光をお考えの方にピッタリ。公衆トイレがすぐ近くにあり、目の前のホテルで温泉の利用【有料💰️】も可能。ただし、利用可能台数が少ないため、空いていない可能性大。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Price Details
■Bathing♨️: 《Natural Hot Spring Onomichi Minato-kan》 751 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: A coin-operated parking lot with a maximum charge of 700 yen for 24 hours. Perfect for those planning to explore the city on foot after spending the night in their car. There are public restrooms nearby, and you can also use the hot springs at the hotel across the street [for a fee💰️]. However, there are only a limited number of available spaces, so it's highly likely that there won't be any available. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja:
■食べログ
■地物のふぐが格安でうまい！ふぐの唐揚げ（揚げたて）＋ふぐ刺しの「ふくふく定食」2000円が非常に美味しかった。これが2000円は絶対安い。おすすめ。
■唐戸市場のビルの駐車場は無条件で1時間無料。
properties.desc_en:
■Tabelog (restaurant review site)
■Local pufferfish is delicious and inexpensive! The "Fukufuku Set Meal" (2000 yen), which includes freshly fried pufferfish and pufferfish sashimi, was extremely delicious. 2000 yen is definitely cheap for this. Highly recommended.

■Parking at the Karato Market building is free for the first hour unconditionally.

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja:
■食べログ
■10月下旬〜3月末か4月中旬頃まで生カキのカキオコを食べられる。シーズン外は冷凍カキ。ホントにここはうまい。カキオコのジョウが1550円だが惜しくない。また食べたい。Sランクと評価させていただきます。岡山の至宝。「タマガキ」（カキ＋ネギの卵とじ）も非常に美味いのでおすすめ。
■20回目くらいのリピート。高いが相変わらず美味い。カキオコのジョウ、1550円でも後悔しない。また食べたいと思わせる魅力がある。
■カキのお好み焼き＝「カキオコ」で有名な店。非常に美味い。ムチャクチャ並ぶので、開店１時間前に並ぶ（名前を書く紙がある）か、それか１５時くらいに行くのがおすすめ。休日の１２時くらいに行くと２時間くらい待つことになります。
■久しぶりに再訪したがやっぱりメチャ美味い。お好み焼きとして最高レベルかと思います。名前を書く紙が店の中にあるので、10時くらいに来て名前を書いて、注文書を書いて、車の中でのんびり待ってればいい。開店前でも店のトイレは使える。wimaxも電波きてる。開店前に客が待っていれば、だいたい10:50くらいにオープンとなる。
properties.desc_en:
■Tabelog (restaurant review site)
■You can eat kakioko (oyster okonomiyaki) with fresh oysters from late October to the end of March or mid-April. Outside of season, they use frozen oysters. This place is really delicious. The kakioko is 1550 yen, but it's worth it. I want to eat it again. I'll rate it as S rank. A treasure of Okayama. The "Tamagaki" (oysters + green onions in egg) is also very delicious and highly recommended.

■This is about my 20th visit. It's expensive, but as delicious as ever. I don't regret paying 1550 yen for the kakioko. It has an appeal that makes you want to eat it again.

■A famous restaurant for oyster okonomiyaki = "kakioko". It's extremely delicious. There's a huge line, so I recommend lining up an hour before opening (there's a paper to write your name on) or going around 3 PM. If you go around 12 PM on a holiday, you'll have to wait about two hours.

■I revisited after a long time, and it's still incredibly delicious. I think it's the highest level of okonomiyaki. There's a sign-up sheet inside the shop, so you can come around 10am, write your name down, fill out the order form, and then just relax and wait in your car. You can use the shop's restrooms even before opening time. There's also WiMAX signal. If there are customers waiting before opening time, they usually open around 10:50am.

Cell phone reception is OK. It is very quiet at night, but there are no people around, so safety is at your own risk. One drawback is that the entire parking lot is slightly sloped. ■当サイト読者様レポート：広島のマリーン公園 なのですが、車中泊マップさんの情報を元に訪れたところ、注意書きの看板に車中泊禁止の貼り紙が追加されていました（添付画像）。入口ではなく、公園に掲示されていて、私も公園を散歩していて偶然目につきました。残念ですが、今後車中泊としては利用できないようです（注意書きの貼り紙の写真ファイルを添付します⇒添付画像）。（投稿：2024年10月、d様）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレはきれいな水洗で洋式もあり。スケボー少年など、若者が集って騒ぐ場合ありとの報告あり。治安については自己責任で。（2020年1月管理人現地確認）
■当サイト読者様レポート：交差点入って右行くとナフコの駐車場ですが、左は無料で開放されている駐車場。意外と騒音も少なくて少し歩くが公園内にトイレもあり。コンビニは近くにないので車中泊するときはパンなどを買っておくとベスト。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：掲載済みのコメントに近くにコンビニはないとありますが、1ブロック西側に「セブンイレブン廿日市木材港店」があります。隣接する港湾の道路は深夜でもトラックがそれなりに通るので、多少うるさいが、十分寝られます。情報通りトイレもありました。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. While physically possible to park overnight, please note that it is clearly marked as 【No Overnight Parking ⛔️】. (On-site survey, December 2025)
■Report from a reader of this site: Regarding Marine Park in Hiroshima, based on information from the Overnight Parking Map website, I visited and found that a sign prohibiting overnight parking had been added to the existing warning sign (attached image). It was posted in the park, not at the entrance, and I happened to notice it while walking through the park. Unfortunately, it seems that it will no longer be possible to park overnight (attached photo file of the warning sign ⇒ attached image). (Submitted by d, October 2024)
■Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. The toilets are clean flush toilets, including Western-style. There have been reports of young people, such as skateboarders, gathering and making noise. Use your own responsibility regarding safety. (On-site verification by administrator, January 2020)
■Report from a reader of this site: Turning right after entering the intersection leads to the Nafco parking lot, but the left side is a free parking lot. Surprisingly, there's not much noise, and although it's a short walk, there's a toilet in the park. There are no convenience stores nearby, so it's best to buy bread and other snacks before you go car camping. (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from a reader of this site: While a previously published comment mentioned there are no convenience stores nearby, there's a "Seven-Eleven Hatsukaichi Lumber Port Store" one block to the west. The adjacent port road has a fair amount of truck traffic even late at night, so it's a bit noisy, but you can sleep perfectly well. There was a toilet, as reported. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight parking is possible. (On-site survey in May 2025)
■Report from a reader of this site: Toilets available, no streetlights, vending machines for drinks available (many also in nearby commercial facilities). I used it from late night to early morning while sightseeing at the Tottori Sand Dunes. It is normally a paid parking lot, but it seems to be open for free at night. There was no lighting and it was pitch black. It was quiet and I could sleep well. Attached image 1, Attached image 2 (Posted by: s, October 2022)
■Report from a reader of this site: This is a parking lot at the entrance to the Tottori Sand Dunes. It is open from late afternoon. There are toilets, and there is a place to wash your feet before going to the beach, and it feels great to wake up early in the morning and go see the sand dunes. (Older post from before 2019)

■当サイト読者様レポート：２０２３年１１月の平日に立ち寄り。砂丘会館の北側に接する駐車場の一角には「観光用無料P」と表示された数台分の枠があります。向い（西側）の鳥取砂丘ビジターセンターの駐車場は有料なので、この砂丘会館Pに駐めれば砂丘見学も無料でできます。そのビジターセンターの敷地にある２４H トイレには外からでも行けるため、この無料Pで車中泊が可能です。（投稿：2023年11月、n様）

■Report from our website reader: Visited on a weekday in November 2023. In a corner of the parking lot adjacent to the north side of the Sand Dune Hall, there are several spaces marked "Free Parking for Tourists." The parking lot at the Tottori Sand Dunes Visitor Center across the street (west side) is paid, so if you park at this Sand Dune Hall parking lot, you can also visit the sand dunes for free. The 24-hour toilets on the grounds of the visitor center can be accessed from outside, so overnight parking is possible in this free parking lot. (Posted by: N, November 2023)

■当サイト読者様レポート：倉敷駅周辺の行きつけの居酒屋さんに行くために泊まりました。駅までは15分程度で歩いて行けますが、途中に用水路が多く、酔っている時は注意が必要です。トイレは綺麗ですが、ウォシュレット、温座ではありません。夜は静かでしたか、朝は早くから、地元の方❓が利用されていました。（投稿：2025年3月、n様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：倉敷美観地区に近く、温泉やコンビニも車で10分以内にあり、いい場所だと思います。静かな場所ですが、夜中に職質がありました。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。静かで良い。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Detailed map and photos of the toilets 🚻. Overnight stays in vehicles are possible. (On-site survey, March 2025)
■Report from a reader of this site: I stayed here to go to my favorite izakaya (Japanese pub) near Kurashiki Station. It's about a 15-minute walk to the station, but there are many irrigation canals along the way, so caution is needed if you're drunk. The toilets are clean, but they don't have bidet seats or heated seats. It was quiet at night, but early in the morning, locals were using them. (Posted by: n, March 2025)
■Report from a reader of this site: It's close to the Kurashiki Bikan Historical Quarter, and there are hot springs and convenience stores within a 10-minute drive, so I think it's a good location. It's a quiet place, but I was stopped and questioned by the police in the middle of the night. (Older post from before 2019)
■Free parking and public toilets. Quiet and nice. (Older post from before 2019)

■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2025年2月現地調査）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ（👉️トイレ🚻の写真と詳細案内図はこちら（2025年2月撮影））。駐車場の入口に、「利用時間　4月～10月：7-20時、11月～3月：7-19時」と書いた看板と門扉がある。2023年2月に来たときは夜間も門扉は閉鎖されていなかったが、場合によっては本当に夜間閉鎖する場合もあるのかもしれないので注意。携帯電波OK。高速道路の走行音が多少聞こえる程度で基本静か。治安については自己責任。（2023年2月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:

■Free parking and public toilets (👉️Photos of the toilets 🚻 and detailed map are here (taken in February 2025)). At the entrance to the parking lot, there is a sign and gate that reads, "Operating hours: April-October: 7am-8pm, November-March: 7am-7pm." When I visited in February 2023, the gate was not closed at night, but please note that it may be closed at night in some cases. Cell phone reception is OK. It is generally quiet, with only slight noise from highway traffic. Safety is your own responsibility. (On-site confirmation by the administrator in February 2023)

■当サイト読者様レポート：トラックだらけで静かとは言い難い。強風時は橋から謎の共鳴音で怖い。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:

■Report from our site's reader: There is a welcome gate, so you can enter the parking area from the general road. Of course, vehicles cannot enter, but there is a parking lot on the general road side (for 7 cars). (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from our site's reader: It's hard to call it quiet with lots of trucks. When there are strong winds, there is a mysterious resonant sound from the bridge, which is scary. (Older post from before 2019)

■PA on a free bypass. It's generally sloped and noisy, so it's difficult to get a good night's sleep. Not highly recommended. By the way, the route to get here is tricky for first-timers; there's an interchange exit before the PA entrance, and many people mistakenly exit there, so be careful. (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from our site's reader: Vending machines and toilets available. It's a little noisy until around 11 PM. You can sleep reasonably well at night. (Older post from before 2019)

Safety is at your own risk. It's a 20-minute drive to the Yamato Museum in Kure, making it ideal for an overnight stay before sightseeing in Kure. Hiroshima city center is also about 25 minutes away. properties.desc_ja:
■詳細案内図とトイレ🚻の写真。車中泊可能。（2024年12月現地調査）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ（👉️トイレ🚻の写真と詳細案内図はこちら（2024年12月撮影））。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。携帯電波OK。標高は250m。フラット水平に整地されている。難点としては、22時ごろまで飛行機が真上を通り、多少の騒音がある。飛行機が飛ぶのが終わったら朝まで非常に静か。なお、昔は無料キャンプ場が併設されていたが、2019年に廃止された（詳細）。（2022年12月管理人現地確認）

Once the planes have stopped flying, it is very quiet until morning. Note that there used to be a free campsite attached, but it was abolished in 2019 (details). (On-site confirmation by the caretaker in December 2022)

There is a hot spring on the other side of the bridge. During the cherry blossom season in spring and the summer holidays, many cars come for overnight parking. However, be careful as the area may be submerged if the river swells due to rain, etc. (Submitted: September 2020, anonymous)

properties.desc_ja:
■料金詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：大山下山駐車場は大山下山キャンプ場と併設されていましたが、この春、「モンベル大山キャンプ場」としてオープンしました。現地での確認は出来ていませんが、サイトの略図を確認すると駐車場の一部が常設テントサイトになり、手前にゲートが設置されているようです。【2024年6月追記】現地確認しました。旧：下山駐車場は、すべてモンベル大山キャンプ場の管理下となっており、キャンプ場利用者しか使えません。（投稿：2024年5月、山びこ様）

properties.desc_en:
■Price Details
■Report from our site's reader: The Oyama Shimoyama parking lot was previously located next to the Oyama Shimoyama Campground, but this spring it reopened as "Montbell Oyama Campground." Although we haven't been able to confirm this on-site, a map of the site suggests that part of the parking lot has been converted into a permanent tent site, with a gate installed in front. [Added June 2024] On-site confirmation confirmed. The former Shimoyama parking lot is now entirely under the management of Montbell Oyama Campground and can only be used by campground users. (Posted: May 2024, Yamabiko)
■At an altitude of 770m, it's cool even in summer.

properties.title_ja: （トイレ無し）建部町親水公園
properties.desc_ja:
■※トイレ無し
■当サイト読者様レポート：旭川に架かる橋の下。橋の上は国道ですが、そんなに交通量はありません。幹線道路の国道も対岸なので、そこまで騒音もありません。徒歩10分圏内に温泉・コンビニ(ファミマ)・22時までマルナカ(スーパー)とザグザグ(ドラッグストア)、さらに、コインランドリーもあります。バーベキューやラジコン等の使用は禁止です(注意書きで「ここはキャンプ場ではありません」と書かれています)。文化センターの裏・すぐ近くに中学校があるため、登下校時にはパトカーが結構来るかもしれません。トイレは無し、docomo回線は良好です。車中泊には割とお勧めできるスポットです。
properties.desc_en:
■*No toilets
■Report from a reader of this site: Under a bridge over the Asahikawa River. The bridge is on a national highway, but there isn't much traffic. The main national highway is on the opposite bank, so it's not too noisy. Within a 10-minute walk there is a hot spring, a convenience store (FamilyMart), a Marunaka (supermarket) and a Zagzag (drugstore) that are open until 10pm, and there is also a coin laundry. The use of barbecues and remote-controlled vehicles is prohibited (there is a sign that says "This is not a campsite"). There is a junior high school behind the cultural center and very close by, so police cars may come around quite often during school hours. There are no toilets, but the Docomo signal is good. It is a fairly recommended spot for overnight stays in your car.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 和の宿ホテル祖谷温泉
properties.desc_ja:
■【百名湯】温泉マニア絶賛、四国最高の温泉。1900円、詳細。値段が高いが、ケーブルカー料金と考えましょう。名実ともに四国最高の温泉。
■管理人評価★5!!!(泉質4.4、景色特別加算0.6)メチャクチャ凄い。西日本最高レベルの温泉。まず泉質は、透明ながら硫黄臭のする極上温泉。白い湯の華が舞っている。秋田の乳頭蟹場温泉に似ています。透明なので4.4評価だが、満点をつけても良いレベル。そして眺望は凄まじい絶景。秋田の鷹の湯温泉、宮城の岩松旅館を超越している。100%天然の絶景。日本最高峰の超絶名湯です。ありがとうございます。
properties.desc_en:
■【Top 100 Hot Springs】Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts, the best hot spring in Shikoku. 1900 yen, details. The price is high, but think of it as cable car fare. Truly the best hot spring in Shikoku.

■Manager's rating ★5!!! (Spring quality 4.4, special bonus for view 0.6) Absolutely amazing. One of the best hot springs in Western Japan. First, the spring quality is superb, clear yet with a sulfurous smell. White mineral deposits float in the water. It's similar to Nyuto Kaniba Onsen in Akita. It's rated 4.4 because it's clear, but it deserves a perfect score. And the view is a tremendous spectacle. It surpasses Takanoyu Onsen in Akita and Iwamatsu Ryokan in Miyagi. A 100% natural spectacle. A truly superb hot spring, one of the finest in Japan. Thank you.

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■2025年2月管理人現地確認：車中泊評価【Bランク】66点👉️現地の写真・詳細案内図はこちら
■当サイト読者様レポート：2026年5月下旬日曜日利用　①駐車場に照明が無く　トイレはセンサー点灯なので　夜は真っ暗　②トイレ近くは大型用駐車枠で　普通車枠は　離れた所に有る③日曜日のせいか　走行音等　ほとんど無く　一晩中静かだった。➃4キロほどのところに　日帰り温泉　元湯がある　昭和スタイルで風情有った（投稿：2026年6月、k様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場も広く幹線道路からも離れており静かですが、駐車場から道の駅敷地入り口の階段にチェーンが張られ「施設閉鎖後の立ち入りはご遠慮ください」の看板があり綺麗な道の駅のトイレは使えません。駐車場にはトイレが一箇所で男女別ですが洗面台も各１箇所ありますが古く清潔感はありませんでした。同駅から歩いて行ける距離にあるショッピングモール（詳細）のスーパーでは総菜の種類も豊富で夕方は半額になっていました。（投稿：2024年5月、山びこ様）
■久しぶりに来たら、南西の運動広場が被災者用住宅地になっていて駐車できなくなっていた。（2023年2月管理人現地確認）
■当サイト読者様レポート：入り口の駐車場にトイレ有り、右方向、奥まで駐車場有り、先まで行くと、キャンプ場有り【有料💰️】。６００ｍ東のイオンが有る。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■2019年8月10日オープン。幹線国道から完全分離で奥の方は比較的静かで良い。
properties.desc_en:
■ February 2025 Administrator's On-site Verification: Car Camping Rating [Rank B] ​​66 points 👉️ Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■ Report from a reader of this site: Used on a Sunday in late May 2026 ① There are no lights in the parking lot, and the toilets are sensor-activated, so it's pitch black at night. ② The area near the toilets is for large vehicles, and the regular car spaces are located further away. ③ Perhaps because it was Sunday, there was almost no traffic noise, and it was quiet all night. ④ There is a day-trip hot spring, Motoyu, about 4 kilometers away. It had a charming Showa-era style (Posted: June 2026, by k)
■ Report from a reader of this site: The parking lot is large and it is quiet as it is far from the main road, but there is a chain stretched across the stairs from the parking lot to the entrance of the roadside station grounds, and there is a sign that says "Please refrain from entering after the facility is closed," so the clean toilets of the roadside station cannot be used. There is one toilet in the parking lot, separate for men and women, and there is one sink in each, but it is old and not very clean. The supermarket in the shopping mall (details) within walking distance of the station had a wide variety of prepared foods, and they were half price in the evenings. (Posted by Yamabiko, May 2024)
■When I came here after a long time, the sports field to the southwest had been turned into a housing area for disaster victims and parking was no longer possible. (Administrator's on-site confirmation, February 2023)
■Report from a reader of this site: There is a toilet in the parking lot at the entrance, there is parking to the right and further back, and if you go further there is a campsite [paid 💰️]. There is an Aeon 600m to the east. (Older post from before 2019)
■Opened on August 10, 2019. It is completely separated from the main national highway, and the back area is relatively quiet and nice.

■ February 2025 Administrator's On-site Inspection: Car Camping Rating [Rank B] ​​69 points 👉️ Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■ Report from a reader of this site: Used on a weekday in late May 2026 ① The toilet and the information area in its anteroom were lit up all night, which gave a sense of security. ② There were two sets of chairs and tables, and free Wi-Fi was available, which was useful for research, etc. ③ However, there was a sign prohibiting eating and drinking, so please observe the manners. ④ There was almost no road noise, etc., and it was quiet all night. ⑤ It was also used as a meeting place for children in the early morning, so please avoid doing anything that might cause discomfort or unease (Posted: June 2026, by k)
■ Opened October 1, 2023.

■5chレポート：街中にあるから夜に飲みに行きたい人はいいかも。朝ラーのお店が目の前にあったり、道の駅になぜか回転寿司屋が併設してたりも。施設もトイレも綺麗だし、駐車場も広い。ただ、トイレが大2(1個は使用禁止中)、小3しかないのが残念。あと、新しいのにトイレに入るとぷんっとワキガや玉ねぎみたいな臭いがするw とはいえ、お風呂が併設している隣りの「くにの松原おおさき」の方がいいかね。志布志市街にファストフード店やファミレスもあるし。（投稿：2026年4月）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2025.4.27（日）の20:30頃に伺い、寿司屋と国道448号線に挟まれた駐車場で車中泊させていただきました。コメントとしては、男性トイレは鼻にツンとする臭い有。国道448号線沿いの飲食店から大音量のカラオケ有。（投稿：2025年4月、FIT3様）
■5chレポート：道の駅くしま。串間市のど真ん中に出来てる道の駅。お蔭で飲食店などの周辺施設には困らないと思われる。トイレも入口に自動ドア付きとても綺麗。WiFiは情報センターでは入るが駐車場からは不可。主要国道沿いなのでソコソコ交通量はあるが、駐車場が広いので奥に行けば気にならないレベル。あと、街中なせいか大型トラックはいなかった。逆に信号の音など「街中の音」が遅くまで聞こえる。聞いた話だと遅くまでたむろしてる若者が居たり酔っ払いが居たりするとの事。（投稿：2022年2月）
■2021年4月24日オープン。駐車場が道路から離れた奥の方にもあるので比較的静かで良さそう。期待の新人。
properties.desc_en:
■5ch Report: It's in the city center, so it might be good for people who want to go out for drinks at night. There's a ramen shop that serves breakfast right in front, and for some reason there's a conveyor belt sushi restaurant attached to the roadside station. The facilities and toilets are clean, and the parking lot is spacious. However, it's a shame that there are only two stalls for men (one is out of order) and three for women. Also, even though it's new, when you enter the toilet there's a strong smell like body odor or onions lol. That being said, the neighboring "Kunino Matsubara Osaki" which has a bath attached is probably better. There are also fast food restaurants and family restaurants in Shibushi city center. (Posted: April 2026)
■Report from a reader of this site: I visited around 8:30 PM on Sunday, April 27, 2025, and stayed overnight in my car in the parking lot sandwiched between a sushi restaurant and National Route 448. My comments are: The men's toilet has a pungent smell. There is loud karaoke coming from a restaurant along National Route 448. (Posted: April 2025, by FIT3)
■5ch Report: Michi-no-Eki Kushima. A roadside station built right in the heart of Kushima City. Thanks to this, there seems to be no shortage of nearby facilities such as restaurants. The toilets are also very clean, with automatic doors at the entrance. WiFi is available in the information center but not in the parking lot. It's along a major national highway, so there's a fair amount of traffic, but the parking lot is large, so it's not noticeable if you go to the back. Also, perhaps because it's in the city, there were no large trucks. On the other hand, you can hear the sounds of the city, such as traffic lights, until late at night. I heard that there are young people hanging around late at night and drunk people. (Posted: February 2022)
■Opened April 24, 2021. The parking lot is located further back, away from the road, so it seems relatively quiet and nice. A promising newcomer.

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 フェニックス
properties.desc_ja:
■5chレポート：道の駅フェニックスで車中泊してきた。夜になると若い子わんさか来て、街灯ない真っ暗中で車を停めて何してるんや？展望台の方へ消えてった子らもいたけど。展望台から海岸まで降りられる階段あったけど、高低差50m、260段を真っ暗闇の中を降りるとは思えんし。外でダベってた女の子らが車の中で女子会？みたいのしてたり、笑い声と灯りが漏れてた。朝になったら車中泊組の他県ナンバーしかおらんかった。0時過ぎは、まあまあ車が停まってたんだけどな。（投稿：2026年4月）
■当サイト読者様レポート：宮崎のヤンキーのたまり場でした。夜通しバイクを吹かして爆音を響かせています。一瞬静かになったと思ったら次から次に他のグループがきて最悪です。トイレは夜間も使用できます。（投稿：2025年4月、ゆーぷる様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：珍走団だらけ、１つのグループが帰ったと思ったらまた別の珍走団が来る。駐車場で延々と空ぶかし、アイドリング、喋り声、叫び声。そしてこの日は、車中泊のトナラーにも遭遇。ガラガラの駐車場なのに、私の車の１つ隣にわざわざ止めてくる。そして、エアコンのコンプレッサーアイドリング。ホントに何なんでしょうね、トナラーさんって。珍走団のいない30分ほどの間、確かに静かな所だなと思いました。奴らがいなけりゃ静かで良い所だと思います。運が悪かったんでしょうけど、何だかなあ。（投稿：2021年11月、m様）
properties.desc_en:
■5ch Report: I stayed overnight in my car at Michi-no-Eki Phoenix. At night, tons of young people came, and I wondered what they were doing parked in their cars in the pitch black with no streetlights. Some of them disappeared towards the observation deck. There were stairs leading down from the observation deck to the coast, but I couldn't imagine descending 50 meters in elevation and 260 steps in complete darkness. Some girls who were chatting outside were having a girls' get-together in their car, and I could hear laughter and light leaking out. By morning, only cars with out-of-prefecture license plates from those who had stayed overnight in their cars were left. There were quite a few cars parked there after midnight, though. (Posted: April 2026)

■Report from a Reader of This Site: It was a hangout for Miyazaki delinquents. They revved their motorcycles all night, making a deafening noise. Just when I thought it was quiet for a moment, other groups started arriving one after another, it was awful. The toilets are available at night. (Submitted by: Yuupuru, April 2025)
■Report from a reader of this site: It's full of reckless driving gangs. Just when you think one group has left, another one comes along. They rev their engines endlessly in the parking lot, idling, talking, and shouting. And on this day, I also encountered a car parked right next to mine. Even though the parking lot was practically empty, they deliberately parked right next to mine. And their air conditioner compressor was idling. Seriously, what's up with these car parkers? For about 30 minutes when the gangs weren't there, I thought it was a really quiet place. If those guys weren't there, it would be a nice, quiet place. I guess I was just unlucky, but still... (Submitted by: m, November 2021)

properties.desc_ja:
■450円、詳細。全国的にも極めて珍しい「足元湧出温泉♨️」。温泉マニア絶賛。2023年10月閉業したが、2025年7月経営者が変わり復活。
■管理人評価★4.7（泉質4.5、景色0.2）アルカリ性単純泉だが、ほのかに硫黄の香り。足下からブクブク湧いている。上の湯と下の湯があり、下の方は不思議なエメラルドグリーンできわめて美しい。一緒に風呂に入った爺さんの話だと、透明度がきわめて高いためこのように見えるという。ここは、アルカリ性単純泉の一つの頂点、究極だと思います。泉質は、透明の温泉としては異例の4.5と評価。エメラルドグリーンに見えるので、色評価も加点。景色は風呂場自体の景色を評価して0.2。合計4.7の極上。
properties.desc_en:
■450 yen, details. An extremely rare "foot-level bubbling hot spring♨️" nationwide. Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. It closed in October 2023 but reopened in July 2025 under new management.

■Manager's rating ★4.7 (Spring quality 4.5, Scenery 0.2) It's an alkaline simple spring, but with a faint sulfurous scent. The water bubbles up from the ground. There's an upper bath and a lower bath, and the lower one is a mysterious emerald green and extremely beautiful. According to an old man who was in the bath with me, it looks this way because of its extremely high transparency. I think this is one of the pinnacles, the ultimate, of alkaline simple springs. The spring quality is rated 4.5, which is unusual for a transparent hot spring. The color rating is also increased because it looks emerald green. The scenery is rated 0.2, based on the view of the bathhouse itself. Total 4.7, excellent.

properties.desc_ja:
■無料駐車場は数ヶ所あるが、トイレがあるのはここだけ。無料の地獄蒸し釜も近くにある。トイレは水洗でキレイ。無料の元湯に行く細い道は駐車禁止＆車中泊禁止。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート： 今日件名の駐車場に車中泊しましたが、駐車場の管理をしている杖立温泉観光協会の方から以下のような指摘を受けました。
・トイレ前の駐車場は増水時に旅館の宿泊客が車を退避させるので車中泊しないでほしい
 ・車中泊をするときは夜遅くにきて朝早くに出てほしい（具体的な時間は聞きませんでした）
・何度も車中泊をするのはやめてほしい（連泊などではなく回数の問題のようです）
管理者の方は過去の車中泊者が問題を起こしているためか、車中泊に対して非常に否定的な考えをもっており「車体にかける金があるなら旅館に宿泊しろ」や「車中泊者は金にならない」などいろいろ言われました。  また、個人としては車中泊は一切締め出して禁止にしたい考えだそうで車中泊マップへの掲載されていることも知っており迷惑なことだと受け取っている様子でした。  私は周囲の迷惑にならないように様々なサイトに書かれているルールを守ってやってきたつもりでしたが、その「つもり」でもやはり限度があるようです。  車中泊マップへの掲載を続けるかどうかは私の判断ではありませんが、もしこれを読んでなおも掲載をつづけるのだとしたら歓迎されていないことは確定しているので一言だけでも書き加えた方が良いと思います。車中泊の車両のナンバーを控えているとも言っていました。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■There are several free parking lots, but this is the only one with a toilet. There is also a free steam cooking pot nearby. The toilet is a flush toilet and clean. Parking and overnight stays in vehicles are prohibited on the narrow road leading to the free Motoyu hot spring. (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from a reader of this site: I stayed overnight in my car at the parking lot mentioned in the subject line today, but I received the following comments from the Tsuetate Onsen Tourism Association, which manages the parking lot:
・Please do not stay overnight in your car in the parking lot in front of the toilet, as hotel guests evacuate their cars there during floods.
・If you are going to stay overnight in your car, please come late at night and leave early in the morning (I didn't ask for specific times).
・Please stop staying overnight in your car multiple times (it seems to be a matter of the number of times, not consecutive nights).
The manager seems to have a very negative view of overnight stays in vehicles, perhaps because past overnight stays have caused problems, and said various things such as "If you have money to spend on your car, stay at a hotel" and "Overnight stays in vehicles don't bring in money." Furthermore, it seems that the person in question wants to completely ban overnight stays in vehicles, and is aware that it's listed on the overnight stay map, considering it a nuisance. I thought I had been following the rules written on various websites to avoid bothering others, but it seems there are limits to what I can do. Whether or not to continue listing my vehicle on the overnight stay map is not my decision, but if you read this and still decide to continue listing it, it's clear that it's not welcome, so I think you should add at least a brief note about it. They also mentioned that they keep track of the license plate numbers of vehicles that stay overnight in their vehicles. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_ja: ■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。標高490m。トイレは水洗で洋式もあり。携帯電波はギリギリ。トイレがある高台にある奥の駐車場（ココ）は、入り方が分かりにくいので夜に来る車はほとんど無い。しかし、下の方の道路沿いの駐車エリア（ココ）は、珍走暴走車の出撃拠点＆休憩所になっており、深夜までうるさいので注意。治安的な意味でおすすめはしない。上の方の駐車場にはDQN軍団は来ないので、耳栓をすれば一応寝ることは可能。DQN珍走軍団の皆さんは深夜1時過ぎまで延々と爆音で走り回っている。（2022年1月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en: ■Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed not to be closed at night. Elevation 490m. Toilets are flush toilets, and some are Western style. Cell phone reception is weak. The parking lot at the back of the hill where the toilets are located (here) is difficult to find, so there are hardly any cars that come at night. However, the parking area along the road further down (here) is a base and rest stop for reckless drivers, and it is noisy until late at night, so be careful. Not recommended for safety reasons. The reckless drivers don't come to the upper parking lot, so it is possible to sleep there if you wear earplugs. The reckless drivers drive around making loud noises until past 1am. (Confirmed on-site by administrator in January 2022)

Around 6 AM the next morning, there was some kind of radio calisthenics? A large group of locals gathered and it was noisy. (Confirmed on-site by the administrator in February 2022)

properties.desc_en: ■Free parking and public restrooms. Confirmed they are not closed at night. properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレはなんと水洗洋式（簡易水洗ではなく、完全な水洗）でビックリ（夜間電気はつかない。また、水洗洋式の多目的トイレはカギが非常にかかりにくいが、一応カギはかかることを確認。カギのかけ方解説）。臭くない。オートキャンプ場よりもこっちのが断然良い。夜間めちゃくちゃ静かで最高。携帯電波問題なし。ここ非常に良いです。人気（ひとけ）皆無のため治安については自己責任（ポケモンのスポットになっているのかわからないが、夜中もたまに人が来る）。川の中洲のため増水には注意。（2021年3月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en: ■Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. Surprisingly, the toilets are flush toilets (not simple flush toilets, but fully flush toilets) (the lights are not on at night. Also, the lock on the multipurpose flush toilet is very difficult to lock, but confirmed that it can be locked. Explanation of how to lock it). It doesn't smell. This is definitely better than the auto campsite. It's incredibly quiet at night, which is great. No problems with cell phone reception. This place is very good. There are no people around, so safety is at your own risk (I don't know if it's a Pokémon spot, but people occasionally come even in the middle of the night). Be careful of flooding as it is on a sandbar in the river. (Confirmed on-site by the manager in March 2021)

■当サイト読者様レポート：星野村の、平和の広場の横の駐車場は、夜間も使用できて、比較的きれいなトイレもあり、夜間も電気が自動で点灯します。車中泊には便利な場所です。場所的には、茶の文化館　の前、と書いた方が分かりやすいかもしれません。隣接しています。ただし、茶の文化館の駐車場は、夜間は閉鎖されます。そのすぐ横に平和の広場用の駐車場があり、そちらに止めなければいけません。少し、難点と言えば難点、メリットとも言えるかもしれませんが、平和の広場は、夜間の星の観光スポットです。夜は、入れ替わり立ち替わり、星を見に、いろんな車がやってきます。大学生の様な若者が、夜の1時2時ぐらいまで、次々に来ることもあるので、若干、賑やかなことがあります。暴走族は経験したことがないので、治安は悪くないと思います。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■標高364m
properties.desc_en:
■Free parking and public toilets. Reports indicate that overnight parking is possible. Details. Elevation is 318m. There is a bathing facility nearby (Hoshino Onsenkan Kirara, 520 yen, details). (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from a reader of this site: The parking lot next to Heiwa no Hiroba (Peace Square) in Hoshino Village can be used at night, has relatively clean toilets, and the lights turn on automatically at night. It is a convenient place for overnight parking. In terms of location, it might be easier to say it is in front of the Tea Culture Museum. It is adjacent to it. However, the Tea Culture Museum's parking lot is closed at night. There is a parking lot for Heiwa no Hiroba right next to it, and you must park there. It is a bit of a drawback, or perhaps an advantage, but Heiwa no Hiroba is a stargazing spot at night. At night, various cars come and go to see the stars. Young people like university students sometimes come one after another until around 1 or 2 in the morning, so it can be a little noisy. I've never encountered any biker gangs, so I think the area is safe. (Older post from before 2019)
■ Elevation: 364m

properties.desc_en: ■Free parking (on top of a mountain but relatively flat and leveled) and public toilets (simple flush toilets, Japanese style). Confirmed that they are not closed at night. Extremely quiet at night, but unfortunately, there is no cell phone reception. (Confirmed on-site by caretaker in January 2024)

■久しぶりに来たら公衆トイレの建物が閉鎖されており、仮設トイレ（和式の簡易水洗でかなり臭い）のみになっていた。携帯電波OK。車中泊は可能だが、幹線道沿いでうるさい。傾斜もあり。（2024年1月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■Free parking available. Unfortunately, the toilets were closed. 👉️See photos of the site here. (Administrator's on-site verification, February 2025)
■When I visited again after a long time, the public toilet building was closed, and only temporary toilets (Japanese-style, simple flush toilets, quite smelly) remained. Cell phone reception is OK. Overnight parking is possible, but it's noisy as it's along a main road. There's also a slope. (Administrator's on-site verification, January 2024)

properties.desc_ja: ■無料駐車場。公衆トイレあり。車中泊可能。wimax電波OK！静かで非常に良い。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Free parking. Public restrooms available. Overnight parking permitted. WiMAX signal OK! Quiet and very nice. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_en: ■Free parking available. The toilets are a bit far away. It becomes a hangout for delinquents in the summer. (Nagasaki has a lot of reckless drivers.) Because it has a free campsite attached, it becomes a noisy party venue on weekends during camping season. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_ja: ■無料キャンプ場、きれいなトイレあり、夜景と朝日がキレイ。ただし！夜に暴走族の馬鹿が来ることがある。１時間ほどブンブン大騒ぎしてゴミをまき散らして去って行く。田舎にありがちな光景。夜景がきれいなところ（特に車に乗ったまま夜景が見える場所）には珍走が集まる、と覚えておきましょう。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Free campsite, clean toilets, beautiful night view and sunrise. However! Sometimes a gang of idiots shows up at night. They rev their engines loudly for about an hour, scatter trash everywhere, and then leave. A common sight in the countryside. Remember that places with beautiful night views (especially places where you can see the night view from your car) tend to attract these reckless drivers. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■無料。別府三秘湯 無料 管理人も行ってきました（2014年4月）。場所は正確な場所にマークしています。
■管理人評価★4.8（泉質4.3、景色0.5満点）まず泉質は無色透明だが、硫黄臭がして析出物がこびりついている。景色については、渓流に沿った湯船から見える、広葉樹の風景が美しい。秋に来たら最高でしょう。泉質4.3、景色0.5満点、合計4.8との評価。最高峰の極上温泉。
properties.desc_en:
■Free. Beppu's Three Secret Hot Springs - Free. The administrator also visited (April 2014). The exact location is marked.

■Administrator's Rating ★4.8 (Spring Quality 4.3, Scenery 0.5 out of 5) First, the spring water is colorless and transparent, but it has a sulfurous smell and deposits are clinging to it. As for the scenery, the view of the broadleaf trees from the bath along the stream is beautiful. It would be best to visit in autumn. The rating is 4.3 for spring quality, 0.5 out of 5 for scenery, for a total of 4.8. A top-class, superb hot spring.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■無料。「別府八湯」の一つ。別府マニアは必修。別府八湯について詳細
■別府三秘湯。無料。温泉マニア絶賛。管理人も行ってきました（2014年4月）。別府三秘湯でここが最高、また、別府温泉のなかでもここが最高峰という人が多い。現在、普通に利用可能。場所がわかりにくいのですが、このマップで正確な位置にマーカーを置いています。航空写真に切り替えると、小さい小屋が写っているのがわかると思いますが、それが鶴の湯です。霊園の一番奥から山道を歩きます。車を置ける場所から歩いてすぐで、上り坂とかもありません。平坦な数分の道です。雨の日は靴がドロドロになるのでやめておいた方がいいです。快晴の夜は懐中電灯持参でやってきて、満天の星をおがむマニアが多いそうです。
■管理人評価★4.8（泉質4.4、景色0.4）泉質は透明だが硫黄の析出物がびっしりついており、湯船が青白く美しい。泉質は4.4評価。景色は絶景とまでは言えないが、きわめて開放的で気持ちがよい、また、ツツジや紅葉が植えられており大変美しいので0.4評価。 合計4.8点の極上温泉。
properties.desc_en:
■Free. One of the "Eight Beppu Hot Springs." A must-see for Beppu enthusiasts. Details about the Eight Beppu Hot Springs are available.
■One of Beppu's Three Hidden Hot Springs. Free. Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. The administrator also visited (April 2014). Many consider this the best of Beppu's three hidden hot springs, and even the finest among all Beppu hot springs. Currently, it is open to the public. The location is a bit difficult to find, but this map shows the exact spot. If you switch to aerial photography, you'll see a small hut; that's Tsuru-no-Yu. You walk along a mountain path from the very back of the cemetery. It's a short walk from where you can park your car, and there are no uphill sections. It's a flat path of just a few minutes. It's best to avoid going on rainy days as your shoes will get muddy. On clear nights, many enthusiasts bring flashlights to admire the starry sky.


■Manager's Rating ★4.8 (Spring Quality 4.4, Scenery 0.4) The spring water is clear, but it is covered with sulfur deposits, making the bath a beautiful pale blue. The spring quality is rated 4.4. The scenery is not spectacular, but it is extremely open and pleasant, and the azaleas and maple trees planted there are very beautiful, hence the 0.4 rating. A superb hot spring with a total score of 4.8.

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 霧島温泉最古の岩風呂 「目の湯」
properties.title_en: Kirishima Onsen's oldest rock bath, """"Me-no-yu"""" (Eye Bath)""
properties.desc_ja:
■無料、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：道路から５０ｍの天然の露天風呂 無料（勿論混浴）２〜３人しか浸かれない。自動車道からは、見えないが、遊歩道が巻いている。脇の川も温泉だが、川上に人家有るので、入らない方がよい。道路駐車可能
properties.desc_en:
■Free, Details
■Report from our site's reader: A natural open-air bath 50m from the road. Free (of course, mixed bathing). Only 2-3 people can soak in it. It's not visible from the road, but there's a walking path winding around it. The river next to it is also a hot spring, but there are houses upstream, so it's best not to go in. Roadside parking is available.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■無人駅で周辺には温泉宿があり朝から入浴できる 駐車できるが照明が明るいのと早朝から通学生で賑やか（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■It's an unmanned station, and there are hot spring inns nearby where you can bathe from the morning. Parking is available, but the lighting is bright and it gets noisy with students commuting from early in the morning (older post from before 2019).

properties.title_en: (Free, closed at night, toilets far away) Beppu Park North Parking Lot""
properties.desc_ja: ■北側駐車場は無料。トイレは道路渡って公園にある。ちょっと遠いが利用可能。21-8時夜間閉鎖。（管理人現地確認：2019年12月以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■The north parking lot is free. Toilets are located across the road in the park. They are a bit far but usable. Closed at night from 9 PM to 8 AM. (Confirmed by administrator: Older post from before December 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 桃山天下市
properties.desc_ja:
■北側の表の駐車場はトラックの車中泊（延々とアイドリング）も多い上に、漁港関係者が出勤前の休憩に寄るようで早朝から騒がしくなる。南側の裏の駐車場（ココ）は静かで良さそうに見えるが、実は配送基地？になっているようで、早朝5時くらいから鮮魚配送の大型トラック（アイドリング音がえぐい）や配送のバンなどが大量に集まってきてめちゃくちゃうるさくなる。結論を言うと、ここでの車中泊はおすすめできない。（2022年1月管理人現地確認）
■当サイト読者様レポート：道の駅・桃山天下市　に2021年11月9日に車中泊した時の情報をお知らせします。第一駐車場は全体に傾斜していますが、24時間利用できるトイレ付近は比較的傾斜がなだらかなので、不快感なく車中泊できました。道の駅の前の道路の反対側には、ドラッグストア，セブンイレブン，コインランドリー，スーパーマーケット，郵便局，ガソリンスタンド（シェル）があり、長期旅行者にとって非常にありがたい道の駅です。（投稿：2022年1月、m様）
■眼の前にコンビニとスーパーがあり大変便利。wimax利用可能。駐車場は幹線道路に面しておりややうるさい。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレあり、駐車場の前はコンビニがるので便利で、交通量もさほど多くもなく静かに過ごせましたが、平坦な駐車スペースが少なく、付近に温泉施設などが無いのが不便ですが、（第２駐車場は平たんですがトイレが遠い）観光地にも近いから便利です。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■The front parking lot on the north side is noisy from early morning because there are many trucks parked overnight (idling for extended periods), and it seems that fishing port workers stop by for breaks before work. The back parking lot on the south side (here) looks quiet and nice, but it seems to be a distribution base, and from around 5 AM a large number of large trucks delivering fresh fish (with extremely loud idling noises) and delivery vans gather there, making it extremely noisy. In conclusion, I do not recommend parking overnight here. (Confirmed on-site by the administrator in January 2022)
■Report from a reader of this site: Information from when I stayed overnight in my car at Michi-no-Eki Momoyama Tenkaichi on November 9, 2021. The first parking lot is sloped overall, but the area near the 24-hour toilets has a relatively gentle slope, so I was able to stay overnight in my car without discomfort. Across the road from the roadside station there is a drug store, a 7-Eleven, a laundromat, a supermarket, a post office, and a gas station (Shell), making it a very convenient roadside station for long-term travelers. (Posted: January 2022, by M)
■There is a convenience store and supermarket right in front, which is very convenient. WiMAX is available. The parking lot faces a main road and is a bit noisy. (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from a reader of this site: There is a toilet, and there is a convenience store in front of the parking lot, which is convenient. The traffic is not too heavy, so it was quiet, but there are few flat parking spaces and it is inconvenient that there are no hot spring facilities nearby (the second parking lot is flat, but the toilets are far away). However, it is convenient because it is close to tourist attractions. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_en:

■当サイト読者様レポート：温泉施設ですが、1,000円支払うと駐車場で車中泊可能でした。温泉の受付が22時まで空いているので、そこで手続きすると許可証がもらえます。大きな温泉施設で、目の前は海でロケーションもいいです。2024年7月1日は他に車もなく静かに過ごせました。トイレもすぐ近くにあります。（初めて投稿するので間違いがあったらすみません）（投稿：2024年7月、h様）

properties.desc_en:
■Bath♨️: 600 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: Visited on December 18, 2025. It faces the calm waters of Kariya Bay. The north side is a cape, so the winter seasonal winds seem to be mild. The parking lot along the breakwater is wide and flat. Overnight stays in vehicles are 1000 yen and require permission, but it is not clearly stated where this applies. I did not obtain any permission, but there were no problems. The RV park with power is 3000 yen and requires reservation. Also, because it is by the sea, fishermen come from early in the morning. There are also people who fish at night, but it was not noisy and I was able to sleep well. The toilets are Western-style, with heated bidet seats, and are cleaned every morning. Attached images. The hot spring is in a surprisingly magnificent building, and I felt the power of nuclear power plant money. It is 600 yen, but 500 yen for those 65 and over. A very reasonable price. Details (Posted: December 2025, by tossan)
■Report from our site's reader: Although it's a hot spring facility, you can park your car overnight in the parking lot for 1,000 yen. The hot spring reception is open until 10 PM, so you can get a permit there. It's a large hot spring facility, and the location is great with the sea right in front. On July 1st, 2024, there were no other cars, so it was quiet. There are also toilets very close by. (Sorry if there are any mistakes as this is my first post) (Posted: July 2024, by h)

properties.desc_ja:
■入浴♨️：《呼子 台場の湯》700円、詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：看板には20時閉鎖と書いてあるが温泉のスタッフさんに聞いたら夜間も閉鎖されず、無料で車中泊黙認のようでした。すぐそばに夜間も利用可能で清潔な水洗洋式のトイレがある基本的には大変静かな駐車場です。朝市近くの臨港駐車場はキャンピングカーお断りと言われた。（投稿：2025年4月、yama2904様）
■2022年1月久しぶりに来たら、コロナのせいなのか分からないが、20時で完全封鎖されるようになっていた。残っている車は追い出される。残念。（2022年1月管理人現地確認）
■当サイト読者様レポート：呼子台場みなとプラザ車中泊禁止の件、今は解除になっているようです、2021年10月24日にあるグループの車中泊での集まりがあったようです。参考になれば。参考リンク（投稿：2021年12月、y様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2021年3月10日に、佐賀の呼子台場みなとプラザに行きましたが、従業員さんからコロナの影響で車中泊禁止と言われました。以前は営業時間外も駐車場は出入り自由でしたが、ロープやチェーンがしてあります。温泉も20時まで開いており、良く利用してましたが残念です。（投稿：2021年4月、S様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2020年12月に呼子台場みなとプラザで車中泊しようとしたが、19時くらいに人がドアを叩いて［20時で閉鎖します。車中泊禁止です。］って言われて追い出された。（投稿：2021年1月、N様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2019年3月27日に車中泊しました。駐車場の入り口に設置してある案内表示板には、「駐車場の利用時間は9時〜20時で、20時〜翌朝9時は閉鎖する」旨の注意事項が書かれていましたが、実際は、閉鎖されることはなく、20時以降も出入り可能状態でした。駐車場横のトイレも24時間利用可能で、清潔に掃除されており、多目的トイレはウォシュレットでした。その他、入浴施設や駐車場の環境などは、すでに投稿されている方の情報を参照してください。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2019年4月利用。「台場の湯」は20時閉店。こじんまりしたお風呂ながら、奥の源泉に大いに癒されました。食事処はありませんが、外からの食料を持ち込んで2Fの休憩所で食べるのはOKです。駐車場は風の強い日は少しうるさい＆若干揺れるかもですが、全体として快適な車中泊スポットで、ご同類が20台ぐらいいました。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：九州佐賀県 「呼子台場みなとプラザ」の車中泊スポット。 「呼子台場の湯」という立ち寄り湯があります。 とても綺麗で、お勧めです。 また、トイレも清掃が行き届いてとても綺麗です。駐車場も広く、傾斜もなく、私個人としてはAランクの車中泊スポットだと思いました。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：広い駐車場、トイレ有り。民家や旅館が近くにあり安全。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Bathing♨️: "Yobuko Daiba no Yu" 700 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: The sign says it closes at 8 PM, but when I asked the staff at the hot spring, they said it wasn't closed at night and that overnight parking was tacitly permitted for free. There's a clean, flushable Western-style toilet nearby that's also available at night, and it's basically a very quiet parking lot. I was told that campervans are not allowed at the port parking lot near the morning market. (Posted: April 2025, yama2904)
■When I came back in January 2022 after a long time, I don't know if it's because of COVID-19, but it's now completely closed at 8 PM. Any remaining cars are kicked out. What a shame. (January 2022, administrator confirmed on-site)
■Report from our site's reader: Regarding the ban on overnight parking at Yobuko Daiba Minato Plaza, it seems to have been lifted now. There was apparently a group gathering there for overnight parking on October 24, 2021. Hope this is helpful. Reference Links (Posted: December 2021, by Y)
■ Reader Report: On March 10, 2021, I went to Yobuko Daiba Minato Plaza in Saga, but an employee told me that overnight parking was prohibited due to the effects of the coronavirus. Previously, the parking lot was freely accessible even outside of business hours, but now it's cordoned off with ropes and chains. The hot springs were open until 8 PM, and I used to use them often, so this is disappointing. (Posted: April 2021, by S)
■ Reader Report: In December 2020, I tried to stay overnight in my car at Yobuko Daiba Minato Plaza, but around 7 PM someone knocked on my door and said, "[We close at 8 PM. Overnight parking is prohibited.]" and kicked me out. (Posted: January 2021, by N)
■ Reader Report: I stayed overnight in my car on March 27, 2019. The sign at the entrance to the parking lot stated that "the parking lot is open from 9:00 to 20:00 and closed from 20:00 to 9:00 the following morning," but in reality, it was not closed and was accessible even after 20:00. The toilets next to the parking lot were also available 24 hours a day, kept clean, and the multipurpose toilet had a bidet. For other details regarding the bathing facilities and parking lot environment, please refer to the information already posted by others. (Older posts from before 2019)
■Report from a reader of this site: Used in April 2019. "Daiba no Yu" closes at 20:00. Although it is a small bath, the hot spring source at the back was very relaxing. There is no restaurant, but it is OK to bring in food from outside and eat it in the rest area on the 2nd floor. The parking lot may be a little noisy and shake a bit on windy days, but overall it is a comfortable spot for overnight stays in a car, and there were about 20 other people doing the same. (Older posts from before 2019)
■Report from a reader of this site: A car camping spot at "Yobuko Daiba Minato Plaza" in Saga Prefecture, Kyushu. There is a public bath called "Yobuko Daiba no Yu". It is very clean and recommended. Also, the toilets are very clean and well-maintained. The parking lot is spacious and flat, and I personally thought it was an A-rank car camping spot. (Older posts from before 2019)
■Report from a reader of this site: Spacious parking lot, toilets available. There are houses and inns nearby, so it is safe. (Older posts from before 2019)

■Report from our site's reader: There's a toilet with lights that can be used at night. This place is quite far from the center of the village, about 1.5km upstream along the river, and surrounded by nature. However, there's a police box diagonally across the street, and a fire station and clinic on the other side of the river, so it feels like a safe spot to stay overnight in your car. Personally, I highly recommend this place. On the map, it doesn't look that far from the Taio Gold Mine roadside station, but the road between them is mountainous and takes a considerable amount of time, so in terms of time, it feels like quite a distance. (Older post from before 2019)
■Elevation 377m

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：夜11時頃に閉店する民営店舗駐車場ですが、もともとは海水浴客用公共駐車場だった未舗装敷地を舗装増築して開店した経緯があり、そのため駐車場だけは24時間開放されています（子供用遊具も設置されて公園になっています）。超絶急傾斜のコンクリ坂を下るとすぐに砂浜に出られますし真水の湧水もあります。注意点として、店舗と海の家は監視/暗視カメラが鬼大量に設置してあるので、ヘタに営業時間外に立ち入るとばっちり撮影されてしまいます。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: This privately owned store's parking lot closes around 11 PM, but it was originally an unpaved public parking lot for beachgoers that was paved and expanded before the store opened. As a result, the parking lot is open 24 hours a day (it's also a park with playground equipment for children). You can reach the beach immediately by going down an extremely steep concrete slope, and there's also a freshwater spring. A word of caution: the store and the beach huts are equipped with a huge number of surveillance/night vision cameras, so if you enter outside of business hours, you'll definitely be filmed. (Submitted by: M, June 2024)

There are two water reservoirs in the concrete retaining wall where the old road remains and Route 384 intersect, and groundwater is constantly flowing from them. Locals occasionally come in with plastic bottles to fill up their water. (Submitted by: m, June 2024)

properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free spring water source. Locals use it for their daily needs. It's just one uphill road from the city road, but the road is so narrow that even a small car and a motorcycle cannot pass each other, and there is no parking space nearby, so it's best to go on foot. It's not listed on Google Maps, but there are several similar spring water sources in the vicinity. (Submitted by: m, June 2024)

properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: After closing time, the lights are turned off and it's quite difficult to find, but the main parking lot at the back of the building (under the overpass) is quiet. The EV charger is in the small parking lot on the west side. It was pitch black there too. The toilet is on the 1st floor of the building on the sea side, but at night you have to turn the lights at the entrance on/off yourself. It's adjacent to the ferry terminal to mainland Kyushu, so I was able to catch the first ferry in the early morning. (Posted December 2018)
■Opened April 2015.

The apron and runway are just beyond the fence, and it's a mountainside airport where you can see takeoffs and landings up close, making it a desirable location for aviation enthusiasts, but the exhaust noise from the jet engines is tremendous, so it's not recommended for the general public. (Submitted by: m, June 2024)
