properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：幅員の広い道路に隣接する公園で、遠くからでも見つけやすい。駐車スペースは未舗装です。公園内に綺麗な公衆トイレと自販機があり、まる一日停車していても何も言われません。ただ、ここは昼夜問わず漁師が船を出すので騒音があるほか、近在に土木業者の材料集積所があって大型ダンプが頻繁に出入りするのでおすすめしない。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: This park is located next to a wide road and is easy to spot from a distance. The parking area is unpaved. There are clean public restrooms and vending machines in the park, and you won't get in trouble even if you park there all day. However, it is noisy because fishermen take their boats out day and night, and there is a construction company's material storage area nearby with large dump trucks coming and going frequently, so I don't recommend it. (Submitted by: M, June 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車30台級の無料駐車場。駐車場の東側にあるトイレはボロくてイマイチだが、北西側にあるトイレは水洗洋式。夜は静かで快眠できる。（投稿：2023年4月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A free parking lot that can accommodate about 30 regular cars. The toilet on the east side of the parking lot is run-down and not very good, but the toilet on the northwest side is a flush toilet with a Western-style design. It's quiet at night, so you can get a good night's sleep. (Submitted by: y, April 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車20台級の無料駐車場。トイレは水洗洋式で、定期的に清掃されている感じ。夜遅くまでor朝早くからウォーキング・ジョギング・犬の散歩等をする人が来るので少し落ち着かない。（投稿：2023年5月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A free parking lot that can accommodate about 20 regular cars. The toilets are flush toilets and appear to be cleaned regularly. It's a little noisy because people come to walk, jog, or walk their dogs late into the night or early in the morning. (Submitted by y in May 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車10台級の無料駐車場。トイレは水洗洋式のウオシュレット付き。隣接する県道は、朝夕はたまに車が往来するものの、夜はそれも途絶えるので快眠できる。（投稿：2023年4月、y様）
■標高525m
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: Free parking lot for about 10 regular cars. The toilet is a flush toilet with a bidet. Although there is occasional traffic on the adjacent prefectural road in the morning and evening, it stops completely at night, allowing for a good night's sleep. (Submitted by: y, April 2023)
■Elevation: 525m

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車100台級の無料駐車場。トイレは水洗洋式のウオシュレット付き。街中にある駐車場だが、ざわついた感じはなく、閑静な一夜を過ごせる。居心地が良くて、ついつい連泊してしまった。（投稿：2023年4月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A free parking lot with space for about 100 regular cars. The toilets are flush toilets with bidet functions. Although it's a parking lot in the middle of the city, it doesn't feel noisy, and you can spend a peaceful night. It was so comfortable that I ended up staying for several nights. (Submitted by: y, April 2023)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：標高：475ｍ （地理院地図）。トイレ：24時間使用可能、不潔ではないが、やや匂う。静かさ：駐車場が道路に面しており、トラックがよく通っていました。気になる人には五月蠅いかもしれない（私は疲れもあってよく眠れました） 入浴：車で10分ほどの距離に東峰村保健福祉センターいずみ館（詳細）があります。300円と格安ですが、シャンプー石鹸は備えてません（持ち込みか購入が必要）詳細。食事：敷地内にレストラン こだち、喫茶（9:00~17:00)　レストラン(10:30~15:00)　その他：①喫煙所や自販機はありましたが、ごみ箱は見当たりませんでした。②徒歩3分ほどの距離に朝倉警察署 小石原駐在所（詳細）があり治安は安心かと思います。（投稿：2023年10月、a様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Elevation: 475m (Geospatial Information Authority of Japan map). Toilets: Available 24 hours a day, not dirty but slightly smelly. Quietness: The parking lot faces the road, and trucks pass by frequently. It might be noisy for some people (I was tired and slept well). Bathing: There is the Higashimine Village Health and Welfare Center Izumikan (details) about a 10-minute drive away. It is very cheap at 300 yen, but shampoo and soap are not provided (you need to bring or buy them) details. Dining: There is a restaurant called Kodachi on the premises, a coffee shop (9:00~17:00), and a restaurant (10:30~15:00). Other: ① There was a smoking area and vending machines, but no trash cans were found. ② There is the Asakura Police Station Koishiwara Police Box (details) about a 3-minute walk away, so I think the area is safe. (Submitted by: a, October 2023)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.title_ja: 尾田の丸池 水汲み場
properties.title_en: Oda's Maru Pond Water Drawing Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：尾田川公園に水汲み場あり。詳細、詳細（投稿：2022年6月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: There is a water source at Odagawa Park. Details, details (Submitted by: n, June 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 池之原園地 西側駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：比較的新しいトイレがあるが、冬季は凍結防止のために使用不可、夜間は車の通行量が少なく快適（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There is a relatively new toilet, but it is unusable in winter to prevent freezing. It is comfortable at night because there is little traffic (older post from before 2019).

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：繁華街の駐車場。トイレは駅まで行く。買い物は、前がショッピングモール。また、飲み屋街・ラーメンなどもあり アクセス良好。だが、出入りが多い。静寂を好みの方は、向かない。駐車料は無料、 高さ制限バーはなし（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Parking lot in a busy downtown area. Toilets are at the station. There's a shopping mall right in front. There are also bars and ramen shops nearby, so access is good. However, there's a lot of traffic. Not suitable for those who prefer quiet. Parking is free, and there are no height restrictions (older post from before 2019).

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：売店・フードコート・レストラン7:00～22:00営業。スマートIC併設。（投稿：2024年2月、n様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：SAなのに休憩中と思われるトラック1台のみで心細かったが問題なく車中泊可能。本線との間に植樹ないので結構音がする。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: Shops, food court, and restaurant open from 7:00 to 22:00. Smart interchange located next door. (Submitted by: n, February 2024)
■ Reader Report: Although it's a service area, there was only one truck that seemed to be taking a break, which made me feel uneasy, but it was possible to stay overnight in the car without any problems. There are no trees planted between it and the main road, so it's quite noisy. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：入浴のみ660円。入浴と食事で1000円。詳細。源泉掛け流しでした。普通のシャワーが付いてました。（投稿：2024年5月、t様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Bathing only: 660 yen. Bathing and meal: 1000 yen. Details: It was a natural hot spring with continuously flowing water. There was a regular shower. (Submitted by: t, May 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：入場料（清掃協力金）100円。詳細（投稿：2020年11月、N様）
■水汲み場所あり。ここのは生で飲めるらしい。超人気スポット。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: Entrance fee (cleaning cooperation fee) 100 yen. Details (Posted by: Mr./Ms. N, November 2020)
■Water drawing area available. Apparently the water here is drinkable raw. A very popular spot.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：入口近くの公園にトイレあり。飲みに行くのに便利な場所。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There are toilets in the park near the entrance. It's a convenient place to go out for drinks. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 白良ヶ浜万葉公園駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：入口から入って右奥に公衆トイレがあります。駐車場に奥行きがなく、また長い直線路の国道に併設されているため疾走音がうるさいですが深夜はとても静かです。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There is a public restroom in the back right corner after entering from the entrance. The parking lot is not very deep and is located next to a long, straight national highway, so it is noisy with the sound of cars speeding by, but it is very quiet at night. (Submitted by: M, June 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 高浜海水浴場 駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：入って左奥、海の家の隣に公衆トイレがあります。島内で最も知名度の高い海水浴場なので、シーズン中は昼夜問わず人出も出入りも多いです。2つのトンネルに挟まれた海水浴場で、最も近い民家は山と海を挟んで1km先という過疎地。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: There is a public toilet in the back left corner, next to the beach hut. As it is the most well-known beach on the island, it is crowded with people day and night during the season. The beach is sandwiched between two tunnels, and the nearest house is 1km away, separated by mountains and the sea, making it a sparsely populated area. (Submitted by: M, June 2024)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：日本最大のアーチ式水道橋。放水は概ね水～日曜・祝日の13時～（5～7月を除く）。詳細（投稿：2022年10月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Reader Report: Japan's largest arch-type aqueduct. Water is released generally from 1 PM on Wednesdays, Sundays, and public holidays (except May to July). Details (Submitted by: M, October 2022)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: ハンドメイドキッチンOJ日田若宮店
properties.title_en: Handmade Kitchen OJ Hita Wakamiya Store
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：日田市発祥のバーガーショップ。詳細、食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: A burger shop originating in Hita City. Details on Tabelog.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：日中は観光客も来るが、夜間は地元DQNの溜まり場で駐車場内でドリフトするほか、ダム周回道路をサーキットのように使って爆走するので危険。駐車場とダムの間の隅に、赤屋根白壁の公衆トイレがある。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: During the day, tourists come here, but at night it becomes a hangout for local delinquents who drift in the parking lot and use the road around the dam like a race track, making it dangerous. There is a public toilet with a red roof and white walls in the corner between the parking lot and the dam. (Submitted by: m, June 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 原鶴 バサロ
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：南側の駐車場は朝4時過ぎぐらいから多数の商品搬入車が入り、時間によっては8割ぐらい埋まる。安眠できないばかりか作業の邪魔になってしまうので絶対避けるべき。西側の駐車場からトイレに行く際は建物北側（道路側）を通るべし。南側（裏手）は土手と建物で挟まれた、人目のない真っ暗な通路なので夜は危険。それ以外はコンビニと温泉街至近で静かな良泊地。（投稿：2023年12月、f様）
■温泉街に行くと500円で日帰り入浴多数あり。トイレから遠くなるが、西側の建物の裏手の駐車場が静かで大変良い。寝るまでは東側駐車場で過ごして、寝る直前にトイレ済ませてから西側に移動すると良い。詳細案内画像を作成しました（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: The south side parking lot is filled with numerous delivery trucks from around 4 AM, sometimes reaching 80% capacity. It's not only difficult to get a good night's sleep, but it also disrupts work, so it should definitely be avoided. When going to the toilets from the west side parking lot, use the north side of the building (road side). The south side (back) is a dark, deserted passage sandwiched between the embankment and the building, making it dangerous at night. Otherwise, it's a quiet and good place to stay, close to a convenience store and a hot spring town. (Submitted by: f, December 2023)

■There are many hot springs in the hot spring town where you can enjoy a day trip for 500 yen. While it's further from the toilets, the parking lot behind the building on the west side is quiet and excellent. It's best to spend time in the east side parking lot until bedtime, use the toilet just before going to sleep, and then move to the west side. Detailed directions have been created (older posts from before 2019).

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：南西側に公衆トイレがあるほか、近在にスーパーとコンビニがあります。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There is a public restroom on the southwest side, and there is a supermarket and a convenience store nearby. (Submitted by: M, June 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 川辺やすらぎの郷
properties.title_en: Kawabe Yasuragi no Sato Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：南九州エリアのひそかにある人気スポット。朝から地元の農家の人がたくさんくるので、奥の方にとめることをおすすめします。（投稿：2025年4月、ゆーぷる様）
properties.desc_en: ■Reader Report: A hidden gem in the Southern Kyushu area. Many local farmers come here from early in the morning, so we recommend parking further back. (Submitted by: Yu-puru, April 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: さんさん富江キャンプ村駐車場
properties.title_en: Sansan Tomie Camp Village Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：内部にいくつかある駐車場群のうちのひとつで、こちらは24時間閉鎖されません。公衆トイレの隣。隣接するキャンプ場の中に自販機があるほか、近在にコンビニあり（夜間閉店）。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: This is one of several parking lots located inside the facility, and it is open 24 hours a day. It is next to the public restrooms. There are vending machines in the adjacent campground, and a convenience store nearby (closed at night). (Submitted by: m, June 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：道路沿いの小さな公園の無料Pと公衆トイレ。朝夕は交通量が多いですが、深夜は静かでした。向いにファミマがあります。温泉は車で１０分程の距離に数か所あります。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A small park along the road has free parking and public restrooms. Traffic is heavy in the mornings and evenings, but it was quiet late at night. There is a FamilyMart across the street. There are several hot springs within a 10-minute drive. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 清和文楽邑
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：道路沿いではありましたが、車の通りはそこまでなく静かに過ごせました。駐車場は第1第2とありますが、トイレも近い第1駐車場が便利だと思います。トイレは清潔で24時間使用可能でした。建物の作り、文楽に関する展示、（日時が合えば）人形浄瑠璃と見どころはたくさんあります。（投稿：2025年5月、a様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Although it was located along a road, there wasn't much traffic, so it was quiet. There are two parking lots, but I think parking lot 1 is more convenient as it's close to the restrooms. The restrooms were clean and available 24 hours a day. There are many things to see, such as the building's architecture, the exhibits related to Bunraku, and (if the timing is right) the Bunraku puppet performances. (Submitted by: A, May 2025)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：道の駅に隣接する通潤橋は、毎週土日には観光用の放水が見られるかも？温泉は、近くに国民宿舎通潤山荘がある。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website's readers: You might be able to see water being released for sightseeing purposes every Saturday and Sunday at Tsujun Bridge, which is adjacent to the roadside station. For hot springs, there is the Tsujun Sanso National Inn nearby. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：豆腐店「五ヶ山豆腐」の敷地内に自由に水を汲める蛇口がある。詳細。（投稿：2023年11月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: There is a tap on the premises of the tofu shop "Gokayama Tofu" where you can freely draw water. Details. (Submitted by: n, November 2023)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：湯平温泉と長湯温泉を結ぶ道沿い（大分県道621号の北）にある。水汲み場あり。詳細
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website readers: Located along the road connecting Yunohira Onsen and Nagayu Onsen (north of Oita Prefectural Road 621). There is a water source. Details

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：湯平温泉と長湯温泉を結ぶ道沿い（大分県道621号の南）にある。水汲み場あり。出水時間7:30〜18:30、10リットル毎に100円との事。詳細
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website's readers: Located along the road connecting Yunohira Onsen and Nagayu Onsen (south of Oita Prefectural Road 621). There is a water source. Water is available from 7:30 to 18:30, and costs 100 yen for every 10 liters. Details

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：湯の水水源水汲み場の近くの売店裏手にも水汲み場あり。詳細（投稿：2021年7月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There is also a water source behind the shop near the Yunomizu spring water source. Details (Submitted by: n, July 2021)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：東九州自動車道速見IC近く。蛇口をひねると水が出るタイプ。詳細、詳細
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Near the Hayami Interchange on the Higashi-Kyushu Expressway. It's the type where water comes out when you turn the tap. Details, details

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 渡半島集団施設地区第1駐車場
properties.title_en: Watari Peninsula Group Facility Area Parking Lot 1
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：東郷神社の隣。トイレあり。（投稿：2022年9月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Located next to Togo Shrine. Restrooms available. (Submitted by: n, September 2022)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：唐揚が絶品！隣接する焼肉店、次郎長も美味い。 ハツ刺身、ササミ刺身が新鮮！ ホルモンとレバーが美味い。特にレバーは異次元の味。食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: The fried chicken is superb! The adjacent yakiniku restaurant, Jirocho, is also delicious. The heart sashimi and chicken breast sashimi are fresh! The offal and liver are delicious. The liver in particular has an otherworldly taste. Tabelog

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：冬季もトイレは使用できるが、汲み取り式だしトイレットペーパーも常備されていない。駐車場は広めで、道路からやや離れるので夜間はかなり静か。ただ登山客が朝早くから来るので、朝は早い時間から起こされそう。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: The toilets are usable in winter, but they are pit toilets and toilet paper is not provided. The parking lot is spacious and is set back from the road, so it is quite quiet at night. However, hikers arrive early in the morning, so you might be woken up early. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 綾南川土手上トイレ（ウォシュレット）
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：土手下（川側）は、駐車可能（水位に注意）、トイレあり（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Parking is available below the embankment (river side) (be careful of water level), and there are toilets (older post from before 2019).

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：天草上島、熊本県道290号沿いにある。詳細、詳細（投稿：2023年1月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Located on Amakusa Kamishima Island, along Kumamoto Prefectural Road 290. Details, details (Submitted by: n, January 2023)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：天草オレンジラインから約2km、老嶽神社の手前。詳細（投稿：2023年6月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Approximately 2km from the Amakusa Orange Line, just before the Otake Shrine. Details (Submitted by: n, June 2023)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：天岩戸神社の北、落立神社の先にある。案内の看板あり、途中の道が細いので注意。詳細（投稿：2022年3月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Located north of Ama-no-Iwato Shrine, past Ochitate Shrine. There is a signpost, but be careful as the road is narrow. Details (Submitted by: n, March 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：鶴観察センターで早朝見に行くための近場の車中泊スポットとして利用。此の公園には車3〜4台駐車可能、トイレは和式二つ男女共同です。（投稿：2024年2月、h様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Used as a nearby overnight parking spot for early morning visits to the crane observation center. This park can accommodate 3-4 cars, and there are two Japanese-style toilets, shared by men and women. (Submitted by: h, February 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：追加情報です。’25・4・8に車中泊　夜は静かで快適です。偶然かもしれませんが、工事関係者の集合場所になっているらしく、朝6時半頃から話し声がかなりうるさかったです。また、前の道は7時半頃から基地へ向かう車列で渋滞します。近隣の「空の駅竜馬」は休業中でした。（投稿：2025年4月、tossan様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：航空自衛隊新田原基地の隣にある駐車場。綺麗なトイレ、東屋や水道もあり水も汲めます。ちょっとしたお菓子と飲み物が買える自販機あり。駐車場はフラット。20台ほどのスペース。自衛隊の訓練飛行が無い日は静かに寝られます。逆に夜間訓練がある日は戦闘機が飛びますので、当然夜遅くまで轟音が響き渡りますし、駐車場にはそれを目当てに見に来る人で一杯になります。昼間も運が良ければ戦闘機の離着陸が見られますよ。戦闘機好きなので、個人的にはAランク。（投稿：2021年11月、m様）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: Additional information. I stayed overnight in my car on April 8th, 2025. It was quiet and comfortable at night. It might be a coincidence, but it seems to be a meeting place for construction workers, as there was quite a lot of talking from around 6:30 AM. Also, the road in front gets congested with cars heading to the base from around 7:30 AM. The nearby "Sora no Eki Ryoma" (Sky Station Ryoma) was closed. (Posted: April 2025, by tossan)

■Report from our site's reader: A parking lot next to the Japan Air Self-Defense Force Nyutabaru Air Base. It has clean toilets, a gazebo, and running water. There's a vending machine where you can buy some snacks and drinks. The parking lot is flat and has space for about 20 cars. On days when there are no Self-Defense Force training flights, you can sleep peacefully. Conversely, on days with night training, fighter jets fly overhead, so naturally the roar echoes until late at night, and the parking lot is filled with people who come to watch. If you're lucky, you can also see fighter jets taking off and landing during the day. As a fighter jet enthusiast, I personally rate it A. (Posted by: M, November 2021)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：鳥栖筑紫野道路 園部IC近く。整備された天然地下水汲み場。駐車場あり。（投稿：2023年8月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Near Sonobe IC on the Tosu-Chikushino Road. A well-maintained natural groundwater collection point. Parking available. (Submitted by: n, August 2023)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：長湯温泉にある神社の境内に湧水「天満湧水 神の水」と飲泉場「陽光院薬泉堂」。水汲み場・駐車場あり。詳細
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website's readers: A spring, "Tenman Spring Water, God's Water," and a drinking spring, "Yokoin Yakusendo," are located within the grounds of a shrine in Nagayu Onsen. Water drawing area and parking available. Details

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 長崎鼻駐車場（花とぴあ山川イベントパーク）
properties.title_en: Nagasakibana Parking Lot (Hanatopia Yamakawa Event Park)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：長崎鼻に向かう県道のどん詰まりではなく、その手前1kmのあたりに二段になった駐車場とトイレがある。駐車場は芝生敷で、普通車50台級の広大なスペース。トイレは水洗洋式も、ややボロくてトイレットペーパーが切れていた。GW中に利用したが、同好の車すらなく気兼ねのない一夜を過ごせる。治安については自己責任…と言うか、人間よりも野生動物に襲われる事を心配した方が良いかも。マムシとか。イノシシとか。（投稿：2023年5月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There is a two-tiered parking lot and toilets about 1km before the dead end of the prefectural road leading to Cape Nagasakibana. The parking lot is covered with grass and has a vast space that can accommodate about 50 regular cars. The toilets are flush toilets, but they are a bit run-down and the toilet paper was out. I used it during Golden Week, but there were no other cars belonging to the same group, so I was able to spend a night without any worries. As for safety, it's your own responsibility...or rather, you should be more worried about being attacked by wild animals than by other people. Like pit vipers or wild boars. (Submitted by y in May 2023)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：長崎市の住宅地の中にある水汲み場。細い道から階段を下りた先。駐車場無し。詳細（投稿：2022年5月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A water source located in a residential area of ​​Nagasaki City. It is at the bottom of a staircase off a narrow road. No parking available. Details (Submitted by: n, May 2022)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：長崎原爆爆心地周辺に作られた公園。平和祈念像は北側にある。市営駐車場は1時間260円、1.5時間380円など（詳細）。詳細（投稿：2021年9月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A park built around the Nagasaki atomic bomb hypocenter. The Peace Memorial Statue is located on the north side. Municipal parking costs 260 yen for 1 hour, 380 yen for 1.5 hours, etc. (details). Details (Submitted by: n, September 2021)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：長崎県道41号から細い道に入った先にある水汲み場。詳細（投稿：2023年5月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A water source located down a narrow road off Nagasaki Prefectural Road 41. Details (Submitted by: n, May 2023)

properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Located along Nagasaki Prefectural Road 207, south of Senbongi Observatory. There is a parking lot near the water source. (Submitted by: n, March 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：長崎県道184号から多良岳グリーンロードに入った所。道路脇に水が出ているホースが７ヶ所程ある。詳細（投稿：2023年5月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: At the point where you turn off Nagasaki Prefectural Road 184 onto the Taradake Green Road, there are about seven hoses with water flowing from them along the side of the road. Details (Submitted by: n, May 2023)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：長崎県道136号沿い、轟渓谷の手前にある。詳細（投稿：2023年5月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Located along Nagasaki Prefectural Road 136, just before Todoroki Gorge. Details (Submitted by: n, May 2023)

■Report from our site's reader: Overnight parking and camping are prohibited in the parking lot of Oshima Ohashi Park in Nagasaki Prefecture. (As of October 3, 2024) (Submitted by: A, October 2024)

■Free parking and public restrooms. Reports indicate that overnight parking is permitted. (Information from October 2023, source of information)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: リンガーハット 長崎宿町店
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：長崎ちゃんぽんのチェーン店「リンガーハット」創業店。店内には創業当時の写真が飾られている。詳細（投稿：2022年12月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: The founding store of Ringer Hut, a Nagasaki-style champon noodle chain. Photos from the store's founding are displayed inside. Details (Submitted by: n, December 2022)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車路面は平たん、隣接道路も夜間は静かであるが、トイレ（終日利用可）がある駐車区画より一段下の区画（乗用車専用）がより静か。日帰り温泉は、車で15分の「遊湯館」（詳細）（投稿：2025年8月、千葉県MO様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場が狭く、知らないナンバープレート対しては排他的｡２時間くらいで西海橋の無料駐車場へ避難した。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: The parking surface is flat, and the adjacent road is quiet at night, but the parking area one level below the area with the toilet (available all day) (for passenger cars only) is even quieter. For a day trip to the hot springs, "Yuyukan" is a 15-minute drive away (details) (Submitted by MO from Chiba Prefecture, August 2025)

■Report from a reader of this site: The parking lot is small and exclusive towards unfamiliar license plates. I escaped to the free parking lot at Saikai Bridge after about two hours. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車路面はほぼ平たん、隣接道路も夜間は静か。周囲に人家なし。トイレ（終日利用可）日帰り温泉は車で15分の「あかねの郷」（詳細）、直近2023年4/23-24に泊（投稿：2025年8月、千葉県MO様）
■国東半島先端部の海岸線に位置し、姫島が間近に見え、遠くには山口 ・四国の島々が見える風光明媚な絶景の地。オートキャンプ場も併設。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: The parking area is mostly flat, and the adjacent road is quiet at night. There are no houses nearby. Toilets are available all day. The nearest day-trip hot spring is "Akane no Sato," a 15-minute drive away (details). Most recently, a stay was held there on April 23-24, 2023 (posted by MO from Chiba Prefecture, August 2025).

■Located on the coastline at the tip of the Kunisaki Peninsula, this scenic spot offers stunning views of Himejima Island nearby and the islands of Yamaguchi and Shikoku in the distance. An auto campsite is also available. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: （夜間閉鎖）21世紀の森公園駐車場
properties.title_en: (Closed at night) 21st Century Forest Park Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車料金無料。トイレ24時間利用可能。夏季遊泳期間中（例年5月〜9月末）のみコインシャワーが使用できます。それ以外の期間はこちらから車で約9分リゾネックス名護ホテルまたは車で約30分ホテルマハイナウェルネスリゾートでお風呂に入ることができます。21世紀の森公園は事前予約でバーベキューもできます。夜は眠ることはできましたが22時くらいから1〜2時間くらい若者がバスケットボールをしており、少しうるさかったです。注意・・駐車場は22時に閉まり、朝にまた開きます。このため22時以降は車を駐車場から出すことはできません。施設参考URL。21世紀の森公園駐車場の様子は私のYouTubeをご視聴頂ければと思います。//youtu.be/YOQGoeon29M（投稿：2021年10月、沖縄ないちゃー様、Youtubeチャンネル）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Parking is free. Toilets are available 24 hours a day. Coin showers are available only during the summer swimming season (usually from May to the end of September). During other times of the year, you can take a bath at the Rizonex Nago Hotel, about a 9-minute drive from here, or at the Hotel Mahaina Wellness Resort, about a 30-minute drive. You can also have a barbecue at 21st Century Forest Park with advance reservations. I was able to sleep at night, but there were some young people playing basketball for about 1-2 hours from around 10 PM, which was a bit noisy. Note: The parking lot closes at 10 PM and reopens in the morning. Therefore, you cannot take your car out of the parking lot after 10 PM. Facility reference URL. Please watch my YouTube video to see what the 21st Century Forest Park parking lot is like. //youtu.be/YOQGoeon29M (Posted: October 2021, Okinawa Naicha, YouTube channel)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車料金無料。トイレ24時間利用可能。こちらから車で約18分リゾネックス名護でお風呂に入ることができます。夜は国道58沿いに駐車場があり、車の音がうるさいですが、私は眠ることができました。施設参考リンク。道の駅許田駐車場の様子は私のYouTubeをご視聴頂ければと思います。//youtu.be/bweB0DDidyw（投稿：2021年11月、沖縄ないちゃー様、Youtubeチャンネル）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free parking. Toilets available 24 hours a day. You can take a bath at Rizonex Nago, which is about an 18-minute drive from here. There is a parking lot along National Route 58 at night, and it is noisy with cars, but I was able to sleep. Facility reference link. Please watch my YouTube video to see what the parking lot at Michi-no-Eki Kyoda looks like. //youtu.be/bweB0DDidyw (Posted: November 2021, Okinawa Naicha, YouTube channel)

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車料金：利用料金20分まで無料、24時間300円。トイレは３か所・駅前トイレ（宮崎交通延岡バスセンター横にあり）（とてもきれい）（たぶん夜閉まる：未確認です）・駅の建物内ファミマ（23：00まで）・歩いて１分セブン（24時間）以上です。ご参考になれば幸いです。（投稿：2021年6月、K様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Parking fee: Free for the first 20 minutes, 300 yen for 24 hours. There are three toilets: the toilet in front of the station (located next to the Miyazaki Kotsu Nobeoka Bus Center) (very clean) (probably closes at night: unconfirmed), a FamilyMart inside the station building (open until 23:00), and a 7-Eleven a 1 minute walk away (24 hours). We hope this is helpful. (Submitted by K in June 2021)

properties.label: Campground + Shower
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車料金：当日最大500円（一泊すると1000円）、トイレ24時間利用可能。温水シャワー300円。また車で約8分ホテルマハイナウェルネスリゾートでお風呂に入ることができます。キャンプサイト2000円もあり、バーベキューやテントを張るなども可能です。夜はとても静かでゆっくり眠ることができました。ビーチの目の前に駐車場が有りとてもおすすめの車中泊スポットです。注意・・駐車料金は車中泊すると次の日も500円必要になります。施設参考URL 　備瀬崎の様子は私のYouTubeをご視聴頂ければと思います。//youtu.be/R99_x5arKj0（投稿：2021年10月、沖縄ないちゃー様、Youtubeチャンネル）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Parking fee: Maximum 500 yen per day (1000 yen for an overnight stay), toilets available 24 hours a day. Hot showers are 300 yen. You can also take a bath at Hotel Mahaina Wellness Resort, about an 8-minute drive away. There is also a campsite for 2000 yen where you can have a barbecue or pitch a tent. It was very quiet at night and I was able to sleep well. There is a parking lot right in front of the beach, making it a highly recommended spot for overnight stays in your car. Note: If you stay overnight in your car, you will need to pay a 500 yen parking fee the next day as well. Facility reference URL: Please check out my YouTube video to see what Bisezaki is like. //youtu.be/R99_x5arKj0 (Posted: October 2021, Okinawa Naicha, YouTube channel)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車台数は少ないですが、とっても静か。薄暗く付近の通過車両も夕方以降少なく安眠できます。トイレ側にも駐車スペースがありますが、夕方頃まで観光バスがトイレ休憩に立ち寄ります。歩いて行ける距離にスーパー２店舗、コンビニ（両方ファミマ）２店舗が有ります。道の駅から一番近いスーパーマーケットは、かなり早い時間から総菜を３割引で販売しているほか、この店舗のみクレジットカードが使えます！（投稿：2023年12月、山びこ様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：通行量は少なくてぐっすり寝れました。２１時くらいまでは駐車場内で調理や食事をしている人も結構多い・・・（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: Although there are few parking spaces, it is very quiet. It is dimly lit, and there are few passing vehicles in the vicinity after evening, so you can sleep soundly. There is also parking space on the toilet side, but tour buses stop there for toilet breaks until around evening. There are two supermarkets and two convenience stores (both FamilyMart) within walking distance. The supermarket closest to the roadside station sells prepared foods at a 30% discount from quite early in the day, and it is the only store that accepts credit cards! (Posted by Yamabiko, December 2023)

■Report from our website reader: There was little traffic, so I was able to sleep soundly. There are quite a few people cooking and eating in the parking lot until around 9 PM... (Older post from before 2019)

properties.title_en: Osezaki Lighthouse Second Observation Deck Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場入口近辺に公衆トイレがありますが、真冬などには水道管凍結で閉鎖されていることがあります。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There is a public restroom near the entrance to the parking lot, but it may be closed due to frozen water pipes in the middle of winter. (Submitted by: M, June 2024)

properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場入口に車中泊禁止の看板がありました。（投稿：2023年1月、加藤の乱様）
■無料駐車場とトイレ。ここは夜間閉鎖されない。（2020年1月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: There was a sign at the entrance to the parking lot prohibiting overnight parking. (Submitted by: Kato no Ran, January 2023)
■Free parking and toilets. This area is not closed at night. (Confirmed on-site by administrator in January 2020)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場最奥の建物が公衆トイレで、建物は古くさいですが、有り余る大量の地下湧水を利用した常時かけ流し便座なので意外と清潔。人気が全然なく、深夜はたまに山から降りてきたシカやタヌキと出会えます。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: The building at the very back of the parking lot is a public restroom. The building is old-fashioned, but it's surprisingly clean because the toilets use a constant flow of abundant underground spring water. There are hardly any people around, and you can occasionally encounter deer or raccoons that have come down from the mountains late at night. (Submitted by: M, June 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場近くの湧水点から湧く水を柄杓で掬う。境内の池は虫が繁殖しているため水汲みに向かない。詳細、詳細
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Scooping water from a spring near the parking lot with a ladle. The pond on the temple grounds is unsuitable for drawing water due to insect infestation. Details, details

properties.label: Campground + Shower
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場も広いしトイレも24時間使えるけど、海の間にあるので海風が強い。らんたいむ氏が車中泊。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■あやはし館前にある管理棟内にコインシャワー(約2分で100円、温水は200円）が設置されています。利用可能時間9：00-18：00。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: The parking lot is spacious and the toilets are available 24 hours a day, but it's located between the seas so the sea breeze is strong. Rantime stayed overnight in his car. (Older post from before 2019)
■There are coin-operated showers (100 yen for about 2 minutes, 200 yen for hot water) inside the management building in front of Ayahashi Hall. Available hours: 9:00-18:00.

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場も広いし、トイレは24時間使えるし、近くにコンビニもあるけど、夜は走り屋とかダンスとかやってる連中が集まる場合がある。でも離れてるとなんの問題もない。夜の一時ぐらいには全部帰る。（2019年以前の古い投稿）

properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: The parking lot is narrow and at the same level as the main road, so the noise from passing vehicles is loud. On top of that, a considerable number of large trucks park in the narrow parking lot, so I was surrounded on three sides by large vehicles and it was extremely noisy. (Submitted by Yamabiko, May 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場は60台程の広さ。トイレは清潔で24時間使用可能でした。道路沿いで夜間も大型車がよく通っていました。東側はトラックが停まることが多いようで、西側（佐用姫像）側に停めることをお勧めします。ここのソフトクリームは一度は食べてみるべきかと。（投稿：2024年11月、a様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: The parking lot has space for about 60 cars. The restrooms were clean and available 24 hours a day. Large vehicles frequently pass by the road, even at night. Trucks seem to park mostly on the east side, so we recommend parking on the west side (near the Sayohime statue). You should definitely try the soft serve ice cream here at least once. (Submitted by: A, November 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場は４０台程。ひとけは無く、また交通量も少ないのか静かに過ごせました。トイレは綺麗で、ゴミ箱も24時間設置してありました。最寄りの温泉は、玄海海上温泉パレア（詳細）、車で20分ほどの距離にあります。道の駅にある、味処まつばら では海鮮料理が豊富でとても美味でした。（投稿：2024年1月、a様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: There is parking for about 40 cars. There were no people around, and the traffic was light, so it was very quiet. The toilets were clean, and there were trash cans available 24 hours a day. The nearest hot spring is Genkai Kaijo Onsen Parea (details), about a 20-minute drive away. The Ajidokoro Matsubara restaurant at the roadside station had a wide variety of delicious seafood dishes. (Submitted by: A, January 2024)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場が夜間閉鎖される上に、ご丁寧に公園内全てのトイレが夜間閉鎖されるので車中泊は不可。しかし、全てのトイレが夜間閉鎖される公園というのも初めて見た。どんだけ治安悪いんだよ、福岡。公共設備を守るためにこうするしかないんだろう。
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Not only is the parking lot closed at night, but all the toilets in the park are also closed at night, making overnight parking impossible. However, this is the first time I've seen a park where all the toilets are closed at night. How bad is the security in Fukuoka? I guess this is the only way to protect public facilities.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場から北側に歩いた先に公衆トイレがあります。地元民すら散歩でも行かないというくらい県道入口から園内まで距離があるため、昼夜どちらもとても静か。グラウンドが広いので、休日になると子供連れの家族や小中学生の野球やサッカーチームが練習に来ることがあります。R384国道交差点まで戻って西へ数百メートル進むとコンビニがあります。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There is a public restroom a short walk north from the parking lot. It is very quiet both day and night because of the distance from the entrance to the prefectural road to the park, so much so that even locals don't go there for a walk. The grounds are large, so on weekends families with children and elementary and junior high school baseball and soccer teams come to practice. If you go back to the intersection of National Route 384 and walk a few hundred meters west, there is a convenience store. (Submitted by: M, June 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：地元民定番の観光+無料駐車スペース。人の出入りが大変多いですが、長時間駐車していても何も言われません。階段上の展望台1階と手前の土産物屋正面に自販機があります。 / 地形的に濃霧が出やすく豪雨になりやすいので、運転に自信がないなら天候不順のときには登らないほうが良い。山頂北側はともかく、南側は路面にコケびっしり落ち葉もっさりの滑りやすい狭路テクニカルコースです（よく観光客がレンタカーで畑に落ちたり木に刺さったりしてます）。【追記】2024年6月現地確認。駐車場正面階段横の2階建て展望台の、1階自販機コーナーの奥に公衆トイレがありました。土産物屋のおばちゃんに確認しましたが、トイレは24時間通年開放されているとのこと。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A popular tourist spot for locals, with free parking. There's a lot of foot traffic, but you won't get told off even if you park for a long time. There are vending machines on the first floor of the observation deck at the top of the stairs and in front of the souvenir shop. / Due to the terrain, dense fog and heavy rain are common, so if you're not confident in your driving skills, it's best not to climb in bad weather. The north side of the summit is fine, but the south side is a narrow, technical course with a slippery surface covered in moss and fallen leaves (tourists often fall into fields or get stuck in trees in rental cars). [Addendum] Confirmed on site in June 2024. There was a public toilet behind the vending machine area on the first floor of the two-story observation deck next to the stairs in front of the parking lot. I confirmed with the lady at the souvenir shop that the toilet is open 24 hours a day, year-round. (Submitted by: m, June 2024)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：大浜高崎公園に2つ併設されている駐車場のうちのひとつ。公園を挟んで北西側に公衆トイレがあります。地元民でも知らない人がいるレベルの秘境、静寂度折り紙付きですが、とても狭く数台しか停まれません。/ 駐車場の向こう側が低い防波堤挟んですぐ海なので、大しけのときに停めると普通に防波堤越えてくる大波被って塩水まみれになります。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: This is one of the two parking lots located next to Ohama Takasaki Park. There is a public restroom on the northwest side of the park. It's a hidden gem that even some locals don't know about, and its tranquility is guaranteed, but it's very small and can only accommodate a few cars. / The sea is right across from the parking lot, separated only by a low breakwater, so if you park there during rough seas, you'll get soaked in saltwater from the waves that come over the breakwater. (Submitted by: M, June 2024)

properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: The glass door on the right side facing the entrance to the waiting area is the public toilet, which is generally open 24 hours a day year-round, but may be closed when the area is damaged by salt, such as during high tides. There is a vending machine behind the warehouse at the port entrance. Outside of business hours, you can sleep on the benches in the waiting room on the left, but there are swallows' nests in the ceiling, so it smells bad and you will be bothered by bird droppings. (Submitted by: M, June 2024)

It looks nice at first glance because it is a large, level parking lot, but because it is at the tip of the port, it is windy, and with ships coming and going and container trucks rumbling around, it is surprisingly noisy. (Submitted by Mr. H in December 2020. He visited Tanegashima from November 27th to December 3rd, 2020.)

properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：西九州自動車道（福岡前原道路）の福岡西料金所すぐ西側にある。トイレ・自販機のみ設置。上下線とも本線と国道に挟まれていて双方から音がする。（投稿：2022年3月、n様）
■有料道路。上り、下り、両方小規模駐車場とトイレあり。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Located just west of the Fukuoka West tollgate on the West Kyushu Expressway (Fukuoka-Maebaru Road). Only toilets and vending machines are installed. Both the northbound and southbound lanes are sandwiched between the main road and the national highway, so noise can be heard from both sides. (Submitted by: n, March 2022)
■Toll road. Small parking lots and toilets are available on both the northbound and southbound lanes.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：西ノ表市街地にある大きな公園の無料駐車場。トイレ、駐車場とも３か所あるが、一番東側は民家も近いのであまり好まれないかもしれない。トイレの位置的には西側の駐車場が良いが、ゆるい傾斜がかかっているので中央の駐車場とお好みで。幹線からは少し入るので走行音は気にならない程度だが、早朝になると散歩の島民が結構来る。西側駐車場に自販機有り。（投稿：2020年12月、H様。令和2年11月27日〜12月3日まで種子島を訪島との事。）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A free parking lot in a large park in the Nishinoomote town area. There are three toilets and three parking areas, but the easternmost one is close to private houses and may not be preferred. The western parking area is better in terms of toilet location, but it has a gentle slope, so choose between that and the central parking area depending on your preference. It is set back a little from the main road, so the traffic noise is not a problem, but quite a few islanders come for walks in the early morning. There is a vending machine in the western parking area. (Submitted by Mr. H in December 2020. He visited Tanegashima from November 27th to December 3rd, 2020.)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：生月大橋の走行音が気になるが、21時過ぎには静かになる。駐車場はやや傾斜があったかも。すぐ近くにあるラーメン屋「大氣圏」は長崎あごだしラーメンの元祖らしい。（投稿：2022年5月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: The noise from cars on the Ikitsuki Bridge is noticeable, but it quiets down after 9 PM. The parking lot might have been slightly sloped. The ramen shop "Daikiken" nearby is apparently the originator of Nagasaki ago-dashi ramen. (Submitted by y in May 2022)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：正式名不明。公衆トイレを挟んで東西に駐車スペースがあります。先に進むと2車線道路が1車線になりますが「その先は舗装はしてあっても車両進入禁止」なので、二輪車も含む車両で進むと秒で通報されます。観光地至近無料駐車場なので、徒歩で行ける範囲に自販機も食事処もあります。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Official name unknown. There are parking spaces on the east and west sides of a public restroom. Further ahead, the two-lane road narrows to one lane, but "vehicles are prohibited beyond that point, even though it's paved," so if you proceed in a vehicle, including a motorcycle, you'll be reported immediately. It's a free parking lot very close to a tourist spot, and there are vending machines and restaurants within walking distance. (Submitted by: m, June 2024)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: <font color="#ff0000">（トイレの有無不明）</font>長崎港 県営駐車場
properties.title_en: <font color="#ff0000">（トイレの有無不明）</font>長崎Port  Pref.営Parking
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：正式名は「長崎港ターミナル駐車場」（詳細）。有料だが夜30分60円（20時～8時、ほか倍額）でとても安いのに市街中心部歓楽街（浜の町）まで車で5分、徒歩でも15分程度という距離なので入れるなら夜がお得。立体駐車場内なのでアイドリングできないが、1日以上車泊しても何も言われない。反面夜が明けると周辺一帯観光地なので人出が多く、長崎港フェリー定期便が一日4～5便発着する関係で汽笛がうるさい。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: The official name is "Nagasaki Port Terminal Parking Lot" (details). It's a paid parking lot, but it's very cheap at 60 yen for 30 minutes at night (8 PM to 8 AM, double the price at other times), and it's only a 5-minute drive or a 15-minute walk to the city center's entertainment district (Hamanomachi), so it's a good deal to park there at night if possible. You can't idle your car because it's in a multi-story parking garage, but you won't get in trouble even if you park your car overnight for more than a day. On the other hand, once dawn breaks, the surrounding area is a tourist spot so it gets crowded, and the Nagasaki Port ferry has 4-5 scheduled departures and arrivals a day, so the ship's horns are noisy. (Submitted by: m, June 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 三井楽港 港湾作業スペース
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：正山みなと公園に隣接する港湾作業スペースで、よく旅行者が車中泊したりBBQしたりで遊んでます。公園内に公衆トイレがあるほか周辺至るところに自販機があり、近在1kmに製氷工場があって10kg100円で砕氷が買えます。ただ、港湾スペースなので港湾作業者が荷の積み下ろしや組み立て作業を始めたら速やかに移動したほうがいいです。また公園そばに団地がある関係で子供が多く、道に近い場所へ長時間駐車していると通報されやすいです。【追記】ここは「無料駐車場」ではなく、港湾管理者管理下の（有償）港湾スペースなので 優先使用権は常に 使用許諾を得て使用料金支払い契約済の港湾作業者にある ことに留意。あくまで地元民や釣人、旅行者などが（無許諾で勝手に）使えていて、1台2台が空き地に泊まってる程度ではいちいち怒られない、というだけです。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: The port work area adjacent to Shoyama Minato Park is often used by travelers for overnight stays in their cars and BBQs. There are public toilets in the park, vending machines all around, and an ice factory within 1km where you can buy crushed ice for 100 yen for 10kg. However, since it is a port area, you should move quickly once port workers start loading, unloading, or assembling cargo. Also, because there is a housing complex near the park, there are many children, and you are likely to be reported if you park for a long time in a place close to the road. [Addendum] Please note that this is not a "free parking lot," but a (paid) port space managed by the port authority, so priority use rights always belong to port workers who have obtained permission and have paid the usage fee. It is just that locals, fishermen, and travelers can use it (without permission), and you won't get in trouble for parking one or two cars in the open space. (Submitted by: m, June 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：初めての投稿です。2021年10月中旬に鹿児島県長島町を訪れ車中泊した針尾公園を紹介します。静かな場所で、海が見下ろせる展望台があります。いわゆる絶景ですね。丁度、写真家？の方も三脚をもって撮影をされていました。その方も一晩車中泊されていました。展望台の１階が水洗トイレ(照明は人感自動点灯）でとても綺麗です。飲み物の自動販売機24Hもあります。現在広場入り口付近の土木工事中で８時位〜１７時位まではうるさくなります。工事はもう暫く掛かりそうですがその時間を外せば快適な場所です。（投稿：2021年11月、ひろさん様）
properties.desc_en: ■Reader Report: This is my first post. I'd like to introduce Hario Park, where I stayed overnight in my car in Nagashima Town, Kagoshima Prefecture in mid-October 2021. It's a quiet place with an observation deck overlooking the sea. It's a truly spectacular view. There was a photographer there with a tripod taking pictures. He was also staying overnight in his car. The first floor of the observation deck has a flush toilet (with motion-activated lighting) and is very clean. There's also a 24-hour vending machine for drinks. Currently, there is civil engineering work near the entrance to the plaza, so it gets noisy from around 8am to 5pm. The construction seems like it will take a while longer, but it's a comfortable place outside of those hours. (Posted by: Hiro-san, November 2021)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：宿泊可能な健康ランド。入浴のみ休日1000円、平日900円。休憩（館内着・タオル付）休日1500円、平日1300円。一泊する場合1500円（土休日1800円）追加。詳細（投稿：2023年5月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A health spa where you can stay overnight. Bathing only: 1000 yen on weekends, 900 yen on weekdays. Rest area (with loungewear and towel): 1500 yen on weekends, 1300 yen on weekdays. An additional 1500 yen (1800 yen on weekends and holidays) is charged for an overnight stay. Details (Submitted by: n, May 2023)

properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Located next to the former site of a Juhachi Shinwa Bank branch. There is a water source. (Submitted by: n, March 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：周辺に街灯は無く陽が沈んだら真っ暗でした。トイレは自動点灯なので大丈夫です。またしっかりと清掃されていました。道路沿いですが、21時ごろには車の通りは少なくなり静かになりました。朝7時ごろには車の通りが増えていました。（投稿：2024年12月、a様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There are no streetlights nearby, so it gets pitch black after sunset. The toilets have automatic lights, so that's fine. They were also kept very clean. Although it's along a road, traffic slows down and it becomes quiet around 9 PM. Traffic increases again around 7 AM. (Submitted by: A, December 2024)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：周辺にいくつか関連駐車場があります（B、C駐車場）が、ここは入口が開放されていて夜でも閉鎖されません。園内に公衆トイレと自販機があります。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）

There are public restrooms and vending machines inside the park. (Submitted by: M, June 2024)

properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: There is a water source next to the reception building. Details

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：種子島北端の灯台の無料駐車場。夜間交通など一切ない島の外れのため、非常に静かだが、当然のことながら近辺に風呂も店も一切ないので、西之表市内で全て済ませてから訪問すること。駐車場は全体的に傾斜がかかっているが、一区画だけ平面のところがあり、そこを取れれば非常に快適。種子島では貴重なウォシュレット完備のトイレがある車中泊スポット。（投稿：2020年12月、H様。令和2年11月27日〜12月3日まで種子島を訪島との事。）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Free parking at the lighthouse at the northern tip of Tanegashima. It's extremely quiet because it's on the outskirts of the island with no nighttime traffic whatsoever, but naturally there are no baths or shops nearby, so be sure to take care of all your needs in Nishinoomote city before visiting. The parking lot is generally sloped, but there is one flat section, which is very comfortable if you can get that spot. It's a rare spot on Tanegashima where you can stay overnight in your car with a toilet equipped with a bidet. (Submitted by Mr. H in December 2020. He visited Tanegashima from November 27th to December 3rd, 2020.)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：種子島最南端の無料駐車場。トイレ、自販機有り。駐車場は広く水平。夜間は誰も来ず静か。職質のあった長谷公園と同じ南種子町のため、警察の巡回はあるかもしれない。（投稿：2020年12月、H様。令和2年11月27日〜12月3日まで種子島を訪島との事。）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Free parking lot at the southernmost tip of Tanegashima. Toilets and vending machines are available. The parking lot is large and level. It is quiet at night with no one around. Since it is in the same Minamitane Town as Hase Park where a police stop occurred, there may be police patrols. (Submitted by Mr. H in December 2020. He visited Tanegashima from November 27th to December 3rd, 2020.)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：蛇口の水は「天然水」の表示有。公園内の鍾乳洞は見学不可（令和7年9月まで河川法面工事中）詳細（投稿：2025年7月、FIT3様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：24時間使えるトイレと、トイレの前に飲用できる蛇口もある。自販機もある。駐車場は6台程止められる狭い駐車場だが、完全にフラット、そして、そもそも夜は車はこないので、十分静かに寝られる。楽天モバイルの電波OK。山の中なので、周りには何もない。食事などの買い物や風呂は事前に。川の流れる音が心地良い、夜は静か。個人的に気に入った場所。（投稿：2024年2月、m様）
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: The tap water is labeled "natural water." The limestone cave in the park is not open to visitors (river slope construction is underway until September 2025). Details (Posted: July 2025, FIT3)

■ Reader Report: There is a 24-hour toilet and a tap with drinkable water in front of it. There are also vending machines. The parking lot is small, accommodating about 6 cars, but it's completely flat, and since no cars come at night, it's quiet enough to sleep comfortably. Rakuten Mobile signal is OK. Since it's in the mountains, there's nothing around. Do your shopping for food and showers beforehand. The sound of the flowing river is soothing, and it's quiet at night. A place I personally liked. (Posted: February 2024, m)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: ふれあいパーク屋久島
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：車中泊適切スポット。無料駐車場とトイレ有、道路沿い安全（交通量少なく静）、近くにエムマート愛子寺田商店（コンビニ11時まで）、日帰り温泉は尾之間地区あたりで（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A suitable spot for overnight stays in a car. Free parking and toilets available, safe along the road (low traffic and quiet), M-Mart Aiko Terada Shoten (convenience store open until 11am) nearby, and day-trip hot springs are available around the Onoaida area (older post from before 2019).

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：車中泊全部で4台。トイレは綺麗でウォッシュレットありです。（投稿：2025年5月、こひ様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：普通車30台級の無料駐車場。トイレは綺麗な水洗洋式のウオシュレット付き。平日の夜に利用したが、貸し切り状態で快適な一夜を過ごせた。（投稿：2023年4月、y様）
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: A total of 4 cars were parked there for overnight stays. The toilets were clean and had bidet functions. (Submitted by: Kohi, May 2025)
■ Reader Report: A free parking lot with space for about 30 regular cars. The toilets were clean, flushable Western-style toilets with bidet functions. I used it on a weekday night and had the place all to myself for a comfortable night's sleep. (Submitted by: Y, April 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 立田山憩いの森（車中泊はお控え下さいの貼り紙）
properties.title_en: Tatsutayama Recreation Forest (Sign posted: Please refrain from overnight parking in your vehicle)
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：車中泊はお控え下さいの貼り紙有り。添付画像（投稿：2023年10月、みずさん様）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。駐車場はアスファルト舗装されている。トイレは新築でびっくりするほどキレイな水洗洋式で素晴らしい。夜間静か。超穴場。（2022年2月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: There is a sign asking people to refrain from sleeping in their cars. (See attached image - submitted by Mizu-san, October 2023)
■Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. The parking lot is paved with asphalt. The toilets are newly built and surprisingly clean, with wonderful flush toilets. Quiet at night. A real hidden gem. (Confirmed on-site by administrator in February 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 地元の方は「ホタルの里」と呼んでいる場所
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：車を停めた場所からトイレまでは…約100ｍ。【 注意点 】夜間は証明等も無いので非常に暗い。側溝に脱輪しない様、明るい時に車の移動をする必要あり。場所によってはスリップして脱出が出来ない傾斜もあり：脱出し辛い傾斜はここ詳細 キャンパーもいたり、少し離れれば民家もある。しかし、コンビニ等が全く無いので飲食物は用意しておく必要がある。川の流れる音がけっこう大きい。以上（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: The distance from where we parked the car to the toilet was about 100m. [Points to note] It is very dark at night as there are no lights. You need to move your car when it is light to avoid getting stuck in the ditch. In some places there are slopes where you may slip and be unable to get out: Details of the slopes that are difficult to get out of are here. There are campers, and houses a little further away. However, there are no convenience stores or anything like that, so you need to bring your own food and drinks. The sound of the river flowing is quite loud. That's all (older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：鹿児島市の「清水小前」交差点にある（駐車位置注意）。蛇口をひねるタイプ。詳細、詳細（投稿：2022年6月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Located at the "Shimizu Elementary School" intersection in Kagoshima City (be careful of parking location). It's a tap-type toilet. Details, details (Submitted by: n, June 2022)

properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A water source along Kagoshima Prefectural Road 499. Parking available. Details (Submitted by: n, May 2024)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：鹿児島県道210号から細い道に入る。細部は地図参照。水質検査済。（投稿：2024年2月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Take a narrow road off Kagoshima Prefectural Road 210. See map for details. Water quality tested. (Submitted by: n, February 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)

properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Located on the grounds of Izumi Shuzo, a sake brewery in Kagoshima Prefecture, water can be drawn from 10:00 to 17:00. Water quality has been tested. Details, details (Posted by: User 7, June 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 荒川登山口 屋久島
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：鹿児島県の屋久島の荒川登山口駐車場は車中泊禁止となってます。それに、春~秋季は自家用車は通行止めで、登山バスで登山口へ行かなければいけません。（投稿：2020年8月、P様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：当スポットは、山中で何もなく翌朝の早朝登山利用者のみ可 →屋久島は熊はいないと言われていますが、山道(林道)が狭く道中も危険である（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: Overnight parking is prohibited at the Arakawa trailhead parking lot on Yakushima Island in Kagoshima Prefecture. Furthermore, private cars are prohibited from passing through from spring to autumn, and you must take a mountain bus to the trailhead. (Submitted by P, August 2020)

■Report from our website reader: This spot is in the mountains with no facilities and is only accessible to early morning hikers. → While it's said that there are no bears on Yakushima, the mountain paths (forest roads) are narrow and the journey is dangerous. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：鹿児島ラーメンの老舗。食べログ、詳細（投稿：2024年7月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A long-established Kagoshima ramen restaurant. Tabelog, details (Posted: July 2024, by user n)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: （<font color="#ff0000">トイレ無し</font>）コインランドリー福江駐車場
properties.title_en: （<font color="#ff0000">トイレ無し</font>）コインランドリー福江Parking
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：自販機ありトイレなし。洗車場とコインランドリー施設が併設されている店舗敷地なのですが、コインランドリーが24時間営業なので洗濯物を洗うついでに敷地内で朝まで就寝していても特に何も言われません。有料ですが給水設備もあります（非飲用）。表の県道を東に数百メートル進むとコンビニがあります。注意点として、DQN車が洗車に訪れることがあるのと、敷地入口に縁石段差があり、入口も狭いのでキャンピングカーなど大型車は入りづらいです。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Vending machines available, but no toilets. The store premises include a car wash and a coin laundry facility, but since the coin laundry is open 24 hours, you can sleep on the premises until morning while your laundry is being washed without any problems. There is also a water supply facility (not for drinking) for a fee. There is a convenience store a few hundred meters east along the prefectural road in front of the store. Points to note: DQN cars sometimes come to wash their cars, and there is a curb step at the entrance to the premises, and the entrance is narrow, so it is difficult for large vehicles such as campervans to enter. (Submitted by: m, June 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 多郎島海水浴場駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：至近距離に公衆トイレがあります。 / 注意点として、駐車場から東西方向、海沿いに景観がすばらしい舗装路がありますが自転車用サイクリングロードなので、誤って車で侵入すると延々とバックで入口まで戻るハメになります。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There is a public restroom very close by. / As a point of caution, there is a paved road with a wonderful view running east and west along the coast from the parking lot, but it is a cycling path for bicycles, so if you accidentally drive onto it, you will have to back up for a long time all the way back to the entrance. (Submitted by: M, June 2024)

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：私が2024/6/6に長崎市内にて実際に宿泊した車中泊スポットを報告します。料金：夜間21時～翌朝8時まで最大400円、昼間8時～21時まで（奥の方5,6,7,8,番区画のみ）最大1400円、オールタイム20分100円。12台ほどの小規模なパーキングですが、私が泊まった際には他に車はいませんでした。トイレは道を渡ってすぐ（徒歩数歩）の出島ワーフ公衆トイレ（水洗できれい）が24時間使用できます。夜中は横の道路の交通量も少なく、快眠できました。ロケーションのいい出島ワーフに隣接している駐車場ですので、テラス席での食事や散歩も楽しめます。グラバー園、眼鏡橋、思案橋や中華街、孔子廟、浜町なども徒歩圏内ですので長崎観光の拠点としてもおすすめです。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: I would like to report on the car camping spot where I actually stayed overnight in Nagasaki City on June 6, 2024. Rates: Maximum 400 yen from 9 PM to 8 AM the next morning, maximum 1400 yen from 8 AM to 9 PM (only the furthest sections 5, 6, 7, and 8), 100 yen for every 20 minutes at all times. It is a small parking lot with about 12 spaces, but there were no other cars when I stayed there. The public toilets at Dejima Wharf (clean flush toilets) are just across the road (a few steps away) and are available 24 hours a day. There was little traffic on the adjacent road at night, so I was able to sleep well. It is a parking lot adjacent to the well-located Dejima Wharf, so you can enjoy meals on the terrace or take a walk. Glover Garden, Meganebashi Bridge, Shianbashi Bridge, Chinatown, Confucius Temple, and Hamamachi are all within walking distance, so it is also recommended as a base for sightseeing in Nagasaki. (Submitted by: M, June 2024)

properties.title_en: Roadside Station Yamakawa Port Live Sea Road
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：指宿名物の砂蒸し温泉に入ってからここで泊まりました。漁船の係留場所に面した小さな道の駅。食堂は15時閉店。夜間は通行量が少なく、快適でした。大隅半島を結ぶフェリー乗り場から僅か100mちょっとです。（2018年12月投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：漁港近くですが夜はとても静かで快眠できます。トラックなどの大型車はまず来ないと思います。食事処も新鮮な海産物を使った料理が多く比較的安めでいただけます。wifiは施設の近くであれば使えますけど少し離れると電波が弱いです。トイレはちょっと狭いですが綺麗です。車で10分以内にコンビニやスーパーもあります。指宿や開聞岳周辺を観光する際の拠点にちょうどいいところなのではと思います。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Reader Report: I stayed here after enjoying the famous sand baths in Ibusuki. It's a small roadside station facing a fishing boat mooring area. The restaurant closes at 3 PM. There was little traffic at night, which was nice. It's just over 100m from the ferry terminal connecting to the Osumi Peninsula. (Posted December 2018)

■Reader Report: Although it's near a fishing port, it's very quiet at night, making for a good night's sleep. I don't think large vehicles like trucks come by. The restaurants offer many dishes using fresh seafood, and they're relatively inexpensive. Wi-Fi is available near the facility, but the signal is weak if you go a little further away. The toilets are a bit small but clean. There are convenience stores and supermarkets within a 10-minute drive. I think it's a good base for sightseeing around Ibusuki and Mount Kaimon. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Free Campground
properties.title_ja: 遙拝八の字広場（無料キャンプ場）
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：最近、オープンした無料キャンプ場。広大な…とまでは行かないが、十分広い芝生エリアと駐車場スペース。駐車場は全面フラット。トイレ超キレイ。そして、トイレの横に飲用も可能な洗い場有り。非常に好条件なキャンプ場。駐車場は、北にある鉄道の線路の下まで舗装されているが、線路周辺に駐めると、夜遅くまで鉄橋の轟音が響くので注意。線路手前に高速も走っているが、夜中の走行音はそこまで気にならない。買い出しはコンビニなら車で3分。市内まで足を伸ばせば、スーパーやドンキなど何でもある。2022/12/30現在も、キャンパー多数。車中泊もちらほら。個人的に、洗い場があるのとトイレの綺麗さでかなりのオススメ。（投稿：2022年12月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A recently opened free campsite. It's not exactly vast, but it has a sufficiently large grassy area and parking space. The parking lot is completely flat. The toilets are super clean. And there's a washing area next to the toilets where you can also drink the water. It's a very good campsite. The parking lot is paved up to the railway tracks to the north, but be careful if you park near the tracks as the roar of the railway bridge can be heard late at night. There is also a highway running in front of the tracks, but the traffic noise at night is not that bothersome. For shopping, there is a convenience store in 3 minutes by car. If you go to the city, there are supermarkets and Don Quijote and everything you need. As of December 30, 2022, there are still many campers. There are also a few people sleeping in their cars. Personally, I highly recommend it because of the washing area and the cleanliness of the toilets. (Posted by: m, December 2022)

That group dispersed around midnight, so your sleep won't be disturbed. There are convenience stores, izakayas, and a 24-hour MaxValu within a 10-minute walk, although they are in different directions. (Submitted by: f, November 2023)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：高台にある公園の無料駐車場。トイレ有り。キャンプ場になっているが（テントサイト有り）、駐車場で車中泊可能。駐車場は全面が水平で超静かだが、当然の如く周囲には景色以外何もない。日が暮れてから向かうのはちょっと怖いが、西之表市街からは意外と近い。（投稿：2020年12月、H様。令和2年11月27日〜12月3日まで種子島を訪島との事。）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A free parking lot in a park located on a hill. There are toilets. It is a campsite (with tent sites), but it is possible to stay overnight in your car in the parking lot. The parking lot is completely level and extremely quiet, but as you might expect, there is nothing around except the scenery. It's a little scary to go there after dark, but it's surprisingly close to Nishinoomote town. (Submitted by Mr. H in December 2020. He visited Tanegashima from November 27th to December 3rd, 2020.)

properties.title_ja: 雷山観音登山口駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：紅葉の名所雷山千如寺大悲王院近くの無料駐車場。夜間閉鎖なし。大型キャンピングカーも駐車可能な広さ。24時間使用可能なトイレあり。洋式水洗できれいに管理されている。夜間は車の通りがほとんどなく静か。トイレの灯りの他は真っ暗になるがすぐ隣に民家があり治安は悪くなさそう。ドコモ、auの電波は入るが楽天モバイルは圏外でした。（投稿：2023年11月、g様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Free parking lot near Raizan Sennyoji Daihioin, a famous spot for autumn leaves. No closures at night. Spacious enough to park large campervans. 24-hour toilet available. Western-style flush toilets are kept clean. Very quiet at night with almost no traffic. It gets pitch black except for the toilet light, but there are houses right next door so it seems safe. Docomo and au have reception, but Rakuten Mobile had no signal. (Submitted by: g, November 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：広大な埋め立て敷地内に2つある港湾公園のひとつで、駐車場に隣接して綺麗な多機能トイレがあります。こちらには自販機がない代わりに、河川敷を降りて川から取水できます。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: This is one of two port parks located within a vast reclaimed land area. There is a clean, multi-functional restroom adjacent to the parking lot. While there are no vending machines here, you can go down to the riverbank and draw water from the river. (Submitted by: M, June 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：広大な埋め立て敷地内に2つある港湾公園のひとつで、こちらは駐車場とグラウンドの間に公衆トイレと自販機があります。道を挟んで対面の未舗装駐車場側に大型車が停まるので、アイドリングしていても音が響いてきません。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: This is one of two port parks located on a vast reclaimed land area. Here, there are public restrooms and vending machines between the parking lot and the sports field. Large vehicles park on the unpaved parking lot across the road, so even if they are idling, the noise doesn't carry. (Submitted by: M, June 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 津志田河川自然公園 乙女河原
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：広大な広さの、河原の公園。キャンプ場ではないことに注意。あくまで、テントを張ることを許可されている「公園」なので、誤解無きよう。だが、非常に人気のスポットで、寒い今の時期でも、かなりの数のテント、そして、車中泊の車も多数。私もかれこれ、車中泊で数日お世話になっております。キャンプ場ではないので、水場は無い。そしてトイレは1箇所しかないので、車を止める場所によっては、トイレが非常に遠くなる。トイレは、ウォシュレット付き温かい便座。そして、地元の方のご厚意だろうか？たくさんのアメニティ(歯磨き粉、カイロ、台所洗剤など)が備え付けてある。モグラにも人気の場所のようで、至る所にモグラ塚がある。テントを張ってモグラに下から突かれないように注意（笑）買い出しは、車で5分で、スーパー、百均、ドラッグストア、ホームセンター、コンビニ等集まっており、非常に便利。スーパーのマルショク御船店は夕方4時頃には惣菜が半額になる。そして美味い。夜は完全に真っ暗、星がキレイ。個人的に超おすすめの場所。（投稿：2022年12月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: A vast riverside park. Note that it is not a campsite. It is merely a "park" where you are permitted to pitch tents, so please do not misunderstand. However, it is a very popular spot, and even in this cold season, there are a considerable number of tents and many cars where people are sleeping in. I myself have been staying there for several days now, sleeping in my car. Since it is not a campsite, there is no water source. And there is only one toilet, so depending on where you park your car, the toilet may be very far away. The toilet has a heated seat with a bidet. And perhaps thanks to the kindness of the locals, there are many amenities provided (toothpaste, hand warmers, dish soap, etc.). It also seems to be a popular spot for moles, as there are molehills everywhere. Be careful not to get poked from below by moles when you pitch your tent (lol). For shopping, there are supermarkets, 100-yen shops, drugstores, home centers, convenience stores, etc. all within a 5-minute drive, which is very convenient. At the Marushoku Mifune supermarket, prepared foods are half price around 4 pm. And they are delicious. It's pitch black at night, and the stars are beautiful. Personally, I highly recommend this place. (Posted by: M, December 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: （<font color="#ff0000">夏以外トイレ無し</font>）舅ケ島海水浴場
properties.title_en: （<font color="#ff0000">夏以外トイレ無し</font>）舅ケ島Swimming Beach
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：公衆トイレ横に数台の駐車スペースがあります。トイレ施設内に水シャワーと更衣室が併設されていますが、夏休みシーズン外は閉鎖されます。ぶっちゃけ田舎すぎて路駐してても特に誰も文句は言いませんが、迂回路がない一本道なので最低限他の車が通過できる幅員は空けてください。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There are several parking spaces next to the public toilets. The toilet facilities include a shower and changing room, but they are closed outside of the summer holiday season. To be honest, it's such a rural area that nobody really complains even if you park on the side of the road, but since it's a single road with no detours, please leave enough space for other cars to pass. (Submitted by: m, June 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 岐宿水ノ浦憩いの広場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：公衆トイレのある公園駐車場。場内は狭く国道に近いですが、昼夜共にそこまで交通量はありません。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A park parking lot with public restrooms. The lot is small and close to a national highway, but there isn't much traffic day or night. (Submitted by: M, June 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：公衆トイレに隣接している数台分の駐車場ですが、敷地を出て港湾スペースにも駐められます（実際釣人や漁民を中心に結構な数の放置車両がいつもいます）。日中は近在に食事処や喫茶店があります。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: There are a few parking spaces adjacent to the public restrooms, but you can also park outside the premises in the harbor area (in fact, there are always quite a few abandoned vehicles there, mainly belonging to anglers and fishermen). There are restaurants and cafes nearby during the daytime. (Submitted by: M, June 2024)

properties.title_ja: 大宝憩いの広場駐車場・トイレ

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：公衆トイレと駐車場のみの簡易PA。ただ、国道と県道の分岐点に近いので日中交通量は意外と多いです。公衆トイレの右奥側の真上に大木の枝が伸びており、日陰で涼しい。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A simple rest area with only a public toilet and parking lot. However, it is close to the junction of a national and a prefectural road, so traffic volume is surprisingly high during the day. A large tree branch extends directly above the back right of the public toilet, providing a cool, shady spot. (Submitted by: M, June 2024)

properties.title_ja: 天地山公園 駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：公園百選に選ばれた公園です。駐車場は狭く15台程度。トイレあり。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: This park was selected as one of Japan's Top 100 Parks. The parking lot is small, accommodating only about 15 cars. There are restrooms. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：公園内歩道を北東グラウンド方向へ進むと公衆トイレがあります。近在数百メートル以内に自販機が無数にあるほか、製氷工場があって一般人でも器さえ持ち込めば20kg200円でかち割り氷が買えます。たまに地元キャンパーがBBQやってます。 / 公園近辺の海に面した舗装空き地は無料駐車場ではないですが非私有地で港湾作業スペースなので長時間駐車ができます。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: If you head northeast towards the grounds along the park's footpath, you'll find a public restroom. Within a few hundred meters, there are countless vending machines, and there's also an ice factory where even ordinary people can buy crushed ice for 200 yen for 20kg, provided they bring their own container. Local campers occasionally have BBQs there. / The paved open space facing the sea near the park isn't a free parking lot, but it's not private property and is a port work area, so you can park there for extended periods. (Submitted by: M, June 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: （<font color="#ff0000">トイレ無し</font>）金山サクラ アジサイ園
properties.title_en: （<font color="#ff0000">トイレ無し</font>）金Mt.サクラ アジサイ園
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：現地未確認、情報提供。トイレも街灯も水場もありませんし未舗装駐車場で狭いですが、トンネルの山頂にありとても涼しく、また園内開花シーズンが3～7月と短いため、時期を外すとほぼ無人。一応展望台はあるんですが、夜に行っても何も見えません。R201道の駅いとだの至近距離なので意外とアクセスはいいです。夜に行くと駐車場へ登る道の案内板は見落としやすい。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Information provided, not verified on-site. There are no toilets, streetlights, or water sources, and the parking lot is small and unpaved, but it is located on top of a mountain with a tunnel and is very cool. Also, the flowering season in the park is short, from March to July, so it is almost deserted outside of that time. There is an observation deck, but you can't see anything if you go at night. It is surprisingly easy to access as it is very close to the Itoda roadside station on Route 201. If you go at night, it is easy to miss the sign for the road leading up to the parking lot. (Submitted by: m, June 2024)

■当サイト読者様レポート：現在はバリケードの所に警告の看板はあるが隙間が開いており、ここに車を止めて地元の人などが通っている。
■別府三秘湯。例の事件後に閉鎖（詳細）。現在も厳重な封鎖。いちおう、バリケードのところに車を置いて、徒歩で抜けていけば、バリケードから徒歩５分くらいでいける。Googleマップで航空写真に切り替えて見るとわかりやすい。最高峰の露天風呂。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Currently, there is a warning sign at the barricade, but there is a gap, and locals and others park their cars there and pass through.

■Beppu's three secret hot springs. Closed after the incident (details). Still strictly sealed off. However, if you park your car at the barricade and walk through, it takes about 5 minutes on foot from the barricade. It's easier to see if you switch to satellite view on Google Maps. The finest open-air bath.

A footbath is open for free. There are countless vending machines and one convenience store within walking distance, but there are no public restrooms. (Submitted by: M, June 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：橋を挟んで東西2つに分かれています。西側駐車場の奥に公衆トイレがあり、また駐車場に入らず道路を真っ直ぐ進むと行き止まり場所に海の家があって自販機があります。 注）狭い西側駐車場の入口は急傾斜になっているので、シャコタン車や車長が長いキャンピングカーは底面をこする可能性があります。南側に伸びる狭い歩道の先に砂防ダムと花見園地があり、キャンプしてる人がたまにいます。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: The area is divided into east and west by a bridge. There is a public restroom at the back of the west side parking lot, and if you go straight down the road without entering the parking lot, you will reach a dead end where there is a beach hut and a vending machine. Note: The entrance to the narrow west side parking lot is steeply sloped, so lowered cars and long campervans may scrape their bottoms. There is a sand control dam and a cherry blossom viewing area at the end of a narrow pedestrian walkway that extends to the south, and you will occasionally see people camping there. (Submitted by: M, June 2024)

At night it is completely dark and you cannot see your hands, let alone your feet. / During the tourist season, many large tour buses come in line, so you may be asked to move your parking spot. (Submitted by: M, June 2024)

properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Free parking at Hamada Beach, home to the tourist attraction, Senza no Iwaya. Toilets and vending machines are available. The parking lot is vast and level. (Submitted by Mr. H in December 2020. He visited Tanegashima from November 27th to December 3rd, 2020.)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 回廊パーク「サンセットビュー能野」
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：幹線道路沿いにある無料駐車場。トイレ有り。駐車区画はあまり多くはないが水平。海沿いだが海は全く見えず入り口も分かりにくいため夜間に訪れる車は殆ど無い。道路からは少し離れているが道路の通行量は種子島としては一番多い道路にあたるため、少々走行音は聞こえる。（投稿：2020年12月、H様。令和2年11月27日〜12月3日まで種子島を訪島との事。）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A free parking lot located along a main road. There are restrooms. There aren't many parking spaces, but they are level. It's by the sea, but you can't see the ocean at all, and the entrance is hard to find, so there are hardly any cars visiting at night. It's a little distance from the road, but the road is the busiest road on Tanegashima, so you can hear some traffic noise. (Submitted by Mr. H in December 2020. He visited Tanegashima from November 27th to December 3rd, 2020.)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：幹線道路沿いにある公園の無料駐車場。トイレ、自販機有り。駐車場は水平だが、幹線道路のすぐ脇なうえに道路にアップダウンがあるため、走行音はそれなりに大きい。住宅地が近いため、全力警戒される可能性も大。（投稿：2020年12月、H様。令和2年11月27日〜12月3日まで種子島を訪島との事。）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Free parking lot at a park located along a main road. Toilets and vending machines are available. The parking lot is level, but because it is right next to a main road and the road has inclines and declines, the noise from vehicles is quite loud. There is a high possibility of being closely watched due to the proximity of a residential area. (Submitted by Mr. H in December 2020. He visited Tanegashima from November 27th to December 3rd, 2020.)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：幹線国道沿いのため、大型トラックが走ると轟音が響く。駐車場にトラックが来るとアイドリング音うるさい。人吉よりの温泉クレオンで入浴してすっきり。トイレは少し薄暗い。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Because it's located along a major national highway, there's a loud roar when large trucks pass by. When trucks come into the parking lot, the idling noise is loud. I felt refreshed after taking a bath at Onsen Creon, which is closer to Hitoyoshi. The toilets are a little dimly lit. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A memorial monument for teachers and students who died in the Battle of Okinawa. It conveys the tragedy of the Battle of Okinawa to this day. Details (Submitted by: n, November 2025)

Many hikers staying overnight in their cars use this parking area. For hot springs, there's the Hikosan Onsen Shakunage-so nearby. (Older post from before 2019)
