He visited Tanegashima from November 27th to December 3rd, 2020.)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：ロケット打ち上げ観覧用に整備された公園の無料駐車場。トイレ有り。ロケットの打ち上げが無ければだれも来ず、静かで広大な駐車場があるが全面にきつめの傾斜が付いており、警察の巡回・職質もあるためあまりお勧めではない。（投稿：2020年12月、H様。令和2年11月27日〜12月3日まで種子島を訪島との事。）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: A free parking lot in a park that has been prepared for watching rocket launches. There are toilets. When there are no rocket launches, no one comes and it is a quiet and spacious parking lot, but the entire area has a steep slope and there are police patrols and questioning, so it is not highly recommended. (Submitted by Mr. H in December 2020. He visited Tanegashima from November 27th to December 3rd, 2020.)

properties.label: Roadside Station (Info)
properties.title_en: Underground water from the Kuju mountain range
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：やまなみハイウェイの休憩所、瀬の本レストハウスの敷地内（駐車場脇）にある。詳細、詳細（投稿：2021年3月、N様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Located on the grounds of the Senomoto Rest House, a rest stop on the Yamanami Highway (next to the parking lot). Details, details (Submitted by Mr./Ms. N, March 2021)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: もつ鍋 やましょう 博多本店
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：やましょう鍋がオススメ！食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Yamasho Nabe is highly recommended! (Tabelog)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 甲佐町 やな場駐車場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：やな場と公園の駐車場。道路沿いの広い駐車場のほか、細い道を入っていくと奥の方にトイレに隣接する8台ほどの狭い駐車場あり。風呂は石段の郷 佐俣の湯が車で10分程度。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Parking at the weir and park. In addition to the large parking lot along the road, there is a small parking lot for about 8 cars located further down a narrow road, next to the toilets. For bathing, Ishidan no Sato Samata no Yu is about a 10-minute drive away. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 辞本涯の碑 駐車場
properties.title_en: Monument to the End of One's Life Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：ものすごく綺麗で清潔な24時間公衆トイレがあり、静寂で涼しく景観も良く最強ポイント、なのですが「ここに至るまでの道筋が超絶テクニカルコース」なので、運転に自信がないとかレンタカーなどを借りているなら絶対に避けるべき場所。キャンピングカーで行くとか正気を疑うレベル。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There's an incredibly clean and hygienic 24-hour public restroom, and it's quiet, cool, and has a great view—it's the best spot! However, "the road to get there is an extremely technical course," so if you're not confident in your driving skills or have rented a car, you should definitely avoid this place. Going there in a campervan is just insane. (Submitted by: m, June 2024)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: 海上自衛隊鹿屋航空基地資料館
properties.title_en: Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force Kanoya Air Base Museum
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：まるで新造機かと思うくらいコックピットの細部まで復元されたかつての日本の名戦闘機零式艦上戦闘機５２型が展示されてます。入場料は無料。他にも多数の貴重な展示物あり。敷地内のおみやげ屋の中にある食堂で鹿屋海軍航空カレーが食べれます。甘口ですが美味しい！食べログ
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A Type 52 Zero fighter, a legendary Japanese fighter plane, is on display, restored to such a high degree of detail in the cockpit that it looks like a brand new aircraft. Admission is free. There are also many other valuable exhibits. You can eat Kanoya Naval Air Curry at the restaurant inside the souvenir shop on the premises. It's sweet, but delicious! (Tabelog)

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.title_ja: ホテルニューオオタニ博多の斜め前駐車場(パーキング一楽)
properties.title_en: Parking lot diagonally across from Hotel New Otani Hakata (Parking Ichiraku)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：ホテルニューオオタニ博多の斜め前駐車場(パーキング一楽)､トイレは1Fのスーパー(24h)｡風呂は､同系列のホテル一楽｡(エレベーター内に案内あり)駐車可能車両 高さ 2.1m 長さ 5.0m 幅 1.9m駐車料金 24h 900円(キャンペーン価格)（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Parking lot diagonally across from Hotel New Otani Hakata (Parking Ichiraku). Toilets are in the supermarket on the 1st floor (24 hours). Baths are at the affiliated Hotel Ichiraku. (Information is available in the elevator) Vehicles that can be parked: Height 2.1m, Length 5.0m, Width 1.9m. Parking fee: 900 yen for 24 hours (campaign price) (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：フードコート11:00〜17:30・売店8:00〜19:00営業。一般道からも8:00〜19:00の間は利用可（詳細）。（投稿：2022年1月、n様）
■本線と分離で悪くない。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: Food court open 11:00-17:30, shop open 8:00-19:00. Accessible from the public road between 8:00 and 19:00 (details). (Submitted by: n, January 2022)
■Not bad, separated from the main road.

properties.label: Highway Rest + Shower
properties.title_ja: 吉志PA（下り側にシャワー、8：00-20：00）
properties.title_en: Kishi PA (showers available on the southbound side, 8:00-20:00)""
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：フードコート・売店8:00-22:00営業。大型トラックが多い。（投稿：2020年9月、N様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：九州道・吉志PA（下り）2019年4月利用。コインシャワーは20時までです（10分300円）。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■下り側シャワーステーションあり！（300円/10分、詳細）これは便利、トラックがメチャクチャ多く、アイドリング音が猛烈にうるさいので寝るのにはおすすめしない。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: Food court and shops are open from 8:00 to 22:00. There are many large trucks. (Submitted by Mr./Ms. N, September 2020)
■ Reader Report: Kyushu Expressway, Kishi PA (downbound), used in April 2019. Coin showers are available until 20:00 (300 yen for 10 minutes). (Older post from before 2019)
■ Shower station available on the downbound side! (300 yen/10 minutes, details) This is convenient, but there are a lot of trucks, and the idling noise is extremely loud, so it's not recommended for sleeping. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：フードコート・売店7:00-22:00営業。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website's readers: Food court and shops are open from 7:00 to 22:00. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：フードコート・売店24h営業。福岡方面にスマートIC（終日利用可能）併設。（投稿：2022年6月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Food court and shops are open 24 hours. Smart interchange (open all day) is located on the Fukuoka side. (Submitted by: n, June 2022)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：フードコート・売店24h営業。（投稿：2021年4月、N様）
■下道用ウェルカムゲート下り側について：傾斜あり。インター入り口の進入路が隣接していてトラックが走るとうるさい。イマイチ。（2020年3月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Food court and shops are open 24 hours. (Submitted by Mr./Ms. N, April 2021)
■Regarding the welcome gate for the lower road on the southbound side: There is a slope. The entrance road to the interchange is adjacent, and it is noisy when trucks pass by. Not great. (Administrator's on-site inspection, March 2020)

properties.label: Highway Rest Area
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：パーキングエリアなので静粛は求められない(大型が走るたびに結構な音の反響あり)（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Since it's a parking area, quietness cannot be expected (there is a considerable echo of noise every time a large vehicle passes by) (older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：とても広い駐車場で、夜間は非常に静か。付近に商店はない。トイレは二箇所あり、うち一つは屋根付きＰがある身障者用。翌朝は豪快な滝が存分に楽しめる。入浴は南へ7kmの「針持温泉」（詳細）がお薦め。掛け流しの極上湯が迎えてくれる。（投稿：2023年10月、tossan様）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ（水洗洋式でキレイ！）。RVパーク併設（RVパークいさ曽木の滝）で、有料で電源利用も可能。夜は誰も来ないのでメチャクチャ静か。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■【RVパーク いさ曽木の滝】1泊　1500円／1台　電源100円／1時間　詳細
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: The parking lot is very spacious and extremely quiet at night. There are no shops nearby. There are two toilets, one of which is a covered parking area for disabled persons. The next morning, you can fully enjoy the magnificent waterfall. For bathing, we recommend "Harimochi Onsen" (details) 7km to the south. You will be greeted by a superb free-flowing hot spring. (Posted by tossan, October 2023)
■Free parking and public toilets (clean flush toilets!). An RV park is attached (RV Park Isasogi no Taki), and electricity is available for a fee. It's extremely quiet at night because no one comes. (Older post from before 2019)
■【RV Park Isasogi no Taki】1 night 1500 yen/1 vehicle, electricity 100 yen/hour, details

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ有るが、建付けが悪い、南側からが楽。近くにスーパーが無いので市街地で買い物を。湧き水は無料で数量制限なし。お向かいの豆腐屋さんが美味しい。オカラが無料でもらえる。（投稿：2022年7月、タケニィ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There is a toilet, but it is poorly constructed and easier to use from the south side. There are no supermarkets nearby, so you have to shop in the city center. The spring water is free and there is no limit on the amount you can take. The tofu shop across the street is delicious. You can get okara (soy pulp) for free. (Submitted by Takenii in July 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 雲仙多良シーライン休憩所
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ有り。車の通る音がうるさいかも。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: There is a toilet. It might be noisy due to passing cars. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ有。遊歩道を少し歩けば夕陽がきれいな放牧地です。お風呂、買い物は平戸にて。添付画像（投稿：2023年1月、タケニィ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There are toilets. A short walk along the promenade leads to a pasture where you can enjoy beautiful sunsets. Baths and shopping are available in Hirado. Attached image (Submitted by Takenii, January 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 俗称：サザエのつぼ焼き売店駐車場（佐賀県唐津市 波戸岬海水浴場東側の駐車場）
properties.title_en: Common name: Parking lot for the grilled turban shell stall (parking lot on the east side of Hatodomari Beach, Karatsu City, Saga Prefecture)""
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ有。近くにスーパーが無いので市街地で買い物を。駐車場全体に傾斜があるので気になる方は北側の有料駐車場の方がいいかも。夜間は管理人さんが不在なのでタダ。但し、釣り人が夜間・早朝通るので煩わしいかも。お風呂は国民宿舎「波戸岬」500ｍ。海が見える温泉「玄海海上温泉パレア」13ｋｍもいいですよ。（投稿：2022年7月、タケニィ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There are toilets. There are no supermarkets nearby, so you'll need to shop in the city center. The entire parking lot is sloped, so if that bothers you, the paid parking lot on the north side might be better. There is no attendant at night, so it's free. However, fishermen pass by at night and early in the morning, which might be annoying. For baths, there is the National Inn "Hato Misaki" 500m away. The hot spring with an ocean view, "Genkai Kaijo Onsen Parea" 13km away, is also good. (Submitted by Takenii in July 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 富岡海域公園展望所（熊本県天草 富岡城址近くの駐車場）
properties.title_en: Tomioka Marine Park Observation Deck (Parking lot near Tomioka Castle Ruins, Amakusa, Kumamoto Prefecture)""
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ有。こちらも夕陽スポットです。隣にキャンプ場（有料、詳細）もありますのでテント泊もできます。お風呂は、少し遠いですが13ｋｍ東の通詞島「ユメール」を。買い物はスパーマーケット「アタックス　シープル店」4ｋｍ。コインランドリーもあります。（投稿：2022年7月、タケニィ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There are toilets. This is also a sunset spot. There is a campsite next door (fee applies, details below), so you can camp in a tent. For bathing, it's a bit far, but you can go to "Yumeeru" on Tsujishima Island, 13km to the east. For shopping, there is the supermarket "Atax Sheepuru Store" 4km away. There is also a coin laundry. (Submitted by Takenii in July 2022)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ有。AmazonのCM（詳細）にも登場する「黄牛の滝」観光者用の駐車場です。CMに使われるだけあって滝は見事です。かなりの田舎なので殆どが貸し切り状態で区画線もなく自由度が上がります。夜は真っ暗で怖いですがその代わり星はきれいです。お風呂は近くに宮城温泉がありますが6ｋｍ西の白丹温泉の方がおすすめです。（投稿：2023年1月、タケニィ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Restrooms available. This is a parking lot for tourists visiting "Ogyu Falls," which is featured in an Amazon commercial (details). The waterfall is magnificent, as you would expect from a place featured in a commercial. It's quite rural, so it's practically deserted, and there are no designated parking spaces, giving you a lot of freedom. It's pitch black and a bit scary at night, but on the other hand, the stars are beautiful. There's Miyagi Onsen nearby, but Shiratani Onsen, 6km to the west, is more recommended for bathing. (Submitted by Takenii, January 2023)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 夕陽が丘そとめ
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ有、ゴミ箱有（但し、夜間は撤収）。夕陽がきれいな道の駅です。トイレからは離れますが、第４駐車場は区画線が無いのでイスやテーブルの車外持ち出しができ、自由度が上がります。添付画像（投稿：2023年1月、タケニィ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Toilets and trash cans are available (however, they are removed at night). This roadside station offers beautiful sunsets. Although it's a bit far from the toilets, the fourth parking lot doesn't have designated parking spaces, so you can bring chairs and tables out of your car, giving you more flexibility. Attached image (Submitted by Takenii, January 2023)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ無し自販機なし「電気なし」。無人集落になってから10年以上経過している隠れキリシタンのカトリック集落跡地。ここに至るまでの道筋が軽自動車でギリギリ幅、すれ違い不能、ガードレールなし、でこぼこコンクリ道、落石あり、連続急坂路の峠道、脱輪即滑落という超絶テクニカルコースを片道1時間くらいかけて進まないと到達できませんが、天然無料キャンプ場のような扱いになっています。集落内の木造家屋や石垣は倒壊危険性 絶大 なので近寄らないほうがいい。陸路がアクセス困難な割に海路では楽勝なので、東の防波堤側から上陸してくる人がいます。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: No toilets, no vending machines, "no electricity." This is the site of a former Catholic settlement of hidden Christians, which has been uninhabited for over 10 years. The road to get there is extremely technical, barely wide enough for a small car, impossible to pass, no guardrails, bumpy concrete road, prone to falling rocks, a continuous steep mountain pass, and a risk of slipping and falling if a wheel comes off, and it takes about an hour each way to reach it, but it is treated like a free natural campsite. The wooden houses and stone walls in the settlement are at extremely high risk of collapse, so it is best not to get close. Although land access is difficult, it is easy by sea, so some people land from the eastern breakwater side. (Submitted by: m, June 2024)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレは鍵がかかっていて使用不可（投稿：2025年5月、こひ様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：完成したばかりでトイレもきれいな無料の駐車場です。２４時間開放されています。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: The toilet was locked and unusable (Submitted by: Kohi, May 2025)
■Report from our website reader: This is a newly completed, free parking lot with clean toilets. It is open 24 hours a day.

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 ゆいゆい国頭
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレは24時間使えるし、隣にコンビニもある。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: The toilets are available 24 hours a day, and there's a convenience store next door. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレは24時間使えるし、近くにコンビニもある。すぐ前に米軍の飛行場があるので朝8時ぐらいになると飛行機の音でちょっとうるさい。道の駅４階の展望台で飛行機と飛行場を見れる。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: The toilets are available 24 hours a day, and there's a convenience store nearby. There's a US military airfield right in front, so it gets a bit noisy with airplane sounds around 8am. You can see the airplanes and the airfield from the observation deck on the 4th floor of the roadside station. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレは24時間使えるけど、他にはなんにもないのでちょっと怖い。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: The toilet is available 24 hours a day, but there's nothing else around, so it's a little scary. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレは、夜間も使用できて、ウォシュレットもありとてもきれいです。道の駅よりも、かなりきれいです。駐車場もかなり広いです。大型車も停められます。食事ができるところがこの辺に集まっており、夕食にはとても便利です。すぐ横に、ファミリーマートもあり、この点も便利です。道の駅のすぐ近くなので、両方を見られて、好みの方で車中泊されると良いのではないでしょうか。お風呂は周囲に、見つけられませんでした。平戸（車で20分ほど）の温泉に行くしか無い様です。（投稿：2020年9月、M様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: The toilets are available even at night, have bidet functions, and are very clean. They are considerably cleaner than those at the roadside station. The parking lot is also quite large, and can accommodate large vehicles. There are several places to eat nearby, making it very convenient for dinner. There is also a FamilyMart right next door, which is also convenient. Since it is very close to the roadside station, you can check out both and choose the one you prefer for your overnight stay. We couldn't find any baths nearby. It seems the only option is to go to the hot springs in Hirado (about 20 minutes by car). (Submitted by M in September 2020)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレの電灯は夜中0時を過ぎても灯いていました。トイレに入ってすぐの所に誰でも触れる電灯のスイッチがあります。（投稿：2024年6月、t様）
■昔はコインシャワーがあったが、いつの間にか廃止されていた。詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：無料の足湯あり。足湯があるがぬるめ(無料)。夜中0時をすぎるとトイレは電気が消え真っ暗。隣にコンビニやスーパーもある。あと温泉街も近くにある。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■ Reader Report: The toilet light remained on even after midnight. There's a light switch that anyone can touch right inside the toilet entrance. (Submitted by: t, June 2024)
■ There used to be a coin-operated shower, but it was discontinued at some point. Details
■ Reader Report: There's a free footbath. The footbath is lukewarm (free). After midnight, the toilet lights go out and it's pitch black. There's a convenience store and supermarket next door. There's also a hot spring town nearby. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: （<font color="#ff0000">トイレ無し</font>）中須川河川公園
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレなし自販機なし。公園敷地の奥に石段の階段があり、そこを降りると中須川の清水を取水できます。階段奥にも四阿がありますが、シーズン外は屋根すら見えないレベルで草に覆われています。たまに地元キャンパーがいます。 注1）間違えやすいですが、公園に隣接する砂利の空き地は 民間私有地 です（昔は民家が建っていました）。公園駐車場は奥の細長い舗装された歩道脇敷地。 注2）道路を挟んで対面の平成小学校は廃校ですが 民営直売所管理者に貸し出されている ので、夜間など無人時間帯に勝手に敷地へ入ると警報装置が（無音で）発報して機動巡回警備員や警察が来ます。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: No toilets, no vending machines. There is a stone staircase at the back of the park grounds, and if you go down it you can get spring water from Nakasugawa. There is also a gazebo at the back of the stairs, but outside of the season it is so overgrown with grass that you can't even see the roof. Occasionally there are local campers. Note 1) It is easy to mistake this for a private property, but the gravel vacant lot adjacent to the park is privately owned (there used to be a house there). The park parking lot is the long, narrow paved area next to the sidewalk at the back. Note 2) Heisei Elementary School across the road is closed, but it is leased to the manager of a privately run direct sales store, so if you enter the premises without permission during unmanned hours such as at night, an alarm will sound (silently) and mobile patrol officers or the police will come. (Submitted by: m, June 2024)

We recommend staying overnight in your car and observing the cranes flying in the early morning. The sight of the cranes flying in the early morning is very moving. I think it is a sight that every Japanese person should see at least once. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：トイレ：あり。 風呂：入浴施設 夕日館まで徒歩15分、車3分　詳細 。 注意点：早朝に釣り客の出入りがあるので、お魚センター寄りに停めた方が寝やすい。路線バスの中継場所にもなっているので、トイレに横並びでの駐車は不可。 経験談：一泊して感じた事は、早朝釣り客の出入りがあるので若干うるさかった、それで目が覚めました。トイレも近いので安心。宿泊時期：2018年3月下旬。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's readers: Toilets: Available. Baths: Bathing facilities available. 15-minute walk or 3-minute drive to Yuhikan. Details. Points to note: There is a lot of fishing activity in the early morning, so it's easier to sleep if you park closer to the fish market. It's also a bus stop, so parking next to the toilets is not allowed. Personal experience: What I felt after staying one night was that it was a bit noisy with fishing activity in the early morning, which woke me up. The toilets are close by, which is reassuring. Stay period: Late March 2018. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：こちらは海水浴シーズン外はトイレも水場も閉鎖されていますが、シーズン中営業時間内であればかき氷屋などが出店を作っています。近在の魚津ヶ崎公園公衆トイレで用を済ませたあと、こちらに移動して寝るのが良いでしょう。 / こちらは観光客がほぼ来ませんが、地元民の車休憩場所および犬やウォーキングの散歩コースになっているので、夜明けと昼食時には出入りが増えます。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）

It's a good idea to use the public toilets at the nearby Uozugasaki Park before moving here to sleep. / Almost no tourists come here, but it's a popular rest stop for locals and a walking course for dogs and pedestrians, so there's more coming and going at dawn and lunchtime. (Submitted by: M, June 2024)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: （<font color="#ff0000">トイレの有無不明</font>）半泊
properties.title_en: （<font color="#ff0000">トイレの有無不明</font>）半泊
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：ここ以外にも近隣に長時間駐車可能なスペースが無数にあります。限界集落の再生事業対象地域になっている関係で、近在に観光名所カトリック教会がある以外にも、廃屋古民家を再利用した民間製塩所、廃校再利用ホテル、古民家民泊ホテルなどがある関係で意外と人が多いです。昔は廃校跡地に公衆トイレと取水施設があって24時間いつでも使用できたのですが、経営者が変わって建物が改築されているので使えるかどうかは要確認。奥の間伏集落と同じく、ここに至るまでの道幅が狭く街灯もない落石ゴロゴロの連続急坂路を片道30分くらい走破しないと到達できないため運転に相当な自信がない限り非推奨。道路から車ごと落ちたらたぶん死にます（ガチで）。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There are countless other places nearby where you can park for extended periods. Because it is part of a project to revitalize a depopulated village, in addition to the nearby tourist attraction, a Catholic church, there are also private salt factories repurposed from abandoned old houses, hotels converted from abandoned schools, and guesthouses in old houses, so it is surprisingly crowded. There used to be a public toilet and water intake facility on the site of the abandoned school that could be used 24 hours a day, but the management has changed and the building has been renovated, so you need to check whether it is still usable. Similar to the Okuno-Mafushi settlement, the road leading here is narrow, unlit, and full of loose rocks, requiring a continuous steep uphill drive of about 30 minutes each way, so it is not recommended unless you are very confident in your driving skills. If you drive your car off the road, you will probably die (seriously). (Submitted by: m, June 2024)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：コイン式でコイン投入後、湯が張られ新しいお湯で入浴できる貸し切り温泉です。アメニティやドライヤーなど有りませんが、値段が６００円～８００円とリーズナブル。「道の駅　小国」から車で１０分程度です。入浴人数に関係ない料金となっているため４人家族なら一人２００円換算。詳細（投稿：2024年4月、山びこ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: This is a private hot spring bath that uses a coin system; after inserting a coin, the bath is filled with fresh water for you to enjoy. There are no amenities or hair dryers, but the price is reasonable at 600 to 800 yen. It's about a 10-minute drive from "Michi-no-Eki Oguni" (roadside station). The price is not affected by the number of people bathing, so for a family of four, it works out to 200 yen per person. Details (Posted by Yamabiko, April 2024)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：ガタリンピックの会場で有名な道の駅鹿島。農産物直売所には広いカキ焼き小屋もあります。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Michi-no-Eki Kashima, famous as the venue for the Gatalympics. The direct sales market for agricultural products also has a large oyster grilling hut. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.title_ja: 弁当のヒライ阿蘇防中店
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：お手頃な値段の大皿に盛られた総菜が多数あり手作り弁当やインスタント食品、酒類も販売している２４時間営業の店です。夕方利用しましたが結構な人が総菜を購入していました。道の駅阿蘇から車で２分程度です。（投稿：2024年5月、山びこ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: This is a 24-hour store that sells a wide variety of reasonably priced side dishes served on large platters, as well as homemade bento boxes, instant food, and alcoholic beverages. I visited in the evening and there were quite a few people buying side dishes. It's about a 2-minute drive from Michi-no-Eki Aso (Roadside Station Aso). (Submitted by: Yamabiko, May 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：オレンジ色のでこぼこ道の両脇未舗装緑地全てが園地兼無料駐車スペースです。長崎鼻灯台の手前、緑地と森の境目に小さなコンクリート屋根の建物があり、それが公衆トイレ。手前に水道の水場もあります。立地的に夏場でも強風が、冬場は烈風が吹く。また、緑地は微妙に傾斜があります。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: The unpaved green space on both sides of the bumpy orange road is a park and free parking area. Just before the Nagasakibana Lighthouse, at the boundary between the green space and the forest, there is a small concrete-roofed building, which is a public toilet. There is also a water tap nearby. Due to its location, it is windy even in summer and extremely windy in winter. Also, the green space has a slight slope. (Submitted by: M, June 2024)

properties.label: Restaurant
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：うどんの出汁にちゃんぽん麺を入れた「ちゃんらー」発祥の店。食べログ（投稿：2021年3月、N様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: The restaurant that originated "Chan-Raa," a dish of champon noodles in udon broth. (Reviewed on Tabelog in March 2021 by Mr. N)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：あまり余所者が来ない僻地の漁港で公衆トイレもありませんが、港湾スペースなので長時間駐車できます。手前の丸木緑地公園公衆トイレで用を済ませたあと、こちらに移動すると良いかも。漁港南側の細い坂の登り口に自販機があります。港湾東側最奥に「 看板がなく見た目はただの民家だけどその正体は寿司屋で味が絶品 」という初見泣かせの寿司屋があります（一応、営業時間中はのぼりが1本立ってます）。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: This fishing port is in a remote area where few outsiders visit, and there are no public toilets, but you can park for a long time in the port area. It might be a good idea to use the public toilets at Maruki Green Park nearby before coming here. There is a vending machine at the bottom of the narrow slope on the south side of the fishing port. At the very back on the east side of the port, there is a sushi restaurant that "looks like an ordinary house with no sign, but is actually a sushi restaurant with exquisite taste" (there is one banner that is out during business hours). (Submitted by: m, June 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: RVパークたかざきがある駐車場
properties.title_en: Parking lot where RV Park Takazaki is located
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：RVパークとパークゴルフ場がある巨大な駐車場。駐車場は、24時間開放していてトイレもある。そして、トイレの横に流しもある。飲用できる蛇口もある。実際来てみましたけど、RVパークよりも普通に駐車場の一角に止めた方がいいような気がします。RVパークの区画は微妙に傾斜してるんですよね。そして、トイレも遠くなる。まあ、電源込み1泊1000円程の激安なんで、お好みでどうぞ。私は、夜に来て朝早く出たので、トイレの近くに止めさせて貰いました。夜はとても静かです。広大な駐車場、そしてトイレの横の流し。流しがあるととても助かるので、個人的に満足した良い場所です。（投稿：2024年1月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: A huge parking lot with an RV park and a park golf course. The parking lot is open 24 hours a day and has toilets. There is also a sink next to the toilets. There is even a tap with potable water. I actually came here, but I think it's better to park in a corner of the regular parking lot rather than in the RV park. The RV park plots are slightly sloped. And the toilets are further away. Well, it's super cheap at about 1000 yen per night including electricity, so do as you please. I came at night and left early in the morning, so I was able to park near the toilets. It's very quiet at night. A vast parking lot, and a sink next to the toilets. Having a sink is very helpful, so I was personally satisfied with this good place. (Posted by: M, January 2024)

properties.title_ja: 平谷物産直売所 第二駐車場
properties.title_en: Hiratani Local Products Direct Sales Store Second Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：R444沿いの山中にある既存ポイント、名称記載がありませんが「平谷物産直売所 第二駐車場」です（2024/5/19確認）。看板と建物は残っていますが物産直売所自体は閉業していますが、第一駐車場側に自販機があります。第一駐車場横の側道から山奥に下ると無料の湧水があります。（投稿：2024年5月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: There is an existing point located in the mountains along Route 444. Although there is no name listed, it is "Hiraya Local Products Direct Sales Store Second Parking Lot" (confirmed on 2024/5/19). The sign and building remain, but the direct sales store itself is closed. However, there is a vending machine on the side of the first parking lot. If you go down into the mountains from the side road next to the first parking lot, you will find free spring water. (Submitted by: m, May 2024)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：JR門司港駅周辺地域に残る外国貿易で栄えた時代の建造物を中心に、大正レトロ調に整備した観光スポット。詳細（投稿：2022年4月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: A tourist spot developed in a Taisho-era retro style, centering on buildings from the era when the area around JR Mojiko Station prospered from foreign trade. Details (Submitted by: n, April 2022)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：GW二泊目に利用。駐車場と道路が近いですが、深夜走行する車両が少なく割と静かでした。大型車が入りにくい構造で左側奥の区画だと静かです。ただ、バス改造キャンピングカーが夜中中発電機を回していて、そちらの音の方が気になった。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■トイレがきれいなのは良いが、駐車場が幹線国道沿いで、トラックも結構多く走りうるさい。静かとは言い難い。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：静かで休憩や車中泊しやすいです。トイレ○ 杖立温泉の帰りによく利用。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Used for the second night during Golden Week. The parking lot is close to the road, but there were few vehicles driving at night, so it was relatively quiet. The structure makes it difficult for large vehicles to enter, and the section at the back on the left is quiet. However, a converted bus camper van was running its generator all night, and that noise was more noticeable. (Older post from before 2019)
■The toilets are clean, which is good, but the parking lot is along a main national highway, and there are quite a few trucks driving by, so it's noisy. It's hard to say it's quiet. (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from a reader of this site: It's quiet and easy to rest or stay overnight in a car. Toilets are good. Often used on the way back from Tsuetate Onsen. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.title_ja: 道の駅 遣唐使ふるさと館
properties.title_en: Roadside Station Kentoshi Furusato-kan (Kentoshi Hometown Museum)
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：Googleマップに記載がないほどの秘境ですが、ちゃんと五島市公式かつ五島市唯一の道の駅です（道の駅 遣唐使ふるさと館）。トイレは館内にしかなく夜間は閉鎖されてます。国道の至近距離ですが 昼夜問わず走行音が気になるレベルで車両が走行することはない（過疎地）ので、安心して宿泊できます。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: This is a secluded spot that isn't even listed on Google Maps, but it is indeed the official and only roadside station in Goto City (Roadside Station Kentoshi Furusato-kan). The toilets are only inside the building and are closed at night. It's very close to the national highway, but there are hardly any vehicles passing by, day or night (it's a sparsely populated area), so you can stay there with peace of mind. (Submitted by: M, June 2024)

You can't open the windows, so it's too hot to soak for long.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：24時間利用できる無料駐車場です。トイレは道路下のトンネル歩道を通って鹿屋海浜公園にあります。夜は真っ暗なのでヘッドライトは必要です。国道269号の通行量は少なく静かな場所です。駐車場は少し傾斜してます。（投稿：2025年6月、名無しの車中泊様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: This is a free parking lot that is available 24 hours a day. Toilets are located in Kanoya Seaside Park, accessible via a tunnel pedestrian walkway under the road. It is pitch black at night, so a headlamp is necessary. National Route 269 has little traffic and is a quiet place. The parking lot is slightly sloped. (Posted by: Anonymous Car Camper, June 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：24時間開放の公共駐車場で、公衆トイレのそばに無人の民営店舗があってそこに自販機があります。区画で仕切られた駐車スペースを通過して進むと公園併設の広大な舗装スペースに行き着き、そちらに停泊しても怒られません。地元キャンパーがよくキャンピングカーで泊まってます。夏場は過ごしやすいですが、冬場になると風速10m級の北風がほぼ常時吹き上げて来る断崖上の立地なので防寒具必須。 / 注意点として、道を挟んで対面に未舗装の広大な緑地がありますが、そちらは魚津ヶ崎公園キャンプ場の敷地で予約制有料です。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: This is a 24-hour public parking lot with an unmanned private shop next to the public restrooms that has a vending machine. If you continue past the partitioned parking spaces, you will reach a large paved area adjacent to a park, where you can park overnight without any problems. Local campers often stay there in their campervans. It is pleasant in the summer, but in winter, it is located on a cliff and is hit by northerly winds of around 10 m/s almost constantly, so warm clothing is essential. / Note that across the road there is a large unpaved green space, but that is part of the Uozugasaki Park Campground and requires a reservation and is subject to a fee. (Submitted by: M, June 2024)

■Report from our website reader: Free parking. Flush toilets are available in the parking lot. There are many hot springs within walking distance. (Submitted by T, Ganbatte Tohoku! Charity Committee, May 2021)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 長崎街道鈴田峠
properties.title_en: Roadside Station Nagasaki Kaido Suzuta Pass
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2025/04/11利用。夜間もトイレは施錠されない、男性用トイレは洋式水洗ウォシュレット付き個室が2つ。トイレのある建物内の休憩情報コーナーより大村市提供の無料Wi-Fi（時間制限・回数制限無し）が使用可能でその周辺に駐車してれば車内からでも利用できる。時期的な鯉のぼり催し物の用意をしてるためなのか、駐車・整備係員が10時ぐらいから活動。夜間でも車の出入りは多く爆音バイクも来るし、朝4時ぐらいには駐車中のトラックのエンジン音が大きくて起きる。（投稿：2025年4月、movement様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：こぢんまりした道の駅で、大型車の駐車枠は３台。隣接する施設の駐車場も駐車可能なので結構な台数が駐車できます。トイレも綺麗でしたが、問題は、この道の駅は三方向が直近を山（丘？）に囲まれているため、たった、一台の大型車のアイドリングの音や通過車両の音が反響してかなり耳障りでした。耳栓が必要でしょう。（投稿：2023年12月、山びこ様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：土.日.祝日は、バイキングレストランが20:00まで延長営業｡(酒類あり) 手洗いは.温水が出る。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■2016.3.25オープン。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Used on April 11, 2025. The toilets are not locked at night, and the men's toilet has two Western-style stalls with flush toilets and bidet functions. Free Wi-Fi (no time or usage limits) provided by Omura City is available from the rest area information corner inside the building where the toilets are located, and can be used from inside your car if you park nearby. Perhaps because they are preparing for the seasonal carp streamer event, parking and maintenance staff are active from around 10am. There is a lot of traffic even at night, including loud motorcycles, and the loud engine noise from parked trucks wakes you up around 4am. (Submitted by: movement, April 2025)

■Report from a reader of this site: A small roadside station with three parking spaces for large vehicles. Since parking is also available in the adjacent facility's parking lot, a considerable number of vehicles can be parked. The toilets were clean, but the problem was that this roadside station is surrounded on three sides by mountains (hills?), so the sound of even a single large vehicle idling and the sounds of passing vehicles echoed and were quite jarring. Earplugs would be necessary. (Posted by Yamabiko, December 2023)
■Report from our site's reader: On Saturdays, Sundays, and holidays, the buffet restaurant extends its hours until 8:00 PM. (Alcohol available) Hot water is available for handwashing. (Older post from before 2019)
■Opened March 25, 2016.

properties.desc_en:
■Report from our site's reader: On Friday, May 9, 2025, I stopped by after 6 PM and it was deserted, with no cars. The toilet was usable. There was a Western-style toilet, but no bidet. (Posted by: Kohi, May 2025)

■Report from our site's reader: This is a parking lot with a toilet. It would be good to use it outside of business hours. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2025.2.17（月）の夜に３回目の車中泊をさせていただきました。3回通してのコメントは、HOTEL AZの東側道路から駐車場へ夜間も出入り可。駐車場は水平。うす暗い。トイレは夜間使用可。人感点灯式。駐車場から東へ150ｍ位。清潔感あり。公園内に外灯なし。通路に花？実？が散乱する時期あり。靴が汚れる。公園から工場群の夜景が見える。駐車場の近くにコンビニあり。警察の巡回コース。（投稿：2025年3月、FIT3様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: I stayed overnight in my car for the third time on the night of February 17, 2025 (Monday). My comments across all three times are: You can enter and exit the parking lot from the road east of HOTEL AZ even at night. The parking lot is level. It's dimly lit. The toilets are usable at night. They are motion-activated. They are about 150m east of the parking lot. They are clean. There are no streetlights in the park. There are times when flowers? or fruits? are scattered on the paths. Your shoes will get dirty. You can see the night view of the factory complex from the park. There is a convenience store near the parking lot. It is on a police patrol route. (Submitted by FIT3 in March 2025)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2025.2.16（日）の夜に2回目の車中泊をさせていただきました。深夜に懐中電灯で照らされることがある。職務質問はありませんでしたので未確認ですが、警察だったと思います。タンクローリーの行き来が多い。緑地到着までご注意をということで、騒がしいということではありません。緑地の先に製油所があるためだと思います。トイレや駐車場、緑地内の電灯は夜中も点灯されていて、また、近くに民家もあり、安心できました。（投稿：2025年3月、FIT3様）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレは水洗で洋式もあり。夜間静か。（2022年2月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: I stayed overnight in my car for the second time on the night of February 16, 2025 (Sunday). I was sometimes illuminated by flashlights in the middle of the night. I wasn't questioned, so I can't confirm, but I think it was the police. There's a lot of tanker truck traffic. It's not noisy, just a warning to be careful until you reach the green space. I think this is because there's an oil refinery beyond the green space. The lights in the toilets, parking lot, and green space were on all night, and there were houses nearby, so I felt safe. (Submitted by FIT3, March 2025)

■Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed they are not closed at night. The toilets are flush toilets, and there are Western-style toilets. Quiet at night. (Administrator's on-site verification, February 2022)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2024年6月宿泊。理由不明ながら トイレがすごく臭い 。羽虫も大量にいるので苦手な方は要注意。入って右側、観光協会案内所奥の防波堤付近が穴場で、深夜1時頃に駐車場照明が消灯すると完全に真っ暗かつ静かになります。近在至近距離に踏切がある関係で、終電前に到着すると相当にうるさい。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2023/11月泊。広い駐車場がありますが、幹線道路沿いで、夜中でも、結構とばす車があり、やや、うるさかったです。コンビニは近隣にありますが、温泉まではは少し距離があります。（投稿：2023年12月、h様）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Stayed in June 2024. For some unknown reason, the toilets smelled terrible. There were also a lot of flying insects, so those who dislike insects should be careful. The area to the right of the entrance, near the breakwater behind the tourist information center, is a hidden gem; when the parking lot lights are turned off around 1 AM, it becomes completely dark and quiet. Because there's a railroad crossing nearby, arriving before the last train is quite noisy. (Submitted by: M, June 2024)

■Report from a reader of this site: Stayed in November 2023. There's a large parking lot, but it's along a main road, and even at night, there are quite a few cars speeding, making it somewhat noisy. There's a convenience store nearby, but the hot springs are a bit of a distance away. (Submitted by: H, December 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 鳴淵ダム 駐車場（西側）
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2024年6月休泊。珍走団の集会場所でした。親切にもうるさいっていうか耳がバカになるレベルの超絶爆音を至近距離で数時間も聞かせてくださいました。二度と行かねー。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。ここのトイレは水洗和式。夜は交通ほとんど無く非常に静か。ドコモ電波OK。（2021年3月管理人現地確認）
■車中泊と心霊現象👻について
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Closed for overnight stay in June 2024. It was a meeting place for a biker gang. They kindly subjected me to an extremely loud noise—not just loud, but so loud it numbed my ears—for several hours at close range. I'm never going there again. (Submitted by: M, June 2024)
■Free parking and public toilets. The toilets here are flush toilets (Japanese style). There is almost no traffic at night, so it's very quiet. Docomo signal is OK. (Confirmed on-site by administrator in March 2021)
■About overnight stays in cars and paranormal phenomena 👻

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2024年6月休憩。バス停と一体化した小さな駐車スペースで、200m東にもうひとつ駐車場があり、そちらに公衆トイレがあります。道路を挟んで真向かいに民営温泉と直売所があり、直売所内でカレーが食べられます。ここを中心に東西200mに合計3つの無料駐車場があり、昼間はダム湖の景観が絶景ですが、夜は車の疾走音がとてもうるさいです。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Reader Report: June 2024 (Break). There is a small parking space integrated with the bus stop, and another parking lot 200m to the east with a public restroom. Directly across the road is a privately run hot spring and a direct sales store where you can eat curry. There are a total of three free parking lots within 200m east and west of this point. The view of the dam lake is spectacular during the day, but the sound of cars speeding by at night is very loud. (Submitted by: M, June 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2024年5月宿泊。建造物から小道を挟んで逆側、福岡銀行ATMがある方の駐車場の方が（大型車スペースがないので）静かで過ごしやすいです。わかりづらいですがこちらも道の駅の併設スペースで、コンビニ側入口に案内板が立ってました。24時間コンビニが至近距離にあるので店舗閉店後到着でも飲食可能でとても便利が良かったです。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：すぐ近くに24hコンビニ（セブンイレブン）あり。公式サイト（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: Stayed in May 2024. The parking lot on the opposite side of the building, across the small path, where the Fukuoka Bank ATM is located, is quieter and more comfortable (because there are no spaces for large vehicles). It's a bit hard to find, but this is also a space attached to the roadside station, and there was a signpost at the entrance on the convenience store side. The 24-hour convenience store is very close by, so it was very convenient to be able to eat and drink even if arriving after the shops closed. (Posted: June 2024, by Ms. M)

■Report from our website reader: There is a 24-hour convenience store (Seven-Eleven) very close by. Official website (older posts from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 簡易パーキング鈴田峠
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2024年5月宿泊。案内看板が白色に青字で「鈴田峠P」なので、下り車線で南向きに来るとこの先にある道の駅鈴田峠と間違えやすいです（間違えました）。かなり狭いながら一応24時間トイレと自販機があり、道を挟んで正面に民営レストランがありトルコライスが旨いことで有名。日中、隣接するR34は上下とも頻繁に渋滞し、夜間も道路にも近すぎるので常時うるさい。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Stayed in May 2024. The sign is white with blue lettering that says "Suzuta Pass Parking Lot," so if you're coming south on the downhill lane, it's easy to mistake it for the Suzuta Pass roadside station further ahead (I made that mistake). It's quite small, but there are 24-hour toilets and vending machines, and across the road there's a privately run restaurant famous for its delicious Turkish rice. During the day, the adjacent Route 34 is frequently congested in both directions, and at night it's constantly noisy because it's too close to the road. (Submitted by: M, June 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 筑前みなみの里
properties.title_en: Roadside Station Chikuzen Minami no Sato
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2024年5月10日～20日に1回宿泊。非常にわかりづらかったのですが、入口から入って右側は店舗、駐車場含め公共施設ではない、民間店舗の私有地駐車場 なので、右側に停めたまま閉店時間を超えた場合、 問答無用で駐車場入口を閉鎖され朝まで出られなくなる ことに要注意（トイレ電源や照明も全て消える+入口に閉鎖予告などもない）。入口から入って左側には24時間開放の駐車場+公衆トイレがありますが、こちらは店舗側の半分にも満たない広さで大型車駐車スペースと近すぎて、ディーゼルのアイドリング音や排気ガスで快適には過ごせないかもしれません。日没後は閑散としてして静かではありますが、幹線道路を大型車が連なって高速で通過していくので泊まるなら耳栓必須です。（投稿：2024年5月、m様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：過去レポにあるように快適な一夜が過ごせる道の駅。併設の農村レストランは朝8:00オープンで朝食セット500円。素朴なメニューながらホッとする味で美味しかった。オススメ。（投稿：2022年5月、y様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2020年12月28日に泊まりました。今年オープンの新しい道の駅なので、施設も新しく本線からも離れていてとても快適に泊まれました。（投稿：2020年12月、フォレストウェイ様）
■2020年4月24日オープン。幹線国道沿いだが、広大な駐車場で、建物の裏は静かで良さそう。期待の新人。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from our website reader: Stayed once between May 10th and 20th, 2024. It was very confusing, but the area to the right of the entrance, including the shop and parking lot, is not a public facility; it's private property belonging to a private shop. Therefore, be aware that if you park on the right side past closing time, the parking lot entrance will be closed without question, and you won't be able to leave until morning (all toilet power and lights will be turned off, and there's no notice of closure at the entrance). To the left of the entrance, there's a 24-hour parking lot and public toilets, but this is less than half the size of the shop side and too close to the large vehicle parking area, so the diesel idling noise and exhaust fumes might make for an uncomfortable stay. It's quiet and deserted after sunset, but large vehicles pass by on the main road at high speed, so earplugs are essential if you're staying overnight. (Submitted by: Ms. M, May 2024)

■Report from our website reader: As mentioned in past reports, this roadside station offers a comfortable night's stay. The attached rural restaurant opens at 8:00 AM and offers a breakfast set for 500 yen. The simple menu was comforting and delicious. Highly recommended. (Posted: May 2022, y)
■Report from our site's reader: I stayed on December 28, 2020. As it's a new roadside station that opened this year, the facilities are new, and it's far from the main road, making for a very comfortable stay. (Posted: December 2020, Forestway)
■Opened April 24, 2020. It's along a main national highway, but has a large parking lot, and the area behind the building seems quiet and nice. A promising newcomer.

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2024年4月に利用。普通車50台くらいの無料駐車場。トイレは水洗洋式で清掃状態も良好。対馬を縦断する国道R382からは少し距離があるので、車の走行音は気にならないレベル。1km圏内にスーパーがあり、買い出しも便利。⇨朝になって気付いたが、さらに奥まで進むとテニスコート横にも駐車場&トイレがある。より静かな環境を求めるなら、奥の駐車場の方が良いかも。（投稿：2024年6月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Used in April 2024. There is a free parking lot that can accommodate about 50 regular cars. The toilets are flush toilets and are in good condition. It is a little distance from National Highway R382 which runs through Tsushima, so the noise from passing cars is not noticeable. There is a supermarket within 1km, making shopping convenient. ⇨I noticed in the morning that if you go further in, there is another parking lot and toilet next to the tennis courts. If you are looking for a quieter environment, the parking lot further in might be better. (Submitted by: y, June 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 筒城浜ふれいあい広場
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2024年4月に利用。普通車50台くらいの無料駐車場。トイレは水洗洋式で、清掃状態も良好。公園のトイレとしては平均以上。朝夕はジョギング等で訪れる人もいるが、夜間は無人状態となるので閑静な一夜を過ごせる。（投稿：2024年6月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Used in April 2024. There is a free parking lot that can accommodate about 50 regular cars. The toilets are flush toilets and are in good condition. They are above average for park toilets. There are people who come to jog in the morning and evening, but it becomes deserted at night, so you can spend a quiet night there. (Submitted by: y, June 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2024年4月に利用。普通車30台くらいの無料駐車場。トイレは水洗洋式で清掃状態も良好。厳原のフェリーターミナルから1km程度で、深夜便のフェリーで対馬に到着した後のP泊地として利用するのに好都合。（投稿：2024年6月、y様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from a reader of this site: Used in April 2024. There is free parking for about 30 regular cars. The toilets are flush toilets and are in good condition. It is about 1km from the Izuhara ferry terminal, making it convenient to use as an overnight parking spot after arriving in Tsushima on a late-night ferry. (Submitted by: y, June 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2024年4月に利用。普通車20台くらいの無料駐車場。トイレは水洗洋式で清掃状態も良好だが、駐車場から少し離れている（灯台側へ徒歩50m程度）のがやや不満。夕日の眺望ポイントで日没まではそれなりに人がいたが、夜間は無人状態となるので閑静な一夜を過ごせる。（投稿：2024年6月、y様）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。車中泊可能との報告あり。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Used in April 2024. Free parking for about 20 regular cars. The toilets are flush toilets and in good condition, but the slight inconvenience is that they are a little far from the parking lot (about a 50m walk towards the lighthouse). There were a fair number of people at the sunset viewing spot until dusk, but it becomes deserted at night, allowing for a peaceful night's sleep. (Posted by: y, June 2024)

■Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. Reports indicate that overnight parking is possible. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2024年4月に利用。普通車20台くらいの無料駐車場。トイレは水洗洋式で清掃状態も良好。公園のトイレとしては平均以上。マイナスポイントとして、目の前の県道が直線の快走路になっているので車が通ると騒々しい。夜も更ければ交通量も途絶えると思うが、投稿者は最終的に伊王島灯台公園でP泊したので詳細は不明。（投稿：2024年6月、y様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：伊王島大橋の東（本土）側にある。トイレあり。（投稿：2023年5月、n様）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: Used in April 2024. Free parking for about 20 regular cars. The toilets are flush toilets (Western style) and are in good condition. Above average for a park toilet. A negative point is that the prefectural road in front is a straight, fast road, so it is noisy when cars pass by. I think the traffic will stop late at night, but the poster ended up parking overnight at Iojima Lighthouse Park, so the details are unknown. (Posted: June 2024, y)

■Report from a reader of this site: Located on the east (mainland) side of Iojima Bridge. Toilets available. (Posted: May 2023, n)

properties.label: Paid Parking
properties.title_ja: （※トイレが使用不可の可能性あり）長崎 水の庭園
properties.title_en: (※Restrooms may be unavailable) Nagasaki Water Garden
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2024/6/6現在、こちらのサイトで紹介されている長崎　水の庭園と県営常盤（南）駐車場近くのトイレは、入り口にロープがはってあり使用できませんでした。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
■18-翌8時 上限1000円。トイレあり。景観もきれいです。ただ、夜は地元のカップルとかスケボー少年がたむろしてます。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: As of June 6, 2024, the toilets near the Nagasaki Water Garden and the Prefectural Tokiwa (South) parking lot, as introduced on this site, were roped off at the entrance and unusable. (Submitted by: M, June 2024)
■18:00-8:00 the next day, maximum charge of 1000 yen. Toilets available. The scenery is beautiful. However, at night, local couples and skateboarders hang out there. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2024/１/21に利用、ひょうたん池の第1駐車場、夜間閉鎖無しです。昼間は地元民の 憩いの場で、駐車場の目の前に夜間閉鎖されないきれいな水洗トイレがあり、公園内はバーべキュー等禁止で夜間は非常に静かで貸切状態でした。早朝から地元民が散歩してます。駐車場は第1～3までありますがここが一番快適です。100点です。（投稿：2024年1月、kon様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Used on January 21, 2024. Parking lot 1 at Hyotan Pond is not closed at night. During the day it is a place of relaxation for locals, and there is a clean flush toilet right in front of the parking lot that is not closed at night. Barbecues and the like are prohibited in the park, so it is very quiet at night and feels like you have it all to yourself. Locals are taking walks from early in the morning. There are three parking lots, but this is the most comfortable. 100 points. (Submitted by: kon, January 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2023年5月休泊。入口から入ってすぐ左手の小さな白い建物が公衆トイレ。奥の展望台1F、屋根駐車場は高さ制限があり、天井がとても低く二輪なら余裕ですが普通乗用車ではぎりぎり。とても狭く数台で満車ですが、立地的に日中長時間山陰なので涼しい。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Closed in May 2023. The small white building immediately to the left after entering the entrance is the public restroom. The observation deck on the 1st floor at the back has a height restriction, and the ceiling is very low, so there is plenty of room for motorcycles, but it is a tight squeeze for regular passenger cars. It is very narrow and can only fit a few cars, but due to its location, it is in the shade of the mountains for long periods during the day, so it is cool. (Submitted by: M, June 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 鬼岳園地芝生広場駐車場
properties.title_en: Onitake Park Lawn Area Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2023年5月休泊。駐車場奥の階段を降りて、芝生広場の左手に公衆トイレと水場があります。駐車場入口側道脇に自販機あり。入口脇側道は地元業者がバイパスのように使っているので、日中は道の細さに関わらず箱トラやダンプなど大型車が通行します。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Closed in May 2023. There are public toilets and a water fountain to the left of the grassy area after descending the stairs at the back of the parking lot. There is a vending machine next to the side road at the entrance to the parking lot. Local businesses use the side road next to the entrance as a bypass, so large vehicles such as box trucks and dump trucks pass through during the day despite the narrowness of the road. (Submitted by: M, June 2024)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 出水麓武家屋敷群駐車場
properties.title_en: Izumi Fumoto Samurai Residences Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2023/１2に利用、夜間閉鎖無し。駐車場の目の前に夜間閉鎖なしの水洗トイレあり夜間は非常に静か。（投稿：2024年2月、kon様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Used in December 2023, no nighttime closures. There is a flush toilet right in front of the parking lot that is open at night and is very quiet at night. (Submitted by: kon, February 2024)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.title_ja: 道の駅 ひまわり（旧：道の駅 みずなし本陣）
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2023/11月泊。リニューアルされて、きれいなトイレがあります。道路からも距離があり、静かに眠れました。コンビニまでは少し距離があります。近隣に温泉はないので、島原市内になります。（投稿：2023年12月、h様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: Stayed in November 2023. The hotel has been renovated and has clean toilets. It is set back from the road, so I was able to sleep peacefully. It is a bit of a distance to the nearest convenience store. There are no hot springs nearby, so you will have to go to one in Shimabara city. (Submitted by: h, December 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2021年7月22日に泊まろうと思い行ってきましたが、駐車場は傾斜していて車中泊には向いていませんでした。少し手前の清流の森駐車場のほうが良かったです。（投稿：2021年7月、フォレストウェイ様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: I went there on July 22, 2021, intending to stay overnight, but the parking lot was sloped and not suitable for sleeping in a car. The Seiryu-no-Mori parking lot a little further down the road was better. (Posted by: Forestway, July 2021)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2021年3月に車中泊したところ、朝の5時くらいに窓をガンガン叩かれて職質を受けました。（投稿：2021年3月、北条様）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。メインの駐車場は全体的に傾斜があるが、右手奥の第二駐車場は比較的フラット。夜間は誰も来ないので非常に静か。ドコモ電波OK。トイレは水洗洋式できれい。ここ最高です。※治安については自己責任で。（2021年3月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: In March 2021, I stayed overnight in my car and was stopped and questioned by the police around 5 AM after someone banged loudly on my window. (Submitted by: Mr. Hojo, March 2021)
■Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed that they are not closed at night. The main parking lot is generally sloped, but the second parking lot at the back on the right is relatively flat. It is very quiet at night as no one comes. Docomo signal is OK. The toilets are clean Western-style flush toilets. This place is great. *Regarding safety, please proceed at your own risk. (Administrator's on-site verification, March 2021)

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: 日田天領水の里元気の駅駐車場 元氣の駅
properties.title_en: Hita Tenryo Suisato Genki no Eki Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja:
■当サイト読者様レポート：2019年GW二泊目に利用しようと現地に行きましたが、入口が閉鎖されていました。夜間は利用できなくなったようです。
■当サイト読者様レポート：道の駅では無いが日田天領水が運営する農産物直売所やレストランがある。広い駐車場の奥には、ブルートレイン富士の車両が展示されている。温泉はかんぽの宿日田がすぐ近くに。河川敷では、家族連れがバーべキュウーをよくしています。
properties.desc_en:
■Report from a reader of this site: I went to the site intending to use it for the second night of Golden Week in 2019, but the entrance was closed. It seems that it is no longer open at night.

■Report from a reader of this site: Although it is not a roadside station, there is a direct sales store for agricultural products and a restaurant operated by Hita Tenryosui. A Blue Train Fuji carriage is on display at the back of the large parking lot. The Kanpo no Yado Hita hot spring is very close by. Families often have barbecues on the riverbank.

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 杉乃井ホテル 棚湯
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：2,400円、詳細　別府温泉のホテル「杉乃井ホテル」内の大浴場。温水プール（ザ アクアガーデン）併設。（投稿：2021年12月、n様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: 2,400 yen, details: The large public bath inside the Suginoi Hotel in Beppu Onsen. It also has a heated swimming pool (The Aqua Garden). (Submitted by: n, December 2021)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 大牟田天然温泉 最高の湯
properties.title_en: Omuta Natural Hot Springs: The Best Bath
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：1400円、詳細　受付内に食堂（食券式）・休憩室あり。（投稿：2021年4月、N様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our website reader: 1400 yen, details: Cafeteria (ticket system) and rest area available inside the reception area. (Submitted by: Ms. N, April 2021)

properties.label: Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 筑紫野天拝の郷 天拝の湯
properties.title_en: Chikushino Tenpai no Sato Tenpai no Yu
properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：1300円、詳細。食堂・休憩室あり。（投稿：2022年5月、n様）

However, the illuminated Megami Ohashi Bridge was beautiful. (Older post from before 2019)

In fact, many campervans and vehicles used for overnight stays gather here during the summer. This was confirmed in August 2023. An image of the sign prohibiting auto camping activities is attached. 👉️Attached image. (Posted: March 2024, by take3)

properties.desc_ja: ■当サイト読者様レポート：’25・4・8現地確認。廃線となった鉄道の駅舎です。近隣に人家や商店等はありません。これ以上ないほど静かです。無人ですが、トイレなどきれいにされていて地元の方々のご厚意に感謝です。トイレの電灯はセンサーで灯ります。外には水道の蛇口があり、便利です。また、裏手には深い軒下にテーブルと椅子があるので雨天時は特にありがたいです。車は横付け可能です。すぐ近くに重要文化財「第三五ヶ瀬川橋梁」があります。入浴は4.8km上流に日之影温泉（詳細場所、詳細）があります。（投稿：2025年4月、tossan様）
properties.desc_en: ■Report from our site's reader: Visited on April 8, 2025. This is the station building of a disused railway line. There are no houses or shops nearby. It is incredibly quiet. Although it is unmanned, the toilets and other facilities are kept clean, and we are grateful for the kindness of the local people. The toilet lights are sensor-activated. There is a water tap outside, which is convenient. Also, there is a table and chairs under a deep eaves at the back, which is especially helpful on rainy days. You can park your car right next to it. The important cultural property "Third Gogasegawa Bridge" is very close by. For bathing, Hinokage Onsen (details of location, details) is 4.8km upstream. (Submitted by tossan in April 2025)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.title_ja: 大浦天主堂（ダブル役満）
properties.desc_ja: ■大浦天主堂（おおうら てんしゅどう）は、長崎県長崎市にあるカトリックの教会堂である。江戸時代幕末の開国後、1865年（元治2年）に建立された。日本に現存するキリスト教建築物としては最古である。正式名は日本二十六聖殉教者堂。その名のとおり日本二十六聖人に捧げられた教会堂で、殉教地である長崎市西坂に向けて建てられている。
properties.desc_en: Oura Church is a Catholic church located in Nagasaki City, Nagasaki Prefecture. It was built in 1865 (Genji 2) after Japan opened its doors to the world at the end of the Edo period. It is the oldest existing Christian building in Japan. Its official name is the Church of the Twenty-Six Japanese Martyrs. As the name suggests, it is a church dedicated to the Twenty-Six Japanese Martyrs and is built facing Nishizaka in Nagasaki City, the site of their martyrdom.

■Car Camping Rating [Excluded Rank 😅] 74 points 👉️Click here for detailed scoring and detailed map. (August 2024)
■Showers are 200 yen for 3 minutes (hot water), details
■Report from our site's reader: The toilets are clean, and showers (200 yen for 3 minutes) are available. However, they are only open from 9 am to 6 pm (may vary depending on the season, so please check). A common issue in Okinawa is that the One-Seg TV signal is somewhat weak. I think this is the number one roadside station in Okinawa Prefecture. It's located along the coast and has a great view. There are also children's play facilities next door, making it a wonderful place. Also, there's a Seven-Eleven next door, which is very convenient. (Posted: February 2024, by A)

■当サイト読者様レポート：2020年1月に車中泊しました。温泉が300円。露天風呂、サウナ、休憩室あり、21:00まで。木がふんだんに使われた湯船、源泉かけ流し。休憩室のデコポン酎ハイ美味かったです。食堂は、21:00まで。野菜カレー美味かった。駐車場広いので静かでした。山中なので少し寒いです。トイレは、シャワートイレありました。一人旅の車中泊には、遅くまで空いている温泉 食堂 休憩室は、大変ありがたいです。私は、九州で一番のおすすめでした。添付写真、添付写真、添付写真、添付写真、添付写真（投稿：2020年8月、h様）
properties.desc_en:
■Car Camping Rating [S Rank 🤩] 86 points 👉️ Click here for detailed scoring and detailed map. (February 2025)
■Bath ♨️: 500 yen, details
■Report from our site's reader: Regarding Ohno Onsen Center, it is scheduled to be closed throughout July 2025 (please call to confirm from August onwards) (Posted: July 2025, FIT3)
■Report from our site's reader: I stayed overnight in my car in January 2020. The hot spring was 300 yen. There is an open-air bath, sauna, and rest room, open until 9 PM. The bathtub is made of plenty of wood, and the hot spring water is free-flowing. The Dekopon chuhai in the rest room was delicious. The restaurant is open until 9 PM. The vegetable curry was delicious. The parking lot is large so it was quiet. It's in the mountains so it's a little cold. There was a toilet with a shower. For solo travelers staying overnight in their cars, a hot spring, restaurant, and rest room that are open late are very much appreciated. This was my top recommendation in Kyushu. (Attached photos, attached photos, attached photos, attached photos, attached photos) (Posted by: H, August 2020)

■当サイト読者様レポート：追加情報　’25・4・11に車中泊　金曜の夜、車中泊約50台で、静かとは言えません。とくに、「1億円トイレ」は個室がたった二つしかなくて、朝はたいへんです。静かな夜を過ごしたい向きには、「道の駅 歓遊舎ひこさん」（詳細）の方がいいでしょう。（投稿：2025年4月、tossan様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：2021年12月26日に泊まりました。ここは温泉もありイルミネーションが有名な場所で、また土曜日ということで駐車場もいっぱいでしたが、イルミネーションが終わると田舎というのもあり、とても静かでゆっくり睡眠が出来ました。（投稿：2022年1月、フォレストウェイ様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：新しくて広い道の駅。温泉も広く料金も安い。1億円のトイレが売りで、夜間も洗浄トイレが使える。フードコートは、夜８時までだが平日は早く閉店するので注意。時に、地元のヤンキーが騒ぐこともある。※ご存知の方も多いと思うが「田川」は、凶悪犯罪多発、治安が悪い事で有名。（2019年以前の古い投稿）

■Report from our site's reader: Additional information Car camping on April 11, 2025. On a Friday night, there were about 50 cars camping, so it wasn't exactly quiet. In particular, the "100 Million Yen Toilet" only has two individual stalls, making it difficult in the morning. For those who want to spend a quiet night, "Michi-no-Eki Kanyusha Hikosan" (details) would be better. (Posted: April 2025, by tossan)
■Report from our site's reader: I stayed here on December 26, 2021. This place has a hot spring and is famous for its illuminations. The parking lot was full because it was a Saturday, but once the illuminations were over, it was very quiet because it's in the countryside, and I was able to sleep soundly. (Posted: January 2022, Forestway)
■Report from our site's reader: A new and spacious roadside station. The hot springs are also spacious and inexpensive. Its selling point is a 100 million yen toilet, and the flush toilets are available even at night. The food court is open until 8 pm, but be aware that it closes earlier on weekdays. Sometimes, local delinquents can be noisy. *As many people probably know, Tagawa is famous for its high incidence of violent crime and poor public safety. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.desc_ja:
■黒川温泉の人気宿。黒川温泉でここがお風呂は最高との評価。600円、詳細。駐車場は30台無料。
■管理人評価★4.9（泉質4.4、景色0.5）ここ良いですね。泉質は無色透明だが香りと味が濃厚。析出物もみとめられる。4.4点。そして景色が大変すばらしい。渓流に臨んだ美しい露天風呂で、初夏の新緑、秋の紅葉が美しい。景色は文句なしの0.5点。名湯です。ちなみに、耕きちの湯も同じ会社が運営しているそうです。
properties.desc_en:
■A popular inn in Kurokawa Onsen. It's rated as having the best baths in Kurokawa Onsen. 600 yen, details. Free parking for 30 cars.

■Manager's rating ★4.9 (Spring quality 4.4, Scenery 0.5) This place is great. The spring water is colorless and transparent, but has a rich aroma and taste. Mineral deposits are also visible. 4.4 points. And the scenery is absolutely wonderful. A beautiful open-air bath overlooking a mountain stream, with stunning views of the fresh greenery in early summer and the autumn foliage. The scenery deserves a perfect 0.5 points. A famous hot spring. Incidentally, it seems that Kōkichi no Yu is also operated by the same company.

It was so delicious that I turned back halfway home and ordered another one. That's how good it is. This is the best hamburger place in Japan. (Tabelog)
■Misa Rosso is overwhelmingly delicious. This is the best Sasebo burger place. In fact, I've never had such a delicious hamburger before.

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.title_ja: 江口浜 無料駐車場
properties.desc_ja:
■久しぶりに来たら夜間閉鎖されるようになっていた（18時-翌9時まで閉鎖）。朝9時まで閉鎖されてもいいなら、どうぞ。
■無料駐車場。幹線国道から離れており、静か。トイレもきれいな水洗洋式で夜間電気も付く。素晴らしい。
■極秘情報。ここだけの話だが、実は蓬莱館の駐車場とこの駐車場は通路でつながっている。蓬莱館の駐車場は夜間も出入りが可能で、実は蓬莱館経由でこっちの駐車場も出入りできるので、車中泊できてしまう。一見すると閉鎖されているように見えるので、DQNが来ずめちゃくちゃ静かで最高である。ここだけの秘密。
properties.desc_en:
■When I visited after a long time, I found that it's now closed at night (closed from 6 PM to 9 AM the next day). If you don't mind it being closed until 9 AM, then go ahead.

■Free parking. It's away from the main national highway and quiet. The toilets are clean, flushable Western-style toilets, and the lights are on at night. Wonderful.

■Top secret information. Just between us, the parking lot at Horai-kan and this parking lot are actually connected by a passageway. You can enter and exit the Horai-kan parking lot at night, and you can actually enter and exit this parking lot via Horai-kan, so you can stay overnight in your car. It looks like it's closed from the outside, so no troublemakers come, and it's incredibly quiet and great. This is a secret just between us.

properties.desc_ja:
■久しぶりに来たら、残念ながら夜は爆音バイクの集会場になっていた。深夜1時過ぎまで延々と爆音を吹かせまくるしょうもない連中である。ここでの車中泊はおすすめできない。しかし長崎・佐世保は珍走多いね。（2023年1月管理人現地確認）
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。標高510m。トイレは駐車場から少し歩くが、こんな場所なのにきれいな水洗で洋式もあり（トイレ詳細）。ここは特に夜景がキレイというわけでもないため、夜間はDQNが集まることもなく非常に静かで素晴らしい。難点としては、夜間人気（ひとけ）が無さすぎるので治安については自己責任。夜間の静寂性Sランク。携帯電波はドコモギリギリ利用可能。（2022年1月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■When I visited after a long time, unfortunately, it had become a gathering place for loud motorcyclists at night. These pathetic people rev their engines loudly until past 1 AM. I wouldn't recommend staying overnight in your car here. However, Nagasaki and Sasebo have a lot of reckless motorcyclists. (Administrator's on-site verification, January 2023)
■Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed they are not closed at night. Elevation 510m. The toilets are a short walk from the parking lot, but despite the location, they are clean flush toilets with Western-style toilets (toilet details). The night view isn't particularly beautiful here, so it's wonderfully quiet at night without any troublemakers gathering. The downside is that it's extremely deserted at night, so safety is at your own risk. Nighttime tranquility: S-rank. Docomo cell phone signal is barely usable. (Administrator's on-site verification, January 2022)

properties.label: Sightseeing
properties.title_ja: 願いが叶うクルスの海
properties.title_en: The Sea of ​​the Cross where wishes come true
properties.desc_ja: ■願いが叶うクルスの海訪れると願いが叶うという不思議な言い伝えがある観光名所。展望台から見えるクルスの海は、その岩の形状かかなうと言う文字に見えることからこういった伝説が言い伝えられたそうです。 ここを訪れたひとの心を清め願いや希望を天に託すため、願いが叶うクルスの鐘も有る。
properties.desc_en: ■ The Sea of ​​the Cross, where wishes come true. This tourist spot has a mysterious legend that wishes will come true if you visit. The Sea of ​​the Cross, visible from the observation deck, is said to have originated from the fact that the shape of the rocks resembles the Japanese word for "wish" (kanau). There is also the Bell of the Cross, which is said to grant wishes, to purify the hearts of visitors and allow them to entrust their wishes and hopes to the heavens.

properties.label: Issues Reported
properties.desc_ja:
■管理人も現地視察して夜間閉鎖を確認（トイレは夜間も利用可能だった）。（2024年1月管理人現地確認）
■当サイト読者様レポート：福岡県にある車中泊可能とされている「駕与丁公園」で2023年12月31日に車中泊を行おうとしたところ22時過ぎに、にしけい(旧西日本警備保障株式会社)がやってきて車の窓をノックされ「駐車場閉めるので車動かしてもらえますか」と言われ移動せざるを得ませんでした。管理人様が2022年1月に車中泊をなさったようですが、その後仕様が変わったかと思われます。（投稿：2024年1月、p様）
■超穴場を発見。無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。夜間も閉鎖されないことを確認。トイレはきれいな水洗で洋式もあり。夜間静か。治安については自己責任。（2022年1月管理人現地確認）
properties.desc_en:
■The administrator also inspected the site and confirmed that it is closed at night (the toilets were usable at night). (Administrator's on-site inspection, January 2024)
■Report from a reader of this site: On December 31, 2023, when I tried to park my car overnight at "Kayochō Park" in Fukuoka Prefecture, which is supposed to allow overnight parking, Nishikei (formerly Nishinihon Security Services Co., Ltd.) came after 10 PM, knocked on my car window, and asked me to move my car because they were closing the parking lot. I had no choice but to move. It seems the administrator parked there overnight in January 2022, but the regulations may have changed since then. (Posted by p, January 2024)
■Discovered a hidden gem. Free parking and public toilets. Confirmed that it is not closed at night. The toilets are clean flush toilets, and there are also Western-style toilets. Quiet at night. Safety is at your own risk. (Administrator's on-site inspection, January 2022)

properties.label: Roadside Station

■幹線国道沿いであり、夜中も大型トラックがバンバン走る。轟音が響き、振動が伝わってくるので深く寝られない。あまりおすすめという感じは無い。うるさいので別の場所に移動した。（2022年2月管理人現地確認）
■当サイト読者様レポート：駐車場：117台。地獄温泉や垂玉温泉などの帰りに車中泊で利用。57号線沿いなので交通量が多く、静かとは言い難いが、周囲にはセブンイレブン、ローソン、ファミリーマート、ナフコ、ジョイフル、つぼ八、博多一番どり、マクドナルド、イオンなど多数お店があり便利。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Located along a major national highway, large trucks roar by even at night. The loud noise and vibrations make it difficult to sleep soundly. I wouldn't really recommend it. It was so noisy that I moved to another location. (Administrator's on-site verification, February 2022)
■Report from a reader of this site: Parking: 117 spaces. Used for overnight stays in the car on the way back from Jigoku Onsen or Tarutama Onsen. It's located along Route 57, so there's a lot of traffic and it's not exactly quiet, but there are many shops nearby such as Seven-Eleven, Lawson, FamilyMart, Nafco, Joyful, Tsubohachi, Hakata Ichiban-dori, McDonald's, and Aeon, making it convenient. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 筌の口温泉（ウケノクチオンセン）山里の湯 天然炭酸泉
properties.title_en: Ukenokuchi Onsen (Mountain Village Hot Spring) Natural Carbonated Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■温泉マニア絶賛。700円。詳細。ものすごい高濃度の炭酸泉。場所は正確な位置にマーキングしています（管理人が実際に現地を訪問して確認）。
■管理人評価★4.6（泉質4.5、景色0.1）高濃度の炭酸泉で泡だらけ。析出物もびっしり。色が無いので4.4評価にするか迷ったが、きわめて珍しい高濃度＆高温(37-40度)の炭酸泉ということを評価して泉質は満点評価。透明の湯としては最高クラス。景色は窓を開ければ露天的に楽しめるので0.1加算。合計4.6の極上温泉。
properties.desc_en:
■ Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. 700 yen. Details. An incredibly high-concentration carbonated spring. The location is marked precisely (confirmed by the administrator after actually visiting the site).

■ Administrator's rating ★4.6 (Spring quality 4.5, Scenery 0.1) A high-concentration carbonated spring full of bubbles. Numerous mineral deposits. I hesitated between a 4.4 rating because it's colorless, but I gave the spring quality a perfect score because it's an extremely rare high-concentration and high-temperature (37-40 degrees Celsius) carbonated spring. It's top-class for clear water. I added 0.1 for the scenery because you can enjoy it like an open-air bath by opening the window. A superb hot spring with a total rating of 4.6.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■温泉マニア絶賛。700円、詳細
■管理人評価★4.4（泉質4.4、景色0.1）無色透明で味、香りは弱めだが、ヌル感がすごい（宮城のしんとろの湯ほどではない）。源泉温度51度。それをチョロチョロと湯船に投入して適温を保っている。析出物もみとめられる。泉質は4.4評価。やはり、普通でないお湯と思われるので、透明の湯としては最高レベルの4.4点と評価。景色は露天がないし、特に風情があるわけではないので加点なし。ただ、やはり佐賀では一番の特筆すべき温泉と思われるので、名湯と評価。
properties.desc_en:
■Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. 700 yen, details
■Manager's rating ★4.4 (Spring quality 4.4, Scenery 0.1) The water is colorless and transparent, with a weak taste and smell, but it has an incredible slippery feel (though not as much as Shintoro-no-Yu in Miyagi). The source temperature is 51 degrees Celsius. It is added to the bath slowly to maintain a comfortable temperature. Mineral deposits can be seen. The spring quality is rated 4.4. It seems to be an unusual hot spring, so it is rated at the highest level of 4.4 points for transparent water. There is no open-air bath and the scenery is not particularly picturesque, so no points were added for the scenery. However, it is still considered the most noteworthy hot spring in Saga, so it is rated as a famous hot spring.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■温泉マニア絶賛。700円、詳細
■「別府八湯」の一つ。別府マニアは必修。別府八湯について詳細
■管理人評価★5（泉質4.5、景色0.5）食事付きで税込み1500円。泉質4.5、眺望0.5、ともに申し分ない。満点評価。泉質は美しい乳青白色で申し分なし。景色も別府市の市街地を一望できる好立地。夕暮れ〜夜景もキレイなはずだと思いますが、残念ながら夜の営業は無いです。なんとか夜の営業をしていただきたい。客はジャンジャン来ると思うので。
properties.desc_en:
■ Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. 700 yen, details
■ One of the "Beppu Eight Hot Springs." A must-visit for Beppu enthusiasts. Details about Beppu Eight Hot Springs
■ Manager's rating ★5 (Spring quality 4.5, View 0.5) 1500 yen including tax with meal. Both the spring quality (4.5) and view (0.5) are excellent. Perfect score. The spring water is a beautiful milky white color and excellent. The view is also excellent, with a panoramic view of Beppu city. I'm sure the sunset and night view would be beautiful, but unfortunately, they are not open at night. I wish they would open at night somehow. I think they would get tons of customers.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 杖立温泉 米屋別荘
properties.desc_ja:
■温泉マニア絶賛。600円、詳細
■管理人評価★4.7（泉質4.4、景色0.3）無色透明だが、、味、香りともに濃厚で、析出物もガッツリ。透明の湯としては最高峰かと。あと杖立名物の蒸し湯（サウナ）も異常に気持ちがいい。泉質は4.4と評価。景色は自然の山などを望むわけではない、天然の絶景ではないが、箱庭的な美しさがある。0.3点。4.7点の極上温泉です。
properties.desc_en:
■Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. 600 yen, details
■Manager's rating ★4.7 (Spring quality 4.4, Scenery 0.3) The water is colorless and transparent, but the taste and aroma are rich, and there are plenty of mineral deposits. It's probably the best transparent hot spring water I've ever had. Also, the steam bath (sauna), a specialty of Tsuetate, feels incredibly good. The spring quality is rated 4.4. The scenery doesn't offer views of natural mountains or anything like that; it's not a natural, breathtaking view, but it has a miniature garden-like beauty. 0.3 points. A superb hot spring with a score of 4.7.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 筌の口温泉（ウケノクチオンセン）新清館
properties.desc_ja:
■温泉マニア絶賛。500円、詳細。
■管理人評価★4.9（泉質4.5、景色0.4）非常にすばらしい。泉質は濃厚な土色の湯。析出物びっしり。何もいうことなし。露天風呂は広葉樹の森の中という風情が素晴らしい。新緑と秋の紅葉が美しい。鳥のさえずりが聞こえる。美しい温泉。
properties.desc_en:
■ Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. 500 yen, details.

■ Manager's rating ★4.9 (Spring quality 4.5, Scenery 0.4) Absolutely wonderful. The spring water is a rich, earthy color. Covered in mineral deposits. Nothing more to say. The open-air bath has a wonderful atmosphere, nestled in a broadleaf forest. The fresh greenery and autumn foliage are beautiful. You can hear the birds singing. A beautiful hot spring.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:

properties.desc_en:
■Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. 400 yen, details
■Manager's rating ★4.7 (Spring quality 4.4, Scenery 0.3) A rare carbonated spring. It's slippery and produces lots of bubbles. Taste, aroma, deposits, and bubbles all earn 4.4 points. It's top-level for a colorless and transparent spring. The scenery is of fields, and the cherry blossoms are beautiful in spring. 0.3 points. A superb total of 4.7.

properties.desc_en:
■Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. 1000 yen, details
■Manager's rating ★4.9 (Spring quality 4.4, Scenery 0.5) This place is great. The spring quality is a clear sulfur spring, scoring 4.4 points. The scenery is spectacular, offering a panoramic view of the surrounding mountains. It would probably be amazing to visit in autumn to see the autumn foliage. Scenery scores a perfect 0.5 points. A superb hot spring with a total score of 4.9 points. Also, you can enjoy a cold spring here that is almost identical to Kanno Jigoku (Cold Hell). I really liked it.

The parking lot itself does not appear to be closed at night.

■やっぱり美味い。チキン南蛮の鶏肉が柔らかくてジュワッと肉汁がほとばしって最高に美味い。めちゃくちゃ美味い。今の店は広くてキレイでいいんだけど、昔の小さくて小汚いお店だった時のほうが美味しく感じたのはなぜだろう。不思議。今の新店舗でも美味いのは美味いですが。昔は狭い店のカウンターの目の前でジューッと揚げていて、それをずっと見ていた。あの演出が良かったのかもしれない。今は調理場が遠いというか見えない。心理的にも全然違うんだな。食べログ
■ここのチキン南蛮がやばいくらいおいしい。チキン南蛮の発祥の店。2014年4月に新店舗に移動。がんばって欲しい。連休時はものすごい行列になるので、開店40分前には並んだ方が良い
properties.desc_en:
■It's still delicious. The chicken in the chicken nanban is so tender, and the juices burst out – it's incredibly delicious. It's unbelievably tasty. The current store is spacious and clean, which is great, but I wonder why it tasted better in the old, smaller, slightly dingy store. It's a mystery. The food is still delicious in the new store, though. Back then, they fried it right in front of the counter in the small store, and I watched it the whole time. Maybe that presentation was part of the appeal. Now the kitchen is far away, or rather, out of sight. It's completely different psychologically. (Tabelog)

■The chicken nanban here is unbelievably delicious. This is the original chicken nanban restaurant. They moved to a new location in April 2014. I hope they do well. There are huge lines during long weekends, so it's best to line up 40 minutes before opening.

The fresh greenery and autumn leaves are beautiful. 0.4 Total 4.9 A superb hot spring. 500 yen for this is cheap. I underestimated Kurokawa Onsen.

properties.desc_ja:
■5chレポート：道の駅たるみずはまびら。一応幹線道路沿いだが広い駐車場なので奥は静か、宿泊トラックとも距離をとり易い、駐車場ではフリーWiFi不可。近くにコンビニ、ガソリンスタンドもあり便利。温泉はやや遠く？車で10分ほどの距離に数カ所。単純に道の駅としては最近出来たんでとても綺麗、海鮮丼が有名らしい、眺めは抜群に良い。垂水には元々足湯で有名な道の駅があったが、2ヵ所目…多少気になったのは喫茶店にモーニングメニューがあるのに10時オープンという謎。（投稿：2022年2月）
