■2018/11/23グランドオープン。
properties.desc_en:
■5ch Report: Michi-no-Eki Tarumizu Hamabira. Although it's along a main road, the large parking lot makes the back quiet, and it's easy to keep distance from overnight trucks. Free WiFi is not available in the parking lot. There's a convenience store and a gas station nearby, which is convenient. The hot springs are a bit far? There are several within a 10-minute drive. As a roadside station, it's relatively new and very clean. It seems to be famous for its seafood bowls, and the view is outstanding. Tarumizu already had a roadside station famous for its footbath, so this is the second one... One thing that bothered me a little was that the coffee shop has a morning menu but opens at 10am, which is a mystery. (Posted: February 2022)
■Report from a reader of this site: A modern, spacious roadside station with excellent facilities. There's a restaurant inside the roadside station and a FamilyMart on the premises. The parking space for large vehicles is right in the middle of the parking lot, so it might be noisy at night and difficult to sleep depending on the situation. If you want to sleep in peace, the back of the FamilyMart in the corner is recommended. Depending on the wind direction, volcanic ash from Sakurajima may accumulate on your car. (Older posts from before 2019)
■Grand opening on November 23, 2018.

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja:
■5chレポート：道の駅 旭志、先日泊まりましたので雑感。幹線道路沿いですが、道路から離れた奥にも駐車場が有りトラックも入ってこないので静か。トイレはウォシュレット付きで凄く綺麗に管理されてました。free-wifiは駐車場からは流石に使えないが、建物近くなら24時間使用可能。最寄りのコンビニは深夜営業無し　（たぶん0時〜6時閉店？）すぐ近くに0時まで開いてる飲食店やファミレスあり。車で15分程度で6：00から開いてる温泉が複数、特に辰頭温泉は炭酸の豊富な名湯。熊本市街や阿蘇などに近く人も多くないので観光の拠点としてとても便利。ただ近くに畜舎があるのか自分が泊まった時はそれなりに臭いあり、車内に居て窓を閉め切れば気にならないが、窓を開けて過ごすのは辛そう。と言う訳で夏場は避けた方が良いかも。（2021年10月）
■幹線国道沿いだが、建物の裏手に静かな駐車場あり。wimaxもOK。レストランでは地元の牛肉を使ったステーキや焼き肉を食べられる。ファミマも隣接。非常に良いですここ。車中泊に適した道の駅。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■5ch Report: Michi-no-Eki Asahi-shi, I stayed there the other day, so here are my impressions. It's along a main road, but there's a parking lot further back away from the road, and since no trucks come in there, it's quiet. The toilets have bidets and are kept very clean. Free Wi-Fi isn't available in the parking lot, but it's available 24 hours a day near the building. The nearest convenience store doesn't have late-night hours (probably closes between midnight and 6am?), but there are restaurants and family restaurants nearby that are open until midnight. There are several hot springs that open from 6am within a 15-minute drive, and Tatsugashira Onsen in particular is a famous hot spring rich in carbon dioxide. It's close to Kumamoto city and Aso, and not crowded, so it's very convenient as a base for sightseeing. However, there seems to be a livestock shed nearby, and when I stayed there there was a noticeable smell. It wasn't noticeable if you stayed in the car with the windows closed, but it would be unpleasant to stay with the windows open. So, it might be better to avoid it in the summer. (October 2021)
■Located along a main national highway, but there is a quiet parking lot behind the building. WiMAX is available. The restaurant serves steaks and yakiniku (Japanese BBQ) made with local beef. There's also a FamilyMart convenience store next door. This place is excellent. A roadside station suitable for overnight stays in your car. (Older post from before 2019)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■5chレポート：道の駅 なんごう。道の駅の駐車場は狭いが、隣の植物園駐車場停められる。駐車場全体に微妙な傾斜があり、気になる人には辛いかも。トイレは清掃管理がしっかりしてる印象、駐車場ではフリーWiFi不可。近場に飲食店、コンビニ、ガソスタは無い。夏場はヤバいほど人が多いとか、深夜までバイカーが居るとか聞いていたが、冬場はかなり静かな上、明かりも少ない、星がとても綺麗。（投稿：2022年2月）
properties.desc_en: ■5ch Report: Michi-no-Eki Nangou. The roadside station's parking lot is small, but you can park in the adjacent botanical garden's parking lot. The entire parking lot has a slight slope, which might be difficult for some people. The toilets seem to be well-maintained and clean, but free Wi-Fi is not available in the parking lot. There are no restaurants, convenience stores, or gas stations nearby. I had heard that it gets incredibly crowded in the summer and that bikers stay there until late at night, but in winter it is quite quiet, there are few lights, and the stars are very beautiful. (Posted: February 2022)

properties.label: Roadside Station
properties.desc_ja: ■5chレポート：東九州道路の無料区画の下道にあるため運送トラックがほぼ来ない、その為非常に静か。トイレもとても清潔でウォシュレット有、EV充電スポットもある。夜間もある程度照明があり真っ暗にはならない。また、駐車場の隅からでも無料WiFiが届き非常に快適。すぐ近くではないが車で5分ほどの距離にコンビニ・ガソリンスタンドがあり。近くに温泉施設が無いのはやや不便か。近場に海水浴場が多く、秋・冬はサーフィンを楽しむ人も多いよう。注意点として道の駅裏手が病院なので、夜間はアイドリング厳禁、駐車場では静かに過ごす事。（これに対して、「そこ曜日や祝日次第で走り屋集まるし、夏は夏でまた集まる。たまたま季節が良いんだよ。」とのレスもあり。）（2021年12月）
properties.desc_en: ■5ch Report: Located on the lower road of the free section of the Higashi-Kyushu Expressway, so there are almost no delivery trucks, making it very quiet. The toilets are very clean and have bidet functions, and there is also an EV charging spot. There is some lighting at night, so it doesn't get completely dark. Also, free WiFi reaches even from the corner of the parking lot, making it very convenient. There is a convenience store and a gas station about a 5-minute drive away, though not right next door. The lack of nearby hot spring facilities is a slight inconvenience. There are many beaches nearby, and it seems that many people enjoy surfing in the fall and winter. A point to note is that there is a hospital behind the roadside station, so idling is strictly prohibited at night, and people should be quiet in the parking lot. (In response to this, there was a comment that said, "Depending on the day of the week and holidays, street racers gather there, and they gather again in the summer. It just happens to be a good season.") (December 2021)

■当サイト読者様レポート：2024年5月10日～5月20日にかけて昼夜で数回ずつ休憩。現在はwiki記述と異なり複数改造車DQNグループの溜まり場になっているようで、平日休日問わず夜半にはクルマ、バイク連合の珍走団が15～20台？ほど入れ代わり立ち代わりで集まり、ヤンキー男女が徒党を組んで場内外を闊歩したり大騒ぎしていて、治安的にとても危険だと感じました。比較的静かと書いてあった裏の臨時駐車場も周辺を改造車、改造バイクが耳栓を貫くジェットエンジン並みの超絶爆音で何時間もぐるぐると徘徊していたため、休憩しても心が休まりませんでした。トイレ前を中心に建物周辺に若い子たちの集団が十数人でいくつもグループを作って集まっていたのですが、パスワード不要の無料Wi-Fi電波がいちばん強いからだと思います。一応、夜中午前3～4時過ぎには珍走団はいなくなりましたが、幹線道路を爆音を響かせながら疾走しているのが何km離れていても聞こえるので、車中泊には大変不向きな場所になってしまったと感じました。（投稿：2024年5月、m様）
■幹線国道沿いだが夜間は交通量少なくわりと静か。駐車場は広く、トラック駐車場とも距離があるのでアイドリング音はそこまで気にならない。トイレもウォシュレットできれい。ココなかなか良いです。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■Administrator's On-Site Verification, February 2025: Car Camping Rating [Good 😊] 71 points 👉️Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■Report from a Reader of This Site: I took several breaks during the day and night from May 10th to May 20th, 2024. Currently, contrary to the wiki description, it seems to have become a hangout for multiple modified car delinquent groups. Regardless of whether it's a weekday or weekend, around 15-20 cars and motorcycles of a combined gang gather there at midnight, coming and going. Delinquent men and women roam around the grounds in groups, making a lot of noise, and I felt it was very dangerous in terms of public safety. Even the temporary parking lot in the back, which was described as relatively quiet, was constantly being patrolled by modified cars and motorcycles making an incredibly loud noise that pierced my earplugs, so I couldn't relax even when I took a break. There were several groups of about a dozen young people gathered around the building, mainly in front of the toilets, probably because the free Wi-Fi signal (no password required) was the strongest there. Although the biker gangs were gone by 3-4 AM, the loud noise of their engines speeding down the main road could be heard from several kilometers away, making it a very unsuitable place for overnight stays in a car. (Posted by m, May 2024)
■Although it's along a main national highway, traffic is light at night and it's relatively quiet. The parking lot is spacious, and there's enough distance from the truck parking area that the idling noise isn't too bothersome. The toilets are clean and have bidet functions. This place is pretty good. (Older post from before 2019)

■当サイト読者様レポート：道の駅・日向　に　2021年11月16日に車中泊しましたので、近況を報告します。併設されている「日向サンパーク」内の入浴施設，レストランは、2020年9月30日以降現在も休業中です。2002年7月1日のオープン以降、18年連続の赤字経営，施設の老朽化に加えて、コロナ禍で107日間の臨時休業を強いられ、休業を決断したとのことです。他の施設（オートキャンプ場や体育施設）は、引き続き運営しているので、入浴施設，レストランは「休業中」と表現していますが、新たな運営会社が名乗りを上げない限り再開は不可能と思うので、事実上の廃業と言えそうです。（投稿：2022年1月、m様）
■道路を挟んで駐車場が2ヶ所あり、車中泊車もちらほらいて安心。トイレ24時間点灯キレイ・自販機多数・眺め最高。トイレは遠くなるが、奥の駐車場で車中泊すると非常に静か。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■温泉は残念ながら事実上の廃業。詳細

■Report from a Reader of This Site: I stayed overnight in my car at Michi-no-Eki Hyuga on November 16, 2021, so I'd like to report on the current situation. The bathing facilities and restaurant within the adjacent "Hyuga Sun Park" have been closed since September 30, 2020, and remain closed to this day. Since opening on July 1, 2002, they have been operating at a loss for 18 consecutive years, and in addition to the aging of the facilities, they were forced to close temporarily for 107 days due to the COVID-19 pandemic, leading to the decision to close permanently. Other facilities (auto campground and sports facilities) continue to operate, so the bathing facilities and restaurant are described as "closed," but unless a new operating company steps forward, it seems impossible for them to reopen, so it can be said that they have effectively gone out of business. (Posted: January 2022, by M)
■There are two parking lots across the road, and there are a few cars parked overnight, so it feels safe. The toilets are clean and have 24-hour lighting, there are many vending machines, and the view is great. The toilets are further away, but it's very quiet if you park your car overnight in the back parking lot. (Older post from before 2019)

■ Report from a Reader of This Site: I recently visited "Michi-no-Eki Nagayu Onsen" (details) in Oita Prefecture, and I would like to report that there were some discrepancies with the existing information. The toilets at this roadside station are only available during the roadside station's operating hours (9:00 to 17:00), and there was a sign instructing visitors to use the toilets at the tourist information center about 100m away at other times. The tourist information center's toilets are clean and available 24 hours a day, which is good, but unfortunately, there was a sign in front of them that said "No car camping at roadside stations." The tourist information center also has a parking lot, and it may be referring to that parking lot (there were no warnings at all in the roadside station's parking lot), but it might be best to refrain from car camping. I'm reporting this because it is currently ranked A. (Posted: April 2023, by Y)
■Report from our site's reader: I always find your site helpful. Here's some information. You can stay at a roadside station with a hot spring in Nagayu Onsen, Oita Prefecture. 2. It is away from the main road, so there is little traffic, and no large trucks pass by. The parking lot is flat, making it a quiet and comfortable place to camp in your car. ■当サイト読者様レポート：先日利用しましたが、深夜になると違法改造車が破裂音が鳴り響かせたりトイレ付近に陣取った20名ほどの若者達が延々お喋りしたりと、相変わらずの状況でした。以前は週末になるとキャンピングカーの利用者も多かったのですが、今ではすっかり見られなくなっています。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■当サイト読者様レポート：車中泊には不向きな道の駅です。場所的にはいいのですが、夜から深夜にかけて改造車や改造バイクが集まります。バイクはエンジンの空ぶかし、改造車はマフラーの改造や大音量スピーカーで音を鳴らし、深夜２時〜３時くらいまで駐車場内を走り回ります。実際に今年２０１７年５月１８日(木)夜に車中泊をしたのですが、うるさいし寝られないしで、大変迷惑でした。車中泊車はキャンピングカーはじめ１０台程度いましたが、朝、他の方とお話ししたのですが、この道の駅は使えないねという話になりました。休憩室のガラス戸等に、禁止事項として「夜遅くのミーティング等の 禁止」という張り紙がありましたがこのことのようでした。これから車中泊したり夜トイレ等利用する方は、止めておいたほう良いと思います。新しい道の駅ですが残念ですね。鹿児島では道の駅に放火された事件等もありますから、注意が必要です。東海地方からの一車中泊人より。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■2016年4月オープン。佐世保に道の駅誕生。
properties.desc_en:
■Administrator's On-Site Verification, December 2025: Car Camping Rating [Rank B] ​​67 points 👉️Click here for photos and detailed map of the site
■Report from a Reader of This Site: I used it the other day, but it was the same as always. Illegally modified cars were making loud popping noises late at night, and about 20 young people were chatting endlessly near the toilets. Previously, there were many campervan users on weekends, but now they are no longer seen at all. (Older post from before 2019)
■Report from a Reader of This Site: This roadside station is unsuitable for car camping. The location is good, but modified cars and motorcycles gather from night until late at night. Motorcycles rev their engines, and modified cars make noise with modified mufflers and loud speakers, driving around the parking lot until around 2 or 3 in the morning. I actually car camped there on the night of May 18th, 2017 (Thursday), and it was very noisy and I couldn't sleep, which was a great nuisance. There were about 10 vehicles parked there for overnight stays, including campervans, but when I spoke with other people in the morning, we agreed that this roadside station is unusable. There was a sign on the glass door of the rest area prohibiting "late-night meetings, etc.," and it seemed this was the reason. I think anyone planning to stay overnight in their vehicle or use the toilets at night should refrain from doing so. It's a shame, considering it's a new roadside station. There have been incidents of arson at roadside stations in Kagoshima, so caution is necessary. From a person who stayed overnight in their vehicle from the Tokai region. (Old post from before 2019)
■Opened in April 2016. A roadside station opens in Sasebo.

properties.desc_ja:
■2000円、詳細。 温泉マニア絶賛。
■湯治湯として非常に有名。泉質：ｐH2.8の単純酸性硫黄温泉（硫化水素型）。駐車場：120台。露天風呂・内湯・家族湯など。浴槽の底から温泉が湧き出る混浴のすずめの湯（20：30〜21：30は女性専用）が最も有名。内湯（元湯）には石鹸・シャワー・シャンプー・ドライヤー（無料）あり。※山奥なので離合が厳しい細い山道を登ります。また天候・気温等の条件によっては霧などで視界を遮られる場合があります。運転には十分にお気を付け下さい。※111号線阿蘇パノラマライン側からの登山道は通行止で行けません。※混浴はすずめの湯だけです。
■管理人評価★5（泉質4.6！、景色0.4）ここはとにかく泉質が凄い。名物のすずめの湯は、濃厚な乳青白色で、なんと足下湧出。ぬるめが39度、熱めが45度らしい。こんな都合の良い温度で、この極上の濁り湯が足下から湧いているというのは奇跡というほかない。個人的には、泉質部門ではここのすずめの湯が日本最高峰かと思います。かなり感動。特別加算で泉質4.6と評価。景色の方は、絶景は無いのですが、まあ気持ちの良い露天風呂という感じです。全体の湯治場の雰囲気などを評価して、景色は0.4評価。合計5点満点。ちなみに九州で複数の温泉マニアと話をしましたが、清風荘の名前は必ず出てきますね。名実そろった名湯と思います。
properties.desc_en:
■2000 yen, details. Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts.

■Extremely famous as a therapeutic hot spring. Spring quality: Simple acidic sulfur spring (hydrogen sulfide type) with a pH of 2.8. Parking: 120 cars. Open-air bath, indoor bath, family bath, etc. The most famous is the mixed-gender Suzume-no-Yu (women only from 8:30 PM to 9:30 PM), where the hot spring water bubbles up from the bottom of the bathtub. The indoor bath (Motoyu) has soap, showers, shampoo, and hair dryers (free of charge). *Since it is deep in the mountains, you will be driving up a narrow mountain road where passing is difficult. Also, depending on the weather and temperature, visibility may be obstructed by fog, etc. Please drive carefully. *The hiking trail from the Route 111 Aso Panorama Line side is closed and inaccessible. *Only Suzume-no-Yu is a mixed-gender bath.

■Manager's rating ★5 (Spring quality 4.6!, Scenery 0.4) The spring quality here is simply amazing. The famous Suzume-no-Yu is a rich milky blue-white color, and surprisingly, the water bubbles up from the ground. The lukewarm temperature is apparently 39 degrees Celsius, and the hotter temperature is 45 degrees Celsius. It's nothing short of a miracle that this superb cloudy hot spring water is bubbling up from beneath your feet at such a convenient temperature. Personally, I think Suzume-no-Yu here is the best in Japan in terms of water quality. I was quite impressed. I gave it a special bonus of 4.6 for water quality. As for the scenery, there isn't a spectacular view, but it's a nice open-air bath. I gave the scenery a 0.4, considering the overall atmosphere of the hot spring resort. Total score out of 5. By the way, I spoke with several hot spring enthusiasts in Kyushu, and the name Seifuso always came up. I think it's a truly excellent hot spring in every sense of the word.

■岩の中から源泉が湧出している足元湧出温泉（極めて珍しい）。※同じ浴槽を2つの旅館で使用しています。白木川川内温泉山荘または旭屋旅館のどちらかで入浴受付をして下さい。
■管理人評価★4.6（泉質4.4、景色0.2）泉質は無色透明だが香りと味が濃厚、岩の間から42度のお湯が染み出している奇跡の温泉である。4.4。窓の外は渓流で山の斜面が見える。渓流の音が心地よい。0.2。合計4.6点の極上。なお、ここの「山荘」と「旭屋」は兄弟が経営者らしく、この温泉の権利を巡って裁判までやって仲が悪いらしい。風呂には、「旭屋にお金を払うべし」という落書きが書かれている。なお、坂の上の方が「旭屋」。日本昔話みたいでおもしろい。
properties.desc_en:
■150 yen, details. Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts.

■A foot-level hot spring where the source water gushes out from within the rocks (extremely rare). *The same bathtub is used by two inns. Please register for bathing at either Shirakigawa Kawauchi Onsen Sanso or Asahiya Ryokan.

■Manager's rating ★4.6 (Water quality 4.4, Scenery 0.2) The water quality is colorless and transparent, but the aroma and taste are rich. It's a miraculous hot spring where 42-degree water seeps out from between the rocks. 4.4. Outside the window, you can see a mountain stream and the slope of the mountain. The sound of the stream is soothing. 0.2. A superb total of 4.6 points. Incidentally, it seems that the "Sanso" and "Asahiya" here are run by brothers, and they are on bad terms, even going to court over the rights to this hot spring. There is graffiti in the bath that says, "You should pay money to Asahiya." Incidentally, "Asahiya" is at the top of the hill. It's interesting, like a Japanese folktale.

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.title_ja: 古湯温泉元湯旅館 鶴霊泉（足元湧出）
properties.title_en: Furuyu Onsen Motoyu Ryokan Tsurureisen (springs from the ground)
properties.desc_ja:
■1000円、詳細
■天然砂湯の温泉で有名な旅館。有名人も多数宿泊。湯船の底にきれいな砂が敷き詰められていて、そこからお湯が湧き上がってくる珍しい温泉（足元湧出という超激レア温泉）。36℃くらいのぬる湯。立ち寄り湯の人は旅館前の駐車スペース利用不可。50ｍくらい離れたところ（大和屋旅館の前）に鶴霊泉利用者用の駐車スペースがあります。
properties.desc_en:
■1000 yen, details
■A ryokan (Japanese inn) famous for its natural sand bath hot spring. Many celebrities have stayed here. The bottom of the bath is covered with beautiful sand, and the hot spring water bubbles up from there, making it a rare hot spring (an extremely rare hot spring where the water bubbles up from your feet). The water is lukewarm at about 36℃. Day visitors cannot use the parking space in front of the ryokan. There is a parking space for Tsurureisen users about 50m away (in front of Yamato-ya Ryokan).

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■1000円、詳細。 多数の温泉マニア絶賛。
■管理人評価★4.7（泉質4.4、景色0.3）青乳白色。源泉は温度が26度程度と低いので加温しているそうですが、濃厚な極上温泉です。
properties.desc_en:
■1000 yen, details. Highly praised by many hot spring enthusiasts.

■Manager's rating ★4.7 (Spring quality 4.4, Scenery 0.3) Blue-milky white. The source water is apparently heated because the temperature is low at around 26 degrees Celsius, but it is a rich, superb hot spring.

properties.label: Paid Campground
properties.desc_ja:
■無料のキャンプ場。 👉️2019年4月から有料化。入り口に無人ゲートが設置され、出るときに料金を払う方式。入場から9時間1000円、18時間1500円。高くなっちゃいました。詳細。有料化のおかげでトイレが建て直され、きれいな水洗洋式になった。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■眼下に福岡市一望できる。トイレは水洗できれい。深夜まで夜景を見に上ってくる爆音DQNがいるので、道路から離れたところがよい。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
■標高386m
properties.desc_en:
■Free campsite. 👉️Became a paid campsite in April 2019. An unmanned gate has been installed at the entrance, and payment is made upon exit. 1000 yen for 9 hours, 1500 yen for 18 hours. It's gotten expensive. Details. Thanks to the introduction of fees, the toilets have been rebuilt and are now clean, flushable Western-style toilets. (Older post from before 2019)
■Offers a panoramic view of Fukuoka City below. The toilets are flushable and clean. There are noisy, rowdy people who come up to see the night view until late at night, so it's best to stay away from the road. (Older post from before 2019)
■Elevation 386m

properties.desc_en:
■Details on fees, usage, etc. (Nogata City Official Website)
■Report from our site's reader: It's inexpensive, but now there's a fee, and it seems the number of plots has increased. Reservations can still be made through the Nogata City website as before (Posted: June 2025, by Shushu-chan)
■The entrance to the auto campsite is locked, and those who apply for use receive the key at the city hall. This prevents unauthorized entry by unscrupulous individuals, making it safe. Also, there's a police station nearby, which is reassuring. (Administrator's on-site verification, March 2021)
■Report from our site's reader: Since it's on a riverbank, it's completely visible from cars passing on the embankment road. Prior application to Nogata City is required. Toilets (simple flush Japanese style, smelly and dirty) are available. (Older post from before 2019)

■当サイト読者様レポート：道の駅・泗水　に　2021年11月10日に車中泊した時の情報をお知らせします。「道の駅に隣接する泗水公園の地下水「孔子泉水」を汲める。」とのこと。確かに、泗水公園には水が豊富に湧き出ていましたが、道の駅の職員さんや近隣にお住いの方に聞いたところ、地元の方々は飲用に利用していないとのことでした。ネットで調べても「飲用可」の情報が見当たりません。「孔子泉水」は汲めますが、飲用は自己責任ということのようです。（投稿：2022年1月、m様）

■Report from our site's reader: Information from a car camping trip at Michi-no-Eki Shisui on November 10, 2021. It was stated that "you can draw groundwater from 'Koshi-sen-sui' in Shisui Park, which is adjacent to the roadside station." Indeed, there was an abundance of water gushing out in Shisui Park, but when I asked the roadside station staff and local residents, they said that locals do not use it for drinking. Even searching online, I couldn't find any information indicating that it is "drinkable." It seems that while you can draw "Koshi-sen-sui," drinking it is at your own risk. (Posted: January 2022, by m)

properties.title_ja: （※トイレが使用不可の可能性あり）県営常盤（南）駐車場
properties.title_en: (※Toilets may be unavailable) Prefectural Tokiwa (South) Parking Lot
properties.desc_ja:
■料金詳細
■当サイト読者様レポート：2024/6/6現在、こちらのサイトで紹介されている長崎　水の庭園と県営常盤（南）駐車場近くのトイレは、入り口にロープがはってあり使用できませんでした。（投稿：2024年6月、m様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：繁華街まで徒歩圏内ながら、夜間は静かな駐車場。トイレは道を渡った公園の公衆トイレが終夜利用可。トイレまで街灯多く懐中電灯不要。3つの駐車場が隣接しているが、全て料金体系が違う。この駐車場は18時〜翌8時まで夜間上限800円、日中は30分100円の上限1000円。ただし車高2.5m以上は大型料金になるため、キャンピングカーは要注意。北側駐車場には夜間料金の設定がなく割高、道の反対側にある水の庭園駐車場は、そちらのレポートにあるとおりスケボー集団がいてうるさい。車中泊も数台あり、特に職質などもなく、治安上の不安も感じない。思案橋で飲んでから格安で寝れるのでよく使っている。（投稿：2023年12月、f様）
properties.desc_en:
■Price Details
■Report from a reader of this site: As of June 6, 2024, the toilets near the Nagasaki Water Garden and the Prefectural Tokiwa (South) parking lot, as introduced on this site, were roped off at the entrance and unusable. (Submitted by: M, June 2024)
■Report from a reader of this site: A quiet parking lot at night, despite being within walking distance of the downtown area. Public toilets in the park across the street are available 24 hours a day. There are many streetlights leading to the toilets, so a flashlight is not necessary. Three parking lots are adjacent to each other, but all have different pricing systems. This parking lot has a night-time maximum of 800 yen from 6 PM to 8 AM the next day, and a daytime maximum of 1000 yen at 100 yen for 30 minutes. However, vehicles over 2.5m in height are charged the large vehicle rate, so campervans should be careful. The north side parking lot does not have a night-time rate and is more expensive. The Water Garden parking lot on the other side of the road is noisy with skateboarders, as mentioned in that report. There are several cars parked overnight, and there have been no police questioning or anything like that, so there are no concerns about safety. I often use this place because I can have a drink in Shianbashi and then sleep there cheaply. (Posted by f, December 2023)

properties.label: Car Camp Spot
properties.title_ja: 樹芸の森 第二駐車場（宿泊キャンプ禁止）
properties.title_en: Tree Art Forest Second Parking Lot (Overnight camping prohibited)
properties.desc_ja:
■※駐車場の前の広場でデイキャンプは可能（無料）だが、宿泊キャンプは禁止なので注意。
■無料駐車場と公衆トイレ。少し傾斜がある。トイレは水洗洋式で非常にキレイ。水場はトイレの横にある（水は飲用不可）。たまに車が通過する。目の前の広場が無料キャンプ場（※宿泊は禁止）になっており、週末はワイワイガヤガヤうるさい。ドコモ電波OK。（2022年1月管理人現地確認）
■当サイト読者様レポート：個人的穴場。昼間は無料のバーベキュースポットとして賑わうが、夜間はほとんど車が通らず大変静か。近くに民家があるためアイドリングは絶対禁止。トイレは水洗で綺麗だが、電灯が無いため夜間は要ライトorランタン。ダムを望む景観が最高で、朝起き抜けに広場の公園で景色を眺めながらコーヒーを飲むと至福の一時。温泉は麓にあるオアシス篠栗で、人工温泉だが湯質もよく格安、330円。（投稿：2020年12月、A様）
properties.desc_en:
■*Day camping is possible (free) in the open area in front of the parking lot, but overnight camping is prohibited, so please be aware.

■Free parking and public toilets. There is a slight slope. The toilets are flush toilets and very clean. There is a water source next to the toilets (the water is not potable). Cars pass by occasionally. The open area in front is a free campsite (*overnight stays are prohibited), and it gets noisy on weekends. Docomo signal is OK. (Confirmed on-site by the administrator in January 2022)

■Report from a reader of this site: A personal hidden gem. It is a lively free barbecue spot during the day, but at night there are hardly any cars and it is very quiet. Idling is strictly prohibited as there are houses nearby. The toilets are flush toilets and clean, but there are no lights, so a flashlight or lantern is necessary at night. The view overlooking the dam is superb, and drinking coffee while enjoying the view in the park in the open area first thing in the morning is a blissful moment. The hot spring is Oasis Sasaguri at the foot of the mountain; it is an artificial hot spring, but the water quality is good and it is cheap at 330 yen. (Posted by: Ms. A, December 2020)

properties.label: Famous Hot Spring
properties.desc_ja:
■【立ち入り禁止】温泉マニア絶賛。野湯界の西日本横綱と称される温泉。管理人も行ってきました。このマップで正確な位置にマークを置いていますので参考にしてください。
■管理人評価★5（泉質4.5、景色0.5）ただただ、凄い。凄すぎる。「最強の野湯」の名は伊達ではない。まず泉質は青みがかった酸性泉で、熱泉が川の水と混じってやや熱めの適温になっている。これが奇跡的。何も言うことない極上。そして景色も、地獄が一望できる絶景。川の向こう側では、穴からシューっと硫黄の噴気が勢いよく吹き出している。大自然の奇跡がここに現出している。管理人は思わず、手を合わせてしまいました。まさに湯の聖域（サンクチュアリ）。感動の満点評価です。ちなみに、虫が出るのでキンチョール持参推奨。
properties.desc_en:
■【No Entry】Highly praised by hot spring enthusiasts. This hot spring is considered the Yokozuna (grand champion) of wild hot springs in Western Japan. I, the administrator, have also visited. I have marked its exact location on this map, so please use it as a reference.

■Administrator's Rating ★5 (Spring Quality 4.5, Scenery 0.5) Simply amazing. Absolutely incredible. The title of "Strongest Wild Hot Spring" is well-deserved. First, the spring water is a bluish acidic spring, and the hot spring water mixes with the river water to create a slightly hot, just-right temperature. This is miraculous. It's superb, nothing more to say. And the scenery is also spectacular, offering a panoramic view of hell. On the other side of the river, sulfurous steam is forcefully spewing out of a hole. A miracle of nature is manifested here. I, the administrator, couldn't help but put my hands together in prayer. Truly a sanctuary of hot springs. A perfect score of感動 (deep emotion). By the way, insects are present, so bringing insect repellent is recommended.

properties.desc_ja:
■【下道用ウェルカムゲート 上下24時間OK】
■当サイト読者様レポート：ウエルカムゲート（下り）について。利用者も少なかったが、深夜、改造車の排気音のような音が定期的に響いてきて寝ずらかった。ＳＡの施設関係の音かと思い発信地を探しましたが見つかりませんでした。たまたまかな？コンビニも１キロ圏内に有り便利です。（投稿：2023年12月、山びこ様）
■当サイト読者様レポート：フードコート・売店24h営業。（投稿：2021年2月、N様）
■ 広くて非常に良い、ハイウェイオアシス側にいけばトラックもおらず非常に静か。（2019年以前の古い投稿）
properties.desc_en:
■ [Welcome Gate for Local Roads, Open 24 Hours (Both Directions)]
■ Reader Report: Regarding the Welcome Gate (downbound). There were few users, but late at night, a sound like the exhaust of a modified car echoed periodically, making it difficult to sleep. I thought it might be a sound related to the service area facilities and tried to find the source, but I couldn't find it. Was it just a coincidence? There's also a convenience store within a 1km radius, which is convenient. (Posted: December 2023, Yamabiko)
■ Reader Report: Food court and shops are open 24 hours. (Posted: February 2021, N)
■ Spacious and very good. If you go towards the highway oasis side, there are no trucks and it's very quiet. (Older post from before 2019)
